01:10:14,857 --> 01:10:17,232
mais ces huit jours là-bas,

1338
01:10:17,811 --> 01:10:20,480
ça n'a pas été une partie de plaisir
d'être une Paria.

1339
01:10:21,059 --> 01:10:23,792
Sandra, tu as toujours
été honnête avec moi.

1340
01:10:23,917 --> 01:10:26,128
Ma question pour toi est :

1341
01:10:26,253 --> 01:10:28,855
penses-tu t'être collée
aux basques de quelqu'un ?

1342
01:10:28,980 --> 01:10:30,655
Dans le sens, où peut-être...

1343
01:10:30,780 --> 01:10:34,169
T'es-tu servie d'une personne
pour avancer ?

1344
01:10:34,294 --> 01:10:36,905
Je n'ai jamais collé
aux basques de personne.

1345
01:10:37,030 --> 01:10:39,264
Au début, je me sentais seule.

1346
01:10:39,389 --> 01:10:41,110
Rupert aussi.

1347
01:10:41,235 --> 01:10:44,646
Je me suis rapprochée de lui
et de Christa,

1348
01:10:44,896 --> 01:10:46,696
et on a formé une alliance.

1349
01:10:47,040 --> 01:10:49,751
Et Rupert est parti tôt dans le jury.

1350
01:10:49,876 --> 01:10:52,443
Alors, après son départ,
j'aurais collé aux basques de qui

1351
01:10:52,568 --> 01:10:54,181
quand Rupert n'était plus là ?

1352
01:10:54,306 --> 01:10:56,250
Je n'ai collé aux basques de personne

1353
01:10:56,375 --> 01:10:58,051
puisque je suis toujours là.

1354
01:10:58,771 --> 01:11:01,063
D'accord. Je suis satisfait.

1355
01:11:01,188 --> 01:11:02,289
Ça me va.

1356
01:11:02,414 --> 01:11:03,799
Bien.
Merci, Ryno.

1357
01:11:05,859 --> 01:11:06,867
Rupert.

1358
01:11:11,300 --> 01:11:13,000
Félicitations à toutes les deux.

1359
01:11:13,125 --> 01:11:14,743
- Merci.
- Merci, Rupert.

1360
01:11:14,868 --> 01:11:16,745
Je suis impressionné et fier de vous.

1361
01:11:16,870 --> 01:11:18,630
- Merci.
- Vous êtes arrivées au bout.

1362
01:11:19,801 --> 01:11:21,183
Pour toi, Lill...

1363
01:11:22,231 --> 01:11:24,562
J'étais aussi scout dans ma jeunesse.

1364
01:11:24,687 --> 01:11:26,657
Je connais le serment
et les principes.

1365
01:11:26,782 --> 01:11:28,715
Je sais comment un scout
doit se comporter.

1366
01:11:29,572 --> 01:11:30,756
Affirmer

1367
01:11:31,343 --> 01:11:33,987
que tu ne vas pas avoir
ce comportement car c'est un jeu,

1368
01:11:34,309 --> 01:11:37,866
ou te servir du jeu

1369
01:11:38,116 --> 01:11:40,836
pour te détourner de ces principes...

1370
01:11:42,128 --> 01:11:43,872
J'ai l'impression que,

1371
01:11:43,997 --> 01:11:46,872
hormis le premier jour de la fusion,

1372
01:11:48,208 --> 01:11:50,237
tu n'as fait que me mentir.

1373
01:11:50,964 --> 01:11:52,881
Tout ce que tu as dit,

1374
01:11:53,131 --> 01:11:54,783
c'était des bobards

1375
01:11:55,033 --> 01:11:56,602
pour m'embobiner,

1376
01:11:56,727 --> 01:11:59,087
jusqu'au jour où j'ai été...

1377
01:11:59,770 --> 01:12:02,758
éjecté du jeu,
tu continuais de me mentir.

1378
01:12:04,885 --> 01:12:06,928
As-tu été honnête avec moi ?
Et quand ?

1379
01:12:07,053 --> 01:12:08,182
Si oui,

1380
01:12:08,307 --> 01:12:10,991
donne-moi un exemple
de ton honnêteté envers moi.

1381
01:12:11,409 --> 01:12:12,611
Tout de suite...

1382
01:12:12,736 --> 01:12:16,104
Tout était honnête
avant que Burton vienne me dire :

1383
01:12:16,229 --> 01:12:17,947
"Il faut virer Rupert."

1384
01:12:18,072 --> 01:12:19,741
- Lill...
- Oui ?

1385
01:12:20,401 --> 01:12:23,612
"Tout était honnête.",
ça ne m'avance pas.

1386
01:12:23,862 --> 01:12:25,935
Tu accuses Burton à ta place...

1387
01:12:26,060 --> 01:12:27,983
Non, j'ai souvent été honnête...

1388
01:12:28,108 --> 01:12:29,710
- Un exemple.
- Quand toi et moi,

1389
01:12:29,835 --> 01:12:32,187
on était dans l'eau, on parlait.

1390
01:12:32,312 --> 01:12:35,287
On a parlé de nos familles,
de nos vies,

1391
01:12:35,526 --> 01:12:37,989
de notre dévouement à la jeunesse.

1392
01:12:38,658 --> 01:12:41,396
Tout ça, c'était honnête.
Tout était sincère.

1393
01:12:43,401 --> 01:12:45,678
- Vous n'aurez rien de plus, Rupert.
- Je crois aussi.

1394
01:12:45,803 --> 01:12:47,461
Rupert, votre question pour Sandra.

1395
01:12:47,793 --> 01:12:48,795
Sandra,

1396
01:12:48,920 --> 01:12:50,430
ma question pour toi :

1397
01:12:50,555 --> 01:12:52,307
le 27e jour,

1398
01:12:52,557 --> 01:12:54,341
quand j'ai été viré du jeu,

1399
01:12:54,466 --> 01:12:56,069
étais-tu au courant ?

1400
01:12:56,194 --> 01:12:58,480
- Je veux juste savoir ça.
- D'accord.

1401
01:12:59,182 --> 01:13:01,783
Ce jour-là, lors du vote,

1402
01:13:01,908 --> 01:13:03,752
j'ignorais que tu serais éliminé.

1403
01:13:03,877 --> 01:13:05,487
J'étais furieuse contre Jon.

1404
01:13:05,612 --> 01:13:07,739
J'ignorais tout.
J'ai voté contre lui, pensant :

1405
01:13:08,100 --> 01:13:10,959
"Peu importe,
tout le monde va voter Darrah.

1406
01:13:11,084 --> 01:13:13,920
Je peux bien voter contre Jon,
ça n'aura aucun impact."

1407
01:13:14,045 --> 01:13:16,319
Quand avec Christa
on est revenu dans la tribu,

1408
01:13:16,444 --> 01:13:17,758
j'ai pété un câble.

1409
01:13:17,883 --> 01:13:19,974
Je jurais,
j'étais furieuse, je hurlais :

1410
01:13:20,099 --> 01:13:21,995
"Comment vous avez pu
faire ça à Rupert ?"

1411
01:13:22,120 --> 01:13:24,072
Je n'étais pas au courant
que tu partirais.

1412
01:13:24,197 --> 01:13:26,117
Mais souviens-toi,
je t'ai toujours dit :

1413
01:13:26,242 --> 01:13:28,468
"Jon est une vipère.
Il se trame quelque chose.

1414
01:13:28,593 --> 01:13:30,677
Y'a un truc qui cloche."
Et qu'as-tu répondu ?

1415
01:13:30,802 --> 01:13:32,368
"Drake jusqu'à la mort.

1416
01:13:32,493 --> 01:13:34,623
On vit pour Drake.
Alliance ceci, alliance cela."

1417
01:13:34,748 --> 01:13:36,089
Et regarde le résultat.

1418
01:13:36,214 --> 01:13:37,775
- Je sais.
- Ça te va ?

1419
01:13:38,537 --> 01:13:39,546
Oui.

1420
01:13:39,671 --> 01:13:40,822
Je l'ignorais.

1421
01:13:41,586 --> 01:13:43,325
- Merci.
- Je t'en prie.

1422
01:13:43,450 --> 01:13:44,583
Merci, Rupert.

1423
01:13:46,042 --> 01:13:47,043
T.

1424
01:13:51,483 --> 01:13:52,701
Salut, mesdames.

1425
01:13:52,826 --> 01:13:55,034
- Salut.
- Tout d'abord, félicitations.

1426
01:13:55,159 --> 01:13:57,285
J'ai une importante question

1427
01:13:57,410 --> 01:14:00,709
pour déterminer
qui aura mon vote pour le million.

1428
01:14:00,959 --> 01:14:02,477
Ma question est :

1429
01:14:02,602 --> 01:14:04,538
donnez-moi une raison pour laquelle

1430
01:14:04,663 --> 01:14:08,108
votre adversaire ne mérite pas
de gagner un million, et vous oui.

1431
01:14:08,470 --> 01:14:10,519
Commençons par Lill.

1432
01:14:10,644 --> 01:14:11,713
Pardonne-moi.

1433
01:14:11,838 --> 01:14:14,489
Non, tu dois dire
une vacherie sur moi. Vas-y.

1434
01:14:18,018 --> 01:14:20,274
J'avais l'impression, quelques fois,

1435
01:14:20,609 --> 01:14:23,223
que Sandra manquait de respect
à beaucoup de gens.

1436
01:14:23,756 --> 01:14:25,425
De nombreuses fois,

1437
01:14:25,550 --> 01:14:28,737
elle m'a traité
de c-o-n-n-a-s-s-e, par exemple.

1438
01:14:30,556 --> 01:14:32,341
De nombreuses fois,

1439
01:14:32,591 --> 01:14:36,436
elle collait aux basques de certains.

1440
01:14:36,958 --> 01:14:38,947
Elle répétait toujours :

1441
01:14:39,756 --> 01:14:41,374
"Dites-moi quoi faire."

1442
01:14:41,990 --> 01:14:45,020
Parfois, je voulais lui dire :

1443
01:14:45,145 --> 01:14:47,222
"Tu ne peux pas penser par toi-même

1444
01:14:47,958 --> 01:14:49,691
et réfléchir par toi-même ?"

1445
01:14:50,346 --> 01:14:53,296
C'est tout.
Je n'en dirai pas plus.

1446
01:14:53,421 --> 01:14:54,654
Ça me va.
Merci.

1447
01:14:54,779 --> 01:14:55,794
Sandra.

1448
01:14:55,919 --> 01:14:57,255
Une bonne raison ?

1449
01:14:57,380 --> 01:14:59,601
Car Lill est responsable
de l'élimination

1450
01:14:59,851 --> 01:15:02,198
de chaque personne ici.

1451
01:15:02,787 --> 01:15:05,432
Chacun de vous
a reçu un vote de Lill.

1452
01:15:06,499 --> 01:15:08,335
Christa, je n'ai jamais
voté contre toi.

1453
01:15:08,460 --> 01:15:10,387
Je ne t'ai pas éliminée.

1454
01:15:10,770 --> 01:15:12,657
Rupert, je ne t'ai pas éliminé.

1455
01:15:13,632 --> 01:15:14,941
C'est la seule chose,

1456
01:15:15,066 --> 01:15:17,719
car c'est une grosse bosseuse.
Tout ce que je peux dire,

1457
01:15:17,844 --> 01:15:20,255
c'est que vous êtes tous là
par sa faute.

1458
01:15:22,641 --> 01:15:24,526
- Satisfaite ?
- Oui, merci.

1459
01:15:24,651 --> 01:15:25,785
Bonne question.

1460
01:15:27,687 --> 01:15:28,697
Christa.

1461
01:15:32,025 --> 01:15:33,393
Quoi de neuf, les meufs ?

1462
01:15:34,101 --> 01:15:35,570
Bien, les rocks-stars.

1463
01:15:37,945 --> 01:15:40,066
Lill, ma première question
est pour toi.

1464
01:15:40,191 --> 01:15:43,512
Tu répétais toujours :
"Je suis désolée, désolée, désolée."

1465
01:15:44,054 --> 01:15:45,338
Et... pour tout.

1466
01:15:45,463 --> 01:15:47,607
Tu gagnais, tu disais :
"Je suis désolée."

1467
01:15:48,504 --> 01:15:50,051
Et deux secondes après,

1468
01:15:50,176 --> 01:15:52,512
tu récitais ton serment scout.

1469
01:15:52,985 --> 01:15:54,381
Tu te cachais toujours

1470
01:15:54,506 --> 01:15:56,725
derrière ton serment scout.

1471
01:15:56,850 --> 01:15:58,952
À quoi ça rimait ?
Quel en était le but ?

1472
01:15:59,489 --> 01:16:02,964
Bien, quand t'ai-je dit
que j'étais désolée ?

1473
01:16:04,238 --> 01:16:05,725
"Je suis désolée...

1474
01:16:06,336 --> 01:16:07,903
d'avoir éliminé Rupert."

1475
01:16:08,028 --> 01:16:09,383
"Je suis désolée...

1476
01:16:10,297 --> 01:16:12,499
de gagner telle récompense."
C'était tout le temps.

1477
01:16:12,624 --> 01:16:15,812
Sur ces deux exemples,
j'étais sincèrement désolée.

1478
01:16:15,937 --> 01:16:18,438
Ça m'a beaucoup coûté
d'éliminer Rupert.

1479
01:16:19,070 --> 01:16:22,442
Mais je devais suivre
mon alliance sur ce coup-là.

1480
01:16:22,743 --> 01:16:25,912
Je ne me planquais pas
derrière le serment toute la journée.

1481
01:16:26,037 --> 01:16:28,367
J'ai fait 16 ans de bénévolat.

1482
01:16:28,492 --> 01:16:31,768
C'étaient mes seuls vêtements.
Je les portais.

1483
01:16:31,893 --> 01:16:34,187
J'étais coincée dedans.
Ils faisaient partie de moi.

1484
01:16:34,312 --> 01:16:36,865
C'est à cause des vêtements
que tu portais...

1485
01:16:36,990 --> 01:16:41,014
À cause de 16 ans de bénévolat
dans une association.

1486
01:16:41,139 --> 01:16:42,963
Ça fait vraiment partie de moi.

1487
01:16:43,088 --> 01:16:45,373
La première fois que j'ai menti,

1488
01:16:45,498 --> 01:16:46,786
c'était à Rupert.

1489
01:16:47,392 --> 01:16:49,302
C'était la toute première fois.

1490
01:16:49,427 --> 01:16:51,480
Et je me suis rendu compte

1491
01:16:51,605 --> 01:16:54,783
que sans mentir,
je ne ferais pas long feu.

1492
01:16:54,908 --> 01:16:55,910
Donc...

1493
01:16:57,269 --> 01:16:58,907
J'imagine que c'est tout ?

1494
01:16:59,032 --> 01:17:01,790
Sandra, comme on passait
beaucoup de temps ensemble,

1495
01:17:02,040 --> 01:17:05,093
j'entendais toujours
les idées insensées

1496
01:17:05,218 --> 01:17:07,095
que tu imaginais, tu me disais :

1497
01:17:07,220 --> 01:17:09,055
"Suis le plan !
Assieds-toi, Christa !"

1498
01:17:09,180 --> 01:17:10,824
Et peu de gens savaient vraiment

1499
01:17:10,949 --> 01:17:13,259
que tu imaginais ces plans insensés.

1500
01:17:13,726 --> 01:17:16,338
Je me demandais, quel a été...

1501
01:17:16,588 --> 01:17:20,440
ton complot ou ta combine
la plus difficile

1502
01:17:20,565 --> 01:17:22,502
pour rester dans le jeu ?

1503
01:17:23,020 --> 01:17:24,679
Ma plus folle combine

1504
01:17:24,804 --> 01:17:27,849
a été de me cacher
derrière les buissons avec Tijuana

1505
01:17:27,974 --> 01:17:29,885
et d'espionner les ragots.

1506
01:17:30,010 --> 01:17:32,454
À ce moment-là,
elle était officiellement

1507
01:17:32,579 --> 01:17:34,812
alliée avec Jon et Burton,

1508
01:17:34,937 --> 01:17:37,325
après qu'elle avait dit
qu'en quittant la tribu Morgan,

1509
01:17:37,450 --> 01:17:40,120
elle était alliée
aux deux femmes de Morgan.

1510
01:17:42,373 --> 01:17:43,365
Très bien.

1511
01:17:43,490 --> 01:17:45,433
- Satisfaite ?
- Satisfaite.

1512
01:17:45,558 --> 01:17:46,726
Merci, Christa.

1513
01:17:47,886 --> 01:17:49,126
Burton, à vous.

1514
01:17:52,820 --> 01:17:55,161
Sandra, Lill, félicitations.

1515
01:17:55,560 --> 01:17:57,512
- Merci.
- Le jeu Survivor

1516
01:17:57,762 --> 01:18:00,113
comporte deux aspects, d'après moi.

1517
01:18:00,238 --> 01:18:01,516
L'aspect survie :

1518
01:18:02,011 --> 01:18:05,396
être dans la nature sauvage,
autonome ou avec sa tribu.

1519
01:18:05,801 --> 01:18:07,389
Et l'aspect stratégique.

1520
01:18:07,514 --> 01:18:09,816
Je voulais savoir, niveau survie

1521
01:18:09,941 --> 01:18:11,692
et compétences de survie,

1522
01:18:12,986 --> 01:18:14,667
sur une échelle de 1 à 10, 1 étant :

1523
01:18:14,792 --> 01:18:17,551
"Si on m'abandonnait sur une île,
je mourrais dans la journée",

1524
01:18:17,676 --> 01:18:18,677
et 10 étant :

1525
01:18:18,802 --> 01:18:21,703
"Je survivrais
dans n'importe quelle situation",

1526
01:18:21,828 --> 01:18:23,163
où vous situez-vous ?

1527
01:18:23,288 --> 01:18:25,094
J'attends une honnête
auto-évaluation.

1528
01:18:25,219 --> 01:18:26,524
- Vas-y.
- D'accord.

1529
01:18:26,649 --> 01:18:27,809
D'après moi,

1530
01:18:27,934 --> 01:18:30,901
si j'avais été abandonnée
sur cette même île,

1531
01:18:31,604 --> 01:18:33,696
je me donnerais un cinq,

1532
01:18:33,821 --> 01:18:35,850
simplement pour le fait

1533
01:18:35,975 --> 01:18:37,578
que comme c'est une île tropicale,

1534
01:18:37,703 --> 01:18:41,283
j'aurais su vers quels fruits
et aliments me tourner.

1535
01:18:41,408 --> 01:18:42,849
Après, en ce qui concerne

1536
01:18:42,974 --> 01:18:45,418
le feu ou ce genre de choses,
je ne suis pas douée.

1537
01:18:45,543 --> 01:18:48,976
Mais je m'en serais bien sortie,
du moins, les deux premiers jours.

1538
01:18:49,101 --> 01:18:52,233
Après, je serais sûrement...
morte de faim.

1539
01:18:52,483 --> 01:18:54,928
Car je n'aurais pas mangé
les bernard-l'hermite

1540
01:18:55,053 --> 01:18:56,563
et autres bestioles.

1541
01:18:56,688 --> 01:18:57,698
Cinq.

1542
01:18:58,031 --> 01:18:59,474
Bonne réponse, merci.

1543
01:18:59,599 --> 01:19:01,515
Je me donnerais un sept,

1544
01:19:01,640 --> 01:19:04,533
car je sais faire du feu

1545
01:19:05,096 --> 01:19:06,301
sans allumettes.

1546
01:19:07,634 --> 01:19:11,716
Je suis capable de trouver de l'eau.

1547
01:19:12,331 --> 01:19:16,683
Ce sont des compétences
que j'ai apprises chez les scouts.

1548
01:19:17,413 --> 01:19:19,578
J'étais assidue

1549
01:19:19,703 --> 01:19:22,455
et veillais constamment
à ce que la tribu Morgan

1550
01:19:22,580 --> 01:19:25,213
ait en permanence de l'eau potable,

1551
01:19:25,859 --> 01:19:28,835
et à la faire bouillir
au moins 30 minutes...

1552
01:19:29,240 --> 01:19:31,406
D'accord, d'accord...

1553
01:19:31,531 --> 01:19:33,167
- Ça te va ?
- Je pense que oui.

1554
01:19:33,292 --> 01:19:34,999
- Merci.
- Merci, Lill et Sandra.

1555
01:19:35,504 --> 01:19:36,511
Merci.

1556
01:19:36,636 --> 01:19:37,656
Darrah.

1557
01:19:38,129 --> 01:19:39,741
La scène est à vous.

1558
01:19:43,076 --> 01:19:45,186
Ma question est pour vous deux.

1559
01:19:45,311 --> 01:19:48,143
Expliquez-moi juste comment
vous êtes arrivées jusqu'ici

1560
01:19:48,268 --> 01:19:50,186
et répondez honnêtement.

1561
01:19:50,311 --> 01:19:53,003
La plus honnête aura mon vote.

1562
01:19:53,942 --> 01:19:56,705
D'après moi,
si je suis à cette place,

1563
01:19:56,830 --> 01:19:59,267
c'est que les autres
avaient un autre programme,

1564
01:19:59,392 --> 01:20:02,103
d'autres chats à fouetter.
Sandra n'inquiétait personne,

1565
01:20:02,228 --> 01:20:04,264
car elle était faible,
et je le répète,

1566
01:20:04,389 --> 01:20:06,808
si quelqu'un avait besoin d'un vote,

1567
01:20:06,933 --> 01:20:07,983
j'étais là.

1568
01:20:08,108 --> 01:20:11,171
Tant que ce n'était pas moi,
j'aurais éliminé n'importe qui.

1569
01:20:11,660 --> 01:20:13,415
J'étais toujours là

1570
01:20:13,540 --> 01:20:15,174
pour tirer avantage de la situation

1571
01:20:15,299 --> 01:20:18,016
et détourner les votes
de ma direction.

1572
01:20:18,645 --> 01:20:19,788
Je suis satisfaite.

1573
01:20:19,913 --> 01:20:20,922
Lill.

1574
01:20:21,339 --> 01:20:23,291
Je n'étais pas dangereuse,

1575
01:20:23,416 --> 01:20:24,422
car...

1576
01:20:25,322 --> 01:20:28,263
J'étais plus âgée, pas sportive.

1577
01:20:28,388 --> 01:20:30,265
Oui, j'ai suivi

1578
01:20:30,390 --> 01:20:32,392
certains alliés, et...

1579
01:20:32,517 --> 01:20:36,137
J'ai brisé cette alliance
et me suis alliée à quelqu'un autre

1580
01:20:36,828 --> 01:20:38,917
pour protéger cette personne.

1581
01:20:39,490 --> 01:20:41,816
Je suis à cette place, car...

1582
01:20:42,369 --> 01:20:44,603
Parfois, j'ai suivi

1583
01:20:44,728 --> 01:20:48,016
et parfois, j'ai utilisé ma tête,
en agissant de mon propre chef.

1584
01:20:48,737 --> 01:20:50,210
- Satisfaite ?
- Satisfaite.

1585
01:20:50,335 --> 01:20:51,529
Merci, Darrah.

1586
01:20:53,947 --> 01:20:54,952
Jon.

1587
01:20:55,847 --> 01:20:57,568
Le plus récent éliminé.

1588
01:20:58,335 --> 01:21:00,989
Vous avez sûrement
quelque chose d'intéressant à dire.

1589
01:21:01,114 --> 01:21:02,513
Ma question est pour Jeff.

1590
01:21:02,638 --> 01:21:04,499
Je peux voter "aucune des deux" ?

1591
01:21:09,269 --> 01:21:10,886
Ma question est...

1592
01:21:11,489 --> 01:21:15,201
Certains pouvaient être eux-mêmes
et représenter autre chose.

1593
01:21:15,326 --> 01:21:18,376
Et vous en êtes
la parfaite illustration.

1594
01:21:18,501 --> 01:21:19,505
Sandra,

1595
01:21:19,630 --> 01:21:22,851
tu as tenté de représenter
les Portoricains.

1596
01:21:22,976 --> 01:21:24,598
Comment t'en es-tu sortie

1597
01:21:24,723 --> 01:21:26,746
avec cette double
casquette honorifique ?

1598
01:21:27,190 --> 01:21:29,695
Je pense avoir fait du bon boulot.

1599
01:21:29,820 --> 01:21:32,629
Je n'ai rien fait
que les autres n'aient pas fait.

1600
01:21:32,754 --> 01:21:34,529
J'ai menti, les autres aussi.

1601
01:21:34,654 --> 01:21:37,590
J'ai trahi, j'ai été trahie.

1602
01:21:37,715 --> 01:21:41,325
J'ai juste fait attention à moi,
et ça vient de là,

1603
01:21:41,450 --> 01:21:43,549
peut-être parce que
je suis Portoricaine,

1604
01:21:43,674 --> 01:21:45,964
je sais que si
je ne pense pas à ma pomme,

1605
01:21:46,089 --> 01:21:47,752
personne ne le fera pour moi.

1606
01:21:47,877 --> 01:21:49,269
Je continue ou ça te va ?

1607
01:21:49,394 --> 01:21:50,970
Ça me convient parfaitement.

1608
01:21:51,635 --> 01:21:52,638
Lill,

1609
01:21:53,331 --> 01:21:55,216
tu as pu être toi-même

1610
01:21:55,466 --> 01:21:57,118
et représenter les scouts.

1611
01:21:57,460 --> 01:21:59,921
À différents moments du jeu,

1612
01:22:00,046 --> 01:22:01,656
tu m'as fait une promesse.

1613
01:22:01,781 --> 01:22:03,583
Tu n'as pas été à la hauteur

1614
01:22:03,708 --> 01:22:06,361
d'un de ces devoirs : l'honnêteté.

1615
01:22:06,486 --> 01:22:08,755
Comment penses-tu
avoir représenté les scouts

1616
01:22:08,880 --> 01:22:10,156
et cet uniforme ?

1617
01:22:10,281 --> 01:22:11,853
Si c'était à refaire,

1618
01:22:11,978 --> 01:22:13,903
je ne porterais pas cet uniforme.

1619
01:22:14,028 --> 01:22:15,828
Je ne représenterais pas les scouts.

1620
01:22:16,793 --> 01:22:17,797
Ce jeu

1621
01:22:17,922 --> 01:22:20,472
n'a rien à voir
avec l'honneur, l'intégrité...

1622
01:22:20,928 --> 01:22:22,734
Il n'a rien à voir...

1623
01:22:23,060 --> 01:22:25,614
avec le serment scout

1624
01:22:25,739 --> 01:22:27,682
et les valeurs du scoutisme.

1625
01:22:28,231 --> 01:22:30,376
J'étais toujours dans mon monde,

1626
01:22:30,501 --> 01:22:32,722
comme chez moi, la cheftaine scout.

1627
01:22:33,250 --> 01:22:35,525
Et encore une fois,
j'ai dû retourner ma veste

1628
01:22:35,650 --> 01:22:40,061
en devenant la P-U-T-E
qui a éliminé Rupert.

1629
01:22:41,009 --> 01:22:42,555
Je n'en étais pas fière,

1630
01:22:42,680 --> 01:22:45,633
et non, je n'ai pas très bien
représenté les scouts.

1631
01:22:47,118 --> 01:22:48,726
- Merci, Jon.
- Merci.

1632
01:22:50,830 --> 01:22:54,233
Sandra, Lill, vous avez résisté
aux questions et remarques du jury.

1633
01:22:56,102 --> 01:22:58,538
Dans un instant,
vous pourrez conclure.

1634
01:22:59,373 --> 01:23:00,849
Profitez de ce moment

1635
01:23:00,974 --> 01:23:03,042
pour réfléchir à vos derniers mots.

1636
01:23:31,003 --> 01:23:32,505
Bien, Lill, Sandra,

1637
01:23:34,112 --> 01:23:36,155
c'est votre dernière occasion

1638
01:23:36,280 --> 01:23:39,987
de plaider votre cause
pour le million de dollars.

1639
01:23:40,642 --> 01:23:41,756
Donc, Sandra,

1640
01:23:42,006 --> 01:23:43,257
commençons par vous.

1641
01:23:44,122 --> 01:23:47,322
Je pense avoir joué
selon mes compétences.

1642
01:23:47,816 --> 01:23:50,770
À mon arrivée ici, j'ai été moi-même.

1643
01:23:50,895 --> 01:23:52,666
Je n'ai pas joué de rôle.

1644
01:23:52,791 --> 01:23:56,137
Je n'ai pas dupé ni menti
sur qui était Sandra.

1645
01:23:56,262 --> 01:23:58,902
Je pensais que ma grande gueule
m'attirerait des problèmes.

1646
01:23:59,027 --> 01:24:00,233
Mais après coup,

1647
01:24:00,358 --> 01:24:03,711
l'ouvrir et dire les choses
telles qu'elles sont,

1648
01:24:03,836 --> 01:24:06,313
c'est ce qui m'a aidé
à arriver si loin.

1649
01:24:06,563 --> 01:24:09,049
Car dès qu'on venait me dire :

1650
01:24:09,299 --> 01:24:11,428
"Sandra, faisons ça comme ça.",

1651
01:24:12,169 --> 01:24:15,070
je donnais très franchement mon avis.

1652
01:24:15,195 --> 01:24:17,316
"Oui, je t'aiderai.",
ou "Oui, je suis avec toi."

1653
01:24:19,151 --> 01:24:21,142
En fait, je suis étonnée d'être ici.

1654
01:24:21,267 --> 01:24:23,522
Mais maintenant que j'y suis,
j'en suis ravie.

1655
01:24:23,932 --> 01:24:25,533
Je pense être quelqu'un de bien,

1656
01:24:25,658 --> 01:24:27,134
même si j'ai pu vous insulter.

1657
01:24:27,259 --> 01:24:29,061
C'était mon ressenti sur l'instant.

1658
01:24:29,186 --> 01:24:31,939
Je ne regrette aucun de mes actes

1659
01:24:32,189 --> 01:24:34,377
et je suis heureuse d'être ici,
c'est tout.

1660
01:24:34,502 --> 01:24:36,641
Merci beaucoup pour votre attention.

1661
01:24:37,336 --> 01:24:39,430
Lill, dernière occasion
de convaincre le jury

1662
01:24:39,555 --> 01:24:41,148
de vous donner un million.

1663
01:24:41,273 --> 01:24:42,573
Si c'était à refaire,

1664
01:24:42,698 --> 01:24:45,366
je laisserais
l'uniforme scout chez moi.

1665
01:24:45,491 --> 01:24:46,712
C'est très facile

1666
01:24:46,837 --> 01:24:48,088
pour n'importe qui

1667
01:24:48,213 --> 01:24:49,529
de dire :

1668
01:24:50,007 --> 01:24:51,692
"Scout : dignité, honneur.

1669
01:24:51,817 --> 01:24:55,009
Survivor : menteur, tricheur."

1670
01:24:55,730 --> 01:24:57,556
Ces deux choses sont incompatibles.

1671
01:24:57,681 --> 01:24:59,967
Peu importe ce que vous dites
sur mon honneur,

1672
01:25:00,092 --> 01:25:01,486
sur mon intégrité.

1673
01:25:02,075 --> 01:25:03,535
C'est des conner*** !

1674
01:25:04,225 --> 01:25:05,760
Ici, c'est comme ça !

1675
01:25:05,885 --> 01:25:07,666
Chez moi, c'est différent !

1676
01:25:08,183 --> 01:25:10,110
Alors, pourquoi me le donner

1677
01:25:10,360 --> 01:25:12,820
plutôt qu'à Sandra ?

1678
01:25:14,098 --> 01:25:17,905
J'ai tenté d'apprendre à jouer
le mieux possible.

1679
01:25:18,312 --> 01:25:22,089
J'ai aussi tenté
de rester respectueuse

1680
01:25:22,214 --> 01:25:23,876
et aussi de nouer des amitiés.

1681
01:25:24,001 --> 01:25:25,584
Des amitiés se sont brisées.

1682
01:25:25,709 --> 01:25:29,194
Ça m'a blessée,
car je ne pouvais rien y faire.

1683
01:25:29,698 --> 01:25:31,098
Vous jouez,

1684
01:25:31,223 --> 01:25:33,044
ou vous vous faites éliminer.

1685
01:25:33,784 --> 01:25:35,603
Peu importe votre décision,

1686
01:25:35,728 --> 01:25:38,500
j'ai fait de mon mieux
avec ce que j'avais

1687
01:25:38,625 --> 01:25:40,394
et celle que je suis.

1688
01:25:40,858 --> 01:25:42,916
Et... Ce n'est qu'une soirée.

1689
01:25:43,041 --> 01:25:44,845
Oui, c'est une énorme récompense,

1690
01:25:44,970 --> 01:25:47,740
mais je rentre chez moi,
je redeviendrai "Big Lill"

1691
01:25:47,865 --> 01:25:50,313
pour 75 gamins
pour qui je suis un modèle.

1692
01:25:50,713 --> 01:25:54,065
Et je leur expliquerai
que c'était un jeu.

1693
01:25:54,880 --> 01:25:57,791
Mettez l'uniforme scout de côté.
Je voudrais l'avoir fait,

1694
01:25:57,916 --> 01:25:59,318
mais je ne l'ai pas fait.

1695
01:26:00,430 --> 01:26:01,433
Merci.

1696
01:26:03,045 --> 01:26:06,062
Bien, Lill, Sandra,
merci pour vos commentaires.

1697
01:26:06,187 --> 01:26:08,462
Jury, merci pour vos questions
et vos commentaires.

1698
01:26:08,587 --> 01:26:09,662
Il est temps,

1699
01:26:10,009 --> 01:26:12,095
enfin, de passer au vote.

1700
01:26:13,821 --> 01:26:15,657
Ce soir,
le vote est un peu différent.

1701
01:26:15,782 --> 01:26:17,813
Vous ne votez pas
pour éliminer quelqu'un.

1702
01:26:17,938 --> 01:26:19,813
Vous votez pour une gagnante.

1703
01:26:19,938 --> 01:26:21,607
Vous votez pour celle

1704
01:26:21,732 --> 01:26:23,509
qui mérite le plus, selon vous,

1705
01:26:23,634 --> 01:26:25,110
le titre d'Ultime Survivante

1706
01:26:25,235 --> 01:26:26,787
et le million de dollars.

1707
01:26:26,912 --> 01:26:29,982
Vous voulez voir votre nom
sur le parchemin ce soir.

1708
01:26:31,250 --> 01:26:32,760
Il est temps de voter.

1709
01:26:32,885 --> 01:26:34,114
Ryno, à vous.

1710
01:27:16,524 --> 01:27:17,529
Sandra,

1711
01:27:17,654 --> 01:27:19,891
<i>je suis vraiment heureux pour toi.</i>

1712
01:27:21,133 --> 01:27:22,260
Tu le mérites.

1713
01:27:22,803 --> 01:27:26,030
Depuis le premier jour,
on était comme frère et soeur.

1714
01:27:26,155 --> 01:27:30,215
J'ai été ravi
d'avoir quelqu'un à mes côtés.

1715
01:27:30,611 --> 01:27:33,076
Je suis content
de pouvoir être là pour toi.

1716
01:27:33,201 --> 01:27:34,913
J'espère que tu vas gagner.

1717
01:28:22,889 --> 01:28:23,896
<i>Sandra,</i>

1718
01:28:24,021 --> 01:28:26,538
je n'ai pas compris si ta stratégie

1719
01:28:26,663 --> 01:28:29,543
était prévue depuis le début

1720
01:28:29,668 --> 01:28:32,106
<i>ou si tu as eu la chance
de faire les bonnes alliances,</i>

1721
01:28:32,231 --> 01:28:34,348
<i>et décidé d'être cash.</i>

1722
01:28:34,473 --> 01:28:37,145
Ceci étant dit,
je dois voir qui a le mieux joué,

1723
01:28:37,270 --> 01:28:40,614
indépendamment du conseil,
au mieux de ses capacités.

1724
01:28:40,739 --> 01:28:42,581
Lill, tu as fait
un boulot phénoménal.

1725
01:28:43,245 --> 01:28:45,772
<i>Tu étais une Paria,
tu es revenue dans le jeu</i>

1726
01:28:45,897 --> 01:28:48,694
<i>et tu as commencé
à te servir de ta tête.</i>

1727
01:28:48,819 --> 01:28:49,988
<i>Ceci étant dit,</i>

1728
01:28:50,113 --> 01:28:52,145
ce vote est pour toi, Lill.

1729
01:29:05,871 --> 01:29:07,339
Pour la dernière fois,

1730
01:29:07,464 --> 01:29:09,249
je vais décompter les votes.

1731
01:29:44,109 --> 01:29:46,979
Bien sûr, vous souhaiteriez
que je les lise et qu'on en finisse.

1732
01:29:47,104 --> 01:29:49,123
Vous êtes ici depuis longtemps.

1733
01:29:49,248 --> 01:29:51,432
Hélas, il va falloir patienter.

1734
01:29:51,557 --> 01:29:53,794
Je vous verrai de l'autre côté.

1735
01:30:48,449 --> 01:30:49,470
Bonsoir.

1736
01:31:00,895 --> 01:31:01,898
Bien.

1737
01:31:03,094 --> 01:31:04,347
Allons-y.

1738
01:31:04,472 --> 01:31:05,835
Qui l'eut cru ?

1739
01:31:05,960 --> 01:31:09,237
Madame "Tant-que-c'est-pas-moi"
et madame "Je-suis-trop-sympa",

1740
01:31:09,362 --> 01:31:10,756
en finale.

1741
01:31:11,671 --> 01:31:13,422
- Félicitations !
- Merci.

1742
01:31:13,547 --> 01:31:16,068
Merci au jury,
pour ce super conseil final.

1743
01:31:16,601 --> 01:31:17,780
Passons aux votes.

1744
01:31:17,905 --> 01:31:19,517
Comme je l'ai dit tout à l'heure,

1745
01:31:19,642 --> 01:31:21,887
ce soir, vous voulez voir
votre nom sur le parchemin.

1746
01:31:22,012 --> 01:31:24,309
Ce soir, le jury n'a pas voté
pour éliminer quelqu'un.

1747
01:31:24,434 --> 01:31:26,453
Ils ont voté pour une gagnante.

1748
01:31:26,578 --> 01:31:28,438
En jeu pour la gagnante :

1749
01:31:28,563 --> 01:31:31,625
le titre de gagnante
de "Survivor : Pearl Islands",

1750
01:31:31,875 --> 01:31:35,076
un 4x4 <i>GMC Envoy</i> flambant neuf,

1751
01:31:35,646 --> 01:31:38,083
et un petit chèque
d'un million de dollars.

1752
01:31:38,567 --> 01:31:40,366
Sept votes à l'intérieur.

1753
01:31:40,491 --> 01:31:43,137
Il en faut quatre pour l'emporter.

1754
01:31:43,753 --> 01:31:45,372
Je vais lire les votes.

1755
01:31:50,115 --> 01:31:51,364
Premier vote :

1756
01:31:53,270 --> 01:31:54,272
Sandra.

1757
01:32:05,414 --> 01:32:06,418
Lill.

1758
01:32:07,500 --> 01:32:09,621
Un vote Sandra, un vote Lill.

1759
01:32:16,954 --> 01:32:17,956
Sandra.

1760
01:32:20,891 --> 01:32:23,210
Deux votes Sandra, un vote Lill.

1761
01:32:31,928 --> 01:32:34,254
Trois votes Sandra, un vote Lill.

1762
01:32:41,000 --> 01:32:43,530
La gagnante
de "Survivor : Pearl Islands"...

1763
01:32:44,059 --> 01:32:45,082
Sandra.

1764
01:33:04,228 --> 01:33:06,745
Sandra, dans mes bras.
Tu l'as fait.

1765
01:33:13,983 --> 01:33:16,769
Tu as gardé la tête haute
dans ce conseil final, Lill.

1766
01:33:16,894 --> 01:33:18,157
C'était dingue !

1767
01:33:20,092 --> 01:33:21,246
Oh, Lill !

1768
01:33:23,508 --> 01:33:26,306
Sandra, approchez-vous.
Votre famille est ici.

1769
01:33:27,535 --> 01:33:28,945
Allez les embrasser !



## S08E16

1
00:00:00,000 --> 00:00:04,162
WWW.MY-SUBS.CO

1
00:00:05,237 --> 00:00:08,673
             JEFF:              
          <i>36 days ago,</i>          
       <i>18 former castaways</i>      

2
00:00:08,741 --> 00:00:10,375
          <i>came together</i>         
     <i>off the coast of Panama</i>    

3
00:00:10,443 --> 00:00:14,011
   <i>under full military escort.</i>  

4
00:00:14,079 --> 00:00:17,082
 <i>They were the best of the best,</i>

5
00:00:17,149 --> 00:00:18,849
         <i>the All-Stars,</i>         
     <i>returning to play</i>          

6
00:00:18,917 --> 00:00:21,919
     <i>the ultimate game</i>          
         <i>one more time.</i>         

7
00:00:21,987 --> 00:00:24,822
              TOM:              
 <i>This ain't a little boys' game.</i>

8
00:00:24,890 --> 00:00:25,924
This is for the big boys.       

9
00:00:25,991 --> 00:00:27,358
          ( <i>whooping</i> )          

10
00:00:27,426 --> 00:00:28,827
             JEFF:              
         <i>They were split</i>        
     <i>into three tribes</i>          

11
00:00:28,895 --> 00:00:31,095
          <i>and marooned</i>          
      <i>with only one machete</i>     

12
00:00:31,163 --> 00:00:34,499
 <i>in the harsh jungles of Panama.</i>

13
00:00:34,534 --> 00:00:36,234
   <i>Everything was heightened.</i>   

14
00:00:36,301 --> 00:00:38,703
         <i>The survival...</i>        
<i>I'm running out of steam.</i>       

15
00:00:38,771 --> 00:00:40,972
       <i>...the strategy...</i>       
            <i>RICHARD:</i>            
   <i>Yeah, I think I could start</i>  

16
00:00:41,039 --> 00:00:42,307
 <i>the fire without even blinking.</i>

17
00:00:42,374 --> 00:00:43,641
      But they don't need       
         to know that.          

18
00:00:43,709 --> 00:00:45,110
        ( <i>laughs</i> )              

19
00:00:45,177 --> 00:00:46,144
      <i>...and the suspicion.</i>     

20
00:00:46,211 --> 00:00:47,245
              ROB:              
         I don't trust          

21
00:00:47,312 --> 00:00:48,513
          any of you.           

22
00:00:48,580 --> 00:00:49,648
I don't trust any of you!       

23
00:00:49,715 --> 00:00:50,649
              ROB:              
          <i>Nobody trusts</i>         

24
00:00:50,716 --> 00:00:52,484
  anybody, do you understand?   

25
00:00:52,551 --> 00:00:55,754
     <i>Still, alliances formed</i>    
          <i>immediately.</i>          

26
00:00:55,821 --> 00:00:58,122
                Me and you ought
                to think about  
                an alliance.    

27
00:00:58,190 --> 00:00:59,558
You're a man                    
of your word, too,              

28
00:00:59,625 --> 00:01:00,925
from what I know of you.        

29
00:01:00,993 --> 00:01:02,827
So what do you think,           
you want to make                

30
00:01:02,895 --> 00:01:04,528
              an alliance, cover
              our own asses?    

31
00:01:04,596 --> 00:01:07,165
     I don't know if I can      
take you seriously or not.      

32
00:01:07,232 --> 00:01:08,966
              Go!               

33
00:01:09,034 --> 00:01:11,903
   <i>The competition was fierce</i>   
       <i>at the challenges,</i>       

34
00:01:11,971 --> 00:01:14,272
      <i>because the All-Stars</i>     
       <i>had a lot to prove.</i>      

35
00:01:14,339 --> 00:01:16,741
             JEFF:              
Chapera-- the first tribe       
        to win immunity!        

36
00:01:16,809 --> 00:01:18,442
          ( <i>cheering</i> )          

37
00:01:19,378 --> 00:01:20,846
      ( <i>thunder crashing</i> )      

38
00:01:20,913 --> 00:01:23,081
  <i>In the beginning, it appeared</i> 

39
00:01:23,148 --> 00:01:25,883
       <i>the former winners</i>       
 <i>would be the targets, when Tina</i>

40
00:01:25,951 --> 00:01:28,219
     <i>was the first All-Star</i>     
           <i>voted out.</i>           

41
00:01:28,287 --> 00:01:29,954
     Tina, the tribe has spoken.

42
00:01:31,656 --> 00:01:35,226
 <i>But Rudy, the 75-year-old</i>      
     <i>former Navy Seal,</i>          

43
00:01:35,294 --> 00:01:38,763
       <i>was the next to go.</i>      

44
00:01:38,831 --> 00:01:41,766
       <i>Then Jenna Morasca</i>       
       <i>surprised everyone</i>       

45
00:01:41,834 --> 00:01:44,436
     <i>when she quit the game</i>     
         <i>to return home</i>         

46
00:01:44,503 --> 00:01:45,937
       <i>to her sick mother.</i>      

47
00:01:46,005 --> 00:01:48,606
 Due to someone who's very ill, 

48
00:01:48,674 --> 00:01:49,874
I need to...                    

49
00:01:49,942 --> 00:01:51,276
  pull myself out of the game.  

50
00:01:54,746 --> 00:01:57,481
Jenna, we're thinking about you.
            Thanks.             

51
00:02:00,152 --> 00:02:03,621
      ( <i>thunder crashing</i> )      

52
00:02:03,623 --> 00:02:05,256
  <i>The elements were relentless,</i> 

53
00:02:05,324 --> 00:02:08,593
 <i>and the adventure became</i>       
 <i>the most difficult ever.</i>       

54
00:02:08,661 --> 00:02:11,463
          ( <i>crying</i> ):           
    It's not worth it.          

55
00:02:13,666 --> 00:02:16,901
       <i>But the true danger</i>      
     <i>proved to be betrayal.</i>     

56
00:02:16,969 --> 00:02:19,637
As long as I have your assurance
      on this, then I'm...      

57
00:02:19,705 --> 00:02:21,239
                    You want to 
                    shake on it?

58
00:02:22,742 --> 00:02:24,576
      <i>When Rob Cesternino,</i>      

59
00:02:24,643 --> 00:02:27,879
 <i>one of the most strategic</i>      
  <i>players in</i> Survivor <i>history,</i>  

60
00:02:27,947 --> 00:02:30,515
         <i>was blindsided</i>         
 <i>at Tribal Council, it was clear</i>

61
00:02:30,583 --> 00:02:32,583
      <i>that the game was on</i>      
          <i>in a big way.</i>         

62
00:02:32,651 --> 00:02:36,421
      Rob, the tribe has spoken.

63
00:02:39,658 --> 00:02:42,626
           <i>On day 15,</i>           
     <i>three tribes became two</i>    

64
00:02:42,694 --> 00:02:44,462
  <i>when the ailing Saboga Tribe</i>  

65
00:02:44,530 --> 00:02:46,464
          <i>was absorbed</i>          
     <i>by the Mogo Mogo</i>           

66
00:02:46,532 --> 00:02:48,132
       <i>and Chapera Tribes.</i>      

67
00:02:48,200 --> 00:02:50,101
Saboga finishes last, and Saboga

68
00:02:50,169 --> 00:02:51,702
    will soon be no longer.     

69
00:02:51,770 --> 00:02:52,870
 <i>Though the former members</i>      

70
00:02:52,938 --> 00:02:54,905
   <i>of Saboga were outnumbered</i>   

71
00:02:54,973 --> 00:02:56,941
   <i>and as vulnerable as ever,</i>   

72
00:02:57,009 --> 00:02:58,476
      <i>it was Richard Hatch,</i>     

73
00:02:58,544 --> 00:03:00,044
 <i>the first-ever</i> Survivor <i>winner,</i>

74
00:03:00,111 --> 00:03:01,179
       <i>who was voted out.</i>       

75
00:03:01,247 --> 00:03:02,881
     I've been bamboozled!      

76
00:03:02,949 --> 00:03:04,149
             <i>Rich...</i>            

77
00:03:04,216 --> 00:03:06,817
        the tribe has spoken.   

78
00:03:08,954 --> 00:03:10,922
     <i>With Boston Rob</i>            
     <i>leading the way,</i>           

79
00:03:10,990 --> 00:03:12,590
 <i>the Chapera Tribe proved to be</i> 

80
00:03:12,657 --> 00:03:15,726
         <i>the powerhouse</i>         
       <i>at the challenges.</i>       

81
00:03:15,794 --> 00:03:17,294
              Wow!              

82
00:03:17,362 --> 00:03:19,564
      <i>And Rupert and Jenna</i>      
      <i>joined Rob and Amber</i>      

83
00:03:19,632 --> 00:03:21,866
     <i>in an alliance of four.</i>    

84
00:03:21,934 --> 00:03:24,168
      Once it gets to the       
      final four, then we can...

85
00:03:24,236 --> 00:03:26,470
         we can, you know, every
         man for themselves.    

86
00:03:26,538 --> 00:03:28,139
     <i>Things at Chapera</i>          

87
00:03:28,206 --> 00:03:31,775
  <i>seemed to be on solid ground,</i> 
   <i>but the tribe had a setback</i>  

88
00:03:31,843 --> 00:03:35,380
 <i>when Sue suddenly quit the game</i>
          <i>under a cloud</i>         

89
00:03:35,448 --> 00:03:37,081
 <i>of personal controversy.</i>       

90
00:03:37,148 --> 00:03:40,485
  I was violated, humiliated,   
          dehumanized,          

91
00:03:40,552 --> 00:03:41,953
and totally spent, Jeff,        

92
00:03:42,021 --> 00:03:44,688
and I'm done                    
with this ... game!             

93
00:03:47,592 --> 00:03:50,227
  <i>But still Chapera pushed on,</i>  

94
00:03:50,295 --> 00:03:52,030
 <i>and the unstoppable tribe</i>      
     <i>won the next two</i>           

95
00:03:52,097 --> 00:03:53,531
     <i>immunity challenges...</i>     

96
00:03:53,599 --> 00:03:58,302
             JEFF:              
     Chapera... wins reward     
         and immunity!          

97
00:03:58,370 --> 00:04:00,238
          ( <i>cheering</i> )          

98
00:04:00,205 --> 00:04:03,507
     <i>...sending Mogo Mogo to</i>    
  <i>the next two Tribal Councils,</i> 

99
00:04:03,575 --> 00:04:06,944
      <i>where Colby and Ethan</i>     
         <i>were voted out.</i>        

100
00:04:07,012 --> 00:04:09,580
        The tribe has spoken.   

101
00:04:09,648 --> 00:04:13,051
      <i>At Chapera, strategy</i>      
      <i>turned into romance</i>       

102
00:04:13,118 --> 00:04:15,153
       <i>for Rob and Amber.</i>       

103
00:04:15,220 --> 00:04:18,522
             AMBER:             
  <i>Flirting was a</i> huge <i>strategy</i>  
     <i>in the beginning,</i>          

104
00:04:18,590 --> 00:04:21,593
but then I got caught up in it, 
and feelings, you know, emerged.

105
00:04:21,660 --> 00:04:25,763
              ROB:              
  <i>Amber and I have been fooling</i> 
  <i>around a little bit out here.</i> 

106
00:04:25,831 --> 00:04:27,932
 <i>I'm definitely attracted</i>       
             <i>to her.</i>            

107
00:04:28,000 --> 00:04:30,334
      It'd be nice to have      
    a million dollars           

108
00:04:30,369 --> 00:04:32,036
  and take the girl away, too.  

109
00:04:32,104 --> 00:04:36,240
             JEFF:              
   <i>On day 22, everyone was hit</i>  
      <i>with a big surprise.</i>      

110
00:04:36,308 --> 00:04:37,441
  All right, drop your buffs.   

111
00:04:37,509 --> 00:04:38,810
        ( <i>groans</i> )              

112
00:04:38,878 --> 00:04:40,211
 <i>It was a tribal shuffle.</i>       

113
00:04:40,279 --> 00:04:41,846
             JEFF:              
     Boston Rob, you don't      
      look pleased at all.      

114
00:04:41,914 --> 00:04:43,948
     <i>Against all odds,</i>          

115
00:04:44,016 --> 00:04:46,551
   <i>the tribes remain the same,</i>  
 <i>merely switching beaches</i>       

116
00:04:46,619 --> 00:04:48,019
     <i>and tribe names.</i>           

117
00:04:48,086 --> 00:04:50,154
     <i>Except for Amber,</i>          
     <i>who remained at Chapera</i>    

118
00:04:50,221 --> 00:04:52,823
  <i>and became the only All-Star</i>  
         <i>to find herself</i>        

119
00:04:52,891 --> 00:04:54,692
      <i>with new tribe mates.</i>     

120
00:04:54,760 --> 00:04:56,760
This is crazy.                  

121
00:04:56,828 --> 00:04:58,396
     <i>She was suddenly alone</i>     

122
00:04:58,464 --> 00:04:59,730
 <i>and vulnerable in her own camp.</i>

123
00:04:59,798 --> 00:05:00,998
             AMBER:             
     <i>I definitely feel</i>          

124
00:05:00,899 --> 00:05:02,734
     <i>like I'm the one</i>           
     <i>who got screwed</i>            

125
00:05:02,801 --> 00:05:04,102
    in this whole situation.    

126
00:05:04,169 --> 00:05:07,805
              ROB:              
 <i>I don't really care that</i>       

127
00:05:07,873 --> 00:05:09,474
  <i>the other team has our camp.</i>  

128
00:05:09,542 --> 00:05:12,110
     What aggravates me is,     
  they got my girl over there.  

129
00:05:12,177 --> 00:05:13,712
             JEFF:              
  <i>When the new Mogo Mogo Tribe</i>  

130
00:05:13,779 --> 00:05:15,479
          <i>won the next</i>          
       <i>immunity challenge,</i>      

131
00:05:15,547 --> 00:05:19,650
  <i>Rob approached Lex and made</i>   
  <i>a daring plea to save Amber.</i>  

132
00:05:22,354 --> 00:05:24,221
    If you can, if you can.     

133
00:05:24,289 --> 00:05:26,057
   <i>And Amber made her own plea</i>  
         <i>to Kathy.</i>              

134
00:05:26,124 --> 00:05:28,826
            Please, Kathy,      
            keep me in the game.

135
00:05:28,894 --> 00:05:31,262
                 Vote for Jerri.

136
00:05:32,631 --> 00:05:36,601
       <i>At Tribal Council,</i>       
   <i>Lex and Kathy came through.</i>  

137
00:05:36,669 --> 00:05:40,138
   <i>They granted Rob the favor</i>   
     <i>and spared Amber.</i>          

138
00:05:40,206 --> 00:05:42,607
     Ninth person voted out     
of <i>Survivor: All-Stars...</i>       

139
00:05:42,674 --> 00:05:44,542
                          Jerri.

140
00:05:44,609 --> 00:05:46,811
 <i>And Jerri paid the price.</i>      

141
00:05:49,147 --> 00:05:52,049
 <i>On day 26, the two tribes</i>      

142
00:05:52,117 --> 00:05:55,420
          ( <i>cheering</i> )          
         <i>finally merged.</i>        

143
00:05:55,487 --> 00:05:57,488
 <i>At the new Chaboga Mogo Tribe,</i> 

144
00:05:57,556 --> 00:05:59,723
   <i>Lex looked for reassurance</i>   
         <i>from Rob.</i>              

145
00:05:59,791 --> 00:06:01,559
          If I get a sense that,
          you know, I'm gonna   

146
00:06:01,627 --> 00:06:03,127
         end up getting         
  the, you know, double-cross,  

147
00:06:03,194 --> 00:06:04,262
     get a knife in my back     

148
00:06:04,329 --> 00:06:05,696
            next Tribal Council,

149
00:06:05,764 --> 00:06:07,498
I certainly won't be happy      
          about that.           

150
00:06:07,566 --> 00:06:09,267
I won't stick a knife           
in your back, man.              

151
00:06:09,334 --> 00:06:10,601
     I ain't gonna do that.     

152
00:06:10,669 --> 00:06:12,236
              ROB:              
      <i>What, "Make the deal,</i>     

153
00:06:12,304 --> 00:06:14,705
 <i>save Amber and I'm gonna</i>       
       <i>help you later on"?</i>      

154
00:06:14,773 --> 00:06:16,908
     You guys didn't really     
     believe that, did you?     

155
00:06:16,975 --> 00:06:20,978
             JEFF:              
       <i>Rob confronted Lex</i>       
 <i>and told him the deal was off.</i> 

156
00:06:21,046 --> 00:06:22,914
Make no mistake                 
about it, Lex,                  

157
00:06:22,981 --> 00:06:25,249
the word I gave you was that    
if I can take care of you,      

158
00:06:25,317 --> 00:06:26,518
I will.                         

159
00:06:26,585 --> 00:06:28,786
I'm sorry, I cannot.            

160
00:06:28,854 --> 00:06:30,554
You have more allegiance to them
      than you got to me.       

161
00:06:30,622 --> 00:06:31,689
                 You're breaking
                 my heart.      

162
00:06:31,756 --> 00:06:33,758
        I can't...              
    I can't even believe it.    

163
00:06:35,194 --> 00:06:39,063
             JEFF:              
       <i>The strategic favor</i>      
          <i>had backfired</i>         

164
00:06:39,131 --> 00:06:42,133
 <i>and Lex was voted out...</i>       

165
00:06:42,201 --> 00:06:44,902
   <i>making him the first member</i>  
          <i>of the jury.</i>          

166
00:06:44,970 --> 00:06:47,438
       <i>Kathy was the next</i>       
       <i>to join the jury.</i>        

167
00:06:47,506 --> 00:06:50,741
 <i>Then Alicia and Shii Ann.</i>      

168
00:06:50,809 --> 00:06:55,212
  <i>Last week, the five remaining</i> 
     <i>members of Chaboga Mogo</i>    

169
00:06:55,280 --> 00:06:57,815
       <i>competed for a car</i>       
 <i>at the reward challenge.</i>       

170
00:06:57,883 --> 00:07:00,118
     <i>Rob won and chose</i>          
     <i>to take Amber with him</i>     

171
00:07:00,185 --> 00:07:01,752
  <i>to an island drive-in movie.</i>  

172
00:07:01,820 --> 00:07:05,323
  <i>When they arrived, things got</i> 
     <i>even better for Amber.</i>     

173
00:07:05,390 --> 00:07:07,124
One of the added benefits       

174
00:07:07,192 --> 00:07:08,959
of being selected               
by Boston Rob--                 

175
00:07:09,027 --> 00:07:10,028
something for you, Amber.       

176
00:07:10,095 --> 00:07:11,428
            Are you serious?!   

177
00:07:11,496 --> 00:07:13,965
       <i>The two kicked back</i>      
      <i>and enjoyed the movie</i>     

178
00:07:14,033 --> 00:07:16,701
 <i>and their first romantic date.</i> 

179
00:07:16,769 --> 00:07:18,436
     <i>Upon returning to camp,</i>    

180
00:07:18,503 --> 00:07:21,172
      <i>Amber told the others</i>     
       <i>about her new car.</i>       

181
00:07:21,240 --> 00:07:22,673
        I had the choice        
 whether or not to tell people, 

182
00:07:22,741 --> 00:07:26,010
         <i>but I felt that</i>        
   <i>holding that back from them</i>  

183
00:07:26,078 --> 00:07:26,911
         <i>just wasn't me.</i>        

184
00:07:26,945 --> 00:07:28,279
             JEFF:              
       <i>And Rupert and Tom</i>       

185
00:07:28,346 --> 00:07:30,548
         <i>had had enough</i>         
      <i>of the power couple.</i>      

186
00:07:30,616 --> 00:07:34,351
              Take that damn    
              couple and break  
              that couple apart.

187
00:07:34,419 --> 00:07:36,988
              TOM:              
         <i>If I get Tom in</i>        
     <i>with Jenna and I,</i>          

188
00:07:37,056 --> 00:07:38,689
       <i>we three would put</i>       
          <i>Rob and Amber</i>         

189
00:07:38,757 --> 00:07:39,890
     <i>out of this game.</i>          

190
00:07:39,958 --> 00:07:41,392
             JEFF:              
 <i>But Rob, sensing trouble,</i>      

191
00:07:41,460 --> 00:07:44,161
      <i>orchestrated a fight</i>      
     <i>between Rupert and Tom.</i>    

192
00:07:44,229 --> 00:07:45,696
ROB:                            
He keeps telling me             

193
00:07:45,764 --> 00:07:47,398
      that you keep saying      
    you want to vote me out.    

194
00:07:47,433 --> 00:07:48,499
        If he tells you that,   

195
00:07:48,567 --> 00:07:50,368
    then he's a lying           
        son of a bitch.         

196
00:07:50,435 --> 00:07:53,971
You've been talking about       
getting rid of everybody, Tom,  

197
00:07:54,039 --> 00:07:56,540
behind everybody's back         
and now I'm the bad guy?        

198
00:07:56,608 --> 00:07:58,542
              ROB:              
      <i>The reason I did this</i>     
         <i>was to get them</i>        

199
00:07:58,611 --> 00:08:00,211
 <i>at each other's throats,</i>       
             <i>so that</i>            

200
00:08:00,278 --> 00:08:02,012
        neither of them         
     will have enough sense     

201
00:08:02,080 --> 00:08:03,781
 <i>to try to get me and Amber off.</i>

202
00:08:03,849 --> 00:08:06,484
             JEFF:              
   <i>At the immunity challenge,</i>   

203
00:08:06,552 --> 00:08:08,820
         <i>Rob walked away</i>        
  <i>with the necklace once again.</i> 

204
00:08:08,887 --> 00:08:11,155
             JEFF:              
Boston Rob wins immunity!       

205
00:08:11,222 --> 00:08:14,859
       <i>But he was worried</i>       
 <i>about Amber being outnumbered.</i> 

206
00:08:14,927 --> 00:08:16,427
              ROB:              
 <i>The only way I don't hold</i>      

207
00:08:16,495 --> 00:08:18,897
     <i>the power is if Rupert,</i>    
  <i>Jenna and Big Tom all team up</i> 

208
00:08:18,964 --> 00:08:20,531
      and vote Amber off.       

209
00:08:20,599 --> 00:08:22,266
             JEFF:              
      <i>Rob and Amber looked</i>      

210
00:08:22,334 --> 00:08:24,068
  <i>for reassurance from Big Tom.</i> 

211
00:08:24,136 --> 00:08:26,504
    Why would you think I went  
    with Rupert and Jenna?      
I don't know,                   

212
00:08:26,571 --> 00:08:28,739
why you been feeding them stuff 
    for the last two weeks,     

213
00:08:28,807 --> 00:08:30,308
          telling them          
you want to get rid of me?      

214
00:08:30,375 --> 00:08:31,609
         Let's make up our mind,

215
00:08:31,676 --> 00:08:32,743
because when you tell me,       

216
00:08:32,811 --> 00:08:33,877
    that's what I'm putting     
         on that card.          

217
00:08:33,945 --> 00:08:34,913
ROB:                            
That's it.                      
Let's do it.                    

218
00:08:34,980 --> 00:08:36,180
AMBER:                          
Let's do it.                    
It's Jenna.                     

219
00:08:36,248 --> 00:08:38,750
       <i>The deal was made</i>        
       <i>to vote Jenna out.</i>       

220
00:08:38,817 --> 00:08:40,951
     <i>But at Tribal Council,</i>     

221
00:08:41,019 --> 00:08:43,855
      <i>Big Tom was betrayed.</i>     

222
00:08:43,923 --> 00:08:46,257
              Big Tom, the tribe
              has spoken.       

223
00:08:46,325 --> 00:08:48,192
    I heard it.                 

224
00:08:48,260 --> 00:08:51,495
     <i>Big Tom was not happy.</i>     

225
00:08:55,434 --> 00:08:57,901
      <i>Now only four remain.</i>     

226
00:08:57,970 --> 00:09:00,304
       <i>Rupert, Boston Rob,</i>      

227
00:09:00,372 --> 00:09:02,406
     <i>Amber and Jenna.</i>           

228
00:09:02,474 --> 00:09:03,740
 <i>Tonight they will compete</i>      

229
00:09:03,808 --> 00:09:05,376
         <i>in their final</i>         
      <i>immunity challenges.</i>      

230
00:09:05,444 --> 00:09:07,744
         <i>Two will go on</i>         
     <i>to face the jury;</i>          

231
00:09:07,812 --> 00:09:09,680
  <i>one will outlast all the rest</i> 

232
00:09:09,747 --> 00:09:13,685
       <i>and become the sole</i>      
       <i>All-Star Survivor.</i>       

233
00:09:15,752 --> 00:09:20,353
Subrip: btf
btf@freemail.hu          

234
00:10:34,299 --> 00:10:37,001
            RUPERT:             
        We just got back        

235
00:10:37,069 --> 00:10:39,570
 from day 36's Tribal Council,  

236
00:10:39,637 --> 00:10:43,841
 where we voted Big Tom's butt  
          out of here.          

237
00:10:43,908 --> 00:10:45,809
             What was that glare
             as he walked out?  

238
00:10:45,877 --> 00:10:47,878
            RUPERT:             
  He was looking at his, uh...  

239
00:10:47,946 --> 00:10:51,816
              ROB:              
          You can tell          
     when someone's lying.      

240
00:10:51,883 --> 00:10:54,451
He lied right to my face,       
    like, five times.           

241
00:10:54,519 --> 00:10:56,186
             JENNA:             
     <i>It was an honest</i>           

242
00:10:56,254 --> 00:10:58,056
  and hurtful Tribal Council.   

243
00:10:58,123 --> 00:11:00,525
 <i>And now there are four torches</i> 
         <i>left up there.</i>         

244
00:11:00,592 --> 00:11:01,959
     <i>It started out with 18</i>     

245
00:11:02,026 --> 00:11:03,627
      <i>of the best survivors</i>     
     <i>to ever play this game,</i>    

246
00:11:03,695 --> 00:11:06,197
     and it's down to four,     
      and I'm one of them.      

247
00:11:06,264 --> 00:11:08,299
    How'd that happen?          

248
00:11:11,103 --> 00:11:13,904
            RUPERT:             
     I'm going to take that     
    down to the creek.          

249
00:11:13,972 --> 00:11:16,941
             JENNA:             
             Okay.              

250
00:11:18,544 --> 00:11:21,512
              ROB:              
     So, here's the thing,      
 me and Amber talked about it,  

251
00:11:21,580 --> 00:11:23,680
 and it's completely up to you, 

252
00:11:23,748 --> 00:11:25,049
     and I'm not gonna try      
        to influence you        

253
00:11:25,117 --> 00:11:26,884
     one way or the other,      
but all I'm gonna say is,       

254
00:11:26,951 --> 00:11:29,153
you have no chance              
to beat Rupert.                 

255
00:11:29,221 --> 00:11:31,222
If you want to take a shot      

256
00:11:31,290 --> 00:11:33,857
    with me and Amber           
      in the final three,       

257
00:11:33,925 --> 00:11:37,261
then you can take               
your own destiny                
in your own hands.              

258
00:11:37,329 --> 00:11:39,029
I mean, like, you don't         
even have to tell us.           

259
00:11:39,097 --> 00:11:41,064
We'll find out                  
whenever...                     
            Yeah, we'll find out

260
00:11:41,132 --> 00:11:43,768
at the vote.                    

261
00:11:45,937 --> 00:11:48,606
      ( <i>insects chirping</i> )      

262
00:12:00,285 --> 00:12:02,286
             AMBER:             
       <i>Little did we know</i>       

263
00:12:02,354 --> 00:12:03,720
      <i>that we were gonna be</i>     
         <i>woken up today</i>         

264
00:12:03,788 --> 00:12:07,224
  <i>by Jeff pulling up in a boat</i>  
     <i>carrying a</i> huge <i>basket.</i>    

265
00:12:07,292 --> 00:12:09,193
Want to give me a hand?         
Take one side.                  
                Sure.           

266
00:12:09,261 --> 00:12:11,061
             AMBER:             
     <i>I got a little nervous</i>     
         <i>at first.</i>              

267
00:12:11,129 --> 00:12:12,462
     <i>I was thinking,</i>            
     <i>maybe, oh, gosh,</i>           

268
00:12:12,530 --> 00:12:14,598
    this is our challenge--     
 what are we gonna have to do?  

269
00:12:15,633 --> 00:12:17,034
I brought you guys gifts        

270
00:12:17,102 --> 00:12:19,269
fitting for a Final Four.       

271
00:12:19,337 --> 00:12:20,304
Let me show you.                

272
00:12:20,372 --> 00:12:24,608
          ( <i>cheering</i> )          

273
00:12:24,676 --> 00:12:27,512
You've got everything           
you need for bacon, eggs,       

274
00:12:27,579 --> 00:12:28,646
pancakes...                     

275
00:12:28,713 --> 00:12:29,780
         ( <i>Rob cheers</i> )         

276
00:12:29,847 --> 00:12:32,283
                    Pancakes!   
                Pancakes!       

277
00:12:32,351 --> 00:12:35,419
Fresh fruit, orange juice,      

278
00:12:35,487 --> 00:12:36,687
champagne for mimosas.          

279
00:12:36,755 --> 00:12:38,956
                Champagne!      

280
00:12:39,024 --> 00:12:40,591
In addition,                    

281
00:12:40,659 --> 00:12:44,228
the top of this is also...      
          a scrapbook.          

282
00:12:44,296 --> 00:12:47,197
So, you have a camera.          

283
00:12:47,265 --> 00:12:49,500
So you can take pictures        
during the day,                 

284
00:12:49,568 --> 00:12:51,101
make up your scrapbook.         

285
00:12:51,169 --> 00:12:52,937
JEFF:                           
Does that look good?            

286
00:12:53,004 --> 00:12:54,472
The Final Four.                 

287
00:12:54,540 --> 00:12:55,773
                    RUPERT:     
                    Thank you.  
You're welcome.                 

288
00:12:55,840 --> 00:12:57,374
             Enjoy!             

289
00:12:57,442 --> 00:12:58,709
                Thank you, Jeff!

290
00:12:58,777 --> 00:13:00,844
             AMBER:             
 Breakfast is my favorite meal  
          of the day.           

291
00:13:00,912 --> 00:13:04,448
 <i>So this meal is</i> huge <i>out here.</i> 

292
00:13:07,252 --> 00:13:09,786
ROB ( <i>laughs</i> ):                 
Guys, we made it 37 days.       

293
00:13:09,855 --> 00:13:11,655
Whatever happens                
tonight happens,                

294
00:13:11,722 --> 00:13:13,658
and, uh, good luck              
to everybody.                   

295
00:13:13,725 --> 00:13:15,459
            RUPERT:             
      Good luck to us all.      

296
00:13:15,527 --> 00:13:17,161
              ALL:              
            Cheers.             

297
00:13:17,229 --> 00:13:20,431
              ROB:              
         <i>The four people</i>        
   <i>that are in the Final Four</i>   

298
00:13:20,499 --> 00:13:22,299
are two distinct groups of two. 

299
00:13:22,367 --> 00:13:25,102
 <i>There's no chance myself</i>       
   <i>and Amber are gonna break.</i>   

300
00:13:25,169 --> 00:13:27,738
 <i>I think it's a toss-up--</i>       
          <i>Jenna may...</i>          

301
00:13:27,806 --> 00:13:29,106
         <i>turn on Rupert.</i>        

302
00:13:29,174 --> 00:13:32,376
     <i>It may come down</i>           
     <i>to a purple rock.</i>          

303
00:13:32,444 --> 00:13:34,978
             JENNA:             
 <i>I've been thinking about</i>       

304
00:13:35,046 --> 00:13:36,814
            this whole purple   
            rock thing.         

305
00:13:36,882 --> 00:13:38,249
        So far...               

306
00:13:38,316 --> 00:13:40,584
         like, the game has gone
         so well for all of us. 

307
00:13:40,651 --> 00:13:42,186
             JENNA:             
       <i>I'm very concerned</i>       

308
00:13:42,253 --> 00:13:44,621
 <i>with the tiebreaker situation.</i> 

309
00:13:44,689 --> 00:13:47,090
 What would happen is, whoever  
has immunity has immunity.      

310
00:13:47,158 --> 00:13:49,226
    And then the other three    

311
00:13:49,293 --> 00:13:50,627
   <i>have to reach into a bag--</i>   

312
00:13:50,695 --> 00:13:52,796
     <i>there's two white rocks</i>    
       <i>and one purple one.</i>      

313
00:13:52,864 --> 00:13:55,433
 The person who gets the purple 
    rock is out of the game.    

314
00:13:55,500 --> 00:13:56,701
                 I don't want it
                 to come down   

315
00:13:56,768 --> 00:13:58,169
            to a frickin' rock. 
        I know.                 

316
00:13:58,236 --> 00:13:59,270
 That's not what we played for. 

317
00:13:59,338 --> 00:14:00,270
             AMBER:             
      <i>We knew it was gonna</i>      

318
00:14:00,338 --> 00:14:01,705
  come down to a purple rock,   

319
00:14:01,773 --> 00:14:02,639
 <i>so we gave her the option</i>      

320
00:14:02,707 --> 00:14:04,141
  <i>of voting out Rupert tonight.</i> 

321
00:14:04,209 --> 00:14:06,210
             JENNA:             
    Why don't you guys          
     just keep up your end      

322
00:14:06,278 --> 00:14:08,378
and vote Rupert?                
            We will.            

323
00:14:08,446 --> 00:14:11,081
             JENNA:             
         Strategically,         
    I came out here to win,     

324
00:14:11,149 --> 00:14:12,783
             and this is the way
             to do it for me;   

325
00:14:12,851 --> 00:14:14,318
                it gets me      
                one step closer.

326
00:14:14,385 --> 00:14:17,454
     I didn't come 37 days      
 to reach into a bag and let... 

327
00:14:17,522 --> 00:14:20,423
    a color decide my fate,     
    so I'm taking fate          

328
00:14:20,491 --> 00:14:21,592
     <i>in my own hands.</i>           

329
00:14:21,660 --> 00:14:23,160
             AMBER:             
     <i>Is that breakfast</i>          

330
00:14:23,228 --> 00:14:25,395
I smell?                        

331
00:14:25,463 --> 00:14:26,597
                     Yes, ma'am!

332
00:14:26,665 --> 00:14:28,165
             JENNA:             
      <i>All I've been craving</i>     

333
00:14:28,232 --> 00:14:30,034
          <i>is a pancake,</i>         

334
00:14:30,102 --> 00:14:32,202
     <i>and it was</i> the <i>best...</i>     

335
00:14:32,270 --> 00:14:33,670
         <i>I, like,</i>               
     <i>ate tiny little bites.</i>     

336
00:14:33,738 --> 00:14:35,305
     <i>It's better than I have</i>    
         <i>at home.</i>               

337
00:14:35,373 --> 00:14:37,174
          Oh, my God!           

338
00:14:37,241 --> 00:14:38,476
              Mmm.              

339
00:14:38,543 --> 00:14:39,977
            RUPERT:             
 <i>This morning's breakfast</i>       

340
00:14:40,045 --> 00:14:42,747
 <i>is good-bye to one of us.</i>      

341
00:14:42,814 --> 00:14:45,949
  <i>Somebody is leaving tonight.</i>  

342
00:14:46,017 --> 00:14:48,185
    Boy, I hope it's not me.    

343
00:15:02,300 --> 00:15:04,668
    All right, let's get to     
  today's immunity challenge.   

344
00:15:04,736 --> 00:15:06,737
    Boston Rob, give it up.     

345
00:15:09,975 --> 00:15:14,211
  Immunity, back up for grabs.  

346
00:15:14,279 --> 00:15:16,280
For today's immunity challenge, 

347
00:15:16,347 --> 00:15:18,148
      we have constructed       
         a giant maze.          

348
00:15:18,216 --> 00:15:20,684
    On my go, you will race     
  from the center of the maze   

349
00:15:20,752 --> 00:15:22,186
to eight different points       
        within the maze.        

350
00:15:22,253 --> 00:15:24,621
         At each point,         
you'll find a ladder rung.      

351
00:15:24,689 --> 00:15:27,224
    Untie it, bring it back     
         to the center.         

352
00:15:27,292 --> 00:15:29,726
  Along the way, you're going   
 to encounter various obstacles 

353
00:15:29,794 --> 00:15:31,161
      blocking your path.       

354
00:15:31,229 --> 00:15:34,331
 And you're going see the same  
    obstacle more than once.    

355
00:15:34,399 --> 00:15:36,233
The trick is don't get confused.

356
00:15:36,300 --> 00:15:38,401
Once you've gathered all eight, 
  you'll assemble your ladder,  

357
00:15:38,469 --> 00:15:40,337
 climb to the top of the tower. 

358
00:15:40,405 --> 00:15:42,673
    First person to the top     
    of the tower wins.          

359
00:15:42,741 --> 00:15:44,241
          Make sense?           

360
00:15:44,308 --> 00:15:45,775
    We'll draw colors.          
        Wait for my go.         

361
00:15:49,881 --> 00:15:51,282
    Here we go, guys.           

362
00:15:51,349 --> 00:15:54,084
 For immunity and a guaranteed  
    spot in the Final Three.    

363
00:15:54,152 --> 00:15:56,453
    Survivors, ready... Go!     

364
00:15:56,521 --> 00:15:58,755
         Everybody off.         

365
00:15:58,823 --> 00:16:01,091
     Jenna hits a dead end.     

366
00:16:03,094 --> 00:16:06,163
     Boston Rob working on      
    the crawl-through.          

367
00:16:06,230 --> 00:16:09,400
     Amber out of the other     
         crawl-through.         

368
00:16:09,467 --> 00:16:11,902
      Rupert makes his way      
    through the ropes.          

369
00:16:11,969 --> 00:16:14,004
  Amber finds her first rung.   

370
00:16:14,071 --> 00:16:17,141
 Jenna working her way through  
 the ropes, getting tangled up. 

371
00:16:19,210 --> 00:16:21,311
 Boston Rob has his first rung. 

372
00:16:21,379 --> 00:16:24,348
  Rupert finds his first rung.  

373
00:16:25,617 --> 00:16:27,184
Amber still making her way      
    back to the center          

374
00:16:27,252 --> 00:16:28,184
      with her first rung.      

375
00:16:28,252 --> 00:16:30,554
 Jenna untying her first rung.  

376
00:16:30,622 --> 00:16:33,256
 Boston Rob has his first rung. 

377
00:16:34,725 --> 00:16:35,626
      Amber's in with one.      

378
00:16:35,694 --> 00:16:36,860
     Rupert's in with one.      

379
00:16:36,928 --> 00:16:39,496
Everybody has one except Jenna. 

380
00:16:44,102 --> 00:16:45,102
     Jenna with her first.      

381
00:16:45,169 --> 00:16:46,470
    Everybody has one rung.     

382
00:16:46,538 --> 00:16:49,339
  Rob and Amber going through   
      the ropes together.       

383
00:16:51,008 --> 00:16:53,910
      Jenna making her way      
through the walk-through.       

384
00:16:53,978 --> 00:16:57,047
    Amber and Rob both          
     getting a second rung.     

385
00:16:57,114 --> 00:17:00,251
Jenna has her second rung.      

386
00:17:02,486 --> 00:17:05,155
 Rob passes Amber in the ropes. 

387
00:17:05,222 --> 00:17:07,791
 Jenna's back with her second,  
 Rupert's back with his second. 

388
00:17:07,859 --> 00:17:10,861
Boston Rob back with his second,
and Amber back with her second. 

389
00:17:10,929 --> 00:17:12,996
 We're tied up, two rungs each. 

390
00:17:13,064 --> 00:17:15,465
 Looking for a total of eight.  

391
00:17:21,405 --> 00:17:23,874
     Rob on his third rung.     

392
00:17:23,942 --> 00:17:25,642
 Jenna untying her third rung.  

393
00:17:25,710 --> 00:17:26,777
     She's got to get back      
         to the center.         

394
00:17:26,844 --> 00:17:28,946
      Boston Rob back with      
        his third rung.         

395
00:17:29,013 --> 00:17:30,648
    Jenna with a third rung.    

396
00:17:30,715 --> 00:17:33,016
    Amber with a third rung.    

397
00:17:41,926 --> 00:17:43,593
 Rupert back with a third rung. 

398
00:17:43,661 --> 00:17:45,762
         We're tied up,         
everybody has three rungs.      

399
00:17:49,067 --> 00:17:50,601
  Boston Rob with four rungs.   

400
00:17:51,770 --> 00:17:53,870
     Jenna with four rungs.     

401
00:17:53,938 --> 00:17:55,038
     Amber with four rungs.     

402
00:17:55,106 --> 00:17:56,540
    Rupert with four rungs.     

403
00:17:56,607 --> 00:17:58,609
    Everybody tied up.          

404
00:18:03,080 --> 00:18:06,082
  Boston Rob quietly sneaks in  
      with his fifth rung.      

405
00:18:06,151 --> 00:18:08,285
        He's got a lead.        

406
00:18:10,322 --> 00:18:11,755
Jenna with her fifth rung.      

407
00:18:11,823 --> 00:18:13,491
 Boston Rob back in the center. 

408
00:18:13,558 --> 00:18:16,827
Amber with her fifth rung.      

409
00:18:16,895 --> 00:18:19,162
 We're all tied up, five rungs. 

410
00:18:19,230 --> 00:18:21,898
  Boston Rob going in circles.  

411
00:18:28,906 --> 00:18:30,808
 Rupert untying his sixth rung. 

412
00:18:30,875 --> 00:18:32,442
 Got to get back to the center. 

413
00:18:32,511 --> 00:18:34,678
Amber with her sixth rung.      

414
00:18:34,746 --> 00:18:37,548
     Boston Rob coming back     
    the other way now.          

415
00:18:37,615 --> 00:18:39,049
    Still going in circles.     

416
00:18:42,086 --> 00:18:44,888
     Rupert closing the gap     
      with his sixth rung.      

417
00:18:49,360 --> 00:18:51,595
Jenna back with her sixth rung. 

418
00:18:52,597 --> 00:18:54,965
        Boston Rob back         
      with his sixth rung.      

419
00:18:55,032 --> 00:18:58,735
    Amber with her seventh.     
Amber needs only one more rung. 

420
00:18:58,803 --> 00:19:01,271
    Rupert with seven,          
looking for his last rung.      

421
00:19:09,380 --> 00:19:12,015
     Amber on her way back      
      with her last rung.       

422
00:19:12,150 --> 00:19:13,884
      Rupert untying his.       

423
00:19:15,352 --> 00:19:17,788
Rob back with his seventh.      

424
00:19:21,893 --> 00:19:24,861
  Amber has all eight pieces.   

425
00:19:24,929 --> 00:19:26,730
  Amber assembling her ladder.  

426
00:19:26,798 --> 00:19:28,698
      She's got two pieces      
         put together.          

427
00:19:28,766 --> 00:19:31,568
         Three pieces.          

428
00:19:31,636 --> 00:19:33,470
  She's got her fourth piece.   

429
00:19:34,906 --> 00:19:37,207
             Fifth.             

430
00:19:37,275 --> 00:19:39,510
    Amber very close.           

431
00:19:39,577 --> 00:19:42,145
She's climbing the ladder.      

432
00:19:42,214 --> 00:19:43,146
        And with that...        

433
00:19:43,214 --> 00:19:44,548
              Yes!              

434
00:19:44,615 --> 00:19:45,849
      Amber wins immunity!      

435
00:19:45,916 --> 00:19:46,983
          ( <i>screams</i> )           

436
00:19:47,051 --> 00:19:48,785
    Guaranteed Final Three!     

437
00:19:59,296 --> 00:20:00,697
      Amber, come on down.      

438
00:20:00,765 --> 00:20:02,432
          Put this on.          

439
00:20:02,500 --> 00:20:04,901
    Boy, when you needed it,    
          you got it.           

440
00:20:04,969 --> 00:20:07,070
                    Nicely done.

441
00:20:07,138 --> 00:20:08,171
          Oh, my God.           

442
00:20:08,239 --> 00:20:10,206
You are safe tonight            
at Tribal Council.              

443
00:20:10,274 --> 00:20:11,841
  I've never worn this before.  

444
00:20:11,909 --> 00:20:13,010
          Looks good.           

445
00:20:13,077 --> 00:20:14,378
        I think so, too.        

446
00:20:14,446 --> 00:20:16,446
         Amber is safe          
      at the vote tonight.      

447
00:20:16,514 --> 00:20:17,982
The other three of you are not. 

448
00:20:18,049 --> 00:20:19,783
 Somebody is about to go home.  

449
00:20:19,850 --> 00:20:21,718
     You have the afternoon     
      to figure that out.       

450
00:20:21,786 --> 00:20:23,153
    I'll see you at Tribal.     

451
00:20:23,221 --> 00:20:24,688
          Head on out.          

452
00:20:50,281 --> 00:20:52,415
        We vote for Rob         
     and see what happens.      

453
00:20:52,483 --> 00:20:55,519
Yeah, I got a lot               
to talk to you about.           

454
00:20:55,587 --> 00:20:58,021
            What do you want    
            to talk to me about?

455
00:20:58,089 --> 00:21:01,425
He came to me last night        
and said there's no way         

456
00:21:01,492 --> 00:21:03,192
that they're going              
to vote for each other,         

457
00:21:03,260 --> 00:21:05,362
"So, Jenna, why don't you       
just take your chances          

458
00:21:05,296 --> 00:21:06,897
and vote Rupert?"               

459
00:21:06,964 --> 00:21:10,033
  I debated it, kept throwing   
    the idea around, and...     

460
00:21:11,268 --> 00:21:12,635
            I'm not.            

461
00:21:14,071 --> 00:21:16,239
         I can't do it.         

462
00:21:16,307 --> 00:21:19,276
I would rather sit there and    
pick a rock than give them      

463
00:21:19,344 --> 00:21:22,045
the smug satisfaction of knowing
    that they're guaranteed     

464
00:21:22,113 --> 00:21:24,081
a spot.                         

465
00:21:24,149 --> 00:21:28,185
            RUPERT:             
   <i>My fate rests on the honor</i>   
     <i>of a 26-year-old</i>           

466
00:21:28,253 --> 00:21:32,589
    single mama who really,     
really wants to win badly.      

467
00:21:35,560 --> 00:21:37,861
              ROB:              
      So how is everything      
going to go down tonight?       

468
00:21:37,929 --> 00:21:39,496
Have you decided?               

469
00:21:39,530 --> 00:21:40,764
              No.               

470
00:21:40,832 --> 00:21:43,333
    Obviously, I have           
    a vested interest in it.    

471
00:21:43,401 --> 00:21:45,168
But, I mean, you can't          

472
00:21:45,236 --> 00:21:46,336
 beat Rupert in the Final Two.  

473
00:21:46,404 --> 00:21:48,304
        Yeah, but that's why it 
        might be worth it for me

474
00:21:48,373 --> 00:21:49,739
             to choose a rock   
             and then you're out

475
00:21:49,807 --> 00:21:50,940
                     and it's me
                     that's in. 

476
00:21:51,008 --> 00:21:52,776
        Maybe you, too.         
                        Exactly.

477
00:21:52,844 --> 00:21:55,679
Well, to me,                    
that's ridiculous...            

478
00:21:55,746 --> 00:21:57,014
              Because you won't 
              do it against her.

479
00:21:57,081 --> 00:21:58,014
                That's my point.

480
00:21:58,082 --> 00:21:59,549
There's a possibility           
I could beat her.               

481
00:21:59,617 --> 00:22:01,451
There's no possibility          
I could beat Rupert.            

482
00:22:01,519 --> 00:22:03,686
There's no possibility          
you could beat Rupert.          
                    I disagree. 

483
00:22:03,754 --> 00:22:04,888
                     I disagree.

484
00:22:04,956 --> 00:22:06,656
It's the difference             
between maybe winning           

485
00:22:06,724 --> 00:22:09,126
the million or a 30% shot       

486
00:22:09,193 --> 00:22:10,293
at maybe going home.            

487
00:22:10,361 --> 00:22:11,962
             JENNA:             
     <i>Now I don't know.</i>          

488
00:22:12,030 --> 00:22:15,899
   <i>I'm not letting Rob push me</i>  
 <i>into anything, but there is...</i> 

489
00:22:15,967 --> 00:22:18,401
truth, I mean, I would be       
      in the Final Three.       

490
00:22:18,469 --> 00:22:20,537
   <i>I might go up against them</i>   
         <i>and beat them,</i>         

491
00:22:20,605 --> 00:22:22,372
       <i>and then I've got</i>        
       <i>a million dollars.</i>       

492
00:22:22,440 --> 00:22:24,307
         Let's go spend         
      some time together.       

493
00:22:24,375 --> 00:22:26,109
This might be my last day here. 

494
00:22:28,045 --> 00:22:29,179
             AMBER:             
          <i>Don't be sad.</i>         

495
00:22:29,247 --> 00:22:30,814
Yesterday, you're all           
feeling confident...            

496
00:22:30,881 --> 00:22:32,382
        Nah, I am, I'm          
        totally fine with it.   

497
00:22:32,450 --> 00:22:34,751
Today, you're not               
feeling confident.              
        It's out of my hands.   

498
00:22:34,819 --> 00:22:36,286
              There's nothing   
              I can do about it,

499
00:22:36,321 --> 00:22:39,089
so I'm not going to worry       
about it, you know?             
                        Yeah.   

500
00:22:40,692 --> 00:22:43,326
If I do go tonight,             
you better win.                 

501
00:22:43,394 --> 00:22:44,661
            Quit saying that.   
        No, you better.         

502
00:22:44,729 --> 00:22:45,796
          You better.           

503
00:22:45,864 --> 00:22:48,632
                I want you to   
                come with me.   

504
00:22:55,273 --> 00:22:56,440
This is so good.                

505
00:22:59,343 --> 00:23:01,111
The decision is still...        

506
00:23:01,179 --> 00:23:04,681
     it's still a little up     
  in the air... to be honest.   

507
00:23:04,748 --> 00:23:07,084
            RUPERT:             
     <i>I can't see Jenna</i>          
     <i>going against me,</i>          

508
00:23:07,152 --> 00:23:08,551
     <i>and I don't want to go</i>     
         <i>against Jenna.</i>         

509
00:23:08,619 --> 00:23:10,186
  <i>She's just a little paranoid.</i> 

510
00:23:10,254 --> 00:23:11,955
 <i>You got to let her alone.</i>      
 <i>She's just a young girl.</i>       

511
00:23:12,023 --> 00:23:13,356
           <i>She's fine.</i>          

512
00:23:13,424 --> 00:23:14,825
Either way,                     
I appreciate it.                

513
00:23:14,892 --> 00:23:16,159
            I know.             

514
00:23:16,227 --> 00:23:19,496
    I believe that she will     
    write Rob's name down.      

515
00:23:19,564 --> 00:23:22,432
The beginning-of-this-game      
person Jenna would say...       

516
00:23:22,500 --> 00:23:25,902
"Don't let emotional attachment 
         get in the way         

517
00:23:25,970 --> 00:23:27,871
    of your strategic           
        survival game."         

518
00:23:27,939 --> 00:23:29,138
        What about you?         

519
00:23:29,206 --> 00:23:32,476
              My emotions       
              control what I do.

520
00:23:32,544 --> 00:23:34,411
            In this game or     
            out of this game,   

521
00:23:34,479 --> 00:23:37,113
                that's all I got
                is who I am.    

522
00:23:37,181 --> 00:23:39,449
              ROB:              
  <i>Rupert's a very smart player.</i> 

523
00:23:39,516 --> 00:23:41,250
  I give him a lot of credit.   

524
00:23:41,318 --> 00:23:44,821
   <i>He's probably conned Jenna</i>   
  <i>into feeling bad about doing</i>  

525
00:23:44,888 --> 00:23:47,124
  anything but pulling a rock.  

526
00:23:50,027 --> 00:23:52,862
I've never been in so much      
      turmoil in my life.       

527
00:23:52,930 --> 00:23:54,664
 <i>I have the power tonight.</i>      

528
00:23:54,732 --> 00:23:56,199
      I really don't know       
    what I'm going to do...     

529
00:23:56,267 --> 00:23:57,768
 <i>until I get to Tribal Council.</i> 

530
00:23:57,835 --> 00:24:00,103
       <i>It's really, really</i>      

531
00:24:00,170 --> 00:24:01,871
    a tough decision.           

532
00:24:25,763 --> 00:24:27,430
Now, bring in the members       
         of our jury--          

533
00:24:27,498 --> 00:24:32,602
Lex, Kathy, Alicia, Shii Ann... 

534
00:24:32,669 --> 00:24:36,506
    Big Tom voted out           
  at the last Tribal Council.   

535
00:24:40,845 --> 00:24:42,112
  So, let's get right into it.  

536
00:24:42,180 --> 00:24:45,882
  At the last Tribal Council,   
  Big Tom clearly blindsided.   

537
00:24:45,949 --> 00:24:48,451
Jury reaction was pretty strong.

538
00:24:48,519 --> 00:24:49,752
     Did you see it, Jenna?     

539
00:24:49,820 --> 00:24:50,820
     Yeah, I saw it, yeah.      

540
00:24:50,888 --> 00:24:52,421
             Did it put anything
             through your head, 

541
00:24:52,489 --> 00:24:53,857
      because the power's       
      clearly shifted now.      

542
00:24:53,924 --> 00:24:55,492
                      Of course.

543
00:24:55,560 --> 00:24:57,527
        These are people        
    that we have voted out.     

544
00:24:57,595 --> 00:25:00,296
                Facing them     
                is traumatic,   

545
00:25:00,364 --> 00:25:02,031
            every single time   
            we come here.       

546
00:25:02,099 --> 00:25:05,601
  Clearly, Big Tom had no idea  
    that he was about to go.    

547
