00:25:05,669 --> 00:25:07,437
    Boston Rob, here we are,    

548
00:25:07,504 --> 00:25:09,472
         we're down to          
     a Final Five situation     

549
00:25:09,540 --> 00:25:10,606
 and you betray somebody again, 

550
00:25:10,674 --> 00:25:13,510
     knowing you need them      
    to get the money.           

551
00:25:13,578 --> 00:25:15,678
         All I can say, Jeff, is

552
00:25:15,746 --> 00:25:18,048
    there's two sides           
        to every story.         

553
00:25:18,115 --> 00:25:21,451
             And I say that with

554
00:25:21,519 --> 00:25:24,220
        100% conviction.        

555
00:25:24,288 --> 00:25:27,990
    Amber, make the argument    
      that "It's not fair       

556
00:25:28,058 --> 00:25:29,693
      "to judge me because      
        I voted you out.        

557
00:25:29,760 --> 00:25:32,596
      That <i>is</i> part of the game."

558
00:25:32,664 --> 00:25:34,531
      In Australia, I had       
      an alliance, um...        

559
00:25:34,598 --> 00:25:36,766
    or what I thought           
    was an alliance,            

560
00:25:36,834 --> 00:25:38,968
              and I was somewhat
              blindsided.       

561
00:25:39,036 --> 00:25:40,503
                But when it     
                came down to it,

562
00:25:40,571 --> 00:25:42,271
        I actually ended up     
        voting for the person   

563
00:25:42,339 --> 00:25:43,840
            who broke their     
            alliance with me.   

564
00:25:43,908 --> 00:25:47,177
 And it was really hard for me  
    to cast that vote           

565
00:25:47,245 --> 00:25:49,079
 because they hurt my feelings. 

566
00:25:49,147 --> 00:25:50,180
                 But then I also
                 had to remember

567
00:25:50,248 --> 00:25:52,115
        that I'm playing        
        the game of <i>Survivor,</i>   

568
00:25:52,183 --> 00:25:53,983
              and it's "outwit, 
              outplay, outlast,"

569
00:25:54,051 --> 00:25:56,619
  and I felt that that person   
      truly outwitted me.       

570
00:25:56,687 --> 00:25:58,788
             JEFF:              
      And it seems to me,       

571
00:25:58,856 --> 00:26:01,024
      with each successive      
        Tribal Council,         

572
00:26:01,092 --> 00:26:03,827
  the emotional wear and tear   
     on you guys increases.     

573
00:26:03,895 --> 00:26:06,496
     Rupert, you and Jenna      
    have been pretty tight.     

574
00:26:06,564 --> 00:26:08,665
    There's no mystery          
that Boston Rob and Amber       

575
00:26:08,733 --> 00:26:10,499
    have been pretty tight,     

576
00:26:10,567 --> 00:26:12,502
    but there's always been     
somebody else to vote out.      

577
00:26:12,570 --> 00:26:13,470
It's not the case anymore.      

578
00:26:13,538 --> 00:26:16,873
  Today was a very tough day.   

579
00:26:16,941 --> 00:26:19,642
It was very high                
and very low.                   

580
00:26:19,710 --> 00:26:22,379
Coming home                     
without the necklace            

581
00:26:22,446 --> 00:26:23,846
and then being told             

582
00:26:23,914 --> 00:26:26,216
that the game might be          
changing for you,               

583
00:26:26,284 --> 00:26:29,719
  those were pretty big lows.   

584
00:26:29,786 --> 00:26:31,588
Jenna, fill in the blanks       
            for me.             

585
00:26:31,655 --> 00:26:34,458
  Because what Rupert's saying  
      is he's either out,       

586
00:26:34,525 --> 00:26:35,591
or it's going to be a tie,      

587
00:26:35,659 --> 00:26:38,094
    and he's going to           
      get a shot at fate.       

588
00:26:38,162 --> 00:26:39,362
            Exactly.            

589
00:26:39,430 --> 00:26:41,864
                 It really is   
                 a true toss-up,

590
00:26:41,932 --> 00:26:43,900
        because I truly         
    have a bond with Rupert.    

591
00:26:43,968 --> 00:26:45,068
                  This is a game

592
00:26:45,136 --> 00:26:47,503
    and I have to get myself    
    as far as I can, but then   

593
00:26:47,571 --> 00:26:49,105
        do I put somebody       
        else's game at risk--   

594
00:26:49,173 --> 00:26:51,107
                that I love--   
                out here?       

595
00:26:51,174 --> 00:26:53,743
    And that's been resting     
    on my shoulders today.      

596
00:26:53,811 --> 00:26:56,446
So, Rupert, what it comes       
down to for you, tonight,       

597
00:26:56,514 --> 00:26:57,814
  from what I'm understanding,  

598
00:26:57,882 --> 00:26:59,682
    is whether or not Jenna     
            is going            

599
00:26:59,750 --> 00:27:02,585
     to put your name down      
        or Boston Rob's,        

600
00:27:02,653 --> 00:27:05,055
     her only other option.     

601
00:27:05,122 --> 00:27:07,156
You know, everybody's got       
to play the game how they play. 

602
00:27:07,224 --> 00:27:09,959
And that's okay.                

603
00:27:10,027 --> 00:27:13,462
  But I hope that Jenna and I   
      would stand strong,       

604
00:27:13,530 --> 00:27:17,667
that we would force             
the rock issue.                 

605
00:27:17,735 --> 00:27:20,103
Amber, you have immunity.       

606
00:27:20,171 --> 00:27:21,538
     Cannot vote for Amber.     

607
00:27:21,605 --> 00:27:23,806
      It is time to vote.       
      Rupert, you're up.        

608
00:27:34,485 --> 00:27:35,985
 <i>I don't know what else to say.</i> 

609
00:27:36,053 --> 00:27:37,687
  <i>I hope we both have two votes</i> 

610
00:27:37,755 --> 00:27:39,722
  and I hope we go into a tie.  

611
00:27:47,598 --> 00:27:49,165
You're a gentleman, buddy.      

612
00:27:49,233 --> 00:27:52,435
      <i>It's been a pleasure</i>      
   <i>playing the game with you.</i>   

613
00:27:52,503 --> 00:27:53,870
    I hope it's you tonight     
          and not me.           

614
00:27:53,937 --> 00:27:55,338
            Thanks.             

615
00:28:15,526 --> 00:28:17,627
      I still don't know.       

616
00:28:35,279 --> 00:28:36,780
    I'll go tally the votes.    

617
00:28:46,858 --> 00:28:48,692
    Once the votes are read,    
     the decision is final.     

618
00:28:48,759 --> 00:28:50,026
      The person voted out      
         will be asked          

619
00:28:50,094 --> 00:28:51,995
to leave the Tribal Council area
          immediately.          

620
00:28:52,062 --> 00:28:53,663
      I'll read the votes.      

621
00:28:55,332 --> 00:28:57,199
         First vote...          

622
00:28:57,267 --> 00:28:58,902
              Rob.              

623
00:28:58,970 --> 00:29:01,337
            Rupert.             

624
00:29:01,405 --> 00:29:03,039
 One vote Rob, one vote Rupert. 

625
00:29:07,344 --> 00:29:08,345
            Rupert.             

626
00:29:08,412 --> 00:29:09,545
    Two votes Rupert.           

627
00:29:09,613 --> 00:29:11,247
         One vote Rob.          

628
00:29:11,315 --> 00:29:13,950
        The last vote...        

629
00:29:17,788 --> 00:29:20,190
The 15th person voted out       
     of <i>Survivor All-Stars</i>      

630
00:29:20,257 --> 00:29:23,293
      and the sixth member      
      of our jury, Rupert.      

631
00:29:23,361 --> 00:29:24,627
  Need to bring me your torch.  

632
00:29:34,071 --> 00:29:35,138
          It's part of the game.

633
00:29:43,180 --> 00:29:45,682
            Rupert, the tribe   
            has spoken.         

634
00:29:47,685 --> 00:29:49,185
    It's time for you to go.    

635
00:30:02,633 --> 00:30:04,667
     Well, you've survived      
         another vote,          

636
00:30:04,734 --> 00:30:06,302
  made it through another day.  

637
00:30:06,270 --> 00:30:11,607
We are now down to three people,
     two Tribal Councils...     

638
00:30:11,675 --> 00:30:12,942
          one winner.           

639
00:30:13,010 --> 00:30:14,143
    Grab your torches.          

640
00:30:14,211 --> 00:30:16,146
    Head back to camp.          
          Good night.           

641
00:30:22,252 --> 00:30:24,287
            RUPERT:             
  <i>I am a little angry at Jenna.</i> 

642
00:30:24,355 --> 00:30:26,889
 Greed won out over friendship. 

643
00:30:26,957 --> 00:30:28,791
      <i>Almost disgusted me.</i>      

644
00:30:28,859 --> 00:30:31,127
     <i>There's not one person</i>     
          <i>in this game</i>          

645
00:30:31,195 --> 00:30:32,896
  <i>that can say I lied to them,</i>  

646
00:30:32,963 --> 00:30:34,430
 <i>that I played conniving.</i>       

647
00:30:34,498 --> 00:30:35,932
         <i>I did my best.</i>         

648
00:30:36,000 --> 00:30:39,736
     I honestly had a very,     
      very good experience      

649
00:30:39,804 --> 00:30:42,038
    with <i>Survivor All-Stars.</i>    

650
00:30:51,549 --> 00:30:53,983
             JENNA:             
  I love Rupert, but you know,  

651
00:30:54,051 --> 00:30:56,786
I couldn't let my whole         
game be put into a bag          

652
00:30:56,853 --> 00:31:00,256
and roll the dice on            
whether I'd get a rock          

653
00:31:00,324 --> 00:31:01,424
    that would send me          
         home tonight.          

654
00:31:01,492 --> 00:31:02,592
                         Mm-hmm.
Right.                          

655
00:31:02,660 --> 00:31:03,827
Not when I still had fate       

656
00:31:03,894 --> 00:31:05,528
                in my hands that
                I could work.   

657
00:31:05,596 --> 00:31:06,896
         Regardless...          

658
00:31:06,964 --> 00:31:08,664
regardless of your decision,    
whatever it was,                

659
00:31:08,732 --> 00:31:11,501
I respect the fact that,        
you know,                       

660
00:31:11,569 --> 00:31:12,568
    you made it on your own.    

661
00:31:12,636 --> 00:31:13,736
                          JENNA:
                          Yeah. 

662
00:31:13,804 --> 00:31:16,539
And that's the most             
important thing.                

663
00:31:16,607 --> 00:31:18,642
                            Ooh!

664
00:31:27,985 --> 00:31:29,452
    Hey, Jeff.                  
Morning.                        

665
00:31:29,519 --> 00:31:31,087
                Good morning.   
                        Morning.

666
00:31:31,154 --> 00:31:32,589
    What are you guys           
    doing up so early?          

667
00:31:32,656 --> 00:31:33,657
We're the Final Three.          

668
00:31:33,724 --> 00:31:34,991
We couldn't really sleep        
too much.                       

669
00:31:35,059 --> 00:31:35,958
                 Beautiful moon.

670
00:31:36,026 --> 00:31:36,992
             It is.             

671
00:31:37,061 --> 00:31:38,194
I got my girls.                 

672
00:31:38,262 --> 00:31:39,195
                Life is good.   

673
00:31:39,263 --> 00:31:40,729
Life is good.                   

674
00:31:40,797 --> 00:31:42,431
     Well, day 38 is here.      

675
00:31:42,499 --> 00:31:45,768
     Today you'll take part     
 in your final rite of passage. 

676
00:31:45,836 --> 00:31:48,037
We brought along a canoe.       

677
00:31:48,105 --> 00:31:49,705
     You'll take this map.      

678
00:31:49,773 --> 00:31:51,641
  You'll follow it to an area   
      where you will find       

679
00:31:51,709 --> 00:31:55,979
    an array of body paints     
and jewelry used and worn       

680
00:31:56,046 --> 00:31:59,682
    by a local and fiercely-    
 independent tribe of Indians,  

681
00:31:59,750 --> 00:32:00,984
        the Cunas.              

682
00:32:01,051 --> 00:32:03,786
    You'll adorn your bodies    
        as you see fit,         

683
00:32:03,854 --> 00:32:05,655
  then you'll set out on foot.  

684
00:32:05,722 --> 00:32:08,491
As you walk, you will come along
          the torches           

685
00:32:08,559 --> 00:32:11,694
  of your fellow tribe members  
    who have been voted out.    

686
00:32:11,762 --> 00:32:13,095
         Take a moment.         

687
00:32:13,197 --> 00:32:16,599
  Think about the impact they   
  had on you and on the game.   

688
00:32:16,666 --> 00:32:18,768
 When you reach the last torch, 

689
00:32:18,836 --> 00:32:20,469
 I'll be waiting for you there  

690
00:32:20,537 --> 00:32:24,774
      to guide you through      
 your final immunity challenge. 

691
00:32:24,842 --> 00:32:26,976
        I encourage you         
      to embrace this day.      

692
00:32:27,044 --> 00:32:30,046
    You're never going          
     to be back here again.     

693
00:32:30,114 --> 00:32:31,081
    Thanks, Jeff.               
Thanks, Jeff.                   

694
00:32:31,148 --> 00:32:32,815
I'll see you at the other side. 

695
00:32:32,883 --> 00:32:35,185
Grab the paddles.               

696
00:33:10,554 --> 00:33:12,388
                    ROB:        
                    Oh... there.

697
00:33:20,530 --> 00:33:22,932
Oh, wow!                        

698
00:33:25,002 --> 00:33:26,369
Oh, my gosh.                    

699
00:33:28,772 --> 00:33:29,872
This is so awesome.             

700
00:33:29,940 --> 00:33:31,841
             JENNA:             
        This <i>is</i> awesome.        

701
00:33:31,909 --> 00:33:33,743
         Look at these.         

702
00:33:59,003 --> 00:34:00,403
             AMBER:             
         It's that one.         

703
00:34:04,674 --> 00:34:05,608
        You girls look pretty.  

704
00:34:05,676 --> 00:34:06,542
          ( <i>chuckles</i> )          

705
00:34:44,615 --> 00:34:47,350
             TINA:              
     <i>I'd do this again</i>          
 <i>because it's part of my being.</i> 

706
00:34:47,418 --> 00:34:49,586
          <i>This was such</i>         
   <i>a life-expanding adventure.</i>  

707
00:34:49,653 --> 00:34:51,854
 <i>I think I would have regretted</i> 
     <i>if I didn't come,</i>          

708
00:34:51,922 --> 00:34:53,823
  <i>and I don't want any regrets</i>  
           <i>in my life.</i>          

709
00:34:53,890 --> 00:34:55,425
                75 years old.   

710
00:34:55,492 --> 00:34:57,660
If I were military,             
I'd salute you.                 

711
00:34:57,728 --> 00:34:59,094
             RUDY:              
     <i>The second time around,</i>    

712
00:34:59,162 --> 00:35:01,831
 <i>I was three years slower,</i>      
         <i>for one thing.</i>         

713
00:35:01,898 --> 00:35:04,033
     <i>And there's a lot</i>          
     <i>of cut-throating</i>           

714
00:35:04,100 --> 00:35:05,334
       <i>going on out there.</i>      

715
00:35:05,402 --> 00:35:07,737
 <i>And I should have known better.</i>

716
00:35:12,776 --> 00:35:16,645
        JENNA M.:               
 <i>I've already played this game,</i> 
      <i>and I've already won.</i>     

717
00:35:16,713 --> 00:35:19,448
     <i>I'll look back on this</i>     
   <i>just like I did the Amazon,</i>  

718
00:35:19,516 --> 00:35:21,985
 <i>and be glad that I fought</i>      
   <i>through as much as I could.</i>  

719
00:35:22,052 --> 00:35:23,118
    ( <i>Rob chuckling</i> )           

720
00:35:23,187 --> 00:35:24,887
He's not even here,             

721
00:35:24,954 --> 00:35:26,622
and he's making                 
us laugh.                       
    I know, right?              

722
00:35:26,690 --> 00:35:28,791
            ROB C.:             
      <i>It's a little bit of</i>      
     <i>a humbling experience.</i>     

723
00:35:28,859 --> 00:35:31,327
   <i>I thought that I might be,</i>   
         <i>in fact,</i>               

724
00:35:31,395 --> 00:35:34,030
  <i>the greatest</i> Survivor <i>player</i>  
          <i>to ever play,</i>         

725
00:35:34,097 --> 00:35:36,332
       <i>but I was a victim</i>       
   <i>of my own success, I think.</i>  

726
00:35:38,869 --> 00:35:40,502
            RICHARD:            
 <i>One of the biggest things</i>      
     <i>that surprised me</i>          

727
00:35:40,570 --> 00:35:41,604
     <i>about the entire</i>           
      <i> Survivor: All-Stars</i>      

728
00:35:41,672 --> 00:35:43,039
      <i>was how tough it was.</i>     

729
00:35:43,106 --> 00:35:44,140
      <i>Certainly more tough</i>      

730
00:35:44,208 --> 00:35:45,608
     <i>than the original game</i>     
         <i>I played.</i>              

731
00:35:45,675 --> 00:35:47,042
 <i>Either I'm getting older</i>       

732
00:35:47,111 --> 00:35:49,612
      <i>or it's getting way,</i>      
      <i>way too tough for me.</i>     

733
00:35:51,715 --> 00:35:55,350
              SUE:              
 <i>I was just totally exempt</i>      
   <i>from any energy or emotion.</i>  

734
00:35:55,418 --> 00:35:57,386
 <i>I decided that I had to leave.</i> 

735
00:35:57,454 --> 00:36:00,489
 <i>It takes too much emotion</i>      
       <i>to play this game.</i>       

736
00:36:02,292 --> 00:36:04,694
             COLBY:             
   <i>I found patience this time</i>   
 <i>that I never knew I had.</i>       

737
00:36:04,761 --> 00:36:05,961
      <i>The game required it,</i>     

738
00:36:06,029 --> 00:36:07,796
       <i>my mental stability</i>      
          <i>required it,</i>          

739
00:36:07,864 --> 00:36:11,100
 <i>and I was so proud to find it.</i> 

740
00:36:13,137 --> 00:36:15,905
             ETHAN:             
   <i>In Africa, I didn't receive</i>  
       <i>one vote against me</i>      

741
00:36:15,972 --> 00:36:17,707
     <i>the entire time</i>            
     <i>I was out there.</i>           

742
00:36:17,774 --> 00:36:19,609
     <i>During</i> All-Stars,          
       <i>you know, it hurts.</i>      

743
00:36:19,676 --> 00:36:20,876
          <i>And each time</i>         
       <i>you see your name,</i>       

744
00:36:20,944 --> 00:36:22,912
   <i>you feel that little punch</i>   
          <i>in your gut.</i>          

745
00:36:22,980 --> 00:36:26,983
  <i>I still want to be out there</i>  
     <i>playing the game.</i>          

746
00:36:27,050 --> 00:36:28,951
             AMBER;             
     <i>The reason why I'm here</i>    

747
00:36:29,019 --> 00:36:30,886
is 'cause the reason            
why she's gone.                 

748
00:36:30,954 --> 00:36:32,588
Thanks, Jerri.                  

749
00:36:32,656 --> 00:36:35,525
             JERRI:             
   <i>I ask myself so many times</i>   
             <i>a day,</i>             

750
00:36:35,592 --> 00:36:38,327
 <i>"Why would I want to put myself</i>
      <i>through this again?"</i>      

751
00:36:38,328 --> 00:36:41,163
 <i>I had no idea that it was going</i>
   <i>to nearly break my spirit.</i>   

752
00:36:41,231 --> 00:36:42,664
         <i>But it didn't.</i>         

753
00:36:45,769 --> 00:36:47,704
              LEX:              
   <i>I broke the biggest promise</i>  
     <i>I made to myself</i>           

754
00:36:47,771 --> 00:36:48,937
     <i>coming into this thing.</i>    

755
00:36:49,005 --> 00:36:50,473
       <i>I mixed friendship</i>       
         <i>with the game.</i>         

756
00:36:50,540 --> 00:36:52,108
  <i>The two cannot mix together.</i>  

757
00:36:52,176 --> 00:36:55,244
 <i>And as soon as you allow</i>       
  <i>a little too much compassion</i>  

758
00:36:55,312 --> 00:36:56,646
     <i>to show through,</i>           

759
00:36:56,713 --> 00:36:59,381
   <i>you're setting yourself up</i>   
          <i>for disaster.</i>         

760
00:37:01,018 --> 00:37:02,985
             KATHY:             
     <i>What I rely on is trust</i>    
           <i>and loyalty</i>          

761
00:37:03,053 --> 00:37:05,054
 <i>and the better qualities</i>       
         <i>of life.</i>               

762
00:37:05,122 --> 00:37:07,923
  <i>Maybe I just don't have it in</i> 
  <i>myself to make it all the way</i> 

763
00:37:07,992 --> 00:37:10,126
     <i>to the million and lie.</i>    

764
00:37:11,895 --> 00:37:13,829
            ALICIA:             
     <i>This time around,</i>          
   <i>I bit my tongue a lot more,</i>  

765
00:37:13,897 --> 00:37:16,765
 <i>I walked away a lot more,</i>      
      <i>kept my mouth quiet.</i>      

766
00:37:16,833 --> 00:37:18,701
          <i>I eased back</i>          
 <i>on the challenges a lot,</i>       

767
00:37:18,769 --> 00:37:20,570
      <i>so that I didn't look</i>     
       <i>like such a threat.</i>      

768
00:37:20,637 --> 00:37:24,707
 <i>And it got me six days further</i> 
 <i>into the game this time.</i>       

769
00:37:27,278 --> 00:37:29,111
        SHII ANN:               
   <i>I've played with the best.</i>   

770
00:37:29,179 --> 00:37:31,381
   <i>I beat my favorite players,</i>  
     <i>I beat them all.</i>           

771
00:37:31,448 --> 00:37:35,017
  <i>And ultimately, it came down</i>  
  <i>to bad luck with the numbers.</i> 

772
00:37:35,085 --> 00:37:38,087
 <i>Sometimes that's the way</i>       
         <i>the chips fall.</i>        

773
00:37:40,791 --> 00:37:43,326
              TOM:              
 <i>Truly, I didn't consider</i>       
       <i>myself an All-Star.</i>      

774
00:37:43,394 --> 00:37:46,696
 <i>For me, just to say that I was</i> 
 <i>in that group is a proud moment</i>

775
00:37:46,763 --> 00:37:49,898
 <i>for an old country boy like me.</i>

776
00:37:52,803 --> 00:37:54,070
             AMBER:             
     I definitely consider      

777
00:37:54,137 --> 00:37:56,606
playing the game with him       
as a huge honor.                

778
00:37:56,674 --> 00:37:59,475
            RUPERT:             
         <i>I came out here</i>        
     <i>to take care of myself</i>     

779
00:37:59,543 --> 00:38:01,477
     <i>and everyone around me,</i>    
           <i>and I did.</i>           

780
00:38:01,545 --> 00:38:04,480
      <i>I might not have won</i>      
  <i>one damn immunity challenge,</i>  

781
00:38:04,548 --> 00:38:06,182
 <i>but I won a few rewards.</i>       

782
00:38:06,250 --> 00:38:12,088
   <i>I enjoyed myself, I shared,</i>  
 <i>I cared and I actually had fun.</i>

783
00:38:15,925 --> 00:38:18,227
             AMBER:             
   <i>Walking by all the torches</i>   

784
00:38:18,295 --> 00:38:19,495
    made me feel proud          

785
00:38:19,563 --> 00:38:21,230
         to be standing         
     where I was standing,      

786
00:38:21,297 --> 00:38:22,764
 <i>but also a little guilty,</i>      

787
00:38:22,832 --> 00:38:25,134
 <i>knowing that I ended this game</i> 
   <i>for a lot of those people.</i>   

788
00:38:25,201 --> 00:38:28,304
     <i>So, it was a little bit</i>    
          <i>bittersweet.</i>          

789
00:38:28,371 --> 00:38:32,475
   <i>I'm feeling a little scared</i>  
         <i>and nervous...</i>         

790
00:38:32,542 --> 00:38:34,043
     <i>and not really knowing</i>     
          <i>what's ahead.</i>         

791
00:38:34,111 --> 00:38:35,345
     <i>At the end of the day,</i>     

792
00:38:35,412 --> 00:38:36,746
       <i>one of us is going</i>       
       <i>to have immunity,</i>        

793
00:38:36,813 --> 00:38:38,748
 <i>and one of us will not be</i>      
     <i>in the Final Two.</i>          

794
00:38:59,603 --> 00:39:01,603
                Well, welcome   

795
00:39:01,671 --> 00:39:04,339
         to your final          
      immunity challenge.       

796
00:39:04,407 --> 00:39:06,608
Amber, I'll take                
that back.                      

797
00:39:12,482 --> 00:39:15,684
    For the last time,          
 immunity is back up for grabs. 

798
00:39:15,752 --> 00:39:18,220
Today's immunity challenge      
        is very simple.         

799
00:39:18,287 --> 00:39:19,755
It's all about endurance.       

800
00:39:19,823 --> 00:39:21,457
How badly do you want it?       

801
00:39:21,525 --> 00:39:23,625
     <i>You will stand barefoot</i>    
         <i>on posts.</i>              

802
00:39:23,693 --> 00:39:27,363
      <i>You'll have one hand</i>      
      <i>on the Immunity Idol,</i>     

803
00:39:27,430 --> 00:39:28,898
     and you'll stand there     
      as long as you can.       

804
00:39:28,965 --> 00:39:30,666
      Here are the rules.       

805
00:39:30,734 --> 00:39:32,801
If either of your feet come off 
    of that post at any time    

806
00:39:32,869 --> 00:39:33,936
        for any reason;         

807
00:39:33,971 --> 00:39:36,305
     if your hand comes off     
          of the Idol           

808
00:39:36,373 --> 00:39:37,707
  at any time for any reason;   

809
00:39:37,775 --> 00:39:40,810
     or if your second hand     
        touches the Idol        

810
00:39:40,878 --> 00:39:42,444
          or the post           
     that it's sitting on,      

811
00:39:42,512 --> 00:39:43,946
    you're out of the game.     

812
00:39:44,013 --> 00:39:47,483
Last person left standing       
         wins immunity.         

813
00:39:47,550 --> 00:39:49,752
    Guaranteed a spot           
    in the Final Two            

814
00:39:49,820 --> 00:39:52,054
          and a chance          
    to face your jury.          

815
00:39:52,122 --> 00:39:54,457
     <i>And</i> you decide who sits    
          next to you           

816
00:39:54,524 --> 00:39:56,458
 at that final Tribal Council.  

817
00:39:58,361 --> 00:39:59,628
        All right.              
      Take off your shoes       

818
00:39:59,696 --> 00:40:00,997
  and any other clothing items  

819
00:40:01,064 --> 00:40:02,999
 or necklaces you don't want on 
          during this.          

820
00:40:03,066 --> 00:40:04,433
  Take your spot on the perch.  

821
00:40:10,807 --> 00:40:13,342
All right, challenge has begun. 

822
00:40:50,980 --> 00:40:53,415
    Coming up on 30 minutes.    

823
00:40:53,483 --> 00:40:55,084
Not much of a breeze, is there? 

824
00:40:55,152 --> 00:40:56,318
             Mm-mm.             

825
00:41:00,323 --> 00:41:02,424
Got a lively group              
here today.                     

826
00:41:02,492 --> 00:41:04,460
The final                       
immunity challenge.             

827
00:41:26,683 --> 00:41:28,484
             JEFF:              
          One hour in.          

828
00:41:28,552 --> 00:41:29,584
    Give me a status report.    

829
00:41:29,652 --> 00:41:31,086
What's hurting the most, Jenna? 

830
00:41:31,154 --> 00:41:32,054
         The back foot.         

831
00:41:32,122 --> 00:41:33,355
     It's just about trying     

832
00:41:33,423 --> 00:41:34,757
     to switch positions up     

833
00:41:34,825 --> 00:41:36,358
without lifting your foot,      

834
00:41:36,426 --> 00:41:38,694
    without sending yourself    
          off balance.          

835
00:41:38,762 --> 00:41:40,029
            How are you doing,  
            Boston Rob?         

836
00:41:40,096 --> 00:41:41,897
Good.                           
                    Amber?      

837
00:41:41,965 --> 00:41:42,931
             Good.              

838
00:41:42,999 --> 00:41:44,733
Jenna, how long you             
think you can go?               

839
00:41:44,801 --> 00:41:47,136
However long these two go.      

840
00:41:47,204 --> 00:41:48,070
                        Really? 

841
00:41:48,204 --> 00:41:49,638
     One minute after that.     

842
00:41:49,706 --> 00:41:51,039
          Game is on.           

843
00:41:51,107 --> 00:41:52,607
    It's a million dollars.     

844
00:41:53,776 --> 00:41:57,045
    So... game is on.           

845
00:42:00,717 --> 00:42:03,452
         I got a cramp.         

846
00:42:03,520 --> 00:42:05,987
ROB:                            
Uh-oh.                          
Jenna has a cramp.              

847
00:42:19,469 --> 00:42:20,669
        Two hours, guys.        

848
00:42:20,737 --> 00:42:24,573
    Two hours, 108 degrees.     

849
00:42:39,756 --> 00:42:40,288
            Jenna...            

850
00:42:41,157 --> 00:42:42,424
     you lifted your foot.      

851
00:42:42,492 --> 00:42:43,359
    I lifted my foot?           

852
00:42:43,426 --> 00:42:44,560
                You lifted      
                your back foot. 

853
00:42:44,627 --> 00:42:47,662
        I thought I had         
    the front of my foot on.    

854
00:42:48,832 --> 00:42:50,666
            I'm sorry, Jenna.   

855
00:42:50,733 --> 00:42:51,901
          You're out.           

856
00:42:56,405 --> 00:42:59,207
Just like that, we're down      
    to Boston Rob and Amber.    

857
00:42:59,275 --> 00:43:00,109
            I want the immunity.

858
00:43:00,243 --> 00:43:01,576
                You've had it   
                a million times.

859
00:43:01,644 --> 00:43:02,844
                A million times.

860
00:43:02,913 --> 00:43:03,913
             Okay.              

861
00:43:03,980 --> 00:43:04,813
            Wait, wait, wait.   

862
00:43:04,881 --> 00:43:06,548
            Catch me up.        
            What's going down?  

863
00:43:06,616 --> 00:43:07,749
        You're going to give her

864
00:43:07,817 --> 00:43:09,919
immunity and step off?          

865
00:43:12,055 --> 00:43:13,889
     I'm going to take you,     
        no matter what.         

866
00:43:13,957 --> 00:43:15,424
     I'm going to take <i>you,</i>     
        <i>no matter what.</i>         

867
00:43:15,491 --> 00:43:16,725
Right.                          

868
00:43:18,395 --> 00:43:19,095
  Let's fight it out, anyway.   

869
00:43:19,229 --> 00:43:20,329
Okay.                           

870
00:43:20,396 --> 00:43:21,530
        Damn you.               

871
00:43:21,598 --> 00:43:22,998
                JEFF:           
                Trust coming up.

872
00:43:23,066 --> 00:43:24,633
        No, it's not...         

873
00:43:24,701 --> 00:43:26,001
    If it's not trust,          
    one of you would step off.  

874
00:43:26,069 --> 00:43:26,669
It's not trust.                 
It's just that...               

875
00:43:26,736 --> 00:43:28,437
            I hate giving up.   

876
00:43:28,505 --> 00:43:32,774
     Do you think this will     
play a factor in who wins?      

877
00:43:32,842 --> 00:43:35,945
  If somebody <i>earned</i> immunity,  
or if somebody gave it up?      

878
00:43:36,013 --> 00:43:38,680
        No, I just think like   
        the whole...            

879
00:43:38,748 --> 00:43:40,749
the whole game, we had          
an alliance since day one.      

880
00:43:40,816 --> 00:43:41,984
     And we stuck together      
        the whole time.         

881
00:43:42,052 --> 00:43:44,887
And every single challenge      
we did,                         

882
00:43:44,954 --> 00:43:47,556
  we always gave 100%, always.  

883
00:43:47,624 --> 00:43:49,358
     We didn't even discuss     
    if it came down to this.    

884
00:43:49,426 --> 00:43:50,259
    We did talk about this.     

885
00:43:50,327 --> 00:43:51,993
    You're saying we didn't,    
          but we did.           

886
00:43:52,061 --> 00:43:54,263
      That we'd would take      
  each other, no matter what.   

887
00:43:54,331 --> 00:43:56,464
     No, we talked about if     
     we were the last two,      

888
00:43:56,532 --> 00:43:58,066
would one of us step down?      

889
00:43:59,770 --> 00:44:00,836
             Mm...              

890
00:44:00,904 --> 00:44:01,870
      Briefly, but we did.      

891
00:44:01,938 --> 00:44:04,106
You wouldn't want me            
to just let you win.            

892
00:44:04,173 --> 00:44:05,507
                    You'd want  
                    to beat me, 

893
00:44:05,575 --> 00:44:07,142
right?                          

894
00:44:07,210 --> 00:44:08,376
      I just want to win.       

895
00:44:08,444 --> 00:44:09,578
Honestly.                       

896
00:44:09,646 --> 00:44:12,114
    Well, you're going          
to have to beat me, then.       

897
00:44:54,390 --> 00:44:55,457
        Oh, that's nice.        

898
00:44:55,525 --> 00:44:57,059
        I thought about doing   
        that a couple times,    

899
00:44:57,126 --> 00:44:59,194
        but I don't know if I   
        was big enough to reach.

900
00:44:59,262 --> 00:45:00,930
         You can reach.         

901
00:45:00,997 --> 00:45:02,430
            I can only reach... 

902
00:45:02,498 --> 00:45:06,134
        JEFF:                   
        Uh! Amber, you're out.  

903
00:45:06,202 --> 00:45:07,402
                I touched it.   

904
00:45:08,804 --> 00:45:09,839
                    Good going. 

905
00:45:09,906 --> 00:45:10,839
You know what you did?          

906
00:45:10,907 --> 00:45:11,874
        Yeah, I touched this.   

907
00:45:11,942 --> 00:45:13,174
Stopped thinking                
for two seconds.                

908
00:45:13,242 --> 00:45:14,376
                I did.          

909
00:45:14,443 --> 00:45:15,610
          You're out.           

910
00:45:15,678 --> 00:45:20,949
  Just like that, Boston Rob,   
    you have final immunity.    

911
00:45:21,017 --> 00:45:22,051
Get over here.                  

912
00:45:24,387 --> 00:45:25,387
It's nicely done.               

913
00:45:25,455 --> 00:45:27,890
You wanted to earn it,          
you earned it.                  

914
00:45:29,992 --> 00:45:31,793
                The last time-- 
                immunity.       

915
00:45:31,861 --> 00:45:34,029
            You're going        
            to the Final Two.   

916
00:45:34,097 --> 00:45:36,765
And tonight at Tribal,          
you will decide                 

917
00:45:36,832 --> 00:45:38,133
            if indeed it's going
            to be Amber--       

918
00:45:38,200 --> 00:45:39,701
        maybe there's a change  
        of heart--              

919
00:45:39,769 --> 00:45:42,037
            Jenna ends up there.

920
00:45:44,640 --> 00:45:46,275
            All right, guys,    
            grab your stuff,    
            head back to camp.  

921
00:45:46,343 --> 00:45:49,210
        I'll see you at Tribal  
        in a little bit.        

922
00:46:07,563 --> 00:46:08,931
             JENNA:             
    You know I wanted           
         to win today.          

923
00:46:08,998 --> 00:46:10,231
            I gave up everything
            with Rupert,        

924
00:46:10,299 --> 00:46:12,000
        and I could have picked 
        rocks yesterday,        

925
00:46:12,068 --> 00:46:13,569
                and maybe Rob   
                would have gone.

926
00:46:13,637 --> 00:46:18,039
    But I lifted my damn foot,  

927
00:46:18,107 --> 00:46:18,974
          <i>so I blew it.</i>         

928
00:46:19,042 --> 00:46:20,041
     <i>I had a million-dollar</i>     

929
00:46:20,109 --> 00:46:21,309
    check written in my hand    

930
00:46:21,377 --> 00:46:23,278
  'cause I would have brought   
          Boston Rob--          

931
00:46:23,346 --> 00:46:24,613
    I would have won.           

932
00:46:24,748 --> 00:46:27,816
     And it all comes down      
to me lifting my foot up.       

933
00:46:27,884 --> 00:46:30,919
      My daughter's going       
    to be very proud.           

934
00:46:30,986 --> 00:46:32,354
       <i>So my game's over.</i>       

935
00:46:32,422 --> 00:46:35,124
 <i>Boston Rob won immunity,</i>       
   <i>he's going to bring Amber,</i>   

936
00:46:35,191 --> 00:46:38,159
       <i>which strategically</i>      
   <i>might not be the best bet,</i>   

937
00:46:38,227 --> 00:46:40,996
 you know, I think she's going  
 to annihilate him in the vote. 

938
00:46:41,064 --> 00:46:42,998
 <i>He'd have a better chance</i>      
           <i>against me,</i>          

939
00:46:43,066 --> 00:46:44,333
     <i>but he won't see that.</i>     

940
00:46:44,400 --> 00:46:47,102
He's giving his girlfriend      
    a million dollars.          

941
00:46:47,170 --> 00:46:49,871
That's a pretty good boyfriend. 

942
00:46:49,939 --> 00:46:50,806
Are you serious?                

943
00:46:50,874 --> 00:46:52,207
        It's not that I don't   
        believe you...          

944
00:46:52,275 --> 00:46:53,208
Oh, my God.                     

945
00:46:53,276 --> 00:46:54,342
        Do you know for sure?   

946
00:46:54,410 --> 00:46:55,743
                If you were     
                in my position, 

947
00:46:55,811 --> 00:46:57,379
        you'd have, like,       
        a scared feeling, too.  

948
00:46:57,447 --> 00:46:58,947
Let me tell you                 
something for sure,             

949
00:46:59,015 --> 00:47:04,919
100% I'm                        
taking you. Okay?               

950
00:47:04,987 --> 00:47:06,255
             AMBER:             
         <i>I feel 99% sure</i>        

951
00:47:06,323 --> 00:47:08,089
 <i>that I'm going to the Final Two</i>
         <i>with Rob.</i>              

952
00:47:08,157 --> 00:47:09,725
    But I have seen him turn    
      on people out here.       

953
00:47:09,792 --> 00:47:11,893
 I have seen him break his word 
      to people out here.       

954
00:47:11,961 --> 00:47:14,563
            Clean up the        
            attitude, will ya?  

955
00:47:14,631 --> 00:47:17,099
             AMBER:             
     <i>I just can't help</i>          
     <i>but feel nervous.</i>          

956
00:47:29,212 --> 00:47:34,015
              ROB:              
     <i>All of a sudden I guess</i>    
 <i>I can't think too clearly</i>      

957
00:47:34,083 --> 00:47:36,318
    trying to realize           
    if what I've been doing     

958
00:47:36,386 --> 00:47:38,920
    this whole time has been    
        the right thing.        

959
00:47:38,988 --> 00:47:42,558
      Is my head clouded,       
      is my judgment bad?       

960
00:47:42,626 --> 00:47:46,427
       <i>I'm not sure where</i>       
       <i>my odds are better.</i>      

961
00:47:46,495 --> 00:47:48,864
   <i>Amber played a solid game,</i>   

962
00:47:48,932 --> 00:47:53,368
       <i>but Amber did ride</i>       
  <i>my coattails the entire way.</i>  

963
00:47:53,436 --> 00:47:54,536
          <i>I don't know,</i>         

964
00:47:54,537 --> 00:47:56,405
      maybe she conned me       
         the whole way.         

965
00:47:56,473 --> 00:47:58,673
  Maybe it's the biggest scam   
  in the history of <i>Survivor.</i>   

966
00:47:58,741 --> 00:48:00,309
       <i>If I go with Jenna,</i>      

967
00:48:00,377 --> 00:48:03,646
  <i>maybe more people are annoyed</i> 
         <i>at Jenna.</i>              

968
00:48:03,713 --> 00:48:06,815
 <i>But then I look like a complete</i>
 <i>ass because I'll sell out</i>      

969
00:48:06,883 --> 00:48:09,851
    absolutely anybody          
    to win this game.           

970
00:48:09,919 --> 00:48:15,057
 <i>I don't know if I can or cannot</i>
 <i>win against either one of them.</i>

971
00:48:15,125 --> 00:48:19,094
   <i>I keep changing my own mind</i>  
         <i>50 times a day.</i>        

972
00:48:19,162 --> 00:48:22,263
  I'm going to think about it,  
        you know.               

973
00:48:22,331 --> 00:48:25,467
          <i>And I'm going</i>         
      <i>to make the decision</i>      

974
00:48:25,535 --> 00:48:27,169
     <i>that I feel most</i>           
       <i>comfortable with...</i>      

975
00:48:27,237 --> 00:48:30,839
          based on me,          

976
00:48:30,907 --> 00:48:35,210
      <i>not based on morals,</i>      
 <i>not based on an alliance</i>       

977
00:48:35,278 --> 00:48:36,511
          <i>that I should</i>         
       <i>or shouldn't honor.</i>      

978
00:48:36,579 --> 00:48:42,417
      <i>A million dollars...</i>      

979
00:48:42,485 --> 00:48:45,253
    What would you do           
     for a million dollars?     

980
00:49:08,377 --> 00:49:10,012
     Now bring in our jury,     

981
00:49:10,080 --> 00:49:12,581
                     Lex, Kathy,

982
00:49:12,648 --> 00:49:14,650
            Alicia, Shii Ann,   

983
00:49:14,717 --> 00:49:16,985
            Big Tom and Rupert--

984
00:49:17,053 --> 00:49:18,987
        voted out at the last   
        Tribal Council.         

985
00:49:22,825 --> 00:49:25,126
        Long day.               

986
00:49:25,194 --> 00:49:27,028
                Started early,  
                had an emotional
                morning,        

987
00:49:27,097 --> 00:49:28,396
          then you had your last

988
00:49:28,464 --> 00:49:30,866
             immunity challenge,

989
00:49:30,934 --> 00:49:32,467
            where it was hot.   

990
00:49:32,535 --> 00:49:33,936
            And it was          
            purely endurance.   

991
00:49:34,003 --> 00:49:36,070
Jenna, you were first off.      

992
00:49:36,138 --> 00:49:37,038
                  What happened?

993
00:49:37,106 --> 00:49:38,206
         I don't know.          

994
00:49:38,274 --> 00:49:40,708
     You said my foot moved     
          off the peg.          

995
00:49:40,776 --> 00:49:42,544
    Yeah, it was very           
      subtle, definitely.       

996
00:49:42,612 --> 00:49:44,846
I'm sure.                       

997
00:49:44,914 --> 00:49:46,648
          Frustrating?          

998
00:49:46,715 --> 00:49:48,951
        More frustrating        
 that it didn't even come down  

999
00:49:49,052 --> 00:49:51,319
    to me, like, falling off    
      or getting too tired      

1000
00:49:51,387 --> 00:49:52,521
     or anything like that.     

1001
00:49:52,588 --> 00:49:53,855
     So that's frustrating.     

1002
00:49:53,923 --> 00:49:54,923
     So, Jenna's first off.     

1003
00:49:54,991 --> 00:49:56,425
     It comes down to Amber     

1004
00:49:56,493 --> 00:49:57,926
                 and Boston Rob,
                 and immediately

1005
00:49:57,994 --> 00:50:00,062
              both of you guys  
              look at each other

1006
00:50:00,129 --> 00:50:01,229
 and say, "Let's make a deal."  

1007
00:50:01,297 --> 00:50:03,598
             But a deal never   
             ended up happening.

1008
00:50:03,666 --> 00:50:05,100
         Amber, was that because

1009
00:50:05,168 --> 00:50:08,369
      this is a game that       
      has a trust issue?        

1010
00:50:08,437 --> 00:50:09,904
I will not deny                 

1011
00:50:09,972 --> 00:50:13,007
  that nerves were definitely   
          taking play           

1012
00:50:13,075 --> 00:50:14,009
                  and definitely
                  thinking,     

1013
00:50:14,076 --> 00:50:15,643
            I would feel much   
            better walking      

1014
00:50:15,711 --> 00:50:18,279
    in tonight with the necklace
    on and being in control     

1015
00:50:18,347 --> 00:50:20,315
              instead of letting
              him be in control.

1016
00:50:20,383 --> 00:50:22,217
          JEFF:                 
          Rob, was that any part
          of your decision      

1017
00:50:22,285 --> 00:50:23,418
                not to step off?

1018
00:50:23,486 --> 00:50:26,054
      That, "What if I do       
      and she turns on me       

1019
00:50:26,121 --> 00:50:28,690
    and takes Jenna instead?"   

1020
00:50:28,758 --> 00:50:30,025
         It had to go through   
         your head a little bit.

1021
00:50:30,093 --> 00:50:31,560
Yeah, of course it              

1022
00:50:31,627 --> 00:50:33,529
     went through my mind.      

1023
00:50:33,596 --> 00:50:34,930
                     I mean, how
                     can it not?

1024
00:50:34,997 --> 00:50:36,131
                You can tell,   

1025
00:50:36,198 --> 00:50:37,633
even at this                    
stage,                          

1026
00:50:37,700 --> 00:50:40,368
    still there's paranoia.     



## S09E14

1
00:00:00,000 --> 00:00:04,162
WWW.MY-SUBS.CO

1
00:00:10,143 --> 00:00:11,614
<i>Il y a 36 jours,</i>

2
00:00:11,739 --> 00:00:15,290
<i>18 Américains
débutèrent l'aventure d'une vie.</i>

3
00:00:18,075 --> 00:00:20,495
<i>Ils furent abandonnés
dans un village tribal</i>

4
00:00:20,620 --> 00:00:23,164
<i>sur l'archipel isolé du Vanuatu.</i>

5
00:00:25,168 --> 00:00:28,205
<i>Lors d'une cérémonie,
les naufragés furent divisés</i>

6
00:00:28,330 --> 00:00:30,786
<i>en deux tribus : hommes et femmes.</i>

7
00:00:32,520 --> 00:00:35,742
<i>Tandis que les femmes devaient
regarder depuis le banc de touche,</i>

8
00:00:35,867 --> 00:00:39,793
<i>les hommes eurent l'occasion
de récupérer une pierre spirituelle,</i>

9
00:00:39,918 --> 00:00:42,217
<i>utilisée pour éloigner
les mauvais esprits.</i>

10
00:00:42,342 --> 00:00:44,280
Vous devez l'attraper
au sommet du poteau.

11
00:00:44,405 --> 00:00:47,355
Si vous échouez, elle ira aux femmes.

12
00:00:48,129 --> 00:00:50,984
<i>La rivalité homme-femme
avait commencé.</i>

13
00:00:52,709 --> 00:00:55,549
<i>Les hommes sortent gagnants
de cette cérémonie.</i>

14
00:00:55,674 --> 00:00:56,929
On veut du sang.

15
00:00:57,308 --> 00:00:58,703
Survivants, prêts ?

16
00:00:58,828 --> 00:00:59,911
Partez !

17
00:01:00,036 --> 00:01:01,803
<i>À la première épreuve d'immunité,</i>

18
00:01:01,928 --> 00:01:04,664
<i>la tribu masculine Lopevi
avait une grande avance</i>

19
00:01:04,789 --> 00:01:06,533
<i>sur la tribu féminine Yasur...</i>

20
00:01:07,473 --> 00:01:09,569
Tirez-la, tirez-la !

21
00:01:09,694 --> 00:01:12,938
<i>... mais Chris échoua
à traverser la poutre,</i>

22
00:01:14,368 --> 00:01:16,451
<i>et les femmes
remportèrent l'immunité.</i>

23
00:01:18,079 --> 00:01:21,198
<i>De retour au camp,
les jeunes voulurent éliminer Chris.</i>

24
00:01:21,643 --> 00:01:22,749
<font color="#ff7f00">Le plus faible.</font>

25
00:01:22,874 --> 00:01:24,050
- Chris ?
- Obligé.

26
00:01:24,175 --> 00:01:27,876
<i>Mais le sergent proposa une stratégie
pour garder les vieux dans le jeu.</i>

27
00:01:28,001 --> 00:01:31,558
Le seul moyen de survivre,
c'est d'éliminer les jeunes.

28
00:01:33,443 --> 00:01:36,763
<i>Premier éliminé de
"Survivor Vanuatu, Îles de Feu" :</i>

29
00:01:37,163 --> 00:01:38,195
Brook.

30
00:01:38,320 --> 00:01:39,899
<i>Le plan du sergent fonctionna.</i>

31
00:01:40,024 --> 00:01:41,901
<i>Perçu comme un danger physique,</i>

32
00:01:42,026 --> 00:01:44,813
<i>Brook fut éliminé,
et Chris fut sauvé.</i>

33
00:01:47,067 --> 00:01:48,908
Pour l'immunité, partez !

34
00:01:49,033 --> 00:01:50,552
<i>À la deuxième épreuve d'immunité...</i>

35
00:01:50,677 --> 00:01:52,078
Tout droit, Bubba, juste ici.

36
00:01:52,203 --> 00:01:54,126
<i>... les hommes l'emportèrent</i>

37
00:01:54,251 --> 00:01:56,408
<i>quand le sergent
mena Lopevi à la victoire.</i>

38
00:01:56,533 --> 00:01:58,193
Lopevi remporte l'immunité !

39
00:01:58,563 --> 00:01:59,819
C'est qui l'patron ?

40
00:02:00,986 --> 00:02:02,756
<i>Quand Yasur vint au conseil,</i>

41
00:02:02,881 --> 00:02:05,156
<i>Dolly fut la première victime.</i>

42
00:02:06,259 --> 00:02:07,993
Sans toi,
on aurait quand même du feu...

43
00:02:08,118 --> 00:02:10,697
<i>Le 7e jour,
Mia et Twila s'expliquèrent</i>

44
00:02:10,822 --> 00:02:12,073
<i>sur l'éthique de travail.</i>

45
00:02:12,198 --> 00:02:16,077
Tu restes ici cinq minutes
et tu files te baigner, sale garce.

46
00:02:16,202 --> 00:02:18,071
C'est ta seule carte,
continue de la jouer.

47
00:02:18,410 --> 00:02:20,104
<i>Le caractère de Mia</i>

48
00:02:20,229 --> 00:02:22,709
<i>lui coûta sa chance
de remporter un million de dollars.</i>

49
00:02:23,927 --> 00:02:26,015
<i>Et aux deux conseils suivants,</i>

50
00:02:26,140 --> 00:02:29,658
<i>Lopevi perdit John P. et Brady.</i>

51
00:02:32,480 --> 00:02:33,720
Bon sang !

52
00:02:34,546 --> 00:02:37,465
<i>Le 11e jour,
un séisme frappa l'île...</i>

53
00:02:37,590 --> 00:02:38,725
Ouais !

54
00:02:38,850 --> 00:02:40,602
Hue, cowboy !

55
00:02:40,852 --> 00:02:42,784
<i>... et les secousses continuèrent.</i>

56
00:02:42,909 --> 00:02:44,867
Sergent, Scout, par ici.

57
00:02:44,992 --> 00:02:46,815
<i>Le sergent et Scout furent désignés</i>

58
00:02:46,940 --> 00:02:50,136
<i>pour choisir
de nouvelles tribus mixtes.</i>

59
00:02:50,261 --> 00:02:54,382
<i>Julie et Twila se retrouvèrent
les deux seules femmes de Lopevi,</i>

60
00:02:54,507 --> 00:02:58,687
<i>et Rory et Bubba,
les deux seuls hommes de Yasur.</i>

61
00:03:00,447 --> 00:03:03,825
<i>Twila et Julie s'intégrèrent bien
avec les hommes de Lopevi.</i>

62
00:03:04,075 --> 00:03:06,358
<i>Le sergent fit même
un pacte avec Twila.</i>

63
00:03:06,483 --> 00:03:08,890
On voulait quelqu'un
qui tienne parole.

64
00:03:09,015 --> 00:03:10,023
C'est mon cas.

65
00:03:11,850 --> 00:03:14,529
<i>Mais à Yasur,
Bubba était mal à l'aise.</i>

66
00:03:14,654 --> 00:03:18,008
<i>Être dans une équipe de femmes,
ça rend nerveux.</i>

67
00:03:18,133 --> 00:03:20,233
Un pas de travers
et c'est l'élimination.

68
00:03:20,358 --> 00:03:22,344
<i>Alors,
à l'épreuve d'immunité suivante,</i>

69
00:03:22,469 --> 00:03:25,188
<i>Bubba tenta d'envoyer un signal
à ses ex-partenaires.</i>

70
00:03:25,313 --> 00:03:26,424
Pense à la fusion.

71
00:03:26,549 --> 00:03:28,650
<i>Et Ami le prit en flagrant délit.</i>

72
00:03:28,775 --> 00:03:30,685
<i>Il complote avec l'autre équipe.</i>

73
00:03:30,810 --> 00:03:34,403
Vous voyez Michael Jordan chuchoter
stratégie avec l'équipe adverse ?

74
00:03:34,528 --> 00:03:35,682
Certainement pas.

75
00:03:35,807 --> 00:03:37,287
<i>Bubba fut remercié.</i>

76
00:03:37,412 --> 00:03:39,152
Bubba, la tribu a parlé.

77
00:03:41,178 --> 00:03:44,064
Voilà, c'est ce que j'aime.

78
00:03:45,048 --> 00:03:48,937
<i>Il devenait évident qu'Ami
tirait les ficelles à Yasur,</i>

79
00:03:49,187 --> 00:03:52,109
<i>et le 15e jour,
la tribu suivit ses directives</i>

80
00:03:52,234 --> 00:03:54,810
<i>quand elle décida d'éliminer Lisa.</i>

81
00:03:54,935 --> 00:03:56,719
La tribu a parlé.

82
00:04:00,019 --> 00:04:02,128
<i>Au conseil de Lopevi suivant,</i>

83
00:04:02,253 --> 00:04:04,423
<i>Julie et Twila
se joignirent aux séniors</i>

84
00:04:04,548 --> 00:04:06,901
<i>et renvoyèrent John K. chez lui.</i>

85
00:04:10,016 --> 00:04:11,415
Désormais, vous êtes une tribu.

86
00:04:11,540 --> 00:04:13,720
<i>Le 20e jour, les tribus fusionnèrent.</i>

87
00:04:13,845 --> 00:04:15,831
<i>Rory rejoignit ses ex-camarades,</i>

88
00:04:15,956 --> 00:04:18,777
<i>et les informa immédiatement
qu'Ami était dangereuse.</i>

89
00:04:18,902 --> 00:04:21,501
À peine arrivés, elles ont dit :
"Rory, t'es le prochain éliminé."

90
00:04:21,626 --> 00:04:23,076
Ami nous l'a dit.

91
00:04:23,715 --> 00:04:27,067
<i>Une fois de plus, les hommes
firent confiance à Twila et Julie</i>

92
00:04:27,192 --> 00:04:29,258
<i>en planifiant d'éliminer Ami.</i>

93
00:04:29,654 --> 00:04:31,604
On est majoritaire,
on sera en bonne position.

94
00:04:31,729 --> 00:04:35,684
<i>Mais les hommes furent stupéfaits
quand Twila et Julie les trahirent.</i>

95
00:04:35,809 --> 00:04:39,035
<i>Les femmes joignirent leurs forces
et éliminèrent Rory.</i>

96
00:04:41,114 --> 00:04:44,292
<i>Les hommes étaient minoritaires,
et dans de beaux draps.</i>

97
00:04:44,730 --> 00:04:46,578
<i>Le sergent fut le suivant,</i>

98
00:04:46,956 --> 00:04:48,239
<i>puis Chad,</i>

99
00:04:48,364 --> 00:04:51,266
<i>faisant de Chris
le dernier homme du jeu.</i>

100
00:04:53,218 --> 00:04:55,695
Accueillons vos binômes, par ici.

101
00:04:56,539 --> 00:04:58,675
<i>Quand les proches des survivants
les rejoignirent</i>

102
00:04:58,800 --> 00:05:01,234
<i>pour l'épreuve d'immunité,
le 27e jour,</i>

103
00:05:01,359 --> 00:05:04,746
<i>Chris informa sa fiancée Laurie
qu'il devait gagner.</i>

104
00:05:04,871 --> 00:05:06,055
<font color="#ff7f00">Je suis éliminé si on perd.</font>

105
00:05:06,180 --> 00:05:08,283
<font color="#ff7f00">- Non, dis pas ça.
- C'est un fait, bébé.</font>

106
00:05:08,533 --> 00:05:12,187
<i>La course fut disputée,
mais aidée de sa petite amie Crissy,</i>

107
00:05:12,312 --> 00:05:13,825
<i>Ami remporta l'immunité.</i>

108
00:05:15,515 --> 00:05:16,971
<font color="#ff7f00">Désolé de pas avoir gagné.</font>

109
00:05:18,749 --> 00:05:22,011
<i>Mais de retour au camp,
tout fut chamboulé.</i>

110
00:05:22,136 --> 00:05:24,602
<font color="#ff7f00">- On a pris notre décision.
- Eliza.</font>

111
00:05:24,727 --> 00:05:28,092
<i>D'abord, les femmes décidèrent
d'éliminer Eliza avant Chris,</i>

112
00:05:28,524 --> 00:05:30,493
<i>et Twila prit l'engagement audacieux</i>

113
00:05:30,618 --> 00:05:32,718
<i>de rester avec Ami et Leann
jusqu'au bout.</i>

114
00:05:32,843 --> 00:05:34,634
Je jure sur mon fils.

115
00:05:37,714 --> 00:05:39,737
<i>Mais Twila revint sur sa parole</i>

116
00:05:39,862 --> 00:05:43,382
<i>en complotant avec Chris
pour éliminer Leann et Ami.</i>

117
00:05:43,646 --> 00:05:45,812
Je changerai le cours du jeu,
je prends le risque.

118
00:05:47,287 --> 00:05:49,705
<i>Au conseil, le plan prit forme</i>

119
00:05:49,830 --> 00:05:53,475
<i>quand Eliza et Scout
les rejoignirent pour éliminer Leann.</i>

120
00:05:53,924 --> 00:05:55,479
La tribu a parlé.

121
00:05:56,514 --> 00:05:59,112
<i>L'alliance féminine
avait du plomb dans l'aile.</i>

122
00:05:59,426 --> 00:06:00,648
Je t'ai bien eue, hein ?

123
00:06:00,773 --> 00:06:03,145
Tu m'as pas eue, je suis toujours là,
t'as eu Leann.

124
00:06:03,270 --> 00:06:05,775
<i>Tout à coup, Ami luttait pour sa vie.</i>

125
00:06:05,900 --> 00:06:08,868
Là, je suis à fond dans la compète.
Je suis toute seule.

126
00:06:08,993 --> 00:06:10,373
Room service !

127
00:06:10,498 --> 00:06:13,094
<i>Quand Ami accompagna Eliza et Chris
sur une récompense au spa...</i>

128
00:06:13,219 --> 00:06:14,308
Bonne nuit, Chris.

129
00:06:14,433 --> 00:06:17,244
<i>... elle fit son maximum
pour rallier Eliza.</i>

130
00:06:17,369 --> 00:06:20,021
À chaque fois je te protégeais,

131
00:06:20,271 --> 00:06:22,449
à chaque vote je l'ai prouvé.

132
00:06:22,574 --> 00:06:25,117
<i>Mais Chris aussi
travaillait Eliza au corps.</i>

133
00:06:25,242 --> 00:06:28,432
On est le pur carré final,
et regarde nos adversaires :

134
00:06:28,557 --> 00:06:31,700
une vieille de 60 ans, et Twila.

135
00:06:33,284 --> 00:06:34,669
Chris remporte l'immunité !

136
00:06:34,794 --> 00:06:37,831
<i>Chris remporta l'immunité
et fut à l'abri trois jours de plus.</i>

137
00:06:39,558 --> 00:06:40,775
<i>Au conseil,</i>

138
00:06:40,900 --> 00:06:44,786
<i>Ami luttait encore, reprochant à Twila
d'avoir juré sur son fils.</i>

139
00:06:44,911 --> 00:06:46,106
C'est inimaginable.

140
00:06:46,231 --> 00:06:49,676
Mais je ne suis pas la seule
à avoir menti dans ce jeu !

141
00:06:49,801 --> 00:06:50,877
Passe l'éponge !

142
00:06:51,002 --> 00:06:52,587
Tu t'es faite avoir, va chier !

143
00:06:52,712 --> 00:06:54,722
<i>Eliza eut une importante
décision à prendre.</i>

144
00:06:54,847 --> 00:06:57,618
- Ami vous manquerait-t-elle ?
- Ouais, beaucoup.

145
00:06:59,190 --> 00:07:00,809
Arrête de pleurer.

146
00:07:02,380 --> 00:07:04,218
<i>Mais lors du vote...</i>

147
00:07:04,491 --> 00:07:07,293
Treizième personne éliminée
de "Survivor Vanuatu"...

148
00:07:07,886 --> 00:07:10,272
<i>... Ami fut finalement détrônée.</i>

149
00:07:11,989 --> 00:07:13,700
<i>Chris revenait de loin,</i>

150
00:07:13,825 --> 00:07:16,036
<i>mais il savait que le jeu
n'était pas terminé.</i>

151
00:07:16,161 --> 00:07:18,580
C'est sûrement dans mon intérêt
d'aller avec Eliza et toi.

152
00:07:18,705 --> 00:07:20,823
<i>Je manipule Julie et Eliza,</i>

153
00:07:20,948 --> 00:07:23,451
<i>en même temps que Scout et Twila.</i>

154
00:07:23,576 --> 00:07:25,606
Ce sont des femmes,
comment leur faire confiance ?

155
00:07:25,731 --> 00:07:28,790
Scout et Twila s'opposeront pas
l'une à l'autre.

156
00:07:28,915 --> 00:07:30,090
Ouais, c'est un risque.

157
00:07:30,215 --> 00:07:33,117
Avec elles, on a 100 % de chances
de pas arriver en finale.

158
00:07:33,751 --> 00:07:36,498
<i>L'heure était grave,
et personne n'était à l'abri.</i>

159
00:07:36,920 --> 00:07:38,138
Quoi de neuf ?

160
00:07:38,263 --> 00:07:39,659
À toi de me dire.

161
00:07:39,784 --> 00:07:42,140
- Je pense que t'es une menteuse, T.
- Qui n'a pas menti ?

162
00:07:42,265 --> 00:07:44,663
T'as essayé de comploter
contre moi depuis le premier jour.

163
00:07:44,788 --> 00:07:46,374
Tu rends dingue tout le monde !

164
00:07:46,499 --> 00:07:48,902
- Chris, à quoi tu penses ?
- Quoi ?

165
00:07:49,540 --> 00:07:52,221
Je suis juste allongé là,
dans le hamac.

166
00:07:52,346 --> 00:07:55,833
<i>Avec ces tensions débordantes,
Chris joua un dernier coup</i>

167
00:07:55,958 --> 00:07:58,512
<i>en garantissant sa loyauté à Julie.</i>

168
00:07:58,637 --> 00:08:03,116
Ce que je compare, c'est notre amitié
à mon amitié avec Twila.

169
00:08:03,241 --> 00:08:05,660
<i>Julie et Eliza crurent Chris</i>

170
00:08:05,785 --> 00:08:07,895
<i>quand il dit que Twila
serait la prochaine éliminée.</i>

171
00:08:08,020 --> 00:08:09,759
Chris m'a prouvé qu'il était fiable,

172
00:08:09,884 --> 00:08:11,658
et j'espère qu'il continuera.

173
00:08:13,648 --> 00:08:15,091
<i>Mais au conseil...</i>

174
00:08:15,216 --> 00:08:18,064
Quatorzième personne éliminée
de "Survivor Vanuatu"...

175
00:08:18,741 --> 00:08:22,671
<i>Eliza fut stupéfaite
quand Chris trahit son amie Julie</i>

176
00:08:22,796 --> 00:08:24,613
<i>en participant à son élimination.</i>

177
00:08:27,077 --> 00:08:29,109
<i>Il n'en reste que quatre :</i>

178
00:08:29,234 --> 00:08:32,739
<i>Chris, Eliza, Scout et Twila.</i>

179
00:08:33,889 --> 00:08:37,415
<i>Ce soir, ils disputeront
leurs dernières épreuves d'immunité.</i>

180
00:08:37,540 --> 00:08:40,086
<i>Deux se présenteront devant le jury.</i>

181
00:08:40,439 --> 00:08:42,559
<i>Un survivra à tous les autres</i>

182
00:08:42,684 --> 00:08:45,212
<i>et deviendra l'Ultime Survivant.</i>

183
00:08:46,584 --> 00:08:49,584
<font color="#ff7f00">Survivor Vanuatu
Saison 09 - Épisode 14, 1re partie
Les esprits et le carré final</font>

184
00:08:49,709 --> 00:08:51,709
<font color="#ff7f00">Traduction : Lény</font>

185
00:08:51,834 --> 00:08:53,834
<font color="#ff7f00">Relecture : Optimus, Jack Bauer</font>

186
00:08:53,959 --> 00:08:55,959
<font color="#ff7f00">Synchro : Lény</font>

187
00:10:09,404 --> 00:10:11,559
<font color="#ff7f00">J'étais si contente au moment de voter,</font>

188
00:10:11,684 --> 00:10:14,023
<font color="#ff7f00">je pensais que ça y était.</font>

189
00:10:15,821 --> 00:10:18,063
<i>J'ai éliminé Julie
ce soir au conseil.</i>

190
00:10:18,188 --> 00:10:20,161
<i>J'ai pris Eliza par surprise.</i>

191
00:10:20,286 --> 00:10:22,153
Julie l'avait mérité.

192
00:10:22,278 --> 00:10:24,206
Elle m'a roulé dans la farine
après la fusion.

193
00:10:24,331 --> 00:10:25,570
Je la protégeais.

194
00:10:25,695 --> 00:10:27,093
C'est le jeu.

195
00:10:27,410 --> 00:10:30,498
C'est juste que...
C'est dur pour moi.

196
00:10:34,196 --> 00:10:36,246
Savoir à qui se fier.

197
00:10:37,824 --> 00:10:39,505
<font color="#ff7f00">Croire les gens et...</font>

198
00:10:39,997 --> 00:10:42,183
<font color="#ff7f00">Puis apprendre
qu'ils disent autre chose.</font>

199
00:10:42,433 --> 00:10:44,986
- Ça fait partie du jeu, Eliza.
- Je sais, mais...

200
00:10:45,111 --> 00:10:46,587
Tout le monde joue pas comme ça.

201
00:10:46,712 --> 00:10:49,315
J'aurais jamais dit
que je pensais que l'un de nous

202
00:10:49,440 --> 00:10:51,219
ne méritait pas sa place.

203
00:10:51,344 --> 00:10:53,693
Je pense que
tu mérites pas ta place, Eliza.

204
00:10:53,976 --> 00:10:55,496
La seule raison de ta présence,

205
00:10:55,621 --> 00:10:58,247
c'est que t'es opportuniste
depuis le début.

206
00:10:58,372 --> 00:11:00,392
C'est l'unique raison
de ta présence, point barre.

207
00:11:00,517 --> 00:11:02,574
C'est faux, complètement faux.

208
00:11:02,699 --> 00:11:06,733
T'as rien fait pour le camp,
à part faire bouillir de l'eau.

209
00:11:06,858 --> 00:11:09,149
À mes yeux, tu mérites pas ta place.

210
00:11:09,469 --> 00:11:12,171
T., je pense que toi non plus.

211
00:11:12,296 --> 00:11:14,622
Au moins, j'ai joué et travaillé dur.

212
00:11:14,747 --> 00:11:16,253
Pas comme toi.

213
00:11:16,378 --> 00:11:18,561
Travailler dur
c'est pas forcément jouer.

214
00:11:18,686 --> 00:11:21,120
Économiser son énergie
et tout déchirer aux épreuves.

215
00:11:21,245 --> 00:11:23,149
Qui a remporté
le plus de récompenses ici ?

216
00:11:23,274 --> 00:11:25,575
T'as peut-être aussi
gardé tes forces pour ça.

217
00:11:25,700 --> 00:11:27,709
C'est peut-être ma façon de jouer,

218
00:11:27,834 --> 00:11:30,511
si t'économisais ton énergie,
tu serais meilleure aux épreuves.

219
00:11:31,062 --> 00:11:32,133
Bon sang.

220
00:11:32,637 --> 00:11:34,474
Probablement pas, mais peut-être.

221
00:11:34,599 --> 00:11:36,238
Probablement pas, t'as raison.

222
00:11:36,488 --> 00:11:38,126
La seule raison
de ta présence, Eliza,

223
00:11:38,251 --> 00:11:40,467
c'est que tout le monde
s'est servi de toi.

224
00:11:40,819 --> 00:11:42,500
C'est la seule raison.

225
00:11:53,541 --> 00:11:55,115
<i>Je pense que Twila est une connasse.</i>

226
00:11:56,013 --> 00:11:59,367
Je refuse de voir l'une d'elles
arriver en finale.

227
00:11:59,492 --> 00:12:02,428
Je refuse que ça arrive,
ça me tuerait.

228
00:12:02,553 --> 00:12:05,125
Julie n'était pas la solution,
voilà tout.

229
00:12:05,250 --> 00:12:06,537
Mais demain,

230
00:12:06,662 --> 00:12:11,214
en supposant que tu restes
dans notre alliance...

231
00:12:11,475 --> 00:12:12,757
Rien n'a jamais changé.

232
00:12:12,882 --> 00:12:15,274
Aujourd'hui,
j'ai agi pour notre alliance.

233
00:12:15,399 --> 00:12:17,949
- Tu verras.
- Je te crois.

234
00:12:18,074 --> 00:12:19,897
Pourquoi en douterais-tu ?
T'ai-je menti ?

235
00:12:20,022 --> 00:12:23,617
Julie était une joueuse, Eliza.
Une joueuse !

236
00:12:24,409 --> 00:12:26,031
Elle en a rien à fout** de toi.

237
00:12:26,156 --> 00:12:28,942
Elle en a rien eu à fout** de toi
quand elle était en danger.

238
00:12:29,067 --> 00:12:31,698
Elle a voté contre toi, rappelle-toi.

239
00:12:32,113 --> 00:12:33,822
Ouais, mais...

240
00:12:33,947 --> 00:12:35,253
<font color="#ff7f00">Femme de peu de foi !</font>

241
00:12:35,378 --> 00:12:39,300
<font color="#ff7f00">Pourquoi ne fais-tu pas
un peu confiance en ton allié ?</font>

242
00:12:39,687 --> 00:12:41,285
<font color="#ff7f00">Juste un peu.</font>

243
00:12:41,410 --> 00:12:43,570
<font color="#ff7f00">Tu pourrais en convaincre une
de voter contre l'autre ?</font>

244
00:12:43,695 --> 00:12:46,127
<font color="#ff7f00">Évite le sujet, c'est pas le moment.</font>

245
00:12:47,764 --> 00:12:48,943
<i>J'en sais rien.</i>

246
00:12:49,068 --> 00:12:53,617
Je ne pense pas beaucoup de bien
de ces femmes depuis qu'on est sept.

247
00:12:55,333 --> 00:12:56,976
Elles jouent toutes.

248
00:12:57,101 --> 00:13:00,142
Elles se sont trahies l'une l'autre,
chacune a son opinion.

249
00:13:00,267 --> 00:13:03,158
<i>Eliza et Twila ne s'apprécient pas,
j'aime ça.</i>

250
00:13:03,642 --> 00:13:06,361
Ça met du piment sur le camp.

251
00:13:27,054 --> 00:13:29,740
<i>Oui, je pensais être ici le 37e jour.</i>

252
00:13:29,865 --> 00:13:32,145
<i>Mais si vous m'aviez dit
que ce serait avec eux,</i>

253
00:13:32,270 --> 00:13:33,812
je vous aurais ri au nez.

254
00:13:33,937 --> 00:13:37,183
Je n'aurais jamais pensé
à ce carré final.

255
00:13:37,557 --> 00:13:40,450
On pourrait prendre le manioc,
sinon, on pourra pas le manger.

256
00:13:40,575 --> 00:13:42,189
<i>N'étant que quatre,</i>

257
00:13:42,314 --> 00:13:45,654
<i>on sait très bien qui restera soudé</i>

258
00:13:45,779 --> 00:13:49,085
<i>et qui votera quoi
au conseil de ce soir.</i>

259
00:13:50,497 --> 00:13:54,421
<i>Scout et Twila veulent voter
contre moi depuis très longtemps.</i>

260
00:13:54,546 --> 00:13:57,727
<i>Je pense que le faire enfin
leur apporterait grande satisfaction.</i>

261
00:13:57,852 --> 00:14:00,606
<i>Alors, il me faut vraiment l'immunité
pour rester dans le jeu.</i>

262
00:14:00,731 --> 00:14:05,020
Si j'échoue,
je prie pour que ce soit Chris.

263
00:14:20,026 --> 00:14:22,170
- Prêts pour l'épreuve ?
- Absolument.

264
00:14:22,295 --> 00:14:24,573
Tout d'abord, je la récupère, Eliza.

265
00:14:29,092 --> 00:14:31,221
L'immunité est remise en jeu.

266
00:14:31,513 --> 00:14:36,073
Vous allez concourir au premier
labyrinthe vertical de Survivor.

267
00:14:36,311 --> 00:14:38,711
<i>Vous grimperez
et traverserez ce labyrinthe,</i>

268
00:14:38,836 --> 00:14:41,781
<i>en collectant dix paires
de tuiles en bois,</i>

269
00:14:41,906 --> 00:14:43,346
<i>une paire à la fois.</i>

270
00:14:43,471 --> 00:14:46,544
<i>Une fois collectées,
et disposées sur votre poste,</i>

271
00:14:46,669 --> 00:14:49,898
vous les détacherez
pour dévoiler dix lettres.

272
00:14:50,023 --> 00:14:53,034
Utilisez ces lettres pour former
une réponse en deux mots.

273
00:14:53,159 --> 00:14:55,895
Le premier à la trouver,
remporte l'immunité,

274
00:14:56,020 --> 00:14:58,131
et une place dans le trio final.

275
00:14:58,256 --> 00:14:59,933
- Prêts pour l'épreuve ?
- Ouais !

276
00:15:00,058 --> 00:15:02,071
Attendez mon signal,
on va commencer.

277
00:15:05,585 --> 00:15:07,607
Pour l'immunité, Survivants, prêts ?

278
00:15:08,766 --> 00:15:10,085
Partez !

279
00:15:11,305 --> 00:15:14,021
Chris et Twila arrivent en premier,
Eliza est juste derrière.

280
00:15:14,146 --> 00:15:15,757
Scout va essayer.

281
00:15:22,060 --> 00:15:23,723
Chris monte haut.

282
00:15:25,392 --> 00:15:27,264
Twila descend bas.

283
00:15:27,526 --> 00:15:28,995
Souvenez-vous de votre couleur.

284
00:15:32,896 --> 00:15:35,477
Twila revient avec sa première paire.

285
00:15:39,910 --> 00:15:42,858
Chris a sa première paire,
il doit redescendre.

286
00:15:43,968 --> 00:15:45,495
Où vont-ils ?

287
00:15:45,620 --> 00:15:48,615
Eliza n'a pas de chance,
Twila est sur sa deuxième paire.

288
00:15:50,606 --> 00:15:53,316
Ça aide Eliza, qui suit le mouvement.

289
00:16:00,752 --> 00:16:02,530
Eliza a sa première paire,

290
00:16:02,655 --> 00:16:04,958
Twila a sa deuxième,
Chris a sa première.

291
00:16:05,083 --> 00:16:06,733
Scout a sa première paire.

292
00:16:07,249 --> 00:16:10,759
Eliza a sa deuxième paire,
Chris aussi.

293
00:16:12,776 --> 00:16:15,671
Twila, Chris et Eliza
ont deux paires chacun.

294
00:16:16,234 --> 00:16:18,656
Twila a sa troisième paire.

295
00:16:23,383 --> 00:16:26,420
Twila redescend vite
avec sa troisième paire.

296
00:16:26,891 --> 00:16:28,396
Attention, Scout, allez.

297
00:16:29,134 --> 00:16:31,758
Twila prend la tête
avec sa troisième paire.

298
00:16:31,883 --> 00:16:33,739
Eliza a sa troisième paire,
elle redescend.

299
00:16:33,864 --> 00:16:35,563
Chris a sa troisième paire.

300
00:16:39,918 --> 00:16:42,611
Eliza monte haut,
et trouve sa quatrième paire.

301
00:16:42,861 --> 00:16:44,771
Scout a sa deuxième paire.

302
00:16:46,662 --> 00:16:48,338
Twila a maintenant quatre paires.

303
00:16:48,791 --> 00:16:51,578
Chris a sa troisième paire,
il doit retrouver la sortie.

304
00:16:51,703 --> 00:16:53,179
Eliza a sa quatrième paire.

305
00:16:53,304 --> 00:16:55,915
Chris en a quatre,
Twila a sa cinquième.

306
00:16:58,830 --> 00:17:00,528
Chris a sa cinquième.

307
00:17:00,778 --> 00:17:04,018
Eliza, Chris et Twila
ont cinq paires.

308
00:17:04,143 --> 00:17:05,258
Égalité.

309
00:17:06,130 --> 00:17:07,794
Twila, montée très haut,
a sa sixième.

310
00:17:08,467 --> 00:17:11,880
Chris a sa sixième dans la bouche,
il essaie de retrouver la sortie.

311
00:17:13,665 --> 00:17:16,109
Chris prend la tête avec six paires.

312
00:17:16,234 --> 00:17:18,519
Twila essaie de retrouver la sortie.

313
00:17:22,567 --> 00:17:24,286
Twila a six paires.

314
00:17:24,411 --> 00:17:26,281
Eliza a sa sixième en main.

315
00:17:29,458 --> 00:17:32,460
- Attention, je suis là.
- Chris et Eliza se heurtent.

316
00:17:33,678 --> 00:17:36,081
Twila a sept paires, Chris aussi.

317
00:17:37,436 --> 00:17:39,401
Eliza a sa septième.

318
00:17:41,519 --> 00:17:43,399
Tout le monde revient avec sa paire.

319
00:17:44,064 --> 00:17:47,142
Twila a sa huitième paire,
Eliza sa septième,

320
00:17:47,392 --> 00:17:49,778
Chris sa huitième,
Scout sa troisième.

321
00:17:53,734 --> 00:17:56,565
Chris a neuf paires,
il lui en reste une.

322
00:17:56,997 --> 00:17:59,895
Eliza est juste derrière avec huit,
il lui en reste deux.

323
00:18:02,431 --> 00:18:03,971
Où est l'autre ?

324
00:18:05,443 --> 00:18:09,203
Twila a neuf paires, Chris aussi,
il leur reste une paire.

325
00:18:10,248 --> 00:18:12,466
Chris a sa dixième paire.

326
00:18:13,064 --> 00:18:14,459
Allez !

327
00:18:14,894 --> 00:18:16,704
Twila a sa dernière paire.

328
00:18:18,828 --> 00:18:21,371
Jetez les vides,
une lettre dans chaque paire.

329
00:18:24,655 --> 00:18:27,600
Vous cherchez deux mots,
une réponse en deux mots.

330
00:18:27,725 --> 00:18:30,205
Eliza ne renonce pas,
elle fait un grand saut.

331
00:18:33,050 --> 00:18:35,890
Eliza revient avec sa 9e paire,
plus qu'une.

332
00:18:36,015 --> 00:18:37,717
Elle doit la trouver et la prendre.

333
00:18:38,076 --> 00:18:40,302
Chris cherche déjà la réponse.

334
00:18:46,936 --> 00:18:49,404
Eliza revient avec sa dernière paire.

335
00:18:51,992 --> 00:18:53,833
Je l'ai !

336
00:18:53,958 --> 00:18:54,975
Je l'ai !

337
00:18:55,100 --> 00:18:56,993
Chris remporte l'immunité !

338
00:19:10,784 --> 00:19:11,954
Trio final.

339
00:19:12,271 --> 00:19:13,867
Chris, venez ici.

340
00:19:13,992 --> 00:19:18,066
La si importante immunité,
une place dans le trio final.

341
00:19:18,665 --> 00:19:22,637
Hélas, après 37 longues
et dures journées ici,

342
00:19:22,762 --> 00:19:26,169
ce soir au conseil ce jeu s'achèvera,
quelqu'un sera éliminé.

343
00:19:26,294 --> 00:19:27,534
Je vous vois au conseil.

344
00:19:41,030 --> 00:19:42,966
- De retour chez soi.
- De retour chez soi.

345
00:19:43,091 --> 00:19:44,608
Je vais vous dire...

346
00:19:44,733 --> 00:19:46,792
Bien sûr, j'allais dire
que c'est une belle journée,

347
00:19:46,917 --> 00:19:48,390
mais c'est vraiment le cas.

348
00:19:48,515 --> 00:19:51,291
C'est une belle journée,
ce collier te va bien.

349
00:19:52,043 --> 00:19:53,593
Bon sang, j'en avais bien besoin.

350
00:19:53,718 --> 00:19:56,268
<i>Je n'abandonne jamais, voilà tout.
Je le savais.</i>

351
00:19:56,393 --> 00:19:59,007
Je suis le dernier mec,
et je ne renonce pas.

352
00:19:59,132 --> 00:20:00,593
Je vais l'accrocher.

353
00:20:00,718 --> 00:20:02,779
Tu savais
que je te collais aux basques ?

354
00:20:02,904 --> 00:20:06,691
Twila m'a donné du fil à retordre,
mais je voulais l'immunité.

355
00:20:06,816 --> 00:20:09,075
C'est tout ce qu'il me fallait,
c'est une bonne journée.

356
00:20:12,737 --> 00:20:16,516
Va chercher assez de bois mort
pour faire une pile.

357
00:20:17,598 --> 00:20:19,352
<i>Ce n'était vraiment pas gagné.</i>

358
00:20:21,579 --> 00:20:25,200
<i>Une alliance où la confiance</i>

359
00:20:25,325 --> 00:20:27,127
<i>ne veut plus dire grand-chose
à ce stade.</i>

360
00:20:27,252 --> 00:20:29,729
Il faut atteindre la finale
et avoir une chance de gagner.

361
00:20:30,514 --> 00:20:31,772
Tous les trois.

362
00:20:33,325 --> 00:20:36,288
- Vous deux.
- J'ai aimé ton plan.

363
00:20:36,413 --> 00:20:39,988
Sachez que j'ai souhaité
que ce jour arrive.

364
00:20:40,113 --> 00:20:41,815
C'est pour ce soir.

365
00:20:43,675 --> 00:20:45,476
<i>Maintenant, je veux juste jubiler.</i>

366
00:20:45,601 --> 00:20:49,396
Je jubile que la nénette
soit éliminée ce soir.

367
00:20:49,521 --> 00:20:50,550
Je jubile.

368
00:20:50,675 --> 00:20:54,742
Chris, mon pote, du coup,
pas besoin de faire mon sac ce soir.

369
00:20:55,200 --> 00:20:56,937
- Je sais.
- Arrête.

370
00:20:57,062 --> 00:20:58,892
Tu me fatigues.

371
00:20:59,017 --> 00:21:01,561
<i>Twila est tendue comme un string,
elle me travaille au corps.</i>

372
00:21:01,686 --> 00:21:03,560
Je vais devoir la supporter
toute l'après-midi.

373
00:21:03,685 --> 00:21:05,514
Elle me tape sur le système.

374
00:21:06,041 --> 00:21:08,168
Elle est tout le temps angoissée.

375
00:21:08,293 --> 00:21:10,908
Si tu veux un peu taquiner Eliza,
ne t'en prive pas.

376
00:21:11,033 --> 00:21:14,512
Elle a trop fait sa maligne hier soir,
ça m'a gonflée.

377
00:21:14,637 --> 00:21:15,908
Énerve-la un peu,

378
00:21:16,033 --> 00:21:19,676
car elle s'en est prise à toi hier,
en essayant de ternir ton image.

379
00:21:19,801 --> 00:21:23,640
Attends 1/2 heure avant,
et traite-la comme un chien.

380
00:21:25,301 --> 00:21:26,814
Merci, mon chéri.

381
00:21:27,875 --> 00:21:29,205
<i>Je veux jubiler,</i>

382
00:21:29,330 --> 00:21:31,458
<i>mais Chris n'attend que ça.</i>

383
00:21:31,583 --> 00:21:34,459
Plus je gonfle tout le monde
avant leur départ,

384
00:21:34,584 --> 00:21:37,551
plus facilement il aura de votes,
si on est en finale.

385
00:21:37,676 --> 00:21:40,333
Je vois bien son manège, il joue.

386
00:21:40,458 --> 00:21:45,153
Je voulais vraiment te parler,
car t'es venue initialement me dire :

387
00:21:45,278 --> 00:21:47,616
"Je veux te garder
et jouer avec toi."

388
00:21:48,141 --> 00:21:50,815
C'est ce qui m'amène
à vouloir te parler.

389
00:21:50,940 --> 00:21:54,011
Je le jure, je le voulais
depuis le jour où je t'ai vu.

390
00:21:54,269 --> 00:21:55,454
Là-bas, sérieusement.

391
00:21:55,579 --> 00:21:58,656
J'ai dit :
"Je veux jouer avec ce gars."

392
00:21:58,781 --> 00:22:00,787
<i>L'après-midi sera longue,
c'est certain.</i>

393
00:22:00,912 --> 00:22:04,088
Je vais devoir supporter
trois femmes toute l'après-midi.

394
00:22:04,213 --> 00:22:05,859
Et ça craint.

395
00:22:05,984 --> 00:22:08,664
<i>J'ai une alliance avec les trois.</i>

396
00:22:08,789 --> 00:22:12,298
Elles aspirent toutes
à une place dans le trio final.

397
00:22:12,423 --> 00:22:16,302
On vote tous les deux contre Twila,
et advienne que pourra.

398
00:22:16,427 --> 00:22:17,881
Twila pense que tu pars.

399
00:22:18,006 --> 00:22:19,727
Elles se doutent de rien.

400
00:22:19,852 --> 00:22:21,534
Je leur ai jamais dit.

401
00:22:21,824 --> 00:22:23,777
Personne n'est au courant
pour notre pacte.

402
00:22:23,902 --> 00:22:25,375
Elles se doutent de rien.

403
00:22:25,500 --> 00:22:27,470
<i>Je suis chanceuse
d'être dans le carré final</i>

404
00:22:27,595 --> 00:22:31,174
avec quelqu'un
qui a toute ma confiance.

405
00:22:31,299 --> 00:22:34,460
<i>Maintenant que j'ai ce pacte,
cette alliance pour la finale,</i>

406
00:22:34,585 --> 00:22:37,232
<i>on ne votera pas l'un contre l'autre.</i>

407
00:22:37,357 --> 00:22:39,826
On fera notre maximum
pour arriver ensemble en finale.

408
00:22:39,951 --> 00:22:42,060
As-tu essayé
de passer un marché avec Chris ?

409
00:22:42,520 --> 00:22:44,386
J'y ai pensé.

410
00:22:46,985 --> 00:22:48,876
- Et toi ?
- Quoi ?

411
00:22:49,001 --> 00:22:51,112
- Et toi ?
- Avec tout le monde.

412
00:22:51,362 --> 00:22:54,768
Mais je sais que Twila
essaie déjà de magouiller.

413
00:22:55,465 --> 00:22:58,122
Je pense que tu devrais aussi
tenter ta chance.

414
00:22:58,389 --> 00:23:00,976
Je préférerais vous voir,
Chris et toi, en finale.

415
00:23:01,101 --> 00:23:02,622
- Vraiment ?
- Ouais.

416
00:23:02,747 --> 00:23:03,892
Ouais.

417
00:23:04,017 --> 00:23:06,003
Tu peux me trouver amère, mais...

418
00:23:06,128 --> 00:23:09,277
Je préférerais voir en finale
deux personnes que j'apprécie,

419
00:23:09,402 --> 00:23:10,612
plutôt que...

420
00:23:10,737 --> 00:23:14,070
Ça m'irait
si l'un de vous deux gagnait.

421
00:23:14,195 --> 00:23:15,559
Ça m'irait.

422
00:23:15,684 --> 00:23:17,776
<i>Plutôt qu'une personne dont je sens</i>

423
00:23:17,901 --> 00:23:20,033
<i>qu'elle a perdu son intégrité
au fil du jeu.</i>

424
00:23:21,209 --> 00:23:24,108
Alors, tu votes avec moi
contre Twila ce soir ?

425
00:23:25,260 --> 00:23:26,782
J'y ai pensé.

426
00:23:30,652 --> 00:23:34,756
<i>Je suis pas venu pour finir 2e,
et certainement pas 3e ou 4e.</i>

427
00:23:34,881 --> 00:23:36,047
<i>Mais pour gagner.</i>

428
00:23:36,172 --> 00:23:39,786
<i>Je ne me considère pas
comme un allié de Scout et de Twila.</i>

429
00:23:39,911 --> 00:23:41,863
<i>Je n'ai aucune loyauté,
aucune confiance.</i>

430
00:23:41,988 --> 00:23:43,523
<i>Il n'y a plus de jeu.</i>

431
00:23:43,927 --> 00:23:46,805
<i>L'important c'est d'accéder
à la prochaine étape.</i>

432
00:23:47,113 --> 00:23:48,795
Au diable les autres !

433
00:24:02,233 --> 00:24:04,163
Accueillons les membres
de notre jury :

434
00:24:04,454 --> 00:24:05,602
Le sergent,

435
00:24:05,727 --> 00:24:06,842
Chad,

436
00:24:06,967 --> 00:24:08,023
Leann,

437
00:24:08,148 --> 00:24:09,206
Ami,

438
00:24:09,331 --> 00:24:12,184
et Julie,
éliminée au dernier conseil.

439
00:24:19,551 --> 00:24:21,236
37 jours.

440
00:24:21,361 --> 00:24:23,338
De longs et laborieux jours.

441
00:24:23,463 --> 00:24:26,557
Ce soir, ce jeu s'achèvera
pour quelqu'un.

442
00:24:26,838 --> 00:24:30,428
Ce ne sera pas vous, Chris.
Vous portez l'immunité.

443
00:24:30,553 --> 00:24:33,559
Je ne vous avais jamais vu
aussi enthousiaste qu'aujourd'hui.

444
00:24:33,684 --> 00:24:36,176
Eliza, vous souvenez-vous
de la première épreuve,

445
00:24:36,301 --> 00:24:38,826
celui qui n'arrivait pas
à traverser la poutre ?

446
00:24:39,116 --> 00:24:40,455
Ce mec-là ?

447
00:24:40,705 --> 00:24:42,735
Je pensais qu'il partirait
le premier jour.

448
00:24:42,860 --> 00:24:45,719
Il fallait que vous évoquiez
la poutre.

449
00:24:45,844 --> 00:24:48,752
À ce stade, c'est quelque chose
que vous avez surmonté.

450
00:24:48,877 --> 00:24:50,790
- Vous êtes toujours dans le jeu.
- C'est vrai.

451
00:24:50,915 --> 00:24:52,926
J'ai pris un mauvais départ,
c'est sûr.

452
00:24:53,051 --> 00:24:55,700
Eliza, en la voyant
autour du cou de Chris,

453
00:24:55,825 --> 00:24:58,017
êtes-vous jalouse
ou pensez-vous : "Je l'apprécie" ?

454
00:24:58,142 --> 00:25:00,497
Bien sûr, je suis jalouse, mais...

455
00:25:00,924 --> 00:25:02,467
Si je ne pouvais pas l'avoir,

456
00:25:02,592 --> 00:25:05,721
je voulais que ce soit Chris.

457
00:25:05,846 --> 00:25:07,153
Tout le monde le sait.

458
00:25:07,278 --> 00:25:08,772
Alors, je suis ravie pour Chris.

459
00:25:08,897 --> 00:25:10,533
Vous dites : "Tout le monde le sait."

460
00:25:10,658 --> 00:25:13,203
Vous faites allusion au fait
que Twila et vous, êtes ouvertement...

461
00:25:13,328 --> 00:25:14,956
Juste différentes.

462
00:25:15,888 --> 00:25:18,383
Il semblerait
que vous soyez amie avec Chris.

463
00:25:18,508 --> 00:25:20,651
On est devenu très proche.

464
00:25:20,776 --> 00:25:23,337
Je suis contente
qu'on ait appris à se connaître,

465
00:25:23,462 --> 00:25:25,394
et du lien fort qu'on a tissé.

466
00:25:25,892 --> 00:25:27,216
Twila, d'un autre côté,

467
00:25:27,341 --> 00:25:30,265
à un moment, vous disiez
en termes non équivoques :

468
00:25:30,390 --> 00:25:32,298
"Je les apprécie,
mais je ne me fie à personne."

469
00:25:32,764 --> 00:25:35,280
Exactement, je l'ai dit.

470
00:25:35,588 --> 00:25:37,045
Rien n'a changé ?

471
00:25:38,728 --> 00:25:40,191
Vous n'êtes pas si confiante ?

472
00:25:40,316 --> 00:25:42,374
Pas autant,
mais je me trompe peut-être.

473
00:25:42,499 --> 00:25:46,200
Mais c'est le premier soir ici,
que je suis sereine.

474
00:25:46,325 --> 00:25:49,782
Je le ressens profondément,
c'est le premier soir.

475
00:25:49,907 --> 00:25:52,818
Scout, c'est le moment
