It just-- it just
makes sense to me.

1000

1002

1003

I'm feeling wonderful because,

00:52:38,972 --> 00:52:41,617
regardless, Russell's
keeping me around

1005
00:52:41,637 --> 00:52:43,939

1006

But I don't know about that.

1007
00:52:59,696 --> 00:53:01,348
?

1008
00:53:01,368 --> 00:53:02,846
♪♪♪

1009
00:53:03,700 --> 00:53:04,773
?

1010
00:53:04,793 --> 00:53:05,785
♪♪♪

1011
00:53:08,723 --> 00:53:10,157
?

1012
00:53:10,177 --> 00:53:12,418
♪♪♪♪

1013
00:53:12,438 --> 00:53:14,027
♪♪

1014
00:53:14,231 --> 00:53:15,392
?

1015
00:53:18,004 --> 00:53:19,394
♪♪♪

1016
00:53:23,503 --> 00:53:24,445
I gonna go for a walk.

1017

?

1018

You want her with us?

1019

Yup.

1020

Let me just say something before

If Sandra is with us,

1026
00:53:46,225 --> 00:53:47,703
I'd rather take Jerri.

1027

I mean, I'd rather
put ger oat jury

1028

because I've got her vote.

What if she doesn't vote for you?

1030

1031

Parvati wants me to
get rid of Sandra

1032

because she can't
even beat Sandra.

1033

1034

1037

Best option for me is to

That would be the best

1041

No, because Sandra would win.

1042

It gives me two people--

1043

I could sit there and say,

1044

1045
00:54:26,113 --> 00:54:29,515

1046

Right now, I'm on the fen fence,

1047
00:54:30,961 --> 00:54:32,735
because if I send Jerri home,

1048
00:54:32,755 --> 00:54:34,108
I'll get her vote.

1049

Fisend Parvati home, I don't know

1050

if I will get her voight.

1051

But I might.

1052
00:54:40,040 --> 00:54:45,157
Tonight's tribal council is
extremely a hard decision.

1053

I suffered way too much in
this game not to win it.

1054
00:54:50,874 --> 00:54:52,585
I have to win this thing.

1055
00:54:53,223 --> 00:54:54,622
?

1056

Let the chips fall where they may.

1058

Coach, Courtney, J.T., Amanda,

1059

Candice, Danielle,
Rupert, and Colby,

1060
00:55:27,423 --> 00:55:29,286

last tribal council.

1061

So, Jerri, you get back to camp.

1062
00:55:35,368 --> 00:55:36,800

1063
00:55:37,135 --> 00:55:38,780
So not only do you
have to think about

1064
00:55:38,800 --> 00:55:39,844

1065
00:55:39,864 --> 00:55:42,870
You have to make sure it's
not you who is voted out.

1066
00:55:43,187 --> 00:55:44,595
How much of your time is spent

1067
00:55:44,615 --> 00:55:46,336

1068

Well, getting back to camp,
you know,

1069
00:55:48,634 --> 00:55:51,755

go sit by myself on the beach

1070
00:55:51,775 --> 00:55:53,515

1071

and contemplate everything
that's going on in the game.

1072
00:55:56,288 --> 00:55:59,427
But today, I didn't
really leave camp.

1073
00:55:59,447 --> 00:56:01,133
I stuck around the whole time.

1074
00:56:01,986 --> 00:56:03,895
Sandra, you get back to camp.

1075

You don't have immunity, either.

1076
00:56:06,192 --> 00:56:07,247
What do I do?

1077
00:56:07,267 --> 00:56:09,129
I go to the person with immunity.

1078
00:56:09,473 --> 00:56:11,064
Because they're not going home,

1079
00:56:11,084 --> 00:56:12,613
and you want to let
that person know

1080
00:56:12,633 --> 00:56:14,320
this is why you should keep me

1081
00:56:14,340 --> 00:56:18,403
and these are the votes I might
possibly get one, if that,

1082
00:56:18,423 --> 00:56:20,707
so, you know,
who better to go up against

1083
00:56:20,727 --> 00:56:22,388
because I don't want
to go home in fourth.

1084

So your play to Russell was
take me because I can't win.

1085
00:56:25,819 --> 00:56:27,455
Yeah, and Russell
already knew that.

1086
00:56:27,475 --> 00:56:28,819
He tells me all the time.

1087
00:56:30,049 --> 00:56:30,948
That you can't win.

1088
00:56:31,159 --> 00:56:31,969
Yeah.

1089
00:56:31,989 --> 00:56:33,319
Well, kind of, no?

1090
00:56:33,895 --> 00:56:35,206
You never know what's
going to happen.

1091
00:56:35,226 --> 00:56:36,930
She could easily, possibly win.

1092
00:56:37,652 --> 00:56:40,375
This is when the
decision making is,

1093
00:56:40,493 --> 00:56:43,054

and the hardest.

1094
00:56:43,204 --> 00:56:46,639
You know, alliances are
going to get broke tonight.

1095
00:56:47,233 --> 00:56:50,576
And the decision making is
who do you want to bring

1096
00:56:50,596 --> 00:56:53,937
that you, that you can beat
when it comes down to it?

1097
00:56:54,844 --> 00:56:56,609
Who has friends, who doesn't,

1098
00:56:56,779 --> 00:56:58,697
who might potentially
give you a vote.

1099
00:56:59,119 --> 00:57:01,239
Who definitely won't
give you a vote.

1100
00:57:01,714 --> 00:57:02,488
You gotta sort it out.

1101
00:57:02,508 --> 00:57:04,362
You gotta write it in the sand.

1102
00:57:05,690 --> 00:57:06,781
Do the math.

1103
00:57:07,573 --> 00:57:10,484
Parvati, after winning two
immunity challenges in a row,

1104
00:57:10,504 --> 00:57:11,558
you don't win today.

1105
00:57:11,656 --> 00:57:13,600
I feel vulnerable.
I feel very vulnerable,

1106
00:57:13,620 --> 00:57:17,337
especially knowing that I have
played a good, strategic game,

1107
00:57:17,397 --> 00:57:19,564
and if people are trying
to vote out threats,

1108

then I'll probably be walking
out that path tonight.

1109
00:57:23,198 --> 00:57:25,111
Jerri, what case do
you make to Russell?

1110
00:57:25,171 --> 00:57:26,356
Why keep you?

1111
00:57:26,376 --> 00:57:28,740
Well, Parvati's a huge threat.

1112
00:57:29,022 --> 00:57:30,447
You know, that's a scary thing.

1113
00:57:30,467 --> 00:57:32,426
So that's kind the case I pushed.

1114
00:57:32,446 --> 00:57:33,987
Why is Parvati a huge threat?

1115
00:57:34,159 --> 00:57:35,813
Because she's been kicking butt,

1116
00:57:36,112 --> 00:57:38,180
and she's got a lot
of friends over there.

1117
00:57:38,286 --> 00:57:40,256
And, you know, it's no secret.

1118
00:57:40,696 --> 00:57:42,693
Right now, that is a threat.

1119
00:57:43,115 --> 00:57:46,106
So, Parvati, Sandra says
take me, I can't win.

1120
00:57:46,221 --> 00:57:48,772
Jerri says rid of Parvati,
she can win.

1121
00:57:49,194 --> 00:57:50,839
What case do you make to Russell?

1122
00:57:51,191 --> 00:57:54,921
I say if he's going to be
loyal to anyone in this game,

1123
00:57:55,062 --> 00:57:58,001
if he wants to redeem himself...

1124
00:58:00,191 --> 00:58:03,216
As far as villains go-
then take me, you know.

1125
00:58:03,236 --> 00:58:05,136
I've been your girl
this whole time.

1126
00:58:05,156 --> 00:58:06,145
I've been protecting you.

1127
00:58:06,165 --> 00:58:07,538
I've had your back
this whole time.

1128
00:58:07,558 --> 00:58:08,688
That's as good as I can get.

1129
00:58:08,948 --> 00:58:09,869
You've been protecting me?

1130
00:58:09,870 --> 00:58:11,655
How have you been protecting me?

1131
00:58:11,656 --> 00:58:13,680
We've been protecting each other

1132
00:58:14,759 --> 00:58:16,821
since day one.

1133
00:58:20,177 --> 00:58:21,088
You disagree?

1134
00:58:21,089 --> 00:58:23,776
I think I've been protecting you.

1135
00:58:23,777 --> 00:58:25,753
We've been protecting each other.

1136
00:58:25,754 --> 00:58:27,479
I've never gone against him.

1137
00:58:27,480 --> 00:58:28,912
Which I could have many times

1138
00:58:28,913 --> 00:58:32,360
because we argue a lot, you know.

1139
00:58:32,361 --> 00:58:34,931
Russell, Parvati could easily
have said, "you're right,

1140
00:58:34,932 --> 00:58:36,820
you've been protecting me.
" She didn't.

1141
00:58:36,821 --> 00:58:38,272
She looked you in
the eye and said,

1142
00:58:38,273 --> 00:58:40,168
"we've been protecting
each other."

1143
00:58:40,169 --> 00:58:42,864
It kind of annoys me.

1144
00:58:43,217 --> 00:58:46,455
So, Russell, completely different
experience for you today.

1145
00:58:46,456 --> 00:58:47,732
You have the upper hand.

1146
00:58:47,733 --> 00:58:49,243
You have the power.

1147
00:58:49,244 --> 00:58:51,447
Everybody has came to me today

1148
00:58:51,448 --> 00:58:53,440
and told me what
they were thinking,

1149
00:58:53,441 --> 00:58:56,474
and every-- everybody
made perfect sense.

1150
00:58:56,475 --> 00:58:59,931
You know, everybody's playing
et strategically today.

1151
00:58:59,932 --> 00:59:02,407
And all three of them
are smiling right now.

1152
00:59:07,055 --> 00:59:08,423
All right, let's get to it.

1153
00:59:08,424 --> 00:59:09,900
Russell has the immunity necklace.

1154
00:59:09,901 --> 00:59:11,048
You cannot vote for Russell.

1155
00:59:11,049 --> 00:59:13,933
He is guaranteed a spot at
the final tribal council.

1156
00:59:13,934 --> 00:59:19,062
Parvati, Jerri, Sandra,
one of you is about to be sent home.

1157
00:59:19,063 --> 00:59:20,967
It is time to vote.

1158
00:59:21,037 --> 00:59:23,508
Parvati, you're up.

1159
00:59:29,000 --> 00:59:31,968
Hopefully it's you tonight not me

1160
00:59:31,969 --> 00:59:35,766
because I want to win. Sorry.

1161
00:59:46,849 --> 00:59:49,780
I have respect for you, Parvati.

1162
00:59:49,781 --> 00:59:53,187
You have shown again you
are capable of kicking

1163
00:59:53,188 --> 00:59:56,056
some serious butt
and for that reason,

1164
00:59:56,057 --> 00:59:59,988
it is not a good idea to sit
next to you in the final three.

1165
01:00:10,777 --> 01:00:12,646
Sorry I had to do this.

1166
01:00:12,647 --> 01:00:14,838
I trusted you the entire game.

1167
01:00:14,839 --> 01:00:16,704
I believe you would
have been loyal to me,

1168
01:00:16,705 --> 01:00:19,851
but now my best shot
to win this game

1169
01:00:19,852 --> 01:00:22,350
is to get rid of you.

1170
01:00:28,323 --> 01:00:30,405
I'll go tally the votes.

1171
01:00:40,298 --> 01:00:42,132
Once the votes are read,
the decision is final.

1172
01:00:42,133 --> 01:00:43,527
The person voted out
will be asked to leave

1173
01:00:43,528 --> 01:00:45,212
the tribal council
area immediately.

1174
01:00:45,213 --> 01:00:47,317
I'll read the votes.

1175
01:00:50,990 --> 01:00:53,737
First vote, Parvati.

1176
01:00:58,857 --> 01:01:02,736
Jerri. One vote Parvati,
one vote Jerri.

1177
01:01:04,257 --> 01:01:05,295
Jerri.

1178
01:01:05,296 --> 01:01:07,627
Two votes Jerri, one vote Parvati.

1179
01:01:07,628 --> 01:01:09,558
One vote left.

1180
01:01:11,836 --> 01:01:15,671
17th person voted out and the
ninth and final member ofour jury,

1181
01:01:15,672 --> 01:01:16,908
Jerri.

1182
01:01:16,909 --> 01:01:19,206
You need to bring me your torch.

1183
01:01:22,270 --> 01:01:24,300
I can't wait to hear
this story later.

1184
01:01:31,627 --> 01:01:34,292
Jerri, the tribe has spoken.

1185
01:01:37,378 --> 01:01:39,527
Bye, guys.

1186
01:01:47,819 --> 01:01:52,060
Well, congratulations on going as
far as you can go in this game.

1187
01:01:52,061 --> 01:01:56,431
Tomorrow night, the power in
this game shifts to the jury.

1188
01:01:56,432 --> 01:01:58,455
All you can do is get
a good night's sleep

1189
01:01:58,456 --> 01:02:00,347
because you're going
to need your wits

1190
01:02:00,348 --> 01:02:03,395
about you tomorrow as you
attempt to convince them

1191
01:02:03,396 --> 01:02:05,995
why you deserve the
title of sole survivor

1192
01:02:05,996 --> 01:02:08,718
and the million dollars
that goes along with it.

1193
01:02:08,719 --> 01:02:09,808
Grab your torches.

1194
01:02:09,809 --> 01:02:12,401
We'll see you tomorrow
for final tribal council.

1195
01:02:14,607 --> 01:02:15,855
Crap!

1196
01:02:15,856 --> 01:02:17,443
One more night!

1197
01:02:17,444 --> 01:02:20,964
I was so sure I had this one.

1198
01:02:20,965 --> 01:02:22,731
This is kind of the villain way.

1199
01:02:22,732 --> 01:02:25,020
I'm leaning towards
voting for Russell

1200
01:02:25,021 --> 01:02:27,456
just because he's
played an amazing game.

1201
01:02:27,457 --> 01:02:29,666
He's a little reactionary
and hot headed,

1202
01:02:29,667 --> 01:02:33,616
but for the most part,
Russell makes decisions that make sense.

1203
01:02:33,617 --> 01:02:36,069
Except tonight.

1204
01:02:46,503 --> 01:02:48,484
Final three!

1205
01:02:49,747 --> 01:02:51,939
Unbelievable.

1206
01:02:51,940 --> 01:02:54,546
It's been quite a ride.

1207
01:02:54,547 --> 01:02:55,509
Ta-da!

1208
01:02:55,510 --> 01:02:58,974
I'm ready to go home to my house,
my kids, my dog.

1209
01:03:00,842 --> 01:03:03,479
Although you're trying
tow focus on the game,

1210
01:03:03,480 --> 01:03:06,523
you still tend to go
back and think about

1211
01:03:06,524 --> 01:03:07,963
I wonder what my kids are doing?

1212
01:03:07,964 --> 01:03:09,639
I wonder what my husband's doing?

1213
01:03:09,640 --> 01:03:10,719
If I think about my husband,

1214
01:03:10,720 --> 01:03:12,472
he's out in Afghanistan.
Is he okay?

1215
01:03:12,473 --> 01:03:14,125
Did he make it through today?

1216
01:03:14,126 --> 01:03:16,051
You know, it's not easy.

1217
01:03:16,052 --> 01:03:18,307
All right, y'all,
I think I'm going to bed.

1218
01:03:18,308 --> 01:03:19,842
What? Really?

1219
01:03:19,843 --> 01:03:21,660
You're going it leave us alone?

1220
01:03:21,661 --> 01:03:24,441
Yeah, there's no need to
baby sit y'all any more.

1221
01:03:25,806 --> 01:03:28,423
He's out there in Afghanistan
fighting for our country

1222
01:03:28,424 --> 01:03:31,905
and here I am fighting to be
the sole survivor, you know?

1223
01:03:32,845 --> 01:03:34,823
But to me it's worth it.

1224
01:03:34,893 --> 01:03:36,522
Yeah, I don't get to talk to him.

1225
01:03:36,523 --> 01:03:38,625
Yeah, I don't know how he's doing,

1226
01:03:38,626 --> 01:03:40,656
but inside, I know he's okay.

1227
01:03:40,657 --> 01:03:42,743
I have that gut feeling.

1228
01:03:42,744 --> 01:03:44,225
We're all on our own now.

1229
01:03:44,226 --> 01:03:46,279
Yeah. You bet.

1230
01:03:46,280 --> 01:03:48,397
Every villain for himself.

1231
01:03:48,719 --> 01:03:50,518
So I have to focus on the game

1232
01:03:50,519 --> 01:03:52,588
because I came for one reason
and for one reason only,

1233
01:03:52,589 --> 01:03:54,492
for another million dollars.

1234
01:03:54,493 --> 01:03:58,073
And if that makes our
life easier, then why not?

1235
01:03:58,143 --> 01:03:59,455
This is how I hustle.

1236
01:03:59,456 --> 01:04:00,624
This is how I make my money.

1237
01:04:00,625 --> 01:04:02,549
I come and play "survivor."

1238
01:04:02,550 --> 01:04:03,581
That's what I know how to do.

1239
01:04:03,582 --> 01:04:05,176
That's what I'm best at,

1240
01:04:05,177 --> 01:04:08,422
coming out here,
getting my money, going home.

1241
01:04:08,423 --> 01:04:11,025
Simple as that.

1242
01:04:24,208 --> 01:04:26,280
All right, let's go get tree mail.

1243
01:04:27,267 --> 01:04:28,423
Do it.

1244
01:04:28,424 --> 01:04:31,529
Day 39, you know,
I said I would do it,

1245
01:04:31,530 --> 01:04:32,836
and here I am.

1246
01:04:32,837 --> 01:04:34,455
I've done it again.

1247
01:04:37,933 --> 01:04:39,845
Oh, my God!

1248
01:04:40,165 --> 01:04:42,123
Look at it! It's amazing!

1249
01:04:42,193 --> 01:04:43,836
Sometimes it makes
me want to tear up.

1250
01:04:43,837 --> 01:04:44,676
It really does.

1251
01:04:44,677 --> 01:04:47,127
You say you can do it

1252
01:04:47,128 --> 01:04:49,952
but it's a lot harder
than you really think.

1253
01:04:49,953 --> 01:04:53,744
And I've done it, twice, day 39.

1254
01:04:53,745 --> 01:04:54,846
I want a piece of that bread

1255
01:04:54,847 --> 01:04:56,007
chunked off in my mouth.

1256
01:04:56,008 --> 01:04:57,822
No one's here to tell us no.

1257
01:04:57,823 --> 01:04:59,211
We're villains.

1258
01:04:59,769 --> 01:05:04,169
Tonight, I believe I have a
good shot of winning this.

1259
01:05:05,543 --> 01:05:09,185
Last season, I brought two people
because I thought I could beat them.

1260
01:05:09,186 --> 01:05:11,301
Because they were
the weak players.

1261
01:05:11,302 --> 01:05:12,390
And I didn't.

1262
01:05:12,391 --> 01:05:15,567
I'd like to say
congratulations to everybody.

1263
01:05:15,568 --> 01:05:17,416
For making it to the
final thr three.

1264
01:05:17,721 --> 01:05:21,859
I'm bringing people that
other people don't like.

1265
01:05:21,860 --> 01:05:23,832
Parvati has a lot of enemies.

1266
01:05:23,833 --> 01:05:25,705
Sandra, she didn't do nothing.

1267
01:05:25,706 --> 01:05:27,355
At the end of the day,
the reason she's here is

1268
01:05:27,356 --> 01:05:28,867
because she's easy to beat.

1269
01:05:28,868 --> 01:05:30,676
I'm going to have
to undo my pants.

1270
01:05:35,472 --> 01:05:36,836
Tell me the truth,

1271
01:05:36,837 --> 01:05:37,646
if I would have been on the jury,

1272
01:05:37,647 --> 01:05:39,384
would you have voted for me?

1273
01:05:39,385 --> 01:05:40,951
I told you, I would
have voted for Sandra.

1274
01:05:40,952 --> 01:05:42,152
I would have voted for you.

1275
01:05:42,153 --> 01:05:44,179
If you put me on the jury,
I still would have vote for you.

1276
01:05:44,180 --> 01:05:45,463
That's nice of you

1277
01:05:45,464 --> 01:05:46,870
but you wouldn't have vote for me?

1278
01:05:46,871 --> 01:05:48,492
I would have voted for Sandra.

1279
01:05:51,413 --> 01:05:55,964
I have played the game
of "survivor" 114 days.

1280
01:05:55,965 --> 01:05:57,661
I don't know if
that makes me crazy.

1281
01:05:57,662 --> 01:05:59,436
Probably.

1282
01:05:59,437 --> 01:06:01,427
But I think it also makes me

1283
01:06:01,428 --> 01:06:05,072
one of the best players
of "survivor," ever.

1284
01:06:05,073 --> 01:06:06,591
Your game was just like mine

1285
01:06:06,592 --> 01:06:07,703
but mine was a little stronger.

1286
01:06:07,704 --> 01:06:08,800
No, it wasn't.

1287
01:06:08,801 --> 01:06:10,744
My game was not like yours at all.

1288
01:06:10,745 --> 01:06:13,004
I think you'll hear
about it at tribal.

1289
01:06:13,005 --> 01:06:14,525
Say what you've got to say.

1290
01:06:14,526 --> 01:06:16,256
We all say what we've got to say.

1291
01:06:16,257 --> 01:06:19,288
This is it. Every man
for themselves now.

1292
01:06:20,700 --> 01:06:23,424
I'm definitely a little mischievous,
a little devious,

1293
01:06:24,959 --> 01:06:27,943
and I have definitely
embraced my villain side

1294
01:06:27,944 --> 01:06:30,418
this time around.
And you know what?

1295
01:06:30,419 --> 01:06:33,742
I've put my heart and
soul into this game

1296
01:06:33,743 --> 01:06:36,081
and I'm here to win,
and that's what I want.

1297
01:06:40,177 --> 01:06:43,377
He don't know what it's like
to be up against two chicks.

1298
01:06:43,378 --> 01:06:44,890
Bam!

1299
01:06:45,140 --> 01:06:46,717
My God!

1300
01:06:46,915 --> 01:06:48,558
I'm going to burn his hat.

1301
01:06:48,975 --> 01:06:51,729
Oh, my God!

1302
01:06:59,498 --> 01:07:01,062
Are you kidding?

1303
01:07:08,625 --> 01:07:10,783
Good work, lady.

1304
01:07:11,312 --> 01:07:13,215
Russell is obnoxious.

1305
01:07:13,216 --> 01:07:16,358
I took his hat,
and I threw it in the fire.

1306
01:07:16,359 --> 01:07:18,235
I don't care.

1307
01:07:18,284 --> 01:07:20,752
I should burn his sneakers.

1308
01:07:21,894 --> 01:07:23,998
You could take his bald-head
to tribal council,

1309
01:07:23,999 --> 01:07:24,968
it will be all right.

1310
01:07:24,969 --> 01:07:26,751
He'll have his buff on his head.

1311
01:07:26,752 --> 01:07:28,998
He has a big,

1312
01:07:28,999 --> 01:07:31,983
bald patch on his head he doesn't
want anybody to know about.

1313
01:07:33,400 --> 01:07:35,439
I've seen it a whole
bunch of times.

1314
01:07:35,440 --> 01:07:36,527
Screw it.

1315
01:07:36,528 --> 01:07:39,200
That's payback to me for all
he's done to me in this game.

1316
01:07:42,653 --> 01:07:44,251
Have y'all seen my hat?

1317
01:07:46,932 --> 01:07:48,984
You haven't seen it? No.

1318
01:07:49,054 --> 01:07:50,054
Did you pack it.

1319
01:07:50,055 --> 01:07:51,755
I put it right there.

1320
01:07:52,324 --> 01:07:54,088
I know I did.

1321
01:07:54,089 --> 01:07:55,737
I don't think it's about
the money tonight.

1322
01:07:55,738 --> 01:07:58,040
I think it's about the
title of sole survivor.

1323
01:07:58,041 --> 01:07:59,647
That's all Russell wants.

1324
01:07:59,648 --> 01:08:01,328
And if that's what result wants,

1325
01:08:01,329 --> 01:08:04,108
that's what I gotta make
sure Russell does not get.

1326
01:08:04,109 --> 01:08:06,169
I don't get my hat,
I ain't leaving here.

1327
01:08:06,170 --> 01:08:07,340
Well, year going to have to leave.

1328
01:08:08,551 --> 01:08:11,141
There's not a day
that didn't go by

1329
01:08:11,142 --> 01:08:13,437
that I was trying to focus on

1330
01:08:13,438 --> 01:08:16,014
what's the best way for
me to get rid of Russell.

1331
01:08:16,074 --> 01:08:18,165
Okay!

1332
01:08:18,848 --> 01:08:21,788
And the worst thing of
all is that those heroes,

1333
01:08:21,789 --> 01:08:24,119
each and every one of
them are responsible

1334
01:08:24,120 --> 01:08:26,874
for their own self-destruction.

1335
01:08:29,056 --> 01:08:30,688
When I was out here,
I had to hustle.

1336
01:08:30,689 --> 01:08:32,955
I had to make sure all
my stuff was in order

1337
01:08:32,956 --> 01:08:34,774
so that when I went
to tribal council

1338
01:08:34,775 --> 01:08:36,816
I made it out in one piece.

1339
01:08:36,817 --> 01:08:39,089
I didn't hide behind
no immunity necklace.

1340
01:08:39,090 --> 01:08:40,324
I never had safety.

1341
01:08:40,325 --> 01:08:42,560
I had to take care of myself.

1342
01:08:43,272 --> 01:08:45,761
Look at it go wild.

1343
01:08:46,062 --> 01:08:48,966
And yet, here I sit, ifiable three.

1344
01:08:49,248 --> 01:08:51,385
I think I deserve it.

1345
01:08:51,386 --> 01:08:54,049
I want the title of sole survivor.

1346
01:08:54,496 --> 01:08:58,861
The villains burn it down.

1347
01:09:24,008 --> 01:09:26,285
We'll now bring in your jury.

1348
01:09:28,145 --> 01:09:34,024
Coach, Courtney, J.T., Amanda,

1349
01:09:34,025 --> 01:09:40,086
Candice, Danielle,
Rupert, colcolby,

1350
01:09:40,087 --> 01:09:43,480
and Jerri, voted out at
the last tribal council.

1351
01:09:47,085 --> 01:09:50,707
So, after 39 days,
here's why we stand.

1352
01:09:50,708 --> 01:09:52,651
We started with 20 people.

1353
01:09:52,652 --> 01:09:54,996
10 heroes, 10 villains.

1354
01:09:54,997 --> 01:09:56,396
We are down to three.

1355
01:09:56,397 --> 01:09:58,917
Parvati, Russell, Sandra.

1356
01:09:58,918 --> 01:10:03,563
Each of you having played a very
different game of "survivor."

1357
01:10:03,564 --> 01:10:06,204
Tonight, the jury takes over.

1358
01:10:06,205 --> 01:10:09,335
Nine people that you had
a hand either directly

1359
01:10:09,336 --> 01:10:11,956
or indirectly in
voting out of this game

1360
01:10:11,957 --> 01:10:15,553
now will decide which one
of you wins this game,

1361
01:10:15,554 --> 01:10:17,508
gets the title of sole survivor,

1362
01:10:17,509 --> 01:10:19,746
and the million dollars
that goes with it.

1363
01:10:19,747 --> 01:10:21,807
This is their first
chance to address you.

1364
01:10:21,808 --> 01:10:23,211
I hope you're ready for it

1365
01:10:23,212 --> 01:10:24,948
because you will be
held accountable.

1366
01:10:24,949 --> 01:10:27,731
And anybody who lasts 39 days in

1367
01:10:27,732 --> 01:10:31,899
this game will have something
to be accountable for.

1368
01:10:31,900 --> 01:10:34,670
Here's how it works-
you'll make your opening statements.

1369
01:10:34,740 --> 01:10:38,181
They'll address you, then we vote.

1370
01:10:39,100 --> 01:10:41,824
Let's start, Sandra.

1371
01:10:41,825 --> 01:10:42,908
Okay.

1372
01:10:42,909 --> 01:10:45,372
I mean, we all know
how "survivor" works.

1373
01:10:45,373 --> 01:10:48,729
I've been sole surviving since
my alliance was wiped out.

1374
01:10:48,730 --> 01:10:50,740
I got to the heroes' camp.

1375
01:10:50,741 --> 01:10:53,590
I tried to get rid of Russell
three different times.

1376
01:10:53,650 --> 01:10:56,571
I'd have to work my way
around things at camp,

1377
01:10:56,572 --> 01:10:59,891
try to make sure to take
all the precautionary

1378
01:10:59,892 --> 01:11:03,298
measures to ensure that when I
brought my torch in here lit,

1379
01:11:03,299 --> 01:11:04,623
that it left heir lit.

1380
01:11:04,624 --> 01:11:07,487
And I did that by myself.

1381
01:11:11,551 --> 01:11:12,789
Russell.

1382
01:11:13,145 --> 01:11:17,430

1631

1638

it really comes down to
how you treat people.

1639

1640

1641

To be honest in this

To be a manipulative, deceiving,

1647
01:23:17,456 --> 01:23:21,792
lying person is very eas.

U u took the e easy way out..

And y you think you should

1650

yorere sadly mistaken.

01:23:30,206 --> 01:23:33,485
Sasandra, ititting
hereisistening y your answers

1652
01:23:33,486 --> 01:23:37,386
m meses me feel en wor
a about myy gam py. Y.

1653
01:23:37,623 --> 01:23:40,386
I wis y youou a I
had talked morere

1654
01:23:40,387 --> 01:23:43,558
t I h been s syed by

1655
01:23:43,559 --> 01:23:47,585
what I consider a d
dgusting human being.

1656
01:23:47,586 --> 01:23:49,937
You opened the door up for us,

1657
01:23:49,938 --> 01:23:52,414
and we kept slamming

1658
01:23:52,415 --> 01:23:54,817
I want to say thank you
for all the heroes,

1659
01:23:54,818 --> 01:23:56,907
whether they give you
their vote or not.

1660
01:23:56,975 --> 01:23:58,693
You deserve a big thank you.

1661

1662

Look, don't make me emotional.

1663

Parvati, you're a very,
very strong player.

1664

You might have aligned
yourself with...

1665

Terrible.

1667

1668

1669

1670

1676
01:24:37,162 --> 01:24:40,473

1678
01:24:42,914 --> 01:24:45,771
I'm going to give you guys a

1679

1680

1681
01:25:05,127 --> 01:25:06,261

1682

you've heard from Parvati,

1683
01:25:08,210 --> 01:25:09,674

1684

1685
01:25:11,300 --> 01:25:14,265
You should have all the

1686
01:25:14,266 --> 01:25:16,933

1687
01:25:16,934 --> 01:25:19,810

1688
01:25:19,811 --> 01:25:23,370
Tonight you are

1689
01:25:23,371 --> 01:25:26,526
For the last time,
it's time to vote.

1690
01:25:26,527 --> 01:25:28,598
Jerri, you're up.

1691
01:25:38,002 --> 01:25:41,900
This is absolutely insane I'm
walking up here going Parvati,

1692
01:25:41,901 --> 01:25:43,842
Sandra, Parvati, Sandra.

1693
01:25:43,843 --> 01:25:47,811

1694
01:25:58,499 --> 01:26:03,223
Sandra, in this game,
the line between hero and villain

1695
01:26:03,224 --> 01:26:05,667
was blurred most of the time,

1696
01:26:05,668 --> 01:26:08,425
but you worked hard,
you put family first,

1697
01:26:08,426 --> 01:26:10,791
and you always stay
true to yourself

1698
01:26:10,858 --> 01:26:13,388
and that makes you
a true hero to me.

1699
01:26:25,143 --> 01:26:27,641
Hey, girl, I'm voting for you.

1700
01:26:27,709 --> 01:26:29,946
I know everything that
you had to go through

1701
01:26:29,947 --> 01:26:31,509
dealing with Russell and all.

1702
01:26:31,510 --> 01:26:33,885
But you are a great player.

1703
01:26:33,886 --> 01:26:37,068
I thought you deserved to be
sitting in the final three.

1704
01:26:47,760 --> 01:26:49,333
First bump, girl.

1705
01:27:14,378 --> 01:27:17,137
Parvati, I was wrong about you.

1706
01:27:17,138 --> 01:27:22,123
You were a warrior,
and that is why you get my vote.

1707
01:27:24,322 --> 01:27:28,450
King Arthur's journey
has officially ended.

1708
01:27:39,724 --> 01:27:43,281
I'm honored that I get to
write your name down again

1709
01:27:43,282 --> 01:27:45,557
and give you $1 million.

1710
01:27:45,558 --> 01:27:47,543
Love you.

1711
01:28:02,043 --> 01:28:03,270
For the last time,

1712
01:28:03,271 --> 01:28:05,479
I'll go get the votes.

1713
01:28:16,398 --> 01:28:19,079
Well, I want to say that
we couldn't have asked

1714
01:28:19,080 --> 01:28:22,160

people to play in this

1715
01:28:22,161 --> 01:28:27,311
20th season of
"Survivor: Heroes versus Villains."

1716
01:28:27,525 --> 01:28:29,190
Thank you.

1717
01:28:29,414 --> 01:28:32,709
Parvati, Russell, Sandra,

1718
01:28:32,710 --> 01:28:35,301
the nine votes inside this urn are

1719
01:28:35,302 --> 01:28:38,705
about to make one of
you a millionaire,

1720
01:28:38,706 --> 01:28:42,405
but you're going to have to
wait just a little bit longer.

1721
01:28:42,406 --> 01:28:45,302
I'll see you back in New York
for the reading of the votes.

1722
01:28:45,303 --> 01:28:55,303

00:00:00,472 --> 00:00:03,542
<i>Previously on "Survivor"</i>

2
00:00:04,986 --> 00:00:07,592
Jane, the tribe has spoken.

3
00:00:08,699 --> 00:00:09,754
You all have fun.

4
00:00:09,789 --> 00:00:14,826
<i>On day 36, when Jane was voted out,
there were only five left in the game,</i>

5
00:00:14,861 --> 00:00:17,155
<i>but back on day one...</i>

6
00:00:17,829 --> 00:00:20,333
Welcome to "Survivor: Nicaragua"

7
00:00:20,368 --> 00:00:25,591
<i>No one would have predicted that
Dan, Fabio, Sash, Holly or Chase</i>

8
00:00:25,631 --> 00:00:27,227
<i>would have gone so far.</i>

9
00:00:27,262 --> 00:00:30,477
<i>They all followed an
improbable path to the end.</i>

10
00:00:30,795 --> 00:00:34,407
<i>Dan stepped into the hostile
Nicaraguan rain forest waring</i>

11
00:00:34,408 --> 00:00:38,844
<i>$1600 shoes and having no
idea what he was getting into.</i>

12
00:00:42,379 --> 00:00:43,952
Three seconds in...

13
00:00:43,953 --> 00:00:45,517
<i>Dan is out of the challenge.</i>

14
00:00:45,552 --> 00:00:48,553
<i>During the challenges, he
was either ineffective...</i>

15
00:00:49,155 --> 00:00:51,323
<i>or didn't participate at all.</i>

16
00:00:51,369 --> 00:00:56,088
This tribe might think I'm a weak link,
but I don't consider myself a weak link.

17
00:00:57,599 --> 00:01:03,581
<i>But he's the only one left who
hasn't made any enemies, ****</i>

18
00:01:03,582 --> 00:01:06,490
*** to me he's like an old wise guy.

19
00:01:07,106 --> 00:01:11,160
<i>Holly's trip to the final five
was also extremely improbable.</i>

20
00:01:11,195 --> 00:01:13,710
Holly, I'm not so sure that everybody is

21
00:01:13,711 --> 00:01:16,225
as comfortable as they
were when we started.

22
00:01:16,260 --> 00:01:17,523
- Are you?
- No.

23
00:01:17,558 --> 00:01:20,978
<i>Holly was even more
uncomfortable back on day five</i>

24
00:01:21,319 --> 00:01:24,653
<i>When she completely flipped
out and stole Dan's shoes.</i>

25
00:01:24,855 --> 00:01:27,899
The New York city boy, Danny,
he doesn't like sand on him

26
00:01:27,934 --> 00:01:29,967
so let's just fill his shoes up.

27
00:01:32,198 --> 00:01:34,052
<i>Later when she tried to quit...</i>

28

I can't do it.

29
00:01:35,426 --> 00:01:39,268
<i>A pep talk from coach Jimmie Johnson
completely turned her game around.</i>

30
00:01:39,594 --> 00:01:42,246
We really do need you.

31
00:01:45,443 --> 00:01:49,218
<i>And by day 27, she had become
the godmother of her tribe</i>

32
00:01:49,253 --> 00:01:52,780
<i>and pulled off a successful hit
on Brenda who at the time was</i>

33
00:01:52,815 --> 00:01:54,959
<i>time was the most strategic
player in the game.</i>

34
00:01:54,994 --> 00:01:57,549
We're all in consensus
that Brenda has to go first.

35
00:01:57,584 --> 00:01:59,977
She's the ringleader.

36
00:02:00,976 --> 00:02:03,968
<i>At the last tribal council,
Chase got into hot water</i>

37
00:02:04,003 --> 00:02:06,375
<i>water when he revealed
his final three alliance.</i>

38
00:02:06,410 --> 00:02:09,709
To be clear, there is
a three-person alliance.

39
00:02:09,744 --> 00:02:12,851
It is Chase, it is
Holly, and it is Sash.

40
00:02:12,886 --> 00:02:14,072
- Yeah.
- Yes.

41
00:02:14,107 --> 00:02:16,863
<i>But his alliances aren't
always what they seem.</i>

42
00:02:16,898 --> 00:02:21,105
<i>Since day three, every person
Chase had ever aligned with...</i>

43
00:02:21,140 --> 00:02:22,731
Without me and you, I
think they're screwed.

44
00:02:22,766 --> 00:02:25,033
There's no reason for
me to backstab you.

45
00:02:25,034 --> 00:02:27,416
I had no idea you were
such a badass woman.

46
00:02:27,417 --> 00:02:28,930
<i>He eventually voted out.</i>

47
00:02:28,931 --> 00:02:31,701
Sorry, dude. This isn't

48
00:02:31,736 --> 00:02:33,331
I wish this wouldn't have happened.

49
00:02:33,357 --> 00:02:35,701
<i>Chase had angered so many people...</i>

50

By god, I started it. I put it out.

51
00:02:38,287 --> 00:02:41,215
<i>That it was a wonder he
was still in the game.</i>

52
00:02:44,025 --> 00:02:47,444
<i>At the last tribal council,
Chase and Sash were safe</i>

53
00:02:47,445 --> 00:02:49,788
<i>because they both had
hidden immunity idols.</i>

54
00:02:49,789 --> 00:02:50,789
Thank you.

55
00:02:50,790 --> 00:02:55,709
<i>Sash had come a long way since day
28 when he was a dead man walking.</i>

56
00:02:55,744 --> 00:02:59,912
I find myself faced with an uphill
struggle to try to get to the end.

57
00:03:00,298 --> 00:03:03,252
<i>His allies, NaOnka
and Purple Kelly, quit.</i>

58
00:03:03,287 --> 00:03:04,334
Head out.

59
00:03:04,369 --> 00:03:06,163
<i>So he's aligned with no one.</i>

60
00:03:06,198 --> 00:03:07,692
I'm kind of like a free agent.

61
00:03:07,693 --> 00:03:10,871
I'd like to work with
whoever had me in their plans.

62
00:03:10,906 --> 00:03:14,613
<i>But he made secret side deals
with everyone to go to the end.</i>

63
00:03:14,648 --> 00:03:16,941
Will you swear you will
take me no matter what?

64
00:03:16,942 --> 00:03:17,942
Yes.

65
00:03:17,943 --> 00:03:20,810
I hold more chips than
anyone else still remaining.

66
00:03:20,884 --> 00:03:22,962
<i>And now he's back in contention.</i>

67
00:03:22,997 --> 00:03:26,883
- Let me ask the question... who's next?
- Whoever doesn't win immunity next.

68
00:03:27,010 --> 00:03:30,239
It sounds like if I don't win
again I could be going next.

69
00:03:30,274 --> 00:03:32,210
Its writing is on the wall, Fabio.

70
00:03:32,211 --> 00:03:35,600
<i>Right now, no one is in
a deeper hole than Fabio.</i>

71
00:03:35,921 --> 00:03:39,517
<i>Back on day one, Fabio was
dismissed as a goof ball.</i>

72
00:03:39,552 --> 00:03:42,607
The guy with the long, blond
hair, he's a dumb blond.

73
00:03:42,642 --> 00:03:46,278
I never really called a guy a dumb
blond before but he's a dumb blond.

74
00:03:46,349 --> 00:03:49,819
My strategy to be out in the
open and make people laugh

75
00:03:49,820 --> 00:03:52,288
and be all crazy, I call it being cool.

76
00:03:52,388 --> 00:03:55,910
<i>But when his life was on the line,
he won the last immunity challenge.</i>

77
00:03:55,911 --> 00:03:59,420
♪♪♪♪♪

78
00:03:59,455 --> 00:04:02,393
Which proved to everyone
he is a serious player.

79
00:04:02,809 --> 00:04:05,339
I always tell myself no
matter what happens, you know,

80
00:04:05,340 --> 00:04:07,201
I make the best of the pieces there.

81
00:04:07,236 --> 00:04:10,837
<i>Tonight, everyone's improbable
journey will come to an end.</i>

82
00:04:10,872 --> 00:04:12,321
Grab your torches and head back to camp.

83
00:04:12,322 --> 00:04:15,364
<i>After 36 days of surprises...</i>

84
00:04:16,120 --> 00:04:18,889
<i>the biggest are yet to come.</i>

85
00:04:18,998 --> 00:04:24,196
<i>One of these five people will
outwit, outplay, and outlast</i>

86
00:04:24,231 --> 00:04:30,152
<i>all the others to win the million-dollar
prize and the title of Sole Survivor.</i>

87
00:04:30,153 --> 00:04:36,153

00:05:32,724 --> 00:05:36,594
Day 37... Unbelievable.

89
00:05:39,228 --> 00:05:42,664
After last night's tribal
council, realizing that Sash,

90
00:05:42,698 --> 00:05:46,434
Holly, and Chase are pretty
tight, you know, I definitely

91
00:05:46,469 --> 00:05:49,304
think it's in my best
interest to break them up.

92
00:05:49,338 --> 00:05:53,446
I feel like they think I'm the big
threat now. They want me out next.

93
00:05:53,447 --> 00:05:56,711
- The next one out should be Holly.
- That's what I'm saying.

94
00:05:56,746 --> 00:05:59,572
It should be a no-brainer.

95
00:06:01,702 --> 00:06:04,844
Sorry Holly for being a
little bit down, but I realize

96
00:06:04,845 --> 00:06:08,048
the way things are lining up and
I'm not in a good position here.

97
00:06:08,049 --> 00:06:10,502
I mean, you, Sash, and
Chase seem pretty tight.

98
00:06:10,742 --> 00:06:12,468
It's anybody's game.

99
00:06:12,497 --> 00:06:18,302
Well, you want to go to the final three
with me or do you want to go with Chase?

100
00:06:19,228 --> 00:06:22,039
What about me?

101
00:06:23,796 --> 00:06:28,165
I'm very much aware of the position
I'm in and I'll go out fighting.

102
00:06:28,578 --> 00:06:31,674
Unless somebody else has a better plan.

103
00:06:31,709 --> 00:06:34,868
So what are you saying your plan is?

104
00:06:35,003 --> 00:06:37,568
Try to win immunity.

105
00:06:37,941 --> 00:06:41,746
I'm not very comfortable going to tribal
council without a necklace right now.

106
00:06:41,781 --> 00:06:47,060
<i>But I gotta be cool right now. I
can't let on that I'm playing the game.</i>

107
00:06:51,067 --> 00:06:54,017
Sash, how do you really
feel about things?

108
00:06:54,052 --> 00:06:58,263
I really think Dan and
Holly are huge threats.

109
00:06:58,708 --> 00:07:01,696
<i>Fabio is definitely a little
bit on edge, which he should be,</i>

110
00:07:01,697 --> 00:07:03,825
<i>if I was in his shoes,
I would be as well.</i>

111
00:07:03,914 --> 00:07:07,684
But there's a very good chance
Fabio could make an immunity run and

112
00:07:07,685 --> 00:07:12,338
<i>go all the way to the end. So you
better believe that I'm telling Fabio...</i>

113
00:07:12,341 --> 00:07:13,741
what he wants to hear.

114
00:07:13,776 --> 00:07:15,081
You know what I want.

115
00:07:15,116 --> 00:07:18,192
But I don't know... I don't know
how tight you and Chase really are.

116
00:07:18,227 --> 00:07:21,607
Chase and I are tight. I would
like to go to the end with Chase.

117
00:07:21,821 --> 00:07:24,450
Just like I'd like to
go to the end with you.

118
00:07:24,501 --> 00:07:27,695
<i>If you only have one clear-cut
strategy in Survivor...</i>

119
00:07:27,696 --> 00:07:29,988
<i>chances are you're not going to
make it all the way to the end.</i>

120
00:07:29,989 --> 00:07:34,996
I'm trying to find as many avenues
to make final three as possible,

121
00:07:35,031 --> 00:07:39,253
so if that means making promises to
every single person left on my tribe,

122
00:07:39,288 --> 00:07:41,033
that's what I'm going to do.

123
00:07:41,034 --> 00:07:43,640
Fabio's extremely nervous
right now because...

124
00:07:43,675 --> 00:07:48,157
He thinks that, you know, he's
the next to go, which he is.

125
00:07:48,192 --> 00:07:51,883
- So the same plan as always, right.
- Yeah, yeah.

126
00:07:52,177 --> 00:07:55,544
<i>We've got a big challenge coming
up, and we're gunning for Fabio.</i>

127
00:07:55,579 --> 00:07:59,124
Fabio is a huge physical threat.
He can win his way to the end,

128
00:07:59,159 --> 00:08:01,964
and he's been winning
immunities. He won the last one,

129
00:08:01,999 --> 00:08:06,853
and if Fabio loses the next
immunity, he's going home tonight.

130
00:08:16,917 --> 00:08:19,493
Come on in, guys.

131
00:08:24,470 --> 00:08:26,592
You guys ready to get to
today's immunity challenge?

132
00:08:26,627 --> 00:08:27,711
- Yup.
- Absolutely.

133
00:08:27,712 --> 00:08:30,750
First things first, Fabio. Give it up.

134
00:08:30,785 --> 00:08:32,789
Thank you.

135
00:08:35,605 --> 00:08:39,104
Once again immunity
is back up for grabs.

136
00:08:39,139 --> 00:08:41,693
On my go, you'll race
out to a station...

137
00:08:41,725 --> 00:08:44,535
where you will find a
question about Nicaragua.

138
00:08:45,134 --> 00:08:49,257
To select your answer, choose the
corresponding bag and race back.

139
00:08:49,285 --> 00:08:52,220
If you're right, the bag
will contain puzzle pieces.

140
00:08:52,289 --> 00:08:54,897
If you're wrong, the
pieces will be black.

141
00:08:54,932 --> 00:08:56,915
You'll have to go back
and get the right bag.

142
00:08:56,950 --> 00:08:59,921
Once you have answered all
three questions and collected all

143
00:08:59,956 --> 00:09:03,808
three bags of puzzle pieces, you'll
use the pieces to solve the puzzle.

144
00:09:03,843 --> 00:09:07,772
First person to get
it right wins immunity.

145
00:09:07,807 --> 00:09:12,035
And will have a one-in-four
shot at the million dollars.

146
00:09:12,047 --> 00:09:15,363
We'll draw for spots and get started.

147
00:09:20,283 --> 00:09:22,422
All right, here we go, for immunity.

148
00:09:22,457 --> 00:09:27,192
And a guaranteed spot in the
final four, survivors ready?

149
00:09:28,780 --> 00:09:30,564
Go!

150
00:09:35,144 --> 00:09:37,829
See what you know about Nicaragua.

151
00:09:37,864 --> 00:09:40,235
Everybody working on
that first question.

152
00:09:40,270 --> 00:09:43,392
Nicaragua shares its southern
border with Costa Rica,

153
00:09:43,393 --> 00:09:46,547
its northern border with what country?

154
00:09:49,425 --> 00:09:52,336
Did you study before you came?

155
00:09:52,382 --> 00:09:56,768
If you think you know what the answer
is, grab that bag and head back.

156
00:09:59,869 --> 00:10:04,531
Holly got it right. If you have it right
there are puzzle pieces. Head back out.

157
00:10:04,566 --> 00:10:07,968
If you have it wrong, it will
be black, and you are wrong.

158
00:10:08,599 --> 00:10:12,732
Sash got it right. Fabio got it right.

159
00:10:14,175 --> 00:10:16,555
Everybody got the first question right.

160
00:10:16,623 --> 00:10:19,920
Honduras is north of Nicaragua.

161
00:10:20,360 --> 00:10:25,529
Question number two, "the east coast
of Nicaragua is also known as what?"

162
00:10:34,911 --> 00:10:37,565
Holly heading back with her second bag.

163
00:10:37,600 --> 00:10:40,144
Chase and Sash heading
back with their second bags.

164
00:10:40,145 --> 00:10:43,429
Do they have it right?
Holly is two for two.

165
00:10:45,115 --> 00:10:49,055
Sash got it right. Chase is two for two.

166
00:10:52,573 --> 00:10:57,016
Fabio, wrong. Frustrated,
tosses his pieces.

167
00:10:57,251 --> 00:10:59,182
He's got to head back out.

168
00:10:59,217 --> 00:11:02,553
Next question, "in
the early 16th century,

169
00:11:02,554 --> 00:11:05,889
these people claimed
Nicaragua for Spain."

170
00:11:09,759 --> 00:11:12,991
Chase and Holly coming
back with their third bag.

171
00:11:13,026 --> 00:11:16,811
Sash right behind. Fabio racing back.

172
00:11:16,846 --> 00:11:19,106
Fabio no back with his second bag.

173
00:11:19,141 --> 00:11:23,178
While Chase, Holly and Sash
are all on their third bags.

174
00:11:23,213 --> 00:11:28,412
Holly has it right. She's working on the
puzzle. Chase is working on the puzzle.

175
00:11:29,042 --> 00:11:32,577
Sash has it right. He's
working on the puzzle.

176
00:11:33,726 --> 00:11:39,267
Fabio working on that third
question. Fabio and Dan way behind.

177
00:11:40,209 --> 00:11:44,328
You know what it is. It is
the logo from this season.

178
00:11:44,563 --> 00:11:48,565
Holly getting there. Sash
making a lot of progress.

179
00:11:48,600 --> 00:11:52,032
Fabio still working
on that third question.

180
00:11:53,890 --> 00:11:58,163
Fabio now back with his third
bag. Does he have it right?

181
00:11:58,495 --> 00:12:01,281
He does. Fabio now
working on the puzzle.

182
00:12:01,316 --> 00:12:04,012
But he's got to make up a lot of time.

183
00:12:04,984 --> 00:12:06,655
Who's going to finish first?

184
00:12:06,690 --> 00:12:10,526
Who's going to be guaranteed
a spot in the final four.

185
00:12:12,166 --> 00:12:15,874
Dan now back with his third
bag. And he has it right.

186
00:12:15,909 --> 00:12:19,266
Everybody working on their puzzle now.

187
00:12:22,137 --> 00:12:25,664
It is Sash with a huge lead right now.

188
00:12:25,884 --> 00:12:30,180
Holly trying to get into
it. Chase having a hard time.

189
00:12:30,490 --> 00:12:35,032
Dan way behind. Fabio
making a lot of progress.

190
00:12:35,067 --> 00:12:37,902
Fabio was behind but he
has caught up quickly.

191
00:12:38,829 --> 00:12:44,417
We've got a race. It is Fabio
and Sash right now. Neck and neck.

192
00:12:45,561 --> 00:12:50,386
Holly's starting to get
into it. Chase still behind.

193
00:12:52,554 --> 00:12:55,205
Fabio has made up a lot of time.

194
00:12:55,240 --> 00:12:59,246
It is still Fabio and
Sash, both very close.

195
00:12:59,476 --> 00:13:03,935
Fabio won the last immunity.
Can he do it back to back?

196
00:13:05,194 --> 00:13:10,399
Sash getting closer. Fabio very close.

197
00:13:10,793 --> 00:13:14,511
Fabio has it! Fabio wins immunity!

198
00:13:17,023 --> 00:13:20,007
- Nice job, Fabio.
- I'm missing a piece.

199
00:13:24,713 --> 00:13:27,885
Must have fell out when
you dumped them out.

200
00:13:28,498 --> 00:13:31,819
- Fabio, come on over.
- Good job, Fabio.

201
00:13:35,947 --> 00:13:41,293
Once again, Fabio has immunity.
You will live to see the final four.

202
00:13:41,328 --> 00:13:43,943
One step closer to the
final tribal council.

203
00:13:45,982 --> 00:13:51,446
After 37 very tough days, Dan,
Chase, Holly, Sash, one of you,

204
00:13:51,481 --> 00:13:55,418
your shot at the million
dollars will come to an end.

205
00:13:55,453 --> 00:13:58,291
Going to be an interesting
afternoon. I have no doubt.

206
00:13:58,326 --> 00:14:02,109
Grab your stuff. Head back to camp.
I'll see you at tribal. Congrats.

207
00:14:02,507 --> 00:14:07,561
<i>Fabio winning immunity today definitely
put a monkey wrench in our plan.</i>

208
00:14:07,704 --> 00:14:12,057
We were hoping that he would
lose so we could get rid of him,

209
00:14:12,142 --> 00:14:17,701
<i>but tonight I'm hoping it's an easy
vote and we're going to vote Dan.</i>

210
00:14:33,484 --> 00:14:36,436
- Nice job, Fabio way to go.
- Thank you very much.

211
00:14:36,437 --> 00:14:37,545
Great job.

212
00:14:37,580 --> 00:14:40,357
I won again. It was awesome, man.

213
00:14:40,392 --> 00:14:45,919
<i>Going into it, I knew that if
I didn't win, I was not safe.</i>

214
00:14:45,954 --> 00:14:48,633
<i>But I got my necklace,
and I'm loving it, man.</i>

215
00:14:48,668 --> 00:14:50,815
Is that what you guys were
expecting for the challenge?

216
00:14:50,850 --> 00:14:51,913
- No.
- No.

217
00:14:51,948 --> 00:14:54,219
I thought it was going
to be more physical.

218
00:14:54,295 --> 00:14:56,716
<i>I've always known that I was
going to wait to the last minute</i>

219
00:14:56,751 --> 00:15:00,611
<i>to be aggressive. I chose to just
follow people, go with their plan.</i>

220
00:15:00,682 --> 00:15:04,316
Right now, I've got to figure
things out and swing them my way,

221
00:15:04,351 --> 00:15:08,169
<i>and my number one plan would
be to talk to Chase and Sash</i>

222
00:15:08,264 --> 00:15:11,147
<i>to get Holly out first.</i>

223
00:15:11,431 --> 00:15:14,082
You think Dan's more
of a threat than Holly?

224
00:15:14,117 --> 00:15:16,105
- Yeah.
- He hasn't done anything.

225
00:15:16,140 --> 00:15:19,620
He lays around the shelter all the time.
I don't know if people respect him.

226
00:15:19,873 --> 00:15:24,337
- Nobody's mad at Dan.
- I'm not sure everybody liked him.

227
00:15:25,083 --> 00:15:29,363
Everybody on the jury does.
Sash and I have talked about it.

228
00:15:29,665 --> 00:15:33,391
For me, between Fabio and Dan,
the other one would go home, so...

229
00:15:33,392 --> 00:15:36,497
but that was an easy decision
when we got back from camp.

230
00:15:36,532 --> 00:15:39,997
<i>Me, personally, I think Dan is
less of a threat than Holly, but...</i>

231
00:15:40,032 --> 00:15:43,597
I've been so close with her it would
be tough for me to vote out Holly.

232
00:15:43,632 --> 00:15:44,899
That would be a tough task.

233
00:15:44,934 --> 00:15:49,260
Chase wants to vote you.
He sees you as a big threat.

234
00:15:49,295 --> 00:15:52,385
I don't know where Sash is at with that.

235
00:15:52,467 --> 00:15:54,969
Let's try to make it Holly, that's all.

236
00:15:55,004 --> 00:15:58,755
- I'm trying, but, you know...
- Right. I...

237
00:15:58,790 --> 00:16:02,204
Sash, I gotta talk to
Sash, you know, alone.

238
00:16:02,691 --> 00:16:05,545
I want to get Sash to
try to vote out Holly.

239
00:16:05,580 --> 00:16:07,283
How many votes do we
need? We need three?

240
00:16:07,318 --> 00:16:11,405
Three... We need you and Sash.

241
00:16:12,031 --> 00:16:14,918
<i>My job is to paint Holly
as a bigger threat than me.</i>

242
00:16:14,953 --> 00:16:18,265
I'd like to convince Sash
we should get rid of Holly.

243
00:16:18,300 --> 00:16:19,759
That would be the optimum.

244
00:16:19,794 --> 00:16:23,680
It's not going to be easy but
that's what I'm going to try and do.

245
00:16:23,715 --> 00:16:27,566
- I want to be with you two guys.
- I would like for us to go.

246
00:16:27,601 --> 00:16:31,495
So if that's what you really
want, we can do it in no time.

247
00:16:31,530 --> 00:16:34,094
Nobody is going to say Dan
gets the million dollars.

248
00:16:34,105 --> 00:16:35,613
Everybody knows I have money.

249
00:16:35,706 --> 00:16:39,409
So Holly's got me
hands down as a threat,

250
00:16:39,573 --> 00:16:41,979
hands down she's a little
girl from North Dakota.

251
00:16:41,980 --> 00:16:45,483
She has a struggling farm. She only
came from a town of eleven hundred.

252
00:16:45,484 --> 00:16:48,428
What's the chances of somebody from
a town of eleven hundred winning?

253
00:16:48,429 --> 00:16:50,447
Right. I think she's a big threat.

254
00:16:50,482 --> 00:16:52,959
I'll be honest with you guys, I
can't be any straighter. That's it.

255
00:16:52,994 --> 00:16:54,825
- I said my piece.
- Ok.

256
00:16:54,860 --> 00:16:57,927
You guys, you're gonna do what you
want to do. I can't tell you what to do.

257
00:16:57,962 --> 00:16:59,548
I know.

258
00:16:59,583 --> 00:17:03,231
<i>I'm going to have to try to make a case
for Dan not being the biggest threat,</i>

259
00:17:03,266 --> 00:17:05,973
and the best person for
me to do that with is Sash.

260
00:17:06,008 --> 00:17:10,315
I have to have a one-on-one, me
and sash, without Chase coming up

261
00:17:10,350 --> 00:17:11,845
and saying, "what are
you guys talking about?"

262
00:17:12,009 --> 00:17:13,905
Because he does that and it's annoying.

263
00:17:14,111 --> 00:17:17,258
You really want to vote Dan out
before Holly, you personally?

264
00:17:18,565 --> 00:17:21,862
- Because that could be bad fore, man.
- I know.

265
00:17:21,897 --> 00:17:24,354
I'm trying to get a real
sense for how you're feeling.

266
00:17:24,389 --> 00:17:28,167
I know Chase... I mean, Chase
has emotional attachment to Holly.

267
00:17:28,202 --> 00:17:31,245
Holly and Chase end up in that
final three together I think

268
00:17:31,280 --> 00:17:32,991
they would take all the votes.

269
00:17:33,026 --> 00:17:36,457
You and I could vote Holly tonight
and not even let it come down to Chase.

270
00:17:36,492 --> 00:17:38,197
That's true.

271
00:17:38,573 --> 00:17:40,343
<i>Fabio brought up a lot of good points.</i>

272
00:17:40,378 --> 00:17:43,451
People are probably giving Dan a little
too much credit for being a threat,

273
00:17:43,486 --> 00:17:47,241
<i>but Holly is a threat because she's
the only woman left in the game</i>

274
00:17:47,242 --> 00:17:51,087
<i>and there are quite a few women
on the jury. Not only that,</i>

275
00:17:51,283 --> 00:17:55,733
Holly could get all the votes
from all the former Espada members.

276
00:17:55,768 --> 00:17:57,187
So I'm not trying to save Dan.

277
00:17:57,221 --> 00:18:00,949
I'm just trying to split up
Chase and Holly while we can.

278
00:18:00,984 --> 00:18:04,303
I like the idea. You
bring up good points.

279
00:18:04,927 --> 00:18:09,361
<i>At this point in the game, it's
transition from an alliance...</i>

280
00:18:09,396 --> 00:18:14,855
type game to an individual game,
and everyone is trying to look out

281
00:18:15,293 --> 00:18:19,453
for themselves. And I am as well.

282
00:18:19,844 --> 00:18:24,616
- What are you guys thinking?
- We're thinking Dan, of course.

283
00:18:24,651 --> 00:18:26,094
- You're what?
- Dan.

284
00:18:26,129 --> 00:18:27,643
- So...
- We were just thinking about Dan.

285
00:18:27,644 --> 00:18:31,901
I didn't realize that you were in
for voting him off. I thought...

286
00:18:32,363 --> 00:18:34,071
You haven't talked to me about it.

287
00:18:34,106 --> 00:18:37,685
Yeah, I know, but we were talking
and I thought my name came up.

288
00:18:38,922 --> 00:18:41,764
- No.
- So that's only thing I was thinking.

289
00:18:41,799 --> 00:18:46,590
I have a feeling that Dan and
Fabio are telling Sash and Chase

290
00:18:46,625 --> 00:18:50,014
<i>that I'm a huge threat, that
they need to get rid of me.</i>

291
00:18:50,049 --> 00:18:52,474
<i>Am I concerned at
this point? Absolutely.</i>

292
00:18:52,509 --> 00:18:55,681
<i>But I just have to trust
in my alliance and hope</i>

293
00:18:55,716 --> 00:18:58,707
that tonight my name isn't written down.

294
00:19:15,531 --> 00:19:18,969
We'll now bring in the
members of our jury.

295
00:19:20,570 --> 00:19:24,456
Alina, Marty, Brenda,

296
00:19:24,604 --> 00:19:28,549
Naonka, Purple Kelly, Benry,

297
00:19:28,584 --> 00:19:32,243
and Jane voted out at
the last tribal council.

298
00:19:35,297 --> 00:19:37,312
Let's talk about today's
immunity challenge.

299
00:19:37,347 --> 00:19:40,187
Fabio, how big was today's win for you?

300
00:19:40,222 --> 00:19:41,833
Today was a big one, man.

301
00:19:41,858 --> 00:19:45,455
Winning immunity is a huge part
of getting to the end of this game.

302
00:19:45,495 --> 00:19:50,029
How big a factor is tonight's vote
from the point of who can I beat?

303
00:19:50,101 --> 00:19:53,551
Tonight's vote is going to come down
to who people think is the threat

304
00:19:53,586 --> 00:19:56,405
for the million because that's the
point of the game we're at, you know?

305
00:19:56,474 --> 00:19:58,555
You have to think
about who's on the jury?

306
00:19:58,590 --> 00:20:00,837
Who has had past
relationships with them.

307
00:20:00,872 --> 00:20:06,627
Who they maybe respect for certain
reasons and who has played a nice game?

308
00:20:06,801 --> 00:20:12,538
Dan, a big part of your strategy from
day one has been "take me to the end,

309
00:20:12,573 --> 00:20:15,509
- I can't possibly win."
- Correct.

310
00:20:15,544 --> 00:20:20,100
- Still feel that way?
- I live a nice life. I have money.

311
00:20:20,135 --> 00:20:24,025
And I don't think anybody is going
to award me a million dollars, ever.

312
00:20:24,060 --> 00:20:25,431
Does that seem fair to you?

313
00:20:25,466 --> 00:20:27,301
I'm not saying I couldn't
use the million dollars.

314
00:20:27,336 --> 00:20:29,411
I'm not making light of
a million dollars, okay.

315
00:20:29,446 --> 00:20:33,169
But there are people here that
they would sooner give it to.

316
00:20:33,379 --> 00:20:36,675
I always said, "take me
there. I'm never going to win."

317
00:20:36,676 --> 00:20:39,046
That was my ploy my whole way here.

318
00:20:39,333 --> 00:20:43,137
Sash, if you buy into that,
it's a pretty good argument.

319
00:20:43,172 --> 00:20:46,621
Its a good argument because
it increases your odds

320
00:20:46,622 --> 00:20:50,321
from 33% to 50 or even 100%.

321
00:20:50,652 --> 00:20:54,471
Holly, at the last tribal council, there
were a lot of fingers pointing at you.

322
00:20:54,506 --> 00:20:56,690
That's what I'm afraid of tonight, also.

323
00:20:56,725 --> 00:20:59,409
I know that Dan has talked to Sash about

324
00:20:59,410 --> 00:21:02,094
teaming up with the guys
and getting rid of me.

325
00:21:02,095 --> 00:21:03,661
Why would that make sense?

326
00:21:03,696 --> 00:21:07,813
Because Dan said he would like
four guys to go to the final four.

327
00:21:07,891 --> 00:21:10,986
I don't think I ever said
I want four guys to go.

328
00:21:11,021 --> 00:21:14,391
The reason why Holly would be
voted out is because she's a threat.

329
00:21:14,426 --> 00:21:16,327
- I don't know where...
- How am I a threat?

330
00:21:16,362 --> 00:21:18,357
Explain to me how you
think I'm a threat.

331
00:21:18,592 --> 00:21:22,756
The lady from South Dakota
a 1100 people in a town.

332
00:21:22,757 --> 00:21:25,666
She's in the final
three. That's a threat.

333
00:21:25,701 --> 00:21:30,089
Why is that a threat where I'm from
and how many people I have in my town?

334
00:21:30,124 --> 00:21:32,392
That's my interpretation.
I just think it is.

335
00:21:32,427 --> 00:21:35,535
- I don't think that's a threat at all.
- Okay I think it is.

336
00:21:35,573 --> 00:21:37,952
Obviously, Holly, you're
going to say it's not a threat.

337
00:21:38,000 --> 00:21:43,490
What matters is not whether Dan is right
or wrong it's that's his perception.

338
00:21:43,525 --> 00:21:44,860
Correct.

339
00:21:44,893 --> 00:21:49,428
Chase, at this point, it really does
come down to perception, doesn't it?

340
00:21:49,463 --> 00:21:54,967
**** They know my mind's always turning.

341
00:21:55,002 --> 00:21:57,638
I think Brenda called me paranoid.

342
00:21:57,830 --> 00:21:58,883
He's paranoid as hell.

343
00:21:58,884 --> 00:22:01,741
My mind's always thinking,
like, how to win in the end.

344
00:22:01,742 --> 00:22:04,845
So it's always a mind game going on.

345
00:22:05,138 --> 00:22:08,946
So, Holly, what do you say to get that
target off your back and back on his?

346
00:22:10,016 --> 00:22:13,053
Has he been aggressive? Has he
gone out and talked to people?

347
00:22:13,088 --> 00:22:15,537
Has he made the right alliances?

348
00:22:15,750 --> 00:22:21,178
But I also think it's really important
to remember the numbers on the jury.

349
00:22:21,284 --> 00:22:24,287
By assessing who is going to
get the least amount of votes,

350
00:22:24,322 --> 00:22:26,364
of course that the
person you want to take.

351
00:22:26,399 --> 00:22:28,909
So you have to take all those
aspects into consideration

352
00:22:28,910 --> 00:22:31,420
when you're this close to the end.

353
00:22:31,455 --> 00:22:35,634
Holly, those attributes you mentioned,
how aggressive was he or wasn't he?

354
00:22:35,669 --> 00:22:37,378
What alliances did he or didn't he have?

355
00:22:37,413 --> 00:22:41,012
Those all seem to make the
argument to take him to the end.

356
00:22:41,047 --> 00:22:44,865
He hasn't done anything to the
money, which is Dan's point exactly.

357
00:22:45,538 --> 00:22:49,206
Fabio, if you just isolate it
down to Holly and Dan tonight,

358
00:22:49,305 --> 00:22:52,271
it's potentially a
million-dollar mistake

359
00:22:52,301 --> 00:22:55,951
- if you vote the wrong person out.
- Uhm, yeah.

360
00:22:55,986 --> 00:22:58,786
It definitely is, and that's
something I'm sure we all thought about

361
00:22:58,787 --> 00:23:00,390
this afternoon at camp.

362
00:23:00,425 --> 00:23:03,925
A lot of the reasons that Holly
pointed out about Dan being a threat

363
00:23:03,960 --> 00:23:06,914
is also why Holly may
be a threat as well.

364
00:23:06,949 --> 00:23:12,224
I think that a lot of the women on the
jury respect Holly as a motherly figure,

365
00:23:12,259 --> 00:23:15,734
and I think a lot of her answers
at tribal council are pretty good.

366
00:23:15,741 --> 00:23:19,335
That's a compliment to Holly. I
think she's a pretty cool lady.

367
00:23:19,726 --> 00:23:23,639
It's a compliment, and
it's also a warning, Holly.

368
00:23:24,798 --> 00:23:27,850
All right, Fabio, you have
individual immunity again.

369
00:23:27,885 --> 00:23:30,079
- You're going to keep that?
- Yeah.

370
00:23:30,114 --> 00:23:34,315
Cannot vote for Fabio. Everybody
else is fair game. It is time to vote.

371
00:23:34,350 --> 00:23:36,857
Chase, you're up.

372
00:24:12,960 --> 00:24:15,552
I'll go tally the votes.

373
00:24:25,202 --> 00:24:27,292
Once the vote are read,
the decision is final.

374
00:24:27,327 --> 00:24:30,226
Person voted out will be asked to leave
the tribal council area immediately.

375
00:24:30,261 --> 00:24:32,849
I'll read the votes.

376
00:24:34,403 --> 00:24:37,150
First vote, Dan.

377
00:24:42,104 --> 00:24:45,195
Dan. That's two votes Dan.

378
00:24:47,884 --> 00:24:51,240
Chase. Two votes Dan, one vote Chase.

379
00:24:57,731 --> 00:25:01,296
14th person voted out and the
eighth member of our jury, Dan.

380
00:25:01,331 --> 00:25:04,562
That's three. That's enough.
You need to bring me your torch.

381
00:25:12,433 --> 00:25:14,991
Dan, the tribe has spoken.

382
00:25:16,710 --> 00:25:19,284
Time for you to go.

383
00:25:27,001 --> 00:25:30,614
Well, congratulations. You
have made it to the final four.

384
00:25:30,649 --> 00:25:33,616
Tomorrow, you'll compete in
your final immunity challenge.

385
00:25:33,651 --> 00:25:36,306
Win tomorrow's challenge,
you are in the final three

386
00:25:36,341 --> 00:25:40,453
and will have a shot at the money.
Lose, you could be going home.

387
00:25:40,488 --> 00:25:44,300
Grab your stuff. Head
back to camp. Good night.

388
00:25:48,942 --> 00:25:52,797
I switched my vote tonight to Chase
to tell him how much I dislike the guy.

389
00:25:52,832 --> 00:25:56,894
<i>I want nothing to do with you. Holly,
you're a crook. You stole my shoes.</i>

390
00:25:56,929 --> 00:25:58,840
<i>They ought to cut your damn hands off.</i>

391
00:25:58,875 --> 00:26:04,265
<i>Sash, you're just like a whining
little girl. And you're a liar.</i>

392
00:26:04,300 --> 00:26:07,855
I wish them the worst, and
I can't wait to cast my vote.

393
00:26:24,421 --> 00:26:26,430
- Final four.
- Yeah.

394
00:26:26,854 --> 00:26:29,963
- Well... We're all still here.
- It's exciting, right?

395
00:26:29,998 --> 00:26:32,205
- Yeah.
- We made it, guys.

396
00:26:32,396 --> 00:26:33,550
- We did.
- I'm excited.

397
00:26:33,585 --> 00:26:35,376
Last four!

398
00:26:35,812 --> 00:26:37,867
- You guys, this is a big deal.
- This is a pretty big deal.

399
00:26:37,869 --> 00:26:41,474
It's a huge deal. Let's have
fun tomorrow and tonight.

400
00:26:41,475 --> 00:26:43,016
- Yeah.
- Okay?

401
00:26:43,051 --> 00:26:46,654
<i>Tonight at tribal council, I felt
comfortable because I had the necklace</i>

402
00:26:46,689 --> 00:26:51,452
around my neck, and tomorrow
night, for me to feel secure,

403
00:26:51,453 --> 00:26:55,224
I'm going to have to have the immunity
necklace again because I really

404
00:26:55,259 --> 00:26:59,198
don't know what's going through
Chase and Sash's mind at this point.

405
00:26:59,724 --> 00:27:04,703
So are we thinking if one of us wins
tomorrow we can all three go together?

406
00:27:04,738 --> 00:27:08,552
- Does that make the most sense?
- Of course it does.

407
00:27:08,818 --> 00:27:11,312
I think we're all on
the same page, right?

408
00:27:11,347 --> 00:27:13,766
<i>Everything at the moment
is going according to plan.</i>

409
00:27:13,801 --> 00:27:18,276
I love how things are playing
out because right now, I truly

410
00:27:18,311 --> 00:27:22,708
believe that every single person
left will take me to the end, no

411
00:27:22,743 --> 00:27:25,800
<i>matter who wins the
final immunity challenge.</i>

412
00:27:25,835 --> 00:27:27,868
Fabio wants to take me.

413
00:27:27,903 --> 00:27:32,656
And he believes that I will also
take him, but if Fabio loses,

414
00:27:32,691 --> 00:27:37,229
he'll be going home because he's
the biggest threat to my end game.

415
00:27:51,207 --> 00:27:54,238
- Are we still a 100%?
- 100%.

416
00:27:54,311 --> 00:27:56,375
You and I have discussed going together.

417
00:27:56,376 --> 00:28:00,324
I mean, we'd be crazy not to. If
I go to the final three with him.

418
00:28:00,412 --> 00:28:03,457
Anybody goes with him,
it's going to be tough.

419
00:28:03,486 --> 00:28:06,375
We've got to give it our
all today because, you know,

420
00:28:06,428 --> 00:28:09,748
he does win the last challenge,
it's going to be complete scramble.

421
00:28:09,783 --> 00:28:11,493
- And he knows that.
- Yeah, he knows.

422
00:28:11,527 --> 00:28:14,903
So he's going to go 100%,
too. Of course he is.

423
00:28:14,938 --> 00:28:17,309
<i>We have our final
immunity challenge today.</i>

424
00:28:17,367 --> 00:28:21,653
And if Fabio does not win individual
immunity, he will be the next to go.

425
00:28:21,688 --> 00:28:25,076
And Sash, Chase, and I
will go to the top three.

426
00:28:25,111 --> 00:28:28,651
<i>But if Fabio wins, we will
have to turn on our own,</i>

427
00:28:28,712 --> 00:28:32,459
and it will be very
interesting to see what happens.

428
00:28:32,915 --> 00:28:36,135
If Fabio wins, we're going to have
to discuss what we're going to do

429
00:28:36,152 --> 00:28:39,419
because number-wise I think
Sash would get a lot of votes.

430
00:28:39,420 --> 00:28:41,611
Marty would go Sash...

431
00:28:41,625 --> 00:28:46,062
Purple Kelly would go Sash,
Dan and Benry would go Sash.

432
00:28:46,096 --> 00:28:47,559
Damn, that's a lot.

433
00:28:47,594 --> 00:28:49,649
We'll have to say the and see
what happens at the challenge,

434
00:28:49,684 --> 00:28:51,513
and then decisions will have to be made.

435
00:28:51,514 --> 00:28:52,514
Ok.

436
00:28:52,515 --> 00:28:56,065
I just want you to know that
you and I need to stick together.

437
00:28:56,263 --> 00:28:58,575
We need to win.

438
00:28:59,277 --> 00:29:03,387
I picture you, me, and
Sash in the final three.

439
00:29:03,422 --> 00:29:05,789
Do you feel comfortable with that plan?

440
00:29:05,824 --> 00:29:08,077
I feel comfortable
with everything, yeah.

441
00:29:08,154 --> 00:29:11,863
We'll see how the challenge
goes today and go from there.

442
00:29:11,898 --> 00:29:14,940
<i>I don't like the lying
part at all to this game,</i>

443
00:29:15,048 --> 00:29:18,752
<i>but Holly, Sash, and I have that
alliance, we're pretty strong,</i>

444
00:29:18,974 --> 00:29:22,295
<i>and Fabio could be breaking that
up if he wins another immunity.</i>

445
00:29:22,330 --> 00:29:25,064
<i>You know, it could be a
million-dollar challenge for me, so...</i>

446
00:29:25,099 --> 00:29:28,388
I'm definitely going to put pressure
on myself and try to win that thing.

447
00:29:28,423 --> 00:29:31,269
- The last tree mail.
- Tree mail.

448
00:29:31,304 --> 00:29:33,878
- Check this out.
- A sword?

449
00:29:33,913 --> 00:29:35,285
Is that what it is?

450
00:29:35,320 --> 00:29:38,668
It's looks like we're sword
fighting for the... Million.

451
00:29:39,246 --> 00:29:41,068
Oh, wow.

452
00:29:41,621 --> 00:29:45,463
"Congratulations, final four. You are
almost to the end of this adventure"

453
00:29:45,779 --> 00:29:49,790
"Follow your map from the beach through
the jungle to the top of the head land"

454
00:29:49,825 --> 00:29:52,253
"There you will find the
torches of your fallen comrades"

455
00:29:52,288 --> 00:29:55,047
"At each torch, you will
collect a representative shield

456
00:29:55,082 --> 00:29:57,092
of those who were voted out before you"

457
00:29:57,127 --> 00:30:00,757
"At the end of your journey you will
offer them up in a ceremonial burning

458
00:30:00,872 --> 00:30:02,672
paying respect to their memory"

459
00:30:02,673 --> 00:30:05,607
You will then proceed to your
final immunity challenge."

460
00:30:05,642 --> 00:30:07,318
- Final challenge.
- Wow.

461
00:30:07,434 --> 00:30:10,923
- ***
- Good job, you guys, good job.

462
00:30:10,958 --> 00:30:13,527
- We came a long way.
- Unbelievable.

463
00:30:13,562 --> 00:30:17,110
<i>Going on the rites of passage,
I have a huge responsibility.</i>

464
00:30:17,145 --> 00:30:20,422
<i>I'm the last one left
from the Espada tribe.</i>

465
00:30:20,457 --> 00:30:24,652
And I truly want to show my
dedication to all the people

466
00:30:24,687 --> 00:30:28,479
<i>that I started this game with whether
they were the first one voted out</i>

467
00:30:28,514 --> 00:30:32,423
<i>or they were just recently voted
out, it is a huge responsability,</i>

468
00:30:32,458 --> 00:30:34,940
<i>and it is an absolute honor.</i>

469
00:30:35,833 --> 00:30:37,481
Wendy Jo.

470
00:30:37,516 --> 00:30:42,044
Whenever you looked at her,
she glowed. Wendy Jo was great.

471
00:30:42,878 --> 00:30:45,213
<i>I never wanted to be
the first one voted off.</i>

472
00:30:45,247 --> 00:30:49,885
<i>If I were to be in this game again
my strategy would be different.</i>

473
00:30:49,920 --> 00:30:55,626
<i>I would tell everybody
about me and how great I am.</i>

474
00:30:57,995 --> 00:30:59,972
Shannon!

475
00:31:00,007 --> 00:31:02,477
I'm sure outside this
game Shannon was awesome.

476
00:31:02,512 --> 00:31:04,933
During this game, I couldn't trust him.

477
00:31:05,357 --> 00:31:08,761
<i>I got put with the little kids and
they didn't have a clue about life</i>

478
00:31:08,796 --> 00:31:12,170
<i>or responsibility and I didn't want
to be on there for another 20 days</i>

479
00:31:12,205 --> 00:31:14,607
<i>baby-sitting these children.</i>

480
00:31:15,857 --> 00:31:17,962
- Jimmy J.
- Jimmie Johnson.

481
00:31:17,997 --> 00:31:22,112
If it wasn't for Jimmy, I wouldn't
have made it past day five.

482
00:31:22,147 --> 00:31:27,550
He will always have a very special
spot in my heart. Wonderful man.

483
00:31:28,150 --> 00:31:31,101
<i>I've coached and played football,</i>

484
00:31:31,102 --> 00:31:34,333
<i>but in "Survivor" out in
the elements without food,</i>

485
00:31:34,368 --> 00:31:38,182
<i>with all the rain, and the
stress of the game, this out here,</i>

486
00:31:38,217 --> 00:31:42,533
<i>it drains you like nothing
I've ever been through before.</i>

487
00:31:44,283 --> 00:31:47,200
Jimmy T. He loved the game.

488
00:31:47,235 --> 00:31:49,629
He's got to be one of
the goofier characters.

489
00:31:49,664 --> 00:31:52,134
- Along with you, buddy.
- Yeah.

490
00:31:52,640 --> 00:31:56,242
<i>You can't control "Survivor"
and I tried to just get ahold</i>

491
00:31:56,277 --> 00:31:58,192
<i>and it became more and more frustrating.</i>

492
00:31:58,193 --> 00:32:04,191
<i>It's amazing how quickly I got knocked
down to size, and I'm certainly humbled.</i>

493
00:32:09,698 --> 00:32:12,834
- Tyrone.
- Tyrone the Fireman.

494
00:32:13,360 --> 00:32:15,984
<i>I knew there was going to come
a time when the social aspect</i>

495
00:32:16,839 --> 00:32:20,606
<i>was going outweigh the physical aspect
and it came earlier than I anticipated.</i>

496
00:32:20,772 --> 00:32:25,693
<i>And I probably didn't adjust as quickly
as I could have. You live, you learn.</i>

497
00:32:28,847 --> 00:32:29,991
Kelly B.

498
00:32:29,992 --> 00:32:32,834
She came out here and did what we
struggled to do with only one leg

499
00:32:32,835 --> 00:32:35,589
- and that's unbelievable.
- What an inspiration.

500
00:32:35,792 --> 00:32:39,401
<i>In my life, I have been
through a lot, and in "Survivor"</i>

501
00:32:39,436 --> 00:32:42,926
<i>I learned that I am actually
stronger than I expected that I was,</i>

502
00:32:42,961 --> 00:32:48,754
<i>and I learned that I have even
a thicker skin than I imagined.</i>

503
00:32:52,486 --> 00:32:54,512
- Yve.
- Very hard worker.

504
00:32:54,547 --> 00:32:58,084
I enjoyed a lot of conversations
around the fire with Ive.

505
00:32:58,214 --> 00:33:00,928
<i>My biggest regret with
Survivor was when we switched</i>

506
00:33:00,929 --> 00:33:02,901
<i>and I didn't take the initiative.
I hesitated.</i>

507
00:33:02,902 --> 00:33:05,086
<i>You can't do that in life.</i>

508
00:33:05,087 --> 00:33:07,781
<i>From here on out, when I get
home, I'm going to do this, and...</i>

509
00:33:07,782 --> 00:33:11,728
<i>if it doesn't work out,
it doesn't work out.</i>

510
00:33:12,860 --> 00:33:14,511
- Jill.
- Jill.

511
00:33:14,546 --> 00:33:17,727
She was good in the challenges,
but I don't think she made enough

512
00:33:17,762 --> 00:33:20,789
of an impact on the new la
Flor tribe to stick around.

513
00:33:22,116 --> 00:33:25,306
<i>I expected surviving in the
elements would be difficult.</i>

514
00:33:25,341 --> 00:33:28,497
<i>I figure that would be something
I would do very well at.</i>

515
00:33:28,498 --> 00:33:30,904
<i>What I didn't expect
is the social aspect</i>

516
00:33:30,905 --> 00:33:33,310
<i>of the game would be
equally as difficult.</i>

517
00:33:33,311 --> 00:33:36,456
<i>Clearly my social game
wasn't up to snuff.</i>

518
00:33:39,289 --> 00:33:43,833
Alina. Probably one of the best overall
competitors in the game, I think.

519
00:33:44,356 --> 00:33:46,733
<i>I'd rather be eliminated
because I'm a threat</i>

520
00:33:46,734 --> 00:33:48,577
<i>than to be eliminated
because I'm dispensable.</i>

521
00:33:48,578 --> 00:33:51,467
<i>So that makes me proud of my game
that I was that big of a threat</i>

522
00:33:51,468 --> 00:33:53,910
<i>that they had to get rid of me.</i>

523
00:33:54,454 --> 00:33:56,894
- Marty.
- Marty.

524
00:33:56,929 --> 00:33:59,958
That guy always had, like,
the master plan, you know.

525
00:33:59,993 --> 00:34:02,400
- Yeah.
- Always thinking about numbers.

526
00:34:02,435 --> 00:34:04,717
- Big strategist.
- Marty.

527
00:34:05,103 --> 00:34:08,475
<i>I would have imagined that my strategy
would have been a little more lying,</i>

528
00:34:08,510 --> 00:34:11,332
<i>cheating, and stealing, and as
it turns out I never lied once.</i>

529
00:34:11,333 --> 00:34:13,893
<i>I never really made any
promises I couldn't keep</i>

530
00:34:13,894 --> 00:34:16,946
<i>so I loved the way I played the game.</i>

531
00:34:19,542 --> 00:34:20,590
Brenda.

532
00:34:20,591 --> 00:34:24,209
Great strategist in the
game, and almost a mastermind.

533
00:34:24,244 --> 00:34:28,091
So one of the best overall
players of the game.

534
00:34:29,301 --> 00:34:32,535
<i>You don't really know how strong
you are until you're tested</i>

535
00:34:32,570 --> 00:34:35,639
<i>with things like not
eating, not sleeping,</i>

536
00:34:35,674 --> 00:34:39,702
<i>dealing with all these personalities,
and I was really proud of myself</i>

537
00:34:39,737 --> 00:34:44,191
<i>because I stayed focused, and
I've come out of this a new person.</i>

538
00:34:48,379 --> 00:34:49,770
NaOnka.

539
00:34:49,835 --> 00:34:52,942
11 days left and to
walk out of the game.

540
00:34:52,994 --> 00:34:55,584
She had an idol in
her hand when she quit.

541
00:34:55,619 --> 00:34:57,127
Definitely disappointing.

542
00:34:57,162 --> 00:35:01,853
<i>I quit the game, and I'm not afraid
to say that, but I always had a smile.</i>

543
00:35:01,888 --> 00:35:05,940
<i>I was friendly. And I had
a very strategical game.</i>

544
00:35:05,975 --> 00:35:10,892
<i>I'm not trying to toot my own horn
but I was literally the smartest player</i>

545
00:35:10,927 --> 00:35:15,418
<i>in the game, hands
down. And the craziest.</i>

546
00:35:19,335 --> 00:35:22,543
- Another quitter.
- Purple Kelly.

547
00:35:23,019 --> 00:35:26,314
Probably would have been better for
her to be voted out than to quit.

548
00:35:26,631 --> 00:35:31,359
<i>My reputation is not a quitter, and
people back home, they all know that.</i>

549
00:35:31,394 --> 00:35:34,945
<i>So it's going to be hard for me to
be seen walking away from something</i>

550
00:35:34,946 --> 00:35:39,309
<i>because that's not who I
am. So that's the worst part.</i>

551
00:35:41,460 --> 00:35:43,694
- Benry.
- Huge physical threat.

552
00:35:43,729 --> 00:35:47,265
Yeah, he's a game
player, man. He was good.

553
00:35:47,313 --> 00:35:51,307
<i>They were smart to get rid of me
because there's no doubt in my mind</i>

554
00:35:51,342 --> 00:35:54,847
<i>that I could have won individual
immunity the next three,</i>

555
00:35:54,882 --> 00:36:00,400
<i>four, however many challenges. Unless
there were some puzzles involved.</i>

556
00:36:02,382 --> 00:36:03,649
Jane.

557
00:36:03,684 --> 00:36:05,705
She was one person who
deserves to be given a

558
00:36:05,706 --> 00:36:07,727
million dollars for how
hard she worked is Jane.

559
00:36:07,949 --> 00:36:11,142
<i>I've had a lot of ups and
downs in my life, but I always</i>

560
00:36:11,143 --> 00:36:15,112
<i>knew I could probably out-do
any person out here as far as</i>

561
00:36:15,113 --> 00:36:18,225
stamina and I proved to myself I could.

562
00:36:18,226 --> 00:36:21,907
<i>I can go back to North
Carolina with my head held high.</i>

563
00:36:25,218 --> 00:36:27,095
- Dan the man.
- Dan.

564
00:36:27,130 --> 00:36:31,978
Twice our age, so to make it this long
in the game, just an incredible feat.

565
00:36:32,013 --> 00:36:33,456
Good job, Dan.

566
00:36:33,491 --> 00:36:37,201
<i>I learned that this city boy
can survive in the wilderness,</i>

567
00:36:37,236 --> 00:36:40,883
<i>And this entire experience has
changed me that I won't be such</i>

568
00:36:40,918 --> 00:36:44,889
<i>a beatch if I don't get my
three meals a day anymore.</i>

569
00:36:44,890 --> 00:36:48,926
<i>I think I'm going to be a lot less
spoiled when I get back in New York.</i>

570
00:36:53,959 --> 00:36:56,118
- ***
- Wow.

571
00:36:56,153 --> 00:36:57,853
These are the people
who helped us get there.

572
00:36:57,888 --> 00:36:58,902
Right.

573
00:36:58,903 --> 00:37:00,362
I think we should
definitely respect that.

574
00:37:00,363 --> 00:37:02,545
- Sure.
- Absolutely.

575
00:37:02,626 --> 00:37:06,638
<i>It feels good to have gotten this
far. It's kind of a big deal, man.</i>

576
00:37:06,673 --> 00:37:08,661
<i>It's an accomplishment, you know.</i>

577
00:37:08,662 --> 00:37:11,862
<i>And now I've just got to be
thinking of this next challenge</i>

578
00:37:11,863 --> 00:37:15,910
<i>and how the million dollars is
actually on the line this time.</i>

579
00:37:15,945 --> 00:37:21,309
It feels good to even be in a position
to compete in something like that.

580
00:37:45,899 --> 00:37:48,348
Come on in, guys.

581
00:37:56,710 --> 00:37:59,778
You guys ready to get to
your final immunity challenge?

582
00:37:59,813 --> 00:38:01,247
- Yeah.
- Absolutely.

583
00:38:01,281 --> 00:38:06,082
First things first. Fabio,
once again, I will take it back.

584
00:38:11,791 --> 00:38:15,506
For the last and most important time,

585
00:38:15,724 --> 00:38:18,639
immunity is back up for grabs.

586
00:38:18,640 --> 00:38:22,869
For your final immunity challenge,
you will each have a sword.

587
00:38:22,904 --> 00:38:26,439
With one hand you will
balance the sword on a shield.

588
00:38:26,473 --> 00:38:31,311
With your other hand, you will stack
coins on the handle of the sword.

589
00:38:31,345 --> 00:38:36,419
As the stack of coins gets higher,
it will get more difficult to balance.

590
00:38:36,454 --> 00:38:40,205
When the stack becomes too
high, the coins will fall.

591
00:38:40,240 --> 00:38:42,032
You're out of the challenge.

592
00:38:42,067 --> 00:38:45,515
Last person left standing wins immunity,

593
00:38:45,516 --> 00:38:49,616
is guaranteed a spot in the final
three, and you will get a chance to

594
00:38:49,617 --> 00:38:55,277
plead your case to the jury of why you
deserve the title of Sole Survivor and

595
00:38:55,312 --> 00:38:58,962
the million dollars that goes
with it. Losers, tribal council,

596
00:38:58,997 --> 00:39:03,595
and somebody's shot at the
million dollars will be over.

597
00:39:03,849 --> 00:39:05,518
- Make sense?
- Yeah.

598
00:39:05,553 --> 00:39:08,169
All right, pick up your swords.

599
00:39:08,716 --> 00:39:12,200
First thing you want to do is find
a spot on that shield that feels

600
00:39:12,235 --> 00:39:16,473
comfortable because you're going to be
holding it here through the challenge.

601
00:39:17,597 --> 00:39:21,493
Time for the first coin,
a medium-sized coin.

602
00:39:24,398 --> 00:39:29,569
Five, four, three, two, one.

603
00:39:29,855 --> 00:39:32,893
That's how it will work.
You'll have a five-second window

604
00:39:32,894 --> 00:39:35,931
to get the coin on and
get your hand out of there.

605
00:39:35,966 --> 00:39:38,967
All right, next coin will be a large.

606
00:39:41,617 --> 00:39:47,520
Five, four, three, two,
one. Everybody looking good.

607
00:39:48,189 --> 00:39:51,503
Let's put another large on there.

608
00:39:52,292 --> 00:39:58,109
Five, four, three, two, one.

609
00:39:59,166 --> 00:40:02,318
