You see where this is going.
As that stack gets higher,

610
00:40:02,353 --> 00:40:05,853
it's going to get more
difficult to balance it.

611
00:40:16,337 --> 00:40:19,277
Every coin here is slightly uneven.

612
00:40:19,397 --> 00:40:24,016
These are not like the coins you are
used to would be very easy to stack.

613
00:40:24,192 --> 00:40:29,781
These were made for a "Survivor"
challenge, thus difficult.

614
00:40:38,573 --> 00:40:44,534
Fabio very close to losing
that stack but a nice recovery.

615
00:40:47,463 --> 00:40:51,559
Time to add another coin. You're
going to add a medium coin.

616
00:40:51,649 --> 00:40:54,962
During those five seconds, if
you want to readjust your stack,

617
00:40:54,997 --> 00:40:57,398
if you think it's leaning, go for it.

618
00:40:57,433 --> 00:41:00,151
That is the only time
you can touch your coins.

619
00:41:00,955 --> 00:41:04,485
Here we go. Five, four...

620
00:41:04,686 --> 00:41:09,048
three, two, one.

621
00:41:12,600 --> 00:41:16,603
You're going to place another
coin. This time a large coin.

622
00:41:18,777 --> 00:41:24,777
In five, four, three, two, one.

623
00:41:26,416 --> 00:41:29,435
Everybody's clean again.

624
00:41:31,691 --> 00:41:35,869
Let's place a medium
coin now on this stack.

625
00:41:40,071 --> 00:41:43,215
Holly drops a coin. Holly
is out of the challenge.

626
00:41:43,250 --> 00:41:48,716
We are down to three,
Sash, Fabio, and Chase.

627
00:41:50,607 --> 00:41:54,327
Time to place your
next coin. Here we go.

628
00:41:54,362 --> 00:41:58,075
Five, four, three,

629
00:41:58,441 --> 00:42:02,295
two, one. Hands away.

630
00:42:03,448 --> 00:42:06,926
Chase can't do it. Chase
is out of the challenge.

631
00:42:07,143 --> 00:42:11,872
Gently take a spot on your
platform. We are down to two now.

632
00:42:12,673 --> 00:42:18,634
Sash and Fabio. Have fought
for 38 days for this shot.

633
00:42:22,256 --> 00:42:27,217
Time to place another coin. You're
going to place a large coin now.

634
00:42:31,327 --> 00:42:36,257
Here you go. Five, four, three,

635
00:42:36,971 --> 00:42:41,630
two, one. Nicely done.

636
00:42:41,981 --> 00:42:45,351
Win this, you are going to the final,
and you will have a shot at the money.

637
00:42:45,386 --> 00:42:49,591
Lose, you could be going
home in just a few hours.

638
00:42:49,935 --> 00:42:54,531
Potentially a million-dollar
challenge right here.

639
00:42:56,225 --> 00:43:01,813
Time for another coin. You're going
to place a medium coin on your stack.

640
00:43:01,848 --> 00:43:06,080
These stacks are getting
very high. Take your time.

641
00:43:06,357 --> 00:43:11,261
Here we go. Five, four, three,

642
00:43:11,323 --> 00:43:14,867
two, one.

643
00:43:23,467 --> 00:43:27,623
Fabio's got a little bit
of an angle to his stack.

644
00:43:31,799 --> 00:43:35,665
The next coin you're going
to stack is a large coin.

645
00:43:41,743 --> 00:43:46,560
In five, four, three,

646
00:43:47,035 --> 00:43:50,584
two, one.

647
00:43:51,071 --> 00:43:55,024
Sash drops his coins.
Fabio winds final immunity.

648
00:43:55,059 --> 00:43:57,644
And will go to the final three.

649
00:43:58,101 --> 00:44:02,287
- Good job, Fabio. Excellent work.
- Good job, man.

650
00:44:03,233 --> 00:44:06,179
Excellent work, brother.

651
00:44:07,214 --> 00:44:11,116
- Fabio, come on over.
- Good job, Fabio.

652
00:44:14,721 --> 00:44:17,729
Three times in a row
you've won immunity.

653
00:44:17,764 --> 00:44:20,518
With this around your neck,
you are going to final tribal.

654
00:44:20,519 --> 00:44:23,693
You will get a shot at the
money, a chance to plead your case

655
00:44:23,728 --> 00:44:28,634
as to why you deserve the title of
Sole Survivor and the million dollars.

656
00:44:28,700 --> 00:44:34,205
Sash, Chase, Holly, tonight at tribal
council, one of the three of you

657
00:44:34,207 --> 00:44:37,216
will go home, your shot
at the money will be over.

658
00:44:37,410 --> 00:44:40,294
You will become the
last member of the jury.

659
00:44:40,329 --> 00:44:43,586
I expect a very interesting
afternoon back at camp.

660
00:44:43,621 --> 00:44:48,182
I'll see you tonight at tribal. Grab
your stuff. Get out of here. Congrats.

661
00:45:06,038 --> 00:45:09,816
Good job, Fabio. Three
in a row. You're on fire.

662
00:45:10,242 --> 00:45:11,963
You gotta do what you
gotta do sometimes.

663
00:45:11,964 --> 00:45:14,644
- You earned that.
- I'm loving this, man.

664
00:45:14,645 --> 00:45:18,554
I mean, I won the final immunity
challenge, and I get to come back

665
00:45:18,589 --> 00:45:23,245
to camp and watch the three of
them plead their case for why

666
00:45:23,246 --> 00:45:25,915
<i>I should take them to the final three.</i>

667
00:45:25,991 --> 00:45:30,530
<i>Of course Sash and Chase and Holly
are all nervous, panicky people anyway.</i>

668
00:45:30,967 --> 00:45:33,573
It's going to be fun watching
them sweat about this one.

669
00:45:33,574 --> 00:45:35,787
I'm just going to let it play out.

670
00:45:35,822 --> 00:45:38,737
I wouldn't mind going on a water
run if somebody needs water.

671
00:45:38,738 --> 00:45:42,179
- Do you want to go with me?
- Sure.

672
00:45:44,276 --> 00:45:46,678
Let's go.

673
00:45:53,652 --> 00:45:56,754
Holly has to be nervous now.

674
00:45:57,090 --> 00:45:59,097
- Yeah.
- Yeah.

675
00:45:59,120 --> 00:46:04,233
***** I haven't made up my mind.

676
00:46:06,465 --> 00:46:10,068
- What are you thinking?
- I don't know, man.

677
00:46:10,102 --> 00:46:13,638
I gotta... I gotta think about
things and figure them out.

678
00:46:13,672 --> 00:46:15,073
Right.

679
00:46:15,107 --> 00:46:18,028
<i>I thought we had a perfect plan
of attack to make it all the way</i>

680
00:46:18,063 --> 00:46:20,272
<i>to the final three, and somehow,</i>

681
00:46:20,273 --> 00:46:24,315
Fabio pulls off three
immunity challenges in a row.

682
00:46:24,416 --> 00:46:27,504
So it's a big disaster for me alliance.

683
00:46:27,539 --> 00:46:31,541
<i>Right now, I'm as desperate
as I've been this entire game.</i>

684
00:46:31,757 --> 00:46:35,643
And anything I can do to try and
convince Fabio that I should be

685
00:46:35,678 --> 00:46:37,256
in the final three with him I'll do.

686
00:46:37,463 --> 00:46:40,345
No matter what, tonight
I vote how you vote.

687
00:46:40,571 --> 00:46:43,608
So... Let's run down the jury.

688
00:46:43,838 --> 00:46:48,299
Brenda. I think she'd
probably vote Chase, obviously.

689
00:46:48,406 --> 00:46:51,818
NaOnka. She gave her idol to Chase.

690
00:46:51,853 --> 00:46:53,409
- Yeah.
- Right?

691
00:46:53,479 --> 00:46:56,047
Purple Kelly will probably vote Chase.

692
00:46:56,211 --> 00:47:01,390
- And, you know, if Holly went out...
- Think she'd vote for Chase?

693
00:47:02,560 --> 00:47:04,489
Yup.

694
00:47:05,027 --> 00:47:08,032
Maybe we do need to rethink this.

695
00:47:08,827 --> 00:47:13,031
Yeah, I mean, you know, Chase
has been the one flip-flopping.

696
00:47:13,065 --> 00:47:16,527
It's out of Chase's hands right now.

697
00:47:17,547 --> 00:47:19,436
- Are you okay?
- Yeah.

698
00:47:19,471 --> 00:47:21,572
It just seems like
you're a little on edge.

699
00:47:21,607 --> 00:47:25,234
Well, I feel one of you
guys would have won immunity,

700
00:47:25,750 --> 00:47:30,291
- I would have been the next to go.
- I can't speak for Chase.

701
00:47:30,326 --> 00:47:34,452
- I don't know, you know?
- Would you have taken Holly and Chase?

702
00:47:35,269 --> 00:47:37,107
No.

703
00:47:37,235 --> 00:47:42,571
I feel like you're my best friend
in the game, and I guarantee,

704
00:47:42,595 --> 00:47:46,583
I promise you, I have never
said that to anyone else here.

705
00:47:47,168 --> 00:47:50,071
- I'm serious.
- Yeah?

706
00:47:50,381 --> 00:47:52,457
Cool.

707
00:48:04,412 --> 00:48:06,685
What did you and Sash talk about?

708
00:48:06,720 --> 00:48:09,657
He was trying to add
up the jury and make it

709
00:48:09,658 --> 00:48:12,595
seem like you were going
to get a lot of votes.

710
00:48:13,405 --> 00:48:16,516
- And it was...
- Let's sit down, dude.

711
00:48:16,551 --> 00:48:19,832
<i>I'm pissed that Sash was trying to go
behind my back and trying to get me out.</i>

712
00:48:19,866 --> 00:48:23,293
We promised to each other, Sash
and I did, that we wouldn't go after

713
00:48:23,336 --> 00:48:25,633
each other and he goes after me
like that and starts talking about me

714
00:48:25,639 --> 00:48:27,442
me behind my back, that piss the me off.

715
00:48:27,542 --> 00:48:29,993
<i>Sash will do whatever it takes
to get further in the game.</i>

716
00:48:30,007 --> 00:48:33,312
I always thought that, but
now that Fabio said that,

717
00:48:33,313 --> 00:48:34,872
he's definitely a snake.

718
00:48:34,907 --> 00:48:36,833
What else did he say?

719
00:48:36,891 --> 00:48:42,110
I asked if you had won today
would you have taken me?

720
00:48:42,145 --> 00:48:45,696
He said I can't speak for
Chase, but I would have.

721
00:48:45,976 --> 00:48:47,634
That's ridiculous.

722
00:48:48,840 --> 00:48:51,618
That pisses me off because he's
just been talking to meet whole time

723
00:48:51,653 --> 00:48:54,183
about him, my, and
Holly going to the end.

724
00:48:54,218 --> 00:48:57,728
I knew it. That's what I thought,
man. I had a sneaking suspicion.

725
00:48:57,763 --> 00:49:00,858
I'm not going to lie to you ****

726
00:49:01,188 --> 00:49:07,050
**** Sash is willing to tell anybody
anything and it gets to me, you know.

727
00:49:07,297 --> 00:49:10,896
But at the same time, look
at the position I'm in,

728
00:49:10,931 --> 00:49:14,526
and I'm just laughing like,
dude, I can see right through you,

729
00:49:14,561 --> 00:49:16,096
<i>and you don't think I can.</i>

730
00:49:16,131 --> 00:49:18,555
<i>And I go back to Chase, and I tell him,</i>

731
00:49:18,556 --> 00:49:20,979
<i>and he's immediately
selling Sash out to me.</i>

732
00:49:21,014 --> 00:49:25,102
It's almost like I just walked
into a kitchen, turned the lights on

733
00:49:25,137 --> 00:49:28,095
and all these little cockroaches
are trying to scam bell to get out

734
00:49:28,130 --> 00:49:31,213
of the way and throw somebody
else under the bus, you know?

735
00:49:31,248 --> 00:49:35,505
I mean, would you have taken
me to the final three, honestly?

736
00:49:37,455 --> 00:49:41,230
If they would have said today,
if you wouldn't have won today,

737
00:49:41,440 --> 00:49:44,241
I honestly think it would
be me, Holly, and Sash.

738
00:49:45,225 --> 00:49:49,538
- So did I, man. I knew it.
- Straight up with you.

739
00:49:49,593 --> 00:49:53,162
Yup. That's what I thought.

740
00:50:03,728 --> 00:50:06,745
Well, Fabio, you know, I'm
not going to lie to you.

741
00:50:06,780 --> 00:50:09,667
The three of us were in an alliance,
and we wanted to go to the end.

742
00:50:09,702 --> 00:50:13,279
I don't know if Chase told you that,
but I just want to plead my case to you.

743
00:50:13,314 --> 00:50:16,362
I know it's going to
be your final decision,

744
00:50:16,397 --> 00:50:20,024
- but Sash has played a tremendous game.
- Yeah.

745
00:50:20,059 --> 00:50:24,426
Strategically, he's
played very, very well.

746
00:50:24,461 --> 00:50:27,305
And I just want you to really
seriously think about it.

747
00:50:27,340 --> 00:50:28,825
She has a pretty good point.

748
00:50:28,860 --> 00:50:30,787
It's just something that you
really need to think about,

749
00:50:30,822 --> 00:50:35,446
because when it comes down
to votes, that could be huge.

750
00:50:35,572 --> 00:50:37,478
Could be Dangerous.

751
00:50:37,513 --> 00:50:40,298
<i>Sash and Chase have lied to
me the whole time saying we</i>

752
00:50:40,333 --> 00:50:42,156
<i>Would go to the final three together.</i>

753
00:50:42,191 --> 00:50:47,016
And now I really feel like I almost
don't want to take either of them.

754
00:50:47,051 --> 00:50:51,252
<i>Holly's actually the only one that
hasn't lied or done anything to me.</i>

755
00:50:51,287 --> 00:50:54,748
- I have respected you this whole game.
- Yeah, and I've respected you a lot.

756
00:50:54,783 --> 00:50:58,411
Yeah. I'm just trying to think
about who is on the jury and how

757
00:50:58,446 --> 00:51:01,840
people have played the game and the
relationships they've had with them.

758
00:51:01,875 --> 00:51:05,254
And, you know, and who would
take votes away from me.

759
00:51:06,093 --> 00:51:09,292
And, also, who deserves
to go to the final three.

760
00:51:09,327 --> 00:51:11,459
Who I want there, you know.

761
00:51:11,494 --> 00:51:14,643
<i>I feel like Holly has played a pretty
good game and she does deserve to go to</i>

762
00:51:14,678 --> 00:51:19,590
the final three, but then again,
she might deserve jury votes, too.

763
00:51:19,625 --> 00:51:24,762
So I've got a big decision to
make on who I want to take and

764
00:51:24,797 --> 00:51:27,596
<i>is it going to cost me
a million dollars or not?</i>

765
00:51:27,631 --> 00:51:32,191
<i>So my head's definitely
spinning, you know, at this point.</i>

766
00:51:58,510 --> 00:52:01,599
We'll now bring in the
members of our jury.

767
00:52:03,950 --> 00:52:07,519
Alina. Marty. Brenda.

768
00:52:07,629 --> 00:52:11,547
NaOnka. Purple Kelly. Benry.

769
00:52:11,682 --> 00:52:16,874
Jane. And Dan, voted out
at the last tribal council.

770
00:52:18,131 --> 00:52:21,116
Fabio, you look like
you're holding it in.

771
00:52:21,151 --> 00:52:24,060
Yeah, man. I feel great right now.

772
00:52:24,095 --> 00:52:27,165
We haven't even said a word
and you're just bursting.

773
00:52:27,200 --> 00:52:30,787
Yeah, I'm pretty excited, man.
This is final tribal council,

774
00:52:30,822 --> 00:52:34,259
and I have the necklace on
and that's a good feeling.

775
00:52:34,347 --> 00:52:36,414
Must have been a fun afternoon for you.

776
00:52:36,415 --> 00:52:39,204
I'm guessing everybody
wanted to talk to Fabio.

777
00:52:39,311 --> 00:52:41,231
Yeah, it was pretty funny.

778
00:52:41,327 --> 00:52:44,831
You know, the past couple of days
I definitely have felt on the outs.

779
00:52:44,832 --> 00:52:48,271
It was funny to watch a
three-person alliance each give

780
00:52:48,272 --> 00:52:51,276
their own angle of why
they should be coming.

781
00:52:51,297 --> 00:52:54,972
- It was a fun afternoon, yes.
- What was Sash's approach?

782
00:52:55,007 --> 00:52:57,111
Sash was the first person to talk to me.

783
00:52:57,136 --> 00:52:59,645
You know, he immediately said,
"who do you want to take?"

784
00:52:59,680 --> 00:53:03,256
And I asked him if one of
you guys would have won today,

785
00:53:03,291 --> 00:53:06,169
would you have taken
me, because that was

786
00:53:06,170 --> 00:53:09,047
the agreement that us
three guys had come to.

787
00:53:09,082 --> 00:53:12,366
And he said, "yeah, you
know, for sure, definitely."

788
00:53:12,812 --> 00:53:17,525
But there was a part of me that,
you know, kind of saw through that.

789
00:53:17,560 --> 00:53:20,332
- You didn't buy it.
- No.

790
00:53:20,593 --> 00:53:22,298
How about Chase?

791
00:53:22,333 --> 00:53:25,745
Chase and I had a good conversation,
and I asked Chase as well,

792
00:53:25,780 --> 00:53:29,005
"if one of you guys would have won,
would you have taken me for real?"

793
00:53:29,153 --> 00:53:34,850
And he said, "probably not"
And I said, "I knew it."

794
00:53:34,941 --> 00:53:38,209
Because they asked me to
give them my word on a plan,

795
00:53:38,301 --> 00:53:43,550
and I didn't really get anything in
return, so it was... It was interesting.

796
00:53:43,953 --> 00:53:48,954
Sash, we get back from the challenge,
you go to Fabio. What's your plead?

797
00:53:48,988 --> 00:53:52,953
I go to Fabio and I tell him
that something we've been

798
00:53:53,255 --> 00:53:57,726
talking about for a while now,
and who would probably carry

799
00:53:57,761 --> 00:54:01,268
more jury votes than... Than others.

800
00:54:01,269 --> 00:54:04,330
Now, Fabio's going to tell
you that he talked to Chase

801
00:54:04,331 --> 00:54:08,319
- and Chase says that's BS.
- Truth is, Jeff, I've had many

802
00:54:08,841 --> 00:54:10,595
alliances with many
different people in this game.

803
00:54:10,667 --> 00:54:15,795
And I'm not afraid to admit that,
and I think over the past few days,

804
00:54:15,830 --> 00:54:19,780
I've been more committal
to you than Chase has.

805
00:54:19,815 --> 00:54:23,130
So right now, if you had won
today, would you have taken me

806
00:54:23,165 --> 00:54:25,408
to the final three like
we had talked about?

807
00:54:27,837 --> 00:54:30,929
I believe I would have.

808
00:54:31,291 --> 00:54:34,332
Wait, you believe you would
have or you would have?

809
00:54:34,367 --> 00:54:38,052
Well, I didn't have the idol, so I
didn't have to make that decision.

810
00:54:40,132 --> 00:54:43,041
- But I...
- That's what I'm talking about.

811
00:54:43,177 --> 00:54:44,390
You know?

812
00:54:44,425 --> 00:54:47,010
It's true that I did make an
alliance with Chase and Holly.

813
00:54:47,146 --> 00:54:49,325
I did make an alliance with Fabio.

814
00:54:49,360 --> 00:54:54,561
I promised two different group of people
if I won I would take them to the end.

815
00:54:54,854 --> 00:54:57,823
Holly, what was your pitch to Fabio?

816
00:54:57,858 --> 00:55:00,181
Fabio and I were sitting
in the hut, first of all,

817
00:55:00,182 --> 00:55:02,505
I told him that I was very proud of him,

818
00:55:02,506 --> 00:55:07,587
and I told him number-wise,
Sash was a huge threat.

819
00:55:07,622 --> 00:55:10,170
And he should be the next one to go.

820
00:55:10,658 --> 00:55:13,093
He also asked me if I
wouldn't have won today

821
00:55:13,094 --> 00:55:15,528
would I have been voted
out tonight and I said yes.

822
00:55:15,614 --> 00:55:18,962
So you also told Fabio you
would have voted him out?

823
00:55:18,963 --> 00:55:20,647
Yes, I was honest.

824
00:55:20,682 --> 00:55:24,021
So that means the only
person in question is Sash

825
00:55:24,056 --> 00:55:26,317
when he told you, "no, I
would have stuck with you."

826
00:55:26,388 --> 00:55:27,765
Yeah.

827
00:55:27,800 --> 00:55:33,171
So now, Fabio, the decision becomes
who do I want to sit next to at the end?

828
00:55:33,605 --> 00:55:37,915
Yeah, you know, after hearing today
that the whole plan we talked about

829
00:55:37,950 --> 00:55:41,135
and the agreement we were
under wasn't true, you know,

830
00:55:41,170 --> 00:55:43,309
I feel like I do have
the right to take whoever.

831
00:55:43,344 --> 00:55:45,573
I don't have to uphold that anymore.

832
00:55:46,370 --> 00:55:51,101
All right, before we get to the vote,
Sash, your last chance to pitch Fabio.

833
00:55:52,015 --> 00:55:54,801
Fabio, we've been in
this since the beginning.

834
00:55:54,836 --> 00:55:59,449
I believe I've been the most
honest and most committed to you.

835
00:55:59,484 --> 00:56:03,717
I hope that my options reflect that.

836
00:56:04,017 --> 00:56:07,669
Chase, your last chance. Lay it out.

837
00:56:09,001 --> 00:56:13,185
Fabio, the most honest and committed
to you, kind of came out tonight.

838
00:56:13,462 --> 00:56:16,129
I was pretty damn honest with you. So...

839
00:56:16,164 --> 00:56:20,191
Yeah, yeah, you know.
At the very last second.

840
00:56:20,226 --> 00:56:23,242
You were pretty honest with
me at the very last second.

841
00:56:23,555 --> 00:56:26,159
So, yeah, I would agree.

842
00:56:26,194 --> 00:56:28,160
All right, Holly, your last chance.

843
00:56:28,580 --> 00:56:31,780
I was very honest with you this
afternoon, and I was honest...

844
00:56:31,815 --> 00:56:33,739
I said we wouldn't have
taken you in our alliance.

845
00:56:33,774 --> 00:56:37,599
And I'm glad you respect me and think
highly of me. That means a lot to me.

846
00:56:37,634 --> 00:56:39,393
Good, thank you, Holly.

847
00:56:39,673 --> 00:56:43,752
All right, Fabio, well,
there are certainly arguments

848
00:56:43,753 --> 00:56:47,832
working for and against
Holly, Chase, and Sash.

849
00:56:47,867 --> 00:56:51,825
It could very well be a
million-dollar decision.

850
00:56:52,019 --> 00:56:56,330
Fabio has immunity. I don't have
to ask. You cannot vote for Fabio.

851
00:56:56,550 --> 00:57:02,456
Everybody else is fair game. It
is time to vote. Holly, you're up.

852
00:57:44,038 --> 00:57:46,796
I'll go tally the votes.

853
00:57:55,534 --> 00:57:57,530
Once the vote are read,
the decision is final.

854
00:57:57,536 --> 00:58:00,613
The person voted out will be asked to
leave the tribal council immediately.

855
00:58:00,614 --> 00:58:03,121
I'll read the votes.

856
00:58:06,632 --> 00:58:09,824
First vote, Sash.

857
00:58:14,896 --> 00:58:17,718
Holly. One vote Holly.

858
00:58:19,656 --> 00:58:25,284
Holly. Two votes Holly, one
vote Sash. One vote left.

859
00:58:27,372 --> 00:58:31,468
15th person voted out and the ninth
and final member of our jury, Holly.

860
00:58:31,469 --> 00:58:34,404
You need to bring me your torch.

861
00:58:43,082 --> 00:58:46,064
Holly, the tribe has spoken.

862
00:58:47,618 --> 00:58:50,686
Time for you to go.

863
00:58:59,559 --> 00:59:04,184
Well, congratulations. You've gone
as far as you can go in this game.

864
00:59:04,356 --> 00:59:09,511
The power shifts to the jury,
nine people that you had a hand

865
00:59:09,512 --> 00:59:11,725
either directly or
indirectly in voting out,

866
00:59:11,726 --> 00:59:14,237
will now hold your fate in their hands.

867
00:59:14,360 --> 00:59:17,599
I suggest you start thinking
about what you're going to say

868
00:59:17,600 --> 00:59:21,008
to convince these guys that
you're the one deserving of the

869
00:59:21,009 --> 00:59:24,333
title of Sole Survivor and
the million-dollar check.

870
00:59:24,356 --> 00:59:27,993
Grab your torches. Head
back to camp. Good night.

871
00:59:34,533 --> 00:59:37,335
Day five, I wanted to
walk away from this game.

872
00:59:37,369 --> 00:59:41,783
<i>Here I am making it through
day 38, so never give up.</i>

873
00:59:41,818 --> 00:59:46,645
One thing I know is that my family
and my true friends back home

874
00:59:46,680 --> 00:59:49,405
are going to be truly proud of me.

875
01:00:02,699 --> 01:00:05,000
- Hey-O!
- Oh, yeah.

876
01:00:05,034 --> 01:00:09,436
On a scale of one to 10
I am about a 10 right now.

877
01:00:09,780 --> 01:00:13,943
<i>It took me 38 days to finally
get into a powerful position</i>

878
01:00:13,944 --> 01:00:15,668
<i>but now I'm finally here.</i>

879
01:00:15,703 --> 01:00:19,235
Fabio, I appreciate it, man.
You made that happen.

880
01:00:19,481 --> 01:00:22,976
<i>Tonight, I brought the heat a
little bit, kind of upset the stage,</i>

881
01:00:23,011 --> 01:00:26,293
<i>because putting Sash against
Chase lets the jury know</i>

882
01:00:26,328 --> 01:00:28,648
I really awear of what's going on.

883
01:00:28,683 --> 01:00:31,681
- It's like we said.
- Final three, baby!

884
01:00:31,716 --> 01:00:34,310
I still feel like I have a
bit more to say tomorrow night

885
01:00:34,345 --> 01:00:37,178
and I think the jury is
going to be receptive to it.

886
01:00:37,213 --> 01:00:40,240
You were the underdog,
you know. They loved it.

887
01:00:40,275 --> 01:00:43,687
And I gotta say, you
sure as hell earned it.

888
01:00:43,722 --> 01:00:46,930
We all kind of fought for our
lives tonight, and it was almost

889
01:00:46,965 --> 01:00:50,202
like we were fighting for our lives and
Fabio could say whatever he wanted to.

890
01:00:50,237 --> 01:00:53,630
<i>But guns will be blazing
tomorrow. I'm excited to, you know,</i>

891
01:00:53,665 --> 01:00:55,884
bring my thoughts tomorrow
now that I know I'm safe.

892
01:00:55,918 --> 01:00:58,647
I'm proud of all of
us, man, that's awesome.

893
01:00:58,655 --> 01:01:01,790
- We all deserve it.
- That's great.

894
01:01:02,478 --> 01:01:03,818
Awesome.

895
01:01:03,853 --> 01:01:06,466
I got called out on pretty
much everything in this game

896
01:01:06,501 --> 01:01:12,495
from not keeping alliances to
flip-flopping to switching votes around,

897
01:01:12,630 --> 01:01:16,298
<i>and between being unsure whether
or not I was going home tonight</i>

898
01:01:16,333 --> 01:01:19,590
and being called out, it was
really a double whammy for me.

899
01:01:19,625 --> 01:01:23,625
I wanted us three to be sitting at
breakfast just smiling at each other.

900
01:01:23,713 --> 01:01:25,739
- We wanted that, too.
- Yeah.

901
01:01:25,774 --> 01:01:29,629
The only problem was, you know, you get
in an alliance, you don't want to break.

902
01:01:30,380 --> 01:01:31,480
Yeah.

903
01:01:31,515 --> 01:01:34,086
But tonight, thanks to
you, we had to break it.

904
01:01:34,121 --> 01:01:35,190
Yeah.

905
01:01:35,191 --> 01:01:40,944
<i>Fabio and Chase, I really don't think
they deserve to be in the final three</i>

906
01:01:40,979 --> 01:01:45,853
because I really do feel as though
I've played the best strategic game.

907
01:01:45,888 --> 01:01:50,642
To end up with two guys
who are just awesome.

908
01:01:51,195 --> 01:01:53,127
My two wingmen.

909
01:01:53,435 --> 01:01:56,817
Sash goes, "I'd be honored for
you guys to be my wingman."

910
01:01:56,852 --> 01:01:59,552
I'm like, "Sash, dude,
you can take a backseat.

911
01:01:59,859 --> 01:02:04,874
I want to you take notes on how this is
going to go because its going to be fun.

912
01:02:28,811 --> 01:02:33,481
<i>Day 39, man. This has
been an awesome journey.</i>

913
01:02:33,916 --> 01:02:37,278
<i>And I loved every part of it, you know.</i>

914
01:02:37,313 --> 01:02:41,161
I've envisioned this day for a long
time, and now it's actually here.

915
01:02:41,196 --> 01:02:43,353
It's day freaking 39, baby!

916
01:02:43,388 --> 01:02:46,428
And this is probably the
most important day of my life.

917
01:02:46,463 --> 01:02:48,797
This is, like, 39 days of exhaustion.

918
01:02:48,832 --> 01:02:52,239
This is about the
furthest I could go, man.

919
01:02:52,274 --> 01:02:53,819
- Yeah.
- Oh, yeah.

920
01:02:53,854 --> 01:02:57,472
Dude. I see champagne bottles!

921
01:02:57,673 --> 01:03:00,742
Pancake mix! Syrup!

922
01:03:02,713 --> 01:03:05,036
- Final three, baby!
- That's right.

923
01:03:05,071 --> 01:03:06,761
Final three.

924
01:03:06,982 --> 01:03:12,930
<i>We're literally starving, and the day
39 breakfast is such a special treat.</i>

925
01:03:13,190 --> 01:03:17,202
<i>To wake up, have everything
presented in front of me is just</i>

926
01:03:17,237 --> 01:03:20,873
overwarming to all the senses
and the food just heightenes

927
01:03:20,908 --> 01:03:23,514
<i>that great feeling you have from within.</i>

928
01:03:24,323 --> 01:03:26,366
I've been waiting so
long for this, guys.

929
01:03:26,401 --> 01:03:30,973
<i>Tonight I go to battle with
Chase and Fabio to try and win</i>

930
01:03:31,008 --> 01:03:33,572
<i>the title of Sole Survivor
and the million dollars.</i>

931
01:03:33,607 --> 01:03:37,159
<i>But they've also been allies of
mine, which have helped me get</i>

932
01:03:37,194 --> 01:03:41,233
to where I'm at today, so we're
best of friends and worst of enemies.

933
01:03:41,268 --> 01:03:43,506
You guys, we're going to remember
this for the rest of our lives.

934
01:03:43,571 --> 01:03:45,612
This couldn't be a better final three.

935
01:03:45,747 --> 01:03:47,922
<i>There's a lot of talk about
being happy, being together.</i>

936
01:03:47,957 --> 01:03:50,710
I mean, I'm happy to be with these
guys. I'm happy to be final three,

937
01:03:50,745 --> 01:03:52,379
but for me it's completely false.

938
01:03:54,919 --> 01:03:56,503
<i>I'm still working the
game right now trying</i>

939
01:03:56,504 --> 01:03:58,088
<i>to figure out how I'm
going to beat these guys.</i>

940
01:03:58,168 --> 01:03:59,796
How do you think tonight
is going to go, man?

941
01:03:59,797 --> 01:04:03,167
I think note matter, god's honest
truth, you just won a million dollars.

942
01:04:03,168 --> 01:04:04,217
Yeah? Prossibly.

943
01:04:04,218 --> 01:04:07,703
<i>I keep telling Fabio
that he's going to win and</i>

944
01:04:07,704 --> 01:04:12,567
<i>congratulations but in my mind I'm
still trying to beat him and I want</i>

945
01:04:12,602 --> 01:04:15,930
<i>to get it in his head that he's got
it and get him a little over-confident.</i>

946
01:04:15,959 --> 01:04:19,373
If I can get him a little ove
over-confident, that can help me.

947
01:04:29,732 --> 01:04:31,780
This is a really great moment.

948
01:04:32,481 --> 01:04:36,229
Gotta take it all in,
one last time, baby.

949
01:04:36,264 --> 01:04:38,831
Great memories.

950
01:04:39,342 --> 01:04:43,224
Well, I guess we gotta go get ready.

951
01:04:43,277 --> 01:04:46,679
<i>It's time to shift gears and
focus on tonight's tribal council</i>

952
01:04:46,714 --> 01:04:50,098
<i>because if you're not completely
in it to win it tonight,</i>

953
01:04:50,195 --> 01:04:52,251
you're going to miss your
chance at a million dollars,

954
01:04:52,286 --> 01:04:55,297
<i>and those are the largest
stakes I've ever played for.</i>

955
01:04:55,332 --> 01:04:59,033
<i>So, I'm going to go into this
last tribal council swinging.</i>

956
01:04:59,068 --> 01:05:00,512
You ready, Fabio?

957
01:05:00,547 --> 01:05:04,189
Let's each grab a
torch and put it on in.

958
01:05:05,417 --> 01:05:07,939
<i>I'm definitely nervous
about facing the jury</i>

959
01:05:07,940 --> 01:05:10,462
tonight because I did
a lot of backstabbing.

960
01:05:10,539 --> 01:05:14,909
I've made a lot of alliancees
that I wasn't able to keep.

961
01:05:14,944 --> 01:05:18,732
<i>So I'm going to the final tribal
council tonight hoping to put</i>

962
01:05:18,767 --> 01:05:22,827
<i>everything out on the table and
be 100% truthful because I think</i>

963
01:05:22,862 --> 01:05:26,097
that's the only way I'm going to
have an opportunity to win their vote.

964
01:05:26,684 --> 01:05:29,629
- Burn.
- Hey!

965
01:05:30,765 --> 01:05:32,829
There goes the tarp.

966
01:05:33,024 --> 01:05:37,011
- Worked so hard for those.
- She is on fire.

967
01:05:37,046 --> 01:05:41,239
<i>Tonight, I am the underdog going
in. I've got to pull off an upset.</i>

968
01:05:41,274 --> 01:05:44,290
<i>I think the main differences
in mine and Fabio's game was I</i>

969
01:05:44,325 --> 01:05:46,314
actually did have
relationships with these people.

970
01:05:46,349 --> 01:05:48,332
I think that could help me definitely.

971
01:05:48,367 --> 01:05:50,208
I think I played a
better game than Sash.

972
01:05:50,666 --> 01:05:54,522
- Libertad.
- Let it burn, baby!

973
01:05:54,857 --> 01:05:57,962
<i>I had a huge target on my back from
the beginning as a physical threat.</i>

974
01:05:57,997 --> 01:05:59,891
<i>And I'm still here at the end.</i>

975
01:05:59,926 --> 01:06:01,817
<i>Obviously, that means
I did something right...</i>

976
01:06:01,818 --> 01:06:04,453
so I'm going into tribal council
tonight like it is a battle...

977
01:06:04,493 --> 01:06:08,805
<i>because I didn't come out here
playing for second place in this game.</i>

978
01:06:44,733 --> 01:06:47,724
We'll now bring in our jury.

979
01:06:52,107 --> 01:06:56,411
Alina. Marty. Brenda.

980
01:06:56,445 --> 01:07:00,559
NaOnka. Purple Kelly. Benry.

981
01:07:00,761 --> 01:07:06,670
Jane, Dan, and Holly, voted
out at the last tribal council.

982
01:07:08,092 --> 01:07:12,276
All right, Chase, Fabio,
Sash. Congratulations.

983
01:07:12,484 --> 01:07:16,653
You lasted 39 days. You've gone
as far as you can go in this game.

984
01:07:16,688 --> 01:07:19,392
Tonight, the power shifts to the jury.

985
01:07:19,427 --> 01:07:24,127
Nine people that you played alongside
hold your fate in their hands.

986
01:07:24,162 --> 01:07:27,573
Tonight they will make a
million-dollar decision.

987
01:07:28,371 --> 01:07:29,575
Here's how it's going to work.

988
01:07:29,610 --> 01:07:32,029
You will each get a chance
to make an opening statement.

989
01:07:32,064 --> 01:07:36,410
Then the jury will get their first
chance to address you, then we vote.

990
01:07:37,643 --> 01:07:41,833
Let's get to the opening
statements. Chase, you're up first.

991
01:07:42,187 --> 01:07:46,470
First of all, obviously, I want to thank
you all for getting me to where I am.

992
01:07:46,505 --> 01:07:48,696
It's truly an honor to play the
game with every single one of you.

993
01:07:48,730 --> 01:07:50,565
It's been an honor. You all know that.

994
01:07:50,599 --> 01:07:53,489
Having said, that tonight,
bring on the questions.

995
01:07:53,524 --> 01:07:54,912
I want to you bring on the questions.

996
01:07:54,947 --> 01:07:57,371
I'm looking forward to each and
every one of you bringing on questions

997
01:07:57,406 --> 01:07:59,195
because I know that some
of you are pissed at me,

998
01:07:59,230 --> 01:08:01,589
and a lot of you said
I played a crazy game.

999
01:08:01,624 --> 01:08:03,648
I've gone back and forth.
I've been wishy-washy.

1000
01:08:03,683 --> 01:08:07,062
I want to say bring it on and I
will be completely honest with you

1001
01:08:07,115 --> 01:08:10,056
and tell you exactly what happened
and why I did some of the things

1002
01:08:10,091 --> 01:08:12,560
I did in this game so
bring it on. Let's go.

1003
01:08:12,907 --> 01:08:15,603
All right, Fabio. You're up.

1004
01:08:15,661 --> 01:08:18,201
I also want to say they
enjoyed each one of you.

1005
01:08:18,236 --> 01:08:20,025
I think we all had a lot of good times.

1006
01:08:20,060 --> 01:08:24,273
Part of my strategy was to be myself
to the fullest, be an open book.

1007
01:08:24,308 --> 01:08:27,290
I knew that I was in the clear a
lot of time, and when it came down

1008
01:08:27,325 --> 01:08:31,701
to the end and I really needed to assert
myself you know, I felt like I did that.

1009
01:08:31,736 --> 01:08:34,239
And winning three immunity
challenges in a row, that's...

1010
01:08:34,274 --> 01:08:38,184
That was survival mode, you know. And
I deserve to be in the final three.

1011
01:08:38,219 --> 01:08:42,436
I played a stand-up game. I don't
think I backstabbed any of you guys,

1012
01:08:42,471 --> 01:08:47,073
and I just think I deserve a million
dollars. I could have a lot of fun.

1013
01:08:48,781 --> 01:08:51,071
- Sash, you're up.
- Thanks, Jeff.

1014
01:08:51,106 --> 01:08:53,246
I really enjoyed playing
the game with everyone.

1015
01:08:53,281 --> 01:08:57,126
And I played much differently
than both Chase and Fabio.

1016
01:08:57,161 --> 01:09:01,407
Really, there are three components
to win the title of Sole Survivor.

1017
01:09:01,442 --> 01:09:03,371
That's outwit, outplay, and outlast.

1018
01:09:03,406 --> 01:09:07,870
All three of us were
able to outlast to day 39.

1019
01:09:07,905 --> 01:09:12,371
So, really, tonight's vote comes down
to strategy and who is able to outwit...

1020
01:09:12,406 --> 01:09:13,985
and outplay.

1021
01:09:14,020 --> 01:09:17,950
Lastly, I just wanted everyone
to upon that the friendships

1022
01:09:17,985 --> 01:09:22,272
that I formed, I take much more
seriously than the actual alliances.

1023
01:09:22,307 --> 01:09:23,935
Alliances are part of the game,

1024
01:09:23,947 --> 01:09:26,768
and I'm sorry if some of
the alliances were broken.

1025
01:09:26,803 --> 01:09:30,707
But that was part of the game.
And I hope you respect me for that.

1026
01:09:31,949 --> 01:09:35,171
All right, jury, you're
about to get your first chance

1027
01:09:35,206 --> 01:09:39,473
to address Chase, Fabio, and Sash.

1028
01:09:39,508 --> 01:09:43,504
I'll give you a moment to think
about what you want to say.

1029
01:09:50,848 --> 01:09:53,869
All right, jury, some of
you have waited a long time

1030
01:09:53,904 --> 01:09:58,988
for the opportunity to
grill Chase, Fabio, and Sash.

1031
01:09:59,080 --> 01:10:04,786
Your job tonight, gather information
to help you make a million-dollar vote.

1032
01:10:04,863 --> 01:10:08,547
Let's get started.
Brenda, you're up first.

1033
01:10:09,709 --> 01:10:13,193
Hey, guys. Congratulations.

1034
01:10:13,228 --> 01:10:16,083
I am really, really,
really proud of you guys.

1035
01:10:16,118 --> 01:10:18,833
Sash, I really enjoyed playing with you.

1036
01:10:18,911 --> 01:10:23,757
You were a great strategist, to make
alliances and then break all of them

1037
01:10:23,792 --> 01:10:26,423
and then having to ask and
expect votes for the jury.

1038
01:10:26,458 --> 01:10:29,853
It was very difficult and that's
why I want to start off and say...

1039
01:10:29,854 --> 01:10:31,996
I am remorseful.

1040
01:10:32,103 --> 01:10:37,852
I did have to backstab nine people,
but I hope people can see that

1041
01:10:37,887 --> 01:10:40,851
what happened in the
game was part of strategy,

1042
01:10:40,852 --> 01:10:46,245
and my friendship is something
different, and I apologize.

1043
01:10:46,691 --> 01:10:51,215
Thanks, Sash. Chase, my snuggle buddy.

1044
01:10:52,456 --> 01:10:57,627
I felt like I had more of an
emotional attachment to you since,

1045
01:10:57,662 --> 01:11:01,007
you know, you would always tell
me that you trusted me the most,

1046
01:11:01,042 --> 01:11:03,038
and that you could never vote for me.

1047
01:11:03,097 --> 01:11:08,267
And it was really shocking how
easy it was for you the day that

1048
01:11:08,302 --> 01:11:10,320
I got voted out to
just kind of accept it.

1049
01:11:10,355 --> 01:11:12,121
No, I did put my neck
on the line for you.

1050
01:11:12,156 --> 01:11:15,943
As soon as, you know, the other alliance
was talking about voting you out,

1051
01:11:15,978 --> 01:11:19,031
what was the first thing I
did? I came to you and I said:

1052
01:11:19,066 --> 01:11:21,625
"listen, this is what Holly is
trying to do with this alliance."

1053
01:11:21,660 --> 01:11:25,145
I, obviously, don't want to do that.
I trust you the most, which I did,

1054
01:11:25,146 --> 01:11:28,131
so I thought the best thing to do
was go out and get a sixth person.

1055
01:11:28,132 --> 01:11:31,499
What happened is Fabio
and NaOnka backed out.

1056
01:11:31,534 --> 01:11:36,825
- That gave me absolutely no option.
- ***

1057
01:11:36,860 --> 01:11:38,780
*** up more.

1058
01:11:38,815 --> 01:11:41,795
- What could I have done?
- You, too, Sash, don't even start.

1059
01:11:41,830 --> 01:11:44,447
You could have stepped up, too.
You could have given me the idol.

1060
01:11:44,482 --> 01:11:47,223
I could have kept on going if
you could have given it to me.

1061
01:11:48,175 --> 01:11:49,398
I think I'm good.

1062
01:11:49,433 --> 01:11:51,478
- Thanks, Brenda.
- Thanks, guys.

1063
01:11:52,321 --> 01:11:54,648
Marty, you're up.

1064
01:11:55,456 --> 01:11:57,815
Guys, what can I say?

1065
01:11:57,850 --> 01:12:01,749
There's real good reasons why
you guys are there and we're here,

1066
01:12:01,784 --> 01:12:05,199
so hats off to you guys. It's got to
be an incredible feeling for you guys.

1067
01:12:05,234 --> 01:12:08,439
- Appreciate it.
- Chase, play this out with me, okay.

1068
01:12:08,474 --> 01:12:09,577
Okay.

1069
01:12:09,612 --> 01:12:13,698
"Survivor: Nicaragua," there's going to
be dumber than a bag of hammers award.

1070
01:12:13,733 --> 01:12:15,255
- Okay?
- Okay.

1071
01:12:15,290 --> 01:12:17,451
You have to pick somebody. Okay.

1072
01:12:17,486 --> 01:12:22,209
It can be one of you three or
it can be somebody on the jury.

1073
01:12:22,567 --> 01:12:26,504
The only caveat, obviously, I'm
not eligible for the award, okay.

1074
01:12:26,539 --> 01:12:28,004
So you can't vote for me.

1075
01:12:28,039 --> 01:12:32,126
Who do you pick for the dumber
than a bag of hammers this year?

1076
01:12:32,161 --> 01:12:34,573
Well, obviously, I'm not
going to pick any one of us

1077
01:12:34,608 --> 01:12:37,520
because we're sitting up here
and y'all are over there...

1078
01:12:37,555 --> 01:12:39,457
Clearly, that's how I started
out talking to you guys.

1079
01:12:39,492 --> 01:12:42,275
I think this is bind of a B.S.
question because I can't pick you.

1080
01:12:42,310 --> 01:12:45,024
Sorry, man, I made the rules. *****.

1081
01:12:45,059 --> 01:12:46,914
Do I have to answer
this question because

1082
01:12:46,915 --> 01:12:48,769
I don't think anyone is, except for you.

1083
01:12:48,804 --> 01:12:51,698
That's cool, all right. If
you don't choose to answer,

1084
01:12:51,733 --> 01:12:54,397
that's totally your
option. My man, Sash.

1085
01:12:54,432 --> 01:12:57,355
You know I think you're
a cerebral player...

1086
01:12:57,820 --> 01:13:00,577
- Chase, that means smart, but anyway...
- I appreciate that one.

1087
01:13:00,612 --> 01:13:02,260
I think you've been a solid strategist.

1088
01:13:02,261 --> 01:13:06,895
We spent a good time talking
about stuff, and, Fabio...

1089
01:13:06,930 --> 01:13:08,342
- What's up.
- Dude.

1090
01:13:08,377 --> 01:13:09,613
Dude.

1091
01:13:09,648 --> 01:13:12,765
I think you've changed the most
as a person and as a player.

1092
01:13:12,800 --> 01:13:15,927
Congratulations again especially
winning three immunities in a row.

1093
01:13:15,962 --> 01:13:17,946
- Thank you, man. Thanks, guys.
- Thanks buddy.

1094
01:13:17,981 --> 01:13:19,551
- Good luck.
- Thanks, Marty.

1095
01:13:20,351 --> 01:13:22,895
Holly, you're up.

1096
01:13:25,429 --> 01:13:30,756
Chase, what do you consider
your best strategical move

1097
01:13:30,875 --> 01:13:34,210
that you made on your own in this game?

1098
01:13:34,245 --> 01:13:35,752
It was in the very
beginning of the game.

1099
01:13:35,787 --> 01:13:38,741
I had a chance to go with
people that I didn't trust

1100
01:13:38,776 --> 01:13:41,285
and an alliance of six versus four,

1101
01:13:41,320 --> 01:13:43,885
or I had a chance to go with
four people they could trust.

1102
01:13:43,920 --> 01:13:47,171
I took that chance in the beginning.
That was to vote Shannon out.

1103
01:13:47,206 --> 01:13:49,362
That was the biggest move
for me in the game because

1104
01:13:49,363 --> 01:13:51,519
it allowed me to play
with people I could trust.

1105
01:13:51,554 --> 01:13:52,753
Okay.

1106
01:13:52,788 --> 01:13:57,031
Fabio, do you think winning the
last three immunity challenges

1107
01:13:57,066 --> 01:14:01,224
- was too little, too late?
- No, I think it was actually

1108
01:14:01,259 --> 01:14:04,479
the best timing possible.

1109
01:14:04,514 --> 01:14:07,558
I knew that there was going to be
no way that people would take me

1110
01:14:07,593 --> 01:14:11,033
to the final three because my whole
plan was to be friends with everybody.

1111
01:14:11,068 --> 01:14:13,709
Winning the challenges
was the only option I had.

1112
01:14:13,744 --> 01:14:18,286
I don't think it was too little, too
late. I think it was, right on time.

1113
01:14:18,612 --> 01:14:23,944
Okay. Sash, did you ever lie to me?

1114
01:14:24,282 --> 01:14:28,203
- Honestly, be honest, very honest.
- Yes, I lied to you.

1115
01:14:29,403 --> 01:14:33,685
You and I both made a commitment that we
would never put each other's names down.

1116
01:14:33,720 --> 01:14:37,101
And, unfortunately, on the last
vote, you and I both had to vote

1117
01:14:37,136 --> 01:14:40,963
against each other, and
I apologize to you for...

1118
01:14:40,998 --> 01:14:44,342
having to do that at the
end of the game. I'm sorry.

1119
01:14:44,377 --> 01:14:48,677
I truly respect you guys.
I had a great time. Thanks.

1120
01:14:49,179 --> 01:14:50,951
Thank you.

1121
01:14:50,986 --> 01:14:52,717
Jane.

1122
01:14:53,894 --> 01:14:58,063
Hello, everybody. All right, tonight I'm
going to start my questions with Sash.

1123
01:14:58,319 --> 01:15:01,086
All I have to say, somebody sure as hell

1124
01:15:01,087 --> 01:15:03,853
raised you good to be a
New York city river rat.

1125
01:15:03,888 --> 01:15:07,407
And as far as I'm concerned,
you can go back to New York city

1126
01:15:07,442 --> 01:15:10,805
gutters and crawl back into
the backhole that you came from.

1127
01:15:11,723 --> 01:15:13,173
Okay?

1128
01:15:13,208 --> 01:15:15,567
- Now, Chase.
- Yup.

1129
01:15:15,602 --> 01:15:18,177
Even though I am still
totally pissed at you.

1130
01:15:18,178 --> 01:15:20,544
- I don't blame you.
- You did make my time out here

1131
01:15:20,579 --> 01:15:23,948
the funnest event I've
ever had in my life.

1132
01:15:23,983 --> 01:15:27,002
If I awarded you the million
dollars, what would do you with it?

1133
01:15:27,037 --> 01:15:30,236
I've had this bracelet on my wrist
the entire time I've been here.

1134
01:15:30,271 --> 01:15:33,807
It says hunt the cure on it. Hunt
the cure was started by my brother.

1135
01:15:33,842 --> 01:15:37,431
The reason he started it was because
we lost my dad from skin cancer

1136
01:15:37,466 --> 01:15:38,946
and he had a heart attack.

1137
01:15:38,981 --> 01:15:44,777
If I win $1 million, $100,000 is going
to help to raise money for cancer.

1138
01:15:44,812 --> 01:15:48,061
That's the first thing I'm going to do.
The second thing if I win $1 million...

1139
01:15:48,096 --> 01:15:50,043
I'm taking care of my mom.

1140
01:15:50,078 --> 01:15:52,631
She's making money on herself but
I'm going to take care of my mom.

1141
01:15:52,632 --> 01:15:53,737
Ok.

1142
01:15:53,772 --> 01:15:56,169
I want to take care of
my mom and dad as well.

1143
01:15:56,204 --> 01:16:00,293
I mean, that's a very...
That's a very sincere...

1144
01:16:00,328 --> 01:16:02,185
I think we all want to
take care of our moms.

1145
01:16:02,220 --> 01:16:05,289
Well, I thoroughly enjoyed
meeting both of your parents, okay.

1146
01:16:05,324 --> 01:16:07,967
Thank you for your
answers, and good luck.

1147
01:16:08,002 --> 01:16:11,517
Thanks, Jane. Benry, you're up.

1148
01:16:14,252 --> 01:16:16,423
Congrats, fellas.

1149
01:16:16,458 --> 01:16:20,320
Chase, I think I've heard everything
I need to hear from you tonight.

1150
01:16:21,026 --> 01:16:26,775
Fabs, congrats on the
back-to-back-to-back immunity wins.

1151
01:16:26,975 --> 01:16:30,439
You played a savage
game. Is it good enough?

1152
01:16:30,474 --> 01:16:33,272
You'll have to wait and see.

1153
01:16:33,307 --> 01:16:34,820
- Sash.
- Hey, benry.

1154
01:16:34,855 --> 01:16:40,342
Throughout the entire game, I was
able to see through the fake smile,

1155
01:16:40,377 --> 01:16:45,153
the a-ha laugh, but I want to know
what told you that I was a mark?

1156
01:16:45,188 --> 01:16:47,211
Tell me about myself.
What did I do wrong?

1157
01:16:47,246 --> 01:16:49,453
You said you could see through me.

1158
01:16:49,491 --> 01:16:53,688
If that was the case, you probably
should have mounted a strike

1159
01:16:53,723 --> 01:16:57,807
against me to try to take me out.
I thought you were a solid player.

1160
01:16:57,842 --> 01:17:01,657
I really did. It's just I didn't
think you'd be willing to to take me

1161
01:17:01,692 --> 01:17:04,832
to the end so that's
why I sent you home.

1162
01:17:04,867 --> 01:17:07,298
All right, appreciate
it. Congrats, fell as.

1163
01:17:07,826 --> 01:17:11,425
Thanks, Benry. Dan. You're up.

1164
01:17:11,857 --> 01:17:17,782
Okay. Sash, I think you're a
liar. I think you're a phony.

1165
01:17:19,158 --> 01:17:22,426
You said things to me and
you never lived up to them.

1166
01:17:22,461 --> 01:17:24,410
I think you're spineless.

1167
01:17:24,445 --> 01:17:29,723
And I hate that smile, and I think if
I was you, I'd go to the doctor tomorrow

1168
01:17:29,758 --> 01:17:32,567
and get that eye fixed so
you stop doing the wink.

1169
01:17:35,033 --> 01:17:39,906
Chase, you were the most paranoid
player in this entire game, okay.

1170
01:17:39,941 --> 01:17:42,500
- Whether you care or not.
- I absolutely... I...

1171
01:17:42,535 --> 01:17:45,878
I mean, there are a lot of people
bleeding here because of you,

1172
01:17:45,913 --> 01:17:48,769
a lot of people bleeding here.
You backstabbed everybody.

1173
01:17:48,804 --> 01:17:49,980
You backstabbed me.

1174
01:17:50,015 --> 01:17:53,871
You backstabbed Jane... Jane
who was your right-hand person.

1175
01:17:54,304 --> 01:17:58,687
When it came to you, she was gone.
So you really let people down.

1176
01:17:58,722 --> 01:18:02,583
- You let me down tremendously.
- This is "Survivor" Dan.

1177
01:18:02,618 --> 01:18:05,588
I'm going to tell you
something, okay. Beauty fades.

1178
01:18:05,623 --> 01:18:09,875
Dumb is forever. That's
all I have to say.

1179
01:18:09,910 --> 01:18:14,900
Thanks, Dan. Purple Kelly, you're up.

1180
01:18:18,331 --> 01:18:22,215
Congratulations, you guys. You
guys did what I couldn't do.

1181
01:18:22,250 --> 01:18:25,954
You stuck through all of this,
and you played the game like crazy.

1182
01:18:25,989 --> 01:18:27,764
My question is for Sash.

1183
01:18:27,799 --> 01:18:33,247
I'm going to give you 60 seconds
to explain how you outwit all of us.

1184
01:18:33,282 --> 01:18:34,312
Very good.

1185
01:18:34,347 --> 01:18:38,510
I really think I should have been
voted out at the merge, but I wasn't.

1186
01:18:38,545 --> 01:18:42,831
So I kept on moving forward
by creating many alliances.

1187
01:18:42,866 --> 01:18:47,320
It was unfortunate now they get all this
feedback that I've hurt so many people

1188
01:18:47,355 --> 01:18:50,993
but I have to own up to it tonight
and that's what I'm trying to do.

1189
01:18:51,324 --> 01:18:54,805
That is not the answer I was
expecting. And the honesty I love.

1190
01:18:55,077 --> 01:18:58,678
I feel like that was perfect. And
that's all I have for you guys.

1191
01:18:58,713 --> 01:19:00,440
- Thanks Kelly. Thanks, Purple.
- You guys are awesome.

1192
01:19:00,475 --> 01:19:03,901
Thanks Purple Kelly. NaOnka.

1193
01:19:06,803 --> 01:19:10,349
Hi, guys. Chase, you were my
brother throughout the game.

1194
01:19:10,384 --> 01:19:15,313
Fabio, you were my hippie friend, and,
Sash, you were the strategic player.

1195
01:19:16,012 --> 01:19:20,861
Fabio. It's been a
pleasure cussing you out.

1196
01:19:21,445 --> 01:19:24,863
You know, you won the first
immunity idol after the merge,

1197
01:19:24,898 --> 01:19:27,548
and then when it came down
to it, where it counted,

1198
01:19:27,583 --> 01:19:29,739
- you ended up getting three in a row.
- Yeah.

1199
01:19:29,774 --> 01:19:32,414
You got to see your mom
on one of those rewards.

1200
01:19:32,449 --> 01:19:37,259
Was that gasoline to boost
intow, what, phase 10?

1201
01:19:37,294 --> 01:19:39,366
I didn't actually go on
the reward with my mom.

1202
01:19:39,401 --> 01:19:42,438
It was just at the challenge
they saw her, and I did dream

1203
01:19:42,473 --> 01:19:45,643
every single day out here what
I could do for my family and it...

1204
01:19:45,678 --> 01:19:50,318
It... Yeah, man. It got me to the end.

1205
01:19:50,353 --> 01:19:53,061
Yeah, you know, that's
just something inside

1206
01:19:53,062 --> 01:19:55,769
of you that comes out
when it's necessary.

1207
01:19:55,804 --> 01:19:58,974
I never felt like that before
in my life. I never put that

1208
01:19:58,975 --> 01:20:02,145
kind of focus into something. And
there was so much emotion going on,

1209
01:20:02,146 --> 01:20:05,316
the jealousy because these
three had a plan to get here

1210
01:20:05,317 --> 01:20:08,486
and I felt like I really
did deserve to be here.

1211
01:20:08,521 --> 01:20:10,744
You know? Love for my family.

1212
01:20:10,779 --> 01:20:13,853
So, yeah, that was my
gasoline to get to the end.

1213
01:20:13,888 --> 01:20:18,176
I appreciate your... I had
my moment where's I cried.

1214
01:20:18,211 --> 01:20:21,826
You gotta dig deep in
this game. So good luck.

1215
01:20:22,168 --> 01:20:24,028
Thanks, NaOnka.

1216
01:20:24,396 --> 01:20:26,913
Alina, you're up.

1217
01:20:28,524 --> 01:20:33,824
Hi, guys. Fabio, you're like the
ultimate surfer boy, like, dude.

1218
01:20:33,859 --> 01:20:37,813
I love that about you, but I don't
really want to give $1 million to a boy.

1219
01:20:37,848 --> 01:20:41,472
I want to give $1 million to a
man. Sash, this is your shot...

1220
01:20:41,574 --> 01:20:46,718
***** convince me you deserve
it more than the young guys.

1221
01:20:46,753 --> 01:20:52,128
Right, well... Throughout the game,
when tribal council was coming up,

1222
01:20:52,163 --> 01:20:56,986
I feel as though Fabio was either
the last to know or played aloof

1223
01:20:57,021 --> 01:20:59,012
until someone told him
right before tribal.

1224
01:20:59,047 --> 01:21:01,755
I knew a lot more than you guys gave
me credit for. I just want to say that.

1225
01:21:01,790 --> 01:21:03,481
You weren't in on many votes.

1226
01:21:03,516 --> 01:21:05,891
There were times when we went
to tribal council where Fabio

1227
01:21:05,926 --> 01:21:09,020
thought it was going to go
one way and it went another.

1228
01:21:09,055 --> 01:21:13,186
And Chase was wishy-washy, would
go from one alliance to the other,

1229
01:21:13,221 --> 01:21:16,202
leak information back and
forth and waited for...

1230
01:21:16,237 --> 01:21:19,432
- someone else to make the decision.
- Okay, okay.

1231
01:21:19,703 --> 01:21:23,264
Chase, I'm actually pleasantly
surprised by you tonight.

1232
01:21:23,299 --> 01:21:24,606
You came in here strong.

1233
01:21:24,641 --> 01:21:27,238
Tell me I have to vote for
you and not the other guys.

1234
01:21:27,418 --> 01:21:30,628
People say I was wishy-washy, people
say I did one thing and all this.

1235
01:21:30,663 --> 01:21:31,734
It wasn't wishy-washy.

1236
01:21:31,769 --> 01:21:35,244
It was meaning mee making myself a
way out to play with people I could

1237
01:21:35,279 --> 01:21:38,135
trust but didn't get myself
in the situation where

1238
01:21:38,170 --> 01:21:41,490
when the alliance was
done I was done. ****

1239
01:21:41,525 --> 01:21:45,008
it did hurt me, going behind the
back and say "why do you think

1240
01:21:45,043 --> 01:21:48,514
I'm so close with her
*** to vote people out"

1241
01:21:48,549 --> 01:21:52,262
And guys like Fabio have the
strategy to not pis people off

1242
01:21:52,297 --> 01:21:54,834
but still make it through the game.
I don't think that's true.

1243
01:21:54,869 --> 01:21:57,812
Half the tribal councils we
came back from Fabio was like:

1244
01:21:57,847 --> 01:22:00,958
"what the hell happened" ****

1245
01:22:00,993 --> 01:22:03,804
You tried to get through the
game without offending anybody,

1246
01:22:03,839 --> 01:22:06,873
without double-crossing
anybody, but I actually did it.

1247
01:22:06,908 --> 01:22:10,724
I didn't have to backstab anybody
and that's hard to do in this game.

1248
01:22:10,759 --> 01:22:13,854
That's hard to do but he
didn't do it with strategy ***

1249
01:22:13,889 --> 01:22:17,131
He did it by not knowing what the
hell was going on half the time.

1250
01:22:17,166 --> 01:22:20,393
And I'm sorry, he won three immunities
to get here and that's impressive.

1251
01:22:20,428 --> 01:22:24,334
But this isn't the N.B.A. finals. ****

1252
01:22:24,369 --> 01:22:29,094
This is outwit, outplay, outlast and
winning three in a row isn't doing that.

1253
01:22:29,129 --> 01:22:31,624
- That's outplaying you, bro.
- You didn't outlast me.

1254
01:22:31,659 --> 01:22:34,765
- ***
- I brought you to the final three.

1255
01:22:34,800 --> 01:22:37,984
- And I appreciate that.
- Outlast gets you to here.

1256
01:22:38,019 --> 01:22:40,119
But the real question should be who was

1257
01:22:40,120 --> 01:22:42,220
able to outplay and
who was able to outwit?

1258
01:22:42,255 --> 01:22:46,020
- Well, you didnt outplay anybody, Sash.
- I like what's happening here.

1259
01:22:46,055 --> 01:22:48,435
I like that this is,
like, two, maybe three men

1260
01:22:48,436 --> 01:22:53,106
really fighting for what they want.
Thank you, guys. You guys helped a lot.

1261
01:22:53,107 --> 01:22:54,134
♪♪♪

1262
01:22:54,169 --> 01:22:56,492
All right, jury asked
a lot of good questions,

1263
01:22:56,527 --> 01:22:59,109
gathered a lot of
interesting information.

1264
01:22:59,144 --> 01:23:03,044
Now it is time to take all
of this information and decide

1265
01:23:03,079 --> 01:23:07,752
which one of these three you know
deserves the title of Sole Survivor

1266
01:23:07,787 --> 01:23:11,167
and the million-dollar check
that goes along with it.

1267
01:23:11,202 --> 01:23:16,008
Take a moment, think about
it, and then we will vote.

1268
01:23:28,089 --> 01:23:31,191
All right, jury, tonight
you have had an opportunity

1269
01:23:31,226 --> 01:23:34,691
to hear a lot of information
that's going to help you decide

1270
01:23:34,895 --> 01:23:39,767
if you are voting for
Chase, or Fabio, or Sash.

1271
01:23:39,967 --> 01:23:43,395
Tonight's the night you want
to see your name written down.

1272
01:23:43,430 --> 01:23:49,061
For the last time, it is time
to vote. Purple Kelly, you're up.

1273
01:24:02,223 --> 01:24:07,077
Chase is the dumbest player on ever
play this game, and Sash is a weasel.

1274
01:24:08,129 --> 01:24:12,341
Fabio, man, I love you,
and I loved your game.

1275
01:24:12,400 --> 01:24:17,470
I believe everything you
said tonight. You are awesome.

1276
01:24:21,189 --> 01:24:24,034
It's been a pleasure.

1277
01:24:30,737 --> 01:24:34,366
Chase, you impressed me today.

1278
01:24:34,401 --> 01:24:37,172
You came in here like somebody
I have never seen before.

1279
01:24:37,207 --> 01:24:40,133
You had your game face on today,
and I was so impressed by you.

1280
01:24:40,161 --> 01:24:42,271
Congratulations.

1281
01:24:54,600 --> 01:24:57,110
Come on, Fabio.

1282
01:24:57,483 --> 01:25:00,983
Come on, I want you to
do that for your mom.

1283
01:25:26,867 --> 01:25:31,276
I hope that you win and
I am really proud of you.

1284
01:25:31,378 --> 01:25:33,790
Congratulations.

1285
01:25:48,796 --> 01:25:51,417
I'll go get the votes.

1286
01:25:55,767 --> 01:25:58,840
Good game, guys. Good game.

1287
01:26:05,212 --> 01:26:09,553
Chase, Fabio, Sash, it's
been a long 39-day adventure.

1288
01:26:09,588 --> 01:26:14,584
I know you'd like to see the results of
the vote right now. You'll have to wait.

1289
01:26:14,585 --> 01:26:18,228
I'll see you back in L.A.
for the reading of the votes.

1290
01:26:33,729 --> 01:26:39,729
Transcript:
wWw. MY-SUBS. Com



## S22E14

1
00:00:00,000 --> 00:00:04,162
WWW.MY-SUBS.CO

1
00:00:03,920 --> 00:00:08,925
<i>Il y a un an, à la finale de
"Survivor : Heroes vs Villains",</i>

2
00:00:09,410 --> 00:00:12,485
<i>Boston Rob défia Russell
pour une revanche.</i>

3
00:00:12,610 --> 00:00:17,240
Si j'en ai l'opportunité, j'aimerais
revenir pour te botter le cul de l'île.

4
00:00:19,110 --> 00:00:21,465
<i>Cette saison, leur voeu fut exaucé.</i>

5
00:00:21,590 --> 00:00:26,595
<i>Boston Rob et Russell</i>

6
00:00:27,070 --> 00:00:31,520
<i>reviennent s'affronter
dans la dernière version de Survivor :</i>

7
00:00:33,030 --> 00:00:34,930
<i>"Redemption Island."</i>

8
00:00:37,120 --> 00:00:40,655
<i>Cette fois-ci, Boston Rob,
ayant une double notoriété,</i>

9
00:00:40,780 --> 00:00:43,625
<i>tenta quelque chose de nouveau :
la loyauté.</i>

10
00:00:43,750 --> 00:00:48,145
<i>Il fit une alliance avec la tribu
Ometepe pour rester unis jusqu'au bout.</i>

11
00:00:48,270 --> 00:00:49,865
C'est tout. C'est nous.

12
00:00:49,990 --> 00:00:52,145
<i>Il y avait Grant, son bras droit.</i>

13
00:00:52,270 --> 00:00:55,095
<i>Natalie, la plus jeune joueuse
dans l'histoire de Survivor.</i>

14
00:00:55,220 --> 00:00:57,595
<i>Andrea, la fille de la ferme.</i>

15
00:00:57,720 --> 00:01:01,655
<i>Ashley, l'infirmière qui s'est révélée
être une sérieuse menace.</i>

16
00:01:01,780 --> 00:01:04,925
Une fois de plus,
Ashley avance très vite.

17
00:01:05,050 --> 00:01:07,875
<i>Et l'imprévisible Phillip.</i>

18
00:01:08,000 --> 00:01:09,505
Avez-vous eu une collision
avec un aigle ?

19
00:01:09,630 --> 00:01:13,880
J'ai demandé un signe et venant du ciel,
cette plume est apparue.

20
00:01:15,720 --> 00:01:19,185
<i>Avec son armée imprenable,
Rob renforca sa position</i>

21
00:01:19,310 --> 00:01:21,245
<i>quand il trouva
l'idole d'immunité cachée.</i>

22
00:01:21,370 --> 00:01:24,045
J'ai peut-être appris quelque chose
depuis la dernière fois.

23
00:01:24,170 --> 00:01:27,715
<i>Il a ensuite gardé le secret
durant le reste du jeu.</i>

24
00:01:27,840 --> 00:01:30,835
<i>Celui qui n'était pas
dans l'alliance de Rob, était une proie.</i>

25
00:01:30,960 --> 00:01:33,835
<i>Rob vit la relation de Matt et Andrea
comme une menace.</i>

26
00:01:33,960 --> 00:01:37,065
Je sais à quel point
un duo est fort dans ce jeu.

27
00:01:37,190 --> 00:01:40,325
<i>Il trahit Matt et l'envoya
sur l'île de la rédemption.</i>

28
00:01:40,450 --> 00:01:43,590
Vous aurez une seconde chance
de réintégrer le jeu.

29
00:01:45,000 --> 00:01:46,605
<i>Au premier duel de la rédemption,</i>

30
00:01:46,730 --> 00:01:48,195
Matt a les trois clés !

31
00:01:48,320 --> 00:01:49,955
<i>Matt bat Francesca.</i>

32
00:01:50,080 --> 00:01:52,005
Matt reste en vie !

33
00:01:52,130 --> 00:01:54,395
<i>Et gagne le droit de rester
sur l'île de la rédemption</i>

34
00:01:54,520 --> 00:01:56,505
<i>dans l'espoir de rejoindre la partie.</i>

35
00:01:56,630 --> 00:01:58,605
<i>Il y resta longtemps tout seul.</i>

36
00:01:58,730 --> 00:02:00,595
Dieu m'aide à avancer.

37
00:02:00,720 --> 00:02:04,240
<i>Sa seule véritable alliance
était avec son Dieu.</i>

38
00:02:04,560 --> 00:02:06,085
<i>Dans la tribu Zapatera,</i>

39
00:02:06,210 --> 00:02:08,045
Où est l'idole ?

40
00:02:08,170 --> 00:02:11,885
<i>Russell reprit ses vieilles habitudes :
rechercher l'idole d'immunité cachée,</i>

41
00:02:12,010 --> 00:02:15,045
<i>et créer une alliance
avec les plus jeunes filles de la tribu.</i>

42
00:02:15,170 --> 00:02:17,625
Krista et Stephanie sont mes deux nanas.

43
00:02:17,750 --> 00:02:20,829
<i>Mais le reste de la tribu
planifiait un coup.</i>

44
00:02:21,054 --> 00:02:22,519
Vous voulez la perdre ?

45
00:02:22,532 --> 00:02:23,875
Manquez le seau.

46
00:02:24,000 --> 00:02:25,845
<i>Ils ont décidé
de perdre l'épreuve exprès.</i>

47
00:02:25,970 --> 00:02:28,415
Ometepe prend de l'avance.

48
00:02:28,540 --> 00:02:30,145
Julie rate.

49
00:02:30,270 --> 00:02:31,455
Allez les gars !

50
00:02:31,580 --> 00:02:33,455
Steve semble affaibli.

51
00:02:33,580 --> 00:02:36,940
Ometepe gagne sa première épreuve !

52
00:02:38,170 --> 00:02:40,295
<i>Ils ont tous perdu l'épreuve exprès.</i>

53
00:02:40,420 --> 00:02:42,435
Je suis avec une bande de cons.

54
00:02:42,560 --> 00:02:44,525
<i>Et ils ont éliminé Russell.</i>

55
00:02:44,650 --> 00:02:46,600
La tribu a parlé.

56
00:02:49,160 --> 00:02:52,085
<i>Sur l'île de la rédemption,
Russell affronta Matt</i>

57
00:02:52,210 --> 00:02:55,015
<i>dans une bataille épique
entre le bien et le mal.</i>

58
00:02:55,140 --> 00:02:57,895
- Ca y est.
- Matt va essayer.

59
00:02:58,020 --> 00:02:59,610
Va-t-il réussir ?

60
00:03:02,580 --> 00:03:05,875
Matt reste en vie !

61
00:03:06,000 --> 00:03:08,215
<i>Et durant ses derniers instants
dans le jeu,</i>

62
00:03:08,340 --> 00:03:11,705
<i>Russell montra qu'il avait un coeur
et fit une promesse.</i>

63
00:03:11,830 --> 00:03:14,465
C'est la dernière fois
que je joue à ce jeu.

64
00:03:14,590 --> 00:03:16,475
Je n'ai rien d'autre à prouver.

65
00:03:16,600 --> 00:03:18,535
<i>Matt gagna chaque duel successivement.</i>

66
00:03:18,660 --> 00:03:19,775
Matt reste en vie !

67
00:03:19,900 --> 00:03:21,785
<i>Et il se fraya un chemin
pour revenir dans le jeu.</i>

68
00:03:21,910 --> 00:03:26,455
Matt saisit sa chance
et réintègre le jeu.

69
00:03:26,580 --> 00:03:29,100
<i>Les tribus fusionnèrent.</i>

70
00:03:29,710 --> 00:03:32,655
<i>Avec six Ometepe.</i>

71
00:03:32,780 --> 00:03:36,255
<i>Contre cinq Zapatera,
et Matt coincé entre les deux.</i>

72
00:03:36,380 --> 00:03:38,125
<i>Je veux rester dans ce jeu
le plus longtemps possible.</i>

73
00:03:38,250 --> 00:03:39,585
<i>Alors je vais essayer de voir</i>

74
00:03:39,710 --> 00:03:41,845
ce qui est le mieux pour moi,
et ce que je dois faire.

75
00:03:41,970 --> 00:03:44,855
<i>Il a vite rétabli
sa relation avec Andrea.</i>

76
00:03:44,980 --> 00:03:48,840
Voilà ce que je veux :
c'est éliminer la tribu Ometepe.

77
00:03:49,670 --> 00:03:52,635
<i>Mais Andrea savait ce qui se passe
quand on froisse Rob.</i>

78
00:03:52,760 --> 00:03:55,555
<i>Huitième personne éliminée de
"Survivor : Redemption Island"</i>

79
00:03:55,680 --> 00:03:58,046
<i>Alors ils trahirent Matt
une seconde fois.</i>

80
00:03:58,171 --> 00:03:59,793
Oh mon Dieu, pauvre garçon.

81
00:04:00,260 --> 00:04:02,855
<i>L'envoyant directement
sur l'île de la rédemption.</i>

82
00:04:02,980 --> 00:04:05,350
<i>Quel bordel !</i>

83
00:04:05,830 --> 00:04:08,705
<i>Chaque membre
de l'ancienne tribu Zapatera</i>

84
00:04:08,830 --> 00:04:10,865
<i>suivit Matt sur l'île de la rédemption,</i>

85
00:04:10,990 --> 00:04:15,025
<i>où des duels de plusieurs
personnes eurent lieu,</i>

86
00:04:15,150 --> 00:04:17,910
<i>et Mike et Matt continuèrent
sur une série de victoire.</i>

87
00:04:18,460 --> 00:04:21,895
Mike et Matt restent en vie
sur l'île de la rédemption.

88
00:04:22,020 --> 00:04:24,590
<i>Alors que les autres sont devenus
membres du jury.</i>

89
00:04:27,210 --> 00:04:30,825
Quand il resta seulement
les membres d'Ometepe à éliminer,

90
00:04:30,950 --> 00:04:33,280
Phillip devint une cible.

91
00:04:35,430 --> 00:04:37,945
<i>Sa personnalité a mis
tout le monde sur les nerfs.</i>

92
00:04:38,070 --> 00:04:39,865
Le truc avec moi, si vous l'ouvrez

93
00:04:39,990 --> 00:04:42,035
c'est que je vais être direct
et vous en faire baver.

94
00:04:42,160 --> 00:04:43,355
Vire de-là.

95
00:04:43,480 --> 00:04:47,005
<i>Mais à la fin Rob était le seul
à décider qui partait.</i>

96
00:04:47,130 --> 00:04:50,325
<i>Un seul homme ne devrait pas avoir
autant de pouvoir dans ce jeu.</i>

97
00:04:50,450 --> 00:04:53,080
Heureusement que je ne suis pas
un homme ordinaire.

98
00:04:53,610 --> 00:04:55,495
<i>Et Andrea découvrit
de manière brutale...</i>

99
00:04:55,620 --> 00:04:57,935
Je sens que j'ai fait confiance
aux bonnes personnes.

100
00:04:58,060 --> 00:04:59,600
<i>... qu'elle était visée.</i>

101
00:05:00,447 --> 00:05:01,588
Oh, mon Dieu.

102
00:05:01,830 --> 00:05:05,990
C'est une trahison.
Je sens que ce n'est pas la dernière.

103
00:05:06,820 --> 00:05:09,965
<i>Grant a également cru
que son alliance avec Rob était solide.</i>

104
00:05:10,090 --> 00:05:13,133
<i>La seule personne
en qui j'ai vraiment confiance est Rob.</i>

105
00:05:13,258 --> 00:05:14,895
Sans aucune réserve.

106
00:05:15,020 --> 00:05:16,645
<i>Mais rob pensait autrement.</i>

107
00:05:16,770 --> 00:05:19,928
<i>Je ne suis pas venu ici
pour me faire des amis mais pour gagner.</i>

108
00:05:20,053 --> 00:05:22,205
Alors je dois t'éliminer ce soir.

109
00:05:22,330 --> 00:05:26,005
<i>Et Grant fut la dernière personne
envoyée sur l'île de la rédemption.</i>

110
00:05:26,130 --> 00:05:29,035
- Vous avez une chance de réintégrer le jeu.
- J'en ai pas fini.

111
00:05:29,160 --> 00:05:30,850
On se revoit rapidement.

112
00:05:31,140 --> 00:05:34,995
<i>Ce soir marque la fin
de cette épique saison de Survivor.</i>

113
00:05:35,120 --> 00:05:39,325
<i>Rob va-t-il terminer le voyage
entrepris il y a une décennie ?</i>

114
00:05:39,450 --> 00:05:42,905
<i>Je sens qu'en ce moment,
je joue mon meilleur jeu.</i>

115
00:05:43,030 --> 00:05:46,815
Mais même avec tout ce qui s'est passé
jusqu'à maintenant,

116
00:05:46,940 --> 00:05:50,315
ça ne signifie pas
que je peux aller jusqu'au bout.

117
00:05:50,440 --> 00:05:52,765
<i>Ou ses loyaux soldats
se retourneront-ils contre lui ?</i>

118
00:05:52,890 --> 00:05:55,645
<i>Natalie et moi, nous sommes
ensemble depuis le début,</i>

119
00:05:55,770 --> 00:06:00,775
et nous pourrions faire un coup énorme
pour sortir Boston Rob.

120
00:06:01,780 --> 00:06:04,885
Nous avons confiance l'une en l'autre,
mais nous voulons gagner,

121
00:06:05,010 --> 00:06:08,425
alors pourquoi devrions-nous
garder Rob dans le jeu ?

122
00:06:08,550 --> 00:06:12,515
<i>Les pitreries de Phillip sont-elles
le meilleur plan pour gagner ?</i>

123
00:06:12,640 --> 00:06:15,975
<i>Je fais le méchant
pour que toute la tribu estime</i>

124
00:06:16,100 --> 00:06:19,475
<i>que sa meilleure chance de gagner
est contre moi.</i>

125
00:06:19,600 --> 00:06:21,745
Mais honnêtement,
je pense pouvoir vaincre Rob.

126
00:06:21,870 --> 00:06:24,165
<i>Et enfin,
le vainqueur du duel de ce soir,</i>

127
00:06:24,290 --> 00:06:27,785
<i>revenant de l'île de la rédemption,
réintégrera le jeu.</i>

128
00:06:27,910 --> 00:06:29,045
<i>Qui ça va être ?</i>

129
00:06:29,170 --> 00:06:32,815
<i>Matt, le chrétien qui a laissé son jeu
entre les mains de Dieu.</i>

130
00:06:32,940 --> 00:06:36,425
<i>Mike, le vétéran de la guerre en Irak
et le dernier Zapatera.</i>

131
00:06:36,550 --> 00:06:39,995
<i>Andrea, la seule femme restant
sur l'île de la rédemption.</i>

132
00:06:40,120 --> 00:06:44,115
<i>Ou Grant, l'ancien joueur de la NFL
trahi par Rob.</i>

133
00:06:44,240 --> 00:06:46,335
<i>Tout prendra fin ce soir.</i>

134
00:06:46,460 --> 00:06:48,895
<i>Découvrez qui va gagner
le prix d'un million de dollars</i>

135
00:06:49,020 --> 00:06:51,940
<i>et le titre d'ultime survivant.</i>

136
00:06:54,550 --> 00:06:56,716
<font color=#38B0DE>>> Survivor ST <<</font>

137
00:06:58,418 --> 00:07:01,521
<font color=#38B0DE>http://survivor-st.forumgratuit.org</font>

138
00:07:07,093 --> 00:07:08,928
<font color=#38B0DE>Traduction : Ryoki</font>

139
00:07:10,864 --> 00:07:12,666
<font color=#38B0DE>Synchro : Sir. ToTo</font>

140
00:07:14,567 --> 00:07:17,737
<font color=#38B0DE>Relecture : Optimus</font>

141
00:07:39,025 --> 00:07:41,728
<font color=#38B0DE>Remerciements : DesertEagle - cixi42</font>

142
00:08:06,400 --> 00:08:08,195
<i>Je ne pensais pas
que j'allais être éliminé.</i>

143
00:08:08,320 --> 00:08:10,825
<i>J'ai fait confiance
aux gens de mon alliance.</i>

144
00:08:10,950 --> 00:08:14,955
Et vous savez, il s'avère
que quelqu'un n'a pas été honnête.

145
00:08:15,080 --> 00:08:18,365
Il est possible que Rob m'ait trahi
ou peut-être Phillip.

146
00:08:18,490 --> 00:08:23,060
Et vous savez quoi ?
Je vais bien.

147
00:08:25,620 --> 00:08:28,085
- Salut !
- Oh ! Grant !

148
00:08:28,210 --> 00:08:31,475
- Salut tout le monde.
- Tu peux venir... Passe par là.

149
00:08:31,600 --> 00:08:33,375
Grant, tu es celui
que je voulais qui vienne

150
00:08:33,500 --> 00:08:36,825
car ce duel va être un carnage.

151
00:08:36,950 --> 00:08:40,375
<i>C'était Grant que je voulais voir
sur l'île de la rédemption.<i></i>

152
00:08:40,500 --> 00:08:45,125
<i>Et bien sûr c'est lui qui est venu.
Donc c'est entre Grant, Matt, Mike et Moi.</i>

153
00:08:45,250 --> 00:08:50,025
<i>Ca ne va pas être un duel facile.
J'ai de grandes chances de perdre.</i>

154
00:08:50,150 --> 00:08:53,350
Mais vous savez quoi ?
Je vais tout donner.

155
00:09:07,093 --> 00:09:08,691
Quelle belle nuit.

156
00:09:08,705 --> 00:09:10,370
Le feu brûle encore.

157
00:09:11,160 --> 00:09:13,055
- Pas de pluie.
- C'était dur.

158
00:09:13,180 --> 00:09:14,975
C'était dur.

159
00:09:15,100 --> 00:09:19,055
Ça m'a touché. Mais on a fait
ce qu'il fallait et c'était super.

160
00:09:19,180 --> 00:09:22,365
Je vais bien. Ca craint.

161
00:09:22,490 --> 00:09:25,385
Je sais que c'est dur, tu sais.

162
00:09:25,510 --> 00:09:30,090
Je suis sûr qu'il n'est pas content
en ce moment, mais au moins c'est fait.

163
00:09:31,060 --> 00:09:36,065
Ca blesse un peu... Mais c'est le jeu.

164
00:09:37,040 --> 00:09:40,065
<i>Ce soir, au conseil, Grant est parti
sur l'île de la rédemption.</i>

165
00:09:40,190 --> 00:09:44,135
L'ironie, c'est que
c'est ma faute s'il est parti.

166
00:09:44,260 --> 00:09:49,085
<i>En même temps il me manque,
car c'était un de mes seuls amis ici.</i>

167
00:09:49,210 --> 00:09:54,215
Je suis un sans-coeur, un calculateur,

168
00:09:54,590 --> 00:09:58,445
mais ça me blesse un peu, vous savez.

169
00:09:58,570 --> 00:10:01,040
J'ai un coeur quelque part.

170
00:10:03,110 --> 00:10:05,955
Il savait qu'il était
une menace, tu sais.

171
00:10:06,080 --> 00:10:07,929
- Il l'est
- Il le savait.

172
00:10:08,054 --> 00:10:11,764
Ca m'inquiète que je sois
la plus grande menace maintenant.

173
00:10:11,829 --> 00:10:13,585
Tu vois ce que je veux dire ?

174
00:10:13,710 --> 00:10:17,835
<i>Je pense que Grant pourrait être
la seule personne de la rédemption</i>

175
00:10:17,960 --> 00:10:22,685
<i>à revenir ici et m'éliminer en premier.</i>

176
00:10:22,810 --> 00:10:25,325
<i>Si c'est Matt, Mike ou Andrea,</i>

177
00:10:25,450 --> 00:10:29,385
je sais pas, Ashley est mauvaise.
Elle doit partir.

178
00:10:29,510 --> 00:10:34,070
<i>C'est mon ressenti. Elle doit partir.</i>

179
00:10:35,380 --> 00:10:37,640
Au revoir Ashley !

180
00:10:51,840 --> 00:10:55,045
<i>Je me sens mieux maintenant.
J'aime cet endroit.</i>

181
00:10:55,170 --> 00:10:59,260
C'est devenu mon "chez moi".
C'est le 29ème jour pour moi.

182
00:10:59,880 --> 00:11:02,495
<i>Je me souviens
de la première nuit ici, il pleuvait.</i>

183
00:11:02,620 --> 00:11:06,135
<i>Je me demandais
comment j'allais surmonter ça.</i>

184
00:11:06,260 --> 00:11:11,085
<i>J'étais extrêmement dégoûté,
bouleversé et en colère, mais<i></i>

185
00:11:11,210 --> 00:11:15,400
ces sentiments sont envolés
car c'est un endroit spécial.

186
00:11:21,460 --> 00:11:24,395
Très bien, voyons ça.

187
00:11:24,520 --> 00:11:27,720
C'est la finale !

188
00:11:31,110 --> 00:11:32,665
J'espère que c'est une pizza.

189
00:11:32,790 --> 00:11:34,645
"Nous y voilà : votre duel final."

190
00:11:34,770 --> 00:11:37,505
"Seul le vainqueur
reviendra dans le jeu."

191
00:11:37,630 --> 00:11:39,085
"Les perdants rejoindront le jury."

192
00:11:39,210 --> 00:11:41,825
- "Tout donner", on donne tout !
- "C'est le moment de tout donner."

193
00:11:41,950 --> 00:11:45,085
- Ramenons-le, Andrea.
- Tout donner !

194
00:11:45,210 --> 00:11:48,165
- C'est la finale !
- Très bien !

195
00:11:48,290 --> 00:11:50,260
<i>Il s'avère que c'est
notre dernier duel aujourd'hui.</i>

196
00:11:51,050 --> 00:11:52,975
<i>Trois perdront,
trois retourneront chez eux.</i>

197
00:11:53,100 --> 00:11:56,405
Un va rester et réintégrer le jeu.

198
00:11:56,530 --> 00:11:59,515
<i>Je suis depuis 14 jours
sur l'île de la rédemption</i>

199
00:11:59,640 --> 00:12:02,335
<i>et pour une part de moi,
cette île va me manquer.</i>

200
00:12:02,460 --> 00:12:05,645
<i>Cette expérience ici a changé ma vie.</i>

201
00:12:05,770 --> 00:12:09,400
- Tu l'as fait Matt, ton dernier duel.
- Ton dernier duel.

202
00:12:10,110 --> 00:12:12,705
<i>C'est un plaisir amer.
L'île de la rédemption se conclut,</i>

203
00:12:12,830 --> 00:12:16,765
<i>mais nous allons connaître notre destin
d'une façon ou d'une autre.</i>

204
00:12:16,890 --> 00:12:21,500
L'île de la rédemption,
le purgatoire touche à sa fin.

205
00:12:23,150 --> 00:12:26,105
Cher Seigneur,
merci beaucoup pour ce matin.

206
00:12:26,230 --> 00:12:29,885
Merci pour l'île de la rédemption,
ce qu'elle signifie et nous a apporté.

207
00:12:30,010 --> 00:12:32,265
Aidez-nous à donner
autant que possible, mais je sais

208
00:12:32,390 --> 00:12:36,735
que votre volonté est parfaite
et peu importe le résultat, Seigneur.

209
00:12:36,860 --> 00:12:40,595
Merci beaucoup pour votre fils
et nous vous aimons.

210
00:12:40,720 --> 00:12:42,075
Amen.

211
00:12:42,200 --> 00:12:46,645
Deux trahisons, sept jours
dans le jeu principal de Survivor,

212
00:12:46,770 --> 00:12:50,475
<i>11 duels, 29 jours sur
l'île de la rédemption.</i>

213
00:12:50,600 --> 00:12:52,645
<i>C'est assez incroyable.</i>

214
00:12:52,770 --> 00:12:55,205
<i>Dieu mérite toute la gloire et l'honneur.</i>

215
00:12:55,330 --> 00:12:57,665
<i>Ma foi a grandi.
J'ai grandi en tant que personne.</i>

216
00:12:57,790 --> 00:13:01,030
Qui savait quel trésor nous attendait
sur l'île de la rédemption ?

217
00:13:08,030 --> 00:13:12,335
Accueillons maintenant
les concurrents du dernier duel.

218
00:13:12,460 --> 00:13:17,465
Matt, Mike, Andrea et Grant.

219
00:13:20,860 --> 00:13:25,865
Bienvenue dans l'arène de l'île
de la rédemption pour ce dernier duel.

220
00:13:27,020 --> 00:13:31,585
Phillip, Rob, Ashley et Natalie
sont là pour assister à ce duel

221
00:13:31,710 --> 00:13:35,905
car ils sont clairement
intéressés par le résultat.

222
00:13:36,030 --> 00:13:37,515
Voilà comment ça se passe.

223
00:13:37,640 --> 00:13:41,215
Vous placez un pied sur l'extrémité
d'une planche en équilibre.

224
00:13:41,340 --> 00:13:44,475
De l'autre côté
se trouve un vase en céramique.

225
00:13:44,600 --> 00:13:48,975
Quand le vase tombe, vous sortez
de l'épreuve. Mais aussi du jeu.

226
00:13:49,100 --> 00:13:53,385
La dernière personne encore debout
avec son vase intact rejoint le jeu

227
00:13:53,510 --> 00:13:55,365
et retrouve une chance
de gagner l'argent.

228
00:13:55,490 --> 00:13:57,065
Pour les perdants vous serez hors jeu,

229
00:13:57,190 --> 00:14:01,530
et vous deviendrez les cinquième,
sixième et septième membres du jury.

230
00:14:01,910 --> 00:14:06,915
Nous y sommes. Une dernière chance.
Prenez place.

231
00:14:11,710 --> 00:14:14,165
Très bien, allons-y.

232
00:14:14,290 --> 00:14:15,745
Le duel final.

233
00:14:15,870 --> 00:14:20,875
Placez un pied sur le bout
de la planche et soulevez.

234
00:14:22,530 --> 00:14:25,630
Et voilà, nous commençons.

235
00:14:26,500 --> 00:14:28,445
Une épreuve très simple.

236
00:14:28,570 --> 00:14:32,965
Garder en équilibre son vase
sur le bord de la planche.

237
00:14:33,090 --> 00:14:37,690
Quand votre vase tombe,
vous êtes éliminé.

238
00:14:51,660 --> 00:14:56,500
Vous maintenez ces vases en équilibre
depuis 20 minutes.

239
00:15:00,260 --> 00:15:02,880
Grant a bien rattrapé le coup.

240
00:15:05,990 --> 00:15:08,910
Proche du bord pour Matt.

241
00:15:11,530 --> 00:15:14,005
Mike a bien rattrapé le coup.

242
00:15:14,130 --> 00:15:16,825
Réveillez-vous, restez éveillés.

243
00:15:16,950 --> 00:15:19,340
Rappelez-vous ce que vous faites ici.

244
00:15:28,630 --> 00:15:31,480
Ca fait 40 minutes
que vous êtes comme ça.

245
00:15:33,140 --> 00:15:36,080
Grant essaie d'étirer sa jambe.

246
00:15:47,280 --> 00:15:49,955
Le vase de Grant est tombé.

247
00:15:50,080 --> 00:15:52,945
Grant est éliminé du jeu.

248
00:15:53,070 --> 00:15:57,020
Grant devient
le cinquième membre du jury.

249
00:15:57,820 --> 00:16:00,495
Nous descendons à trois,

250
00:16:00,620 --> 00:16:03,920
avec Matt, Mike et Andrea.

251
00:16:12,480 --> 00:16:17,485
Une heure que vous maintenez
ces vases en équilibre.

252
00:16:20,110 --> 00:16:23,070
Andrea s'étire.

253
00:16:36,100 --> 00:16:43,000
Et avec ça, Matt sort de l'épreuve
et est éliminé du jeu.

254
00:16:43,500 --> 00:16:46,145
Après 36 jours dans ce jeu.

255
00:16:46,270 --> 00:16:51,275
Vous avez survécu à dix duels,
mais vous perdez celui à gagner.

256
00:16:51,590 --> 00:16:53,745
Matt est le sixième membre du jury,

257
00:16:53,870 --> 00:16:58,435
il n'a plus aucune chance de gagner
et nous descendons à deux.

258
00:16:58,560 --> 00:17:03,115
Mike et Andrea
dans une épreuve de force.

259
00:17:03,240 --> 00:17:08,035
La fille de la ferme contre
le vétéran de la guerre d'Irak.

260
00:17:08,160 --> 00:17:11,825
Le gagnant revient dans le jeu.

261
00:17:11,950 --> 00:17:14,610
Mike a bien rattrapé le coup.

262
00:17:22,320 --> 00:17:25,030
Andrea fait un beau rattrapage.

263
00:17:26,960 --> 00:17:31,965
Assurez-vous de rester concentré
sur ce que vous faites.

264
