1536
01:24:44,178 --> 01:24:45,189
- Toi.
- OK.

1537
01:24:46,573 --> 01:24:50,026
Tu dois savoir ça, Lauren.
Tommy ne te dit pas tout.

1538
01:24:50,151 --> 01:24:52,753
Je sais que tu ne m'adores pas, là,
mais...

1539
01:24:52,878 --> 01:24:54,691
- je dois te le dire.
- Ne dis pas ça.

1540
01:24:54,816 --> 01:24:56,570
- Je suis fière de vous.
- Merci.

1541
01:24:56,695 --> 01:24:59,476
- Hier, j'étais fâchée. Ça va mieux.
- Je regrette.

1542
01:24:59,601 --> 01:25:01,810
Mais moi, je dis ce qui est non-dit.

1543
01:25:01,935 --> 01:25:05,297
Quand on bossait sur le feu,
l'attention était sur Dean.

1544
01:25:05,884 --> 01:25:08,878
Tommy lui a appris des méthodes
qu'il t'a cachées.

1545
01:25:09,128 --> 01:25:13,289
Il cherchait aussi à te troubler
pour que tu sois plus émue

1546
01:25:13,414 --> 01:25:16,030
et pas au mieux à l'épreuve du feu.

1547
01:25:16,155 --> 01:25:18,462
<font color="#9C47AF">C'est pour ça
qu'elle ne me lâchait pas, hier.</font>

1548
01:25:18,587 --> 01:25:22,025
- Et ça, il ne te le dit pas.
- Voilà ce qui se passe.

1549
01:25:22,150 --> 01:25:24,998
Ce soir, vous rendez des comptes
sur vos actions.

1550
01:25:25,123 --> 01:25:27,793
Vous avez l'occasion
d'assumer votre jeu.

1551
01:25:27,918 --> 01:25:29,691
- Assume, sois honnête.
- Je le suis.

1552
01:25:29,816 --> 01:25:33,669
Il a assumé en disant : "Je voulais
créer des liens, que tous m'aiment."

1553
01:25:33,794 --> 01:25:34,811
- Non ?
- Oui.

1554
01:25:34,936 --> 01:25:37,841
Ça veut dire
promettre la finale aux gens.

1555
01:25:37,966 --> 01:25:40,521
Il y a des gens avec qui
je n'ai jamais bossé :

1556
01:25:40,646 --> 01:25:43,380
Janet, Karishma, Noura,
on n'a pas bossé ensemble.

1557
01:25:43,505 --> 01:25:45,415
- Ma philosophie était...
- Suivre la majorité.

1558
01:25:45,540 --> 01:25:47,737
- ... si j'aime mes alliés, ...
- Être dans la majorité.

1559
01:25:47,862 --> 01:25:50,286
... que je parle stratégie
avec eux...

1560
01:25:50,411 --> 01:25:52,622
Je n'allais rien te promettre
si on ne parlait pas.

1561
01:25:52,747 --> 01:25:54,329
Deux stratégies différentes.

1562
01:25:54,454 --> 01:25:57,431
L'honnêteté, "on ne collabore pas
donc on ne parle pas",

1563
01:25:57,556 --> 01:26:00,992
ou "je veux qu'ils m'aiment tous,
je leur promets n'importe quoi."

1564
01:26:01,117 --> 01:26:04,132
Lui dit : "On bosse ensemble,
ou pas."

1565
01:26:04,257 --> 01:26:06,377
Ce n'est pas un bon jeu social,
pour moi.

1566
01:26:06,502 --> 01:26:09,272
Je voulais des liens avec tous
car j'avais des yeux partout.

1567
01:26:09,397 --> 01:26:12,442
Et j'ai joué à fond, je n'étais pas
Tommy le Glandeur.

1568
01:26:12,567 --> 01:26:14,523
Je suis venu... Je t'aime !

1569
01:26:14,648 --> 01:26:16,438
- Ça sonne bien.
- C'est vrai !

1570
01:26:16,563 --> 01:26:18,383
Mais qui agissait, décidait ?

1571
01:26:18,508 --> 01:26:20,873
Qui a fixé l'ordre des départs,
à huit ?

1572
01:26:20,998 --> 01:26:22,106
Et ensuite...

1573
01:26:22,450 --> 01:26:24,181
Dean nous a juste rejoints.

1574
01:26:24,306 --> 01:26:26,866
Dans ce jeu, on ne peut pas
être un suiveur.

1575
01:26:26,991 --> 01:26:28,704
Juste pour clarifier.

1576
01:26:28,829 --> 01:26:31,858
Tommy, quand as-tu décidé
de me trahir ?

1577
01:26:31,983 --> 01:26:34,609
Je serai honnête.
Probablement autour de huit,

1578
01:26:34,734 --> 01:26:36,963
je disais :
"Je ne peux pas la battre,

1579
01:26:37,088 --> 01:26:41,104
mais je veux la garder en tant que
bouclier social, comme Elaine."

1580
01:26:41,229 --> 01:26:44,165
Car je savais que si vous partiez
neuvième et huitième,

1581
01:26:44,290 --> 01:26:45,809
je partais septième.

1582
01:26:45,934 --> 01:26:48,393
Aurais-je aimé que tu sois ici ?
Absolument.

1583
01:26:48,518 --> 01:26:50,928
Je t'adore, tu as changé ma vie.
Vraiment.

1584
01:26:51,311 --> 01:26:53,483
Ce n'était pas facile du tout.

1585
01:26:54,261 --> 01:26:56,580
D'autres remarques
sur la partie sociale ?

1586
01:26:56,705 --> 01:26:58,922
- Vous êtes au coeur du sujet.
- Merci, Jeff.

1587
01:26:59,047 --> 01:27:01,758
Vous vous en sortez tous très bien.
J'apprends beaucoup.

1588
01:27:01,883 --> 01:27:04,152
J'apprécie tout cela
à sa juste valeur.

1589
01:27:04,277 --> 01:27:07,195
Il y a des limites
que je ne voulais pas franchir ici.

1590
01:27:07,320 --> 01:27:08,304
Pour moi.

1591
01:27:08,429 --> 01:27:12,435
Je les ai définies pour moi, ça n'a
pas d'importance dans l'immédiat.

1592
01:27:12,560 --> 01:27:14,506
Mais quelles étaient les limites,

1593
01:27:14,631 --> 01:27:17,257
dans cette partie "ruser",
dans votre jeu social,

1594
01:27:17,382 --> 01:27:19,166
que vous ne vouliez pas franchir ?

1595
01:27:19,291 --> 01:27:21,172
Quoi que ça signifie pour vous.

1596
01:27:21,297 --> 01:27:24,435
J'adore cette question.
Pour moi, c'était simple.

1597
01:27:24,560 --> 01:27:28,785
Je ne veux rien faire
qui me déplairait rétrospectivement.

1598
01:27:28,910 --> 01:27:32,043
J'essaye d'être transparente.
Je vais faire un truc, je le dis.

1599
01:27:32,168 --> 01:27:36,123
Donc en gros, je ne veux pas faire
un coup et le regretter plus tard.

1600
01:27:36,248 --> 01:27:37,494
OK, merci. Tommy ?

1601
01:27:38,197 --> 01:27:40,512
Avant de venir,
j'ai dit à mes élèves :

1602
01:27:40,637 --> 01:27:43,577
"Avertissement : c'est le 1er truc
que je vais faire pour moi-même."

1603
01:27:43,702 --> 01:27:46,347
J'ai passé ma vie à servir
les autres, servir mes gamins.

1604
01:27:46,472 --> 01:27:49,008
Alors j'ai dit :
"Je mentirai, tricherai, volerai,

1605
01:27:49,133 --> 01:27:51,175
ce qu'il faudra pour aller au bout.

1606
01:27:51,300 --> 01:27:54,178
Mais je n'irai jamais
jusqu'à tyranniser quelqu'un,

1607
01:27:54,303 --> 01:27:57,154
ce genre de choses,
car ça peut faire du mal."

1608
01:27:57,279 --> 01:28:00,422
- C'est ma limite.
- Super.

1609
01:28:00,547 --> 01:28:02,452
Et pour toi, Dean ?

1610
01:28:02,702 --> 01:28:05,108
- Laisse-moi y réfléchir.
- Bien sûr.

1611
01:28:07,277 --> 01:28:10,612
Je veux dire...
Je n'y ai jamais vraiment réfléchi.

1612
01:28:10,737 --> 01:28:14,411
Je n'avais pas de limites
clairement établies avant de venir.

1613
01:28:14,536 --> 01:28:17,317
J'imagine que je n'aurais
jamais promis

1614
01:28:17,442 --> 01:28:19,766
la finale à quelqu'un sans le penser.

1615
01:28:19,891 --> 01:28:22,105
Et je ne crois pas l'avoir fait.

1616
01:28:22,230 --> 01:28:24,140
Si je comprends bien,

1617
01:28:24,390 --> 01:28:27,830
tu n'avais aucune limite éthique
préétablie.

1618
01:28:27,955 --> 01:28:28,918
Correct.

1619
01:28:29,489 --> 01:28:31,963
Je ne suis pas sûre
de vraiment comprendre

1620
01:28:32,088 --> 01:28:33,850
qui tu es, ton essence.

1621
01:28:34,100 --> 01:28:36,219
Je comprends Noura et Tommy.

1622
01:28:36,344 --> 01:28:38,296
Mais j'ignore si j'ai vraiment

1623
01:28:38,421 --> 01:28:39,581
compris

1624
01:28:39,938 --> 01:28:40,757
Dean.

1625
01:28:41,911 --> 01:28:44,696
Je suis juste Dean Tranquille,
je suis les vibrations,

1626
01:28:44,821 --> 01:28:47,657
j'essaye de ne pas aller trop haut,
de rester optimiste

1627
01:28:47,782 --> 01:28:50,194
- et positif, beaucoup l'ont vu.
- Vrai.

1628
01:28:50,319 --> 01:28:54,839
Même au bas de l'échelle,
je vais peut-être recevoir une idole.

1629
01:28:54,964 --> 01:28:58,575
Et sinon, un cheeseburger
m'attend à Ponderosa,

1630
01:28:58,700 --> 01:29:00,810
et l'expérience était incroyable.

1631
01:29:00,935 --> 01:29:02,710
Ne jamais être négatif,

1632
01:29:02,835 --> 01:29:05,327
c'est mon gros, gros truc
dans la vie.

1633
01:29:05,452 --> 01:29:09,715
Et être optimiste... Oui, je pense
que c'était ma faiblesse.

1634
01:29:11,549 --> 01:29:14,248
Passons à la partie "dominer" du jeu.

1635
01:29:14,373 --> 01:29:17,531
Votre gestion des conditions
qui vous sont imposées.

1636
01:29:17,784 --> 01:29:20,793
Vous devez vivre dehors,
disputer les épreuves,

1637
01:29:20,918 --> 01:29:22,723
chercher des idoles,

1638
01:29:22,848 --> 01:29:25,435
gérer les mélanges,
les surprises du jeu.

1639
01:29:25,560 --> 01:29:26,815
Qui commence ?

1640
01:29:26,940 --> 01:29:29,361
J'imagine pouvoir parler

1641
01:29:29,486 --> 01:29:32,008
pour tous les fans de Survivor
du monde :

1642
01:29:32,133 --> 01:29:34,780
l'un des moments
auxquels on pense le plus,

1643
01:29:34,905 --> 01:29:37,441
c'est celui où on gagne
la dernière immunité.

1644
01:29:37,566 --> 01:29:38,815
Que ferait-on ?

1645
01:29:38,940 --> 01:29:41,884
Noura, tu as eu l'honneur
de cette position

1646
01:29:42,009 --> 01:29:43,716
pour la saison 39. Génial.

1647
01:29:43,841 --> 01:29:45,579
- Merci
- OK ?

1648
01:29:45,704 --> 01:29:49,212
Ce que tu as expliqué sur Lauren :
tout à fait sensé.

1649
01:29:49,337 --> 01:29:53,101
"Je vois Lauren comme une menace,
je doute de pouvoir la battre,

1650
01:29:53,226 --> 01:29:55,349
je l'envoie au feu." Super.

1651
01:29:55,474 --> 01:29:58,209
Mais le pendant de cette logique
devrait être :

1652
01:29:58,334 --> 01:30:00,639
"La personne que j'emmène avec moi,

1653
01:30:00,764 --> 01:30:03,072
je pense pouvoir la battre."

1654
01:30:03,197 --> 01:30:05,742
Donc s'il te plaît,
aide-moi à comprendre

1655
01:30:05,867 --> 01:30:08,546
un peu mieux comment tu as choisi
qui envoyer au feu

1656
01:30:08,671 --> 01:30:10,110
- et qui emmener.
- Sûr.

1657
01:30:10,235 --> 01:30:12,164
En gros, j'ai choisi Dean

1658
01:30:12,289 --> 01:30:15,331
car son jeu était juste
de suivre la majorité.

1659
01:30:15,779 --> 01:30:18,336
Il n'a jamais fait de gros coup.

1660
01:30:18,461 --> 01:30:22,284
C'était plus facile d'emmener
une personne au jeu faible.

1661
01:30:22,409 --> 01:30:24,327
Mais tu n'a pas emmené Dean.

1662
01:30:24,452 --> 01:30:26,362
Tu as emmené Tommy.

1663
01:30:26,487 --> 01:30:29,032
- Il n'a rien eu à faire.
- C'est très simple.

1664
01:30:29,157 --> 01:30:32,391
Tommy m'a semblé
plus facile à battre que Lauren.

1665
01:30:32,516 --> 01:30:35,857
Et il m'a donné l'impression
qu'il était si nul en feu

1666
01:30:35,982 --> 01:30:39,259
qu'il ne battrait pas Lauren.
Je le lui ai demandé plusieurs fois.

1667
01:30:39,384 --> 01:30:42,111
Merci. Si je peux enchaîner...
Tommy.

1668
01:30:42,236 --> 01:30:45,280
Tu tentes de faire quelque chose
d'inédit dans Survivor.

1669
01:30:45,405 --> 01:30:46,215
Oui.

1670
01:30:46,340 --> 01:30:47,885
- Gagner en mouton.
- Oui.

1671
01:30:48,010 --> 01:30:50,470
- On t'a emmené au bout. C'est inédit.
- Oui.

1672
01:30:50,595 --> 01:30:54,901
Je crois que ça montre que je suis
méchamment bon à ce jeu.

1673
01:30:55,026 --> 01:30:58,665
Elle dit qu'il est plus facile
à battre que moi.

1674
01:30:58,790 --> 01:31:01,894
Dean n'a-t-il pas une meilleure
histoire ? Il a gagné sa place.

1675
01:31:02,019 --> 01:31:04,269
Si tu veux
que la saison et son gagnant

1676
01:31:04,394 --> 01:31:06,894
se résument à qui a gagné
l'épreuve du feu,

1677
01:31:07,019 --> 01:31:09,448
alors oui, il a battu Lauren au feu.

1678
01:31:09,573 --> 01:31:13,876
Mais alors qu'elle était focalisée
sur Lauren, j'ai pu retourner le truc

1679
01:31:14,251 --> 01:31:17,010
et dire :
"Je n'ai jamais allumé de feu."

1680
01:31:17,135 --> 01:31:20,981
On ne m'a jamais vu le faire. C'était
fait exprès, dès le premier jour.

1681
01:31:21,106 --> 01:31:23,342
Ça m'a permis d'avoir cette place.

1682
01:31:23,912 --> 01:31:26,279
J'ai une question. Résumez-moi

1683
01:31:26,404 --> 01:31:29,559
vos approches stratégiques
des immunités individuelles.

1684
01:31:29,684 --> 01:31:32,261
- Noura, d'abord.
- En gros, au début du jeu,

1685
01:31:32,386 --> 01:31:34,534
ma tribu n'utilisait pas mes atouts.

1686
01:31:34,659 --> 01:31:38,522
Plus tard, quand c'est devenu
individuel, j'ai adoré.

1687
01:31:38,647 --> 01:31:41,139
Car j'étais responsable de moi-même.

1688
01:31:41,264 --> 01:31:43,239
Là, j'ai commencé à m'épanouir.

1689
01:31:43,364 --> 01:31:45,667
Je me suis donnée à fond
à chaque fois,

1690
01:31:45,792 --> 01:31:49,577
et ça m'a entraînée pour les épreuves
vraiment importantes de la suite.

1691
01:31:49,702 --> 01:31:51,029
Parfait. Dean ?

1692
01:31:52,022 --> 01:31:53,785
En groupe, je donnais tout.

1693
01:31:53,910 --> 01:31:56,267
Mais ce jeu
est comme une course de chevaux.

1694
01:31:56,392 --> 01:32:00,148
Donnez tout trop tôt, vous semblerez
dangereux et serez visé.

1695
01:32:00,273 --> 01:32:04,026
Ai-je gagné deux des trois dernières
immunités ? Absolument.

1696
01:32:04,151 --> 01:32:06,168
En a-t-il gagné ?

1697
01:32:07,018 --> 01:32:08,516
Oui, je perdais.

1698
01:32:08,641 --> 01:32:12,976
Mais j'ai toujours vu colliers
et idoles comme des malédictions.

1699
01:32:13,101 --> 01:32:16,038
Si vous avez une idole,
on va vous attaquer.

1700
01:32:16,288 --> 01:32:20,109
Mais les récompenses ?
J'ai emmené Janet, Lauren et Dan

1701
01:32:20,234 --> 01:32:21,778
à la visite des proches.

1702
01:32:21,903 --> 01:32:24,418
Ça, ça vous renforce un lien.

1703
01:32:24,843 --> 01:32:28,922
Un collier vous sauve une fois
et fait de vous une cible après.

1704
01:32:29,047 --> 01:32:32,371
Je n'en voulais pas.
Je misais tout sur le social.

1705
01:32:32,496 --> 01:32:36,392
Dis-tu que sur les trois critères
qui décident du gagnant,

1706
01:32:36,517 --> 01:32:39,822
tu n'étais bon que dans un
et tu as ignoré les autres ?

1707
01:32:39,947 --> 01:32:42,415
Non, car ma stratégie pour "dominer"

1708
01:32:42,540 --> 01:32:44,855
était de savoir
qui avait quel avantage.

1709
01:32:44,980 --> 01:32:47,897
Je savais pour l'idole de Janet,
et pour son avantage.

1710
01:32:48,022 --> 01:32:51,034
Je savais qu'il avait eu
l'annulateur à pile ou face.

1711
01:32:51,159 --> 01:32:54,210
Il me l'a dit, elle me l'a dit.
Voilà le lien.

1712
01:32:54,335 --> 01:32:58,566
Ce sont des avantages que j'ai
utilisés pour contrôler le jeu.

1713
01:32:58,823 --> 01:33:01,217
Mon pote a eu un jeu social épatant.

1714
01:33:01,342 --> 01:33:03,149
Mais comme l'a dit Missy,

1715
01:33:03,274 --> 01:33:06,122
au niveau avantages
et immunités : zéro.

1716
01:33:06,372 --> 01:33:08,825
Donc, s'agissant de "dominer" :

1717
01:33:09,075 --> 01:33:12,829
d'abord, Jamal m'a donné
un avantage de l'héritier.

1718
01:33:12,954 --> 01:33:15,498
Celui que j'ai donné à Jeff
était faux.

1719
01:33:15,623 --> 01:33:19,845
J'ai pris un bout de courrier,
je l'ai peint et donné à Jeff.

1720
01:33:20,213 --> 01:33:23,497
Donc à neuf et à six,
j'étais protégé. Voilà le vrai.

1721
01:33:23,622 --> 01:33:24,780
Non, Jamal ?

1722
01:33:26,200 --> 01:33:28,198
Non, Dean, il est faux.

1723
01:33:29,262 --> 01:33:31,498
Je suis allé sur l'Île des Idoles.

1724
01:33:31,623 --> 01:33:35,467
On m'a donné un papier vierge
et un stylo.

1725
01:33:35,836 --> 01:33:38,914
À moi de décider
ce que je voulais en faire,

1726
01:33:39,039 --> 01:33:41,113
- comme je le voulais.
- Cool.

1727
01:33:41,238 --> 01:33:43,317
Donc il n'a aucun pouvoir.

1728
01:33:43,442 --> 01:33:46,148
Mais ce qu'a fait Dean
est assez génial.

1729
01:33:46,273 --> 01:33:49,082
- Il n'a pas eu besoin de l'utiliser.
- Exact.

1730
01:33:49,207 --> 01:33:51,818
Et il nous le montre.
Il aurait pu être vrai. Génial.

1731
01:33:51,943 --> 01:33:53,736
- Tu le croyais vrai.
- Oui.

1732
01:33:53,861 --> 01:33:55,772
Et je n'ai pas fini.

1733
01:33:55,897 --> 01:33:57,974
À cinq, sur l'Île des Idoles,

1734
01:33:58,224 --> 01:34:00,910
mon pote cherchait à fond une idole.

1735
01:34:01,345 --> 01:34:04,580
Alors, qui l'a trouvée ?
Attendez, je vous montre.

1736
01:34:04,830 --> 01:34:07,639
- Ouah.
- J'ai un message, je vous le lis.

1737
01:34:08,784 --> 01:34:11,854
"On ne serait pas parti
sans un dernier test !

1738
01:34:12,204 --> 01:34:13,435
<i>Tu l'as réussi.</i>

1739
01:34:13,845 --> 01:34:15,091
<i>Bonne chance.</i>

1740
01:34:15,341 --> 01:34:16,786
<i>Sandra et Rob."</i>

1741
01:34:17,506 --> 01:34:19,112
Ouais, mon gars, allez !

1742
01:34:19,237 --> 01:34:21,230
À cinq, j'étais blindé.

1743
01:34:21,714 --> 01:34:24,068
Collier au cou, annulateur d'idole,

1744
01:34:24,193 --> 01:34:25,821
avantage de l'héritier,

1745
01:34:25,946 --> 01:34:27,270
idole d'immunité.

1746
01:34:27,395 --> 01:34:29,599
- Ai-je dû en jouer un ?
- Non.

1747
01:34:29,724 --> 01:34:31,024
- Non.
- Ouah.

1748
01:34:31,149 --> 01:34:32,663
Il a le jeu social.

1749
01:34:32,788 --> 01:34:35,663
Mais qu'a-t-il eu pour "dominer" ?
Rien.

1750
01:34:35,788 --> 01:34:39,342
Tout ce que tu pouvais faire,
je pouvais le faire mieux. Tout ça.

1751
01:34:39,467 --> 01:34:41,764
Oui, mais avec le collier...

1752
01:34:41,889 --> 01:34:43,279
- Tiens.
- Merci.

1753
01:34:43,868 --> 01:34:47,423
Avec le collier ou sans,
quelqu'un allait-il l'éliminer ?

1754
01:34:48,256 --> 01:34:49,091
Non.

1755
01:34:49,216 --> 01:34:51,460
L'île t'a fait un cadeau.

1756
01:34:51,585 --> 01:34:53,663
Tu peux l'accrocher au mur chez toi.

1757
01:34:53,788 --> 01:34:55,789
Dis-moi que ce n'était pas bien joué.

1758
01:34:55,914 --> 01:34:58,674
Mais non. Tu as trouvé des avantages.

1759
01:34:58,799 --> 01:35:01,225
- T'en es-tu servi ?
- C'était inutile.

1760
01:35:01,350 --> 01:35:02,852
Parce qu'on t'a emmené.

1761
01:35:02,977 --> 01:35:05,241
Tu aurais fini ici de toute façon.

1762
01:35:05,366 --> 01:35:07,944
Karishma a joué une idole.
Ça, c'était un coup.

1763
01:35:08,069 --> 01:35:10,490
- Abattre quelqu'un et...
- Tommy, laisse-moi t'aider.

1764
01:35:10,615 --> 01:35:12,958
- Tu tentes de minimiser ses coups.
- Oui.

1765
01:35:13,083 --> 01:35:15,481
- Moi, j'éviterais.
- Et je dirais...

1766
01:35:15,606 --> 01:35:17,587
- J'essaye de t'aider.
- Je...

1767
01:35:17,837 --> 01:35:21,146
- Ce n'est pas le consensus.
- Je ne suis pas d'accord.

1768
01:35:21,416 --> 01:35:24,360
- Je veux l'entendre.
- Et s'il est assis ici,

1769
01:35:24,485 --> 01:35:26,462
c'est aussi
car j'ai eu deux colliers.

1770
01:35:26,587 --> 01:35:29,865
- Dean t'a sauvé, Tommy. Vraiment.
- C'est mon jeu social.

1771
01:35:29,990 --> 01:35:33,013
- Ou le mien, peut-être ?
- Non, c'était un super coup social.

1772
01:35:33,138 --> 01:35:36,639
Tommy, les infos que tu avais,
les as-tu partagées avec Dean ?

1773
01:35:36,764 --> 01:35:37,689
Oui.

1774
01:35:37,814 --> 01:35:40,849
Tu lui as dit pour tous
les avantages, et en prime,

1775
01:35:40,974 --> 01:35:42,328
il a eu les colliers.

1776
01:35:42,453 --> 01:35:44,812
Et même si l'avantage de l'héritier
était faux,

1777
01:35:44,937 --> 01:35:47,563
il en a fait
un argument en sa faveur.

1778
01:35:47,688 --> 01:35:49,229
- Je crois...
- Cependant,

1779
01:35:49,354 --> 01:35:52,688
Tommy a donné ces infos à Dean
dans le cadre de son jeu social,

1780
01:35:52,813 --> 01:35:55,519
mais aussi car il le prenait
pour un mouton.

1781
01:35:55,644 --> 01:35:59,818
Si Dean nous avait dit ici : "Je
jouais le mouton depuis le début.",

1782
01:35:59,943 --> 01:36:03,466
je dirais : "Ouais !"
Mais la stratégie de Dean...

1783
01:36:07,386 --> 01:36:09,839
Sa stratégie était d'être moyen.

1784
01:36:09,964 --> 01:36:11,365
Très différent.

1785
01:36:11,490 --> 01:36:12,650
- Oui.
- Vrai.

1786
01:36:12,775 --> 01:36:16,596
La stratégie d'être au milieu,
je pense l'avoir accomplie.

1787
01:36:16,721 --> 01:36:21,258
Mes deux plus proches alliées
étaient Elizabeth et Elaine.

1788
01:36:21,383 --> 01:36:25,346
Avec Elizabeth, dès les tout premiers
jours, on avait un pacte secret

1789
01:36:25,471 --> 01:36:27,690
pour aller en finale ensemble.

1790
01:36:27,815 --> 01:36:30,442
Stop. Quand Jamal lui a demandé
ses limites éthiques,

1791
01:36:30,567 --> 01:36:34,080
Dean a dit : "Ne pas passer d'accord
pour aller en finale."

1792
01:36:34,205 --> 01:36:36,609
- Vrai.
- Et tu en avais un avec Elizabeth !

1793
01:36:36,734 --> 01:36:38,791
- Merci !
- Et aussi avec moi !

1794
01:36:38,916 --> 01:36:40,036
Et avec moi !

1795
01:36:40,700 --> 01:36:43,340
Seigneur !
Quand il pleut, c'est du sérieux !

1796
01:36:43,465 --> 01:36:46,058
Mon Dieu, c'est de la folie !

1797
01:36:47,609 --> 01:36:50,346
Dean, on te critique
car tu t'es contredit.

1798
01:36:50,471 --> 01:36:53,794
Vous le voyez tel qu'il est !
Traquant l'opportunité,

1799
01:36:53,919 --> 01:36:56,052
cherchant toujours la majorité.

1800
01:36:56,177 --> 01:36:58,869
- Voilà son jeu.
- Mais j'étais avec toi tout du long !

1801
01:36:58,994 --> 01:37:02,525
- Lui as-tu promis ça ?
- Pourquoi ça ne sort que maintenant ?

1802
01:37:02,650 --> 01:37:04,326
Parce que tu es là et pas moi !

1803
01:37:04,451 --> 01:37:06,573
- Non, mais ce soir ?
- Voilà pourquoi !

1804
01:37:06,698 --> 01:37:08,030
Aïe, aïe, aïe !

1805
01:37:12,384 --> 01:37:16,187
Ouah. Y a-t-il autre chose,
maintenant que la pluie est partie ?

1806
01:37:16,312 --> 01:37:19,275
C'était rafraîchissant.
C'est comme un nouveau départ.

1807
01:37:19,618 --> 01:37:22,311
Toute l'énergie négative
a été lessivée.

1808
01:37:23,432 --> 01:37:27,616
Bien. Passons à la dernière phase
de ce dernier conseil : "durer".

1809
01:37:27,741 --> 01:37:29,418
On en revient à vous.

1810
01:37:29,668 --> 01:37:32,054
Avez-vous fait le travail
qui devait être fait ?

1811
01:37:32,179 --> 01:37:34,657
Avez-vous éliminé
des gens qui voteront pour vous ?

1812
01:37:34,782 --> 01:37:37,908
Si vous avez des doutes
sur quelqu'un, c'est le moment.

1813
01:37:38,033 --> 01:37:39,633
Tommy, lancez-vous !

1814
01:37:40,563 --> 01:37:43,236
Saison 39, 39 jours.

1815
01:37:43,361 --> 01:37:46,925
On doit jouer dès le 1er jour.
J'ai tissé des liens avec vous tous.

1816
01:37:47,050 --> 01:37:49,428
Et oui, merci
pour les super souvenirs.

1817
01:37:49,553 --> 01:37:53,309
Mais qui doit représenter
le gagnant de la saison 39 ?

1818
01:37:53,559 --> 01:37:57,895
J'ai joué à fond et fait
une tonne de coups risqués.

1819
01:37:58,020 --> 01:38:00,616
J'étais sans cesse menacé.
Ce que j'ai dû faire,

1820
01:38:00,741 --> 01:38:03,736
c'est proposer des gens à éliminer
avant de l'être moi-même.

1821
01:38:03,861 --> 01:38:05,895
J'ai fait des alliances,
franchi des lignes.

1822
01:38:06,020 --> 01:38:09,892
Sans avoir besoin de collier, j'ai
fait des coups et suis arrivé ici.

1823
01:38:10,017 --> 01:38:13,278
Pour moi, c'est ça, Survivor.

1824
01:38:14,162 --> 01:38:15,071
Noura.

1825
01:38:15,930 --> 01:38:19,048
Merci pour votre temps,
vos questions, votre perspicacité.

1826
01:38:19,173 --> 01:38:22,333
Nous avons beaucoup appris
sur nous-mêmes ici, moi en tout cas.

1827
01:38:22,458 --> 01:38:24,439
Pour moi, ça, c'est Noura.

1828
01:38:24,564 --> 01:38:28,878
Dans ce jeu, j'ai voulu être
transparente, ouverte, authentique.

1829
01:38:29,003 --> 01:38:32,203
Vous m'avez aimée, peut-être parfois
détestée, pour qui je suis.

1830
01:38:32,328 --> 01:38:35,151
Vous m'avez acceptée,
m'avez permis d'être moi-même.

1831
01:38:35,276 --> 01:38:37,840
Je suis une joueuse
comme on n'en a jamais vue.

1832
01:38:37,965 --> 01:38:40,682
Je suis un électron libre,
un être d'amour,

1833
01:38:40,807 --> 01:38:43,526
mais je peux être bizarre, folle,
dire des trucs blessants.

1834
01:38:43,908 --> 01:38:47,897
J'ai fait mon possible pour utiliser
des outils, gagner des épreuves.

1835
01:38:48,022 --> 01:38:50,599
Je suis fière d'être ici,
quoi qu'il arrive ce soir.

1836
01:38:50,724 --> 01:38:53,598
Quand j'étais pleinement moi,
je me sentais épanouie.

1837
01:38:53,723 --> 01:38:57,506
Et j'ai noué des liens sociaux,
et ça a profité à ma stratégie

1838
01:38:57,631 --> 01:39:00,817
et m'a aidée à arriver ici.
Donc, merci.

1839
01:39:01,860 --> 01:39:03,393
- Bien parlé.
- Merci.

1840
01:39:03,518 --> 01:39:05,213
Dean, concluez !

1841
01:39:05,631 --> 01:39:06,702
Alors...

1842
01:39:07,066 --> 01:39:10,265
On pense à Survivor,
on est tous fans de longue date.

1843
01:39:10,390 --> 01:39:13,992
Je veux que vous pensiez
à ces moments époustouflants,

1844
01:39:14,117 --> 01:39:17,147
le deuxième annulateur d'idole
jamais joué dans le jeu,

1845
01:39:17,272 --> 01:39:20,019
avec succès,
le fait de trouver une idole...

1846
01:39:20,144 --> 01:39:23,343
Et associez ça aux moments
dans le jeu

1847
01:39:23,468 --> 01:39:26,502
où vous étiez désespérés,
le dos au mur.

1848
01:39:26,627 --> 01:39:28,832
C'est ce que j'ai vécu tout du long.

1849
01:39:28,957 --> 01:39:31,974
Sur la plage Lairo,
un mélange à cinq - trois.

1850
01:39:32,099 --> 01:39:34,476
Bas de l'échelle, dos au mur.

1851
01:39:34,601 --> 01:39:38,371
À la fusion, je trouve mon chemin,
ma petite bande.

1852
01:39:38,496 --> 01:39:41,428
Et au dernier quart-temps,
vous avez vu mon palmarès.

1853
01:39:41,553 --> 01:39:43,299
Boum, boum, boum.

1854
01:39:43,424 --> 01:39:46,255
J'étais au quintette final
avec tous ces bijoux.

1855
01:39:46,380 --> 01:39:50,494
Et si vous ne m'aidez pas à graver ça
dans l'histoire de Survivor ce soir...

1856
01:39:50,619 --> 01:39:53,664
Ne l'oubliez pas :
je n'ai pas eu à les jouer !

1857
01:39:53,789 --> 01:39:57,305
J'étais là, souriant,
sachant que j'irais au bout,

1858
01:39:57,430 --> 01:40:01,284
car je l'avais convaincu
de m'y emmener.

1859
01:40:01,409 --> 01:40:04,643
Je vous demande donc
de contribuer à écrire l'histoire.

1860
01:40:04,768 --> 01:40:05,791
Avec moi.

1861
01:40:08,172 --> 01:40:12,192
Ça a été un conseil bien rempli.
Très beau boulot, les jurés.

1862
01:40:12,317 --> 01:40:14,850
Une étude minutieuse des finalistes.

1863
01:40:15,100 --> 01:40:17,620
Il ne reste plus qu'à voter.

1864
01:40:17,870 --> 01:40:20,807
Je laisse aux juré un moment
pour digérer tout ça,

1865
01:40:20,932 --> 01:40:24,413
puis nous voterons, pour dire
qui gagnera un million de dollars.

1866
01:40:35,210 --> 01:40:37,494
Bien. Tommy, Noura, Dean,

1867
01:40:37,619 --> 01:40:39,646
il n'y a plus rien à dire.

1868
01:40:39,771 --> 01:40:42,432
Il ne reste plus qu'à voter.

1869
01:40:42,557 --> 01:40:45,314
Jurés, ce soir,
vous votez pour un gagnant,

1870
01:40:45,439 --> 01:40:49,111
la personne qui, selon vous, mérite
le plus le titre d'Ultime Survivant

1871
01:40:49,236 --> 01:40:52,888
et le prix d'un million de dollars
qui va avec.

1872
01:40:53,013 --> 01:40:54,410
Il est temps de voter.

1873
01:40:54,535 --> 01:40:55,956
Jack, à vous.

1874
01:41:06,763 --> 01:41:09,117
C'est bien qui je veux ? Genre...

1875
01:41:09,242 --> 01:41:10,194
OK.

1876
01:41:16,145 --> 01:41:18,483
Je t'aime. C'est ça, la loyauté.

1877
01:41:18,890 --> 01:41:20,923
<i>Je savais que tu pouvais le faire.</i>

1878
01:41:32,938 --> 01:41:35,642
Mon gars. Tu as joué
comme je voulais le faire.

1879
01:41:36,139 --> 01:41:38,375
<i>Un dernier quart-temps explosif.</i>

1880
01:41:38,500 --> 01:41:39,635
<i>Chapeau !</i>

1881
01:41:44,241 --> 01:41:45,594
Bon...

1882
01:41:45,719 --> 01:41:48,903
Voter pour un gagnant de Survivor.
C'est dingue.

1883
01:42:08,280 --> 01:42:10,274
Je vais chercher les votes.

1884
01:42:11,583 --> 01:42:13,581
<font color="#9C47AF">Ouah. C'est fini.</font>

1885
01:42:19,258 --> 01:42:20,209
Tommy,

1886
01:42:20,459 --> 01:42:22,544
Noura, Dean, jurés.

1887
01:42:22,669 --> 01:42:26,215
Merci d'avoir joué à Survivor
et partagé vos histoires avec nous.

1888
01:42:26,340 --> 01:42:30,252
Nous nous reverrons à Los Angeles
pour la lecture des votes.

1889
01:43:16,616 --> 01:43:18,864
Super ! Merci ! Asseyez-vous !

1890
01:43:18,989 --> 01:43:20,493
Allons-y !

1891
01:43:21,445 --> 01:43:22,304
Bien.

1892
01:43:22,429 --> 01:43:24,121
D'abord, à vous tous,

1893
01:43:24,246 --> 01:43:27,753
merci pour cette nouvelle
super saison de Survivor.

1894
01:43:30,829 --> 01:43:33,753
À Tommy, Noura et Dean :

1895
01:43:33,878 --> 01:43:37,809
peu importe si vous êtes fans ou pas,
fidèles à l'émission ou pas,

1896
01:43:37,934 --> 01:43:39,588
si vous rêviez de jouer,

1897
01:43:39,713 --> 01:43:44,238
on ne peut pas anticiper
ce que sont 39 jours dans la jungle.

1898
01:43:44,363 --> 01:43:46,643
Mais vous trois avez accompli ça.

1899
01:43:46,768 --> 01:43:50,216
Et quel que soit le résultat,
ça vous appartient.

1900
01:43:50,341 --> 01:43:51,705
Donc, félicitations.

1901
01:43:51,830 --> 01:43:52,932
Mais c'est

1902
01:43:53,479 --> 01:43:55,180
une compétition.

1903
01:43:55,917 --> 01:43:58,486
Et il ne peut y avoir qu'un gagnant.

1904
01:43:58,611 --> 01:44:00,335
Je vais lire les votes.

1905
01:44:03,581 --> 01:44:04,758
Premier vote :

1906
01:44:05,436 --> 01:44:06,471
Tommy.

1907
01:44:11,756 --> 01:44:13,691
Dean.
Un vote Tommy, un vote Dean.

1908
01:44:18,055 --> 01:44:19,509
Deux votes Tommy,

1909
01:44:19,634 --> 01:44:20,863
un vote Dean.

1910
01:44:24,819 --> 01:44:26,508
Dean. Nouvelle égalité.

1911
01:44:26,633 --> 01:44:28,506
Deux votes Tommy, deux votes Dean.

1912
01:44:33,806 --> 01:44:34,900
Tommy.

1913
01:44:35,025 --> 01:44:36,232
Trois votes Tommy,

1914
01:44:36,357 --> 01:44:37,558
deux votes Dean.

1915
01:44:41,890 --> 01:44:42,919
Tommy.

1916
01:44:43,044 --> 01:44:45,172
Quatre votes Tommy, deux votes Dean.

1917
01:44:49,482 --> 01:44:50,612
Tommy.

1918
01:44:50,737 --> 01:44:53,229
Cinq votes Tommy, deux votes Dean.

1919
01:44:56,237 --> 01:44:57,665
Le gagnant de Survivor :

1920
01:44:57,790 --> 01:44:58,979
Tommy !

1921
01:45:17,092 --> 01:45:19,209
Montre-nous ces votes, Joe !

1922
01:45:19,334 --> 01:45:21,926
Voyons qui a voté pour qui.

1923
01:45:22,747 --> 01:45:23,924
Et voilà.

1924
01:45:24,245 --> 01:45:27,272
Deux votes pour Dean,
tous les autres pour Tommy.

1925
01:45:27,397 --> 01:45:31,118
Tout de suite, la Réunion. Nous
parlerons avec un Tommy très excité

1926
01:45:31,243 --> 01:45:32,667
à propos de loyauté.

1927
01:45:32,792 --> 01:45:35,719
Et nous vous dirons
ce que sera notre 40e saison.

1928
01:45:35,844 --> 01:45:37,839
Et nous parlerons avec Kellee

1929
01:45:38,089 --> 01:45:40,786
de ce qui tout ce qui s'est passé
entre elle et Dan

1930
01:45:40,911 --> 01:45:42,799
et de ce que nous en avons appris.

1931
01:45:42,924 --> 01:45:44,880
La Réunion, c'est tout de suite !

1932
01:45:49,267 --> 01:45:52,835
<font color=#9C47AF>Team Survivor ST
http://survivor-st.variousforum.com/</font>

1933
01:45:52,960 --> 01:45:56,105
<font color=#9C47AF>Traduction : Ozzy, Pieih, Jack Bauer</font>

1934
01:45:56,230 --> 01:45:59,423
<font color=#9C47AF>Relecture : Jack Bauer, Verose, Ozzy</font>

1935
01:45:59,548 --> 01:46:02,667
<font color=#9C47AF>Synchro : Verose, Jack Bauer</font>



## S40E14

1
00:00:00,000 --> 00:00:04,162
WWW.MY-SUBS.CO

﻿1
00:00:01,501 --> 00:00:04,921
Welcome to the finale of
<i>Survivor: Winners at War.</i>

2
00:00:05,004 --> 00:00:09,008
Now, normally, on a finale
night, we're in Los Angeles,

3
00:00:09,092 --> 00:00:10,885
we're live, we're all together,

4
00:00:10,969 --> 00:00:14,597
packed house full of
screaming<i> Survivor</i> fans,

5
00:00:14,681 --> 00:00:18,226
giant Tribal Council
and some really great energy.

6
00:00:18,309 --> 00:00:20,103
But for obvious reasons,
we can't do that tonight.

7
00:00:20,186 --> 00:00:22,105
So instead,

8
00:00:22,188 --> 00:00:24,107
we're in my garage.

9
00:00:24,190 --> 00:00:26,151
For real.

10
00:00:26,234 --> 00:00:28,945
The amazing
<i>Survivor</i> art department

11
00:00:29,028 --> 00:00:32,991
designed a Tribal Council set
and they shipped it to me

12
00:00:33,074 --> 00:00:34,284
in these two huge crates--

13
00:00:34,367 --> 00:00:36,703
this was in pieces,
I mean, brick by brick--

14
00:00:36,786 --> 00:00:40,206
along with a instruction guide,
basically a-a manual

15
00:00:40,290 --> 00:00:42,459
for how to build
a Tribal Council for dummies--

16
00:00:42,542 --> 00:00:43,835
me being the dummy--

17
00:00:43,918 --> 00:00:45,920
that would allow me
to build this in my garage.

18
00:00:46,004 --> 00:00:48,423
Yes, I might have had a little
help from our 16-year-old.

19
00:00:48,506 --> 00:00:49,549
But we've had
a great time doing it.

20
00:00:49,632 --> 00:00:52,302
They also shipped out
the cameras, a couple of lights,

21
00:00:52,385 --> 00:00:53,303
and FaceTime,
getting them set up.

22
00:00:53,386 --> 00:00:55,305
There are no camera operators.

23
00:00:55,388 --> 00:00:58,266
We're using our home Internet
to transmit.

24
00:00:58,349 --> 00:01:01,269
This is my daily EarPod
that I use for sports.

25
00:01:01,352 --> 00:01:03,271
That's the microphone.

26
00:01:03,354 --> 00:01:04,314
People ask if<i> Survivor</i> is real.
Come on.

27
00:01:04,397 --> 00:01:06,316
This is as real as it gets.

28
00:01:06,399 --> 00:01:09,152
And it's the perfect way
to end this fantastic season,

29
00:01:09,235 --> 00:01:11,654
so let's get into it.

30
00:01:11,738 --> 00:01:13,156
This was the biggest season
we'd ever done.

31
00:01:13,239 --> 00:01:19,204
20 winners, $2 million prize,
the introduction of fire tokens,

32
00:01:19,287 --> 00:01:21,331
the return of
the Edge of Extinction,

33
00:01:21,414 --> 00:01:23,333
and gameplay that has
truly taken<i> Survivor</i>

34
00:01:23,416 --> 00:01:24,751
to the next level.

35
00:01:24,834 --> 00:01:28,046
And I've heard from so many
of you, so many<i> Survivor</i> fans,

36
00:01:28,129 --> 00:01:30,965
so many<i> Survivor</i> families, that
I know are watching tonight,

37
00:01:31,049 --> 00:01:32,509
saying, week after week,

38
00:01:32,592 --> 00:01:34,344
"This is the greatest season
of all time."

39
00:01:34,427 --> 00:01:37,806
I agree. I think this is the
greatest season we've ever done.

40
00:01:37,889 --> 00:01:42,227
And for a show that has been on
for 20 years and 40 seasons,

41
00:01:42,310 --> 00:01:44,354
it really is saying something.

42
00:01:44,437 --> 00:01:46,898
And all credit goes
to the players.

43
00:01:46,981 --> 00:01:48,358
They did this.
Put 'em up there.

44
00:01:48,441 --> 00:01:51,903
They deserve all of the praise.

45
00:01:51,986 --> 00:01:54,531
20 returning winners
who battled all season.

46
00:01:54,614 --> 00:01:57,200
There they are,
safe and sound at home tonight.

47
00:01:57,283 --> 00:01:58,409
Nice to get a little peek
into their world.

48
00:01:58,493 --> 00:02:02,247
They'll be watching with their
family, loved ones, friends,

49
00:02:02,330 --> 00:02:05,708
as we bring this season
to a close.

50
00:02:05,792 --> 00:02:10,505
So I hope you are ready
for a packed finale,

51
00:02:10,588 --> 00:02:12,924
because this is-- it's epic.

52
00:02:13,007 --> 00:02:14,509
It is dramatic.

53
00:02:14,592 --> 00:02:15,718
It's emotional.

54
00:02:15,802 --> 00:02:17,011
It's unpredictable.

55
00:02:17,095 --> 00:02:19,514
There is so much story going on,

56
00:02:19,597 --> 00:02:22,016
we don't have time
for a reunion show.

57
00:02:22,100 --> 00:02:23,226
It is that packed. You'll see.

58
00:02:23,309 --> 00:02:26,271
And at the end of the night,
we'll be right here.

59
00:02:26,354 --> 00:02:27,730
We'll have the urn
with the votes.

60
00:02:27,814 --> 00:02:30,233
We have Zoom set up
for the final three.

61
00:02:30,316 --> 00:02:32,861
And we will crown the champion
of<i> Survivor: Winners at War,</i>

62
00:02:32,944 --> 00:02:34,404
which comes with
huge bragging rights--

63
00:02:34,487 --> 00:02:36,781
are they the best of all time?--

64
00:02:36,865 --> 00:02:40,410
and $2 million
for their efforts.

65
00:02:40,493 --> 00:02:41,995
So let's set it up.

66
00:02:42,078 --> 00:02:43,580
We have our final five:

67
00:02:43,663 --> 00:02:45,415
Sarah, Ben, Tony,
Michele, Denise.

68
00:02:45,498 --> 00:02:48,042
Then we have
the Edge of Extinction,

69
00:02:48,126 --> 00:02:50,587
where everybody,
with the exception of Sandra,

70
00:02:50,670 --> 00:02:51,462
is still in it.

71
00:02:51,546 --> 00:02:53,840
They're gonna battle
in one challenge.

72
00:02:53,923 --> 00:02:55,800
One of them will
get back in the game.

73
00:02:55,884 --> 00:02:58,428
This is why they've been living
out there, for this one shot.

74
00:02:58,511 --> 00:02:59,470
That person will make
the final six.

75
00:02:59,554 --> 00:03:01,431
And from that point forward,

76
00:03:01,514 --> 00:03:05,268
I promise you it's a beautiful
but bloody battle to the end.

77
00:03:05,351 --> 00:03:08,104
So buckle up. Here we go.

78
00:03:08,187 --> 00:03:10,481
The finale of
<i>Survivor: Winners at War.</i>

79
00:03:13,526 --> 00:03:15,528
♪ ♪

80
00:03:23,161 --> 00:03:24,454
Come on in, guys!

81
00:03:40,553 --> 00:03:42,347
All right.

82
00:03:42,430 --> 00:03:43,848
Final five.

83
00:03:43,932 --> 00:03:46,100
Today you will not compete.

84
00:03:46,184 --> 00:03:46,601
Today you watch.

85
00:03:46,684 --> 00:03:48,770
Come on in, guys!

86
00:03:48,853 --> 00:03:51,898
♪ ♪

87
00:03:54,233 --> 00:03:57,528
Returning from the Edge
of Extinction for the last time.

88
00:03:59,572 --> 00:04:03,660
Edge of Extinction
started 33 days ago

89
00:04:03,743 --> 00:04:07,038
with Natalie, first person
voted out on day two.

90
00:04:07,121 --> 00:04:11,167
One after another, you were
voted out and sent to the Edge,

91
00:04:11,250 --> 00:04:13,836
waiting for this moment
right here,

92
00:04:13,920 --> 00:04:17,465
a chance to earn your way
back into this game

93
00:04:17,548 --> 00:04:21,010
with a legit shot
at the title of Sole Survivor

94
00:04:21,094 --> 00:04:24,347
and the $2 million prize
at stake.

95
00:04:24,430 --> 00:04:26,975
This is that moment.
Let's get to it.

96
00:04:27,058 --> 00:04:30,061
<i>For today's challenge,</i>
<i>you'll be attached to a rope.</i>

97
00:04:30,144 --> 00:04:33,064
<i>On my go, you'll race</i>
<i>through a fence obstacle</i>

98
00:04:33,147 --> 00:04:34,691
<i>and then a post obstacle.</i>

99
00:04:34,774 --> 00:04:36,734
<i>You'll then dig up a rope rung</i>

100
00:04:36,818 --> 00:04:38,528
<i>and use it</i>
<i>to build a rope bridge.</i>

101
00:04:38,611 --> 00:04:40,530
<i>You'll then race to the end,</i>
<i>where you must maneuver</i>

102
00:04:40,613 --> 00:04:44,117
<i>two balls through a table maze.</i>

103
00:04:44,200 --> 00:04:48,997
First person to land both their
balls earns their way back in.

104
00:04:49,080 --> 00:04:51,541
This is the moment.
Let's see what you do with it.

105
00:04:51,624 --> 00:04:53,876
Take your spots.
We'll get it on.

106
00:04:53,960 --> 00:04:56,045
Here we go. Good luck.

107
00:04:56,129 --> 00:04:58,131
♪ ♪

108
00:05:04,303 --> 00:05:06,723
All right, during your time
on Extinction,

109
00:05:06,806 --> 00:05:10,226
you worked hard for a shot
at earning some advantages.

110
00:05:10,310 --> 00:05:12,103
Natalie, Parvati,
Yul and Wendell

111
00:05:12,186 --> 00:05:14,063
bought the first advantage.

112
00:05:14,147 --> 00:05:18,735
They will skip the fence
obstacle and start at the post.

113
00:05:18,818 --> 00:05:22,030
Natalie also bought
the second advantage,

114
00:05:22,113 --> 00:05:24,073
which allows her
to skip the dig.

115
00:05:24,157 --> 00:05:29,245
Her rope rung will be waiting
for her at the rope bridge.

116
00:05:29,328 --> 00:05:31,247
She also bought
the third advantage,

117
00:05:31,330 --> 00:05:35,084
which means one-third
of her rope bridge

118
00:05:35,168 --> 00:05:35,585
is already assembled.

119
00:05:35,668 --> 00:05:37,628
Big advantages.

120
00:05:37,712 --> 00:05:39,630
Let's see what you do with them.
Here we go.

121
00:05:39,714 --> 00:05:41,507
Survivors ready?

122
00:05:43,801 --> 00:05:45,011
Go!

123
00:05:46,012 --> 00:05:47,430
It is on.

124
00:05:47,513 --> 00:05:50,266
This is it,
your return challenge.

125
00:05:50,349 --> 00:05:53,895
Out of the gate, four people
have the first advantage.

126
00:05:53,978 --> 00:05:57,065
Everybody else is gonna
run the entire course.

127
00:05:57,148 --> 00:05:58,941
(grunting)

128
00:05:59,025 --> 00:06:01,444
Yul is through quickly.
He's out first.

129
00:06:01,527 --> 00:06:04,280
Yul can start digging.

130
00:06:04,363 --> 00:06:06,616
Parvati right behind him.

131
00:06:06,699 --> 00:06:09,118
Wendell is through.
He can start digging.

132
00:06:09,202 --> 00:06:10,119
(grunting)

133
00:06:10,203 --> 00:06:13,081
Everybody else
launching themselves

134
00:06:13,164 --> 00:06:15,166
through this first obstacle.

135
00:06:18,753 --> 00:06:22,298
Natalie, who has
all three advantages,

136
00:06:22,381 --> 00:06:24,509
is stuck in the first section
she has to run.

137
00:06:27,011 --> 00:06:29,931
It is costing her a lot of time.

138
00:06:30,014 --> 00:06:31,224
She cannot get through.

139
00:06:34,268 --> 00:06:36,646
Wendell is through. He can start
working on his rope bridge.

140
00:06:36,729 --> 00:06:38,523
Boston Rob is through.

141
00:06:38,606 --> 00:06:39,982
He's now where Natalie is.

142
00:06:40,066 --> 00:06:41,984
Here comes Sophie.

143
00:06:42,068 --> 00:06:45,154
Wow, what an unexpected
turn of events.

144
00:06:45,238 --> 00:06:48,616
Three advantages, and she can't
get out of the first section.

145
00:06:48,699 --> 00:06:51,244
Rob is through quickly.
He can start digging.

146
00:06:52,245 --> 00:06:54,205
Natalie finally through.

147
00:06:54,288 --> 00:06:56,124
Tyson gonna start to dig.

148
00:06:56,207 --> 00:06:58,626
Natalie's good.
You skip the dig.

149
00:06:58,709 --> 00:07:01,337
Natalie goes
right to the rope bridge.

150
00:07:01,420 --> 00:07:05,174
It is now Natalie and Wendell
in the lead.

151
00:07:05,258 --> 00:07:06,509
But a lot of people are in this.

152
00:07:06,592 --> 00:07:07,969
(panting):
Okay.

153
00:07:08,052 --> 00:07:10,680
(grunting)

154
00:07:15,268 --> 00:07:17,645
Yul has his rope rung.
He's good.

155
00:07:17,728 --> 00:07:19,522
He's working on the rope bridge.

156
00:07:19,605 --> 00:07:21,732
Parvati's got hers.

157
00:07:21,816 --> 00:07:25,236
It is Natalie, Parvati,
Yul and Wendell.

158
00:07:25,319 --> 00:07:27,697
All four had advantages
in this challenge,

159
00:07:27,780 --> 00:07:29,782
and right now
they are paying off.

160
00:07:34,453 --> 00:07:35,913
Another setback for Natalie.

161
00:07:38,457 --> 00:07:38,916
Rob's in it now.

162
00:07:39,000 --> 00:07:41,502
Tyson staying in it.

163
00:07:41,586 --> 00:07:42,920
Sophie's got hers.

164
00:07:43,004 --> 00:07:43,713
We got a challenge.

165
00:07:46,507 --> 00:07:48,509
It's Wendell in the lead.

166
00:07:48,593 --> 00:07:51,387
Natalie right on his tail,
but she had three advantages.

167
00:07:51,470 --> 00:07:53,222
Jeremy has his.

168
00:07:53,306 --> 00:07:54,765
Kim has hers.

169
00:07:54,849 --> 00:07:56,601
Everybody else still fighting.

170
00:07:57,643 --> 00:08:00,062
Wendell is through first.

171
00:08:00,146 --> 00:08:02,607
He's working on his knots,
trying to release those balls

172
00:08:02,690 --> 00:08:04,400
for the table maze.

173
00:08:04,483 --> 00:08:06,068
There's still
a lot of challenge left.

174
00:08:06,152 --> 00:08:07,403
That table maze is tough.

175
00:08:07,486 --> 00:08:08,696
Rob's getting very close.

176
00:08:08,779 --> 00:08:10,406
Tyson's still in this.

177
00:08:11,532 --> 00:08:13,451
No, Natalie's got to go back.

178
00:08:13,534 --> 00:08:15,578
Natalie has one rope down.

179
00:08:15,661 --> 00:08:18,080
She's got to go back,
re-hook it.

180
00:08:18,164 --> 00:08:20,541
Another setback for Natalie.

181
00:08:21,834 --> 00:08:23,586
Wendell has his two balls.

182
00:08:23,669 --> 00:08:24,879
He's first to the maze.

183
00:08:24,962 --> 00:08:26,714
Trying to land that first ball.

184
00:08:29,508 --> 00:08:31,886
Wendell drops.
Got to go back.

185
00:08:31,969 --> 00:08:33,554
Boston Rob is through.

186
00:08:33,638 --> 00:08:34,597
Yul is through.

187
00:08:34,680 --> 00:08:36,307
Here comes Sophie.

188
00:08:36,390 --> 00:08:37,433
Jeremy's in this.

189
00:08:37,516 --> 00:08:39,769
Natalie finally through.

190
00:08:39,852 --> 00:08:42,438
It is Wendell's challenge
right now.

191
00:08:42,521 --> 00:08:42,647
Can anybody catch him?

192
00:08:46,317 --> 00:08:48,986
Wendell very close
to that first ball.

193
00:08:54,033 --> 00:08:56,244
And he's got it.
Wendell has the first.

194
00:08:56,327 --> 00:08:58,287
He's down to one ball left.

195
00:08:58,371 --> 00:08:58,955
Natalie's through.

196
00:08:59,038 --> 00:09:01,499
Rob is now at the table maze.

197
00:09:01,582 --> 00:09:03,459
Here comes Yul.

198
00:09:03,543 --> 00:09:06,462
Wendell in the lead
with his first ball.

199
00:09:06,545 --> 00:09:09,298
After a long time on Extinction,

200
00:09:09,382 --> 00:09:11,050
there's not much left
in the tank.

201
00:09:11,133 --> 00:09:12,551
Everybody's using
everything they have

202
00:09:12,635 --> 00:09:15,554
right now to get back
in the game.

203
00:09:20,393 --> 00:09:23,312
Natalie trying
to land that first ball.

204
00:09:23,396 --> 00:09:24,855
Would tie her with Wendell.

205
00:09:25,856 --> 00:09:29,568
It requires a lot of touch.

206
00:09:31,404 --> 00:09:33,406
And she's got it.
It is now Natalie with one

207
00:09:33,489 --> 00:09:34,657
and Wendell with one.

208
00:09:35,741 --> 00:09:36,826
Rob drops.
Got to start again.

209
00:09:39,370 --> 00:09:40,413
Parvati drops.
Has to start again.

210
00:09:41,747 --> 00:09:45,501
Tyson-- very close
to sticking that first ball.

211
00:09:47,586 --> 00:09:49,755
Tyson has his first ball.
He's in it.

212
00:09:50,756 --> 00:09:53,676
It is Tyson, Wendell and Natalie

213
00:09:53,759 --> 00:09:55,845
trying to work their way
back in.

214
00:09:58,389 --> 00:10:01,267
Wendell at a dicey part
of this maze.

215
00:10:03,728 --> 00:10:05,521
He's in the finish zone.

216
00:10:05,938 --> 00:10:06,731
Wendell drops.

217
00:10:06,814 --> 00:10:10,151
Natalie very close.

218
00:10:10,234 --> 00:10:11,694
And a tough corner.

219
00:10:16,907 --> 00:10:18,534
-She's got it!
-(whoops) Oh, my God!

220
00:10:18,617 --> 00:10:21,829
Natalie has earned her way
back into this game!

221
00:10:21,912 --> 00:10:24,999
-(crying)
-After 33 days,

222
00:10:25,082 --> 00:10:27,376
being the first person
voted out,

223
00:10:27,460 --> 00:10:29,879
she is now part
of the final six.

224
00:10:29,962 --> 00:10:32,465
-What a story.
-NATALIE: Thank you so much.

225
00:10:33,549 --> 00:10:35,676
PROBST:
Instantly, the reality
for everybody else

226
00:10:35,760 --> 00:10:36,844
starts to set in.

227
00:10:36,927 --> 00:10:39,680
NATALIE:
Thank you.

228
00:10:39,764 --> 00:10:41,057
PROBST:
This game is over.

229
00:10:42,933 --> 00:10:44,769
Natalie, here is your new Buff.

230
00:10:44,852 --> 00:10:48,522
Take your spot
with the final six.

231
00:10:50,024 --> 00:10:52,443
-Thanks, guys.
-Good job, Nat.

232
00:10:53,944 --> 00:10:55,654
BEN:
Hey. Good job.

233
00:10:56,864 --> 00:11:00,576
So, there are
a lot of unique stories

234
00:11:00,659 --> 00:11:03,454
on<i> Survivor</i> over 20 years.

235
00:11:03,537 --> 00:11:04,538
-Kim.
-Yeah.

236
00:11:04,622 --> 00:11:07,833
You're always so good
at wrapping up your story.

237
00:11:07,917 --> 00:11:11,128
So when you look back on this,

238
00:11:11,212 --> 00:11:13,381
<i>Winners at War,</i>
what was it about?

239
00:11:13,464 --> 00:11:14,757
Um, my first season,
I was told

240
00:11:14,840 --> 00:11:18,427
I was perfect,
flawless, it was easy.

241
00:11:18,511 --> 00:11:20,471
And this was anything but that.

242
00:11:20,554 --> 00:11:22,473
I was on the outs. I could
never get a footing in the game.

243
00:11:22,556 --> 00:11:23,474
I made every mistake.

244
00:11:23,557 --> 00:11:24,767
And this, in a lot of ways,

245
00:11:24,850 --> 00:11:26,435
was my greatest fear,
you know,

246
00:11:26,519 --> 00:11:28,437
that I was gonna come out,
like, screw up everything

247
00:11:28,521 --> 00:11:31,273
that I proved myself to be
the first time around.

248
00:11:31,357 --> 00:11:33,442
And yet I feel...
maybe, better.

249
00:11:33,526 --> 00:11:36,445
I feel really at peace
with my story here,

250
00:11:36,529 --> 00:11:39,281
which was it didn't
have to be perfect.

251
00:11:39,365 --> 00:11:41,492
I didn't have to win.
I'm still me.

252
00:11:41,575 --> 00:11:43,494
I'm so glad
I did not say no to this.

253
00:11:43,577 --> 00:11:44,328
I'm so glad that I said yes,

254
00:11:44,412 --> 00:11:46,288
that my kids
got to see me say yes,

255
00:11:46,372 --> 00:11:47,998
that I did it,
and that I screwed it up

256
00:11:48,082 --> 00:11:49,291
and I'm going home me.

257
00:11:49,375 --> 00:11:51,001
And it feels really good.

258
00:11:51,085 --> 00:11:54,505
PROBST:
Tyson, if this is
the end for you,

259
00:11:54,588 --> 00:11:56,090
wrap it up for me.

260
00:11:57,091 --> 00:11:59,009
I mean, the last decade

261
00:11:59,093 --> 00:12:01,470
has been, for me,
pretty much<i> Survivor.</i>

262
00:12:01,554 --> 00:12:03,264
There's nothing that...

263
00:12:03,347 --> 00:12:07,476
fully encompassed all the weird
talents I had as a person

264
00:12:07,560 --> 00:12:09,019
more than<i> Survivor.</i>

265
00:12:09,103 --> 00:12:11,272
Like, the first time I played,
I was like,

266
00:12:11,355 --> 00:12:14,442
"This is the only job
built for me."

267
00:12:14,525 --> 00:12:15,317
(laughter)

268
00:12:15,401 --> 00:12:18,028
And then, you know,
I had kids, and...

269
00:12:21,115 --> 00:12:23,325
...I think, for me,

270
00:12:23,409 --> 00:12:26,495
that encompasses
all of my weird talents

271
00:12:26,579 --> 00:12:28,122
even better than<i> Survivor</i> does.

272
00:12:28,205 --> 00:12:29,832
I think I needed
to come out here

273
00:12:29,915 --> 00:12:32,543
and struggle
and play from the bottom.

274
00:12:32,626 --> 00:12:34,670
I've never had to do that.

275
00:12:34,753 --> 00:12:37,006
And I think I kind of needed it
to know I don't need it.

276
00:12:37,089 --> 00:12:40,468
I think being a dad,

277
00:12:40,551 --> 00:12:42,761
for me, is a good replacement
for<i> Survivor.</i>

278
00:12:44,763 --> 00:12:46,682
PROBST:
Amber,

279
00:12:46,765 --> 00:12:49,018
why are you out here?

280
00:12:49,101 --> 00:12:51,479
(sniffling):
I didn't come here for me.

281
00:12:51,562 --> 00:12:53,981
I only came here for one person,
and I came here for him.

282
00:12:54,064 --> 00:12:56,025
(both sniffling)

283
00:12:56,108 --> 00:13:00,070
Nobody respects this game
more than my husband does.

284
00:13:02,781 --> 00:13:05,701
I wanted to be here for him.
I wanted to be his rock.

285
00:13:05,784 --> 00:13:08,537
I never thought
I had a chance in hell

286
00:13:08,621 --> 00:13:11,248
to win this time around,
because...

287
00:13:12,791 --> 00:13:16,545
...even when you read my name
as the<i> All-Star</i> winner,

288
00:13:16,629 --> 00:13:18,506
I knew that...

289
00:13:18,589 --> 00:13:20,049
nobody really felt like
I deserved it.

290
00:13:22,468 --> 00:13:24,845
Everybody felt
that this guy deserved it,

291
00:13:24,929 --> 00:13:27,556
and the only reason why
they voted for me is because

292
00:13:27,640 --> 00:13:29,850
they hated him
more than they hated me.

293
00:13:29,934 --> 00:13:30,601
(laughter)

294
00:13:30,684 --> 00:13:32,561
ROB:
But if there's any lesson

295
00:13:32,645 --> 00:13:34,522
I want to take away from this,

296
00:13:34,605 --> 00:13:36,732
we came out here
to show our kids

297
00:13:36,815 --> 00:13:39,068
you try, you don't quit,

298
00:13:39,151 --> 00:13:41,028
you don't give up,
and you do your best.

299
00:13:41,111 --> 00:13:42,905
And their mother's the
toughest woman in this world.

300
00:13:42,988 --> 00:13:46,283
She stayed out there
that whole time,

301
00:13:46,367 --> 00:13:48,035
made rice for everybody
every single day,

302
00:13:48,118 --> 00:13:51,330
never complained.

303
00:13:51,413 --> 00:13:53,207
This is a woman
that's a champion.

304
00:13:53,290 --> 00:13:54,542
(applause)

305
00:13:58,629 --> 00:14:00,381
188 days for me.

306
00:14:00,464 --> 00:14:02,258
-ADAM: Wow.
-But I leave here with nothing

307
00:14:02,341 --> 00:14:06,011
but love for everybody,
gratitude and appreciation.

308
00:14:06,095 --> 00:14:07,680
Thank you.

309
00:14:09,974 --> 00:14:11,600
PROBST:
Parvati,

310
00:14:11,684 --> 00:14:13,978
you came back to play again
after just giving birth.

311
00:14:14,061 --> 00:14:16,605
Why did you come back?

312
00:14:16,689 --> 00:14:17,982
Where was the gas in the tank
coming from?

313
00:14:18,065 --> 00:14:20,025
(Parvati chuckles)

314
00:14:21,068 --> 00:14:22,778
Um...

315
00:14:22,861 --> 00:14:25,781
Yeah, I didn't have
much gas in the tank.

316
00:14:25,864 --> 00:14:28,450
When you called me and
you were asking me to come back,

317
00:14:28,534 --> 00:14:31,078
I was like, "No way.
You're out of your mind.

318
00:14:31,161 --> 00:14:32,580
-I'm, like, so happy."
-(chuckles)

319
00:14:32,663 --> 00:14:34,456
Because I'm having
this adventure

320
00:14:34,540 --> 00:14:36,458
as a new mom,
with a little newborn

321
00:14:36,542 --> 00:14:37,084
who's, like,
the love of my life,

322
00:14:37,167 --> 00:14:39,795
who's squishy and cute.

323
00:14:39,878 --> 00:14:41,630
And then there's<i> Survivor,</i>

324
00:14:41,714 --> 00:14:42,464
which is the exact opposite
of that.

325
00:14:42,548 --> 00:14:45,259
It's, like,
blindsides and deceit

326
00:14:45,342 --> 00:14:47,469
and, like,
really hurting people.

327
00:14:47,553 --> 00:14:48,304
Like, it's a vicious game.

328
00:14:48,387 --> 00:14:50,222
I didn't know
if I had that in me,

329
00:14:50,306 --> 00:14:54,018
but I was willing
to come back out here

330
00:14:54,101 --> 00:14:57,646
and play this game with
every ounce of heart that I had.

331
00:14:57,730 --> 00:14:59,106
And I feel like I did.
(chuckles)

332
00:14:59,189 --> 00:15:02,484
(sniffles, sobs softly)

333
00:15:02,568 --> 00:15:05,279
It's been a very different ride
for me this time

334
00:15:05,362 --> 00:15:07,656
than it ever has before.

335
00:15:07,740 --> 00:15:10,117
But I'm going back out
really proud of who I was

336
00:15:10,200 --> 00:15:12,661
in this version of the game.

337
00:15:12,745 --> 00:15:14,705
PROBST:
Ethan,

338
00:15:14,788 --> 00:15:18,375
is it fair to ask you
about what it is like

339
00:15:18,459 --> 00:15:23,005
to have literally been
to the edge in our human life

340
00:15:23,088 --> 00:15:25,257
and then come out here
and play this game

341
00:15:25,341 --> 00:15:26,842
that's silly on one hand

342
00:15:26,925 --> 00:15:29,178
but can be transformative
on the other?

343
00:15:29,261 --> 00:15:31,639
Yeah, I mean, um...

344
00:15:31,722 --> 00:15:32,890
(smacks lips)

345
00:15:32,973 --> 00:15:36,060
You know,<i> Survivor: Africa</i>
changed my life.

346
00:15:36,143 --> 00:15:38,729
Because of<i> Survivor,</i>

347
00:15:38,812 --> 00:15:40,189
we launched
<i>Survivor</i> Stand Up To Cancer,

348
00:15:40,272 --> 00:15:42,191
which has raised millions
of dollars for cancer research.

349
00:15:42,274 --> 00:15:46,403
And I don't know
if many people know this, but...

350
00:15:46,487 --> 00:15:49,406
some of the money raised through
<i>Survivor</i> Stand Up To Cancer

351
00:15:49,490 --> 00:15:51,700
helped fund the drug
that saved my life.

352
00:15:51,784 --> 00:15:53,786
-Wow.
-So, not only did it,

353
00:15:53,869 --> 00:15:56,205
like, create a life for me,
this show saved my life.

354
00:15:56,288 --> 00:15:59,541
Not too long ago,
like, I was battling

355
00:15:59,625 --> 00:16:03,921
a rare form of blood cancer,
and I just craved survival.

356
00:16:04,004 --> 00:16:06,507
Like, I just wanted
to live one more day.

357
00:16:06,590 --> 00:16:07,883
And I was thinking
to myself, like,

358
00:16:07,966 --> 00:16:09,176
"If I get out
of this transplant alive,

359
00:16:09,259 --> 00:16:12,262
I want to play<i> Survivor."</i>
And I prayed and I dreamed

360
00:16:12,346 --> 00:16:13,389
that I could get myself
healthy enough

361
00:16:13,472 --> 00:16:16,684
to be able to, like,
come out here and play again.

362
00:16:16,767 --> 00:16:17,726
And I did.

363
00:16:17,810 --> 00:16:20,521
For me, this is like
the perfect bookend

364
00:16:20,604 --> 00:16:24,900
on this crazy and amazing life
that<i> Survivor</i> has gifted me.

365
00:16:24,983 --> 00:16:26,735
And I'm so grateful and honored

366
00:16:26,819 --> 00:16:28,195
to be part of this crew
right here.

367
00:16:28,278 --> 00:16:31,115
So I truly appreciate that.

368
00:16:31,198 --> 00:16:32,074
And, uh, thank you, everyone.

369
00:16:32,157 --> 00:16:34,201
-YUL: Thank you, Ethan.
-(applause)

370
00:16:39,123 --> 00:16:41,834
I'd just like to say that

371
00:16:41,917 --> 00:16:43,752
I think one of the reasons

372
00:16:43,836 --> 00:16:46,755
<i>Survivor</i> is so unique
is that

373
00:16:46,839 --> 00:16:50,134
we are all, sort of,
this giant weird family.

374
00:16:50,217 --> 00:16:53,303
Fans who have watched for
20 years, they know you guys.

375
00:16:53,387 --> 00:16:57,307
They've seen you at your bottom,
and they've seen you at the top.

376
00:16:57,391 --> 00:16:59,226
And yet you continue
to come back

377
00:16:59,309 --> 00:17:02,771
and share your stories with us,
and they inspire people.

378
00:17:02,855 --> 00:17:04,356
-So I give it up to you guys.
-(applause)

379
00:17:06,692 --> 00:17:09,987
And with that,
Edge of Extinction is over,

380
00:17:10,070 --> 00:17:12,614
but your job remains the same.

381
00:17:12,698 --> 00:17:14,116
You are the jury.

382
00:17:14,199 --> 00:17:15,617
You'll have some more members
joining you.

383
00:17:15,701 --> 00:17:17,327
But, for now,
grab your stuff, head out,

384
00:17:17,411 --> 00:17:20,956
and we'll see you
at the next Tribal Council.

385
00:17:21,039 --> 00:17:22,791
-(whoops)
-PARVATI: Thanks, Jeff.
-Thank you. Thank you.

386
00:17:22,875 --> 00:17:24,793
-Thank you.
-Thank you.

387
00:17:24,877 --> 00:17:27,546
Good luck, guys.

388
00:17:29,840 --> 00:17:32,968
PROBST:
We started with 20 of the best

389
00:17:33,051 --> 00:17:34,636
that have ever played this game.

390
00:17:34,720 --> 00:17:36,805
You are the final six.

391
00:17:36,889 --> 00:17:39,850
And this battle
is not yet over.

392
00:17:39,933 --> 00:17:41,977
Grab your stuff.

393
00:17:42,060 --> 00:17:44,938
Head back to camp. I'll see you
at your next immunity challenge.

394
00:17:45,898 --> 00:17:47,816
<i>TONY:</i>
<i>When I seen all these people</i>

395
00:17:47,900 --> 00:17:49,026
<i>and they're telling</i>
<i>their stories--</i>

396
00:17:49,109 --> 00:17:49,985
the hardships,
the suffering,

397
00:17:50,068 --> 00:17:51,820
the struggling that they did
on the Edge--

398
00:17:51,904 --> 00:17:53,864
<i>it really hurt me</i>
<i>on an emotional level.</i>

399
00:17:53,947 --> 00:17:56,200
<i>However, I got to put</i>
<i>the emotions to the side.</i>

400
00:17:56,283 --> 00:17:57,659
We have a game to play.

401
00:17:57,743 --> 00:17:59,495
<i>I'm not gonna let off the gas</i>
<i>for one second.</i>

402
00:17:59,578 --> 00:18:01,330
<i>As a matter of fact, I'm gonna</i>
<i>press it even harder, if I can.</i>

403
00:18:01,413 --> 00:18:03,999
<i>I'll put it right through</i>
<i>the floor at this time,</i>

404
00:18:04,082 --> 00:18:06,126
<i>because the end is coming up.</i>

405
00:18:08,629 --> 00:18:12,174
That drive is what makes
these players great.

406
00:18:12,257 --> 00:18:16,178
They lived on the Edge
for that one opportunity.

407
00:18:16,261 --> 00:18:19,890
Natalie won, she's back in,
and now, as Tony said,

408
00:18:19,973 --> 00:18:22,184
you put the pedal
through the metal.

409
00:18:22,267 --> 00:18:23,352
All right, you're not
gonna hear from me again

410
00:18:23,435 --> 00:18:25,813
until it's time
to read the votes,

411
00:18:25,896 --> 00:18:27,856
but because we can't do
a reunion show tonight,

412
00:18:27,940 --> 00:18:30,317
due to time,
we sent audio recorders

413
00:18:30,400 --> 00:18:32,194
to each of the 20 players,
and we asked them to tell us,

414
00:18:32,277 --> 00:18:34,696
in their own words,

415
00:18:34,780 --> 00:18:36,365
what their<i> Survivor</i> experience
has meant to them.

416
00:18:36,448 --> 00:18:38,325
Take a look.

417
00:18:38,408 --> 00:18:39,910
♪ ♪

418
00:18:39,993 --> 00:18:42,871
<i>ADAM:</i>
<i>Being able to step</i>
<i>inside of the television</i>

419
00:18:42,955 --> 00:18:44,873
<i>with my childhood heroes</i>

420
00:18:44,957 --> 00:18:48,836
<i>means, for my life,</i>
<i>that anything is possible.</i>

421
00:18:48,919 --> 00:18:50,045
<i>-...Winners at War.</i>
-(applause)

422
00:18:50,128 --> 00:18:51,922
<i>ADAM:</i>
<i>It completely changed my life,</i>

423
00:18:52,005 --> 00:18:54,716
<i>and now I believe I can do</i>
<i>anything I set my mind to.</i>

424
00:18:54,800 --> 00:18:55,884
MICHELE:
Come on, Adam!

425
00:18:55,968 --> 00:18:57,553
-PROBST: And he's got it!
-(excited shouting)

426
00:18:57,636 --> 00:18:59,930
<i>TONY:</i>
<i>I'm the type of person that</i>

427
00:19:00,013 --> 00:19:01,473
<i>I don't even leave my city.</i>

428
00:19:01,557 --> 00:19:04,059
-Don't drop it, Tony!
<i>-So playing the game is</i>

429
00:19:04,143 --> 00:19:07,062
<i>the most amazing experience</i>
<i>that I will ever have.</i>

430
00:19:07,145 --> 00:19:11,066
<i>KIM:</i>
<i>It is such a hard physical</i>
<i>and emotional experience.</i>

431
00:19:11,149 --> 00:19:12,609
<i>You have to know who you are</i>
<i>to play</i> Survivor.

432
00:19:12,693 --> 00:19:14,987
<i>And if you don't know who you</i>
<i>are, you're about to find out.</i>

433
00:19:16,488 --> 00:19:18,907
<i>MICHELE:</i>
<i>You transform out there</i>
<i>on the beach,</i>

434
00:19:18,991 --> 00:19:21,910
<i>and it changed me</i>
<i>for the better.</i>

435
00:19:21,994 --> 00:19:22,786
<i>I found my own identity.</i>

436
00:19:22,870 --> 00:19:24,246
<i>PARVATI:</i>
<i>It has certainly instilled</i>

437
00:19:24,329 --> 00:19:29,376
<i>this unquenchable thirst</i>
<i>for adventure in my life.</i>

438
00:19:29,459 --> 00:19:31,253
-(whooping)
<i>-WENDELL: If you don't</i>
<i>have confidence,</i>

439
00:19:31,336 --> 00:19:33,922
<i>getting to go</i>
<i>out on that island</i>

440
00:19:34,006 --> 00:19:36,925
<i>and actually proving it</i>
<i>to yourself, that's a blessing.</i>

441
00:19:37,009 --> 00:19:39,386
-Yara wins immunity!
-(cheering)

442
00:19:39,469 --> 00:19:43,098
<i>SOPHIE:</i>
<i>It taught me to embrace</i>
<i>the parts of me that succeed,</i>

443
00:19:43,182 --> 00:19:44,600
<i>but also the parts of me</i>
<i>that can fail things</i>

444
00:19:44,683 --> 00:19:45,976
<i>and being okay with that.</i>

445
00:19:46,059 --> 00:19:48,645
<i>NATALIE:</i>
<i>When I have hard times</i>
<i>in real life,</i>

446
00:19:48,729 --> 00:19:51,398
<i>I always go back</i>
<i>to that</i> Survivor<i> experience,</i>

447
00:19:51,481 --> 00:19:53,108
<i>when it seemed,</i>
<i>like, impossible.</i>

448
00:19:53,192 --> 00:19:54,902
<i>YUL:</i>
<i>Go!</i>

449
00:19:54,985 --> 00:19:57,779
<i>NICK:</i>
Survivor<i> kicked me</i>
<i>in the butt to get me</i>

450
00:19:57,863 --> 00:20:00,282
<i>to that place where</i>
<i>I was finally grown-up.</i>

451
00:20:00,365 --> 00:20:01,950
<i>DENISE:</i>
<i>It taught me</i>
<i>so much about life,</i>

452
00:20:02,034 --> 00:20:03,660
<i>about what I was capable of.</i>

453
00:20:03,744 --> 00:20:05,495
<i>YUL:</i>
<i>When I was a kid, I was an</i>
<i>incredibly introverted person.</i>

454
00:20:05,579 --> 00:20:07,956
Done. (whoops)

455
00:20:08,040 --> 00:20:10,125
<i>But winning</i> Survivor
<i>kind of validated</i>

456
00:20:10,208 --> 00:20:12,794
<i>the kind of person I've grown</i>
<i>into, which is priceless.</i>

457
00:20:12,878 --> 00:20:15,964
<i>SARAH:</i>
<i>Winning a million dollars,</i>
<i>especially in the Midwest,</i>

458
00:20:16,048 --> 00:20:17,341
<i>-definitely changed my life.</i>
-(applause, shouting)

459
00:20:17,424 --> 00:20:21,136
<i>Getting that opportunity,</i>
<i>I'm so fortunate.</i>

460
00:20:21,219 --> 00:20:22,471
<i>SANDRA:</i>
<i>I wouldn't have</i>
<i>what I have today</i>

461
00:20:22,554 --> 00:20:25,515
<i>if it wasn't for</i> Survivor.

462
00:20:25,599 --> 00:20:28,143
<i>It is the greatest thing</i>
<i>I have ever done.</i>

463
00:20:28,226 --> 00:20:31,980
-(Parvati laughs)
<i>-ETHAN: At its core is</i>
<i>a game of relationships.</i>

464
00:20:32,064 --> 00:20:33,982
-Ethan.
<i>-And it's human to human,</i>

465
00:20:34,066 --> 00:20:35,943
<i>even if we're playing</i>
<i>this really hard game.</i>

466
00:20:36,026 --> 00:20:38,320
-Proud of you, dude.
-Keep going, keep going.

467
00:20:38,403 --> 00:20:41,490
<i>BEN:</i>
<i>I grew immensely</i>
<i>as a human being playing.</i>

468
00:20:41,573 --> 00:20:44,993
<i>I learned it was okay</i>
<i>to trust people,</i>

469
00:20:45,077 --> 00:20:46,536
<i>and I learned</i>
<i>about forgiveness.</i>

470
00:20:46,620 --> 00:20:50,332
<i>DANNI:</i>
Survivor<i> really took me</i>
<i>back to the basics</i>

471
00:20:50,415 --> 00:20:52,793
<i>when it comes to realizing</i>

472
00:20:52,876 --> 00:20:55,504
<i>-what's really important</i>
<i>in life.</i>
-(laughing)

473
00:20:55,587 --> 00:20:57,673
<i>ROB:</i>
<i>When I started playing,</i>
<i>I was just a kid,</i>

474
00:20:57,756 --> 00:21:00,842
<i>and now just celebrated</i>
<i>my 15-year wedding anniversary.</i>

475
00:21:00,926 --> 00:21:02,177
I love you.

476
00:21:02,260 --> 00:21:02,970
<i>AMBER:</i>
Survivor<i> has given me</i>

477
00:21:03,053 --> 00:21:07,015
<i>everything that I value</i>
<i>in life,</i>

478
00:21:07,099 --> 00:21:09,184
<i>worth way more than</i>
<i>the million dollars, for sure.</i>

479
00:21:09,267 --> 00:21:10,852
<i>TYSON:</i>
<i>With the million dollars</i>

480
00:21:10,936 --> 00:21:13,855
<i>comes freedom to spend</i>
<i>a lot of time with my children,</i>

481
00:21:13,939 --> 00:21:15,065
<i>my family.</i>

482
00:21:15,148 --> 00:21:16,358
<i>That's the biggest blessing.</i>

483
00:21:16,441 --> 00:21:17,651
-PROBST: And he's got it!
-Yeah!

484
00:21:17,734 --> 00:21:21,196
<i>JEREMY:</i>
<i>The biggest life lesson</i>
<i>I've taken from this:</i>

485
00:21:21,279 --> 00:21:23,198
<i>enjoy the people</i>
<i>that you love...</i>

486
00:21:23,281 --> 00:21:24,533
Let's go!

487
00:21:24,616 --> 00:21:26,743
<i>...and have a deeper bond</i>
<i>with your family.</i>

488
00:21:26,827 --> 00:21:28,203
-Survivor<i> has given me that.</i>
-(crying)

489
00:21:28,286 --> 00:21:29,705
<i>You don't even</i>
<i>have to win the mil to--</i>

490
00:21:29,788 --> 00:21:30,414
<i>for it to change your life.</i>

491
00:21:30,497 --> 00:21:32,499
<i>It changes everybody's life.</i>

492
00:21:32,582 --> 00:21:33,875
Thank you.

493
00:21:33,959 --> 00:21:34,918
(cheering)

494
00:21:35,002 --> 00:21:35,752
<i>JEREMY:</i>
<i>It's awesome.</i>

495
00:21:35,836 --> 00:21:37,295
-Thank you for the gift!
-Thank you!

496
00:21:41,758 --> 00:21:43,969
♪ ♪

497
00:21:48,473 --> 00:21:51,059
TONY:
Welcome to Casa Koru.

498
00:21:53,478 --> 00:21:56,398
<i>NATALIE:</i>
<i>I left this camp day two,</i>

499
00:21:56,481 --> 00:21:59,192
<i>and it's unreal that</i>
<i>I'm even saying this, but...</i>

500
00:21:59,276 --> 00:22:00,736
I made it back on<i> Survivor.</i>

501
00:22:00,819 --> 00:22:02,195
Like, this has been the goal

502
00:22:02,279 --> 00:22:03,905
<i>since I was first voted off.</i>

503
00:22:03,989 --> 00:22:06,950
<i>I bet everything</i>
<i>on myself today,</i>

504
00:22:07,034 --> 00:22:09,578
<i>and it paid off, because</i>
<i>today I'm with the final six</i>

505
00:22:09,661 --> 00:22:11,955
and feels ... amazing.

506
00:22:12,039 --> 00:22:13,749
-Oh, my God!
-(Sarah chuckles)

507
00:22:13,832 --> 00:22:16,418
Oh, my God, guys.
This is crazy.

508
00:22:16,501 --> 00:22:18,253
<i>The challenge</i>
<i>was the first hurdle.</i>

509
00:22:18,336 --> 00:22:19,921
<i>And now I have a huge feat</i>

510
00:22:20,005 --> 00:22:21,882
<i>in front of me</i>
<i>to make it to the end.</i>

511
00:22:21,965 --> 00:22:24,885
<i>The target's on me.</i>
<i>This is a tight clique.</i>

512
00:22:24,968 --> 00:22:27,262
<i>I have to create</i>
<i>some waves so that</i>

513
00:22:27,346 --> 00:22:29,097
<i>wheels start churning</i>
<i>in people's heads</i>

514
00:22:29,181 --> 00:22:31,600
<i>to turn on anybody but me.</i>

515
00:22:31,683 --> 00:22:33,060
<i>Luckily, it's only me here,</i>

516
00:22:33,143 --> 00:22:35,937
<i>so I can tell any lie</i>
<i>of Extinction I want.</i>

517
00:22:36,021 --> 00:22:37,773
But I got to keep my lies
straight.

518
00:22:39,691 --> 00:22:41,276
-BEN: Yeah.
-NATALIE: I think everybody's

519
00:22:41,359 --> 00:22:44,029
kind of obsessed with Tony.

520
00:22:44,112 --> 00:22:45,781
Everybody's on
the Tony bandwagon there.

521
00:22:45,864 --> 00:22:47,157
I'm just sick of it.

522
00:22:47,240 --> 00:22:49,242
And the old-school people--

523
00:22:49,326 --> 00:22:50,619
basically,
the impression is that

524
00:22:50,702 --> 00:22:51,661
Tony's doing everything
and everybody else

525
00:22:51,745 --> 00:22:55,165
-is just taking instructions.
-TONY: What?

526
00:22:55,248 --> 00:22:57,292
<i>TONY:</i>
<i>You have somebody like Natalie</i>
<i>coming into this</i>

527
00:22:57,375 --> 00:22:58,126
<i>from the Edge;</i>
<i>it's very tricky.</i>

528
00:22:58,210 --> 00:22:59,795
<i>It's very dangerous</i>
<i>for my game,</i>

529
00:22:59,878 --> 00:23:01,630
<i>'cause she can say</i>
<i>whatever she wants to us.</i>

530
00:23:01,713 --> 00:23:03,840
<i>That information</i>
<i>could be total lies,</i>

531
00:23:03,924 --> 00:23:07,469
<i>because nobody's here</i>
<i>from the Edge to debunk it.</i>

532
00:23:07,552 --> 00:23:09,012
<i>And she started blowing up</i>
<i>people's spots,</i>

533
00:23:09,096 --> 00:23:11,264
especially mine. She's like,
"Oh, everybody loves you, Tony.

534
00:23:11,348 --> 00:23:13,642
"Uh, you're-you're their
favorite. You're-you're gonna--

535
00:23:13,725 --> 00:23:15,102
You're-you're the winner
in their eyes."

536
00:23:15,185 --> 00:23:16,520
And I'm like, uh,
you know what, this is no good.

537
00:23:16,603 --> 00:23:19,064
I hope nobody believes that.

538
00:23:19,147 --> 00:23:20,732
I-I mean, deep down inside,
I hope it's true.

539
00:23:20,816 --> 00:23:22,818
<i>But I hope nobody</i>
<i>believes that, because</i>

540
00:23:22,901 --> 00:23:23,819
<i>I don't want her to put</i>
<i>this target on my back</i>

541
00:23:23,902 --> 00:23:27,197
<i>that I don't need right now.</i>
<i>It's poison.</i>

542
00:23:28,907 --> 00:23:30,492
<i>SARAH:</i>
<i>Mm-mm.</i>

543
00:23:30,575 --> 00:23:32,786
<i>TONY:</i>
<i>Yeah.</i>

544
00:23:32,786 --> 00:23:33,954
-I don't know.
-I don't know her enough.

545
00:23:34,037 --> 00:23:35,497
But if-if somebody
takes her to the end,

546
00:23:35,580 --> 00:23:37,040
she wins,
if she gets to the end, no?

547
00:23:37,124 --> 00:23:37,958
-You think-- No.
-No?

548
00:23:38,041 --> 00:23:39,167
-No.
-Oh, my. See?

549
00:23:39,251 --> 00:23:40,502
If you're thinking like that,
so is Ben.

550
00:23:40,585 --> 00:23:42,003
-I know. But he won't turn.
-I'm not thinking like that.

551
00:23:42,087 --> 00:23:44,840
-No, I know,
but I'm not thinking like that.
-And I'm not turning, so...

552
00:23:44,923 --> 00:23:45,715
If she goes to the Edge,
that's an accomplishment.

553
00:23:45,799 --> 00:23:48,051
She stayed there
the whole 39 days.

554
00:23:48,135 --> 00:23:49,469
That's such a backstory.

555
00:23:49,553 --> 00:23:50,679
-Mm-hmm.
-She made it through.

556
00:23:50,762 --> 00:23:52,347
She didn't eat
so she could get advantages

557
00:23:52,430 --> 00:23:53,056
-to get back in the game.
-Mm-hmm.

558
00:23:53,140 --> 00:23:55,016
She struggled.
She suffered.

559
00:23:55,100 --> 00:23:56,852
-She came back and won.
-Mm-hmm. Mm-hmm.

560
00:23:56,935 --> 00:23:57,853
-No, I get that.
-So...

561
00:23:57,936 --> 00:23:59,312
<i>SARAH:</i>
<i>I've never played with Natalie,</i>

562
00:23:59,396 --> 00:24:00,856
<i>so I don't know</i>
<i>how savvy she is.</i>

563
00:24:00,939 --> 00:24:04,693
<i>She's telling everybody that</i>
<i>the jury's gonna vote for Tony.</i>

564
00:24:04,776 --> 00:24:07,863
Is that a ploy to get me
to vote Tony out?

565
00:24:07,946 --> 00:24:10,323
Or is it truthful?

566
00:24:10,407 --> 00:24:12,492
<i>You know,</i>
<i>it strikes a nerve with me,</i>

567
00:24:12,576 --> 00:24:14,244
<i>because Tony would not be here</i>
<i>without me.</i>

568
00:24:14,327 --> 00:24:15,745
But it doesn't matter
what I believe.

569
00:24:15,829 --> 00:24:18,081
It's what the jury believes.

570
00:24:18,165 --> 00:24:20,208
I feel like you wouldn't be
where you are without me,

571
00:24:20,292 --> 00:24:21,710
and I feel like I wouldn't be
where I am without you.

572
00:24:21,793 --> 00:24:24,504
-Yeah.
-I know the game that I played.

573
00:24:24,588 --> 00:24:25,547
I know that, if you win,

574
00:24:25,630 --> 00:24:28,717
you might win the money,
you might win the title,

575
00:24:28,800 --> 00:24:31,094
but you wouldn't have it
without me,

576
00:24:31,178 --> 00:24:32,012
and I was not your puppet.

577
00:24:32,095 --> 00:24:34,014
-I know that, Sarah.
-And I know that.

578
00:24:34,097 --> 00:24:35,765
<i>SARAH:</i>
<i>I have to get my story out</i>
<i>to the jury</i>

579
00:24:35,849 --> 00:24:40,061
<i>and make sure</i>
<i>that they know that women</i>

580
00:24:40,145 --> 00:24:41,229
are just as equal as men,

581
00:24:41,313 --> 00:24:44,274
and just because a man
and a woman are working together

582
00:24:44,357 --> 00:24:45,817
doesn't mean the man
is calling all the shots.

583
00:24:52,824 --> 00:24:54,743
(birds chirping)

584
00:24:54,826 --> 00:24:56,828
♪ ♪

585
00:25:04,794 --> 00:25:06,504
Come on in, guys!

586
00:25:16,806 --> 00:25:18,808
What the heck?

587
00:25:23,521 --> 00:25:25,357
-MICHELE: Wow.
-PROBST: All right.

588
00:25:25,440 --> 00:25:26,441
Let's get to
today's immunity challenge.

589
00:25:26,524 --> 00:25:30,237
First things first, Michele,
gonna take it back.

590
00:25:30,320 --> 00:25:32,572
(chuckles softly)
Bummer.

591
00:25:32,656 --> 00:25:34,491
-Thank you.
-Thanks, Jeff.

592
00:25:35,450 --> 00:25:38,787
Once again,
immunity is back up for grabs.

593
00:25:38,870 --> 00:25:40,622
<i>For today's challenge, you're</i>
<i>gonna race through an obstacle,</i>

594
00:25:40,705 --> 00:25:43,917
<i>collect a bag,</i>
<i>then head up a tower.</i>

595
00:25:45,543 --> 00:25:47,796
<i>You'll drop the bag</i>
<i>and then launch yourself</i>

596
00:25:47,879 --> 00:25:49,089
<i>down a giant water slide.</i>

597
00:25:50,757 --> 00:25:52,634
<i>Do it again.</i>

598
00:25:52,717 --> 00:25:55,428
<i>Once you have all three bags,</i>
<i>you'll use</i>

599
00:25:55,512 --> 00:25:57,806
<i>the pieces inside to solve</i>
<i>a three-tier puzzle.</i>

600
00:26:01,184 --> 00:26:02,477
<i>First to finish</i>

601
00:26:02,560 --> 00:26:03,979
wins immunity--
safe from the vote,

602
00:26:04,062 --> 00:26:06,606
guaranteed to see day 37.

603
00:26:06,690 --> 00:26:08,316
Losers, Tribal Council,

604
00:26:08,400 --> 00:26:09,818
where somebody will be
voted out and become

605
00:26:09,901 --> 00:26:11,987
the 14th member of our jury.

606
00:26:12,070 --> 00:26:13,697
-Draw for spots.
We'll get started. Let's do it.
-BEN: Yes, sir.

607
00:26:13,780 --> 00:26:15,907
♪ ♪

608
00:26:22,872 --> 00:26:23,832
PROBST:
Here we go.

609
00:26:23,915 --> 00:26:24,916
For immunity.

610
00:26:25,000 --> 00:26:26,835
Survivors ready?

611
00:26:26,918 --> 00:26:29,504
Go!

612
00:26:30,380 --> 00:26:33,300
The course is divided
into two halves.

613
00:26:34,718 --> 00:26:37,679
It is Denise, Tony
and Sarah on one side,

614
00:26:37,762 --> 00:26:39,681
Michele, Natalie
and Ben on the other,

615
00:26:39,764 --> 00:26:41,850
running the same course.

616
00:26:41,933 --> 00:26:44,102
Denise on the two-plank bridge.

617
00:26:47,731 --> 00:26:49,816
Tony's across the disc bridge.

618
00:26:49,899 --> 00:26:50,817
Ben is across the rope bridge.

619
00:26:53,028 --> 00:26:55,655
Sarah across the rope bridge.

620
00:26:55,739 --> 00:26:56,865
Natalie is across
the disc bridge.

621
00:26:56,948 --> 00:27:01,661
Michele working
on the two-plank bridge.

622
00:27:05,623 --> 00:27:07,500
Ben heading back
with his first bag.

623
00:27:07,584 --> 00:27:10,712
Here comes Tony.
Sarah right behind.

624
00:27:10,795 --> 00:27:13,548
Here comes Natalie
with her first.

625
00:27:13,631 --> 00:27:15,884
Now you got to go up
a lot of steps

626
00:27:15,967 --> 00:27:19,554
and then slide down
and do it again.

627
00:27:19,637 --> 00:27:23,058
Heading up those steps
on day 36,

628
00:27:23,141 --> 00:27:25,602
that looks like Mount Everest.

629
00:27:27,812 --> 00:27:31,024
Ben is on fire right now.

630
00:27:34,986 --> 00:27:37,947
Tony's down,
looking for his second bag.

631
00:27:41,034 --> 00:27:44,913
Here comes Natalie and Sarah,
side by side.

632
00:27:45,997 --> 00:27:48,041
That's how you do it
on<i> Survivor!</i>

633
00:27:49,459 --> 00:27:49,918
Denise is through
the two-plank bridge.

634
00:27:50,001 --> 00:27:52,754
She's coming back.

635
00:27:52,837 --> 00:27:55,757
It is Michele still working
on that two-plank bridge.

636
00:27:55,840 --> 00:27:58,385
It does take more time.

637
00:27:58,468 --> 00:28:00,428
Everybody has to do it.

638
00:28:02,013 --> 00:28:03,473
Here comes Ben with his second.

639
00:28:04,849 --> 00:28:07,936
-(exhales)
-PROBST: Denise has
her first bag.

640
00:28:08,019 --> 00:28:08,895
She's heading down the slide.

641
00:28:18,196 --> 00:28:19,906
Tony with his second.

642
00:28:19,989 --> 00:28:22,909
Here comes Natalie
with her second.

643
00:28:26,037 --> 00:28:28,581
Ben out of control,
going sideways.

644
00:28:28,665 --> 00:28:30,792
Landing nicely.

645
00:28:30,875 --> 00:28:31,042
-I give it a ten.
-(chuckles)

646
00:28:33,420 --> 00:28:35,755
Michele has her first bag.

647
00:28:35,839 --> 00:28:37,048
Let's go, Michele.

648
00:28:39,717 --> 00:28:41,803
Here comes Tony.

649
00:28:41,886 --> 00:28:44,597
Not pretty. Doesn't matter.

650
00:28:44,681 --> 00:28:46,057
Natalie coming back down.

651
00:28:50,687 --> 00:28:53,064
Michele tries to stay in it.

652
00:28:54,274 --> 00:28:56,151
Denise coming back
with her second bag.

653
00:28:56,234 --> 00:28:58,153
Sarah right behind her.

654
00:28:58,236 --> 00:29:00,572
-Woo-hoo!
-Here comes Michele.

655
00:29:01,906 --> 00:29:03,658
-Ah!
-She's through.

656
00:29:04,451 --> 00:29:07,287
-(panting)
-Sarah heading back down

657
00:29:07,370 --> 00:29:10,081
for the second time
on the slide.

658
00:29:10,165 --> 00:29:10,999
Here comes Denise
right behind.

659
00:29:13,042 --> 00:29:15,628
We got a challenge
going on here.

660
00:29:15,712 --> 00:29:18,465
Ben untying his third
and final bag.

661
00:29:18,548 --> 00:29:21,176
He's got it.
Ben will get to the top first.

662
00:29:21,259 --> 00:29:22,886
He can start working
on that puzzle.

663
00:29:23,928 --> 00:29:25,889
Tony has his third bag.

664
00:29:26,890 --> 00:29:28,516
Michele with her second.

665
00:29:29,726 --> 00:29:32,687
Natalie with her third
and final bag.

666
00:29:32,770 --> 00:29:33,688
Natalie gonna get in
on the puzzle.

667
00:29:33,771 --> 00:29:37,567
She's gonna lap Michele
heading up those steps.

668
00:29:37,650 --> 00:29:38,860
That is what it takes,
is a second,

669
00:29:38,943 --> 00:29:43,907
third, fourth burst of energy
on<i> Survivor.</i>

670
00:29:49,621 --> 00:29:52,916
Denise and Sarah coming back
with that third and final bag.

671
00:29:58,087 --> 00:30:00,715
You're still in it, Michele.
You know this puzzle.

672
00:30:00,798 --> 00:30:01,883
Yes, I do, Jeff.

673
00:30:01,966 --> 00:30:05,094
Michele did this puzzle,
and she won.

674
00:30:05,178 --> 00:30:06,137
That could be the difference.

675
