00:30:06,221 --> 00:30:09,057
But she's got to get
that third and final bag.

676
00:30:12,101 --> 00:30:15,396
-Sarah back with her third
and final bag.
-(panting)

677
00:30:15,480 --> 00:30:17,023
You can see the fatigue.

678
00:30:18,024 --> 00:30:20,026
Denise is to the top.

679
00:30:20,109 --> 00:30:22,362
She can start working
on the puzzle.

680
00:30:25,949 --> 00:30:26,991
It is everybody but Michele
working on the puzzle.

681
00:30:27,075 --> 00:30:29,911
It's a three-tier puzzle,

682
00:30:29,994 --> 00:30:32,747
so you're looking
to measure these pieces

683
00:30:32,830 --> 00:30:34,415
so they all are the same height.

684
00:30:34,499 --> 00:30:36,960
That will allow you to start
building the second layer.

685
00:30:40,129 --> 00:30:41,005
Here comes Michele.

686
00:30:41,089 --> 00:30:44,092
Michele has untied
her third bag.

687
00:30:44,175 --> 00:30:46,094
Michele heading back now.

688
00:30:46,177 --> 00:30:49,973
One last ascent up these steps,
and she'll be in it.

689
00:30:54,352 --> 00:30:58,481
It would be a massive comeback
for Michele to get back in this.

690
00:31:01,401 --> 00:31:02,443
Looks so easy.

691
00:31:02,527 --> 00:31:04,696
How difficult could it be

692
00:31:04,779 --> 00:31:07,031
to get six posts to line up
at the same height?

693
00:31:16,124 --> 00:31:19,294
Michele has her first tier.

694
00:31:19,377 --> 00:31:21,254
That is a big advantage
right now.

695
00:31:23,881 --> 00:31:26,926
Everybody looking over
to see what she did.

696
00:31:27,010 --> 00:31:28,928
Y'all are a bunch of cheaters.

697
00:31:29,012 --> 00:31:32,181
PROBST: Michele is trying to
make a giant comeback right now.

698
00:31:33,099 --> 00:31:35,310
And, suddenly,

699
00:31:35,393 --> 00:31:40,023
Natalie thinks she has
that first tier figured out.

700
00:31:41,899 --> 00:31:42,900
Natalie's now in it.

701
00:31:42,984 --> 00:31:44,819
Now Michele will start
to feel a little pressure.

702
00:31:44,902 --> 00:31:46,195
That's okay.

703
00:31:46,279 --> 00:31:48,948
PROBST: Quickly,
Natalie starts placing pieces.

704
00:31:55,079 --> 00:31:57,999
Sarah now has her first tier.

705
00:31:58,082 --> 00:31:58,666
Sarah's now in it.

706
00:31:58,750 --> 00:32:00,043
Michele is on fire right now.

707
00:32:00,126 --> 00:32:02,795
There is a theme this season

708
00:32:02,879 --> 00:32:05,173
of a lot of winners feeling
they have something to prove.

709
00:32:05,256 --> 00:32:08,968
Michele is proving it right now.

710
00:32:09,052 --> 00:32:10,928
Very quickly,
Michele has her second tier.

711
00:32:12,263 --> 00:32:15,058
Michele now starting to work
on her third and final tier.

712
00:32:15,141 --> 00:32:20,855
It would be a repeat win
for immunity.

713
00:32:22,815 --> 00:32:25,818
It is literally everybody
just looking

714
00:32:25,902 --> 00:32:26,653
at what Michele is doing,

715
00:32:26,736 --> 00:32:30,406
trying to find
the matching pieces

716
00:32:30,490 --> 00:32:32,450
to just copy what she's doing.

717
00:32:33,743 --> 00:32:34,202
Sarah right next door
to Michele,

718
00:32:34,285 --> 00:32:35,036
just looking over.

719
00:32:35,119 --> 00:32:38,581
Natalie checking
what Michele's doing.

720
00:32:38,665 --> 00:32:41,751
Michele undaunted
as she continues

721
00:32:41,834 --> 00:32:43,211
to move pieces around.

722
00:32:43,294 --> 00:32:45,296
Michele thinks she has it.

723
00:32:47,256 --> 00:32:49,258
Is she right?

724
00:32:50,760 --> 00:32:52,470
That's it.

725
00:32:52,553 --> 00:32:54,847
-That is it!
-(squeals)

726
00:32:54,931 --> 00:32:56,099
-... yeah!
-Michele wins
individual immunity!

727
00:32:56,182 --> 00:32:59,727
(laughing)

728
00:32:59,811 --> 00:33:01,896
I told you it was okay.

729
00:33:01,979 --> 00:33:04,190
Oh, my God.
(blows raspberry)

730
00:33:05,149 --> 00:33:06,526
Michele, come on over.

731
00:33:08,778 --> 00:33:09,153
(Michele chuckles)

732
00:33:10,154 --> 00:33:12,740
The dance again.

733
00:33:12,824 --> 00:33:14,617
You are safe tonight.

734
00:33:14,701 --> 00:33:15,576
Cannot be voted out
of this game.

735
00:33:15,660 --> 00:33:18,538
As for the rest of you,
got nothing for ya.

736
00:33:18,621 --> 00:33:20,415
Grab your stuff. Head back to
camp. See you tonight at Tribal.

737
00:33:20,498 --> 00:33:23,626
<i>TONY:</i>
<i>This next Tribal's gonna be</i>
<i>very, very tricky.</i>

738
00:33:23,710 --> 00:33:25,086
<i>We seen it in season 38,</i>

739
00:33:25,169 --> 00:33:27,463
<i>where Chris comes back</i>
<i>from the Edge with an idol.</i>

740
00:33:27,547 --> 00:33:29,549
But I'm glad that happened,
because it opens up

741
00:33:29,632 --> 00:33:30,299
people's eyes to see
that's what's gonna happen

742
00:33:30,383 --> 00:33:32,385
to all of you guys.

743
00:33:32,468 --> 00:33:33,594
<i>I'm pretty nervous about that,</i>

744
00:33:33,678 --> 00:33:35,555
<i>because if she plays</i>
<i>some advantage,</i>

745
00:33:35,638 --> 00:33:36,431
<i>that could be</i>
<i>sending me packing,</i>

746
00:33:36,514 --> 00:33:38,599
<i>and I don't want that</i>
<i>to happen.</i>

747
00:33:44,188 --> 00:33:46,232
♪ ♪

748
00:33:51,529 --> 00:33:53,114
BEN:
Is that all right?

749
00:33:53,197 --> 00:33:54,741
-Is that enough?
-NATALIE: Of course, take more.

750
00:33:54,824 --> 00:33:56,159
-We have so much here.
-(chuckles): I know, I know.

751
00:33:56,242 --> 00:33:58,286
But, like, I'm sick of rice
right now, Natalie.

752
00:33:58,369 --> 00:34:00,955
-Oh, you're telling me, dude.
-(laughs)

753
00:34:01,038 --> 00:34:02,290
-Let's just chill, man.
Eat this.
-NATALIE: Yeah.

754
00:34:02,373 --> 00:34:04,959
I can't chill out like you guys.
You guys can chill.

755
00:34:05,042 --> 00:34:07,503
I'm gonna go look for an idol.
(chuckles)

756
00:34:07,587 --> 00:34:10,923
<i>TONY: When there's a potential</i>
<i>problem, I'd rather try</i>

757
00:34:11,007 --> 00:34:12,550
to address it than ignore it.

758
00:34:12,633 --> 00:34:13,968
'Cause when you ignore
a potential problem,

759
00:34:14,051 --> 00:34:15,511
it usually bites you
in the butt.

760
00:34:15,595 --> 00:34:17,597
-NATALIE: Shall I go get water?
-Yeah, yeah, go ahead.

761
00:34:17,680 --> 00:34:20,349
<i>TONY:</i>
<i>This is</i> Survivor.
<i>It's a game of the unknown.</i>

762
00:34:20,433 --> 00:34:21,684
So let's prepare
for the unknown.

763
00:34:21,768 --> 00:34:23,019
-All right, I'll be back.
<i>-It's better to</i>

764
00:34:23,102 --> 00:34:26,230
<i>assume that she has something</i>
<i>than assume that she doesn't.</i>

765
00:34:33,613 --> 00:34:34,280
What do you mean? We...
It's all good.

766
00:34:34,363 --> 00:34:36,699
I know. We got to figure it out,

767
00:34:36,783 --> 00:34:38,659
because if she has something,
man, what's gonna happen?

768
00:34:38,743 --> 00:34:40,161
There's no way she has...

769
00:34:40,244 --> 00:34:41,537
I'm not gonna guarantee it,
but...

770
00:34:41,621 --> 00:34:43,498
<i>Tony's got an idol.</i>
<i>All he's got to do</i>

771
00:34:43,581 --> 00:34:44,540
is just play it cool tonight,

772
00:34:44,624 --> 00:34:46,375
and we can make it
to the final four.

773
00:34:46,459 --> 00:34:48,211
<i>(laughs): And he's not</i>
<i>playing it cool right now.</i>

774
00:34:48,294 --> 00:34:51,672
We seen somebody come in
from the Edge and win, man.

775
00:34:51,756 --> 00:34:54,175
-I know.
-What would two,
two, two happen?

776
00:34:54,258 --> 00:34:55,843
No harm, no foul, right?
If two of us

777
00:34:55,927 --> 00:34:57,345
are going Natalie, two of us
are going Denise, and those two,

778
00:34:57,428 --> 00:34:59,680
whoever they vote,
it doesn't matter.

779
00:34:59,764 --> 00:35:02,391
We-we break the tie
by sending Natalie home.

780
00:35:02,475 --> 00:35:04,310
<i>BEN:</i>
<i>A smart Survivor</i>
<i>would say split the votes,</i>

781
00:35:04,393 --> 00:35:07,480
<i>but I'm not gonna do that</i>
<i>to Mama D right now.</i>

782
00:35:07,563 --> 00:35:10,399
Survivor<i> for me the first time</i>
<i>was powering through people</i>

783
00:35:10,483 --> 00:35:13,027
and not worrying
about the human aspect.

784
00:35:13,110 --> 00:35:16,864
This time, I've learned
from my first experience,

785
00:35:16,948 --> 00:35:19,867
<i>and I'm trying to grow on that</i>
<i>as a</i> Survivor<i> player</i>

786
00:35:19,951 --> 00:35:21,244
<i>and as a human.</i>

787
00:35:21,327 --> 00:35:23,371
<i>Denise is not a number to me.</i>

788
00:35:23,454 --> 00:35:26,040
She's a friend. She's an ally.

789
00:35:26,123 --> 00:35:27,416
Anybody wants to talk to me,
I am open.

790
00:35:27,500 --> 00:35:29,377
I'm trying to go with the flow,
apparently,

791
00:35:29,460 --> 00:35:32,547
that you guys have here,
which is no scramble.

792
00:35:32,630 --> 00:35:33,714
Everybody tells each other
everything.

793
00:35:33,798 --> 00:35:36,759
-We can talk.
Do you want to talk?
-NATALIE: Yeah.

794
00:35:36,843 --> 00:35:38,719
-Yeah, we can talk. Let's go.
-MICHELE: Okay. Let's do it.

795
00:35:38,803 --> 00:35:40,721
<i>NATALIE: The best-case scenario</i>
<i>for me not winning immunity,</i>

796
00:35:40,805 --> 00:35:42,223
which was obviously
my first choice,

797
00:35:42,306 --> 00:35:43,266
is Michele winning immunity.

798
00:35:43,349 --> 00:35:45,226
<i>She's at the bottom, and, so,</i>

799
00:35:45,309 --> 00:35:48,437
at this point, my game plan
is to work with Michele

800
00:35:48,521 --> 00:35:50,439
<i>and make sure we break up</i>
<i>this foursome tonight.</i>

801
00:35:50,523 --> 00:35:53,818
BEN:
I mean, you think
Michele's working with her?

802
00:35:53,901 --> 00:35:55,903
-TONY: She has no choice.
-What do you mean,
she has no choice?

803
00:35:55,987 --> 00:35:56,696
TONY:
She has no choice
because she knows...

804
00:35:56,779 --> 00:35:58,698
She'd be stupid
to work with her.

805
00:36:00,324 --> 00:36:02,910
-(whispers): No!
Dude, this has been...
-And...

806
00:36:02,994 --> 00:36:04,412
-Wait, let's sit.
-Now Tony's like... Yeah.

807
00:36:05,496 --> 00:36:06,914
No.

808
00:36:06,998 --> 00:36:09,041
And that's what I'm saying.

809
00:36:15,673 --> 00:36:17,842
<i>MICHELE:</i>
<i>I've been trying so hard</i>

810
00:36:17,925 --> 00:36:19,302
to shake up this game.

811
00:36:19,385 --> 00:36:22,680
<i>But it's been really hard</i>
<i>with Tony</i>

812
00:36:22,763 --> 00:36:24,056
<i>and Sarah running this game.</i>

813
00:36:24,140 --> 00:36:26,726
<i>They have been so loyal</i>
<i>to each other.</i>

814
00:36:26,809 --> 00:36:28,477
I have no allegiance
to any of these people.

815
00:36:28,561 --> 00:36:29,645
<i>Somebody coming in</i>
<i>from the Edge</i>

816
00:36:29,729 --> 00:36:31,564
<i>and saying that</i>
<i>they want to work with me,</i>

817
00:36:31,647 --> 00:36:32,732
<i>that they have an idol</i>

818
00:36:32,815 --> 00:36:33,941
<i>and I have the necklace</i>
<i>around my neck</i>

819
00:36:34,025 --> 00:36:37,570
is pretty much
the ideal situation

820
00:36:37,653 --> 00:36:39,447
on day 36.

821
00:36:39,530 --> 00:36:41,908
All votes are
gonna go on you tonight.

822
00:36:41,991 --> 00:36:43,159
We can't beat Tony.

823
00:36:43,242 --> 00:36:46,579
So do we take Tony out right now
with an idol and...

824
00:36:46,662 --> 00:36:48,289
-Tony's gonna play his idol.
-He is?

825
00:36:48,372 --> 00:36:49,957
<i>NATALIE:</i>
<i>If I pull out an idol</i>
<i>at Tribal,</i>

826
00:36:50,041 --> 00:36:51,667
<i>-he's gonna play his for him.</i>
<i>-MICHELE: Yeah.</i>

827
00:36:51,751 --> 00:36:53,669
<i>NATALIE:</i>
<i>The only thing</i>
<i>I really know for sure</i>

828
00:36:53,753 --> 00:36:55,963
<i>is that Michele</i>
<i>is safe tonight,</i>

829
00:36:56,047 --> 00:36:57,673
<i>I have an idol,</i>

830
00:36:57,757 --> 00:37:00,384
<i>and it's about time</i>
<i>we shook this foursome up.</i>

831
00:37:00,468 --> 00:37:03,763
So I'm so thankful
that I held out on that idol

832
00:37:03,846 --> 00:37:05,848
and I brought it in the game
with me,

833
00:37:05,932 --> 00:37:07,516
because if not,
I would be going home tonight.

834
00:37:12,396 --> 00:37:13,773
Yeah.

835
00:37:19,570 --> 00:37:21,489
<i>MICHELE:</i>
<i>Actually,</i>

836
00:37:21,572 --> 00:37:22,615
we just basically said, like,

837
00:37:22,698 --> 00:37:23,616
"I'm gonna throw my vote
on Tony."

838
00:37:23,699 --> 00:37:26,202
-Okay, good.
-But...
-Does she have an idol?

839
00:37:26,285 --> 00:37:28,371
I don't know.
She seems paranoid right now,

840
00:37:28,454 --> 00:37:31,874
so if she did,
she's voting Tony.

841
00:37:31,958 --> 00:37:33,834
-Yeah.
-I don't know.

842
00:37:33,918 --> 00:37:35,628
-TONY: Okay.
<i>-BEN: She's probably gonna</i>
<i>vote me.</i>

843
00:37:35,711 --> 00:37:36,754
If she stands up
and plays an idol tonight,

844
00:37:36,837 --> 00:37:38,506
-I'm gonna have to play mine.
-TONY: You don't want

845
00:37:38,589 --> 00:37:40,967
to do some splitting
so you don't have to waste

846
00:37:41,050 --> 00:37:42,176
the idol, man? 'Cause
tomorrow's the last day, man.

847
00:37:42,259 --> 00:37:44,553
-I don't.
-But, damn, do I have
to do it, too, man?

848
00:37:44,637 --> 00:37:45,596
'Cause I think they're
making me flush mine out.

849
00:37:45,680 --> 00:37:48,849
<i>I would think</i>
<i>Ben would be all for saving</i>

850
00:37:48,933 --> 00:37:52,019
his idol so we can guarantee
ourselves in the final four.

851
00:37:52,103 --> 00:37:56,023
<i>It's mind-boggling</i>
<i>how everybody's so reluctant</i>

852
00:37:56,107 --> 00:37:58,359
<i>to throw any votes on Denise.</i>

853
00:37:58,442 --> 00:38:02,196
They're adamant that this girl
Natalie does not have anything.

854
00:38:02,279 --> 00:38:03,698
-I don't think she's got one.
-No.

855
00:38:03,781 --> 00:38:05,366
So I-I think
we're-we're spinning our wheels

856
00:38:05,449 --> 00:38:06,993
on this and doing a lot
of coulda, woulda, shouldas.

857
00:38:07,076 --> 00:38:09,203
-BEN: Mm-hmm.
<i>-TONY: If Natalie stands up</i>
<i>and plays an idol,</i>

858
00:38:09,286 --> 00:38:10,871
now I go into panic mode.

859
00:38:10,955 --> 00:38:11,372
You, Ben, go into panic mode.

860
00:38:11,455 --> 00:38:13,541
We burn our idols.

861
00:38:13,624 --> 00:38:15,918
<i>Natalie's safe,</i>
<i>and either Sarah</i>

862
00:38:16,002 --> 00:38:17,878
<i>or Denise are on the</i>
<i>chopping block at that point.</i>

863
00:38:17,962 --> 00:38:19,547
<i>So let's just get rid of Denise</i>
<i>and be safe.</i>

864
00:38:19,630 --> 00:38:21,340
It's a win-win.

865
00:38:25,469 --> 00:38:26,721
I want me. I want you.

866
00:38:26,804 --> 00:38:29,265
I want Ben. We vote Denise.

867
00:38:29,348 --> 00:38:30,891
And keep Natalie?

868
00:38:30,975 --> 00:38:33,644
-If she has an idol...
-She doesn't.

869
00:38:34,687 --> 00:38:35,479
<i>SARAH:</i>
<i>Tony started freaking out</i>

870
00:38:35,563 --> 00:38:37,857
<i>that Natalie</i>
<i>might have an idol.</i>

871
00:38:37,940 --> 00:38:40,276
I have to always tell him,
"Would you just trust me?

872
00:38:40,359 --> 00:38:42,278
<i>Calm down."</i>
<i>That's all I do,</i>

873
00:38:42,361 --> 00:38:43,571
<i>and that's what</i>
<i>people don't realize.</i>

874
00:38:43,654 --> 00:38:45,740
Why take a chance
for me to blow my idol,

875
00:38:45,823 --> 00:38:46,574
Ben to blow his idol,

876
00:38:46,657 --> 00:38:48,951
and-and then
you possibly going home?

877
00:38:49,035 --> 00:38:51,203
-We move on
for another day to fight.
-She don't have an idol.

878
00:38:51,287 --> 00:38:52,913
<i>SARAH:</i>
<i>Natalie doesn't have an idol.</i>
<i>You know why?</i>

879
00:38:52,997 --> 00:38:56,876
Because Natalie and I,
in the one day she's been here,

880
00:38:56,959 --> 00:38:58,419
have built a good enough bond

881
00:38:58,502 --> 00:39:01,422
that Natalie would've told me
if she had something.

882
00:39:01,505 --> 00:39:02,798
-Sarah, please, think about it.
-Well, damn it, Tony.

883
00:39:02,882 --> 00:39:04,258
-But I'm telling you, though.
-Okay.

884
00:39:04,341 --> 00:39:06,052
-Okay, that's it, then. If...
-I get what you're saying.

885
00:39:06,135 --> 00:39:07,595
-If you're 100%, then that's it.
-I'm 100%.

886
00:39:07,678 --> 00:39:08,637
-Boom. Done.
<i>-SARAH: Welcome to my world.</i>

887
00:39:08,721 --> 00:39:12,433
I've lived 36 days
of trying to calm Tony down.

888
00:39:12,516 --> 00:39:15,936
<i>These girls</i>
<i>don't have anything,</i>

889
00:39:16,020 --> 00:39:17,438
<i>so calm down, dude.</i>

890
00:39:17,521 --> 00:39:20,232
<i>Guess who's in control? Sarah.</i>

891
00:39:20,316 --> 00:39:21,942
Sarah knows what's going on.

892
00:39:28,616 --> 00:39:30,618
♪ ♪

893
00:39:39,001 --> 00:39:40,503
PROBST:
All right. Ben,

894
00:39:40,586 --> 00:39:42,797
is the elephant in the room

895
00:39:42,880 --> 00:39:44,632
the Edge of Extinction
returning player

896
00:39:44,715 --> 00:39:46,801
and the threat that holds?

897
00:39:46,884 --> 00:39:47,635
BEN:
I would say so, Jeff.

898
00:39:47,718 --> 00:39:50,346
She's been able
to sit over there

899
00:39:50,429 --> 00:39:53,099
with a lot of these folks
and make a lot of friendships

900
00:39:53,182 --> 00:39:55,309
while we've been away
hacking at each other,

901
00:39:55,393 --> 00:39:56,685
and that's part of the strategy
that comes into play.

902
00:39:56,769 --> 00:39:59,105
PROBST:
So, Michele,

903
00:39:59,188 --> 00:40:01,524
the easy vote would be
for the five of you

904
00:40:01,607 --> 00:40:03,984
to just simply say, "Look,
we can all just stay together

905
00:40:04,068 --> 00:40:06,654
-and get rid of her."
-MICHELE: Well, the reality
of the situation is

906
00:40:06,737 --> 00:40:07,822
that somebody new comes in.

907
00:40:07,905 --> 00:40:10,074
They bring in new information.

908
00:40:10,157 --> 00:40:11,117
There's a lot to digest

909
00:40:11,200 --> 00:40:13,953
with what they're saying
that the jury is saying.

910
00:40:14,036 --> 00:40:17,123
And, so, we knew
the chaos was gonna come,

911
00:40:17,206 --> 00:40:18,499
but it hit us all
in different ways.

912
00:40:18,582 --> 00:40:20,543
But normally,
you have someone to back-check

913
00:40:20,626 --> 00:40:23,504
and-and follow up on a story.

914
00:40:23,587 --> 00:40:26,340
With Miss Nat here,
there's no fact-checking.

915
00:40:26,423 --> 00:40:29,009
We have to take everything
that she says for her word.

916
00:40:29,093 --> 00:40:30,845
And she's good at what she does.

917
00:40:30,928 --> 00:40:32,054
She stayed and fought,

918
00:40:32,138 --> 00:40:34,014
and she's still
staying and fighting.

919
00:40:34,098 --> 00:40:35,391
SARAH:
And I think

920
00:40:35,474 --> 00:40:39,061
having Natalie come back
into the game actually, like,

921
00:40:39,145 --> 00:40:41,147
was a blessing for me.

922
00:40:41,230 --> 00:40:41,981
PROBST:
How so?

923
00:40:42,064 --> 00:40:44,525
SARAH:
Well, had the Edge not been

924
00:40:44,608 --> 00:40:48,112
available this season,
there's information

925
00:40:48,195 --> 00:40:50,156
I would've never got
till after the game,

926
00:40:50,239 --> 00:40:52,992
and I would've continued
to play it differently

927
00:40:53,075 --> 00:40:54,577
than the way
I needed to play it.

928
00:40:54,660 --> 00:40:58,539
PROBST:
Natalie, what was
that information?

929
00:40:58,622 --> 00:41:00,708
I told everybody, basically,
Tony's the guy

930
00:41:00,791 --> 00:41:02,835
that everybody's saying
is playing the best game.

931
00:41:02,918 --> 00:41:04,712
Whether or not it's true,

932
00:41:04,795 --> 00:41:07,715
from my perspective
and everybody on Extinction,

933
00:41:07,798 --> 00:41:09,466
Tony's running the show.

934
00:41:09,550 --> 00:41:11,719
And I think
that really fired Sarah up.

935
00:41:11,802 --> 00:41:14,180
SARAH:
I-It did. It made me realize

936
00:41:14,263 --> 00:41:16,557
that if a woman in this game

937
00:41:16,640 --> 00:41:20,227
lies or-or cheats or steals,

938
00:41:20,311 --> 00:41:22,438
then she's fake
and phony and a bitch.

939
00:41:23,647 --> 00:41:26,901
If a guy does it,
it's good gameplay.

940
00:41:26,984 --> 00:41:29,737
If a guy does it,
they're a stud.

941
00:41:29,820 --> 00:41:33,949
What it is is it's a gender
bias, and it holds me back.

942
00:41:34,033 --> 00:41:35,618
It holds other women back
from playing the game the way

943
00:41:35,701 --> 00:41:38,078
we should be allowed
to play the game.

944
00:41:38,162 --> 00:41:40,706
And it made me realize

945
00:41:40,789 --> 00:41:44,960
that I, for two years,
have been so hard on myself

946
00:41:45,044 --> 00:41:45,836
from<i> Game Changers</i>

947
00:41:45,920 --> 00:41:49,590
that I felt like
I was such a bad person,

948
00:41:49,673 --> 00:41:50,633
and I'm not.

949
00:41:52,134 --> 00:41:53,761
And, um...

950
00:41:54,845 --> 00:41:56,430
And I can finally...

951
00:41:56,513 --> 00:41:59,058
I really feel like
I can let that go now.

952
00:41:59,141 --> 00:42:00,434
Like, she brought that to me.

953
00:42:00,518 --> 00:42:02,937
And it's... It is such,

954
00:42:03,020 --> 00:42:03,938
like, a weight
lifted off my shoulder.

955
00:42:04,021 --> 00:42:08,150
I know who I am,
and I can do a lot of things,

956
00:42:08,234 --> 00:42:08,817
and I'm not scared of anyone.

957
00:42:08,901 --> 00:42:11,946
And I'm gonna prove it.

958
00:42:12,029 --> 00:42:14,114
I ran seven marathons in
seven days on seven continents.

959
00:42:14,198 --> 00:42:16,617
I've been on the SWAT team.
I've been a police officer.

960
00:42:16,700 --> 00:42:20,079
I work my ass off
for everything I have

961
00:42:20,162 --> 00:42:23,415
because I'm a strong woman,
and I can play however I want.

962
00:42:23,499 --> 00:42:26,168
Because if a man can do it,
so can I.

963
00:42:26,252 --> 00:42:27,878
And so can Michele,
and so can Denise,

964
00:42:27,962 --> 00:42:30,464
and so can Natalie.

965
00:42:30,547 --> 00:42:32,841
And I will not be defeated
by a gender bias.

966
00:42:32,925 --> 00:42:35,928
The biggest weight
that has held me down

967
00:42:36,011 --> 00:42:40,599
for two years has been lifted,
and it feels great.

968
00:42:42,059 --> 00:42:44,061
Tony, we are
in a cultural shift,

969
00:42:44,144 --> 00:42:46,438
and it's beautiful,
and it's powerful.

970
00:42:46,522 --> 00:42:47,481
But to Sarah's point,

971
00:42:47,564 --> 00:42:49,650
men have never had to deal
with a lot of the labels

972
00:42:49,733 --> 00:42:51,652
that come with
playing aggressively

973
00:42:51,735 --> 00:42:54,280
or lying or cheating.

974
00:42:54,363 --> 00:42:56,824
So, as a man,
are you starting to reappreciate

975
00:42:56,907 --> 00:42:59,493
and reevaluate
how you would label people

976
00:42:59,576 --> 00:43:00,661
-even in this game?
-Um, no. I-I...

977
00:43:00,744 --> 00:43:03,330
I'm not reappreciating it
or reevaluating it

978
00:43:03,414 --> 00:43:04,373
'cause I already know it.

979
00:43:04,456 --> 00:43:07,001
I see it in real life.
I see it at my workplace.

980
00:43:07,084 --> 00:43:09,128
I see it everywhere.
We all know it.

981
00:43:09,211 --> 00:43:09,837
PROBST:
Ben, how about for you?

982
00:43:09,920 --> 00:43:12,298
BEN:
Um, I know that women

983
00:43:12,381 --> 00:43:14,508
can do anything
that a man can do,

984
00:43:14,591 --> 00:43:15,718
especially in<i> Survivor.</i>

985
00:43:15,801 --> 00:43:19,013
And there's a lot
that goes on in<i> Survivor</i>

986
00:43:19,096 --> 00:43:21,140
that doesn't relate outside,

987
00:43:21,223 --> 00:43:23,976
and strong women like Sarah
is bringing it to light.

988
00:43:24,059 --> 00:43:25,894
And I think that everybody
needs to respect women,

989
00:43:25,978 --> 00:43:29,690
because they're all our mothers,
and they're our daughters.

990
00:43:29,773 --> 00:43:31,358
And that's what we got

991
00:43:31,442 --> 00:43:33,193
-to sit back and realize.
-PROBST: Well, then,

992
00:43:33,277 --> 00:43:35,070
let me own my part.

993
00:43:35,154 --> 00:43:37,698
I'm certain right now,
if I were to look back

994
00:43:37,781 --> 00:43:40,993
at all of the comments
I have made over 20 years,

995
00:43:41,076 --> 00:43:43,370
I would find
the exact same bias in me.

996
00:43:43,454 --> 00:43:45,331
Who-who I call by last names.

997
00:43:45,414 --> 00:43:46,915
Guys have different
relationships with each other,

998
00:43:46,999 --> 00:43:50,127
and I might not know how to have
that relationship with a woman.

999
00:43:50,210 --> 00:43:51,920
So I'll definitely own the fact

1000
00:43:52,004 --> 00:43:54,340
that I don't think I saw it
when<i> Survivor</i> started.

1001
00:43:54,423 --> 00:43:55,841
And I don't think I even knew
I was supposed to look for it.

1002
00:43:55,924 --> 00:43:59,178
But I'm very much aware
of it now, and I'm grateful

1003
00:43:59,261 --> 00:44:00,929
that we can open up
and investigate,

1004
00:44:01,013 --> 00:44:02,890
even though it comes with crisis

1005
00:44:02,973 --> 00:44:06,560
or it comes with some hardship
or it comes with some tears.

1006
00:44:06,643 --> 00:44:08,020
Whatever it is,

1007
00:44:08,103 --> 00:44:09,897
it's out there,
and it's being talked about.

1008
00:44:09,980 --> 00:44:10,939
You can start calling me Lacina.

1009
00:44:11,023 --> 00:44:13,025
(laughter)

1010
00:44:13,108 --> 00:44:14,276
PROBST:
All right, Lacina.

1011
00:44:14,360 --> 00:44:15,361
Let's get back to the game.

1012
00:44:15,444 --> 00:44:19,198
Natalie, what do you do
to try to ease this weight

1013
00:44:19,281 --> 00:44:21,367
off your shoulder that you're

1014
00:44:21,450 --> 00:44:22,910
the easy target,
or there's this uncertainty

1015
00:44:22,993 --> 00:44:24,912
about if you came back
with an advantage,

1016
00:44:24,995 --> 00:44:26,080
and therefore,
that's another reason

1017
00:44:26,163 --> 00:44:27,998
-to get rid of you.
-NATALIE: Yeah, I mean, clearly,

1018
00:44:28,082 --> 00:44:30,417
it's them four strong,

1019
00:44:30,501 --> 00:44:33,045
Michele's on the bottom,
and I'm rock-bottom.

1020
00:44:33,128 --> 00:44:33,921
And if she had not won immunity

1021
00:44:34,004 --> 00:44:36,423
and I had won immunity,
it would be her

1022
00:44:36,507 --> 00:44:37,424
going home, but I'm still here

1023
00:44:37,508 --> 00:44:39,301
hoping that something's
gonna happen tonight

1024
00:44:39,385 --> 00:44:41,136
that shakes this foursome up.

1025
00:44:41,220 --> 00:44:43,931
PROBST:
One thing, Tony,
that never changes

1026
00:44:44,014 --> 00:44:45,891
in this game
is when somebody is desperate,

1027
00:44:45,974 --> 00:44:49,645
they will find a crack
where you think there isn't one.

1028
00:44:49,728 --> 00:44:52,106
And when Natalie says, "Hey, all
I have to do is go to Michele

1029
00:44:52,189 --> 00:44:54,274
"and say, 'You were
on the bottom, and it was you

1030
00:44:54,358 --> 00:44:56,610
if not me,'"
suddenly, this is a problem.

1031
00:44:56,693 --> 00:44:58,278
Yeah, that's not
finding a crack, Jeff.

1032
00:44:58,362 --> 00:44:59,405
That's creating a crack.

1033
00:44:59,488 --> 00:45:02,032
Again, the Edge has
all the intel from our side.

1034
00:45:02,116 --> 00:45:03,117
Every time somebody gets
voted off,

1035
00:45:03,200 --> 00:45:04,076
they tell them who has idols,

1036
00:45:04,159 --> 00:45:06,412
how many idols they have,
where the idols

1037
00:45:06,495 --> 00:45:07,996
are hiding at.
We don't know nothing.

1038
00:45:08,080 --> 00:45:09,957
We only know what
they tell us, and, you know,

1039
00:45:10,040 --> 00:45:11,792
you got to either accept it
at face value,

1040
00:45:11,875 --> 00:45:13,210
or you got to look
a little bit deeper into it.

1041
00:45:13,293 --> 00:45:15,045
And that's why there's a lot
of confusion with this twist,

1042
00:45:15,129 --> 00:45:17,172
because you're battling
the unknown.

1043
00:45:17,256 --> 00:45:18,632
It's like you're fighting
the invisible person.

1044
00:45:18,715 --> 00:45:20,467
It's unknown,
but at the same time,

1045
00:45:20,551 --> 00:45:22,094
I feel like there's a lot

1046
00:45:22,177 --> 00:45:24,012
of things that people are
just keeping their blinders to.

1047
00:45:24,096 --> 00:45:26,640
And, so,
I talked to all the ladies.

1048
00:45:26,723 --> 00:45:29,726
I said, "Listen,
don't shoot the messenger,

1049
00:45:29,810 --> 00:45:32,104
"but you guys
are giving Tony $2 million

1050
00:45:32,187 --> 00:45:33,689
unless you guys
shake things up."

1051
00:45:36,733 --> 00:45:38,652
Wow. Big-time move.

1052
00:45:38,735 --> 00:45:40,654
She's good
at what she does, Jeff.

1053
00:45:40,737 --> 00:45:42,448
PROBST:
All right.

1054
00:45:42,531 --> 00:45:44,992
Time to vote.
Natalie, you're up.

1055
00:45:45,075 --> 00:45:47,119
♪ ♪

1056
00:46:15,939 --> 00:46:17,316
I'll go tally the votes.

1057
00:46:17,399 --> 00:46:19,026
♪ ♪

1058
00:46:26,575 --> 00:46:29,328
If anybody has a hidden immunity
idol and you want to play it,

1059
00:46:29,411 --> 00:46:31,079
now would be the time to do so.

1060
00:46:34,917 --> 00:46:36,877
Yeah, Jeff.

1061
00:46:46,637 --> 00:46:48,889
I'm playing this for myself
'cause...

1062
00:46:48,972 --> 00:46:51,266
I want to be here tomorrow,

1063
00:46:51,350 --> 00:46:52,935
-and there's no point saving it.
-Okay.

1064
00:46:55,646 --> 00:46:57,606
That's crazy. Just like that.

1065
00:47:00,484 --> 00:47:02,027
This is a hidden immunity idol.

1066
00:47:02,110 --> 00:47:06,448
Any votes cast for Natalie
will not count.

1067
00:47:07,241 --> 00:47:08,951
Yeah, I'm playing mine,
too, Jeff.

1068
00:47:23,632 --> 00:47:26,552
This is a hidden immunity idol.

1069
00:47:26,635 --> 00:47:29,137
Any votes cast for Tony
will not count.

1070
00:47:32,224 --> 00:47:33,725
-Okay. I'll read...
-BEN: Hey, Jeff.

Since we're talking about
beautiful, strong women,

1073

my wife keeps putting
these darn things in my boots.

1074

First vote:

1082
00:48:15,058 --> 00:48:16,810
Natalie. Does not count.

1083
00:48:17,227 --> 00:48:18,145
Natalie.

1084
00:48:18,228 --> 00:48:20,731
Does not count.

1085
00:48:21,898 --> 00:48:22,941
Natalie.

1086
00:48:23,025 --> 00:48:24,151
Does not count.

1087
00:48:26,069 --> 00:48:27,195
Natalie.

1088
00:48:27,279 --> 00:48:29,072
Does not count.

1089
00:48:31,908 --> 00:48:32,284
Ben.

1090
00:48:32,367 --> 00:48:34,369
Does not count.

1091
00:48:38,540 --> 00:48:39,666
Ben.

1092
00:48:39,750 --> 00:48:40,709
Does not count.

1093
00:48:40,792 --> 00:48:44,504
We have no votes cast
for any player.

1094
00:48:44,588 --> 00:48:47,007

Here's how it's gonna work.

1095
00:48:47,090 --> 00:48:49,468
You cannot vote for Michele.
She has the immunity necklace.

1096

You cannot vote

1097

1098

The only people you can vote for

1099

Denise and Sarah,
because you can

00:48:59,144 --> 00:49:02,648

you won't vote.

1101
00:49:02,731 --> 00:49:04,524
Four people voting between
Denise and Sarah.

1102

And let me explain
how the tiebreaker works

1103
00:49:07,319 --> 00:49:08,403

1104

Our normal tiebreaker states
when two people are tied,

1105

and everybody else draws rocks.

1106

There is nobody to draw rocks.

1107

So, in this situation,

1108
00:49:18,497 --> 00:49:21,708
if there is a tie
between Denise and Sarah,

1109
00:49:21,792 --> 00:49:25,045

with a fire-making showdown.

1110
00:49:25,128 --> 00:49:26,672
-Those are the stakes.
-ADAM: Wow.

1111
00:49:26,755 --> 00:49:28,215
-Oh, wow.
-Wow.

1112

Natalie,
if you'll come grab the urn.

1113
00:49:32,177 --> 00:49:34,096
♪ ♪

1114
00:50:03,417 --> 00:50:05,419
♪ ♪

1116
00:50:10,382 --> 00:50:13,051
♪ ♪

1117

1118

First vote:

1119

Denise.

1120
00:50:36,491 --> 00:50:37,868
Denise.

1121
00:50:42,372 --> 00:50:44,291

1122

Denise.
That's three. That's enough.

1123

1124
00:50:47,669 --> 00:50:49,296
-PROBST: Bring me your torch.
-DENISE: Love you, lady.

00:50:49,379 --> 00:50:51,131

1127

-BEN: Come here, Mama.

1129

Denise, the tribe has spoken.

1131
00:51:11,359 --> 00:51:14,154
Kick ass.

1132
00:51:14,237 --> 00:51:15,655
Love you, Mama D.

1133
00:51:24,372 --> 00:51:25,499

Well,

1134
00:51:25,582 --> 00:51:28,043

1135
00:51:28,126 --> 00:51:30,212

unpredictable season.

1136
00:51:30,295 --> 00:51:32,005
Grab your torches.

1137
00:51:32,088 --> 00:51:34,132
Head back to camp. Good night.

1138
00:51:35,091 --> 00:51:36,676
I may not have won the game,

1139
00:51:36,760 --> 00:51:40,013

<i>as the Queenslayer.</i>

1140
00:51:40,096 --> 00:51:41,264

<i>with me.</i>

1141
00:51:41,348 --> 00:51:44,351
<i>I got more than I needed</i>
<i>and more than I wanted</i>

1142
00:51:44,434 --> 00:51:45,352
<i>out of my second time out here,</i>

1143
00:51:45,435 --> 00:51:48,814
<i>and I'm incredibly grateful</i>
<i>for that.</i>

1144

1145

TONY:
I have the utmost respect

1147

something or tell you guys,

1148
00:52:08,625 --> 00:52:10,418
-"Listen, if you guys are 100%,
then I'll back down."
-Yeah.

1149
00:52:10,502 --> 00:52:13,004

-Yeah.

1150
00:52:13,088 --> 00:52:14,339
But you guys never do
with me, man.

1151

I was telling you guys,

1152
00:52:16,299 --> 00:52:18,552
Let's try to figure this out
so we don't waste our idols,"

1153
00:52:18,635 --> 00:52:20,053
-and you guys
didn't want to budge.
-Right.

1154
00:52:20,136 --> 00:52:22,222
-You didn't want to listen
to me, you know.
-Yeah.

1155
00:52:22,305 --> 00:52:24,057
-I am sorry. When we left...
-No, no, no, man.

1156
00:52:24,140 --> 00:52:25,225
When we left
and her ... jacket was here,

1157
00:52:25,308 --> 00:52:26,393
<i>there was something up.</i>

1158
00:52:26,476 --> 00:52:28,937
<i>-You know what I mean?</i>
<i>-TONY: I know.</i>

1159
00:52:29,020 --> 00:52:31,690
<i>I'm so angry. I'm frustrated.</i>
<i>Denise goes home.</i>

1160
00:52:31,773 --> 00:52:33,233
I lose an idol.
Ben loses an idol.

1161
00:52:33,316 --> 00:52:36,945
We're vulnerable
at the final five.

1162
00:52:37,028 --> 00:52:38,321
Nice job, guys.

1163
00:52:39,322 --> 00:52:40,740
SARAH:
Okay.

1164
00:52:42,659 --> 00:52:44,953
<i>TONY:</i>
<i>The only good part is there was</i>

1165
00:52:45,036 --> 00:52:47,038
three idols played.

1166
00:52:47,122 --> 00:52:49,958
<i>At least one</i>
<i>is coming back into the game,</i>

1167
00:52:50,041 --> 00:52:52,252
<i>and I want to get a jump</i>
<i>on finding it.</i>

1168
00:52:52,335 --> 00:52:54,588
I'm not gonna wait
till the sun comes out, so...

1169
00:52:54,671 --> 00:52:56,089
<i>I do one of</i>
<i>my midnight specials.</i>

1170
00:52:56,172 --> 00:52:58,800
<i>(chuckles): I get a shell,</i>
<i>I throw some coal in it,</i>

1171
00:52:58,884 --> 00:53:00,218
and off I go

1172
00:53:00,302 --> 00:53:02,762
<i>into the jungle,</i>
<i>searching for the idol.</i>

1173
00:53:02,846 --> 00:53:03,346
♪ ♪

1174
00:53:30,749 --> 00:53:32,792
♪ ♪

1175
00:53:35,086 --> 00:53:36,463
<i>So, I'm feeling around,</i>
<i>feeling around,</i>

1176
00:53:36,546 --> 00:53:38,673
<i>searching high and low,</i>

1177
00:53:38,757 --> 00:53:40,467
everywhere in between,
and I come up short.

1178
00:53:40,550 --> 00:53:43,637
<i>And then here comes the sun,</i>

1179
00:53:43,720 --> 00:53:45,096
and then here comes
everybody else.

1180
00:53:45,180 --> 00:53:46,681
<i>And now I'm getting nervous,</i>

1181
00:53:46,765 --> 00:53:49,809
<i>because with a little luck,</i>
<i>anybody can find an idol.</i>

1182
00:53:50,852 --> 00:53:53,271
♪ ♪

1183
00:53:58,109 --> 00:53:59,194
Yeah.

1184
00:54:16,586 --> 00:54:19,339
<i>NATALIE:</i>
<i>Oh, my God. I can't believe it.</i>

1185
00:54:19,422 --> 00:54:21,341
<i>This would be the...</i>
<i>probably the 50th time</i>

1186
00:54:21,424 --> 00:54:23,802
I've stuck my hand
into a little crevice.

1187
00:54:23,885 --> 00:54:27,013
<i>And I felt a rope, and my heart</i>

1188
00:54:27,097 --> 00:54:28,473
just starts pounding so fast.

1189

<i>NATALIE:</i>
<i>This is awesome.</i>

1190
00:54:35,146 --> 00:54:35,647
<i>I have an immunity idol.</i>

1191
00:54:35,730 --> 00:54:37,399
<i>It shows dedication</i>

1192
00:54:37,482 --> 00:54:42,070
<i>and that relentlessness</i>
<i>on a goal is something</i>

1193
00:54:42,153 --> 00:54:44,531
<i>that I've been able to harness</i>
<i>from Extinction.</i>

1194
00:54:44,614 --> 00:54:48,702
<i>And now I'm gonna use it</i>
<i>to break up those three.</i>

1195
00:54:48,785 --> 00:54:50,578
So, my work is
just getting started.

1196
00:54:53,665 --> 00:54:56,001
So it's got to be around
somewhere.

1197
00:54:56,084 --> 00:54:57,502
Yeah.

1198
00:54:57,585 --> 00:55:00,505
<i>BEN:</i>
<i>Me and Tony have been scouring</i>
<i>this whole island.</i>

00:55:00,588 --> 00:55:01,840
There's two idol hounds

1200
00:55:01,923 --> 00:55:02,882

1201
00:55:02,966 --> 00:55:06,219
So, that's starting to get

1202
00:55:06,302 --> 00:55:08,513
<i>'cause that means</i>
<i>that possibly Michele</i>

1203
00:55:08,596 --> 00:55:10,557

1204
00:55:10,640 --> 00:55:12,392

1205

♪ ♪

Come on in, guys!

1208

All right.

immunity challenge.

1210

First things first, Michele,
the second time

1211
00:55:48,511 --> 00:55:52,390
-in a row
I'm gonna take it back.
-Dang it.

1212
00:55:53,475 --> 00:55:54,768

1213
00:55:57,353 --> 00:56:00,440

immunity is back up for grabs.

1214

1215

<i>you're gonna race</i>
<i>through a series of obstacles,</i>

1216

<i>collecting a key along the way.</i>

1217
00:56:06,529 --> 00:56:09,783

<i>two sandbags.</i>

1218
00:56:09,866 --> 00:56:12,118
<i>First player</i>
<i>to land both their sandbags</i>

1220

guaranteed a spot

1221
00:56:19,167 --> 00:56:22,629

you have a shot at the end,

1222
00:56:22,712 --> 00:56:25,173

taken or winning in fire.

1223
00:56:25,256 --> 00:56:28,093
Huge stakes today.

1224
00:56:28,176 --> 00:56:30,428
We'll draw for spots.
We'll get started.

1225
00:56:36,726 --> 00:56:38,645
All right, here we go!

1226
00:56:38,728 --> 00:56:43,316
For immunity and a spot
in the final four.

1227
00:56:43,399 --> 00:56:43,566
Survivors ready?

1228
00:56:46,694 --> 00:56:47,654
Go!

1229
00:56:47,737 --> 00:56:51,449
♪ ♪

1230
00:56:51,533 --> 00:56:52,700
Everybody in the water.

1231
00:56:52,784 --> 00:56:56,496
You got to swim to your ramp.

1232
00:56:56,579 --> 00:56:58,206

1233
00:56:58,289 --> 00:56:59,707
Natalie's gonna get there first.

1234
00:56:59,791 --> 00:57:01,209
Ben's right in it.

1235
00:57:01,292 --> 00:57:04,838
Here comes Michele,
Sarah and Tony.

1236
00:57:06,297 --> 00:57:07,632
Natalie's up the ramp.

1237
00:57:07,715 --> 00:57:09,008
Ben is up the ramp.

1238
00:57:09,968 --> 00:57:12,345
Both are in the water.

1239
00:57:12,428 --> 00:57:14,347
Here comes Sarah and Michele.

1240
00:57:17,058 --> 00:57:18,351
Sarah's in the water.

1241
00:57:18,434 --> 00:57:20,353
Michele in the water.

1242
00:57:20,436 --> 00:57:22,188
There goes Tony.

1243

Now you got to get across
the beam any way you want.

1244
00:57:26,234 --> 00:57:28,153
-(Ben grunts)
-You can walk it,

1245
00:57:28,236 --> 00:57:29,362

1246
00:57:29,445 --> 00:57:30,238
It does not matter.

1247
00:57:30,321 --> 00:57:33,366
You're untying one key
along the way.

1248
00:57:33,449 --> 00:57:35,326
Natalie has her key.

1249
00:57:35,410 --> 00:57:37,245
Ben has his key.

1250
00:57:37,328 --> 00:57:38,997
Sarah's in it.

1251
00:57:39,080 --> 00:57:41,166
Here comes Tony.

1252
00:57:42,125 --> 00:57:43,751
Nat's good.

1253
00:57:45,628 --> 00:57:46,546
Ben is good.

1254
00:57:46,629 --> 00:57:49,174
Sarah has her key.

1255
00:57:49,257 --> 00:57:51,217
Tony's working on his key.

1256
00:57:51,301 --> 00:57:53,970
Michele taking a long time
on that beam.

1257
00:57:54,971 --> 00:57:57,390
Sarah's good.
She's in the water.

1258
00:57:58,391 --> 00:58:01,394
Now you got to
throw yourself under the net,

1259
00:58:01,477 --> 00:58:02,854

1260
00:58:08,026 --> 00:58:09,402
Tony's in the water.

1261
00:58:09,485 --> 00:58:13,323
Michele in last,
working on her key.

1262
00:58:15,450 --> 00:58:17,202
Ben takes the lead now.

1263
00:58:17,285 --> 00:58:19,579
He's through first.
Here comes Natalie.

1264
00:58:19,662 --> 00:58:20,914
Sarah's in the net.

1265
00:58:20,997 --> 00:58:22,415
Tony right behind.

1266
00:58:22,498 --> 00:58:22,999
Michele still on the beam.

1267
00:58:23,082 --> 00:58:25,543
Oh, God. I'm so scared.

1268
00:58:25,627 --> 00:58:28,213
PROBST:
Ben has his two sandbags free.
He can start tossing.

1269
00:58:28,296 --> 00:58:30,715
Got to land both of them.

1270
00:58:30,798 --> 00:58:32,008
Ben close with the first.

1271
00:58:33,301 --> 00:58:34,344
On and off with the second.

1272
00:58:34,427 --> 00:58:35,762
Ben zoned in very quickly.

1273
00:58:35,845 --> 00:58:38,806
Natalie on and off.

1274
00:58:38,890 --> 00:58:41,601
Sarah unlocking her sandbags.

1275
00:58:41,684 --> 00:58:42,602
Tony unlocking his sandbags.

1276
00:58:42,685 --> 00:58:46,439
Michele's in the water now.

1277
00:58:46,522 --> 00:58:49,359
You've got to get both bags
on the target.

1278
00:58:49,442 --> 00:58:50,818
If you knock one off,
you got to land it again.

1279
00:58:50,902 --> 00:58:52,695
Tony now in on it.
Sarah's in on it.

1280
00:58:54,822 --> 00:58:56,658
Guaranteed spot at four.

1281
00:58:56,741 --> 00:59:00,578
Anything can happen at four.

1282
00:59:00,662 --> 00:59:03,498
Here comes Michele,
still digging to stay in this.

1283
00:59:06,542 --> 00:59:07,627
Tony on and off.
Ben has his first bag!

1284
00:59:07,710 --> 00:59:10,296
He's got one left.

1285
00:59:10,380 --> 00:59:12,173
Everybody chasing Ben now.

1286
00:59:12,257 --> 00:59:14,759
Sarah short.
Trying to dial in that touch.

1287
00:59:14,842 --> 00:59:15,802
Ben for the win.

1288
00:59:16,761 --> 00:59:19,264
Oh! On and off.

1289
00:59:19,347 --> 00:59:23,476
Stayed for a second
but rolled off.

1290
00:59:23,559 --> 00:59:25,812
Tony's on.
He's got his first sandbag.

1291
00:59:25,895 --> 00:59:26,980
It's Tony and Ben now.

1292
00:59:27,063 --> 00:59:28,648
-(grunts)
-Ben on and off again.

1293
00:59:28,731 --> 00:59:32,610
Tony can win it now right here.

1294
00:59:32,694 --> 00:59:33,903
Tony on and off.

1295
00:59:36,072 --> 00:59:38,324

-(grunts)

1296
00:59:38,408 --> 00:59:39,784
Wow.

1297
00:59:39,867 --> 00:59:42,120
Ben and Tony are all around it.
They're hitting

1298
00:59:42,203 --> 00:59:45,748

but you got to get it to stick.

1299
00:59:48,876 --> 00:59:49,877

1300
00:59:49,961 --> 00:59:52,922
Tony wins individual immunity.

1301
00:59:53,006 --> 00:59:56,301
Guaranteed a spot
in the final four.

1302
00:59:56,384 --> 00:59:58,011
Wow.

1303
00:59:58,094 --> 01:00:00,805
<i>BEN:</i>
<i>The good thing is</i>
<i>is that Tony won immunity.</i>

1304
01:00:00,888 --> 01:00:03,516
<i>However, neither of us have</i>
<i>been able to find the idol.</i>

1305
01:00:03,599 --> 01:00:07,395
So the risk is we do not know
what Natalie has.

1306
01:00:07,478 --> 01:00:11,024
<i>If we all put our votes</i>
<i>on Natalie right now</i>

1307
01:00:11,107 --> 01:00:14,027
<i>and then she pulls out an idol,</i>
<i>that's unnerving.</i>

1308
01:00:22,994 --> 01:00:26,122
♪ ♪

1309
01:00:31,127 --> 01:00:33,546
-Good job, Tony.
-Yeah.

1310
01:00:33,629 --> 01:00:34,881
-Good job, brother.
-Oh, thank you, man.

1311
01:00:34,964 --> 01:00:36,883
-Good job, man.
-Hey, thanks.

1312
01:00:36,966 --> 01:00:38,843
<i>NATALIE:</i>
<i>Even though</i>
<i>Tony won the necklace,</i>

1313
01:00:38,926 --> 01:00:39,969
<i>I still want to break up</i>
<i>this three.</i>

1314
01:00:40,053 --> 01:00:44,098
<i>And the only one of them</i>
<i>that might flip is Sarah.</i>

1315
01:00:49,145 --> 01:00:50,772
Sarah?

1316
01:00:51,814 --> 01:00:52,857
Same.

1317
01:00:52,940 --> 01:00:54,901
<i>NATALIE:</i>
<i>I do have an idol,</i>

1318
01:00:54,984 --> 01:00:57,278
but self-preservation
only gets me till tomorrow.

1319
01:00:57,362 --> 01:00:59,781
<i>And if we don't break up</i>
<i>this threesome today,</i>

1320
01:00:59,864 --> 01:01:00,823
<i>it's not happening.</i>

1321
01:01:04,160 --> 01:01:05,328
<i>SARAH:</i>
<i>Who?</i>

1322
01:01:05,411 --> 01:01:06,746
<i>TONY:</i>
<i>Natalie and Michele.</i>

1323
01:01:06,829 --> 01:01:08,039
<i>Natalie-- she's not</i>
<i>looking for an idol.</i>

1324
01:01:08,122 --> 01:01:09,749
They might have found it, Sarah.

1325
01:01:09,832 --> 01:01:10,958
So this is what we have--

1326
01:01:11,042 --> 01:01:13,461
Just to make sure,
I have to go in my spy nest.

1327
01:01:13,544 --> 01:01:15,963
-All right.
-So I need you
to try to get the girls.

1328
01:01:16,047 --> 01:01:17,799
<i>-SARAH: Okay.</i>
<i>-Or we can say,</i>
<i>"Girls, let's talk."</i>

1329
01:01:17,882 --> 01:01:19,550
<i>-And then I want to hear</i>
<i>what they say.</i>
<i>-And see what they say.</i>

1330
01:01:19,634 --> 01:01:20,551
-Yeah.
-Okay. All right.

1331
01:01:20,635 --> 01:01:21,886
I'm gonna go
in the spy nest now.

1332
01:01:21,969 --> 01:01:23,262
-Okay.
-I-I don't think they have it,

1333
01:01:23,346 --> 01:01:25,098
-but just in case. All right?
-All right.

1334
01:01:25,181 --> 01:01:27,183
♪ ♪

1335
01:01:46,828 --> 01:01:49,455
SARAH:
All right, what are
you thinking, girl?

1336
01:01:50,915 --> 01:01:51,874
NATALIE:
Well, if I was Tony--

1337
01:01:51,958 --> 01:01:53,876
I'm trying to put myself
in his shoes.

1338
01:01:53,960 --> 01:01:56,462
Obviously, I don't know
if he wants to be like,

1339
01:01:56,546 --> 01:01:58,297
"All right, Michele or Natalie,"

1340
01:01:58,381 --> 01:02:00,758
or if he wants to do
something bigger

1341
01:02:00,842 --> 01:02:02,844
and get rid of,
I don't know, Ben.

1342
01:02:02,927 --> 01:02:04,470
But obviously,
you three are like,

1343
01:02:04,554 --> 01:02:06,139
"I'm not gonna write
each other's names down."

1344
01:02:06,222 --> 01:02:08,141
(chuckles):
So...

1345
01:02:08,224 --> 01:02:09,934
Well, and that's just it.
That's what I have to debate is:

1346
01:02:10,017 --> 01:02:12,270
-How can I win this game?
-Yeah.

1347
01:02:12,353 --> 01:02:15,356
I think last Tribal was
probably your best Tribal.

1348
01:02:15,440 --> 01:02:16,983
-SARAH: Yeah, but it doesn't
win you the game.
-No,

1349
01:02:17,066 --> 01:02:18,985
but when you have moments
like that, people do give a ....

1350
01:02:19,068 --> 01:02:20,945
It's not fake.

1351
01:02:21,028 --> 01:02:25,324
Are-are you only willing
to write down Ben's name?

1352
01:02:25,408 --> 01:02:28,119
I would rather write Ben's
because I would rather not

1353
01:02:28,202 --> 01:02:31,539
-compete against Ben
in fire, ever.
-Sure.

1354
01:02:31,622 --> 01:02:32,999
So this is my situation, right?

1355
01:02:33,082 --> 01:02:35,668
So if it's three of us
and Ben goes home tonight,

1356
01:02:35,751 --> 01:02:36,961
I feel like you have an idol,

1357
01:02:37,044 --> 01:02:38,296
so I'm not, I'm not
pitching anything...

1358
01:02:38,379 --> 01:02:38,921
SARAH:
What is that? What do you have?

1359
01:02:39,005 --> 01:02:40,882
Something to keep me safe.

1360
01:02:40,965 --> 01:02:42,300
Let me see.

1361
01:02:45,261 --> 01:02:46,012
Shut up.

1362
01:02:46,095 --> 01:02:48,890
NATALIE:
Yeah. I found it.

1363
01:02:48,973 --> 01:02:50,183
Where'd you find it?

1364
01:02:50,266 --> 01:02:51,893
Um, on the way to water,
around that back way.

1365
01:02:51,976 --> 01:02:54,020
<i>TONY:</i>
<i>So I climb up the tree,</i>

1366
01:02:54,103 --> 01:02:56,856
<i>listening to their</i>
<i>conversation, and then</i>

1367
01:02:56,939 --> 01:02:57,857
my eyes are like "bing!"

1368
01:02:57,940 --> 01:02:59,609
<i>And sure enough,</i>

1369
01:02:59,692 --> 01:03:00,902
<i>Natalie tells Sarah</i>
<i>she has an idol.</i>

1370
01:03:00,985 --> 01:03:02,403
SARAH:
All right.

1371
01:03:02,487 --> 01:03:04,363
So what do we want to do?

1372
01:03:04,447 --> 01:03:05,990
<i>NATALIE:</i>
<i>So, Michele,</i>
<i>day one, she told me,</i>

1373
01:03:06,073 --> 01:03:08,034
<i>"I'm a hundred percent</i>
<i>with you,</i>

1374
01:03:08,117 --> 01:03:09,535
and we both want
to work with you."

1375
01:03:09,619 --> 01:03:12,163
SARAH:
The three of us need
to come to a consensus.

1376
01:03:12,246 --> 01:03:13,539
-Yeah.
-All right.

1377
01:03:13,623 --> 01:03:15,833
Let's get back,
check on that rice.

1378
01:03:15,917 --> 01:03:18,377
-Um...
-Between you four,
who do you think

1379
01:03:18,461 --> 01:03:20,588
would've had the best chance of
winning immunity-- I mean...

1380
01:03:20,671 --> 01:03:22,548
(conversation fades)

1381
01:03:27,929 --> 01:03:30,223
(quietly): That was
the worst experience of my life.

1382
01:03:30,306 --> 01:03:31,015
They were talking
for, like, an hour.

1383
01:03:31,098 --> 01:03:32,016
Look at me.

1384
01:03:32,099 --> 01:03:34,018
<i>My legs are shaking.</i>

1385
01:03:34,101 --> 01:03:36,062
<i>I almost died.</i>

1386
01:03:36,145 --> 01:03:38,397
But after she showed her
the idol,

1387
01:03:38,481 --> 01:03:39,065
I knew that we're all good.

1388
01:03:39,148 --> 01:03:41,609
I saw it and heard it all.

1389
01:03:41,692 --> 01:03:43,194
How spot-on am I
with these girls?

1390
01:03:43,277 --> 01:03:45,238
-Super spot-on. So...
-I knew it, man.

1391
01:03:45,321 --> 01:03:47,365
Okay, so here's what I think
we need to do.

1392
01:03:47,448 --> 01:03:49,700
<i>I don't think she'd play it</i>
<i>for Michele.</i>

1393
01:03:49,784 --> 01:03:51,869
<i>-I think she'll play it</i>
<i>for herself.</i>
<i>-Yeah.</i>

1394
01:03:51,953 --> 01:03:53,621
-So the votes need
to go on Michele.
-Yeah.

1395
01:03:53,704 --> 01:03:55,748
-Right? 'Cause we don't
want Ben out, right?
-Yeah. Yeah.

1396
01:03:55,831 --> 01:03:56,791
<i>You're gonna tell them</i>
<i>that the plan is</i>

1397
01:03:56,874 --> 01:03:57,959
<i>for me and Ben to vote Natalie,</i>

1398
01:03:58,042 --> 01:03:59,043
so then she thinks
the votes are gonna go on her.

1399
01:03:59,126 --> 01:04:00,920
You know what I mean?

1400
01:04:01,003 --> 01:04:02,922
<i>Knowing that Natalie</i>
<i>has an idol,</i>

1401
01:04:03,005 --> 01:04:04,757
<i>we're all voting for Michele.</i>

1402
01:04:04,840 --> 01:04:06,050
<i>We can't let her</i>
<i>stay here any longer.</i>

1403
01:04:06,133 --> 01:04:08,261
She's just gonna cause
trouble and chaos,

1404
01:04:08,344 --> 01:04:09,929
<i>so she's going home tonight.</i>

1405
01:04:10,012 --> 01:04:17,103
<i>Done.</i>

1406
01:04:17,103 --> 01:04:19,397
But I put my idol in my buff.

1407
01:04:19,480 --> 01:04:21,816
-Mm-hmm.
-I'm standing,
and she's like, "What's that?"

1408
01:04:21,899 --> 01:04:23,401
I was like,
"Okay, it's-it's the idol."

1409
01:04:23,484 --> 01:04:24,986
<i>-MICHELE: Damn it.</i>
<i>-But it ended up working--</i>

1410
01:04:25,069 --> 01:04:26,946
No, but it ended up working
'cause then she was like,

1411
01:04:27,029 --> 01:04:28,948
<i>"Wow. All right, yeah."</i>

1412
01:04:29,031 --> 01:04:30,825
<i>Natalie...</i>

1413
01:04:30,908 --> 01:04:32,285
she's gonna vote me out tonight.

1414
01:04:32,368 --> 01:04:33,119
-No.
-Yes.

1415
01:04:35,037 --> 01:04:36,122
<i>They know that I have nothing,</i>

1416
01:04:36,205 --> 01:04:39,041
and they are going to go
at this point with a safe bet.

1417
01:04:44,046 --> 01:04:47,300
<i>MICHELE:</i>
<i>What an absolute disaster.</i>

1418
01:04:47,383 --> 01:04:50,177
Sarah knows now
that Natalie has an idol

1419
01:04:50,261 --> 01:04:51,470
<i>and I have nothing.</i>

1420
01:04:51,554 --> 01:04:54,640
<i>And since I don't see those</i>
<i>three cracking on each other,</i>

1421
01:04:54,724 --> 01:04:57,935
<i>I am the obvious target</i>
<i>tonight.</i>

1422
01:04:58,019 --> 01:04:59,186
<i>SARAH:</i>
<i>They're scheming now.</i>

1423
01:04:59,270 --> 01:05:00,479
<i>BEN:</i>
<i>Yeah.</i>

1424
01:05:00,563 --> 01:05:03,024
Here's the problem.
Do you think she would

1425
01:05:03,107 --> 01:05:04,108
<i>play her idol for Michele?</i>

1426
01:05:04,191 --> 01:05:07,820
<i>BEN:</i>
<i>Coming from the edge, probably.</i>

1427
01:05:07,903 --> 01:05:08,654
I mean, that's the kind of move

1428
01:05:08,738 --> 01:05:10,156
she's gonna have to make
to win it.

1429
01:05:10,239 --> 01:05:12,783
Plays an idol for herself
one Tribal.

1430
01:05:12,867 --> 01:05:14,994
Plays an idol for someone else
the next Tribal.

1431
01:05:15,077 --> 01:05:18,247
<i>I mean, I'm all for</i>
<i>writing down Michele, but...</i>

1432
01:05:21,542 --> 01:05:23,002
-And they play-- I know.
-It's okay.

1433
01:05:23,085 --> 01:05:24,879
Listen, I've accepted my fate
in this game.

1434
01:05:24,962 --> 01:05:27,214
I'm okay with it.
I won't be mad at you.

1435
01:05:27,298 --> 01:05:28,883
<i>I won't be mad at Tony.</i>

1436
01:05:28,966 --> 01:05:30,176
<i>SARAH:</i>
<i>Well, I'm not writing</i>
<i>your name down.</i>

1437
01:05:30,259 --> 01:05:32,011
Listen, just hear me out.

1438
01:05:32,094 --> 01:05:34,138
If you want to put my name down,

1439
01:05:34,221 --> 01:05:37,683
use that as your résumé
and win it, I'm for it.

1440
01:05:37,767 --> 01:05:39,143
Ben.

1441
01:05:39,226 --> 01:05:40,353
No, I'm serious, though.

1442
01:05:40,436 --> 01:05:42,980
Because, listen... (stammers)

1443
01:05:43,064 --> 01:05:44,148
you gave such a good speech
last night...

1444
01:05:44,231 --> 01:05:46,901
<i>SARAH:</i>
<i>You're seriously</i>
<i>okay with that?</i>

1445
01:05:46,984 --> 01:05:48,027
<i>BEN:</i>
<i>Mm-hmm.</i>

1446
01:05:48,110 --> 01:05:49,987
<i>SARAH:</i>
<i>Ben.</i>

1447
01:05:50,071 --> 01:05:52,573
Listen, that way, you can't say
you got drug along.

1448
01:05:55,076 --> 01:05:56,994
-Ben.
-You know what I'm saying?

1449
01:05:59,163 --> 01:06:01,707
Are you being serious?

1450
01:06:01,791 --> 01:06:03,876
I'm being whatever this is.

1451
01:06:05,836 --> 01:06:07,004
I love you.

1452
01:06:07,088 --> 01:06:08,923
Ben.

1453
01:06:09,006 --> 01:06:11,384
You have my permission.

1454
01:06:11,467 --> 01:06:13,052
..., Ben.

1455
01:06:13,135 --> 01:06:14,178
Why are you doing this?

1456
01:06:14,261 --> 01:06:17,515
You have to go
... win it though. Okay?

1457
01:06:19,850 --> 01:06:21,894
<i>BEN:</i>
<i>I've struggled enough</i>
<i>in my heart.</i>

1458
01:06:21,977 --> 01:06:24,355
<i>I know she's been</i>
<i>struggling to protect me,</i>

1459
01:06:24,438 --> 01:06:25,564
and I don't want
to drag her down.

1460
01:06:25,648 --> 01:06:29,402
<i>It's just, I feel in my heart</i>
<i>the right thing to do</i>

1461
01:06:29,485 --> 01:06:31,070
is to give her permission.

1462
01:06:31,153 --> 01:06:33,197
And she doesn't have to, but
if she does, she does, you know?

1463
01:06:33,280 --> 01:06:35,741
<i>I know, no matter what happens,</i>

1464
01:06:35,825 --> 01:06:37,952
<i>I'm gonna walk away from</i>
Survivor<i> with my head held high</i>

1465
01:06:38,035 --> 01:06:40,079
<i>and actually have</i>
<i>actual friends.</i>

1466
01:06:40,162 --> 01:06:43,082
'Cause having friends
is worth more than money.

1467
01:06:45,626 --> 01:06:49,755
<i>SARAH:</i>
<i>Ben has given me the blessing</i>
<i>to vote him out.</i>

1468
01:06:49,839 --> 01:06:51,215
<i>And it tears me up, like...</i>

1469
01:06:51,298 --> 01:06:54,427
He's looked out for me
this whole game,

1470
01:06:54,510 --> 01:06:55,428
and I've looked out for him.

1471
01:06:55,511 --> 01:06:59,432
<i>And in a game where</i>
<i>you can't trust anyone,</i>

1472
01:06:59,515 --> 01:07:02,309
we trust each other 100%.

1473
01:07:02,393 --> 01:07:07,982
<i>And to see him in tears</i>
<i>destroys me.</i>

1474
01:07:08,065 --> 01:07:09,150
He's the last person
that I want to hurt.

1475
01:07:09,233 --> 01:07:11,277
<i>MICHELE:</i>
<i>I think she's</i>
<i>straight-up lying.</i>

1476
01:07:11,360 --> 01:07:15,823
-I-I'm 95% confident that
they're gonna go on me tonight.
-Yeah.

1477
01:07:15,906 --> 01:07:19,076
<i>SARAH:</i>
<i>But in order for me</i>
<i>to even have a shot,</i>

1478
01:07:19,160 --> 01:07:20,244
<i>I have to make a move.</i>

1479
01:07:20,327 --> 01:07:24,665
<i>And I have to make a move</i>
<i>without Tony.</i>

1480
01:07:24,749 --> 01:07:26,292
I've had to make hard decisions,

1481
01:07:26,375 --> 01:07:30,254
<i>but this one's the worst ever.</i>

1482
01:07:30,337 --> 01:07:32,339
<i>And I don't know</i>
<i>what I'm gonna do.</i>

1483
01:07:40,931 --> 01:07:43,684
♪ ♪

1484
01:07:45,436 --> 01:07:47,480
PROBST:
So I was thinking about
you guys today,

1485
01:07:47,563 --> 01:07:48,773
and I have a thought.

1486
01:07:48,856 --> 01:07:52,610
This season was envisioned
as a celebration.

1487
01:07:52,693 --> 01:07:54,820
Let's bring back
20 of the greatest

1488
01:07:54,904 --> 01:07:57,281
and let's just watch them play,
one more time.

1489
01:07:57,364 --> 01:08:01,535
But when you invite winners back
and you call it<i> Winners at War,</i>

1490
01:08:01,619 --> 01:08:03,954
you also invite
that competitive spirit

1491
01:08:04,038 --> 01:08:05,706
that got all you guys here

1492
01:08:05,790 --> 01:08:06,874
to win the game
in the first place.

1493
01:08:06,957 --> 01:08:10,294
And you started at this pace
that has been unforgiving,

1494
01:08:10,377 --> 01:08:12,963
like a group of marathon runners
that went a little too quick

1495
01:08:13,047 --> 01:08:16,133
that first mile and they are
trying desperately to finish.

1496
01:08:16,217 --> 01:08:19,011
Painful to go through,
powerful to watch.

1497
01:08:19,094 --> 01:08:21,347
And one of the themes
this season

1498
01:08:21,430 --> 01:08:22,515
has been breakthroughs.

1499
01:08:22,598 --> 01:08:25,559
Sarah, you had one at the last
Tribal that was amazing.

1500
01:08:25,643 --> 01:08:28,896
Been carrying around two years
of pain that you now realize

1501
01:08:28,979 --> 01:08:32,566
wasn't even yours to carry;
it was some gender bias crap.

1502
01:08:32,650 --> 01:08:34,360
-It's now gone.
-It's Lacina.

1503
01:08:34,443 --> 01:08:35,528
You're right.

1504
01:08:35,611 --> 01:08:37,029
(laughter)

1505
01:08:37,112 --> 01:08:37,571
Lacina.

1506
01:08:37,655 --> 01:08:40,199
So here's the thought.

1507
01:08:40,282 --> 01:08:45,538
Is it possible that<i> Survivor</i>
serves the purpose of

1508
01:08:45,621 --> 01:08:51,043
a well-intentioned
but relentless adversary

1509
01:08:51,126 --> 01:08:52,211
that pushes you
to deal with stuff?

1510
01:08:52,294 --> 01:08:56,382
It's not just 39 days in Fiji.
That's a great vacation.

1511
01:08:56,465 --> 01:09:00,052
This is 39 days of
intense personal scrutiny.

1512
01:09:00,135 --> 01:09:01,720
SARAH:
Yeah. It brings out
the best in you

1513
01:09:01,804 --> 01:09:03,430
and it brings out
the worst in you.

1514
01:09:03,514 --> 01:09:08,060
I always chose to ignore when it
would bring out the best in me,

1515
01:09:08,143 --> 01:09:10,563
and I wouldn't give myself
credit for that,

1516
01:09:10,646 --> 01:09:13,732
and I would downplay
those moments.

1517
01:09:13,816 --> 01:09:17,069
And I would take when
it brings out the worst in me

1518
01:09:17,152 --> 01:09:18,863
and inflate it.

1519
01:09:18,946 --> 01:09:21,073
I was so hard on myself,
but I think you have to

1520
01:09:21,157 --> 01:09:22,408
forgive yourself, and it's okay.

1521
01:09:22,491 --> 01:09:26,078
But I think everybody
walks away from this growing.

1522
01:09:26,161 --> 01:09:28,247
And so if that's what
I get out of this journey,

1523
01:09:28,330 --> 01:09:30,749
it's worth everything for me.

1524
01:09:30,833 --> 01:09:33,043
PROBST:
Ben, when Sarah said

1525
01:09:33,127 --> 01:09:35,963
she downplays the good
but really highlights the bad,

1526
01:09:36,046 --> 01:09:37,882
you were nodding.

1527
01:09:37,965 --> 01:09:39,425
What were you relating to
about that?

1528
01:09:39,508 --> 01:09:41,468
Coming out this time, I-I didn't
want to be that person again.

1529
01:09:41,552 --> 01:09:43,470
She talks about growth,

1530
01:09:43,554 --> 01:09:44,930
and that's what this season
was for me.

1531
01:09:45,014 --> 01:09:45,973
It was growth.

1532
01:09:46,056 --> 01:09:48,767
I wanted to be
a more positive person,

1533
01:09:48,851 --> 01:09:51,604
you know, represent my family
in-in a better light,

1534
01:09:51,687 --> 01:09:54,106
and walk away from
this experience with friends,

1535
01:09:54,189 --> 01:09:57,943
not go back home and not like
the person that I was, you know?

1536
01:09:58,027 --> 01:10:00,446
And I think that is worth more
than any, um, dollar sign

1537
01:10:00,529 --> 01:10:02,448
or anything like that.

1538
01:10:02,531 --> 01:10:05,117
That's been my goal.

1539
01:10:05,201 --> 01:10:10,664
So what is it, Tony, that, in
this game, highlights the bad

1540
01:10:10,748 --> 01:10:14,627
in your eyes, when the audience
so often sees the good?

1541
01:10:14,710 --> 01:10:16,795
'Cause they're not
dealing with the people.

1542
01:10:16,879 --> 01:10:19,131
Th-They're watching a show for
entertainment purposes only.

1543
01:10:19,215 --> 01:10:21,967
They're not dealing with
the emotions and the feelings

1544
01:10:22,051 --> 01:10:24,511
that you get from people
that you bond with.

1545
01:10:24,595 --> 01:10:26,639
They don't see
the social part of it.

1546
01:10:26,722 --> 01:10:27,932
They see the strategic part.

1547
01:10:28,015 --> 01:10:29,141
"I'm gonna blindside
this person.

1548
01:10:29,224 --> 01:10:30,476
I'm gonna play an idol
and send somebody home."

1549
01:10:30,559 --> 01:10:33,646
And then I'm here with people
that I just know,

1550
01:10:33,729 --> 01:10:35,272
and it's like
the closer I get to them,

1551
01:10:35,356 --> 01:10:36,565
the harder it is
to vote them off.

1552
01:10:36,649 --> 01:10:38,651
So that's the feeling
that nobody can get

1553
01:10:38,734 --> 01:10:40,110
from watching it on TV.

1554
01:10:40,194 --> 01:10:41,487
PROBST:
So, Lacina,
when you get back to camp,

1555
01:10:41,570 --> 01:10:46,700
Tony's got his fourth win,
there's only four other people,

1556
01:10:46,784 --> 01:10:48,827
what happens?
What's that like?

1557
01:10:48,911 --> 01:10:52,498
SARAH:
Well, I think
it's time to evaluate:

1558
01:10:52,581 --> 01:10:54,959
How do you get through tonight

1559
01:10:55,042 --> 01:10:58,045
and set yourself up
for success tomorrow?

1560
01:10:58,128 --> 01:11:01,006
So I think
everybody had conversations

1561
01:11:01,090 --> 01:11:04,677
with everyone today,
because the game turned

1562
01:11:04,760 --> 01:11:07,471
not so alliance based and turned

1563
01:11:07,554 --> 01:11:09,473
more into
an individual game today.

1564
01:11:09,556 --> 01:11:11,850
This is the last time
we write someone's name down

1565
01:11:11,934 --> 01:11:13,811
to vote them out.

1566
01:11:13,894 --> 01:11:16,981
After this, everybody's on their
own to save their own butt.

1567
01:11:17,856 --> 01:11:20,192
Ben, was it different
for you today?

1568
01:11:20,275 --> 01:11:21,193
It was a little different.

1569
01:11:21,277 --> 01:11:25,489
And tonight is about being brave
and being strong

1570
01:11:25,572 --> 01:11:28,867
and having friendships
and just staying positive, Jeff.

1571
01:11:28,951 --> 01:11:30,369
That's all we got to do.

1572
01:11:30,452 --> 01:11:32,705
PROBST:
So, Michele, it sounds like

1573
01:11:32,788 --> 01:11:34,206
without anybody saying it,
the collective unconscious

1574
01:11:34,289 --> 01:11:38,377
all just sort of happened, which
is, "Oh, we're on our own now."

1575
01:11:38,460 --> 01:11:39,920
MICHELE:
I don't know.

1576
01:11:40,004 --> 01:11:43,841
I have been running against
this wall of an alliance

1577
01:11:43,924 --> 01:11:46,719
for over a week now...

1578
01:11:46,802 --> 01:11:48,012
You're talking with
Sarah, Ben and Tony?

1579
01:11:48,095 --> 01:11:50,097
MICHELE:
Yeah, that's right.

1580
01:11:50,180 --> 01:11:52,558
I think these players found
a very strong alliance,

1581
01:11:52,641 --> 01:11:56,562
very early on, that carried them
through this game.

1582
01:11:56,645 --> 01:11:58,564
I've been in
a very different position,

1583
01:11:58,647 --> 01:12:03,610
so of course my optimism says,
"I hope I can work my way in,"

1584
01:12:03,694 --> 01:12:05,904
but my realistic side
of me says,

1585
01:12:05,988 --> 01:12:09,491
"I haven't been able to do that
yet, so curb your expectation."

1586
01:12:11,827 --> 01:12:13,746
All right, it is time to vote.

1587
01:12:13,829 --> 01:12:15,789
Michele, you're up.

1588
01:12:15,873 --> 01:12:17,458
♪ ♪

1589
01:12:38,520 --> 01:12:39,605
I'll go tally the votes.

1590
01:12:51,992 --> 01:12:53,452
If anybody has
a hidden immunity idol

1591
01:12:53,535 --> 01:12:55,704
and you want to play it,
now would be the time to do so.

1592
01:12:58,707 --> 01:13:00,667
-Okay.
-Oh.

1593
01:13:00,751 --> 01:13:03,504
♪ ♪

1594
01:13:06,340 --> 01:13:08,300
I hope this goes as planned.

1595
01:13:08,384 --> 01:13:10,719
-I'm playing this
for myself tonight.
-Okay.

1596
01:13:14,681 --> 01:13:15,682
This is a hidden immunity idol.

1597
01:13:15,766 --> 01:13:18,811
Any votes cast for Natalie
will not count.

1598
01:13:18,894 --> 01:13:19,561
Wow.

1599
01:13:21,772 --> 01:13:22,815
I'll read the votes.

1600
01:13:25,567 --> 01:13:27,236
First vote:

1601
01:13:27,319 --> 01:13:28,612
Ben.

1602
01:13:31,907 --> 01:13:32,908
Michele.

1603
01:13:35,702 --> 01:13:36,829
Ben.

1604
01:13:36,912 --> 01:13:38,622
Two votes Ben, one vote Michele.

1605
01:13:41,792 --> 01:13:43,669
Michele. We're tied.
Two votes Ben,

1606
01:13:43,752 --> 01:13:45,546
two votes Michele,
one vote left.

1607
01:13:47,923 --> 01:13:49,633
18th person voted out of
<i>Survivor: Winners at War...</i>

1608
01:13:51,760 --> 01:13:52,803
-...Ben.
-Ooh.

1609
01:13:58,934 --> 01:14:00,435
Love you.

1610
01:14:03,605 --> 01:14:06,024
-Hope you all are
ready to party.
-(laughter)

1611
01:14:08,277 --> 01:14:11,029
You know I'm getting a hug
from you, too, Mr. Jeff.

1612
01:14:11,113 --> 01:14:11,697
I'll take it.

1613
01:14:11,780 --> 01:14:14,241
Ben, the tribe has spoken.

1614
01:14:15,951 --> 01:14:16,869
Thanks for playing.

1615
01:14:16,952 --> 01:14:18,787
Yeah, buddy.

1616
01:14:20,080 --> 01:14:21,999
Aha!

1617
01:14:22,958 --> 01:14:25,002
PROBST:
You've made it
to the final four.

1618
01:14:25,085 --> 01:14:27,713
Tomorrow you will compete in
your final immunity challenge.

1619
01:14:27,796 --> 01:14:30,382
Get some rest.

1620
01:14:30,465 --> 01:14:31,758
Grab your torches,
head back to camp.

1621
01:14:31,842 --> 01:14:34,011
Good night.

1622
01:14:36,305 --> 01:14:37,890
<i>BEN:</i>
<i>This has been a humbling</i>

1623
01:14:37,973 --> 01:14:40,767
and a fantastic
learning experience for myself.

1624
01:14:40,851 --> 01:14:42,769
<i>I got what I needed</i>
<i>out of this season:</i>

1625
01:14:42,853 --> 01:14:44,897
<i>a lot of self-growth.</i>

1626
01:14:44,980 --> 01:14:46,064
<i>I left it all out there.</i>

1627
01:14:46,148 --> 01:14:48,942
<i>I'm proud of my game and</i>
<i>grateful for the experience</i>

1628
01:14:49,026 --> 01:14:52,237
<i>that</i> Survivor<i> has given me</i>
<i>and my children and my wife.</i>

1629
01:14:52,321 --> 01:14:53,697
Very much appreciative
and-and blessed.

1630
01:15:00,996 --> 01:15:03,123
♪ ♪

1631
01:15:08,629 --> 01:15:10,422
Come on in, guys!

1632
01:15:10,505 --> 01:15:12,424
(sighs)

1633
01:15:20,933 --> 01:15:21,850
All right.

1634
01:15:21,934 --> 01:15:25,771
Shall we get to
your final immunity challenge?

1635
01:15:25,854 --> 01:15:28,315
First things first, Tony,
for the fourth time,

1636
01:15:28,398 --> 01:15:29,733
got to take back the necklace.

1637
01:15:30,817 --> 01:15:32,569
-Thank you.
-Yep.

1638
01:15:34,696 --> 01:15:39,743
For the last time,
immunity is back up for grabs.

1639
01:15:39,826 --> 01:15:41,078
<i>For today's challenge,</i>

1640
01:15:41,161 --> 01:15:43,622
<i>you'll have one hand</i>
<i>tied behind your back.</i>

1641
01:15:43,705 --> 01:15:46,625
<i>On my go, you'll drop a ball</i>
<i>down a chute.</i>

1642
01:15:46,708 --> 01:15:47,626
<i>It will spiral to the bottom.</i>

1643
01:15:47,709 --> 01:15:48,794
<i>You'll catch it,</i>
<i>put it back in.</i>

1644
01:15:48,877 --> 01:15:52,965
<i>At regular intervals,</i>
<i>we will add more balls,</i>

1645
01:15:53,048 --> 01:15:54,967
<i>making it more difficult.</i>

1646
01:15:55,050 --> 01:15:56,885
<i>If at any point a ball drops,</i>
<i>you're out.</i>

1647
01:15:56,969 --> 01:16:02,766
Last person left standing wins
immunity, is guaranteed a spot

1648
01:16:02,849 --> 01:16:06,395
at the final Tribal Council
where you will get a chance

1649
01:16:06,478 --> 01:16:10,440
to plead your case to the jury
about why you deserve

1650
01:16:10,524 --> 01:16:11,817
the title of Sole Survivor

1651
01:16:11,900 --> 01:16:14,611
and the $2 million prize
that comes with it.

1652
01:16:14,695 --> 01:16:17,406
In addition, you control
the fate of the other three.

1653
01:16:17,489 --> 01:16:19,032
Who do you bring with you?

1654
01:16:19,116 --> 01:16:20,826
Who do you force to make fire?

1655
01:16:20,909 --> 01:16:23,662
The biggest challenge of
<i>Survivor: Winners at War</i>

1656
01:16:23,745 --> 01:16:24,830
is here.

1657
01:16:24,913 --> 01:16:26,123
Let's do it.

1658
01:16:33,588 --> 01:16:33,880
All right.

1659
01:16:33,964 --> 01:16:35,716
Here we go.

1660
01:16:35,799 --> 01:16:38,677
You'll have five seconds
to drop your first ball.

1661
01:16:38,760 --> 01:16:41,555
Everybody, grab one.

1662
01:16:42,764 --> 01:16:47,060
Five, four, three,

1663
01:16:47,144 --> 01:16:49,730
two, one.

1664
01:16:51,440 --> 01:16:52,899
And it's on.

1665
01:16:52,983 --> 01:16:55,861
The final immunity challenge
in our 40th season of<i> Survivor.</i>

1666
01:16:55,944 --> 01:16:59,239
Natalie, Michele,

1667
01:16:59,323 --> 01:17:02,117
Tony and Sarah.

1668
01:17:03,410 --> 01:17:05,662
Your ball will rotate

1669
01:17:05,746 --> 01:17:07,789
which side it comes out
automatically every time.

1670
01:17:07,873 --> 01:17:11,668
So if it comes out on
the right side, the next time,

1671
01:17:11,752 --> 01:17:13,462
it will be on the left.

1672
01:17:14,463 --> 01:17:17,841
This'll continue
as we add more balls into this.

1673
01:17:20,635 --> 01:17:21,762
Couple of
interesting statistics.

1674
01:17:21,845 --> 01:17:24,890
Of the four of you,
all of whom won the game,

1675
01:17:24,973 --> 01:17:28,518
only one of you won
the final immunity challenge

1676
01:17:28,602 --> 01:17:30,187
in their season: Michele.

1677
01:17:30,270 --> 01:17:33,732
Contrast that
against this statistic.

1678
01:17:33,815 --> 01:17:36,526
We have done this challenge
three times

1679
01:17:36,610 --> 01:17:38,737
as the final immunity challenge,

1680
01:17:38,820 --> 01:17:42,407
and every person who won it
won the game.

1681
01:17:43,200 --> 01:17:45,744
All right,
you each have 15 seconds

1682
01:17:45,827 --> 01:17:47,788
to place another ball.

1683
01:17:47,871 --> 01:17:48,747
That's a big window.

1684
01:17:48,830 --> 01:17:50,916
You can use that time
however you want.

1685
01:17:50,999 --> 01:17:53,919
You got to stay focused
right now.

1686
01:17:54,002 --> 01:17:57,839
This is that moment right here.

1687
01:17:59,007 --> 01:18:03,220
Everybody now has two balls
in motion.

1688
01:18:03,303 --> 01:18:05,764
Now it just got
a little more difficult.

1689
01:18:05,847 --> 01:18:09,101
Now you have one ball
coming out on the right,

1690
01:18:09,184 --> 01:18:11,186
the next ball on the left.

1691
01:18:12,312 --> 01:18:14,106
That ball drops,

1692
01:18:14,189 --> 01:18:18,276
you're out and you are not
in control of your fate tonight.

1693
01:18:18,360 --> 01:18:20,404
♪ ♪

1694
01:18:37,504 --> 01:18:39,965
All right,
everybody has 15 seconds

1695
01:18:40,048 --> 01:18:42,884
to place a third ball.

1696
01:18:42,968 --> 01:18:45,762
Natalie drops.

1697
01:18:46,847 --> 01:18:47,305
Tony drops his.

1698
01:18:47,389 --> 01:18:50,308
Michele drops hers.

1699
01:18:50,392 --> 01:18:51,810
Sarah drops hers.

1700
01:18:51,893 --> 01:18:53,937
Everybody now with three balls
in motion.

1701
01:18:54,020 --> 01:18:55,981
Now the challenge is full-on.

1702
01:18:56,064 --> 01:18:57,858
You got to be
on your toes now.

1703
01:19:00,485 --> 01:19:02,946
Always thinking,
"Right, left, right, left."

1704
01:19:08,910 --> 01:19:11,788
-(shouts)
-Tony drops.

1705
01:19:11,872 --> 01:19:12,998
He's first out.
No shot at immunity.

1706
01:19:15,125 --> 01:19:18,086
It is Natalie,
Michele and Sarah.

1707
01:19:19,921 --> 01:19:22,674
Three women now
fighting for immunity.

1708
01:19:25,927 --> 01:19:29,306
This game requires so much.

1709
01:19:29,389 --> 01:19:32,017
It is an all-encompassing
challenge of the human spirit,

1710
01:19:32,100 --> 01:19:36,897
depriving you of
all of your basic needs,

1711
01:19:36,980 --> 01:19:41,818
all while everybody else in the
game is trying to take you out.

1712
01:19:49,284 --> 01:19:52,037
All right,
you each have 15 seconds

1713
01:19:52,120 --> 01:19:55,207
to place another ball.

1714
01:19:55,290 --> 01:19:56,917
Natalie drops.

1715
01:19:58,126 --> 01:19:59,711
Michele drops hers.

1716
01:20:03,465 --> 01:20:05,383
-Sarah drops. She's out.
-(grunts)

1717
01:20:05,467 --> 01:20:08,386
We're down to two.
They are side by side.

1718
01:20:10,931 --> 01:20:14,226
It is Natalie and Michele,
both with four balls.

1719
01:20:14,309 --> 01:20:18,563
One of them is guaranteed a spot
at the final Tribal Council.

1720
01:20:20,941 --> 01:20:24,361
Five balls is the most we have
ever done in this challenge.

1721
01:20:24,444 --> 01:20:26,363
You are at four.

1722
01:20:27,155 --> 01:20:28,990
Cannot lose your concentration.

1723
01:20:34,496 --> 01:20:35,956
Both women zoned in.

1724
01:20:37,999 --> 01:20:39,167
Michele very steady.

1725
01:20:43,630 --> 01:20:45,757
Nice save by Natalie.

1726
01:20:48,176 --> 01:20:50,887
All right,
you each have 15 seconds

1727
01:20:50,971 --> 01:20:52,764
to place your fifth ball.

1728
01:20:54,015 --> 01:20:57,227
We're live
during this transition.

1729
01:20:58,061 --> 01:21:00,897
Ten seconds left.

1730
01:21:01,439 --> 01:21:02,983
Michele drops hers.

1731
01:21:05,193 --> 01:21:07,487
Natalie drops.

1732
01:21:07,571 --> 01:21:10,907
Both women have all five balls
in motion now.

1733
01:21:14,160 --> 01:21:17,914
The most we've ever done
in this challenge.

1734
01:21:17,998 --> 01:21:20,083
The pace is very fast now.

1735
01:21:24,713 --> 01:21:26,590
One mistake and it's over.

1736
01:21:29,551 --> 01:21:31,511
Nice save by Natalie.

1737
01:21:31,595 --> 01:21:33,972
Pacing of your balls
is so critical right now,

1738
01:21:34,055 --> 01:21:37,851
how fast they kick out
of that chute.

1739
01:21:41,229 --> 01:21:44,149
Natalie again
with a nice bobble and save.

1740
01:21:44,232 --> 01:21:47,694
Michele with a really nice pace.

1741
01:21:51,823 --> 01:21:53,700
Natalie with another save.

1742
01:21:53,783 --> 01:21:56,202
Never has to be pretty
on<i> Survivor.</i>

1743
01:21:58,913 --> 01:22:00,540
-(shouts)
-Oh, my God!
-Michele drops!

1744
01:22:00,624 --> 01:22:01,666
-Did I win?! (shouts)
-It's over!

1745
01:22:01,750 --> 01:22:03,043
-Natalie has won
individual immunity...
-Oh, my God!

1746
01:22:03,126 --> 01:22:06,171
-Oh, my God.
-...and has come
all the way back

1747
01:22:06,254 --> 01:22:09,007
from being voted out on day two

1748
01:22:09,090 --> 01:22:13,553
and is back now
at the final Tribal Council.

1749
01:22:13,637 --> 01:22:15,138
-Wow.
-(Natalie pants)

1750
01:22:19,476 --> 01:22:20,060
(sputters)

1751
01:22:20,143 --> 01:22:22,687
Natalie, come on over.

1752
01:22:22,771 --> 01:22:24,814
Jeff, this doesn't
seem real right now.

1753
01:22:24,898 --> 01:22:25,190
It's real.

1754
01:22:28,276 --> 01:22:31,738
Individual immunity is yours.

1755
01:22:31,821 --> 01:22:34,115
You are guaranteed
a spot at the final three.

1756
01:22:34,199 --> 01:22:36,034
-(Natalie exclaims)
-You're in charge
of what happens

1757
01:22:36,117 --> 01:22:39,037
for the rest of the night
as well.

1758
01:22:39,120 --> 01:22:41,164
You're gonna take one person
and sit them next to you

1759
01:22:41,247 --> 01:22:43,875
and force two people
to make fire.

1760
01:22:43,958 --> 01:22:45,627
All right, grab your stuff,
head back to camp.

1761
01:22:45,710 --> 01:22:47,045
-See you tonight
at Tribal Council.
-Thanks, Jeff.

1762
01:22:47,128 --> 01:22:47,837
Congrats.

1763
01:22:47,921 --> 01:22:49,798
<i>TONY:</i>
<i>Today was the biggest</i>

1764
01:22:49,881 --> 01:22:51,716
immunity challenge
of the season.

1765
01:22:51,800 --> 01:22:52,634
<i>I could've tied a record,</i>

1766
01:22:52,717 --> 01:22:55,011
<i>which is five</i>
<i>immunity challenge wins.</i>

1767
01:22:55,095 --> 01:22:56,054
All I do is catch the ball,
put it back,

1768
01:22:56,137 --> 01:22:57,222
catch the ball, put it back,

1769
01:22:57,305 --> 01:22:58,848
<i>and I would've been</i>
<i>in good shape.</i>

1770
01:22:58,932 --> 01:23:00,767
<i>I lost focus for a second,</i>
<i>and just like that,</i>

1771
01:23:00,850 --> 01:23:02,894
my game is in the fate of fire.

1772
01:23:11,111 --> 01:23:12,112
♪ ♪

1773
01:23:15,657 --> 01:23:17,409
<i>NATALIE:</i>
<i>I'm so excited.</i>

1774
01:23:17,492 --> 01:23:21,204
<i>I'm proud of myself</i>
<i>that I never stopped trying</i>

1775
01:23:21,287 --> 01:23:22,872
to give it my best shot.

1776
01:23:22,956 --> 01:23:24,582
TONY:
Oh, so this is the knife, huh?

1777
01:23:24,666 --> 01:23:27,127
-SARAH: Yes.
<i>-NATALIE:</i>
<i>But before the sun sets,</i>

1778
01:23:27,210 --> 01:23:29,421
<i>I have the biggest decision</i>

1779
01:23:29,504 --> 01:23:30,880
of my life.

1780
01:23:32,966 --> 01:23:33,883
Yeah, absolutely.

1781
01:23:33,967 --> 01:23:35,093
-Against each other.
-I know.

1782
01:23:35,176 --> 01:23:36,886
<i>TONY:</i>
<i>So I'm pretty certain that</i>

1783
01:23:36,970 --> 01:23:38,972
<i>Natalie's gonna throw Sarah</i>
<i>under the bus</i>

1784
01:23:39,055 --> 01:23:40,598
and make me go against
the other cop.

1785
01:23:40,682 --> 01:23:42,392
Damn, Sarah,
that's how our story ends?

1786
01:23:42,475 --> 01:23:44,769
-Cops-R-Us, man?
We-we kill each other?
-No, it's not. It's not.

1787
01:23:44,853 --> 01:23:46,104
W-We don't know that yet.

1788
01:23:49,858 --> 01:23:52,902
What is the other strategy?

1789
01:23:52,986 --> 01:23:53,445
This?

1790
01:23:53,528 --> 01:23:56,114
I don't like that way.

1791
01:23:56,197 --> 01:23:57,907
TONY:
That's how you do it.

1792
01:23:57,991 --> 01:23:59,784
-SARAH: Why?
-Y-You're hitting it
too straight on.

1793
01:23:59,868 --> 01:24:01,286
Straighten up the knife
a little bit. Yeah, like that.

1794
01:24:01,369 --> 01:24:02,912
-This way?
-Yeah, not that much,
but you know.

1795
01:24:02,996 --> 01:24:03,455
You're breaking the flint,
Sarah.

1796
01:24:03,538 --> 01:24:05,707
You got to be careful.

1797
01:24:08,501 --> 01:24:10,003
Right?

1798
01:24:10,086 --> 01:24:11,963
That is right.

1799
01:24:12,046 --> 01:24:14,799
I'm not even gonna practice
if you go up against me.

1800
01:24:14,883 --> 01:24:16,092
'Cause you suck.

1801
01:24:17,427 --> 01:24:18,970
Now, how do we get you up?

1802
01:24:21,389 --> 01:24:22,515
How did you do that?

1803
01:24:24,267 --> 01:24:25,185
I'm gonna have a hard time, man.

1804
01:24:27,187 --> 01:24:29,397
MICHELE:
You go, girl.

1805
01:24:29,481 --> 01:24:31,357
Not bad.

1806
01:24:35,403 --> 01:24:37,697
<i>NATALIE:</i>
<i>Tony's the biggest threat</i>
<i>in the game,</i>

1807
01:24:37,781 --> 01:24:40,617
<i>and getting him out</i>
<i>would be ideal.</i>

1808
01:24:40,700 --> 01:24:42,452
<i>So there's two options:</i>

1809
01:24:42,535 --> 01:24:45,330
<i>Michele and Sarah.</i>

1810
01:24:45,413 --> 01:24:47,332
<i>The reason I wouldn't want</i>
<i>Sarah beating Tony</i>

1811
01:24:47,415 --> 01:24:53,046
<i>is that gives her this really</i>
<i>strong story at the end.</i>

1812
01:24:53,129 --> 01:24:57,050
