mais elle avait reçu l'avantage
"Connaissance égale Pouvoir".

2393
01:51:06,272 --> 01:51:09,006
Shan l'a révélé
par accident à Tiffany,

2394
01:51:09,131 --> 01:51:11,702
qui m'a alors dit
que Liana avait un avantage.

2395
01:51:11,827 --> 01:51:13,952
Liana s'est alors sentie
forcée de me dire

2396
01:51:14,077 --> 01:51:16,581
qu'elle avait cet avantage.
On s'est assises,

2397
01:51:16,706 --> 01:51:19,294
elle m'a montré le papier
et j'ai pu lire exactement

2398
01:51:19,419 --> 01:51:21,245
comment marchait l'avantage.

2399
01:51:21,370 --> 01:51:24,251
Il est devenu clair,
quand mon nom était sur le billot,

2400
01:51:24,376 --> 01:51:26,369
que Liana n'était plus avec nous.

2401
01:51:26,494 --> 01:51:30,277
Et Xander avait dit aux gens :
"Je vais jouer mon idole pour Evvie."

2402
01:51:30,402 --> 01:51:32,962
Donc, quand vous essayez
de mettre un plan en place,

2403
01:51:33,087 --> 01:51:34,345
devez-vous dire :

2404
01:51:34,470 --> 01:51:37,176
"Hé, retrouve moi près de l'arbre,
j'ai une idée." ?

2405
01:51:37,301 --> 01:51:38,979
Ouais, l'étonnant, avec Yase,

2406
01:51:39,104 --> 01:51:41,715
c'est qu'on travaillait ensemble
depuis si longtemps

2407
01:51:41,840 --> 01:51:44,952
que rapidement, j'ai dit à Tiffany :
"On doit bouger l'idole."

2408
01:51:45,077 --> 01:51:47,071
Elle a dit à Xander :
"On doit bouger l'idole."

2409
01:51:47,196 --> 01:51:49,573
On a couru dans les bois,
Xander a pris son sac.

2410
01:51:49,698 --> 01:51:52,455
Très vite, on a tout fourré
dans le soutien-gorge de Tiff,

2411
01:51:52,580 --> 01:51:55,774
et Xander a mis cette fausse idole
dans son entrejambe,

2412
01:51:55,899 --> 01:51:57,452
pile quand Liana arrivait.

2413
01:51:57,577 --> 01:51:58,911
<font color="#fab419">C'est le chaos...</font>

2414
01:51:59,632 --> 01:52:02,030
- On doit te protéger.
- Oui.

2415
01:52:02,155 --> 01:52:04,013
- J'ai vraiment peur.
- T'inquiète pas pour ça.

2416
01:52:05,177 --> 01:52:06,828
<font color="#fab419">- Tu la joues pour elle ?
- Oui.</font>

2417
01:52:06,953 --> 01:52:08,783
<font color="#fab419">- C'est sûr ?
- Certain.</font>

2418
01:52:08,908 --> 01:52:09,850
OK.

2419
01:52:09,975 --> 01:52:11,554
Le timing était parfait,

2420
01:52:11,679 --> 01:52:15,375
car elle a cru le voir mettre
la vraie idole dans son pantalon.

2421
01:52:15,500 --> 01:52:17,017
Ça a parfaitement marché.

2422
01:52:17,142 --> 01:52:18,402
Elle a vraiment cru

2423
01:52:18,527 --> 01:52:21,218
qu'on lui faisait confiance,
alors que pas du tout,

2424
01:52:21,343 --> 01:52:23,149
on savait ce qu'elle mijotait.

2425
01:52:23,275 --> 01:52:26,615
Et je dois reconnaître à Xander
un beau talent d'acteur.

2426
01:52:26,865 --> 01:52:27,713
Et...

2427
01:52:27,838 --> 01:52:30,244
Pour être honnête,
c'était vraiment effrayant,

2428
01:52:30,369 --> 01:52:32,314
j'ai quand même failli partir.

2429
01:52:32,572 --> 01:52:35,119
Mais savoir qu'on avait cet avantage,

2430
01:52:35,244 --> 01:52:38,627
on a utilisé nos relations,
les connaissances qu'on partageait,

2431
01:52:38,791 --> 01:52:42,078
pour contrecarrer la première fois
que cet avantage était joué.

2432
01:52:42,203 --> 01:52:43,661
C'était un moment génial.

2433
01:52:43,786 --> 01:52:46,056
Xander, quand vous regardez
un moment comme ça,

2434
01:52:46,181 --> 01:52:47,579
en tant que spectateur,

2435
01:52:47,704 --> 01:52:50,219
vous oubliez que vous regardez
de vrais gens.

2436
01:52:50,344 --> 01:52:53,478
On commence à penser
qu'on regarde une série.

2437
01:52:53,603 --> 01:52:56,337
Mais comment est la tension ?
Quel est le niveau d'adrénaline ?

2438
01:52:56,462 --> 01:52:58,075
Car, comme Evvie l'a décrit,

2439
01:52:58,200 --> 01:53:00,649
Liana va apparaître
d'ici quelques secondes.

2440
01:53:00,973 --> 01:53:04,270
Oui, c'est une sacrée montée
d'adrénaline de devoir

2441
01:53:04,644 --> 01:53:07,378
établir ce plan
et déterminer quoi faire

2442
01:53:07,503 --> 01:53:10,073
à partir d'informations
pas forcément vraies.

2443
01:53:10,198 --> 01:53:12,054
Je ne sais pas à qui me fier,

2444
01:53:12,179 --> 01:53:14,573
mais on va le faire de toutes façons,

2445
01:53:14,698 --> 01:53:17,202
et paf ! Elle est là,
on doit le faire.

2446
01:53:17,701 --> 01:53:19,503
Je suppose qu'on a un plan.

2447
01:53:19,628 --> 01:53:21,978
Liana, quand vous êtes au conseil,

2448
01:53:22,103 --> 01:53:26,346
prête à faire ce gros coup
et renverser le jeu...

2449
01:53:26,471 --> 01:53:28,301
Racontez-moi ce que vous ressentiez

2450
01:53:28,426 --> 01:53:31,291
et comment vous vous êtes sentie
une fois comprise l'arnaque.

2451
01:53:31,416 --> 01:53:33,660
Ouais, c'était un gros truc,

2452
01:53:33,785 --> 01:53:36,198
rien que le fait d'avoir l'avantage.

2453
01:53:36,323 --> 01:53:37,921
Je l'ai eu, je suis me suis dit :

2454
01:53:38,046 --> 01:53:40,207
wow, l'avantage
"Connaissance égale Pouvoir" !

2455
01:53:40,332 --> 01:53:42,825
Ça ressemblait à ce que
j'avais vécu à Yase,

2456
01:53:42,950 --> 01:53:44,979
car tout ce temps, ce gars pensait

2457
01:53:45,104 --> 01:53:47,513
que j'étais la seule ignorant
qu'il avait une idole,

2458
01:53:47,638 --> 01:53:49,617
alors que je le savais.
Donc super !

2459
01:53:49,742 --> 01:53:51,692
C'était l'avantage parfait pour moi.

2460
01:53:51,817 --> 01:53:53,357
Le plus puissant ayant existé.

2461
01:53:53,482 --> 01:53:55,325
J'avais montré l'avantage à Evvie,

2462
01:53:55,450 --> 01:53:58,628
je savais que c'était super risqué
pour la suite, pour le jouer.

2463
01:53:58,753 --> 01:54:01,721
Je vais voir Shan et dis :
"Je pense qu'ils l'ont déplacée."

2464
01:54:01,846 --> 01:54:04,964
"Pas sûre", dit-elle. Et j'ai senti
que quelque chose clochait,

2465
01:54:05,089 --> 01:54:06,837
mon sens d'araignée réagissait.

2466
01:54:06,962 --> 01:54:09,430
Mais c'est un jeu risqué,
je voulais faire ce gros coup.

2467
01:54:09,555 --> 01:54:11,218
J'ai décidé de me faire confiance.

2468
01:54:11,343 --> 01:54:13,968
J'ai juste une question
pour un joueur.

2469
01:54:15,389 --> 01:54:17,105
As-tu une idole, Xander ?

2470
01:54:18,952 --> 01:54:21,086
<font color="#fab419">Non, mais tu peux avoir cette fausse.</font>

2471
01:54:22,101 --> 01:54:24,733
Ça m'a explosé à la figure,
mais ce fut aussi

2472
01:54:24,858 --> 01:54:28,906
un grand moment de fierté dans
le jeu, au niveau de ma réaction.

2473
01:54:29,031 --> 01:54:30,719
Oui, vous l'avez très bien géré.

2474
01:54:30,844 --> 01:54:33,554
Oui, c'est ce qui est génial
dans Survivor pour moi,

2475
01:54:33,679 --> 01:54:36,649
dans cette expérience, c'est...
J'ai été mise à terre, putain !

2476
01:54:36,774 --> 01:54:37,620
Désolée.

2477
01:54:39,399 --> 01:54:41,479
J'ai été étalée, bien proprement.

2478
01:54:41,604 --> 01:54:43,292
Mais honnêtement, dans ma tête,

2479
01:54:43,417 --> 01:54:45,812
je suis pessimiste
la plupart du temps,

2480
01:54:45,937 --> 01:54:47,493
je ne crois pas trop en moi.

2481
01:54:47,618 --> 01:54:49,647
Comment parler au gens après ça ?

2482
01:54:49,772 --> 01:54:51,304
Ils m'ont vue à terre.

2483
01:54:51,429 --> 01:54:54,874
Que suis-je ? Je suis un peu inutile.
Vous voyez ? Et...

2484
01:54:55,338 --> 01:54:58,141
Il y avait ces voix
dans ma tête, qui disaient :

2485
01:54:58,562 --> 01:55:01,658
"C'est pas grave d'échouer.
C'est pas grave d'échouer."

2486
01:55:01,783 --> 01:55:04,425
Honnêtement, c'était mon plus grand
moment de fierté,

2487
01:55:04,550 --> 01:55:07,028
car ça aurait pu tourner
différemment dans ma tête.

2488
01:55:07,153 --> 01:55:09,978
Je ne sais même pas
qui est cette personne

2489
01:55:10,103 --> 01:55:13,660
qui vient de se relever
et essaye de ramasser les morceaux.

2490
01:55:13,785 --> 01:55:16,623
C'était vraiment spécial pour moi,

2491
01:55:16,748 --> 01:55:18,921
de voir la Liana d'après ce moment.

2492
01:55:19,046 --> 01:55:20,975
Pensez-vous que c'est permanent ?

2493
01:55:21,100 --> 01:55:23,589
Je l'espère, je veux que ça le soit.

2494
01:55:23,714 --> 01:55:27,280
Je pense qu'en quittant ce jeu,
je suis une nouvelle personne.

2495
01:55:27,405 --> 01:55:29,102
J'ai l'impression d'être re-née.

2496
01:55:29,227 --> 01:55:31,885
Que si j'échoue,
je reviendrai à ce moment,

2497
01:55:32,010 --> 01:55:34,963
où il y a cette voix
dans votre tête :

2498
01:55:35,088 --> 01:55:37,576
"J'ai échoué,
mais tu peux revenir, Liana."

2499
01:55:37,701 --> 01:55:39,540
"Peu importe
ce que pensent les autres."

2500
01:55:39,665 --> 01:55:42,078
"L'important, c'est la voix
dans votre tête qui dit :"

2501
01:55:42,203 --> 01:55:43,621
"«C'est OK, c'est OK.»"

2502
01:55:43,746 --> 01:55:46,935
"Tant qu'on pense pouvoir
s'en sortir, on peut tout faire."

2503
01:55:47,060 --> 01:55:49,650
J'étais si fière le lendemain matin,

2504
01:55:50,097 --> 01:55:53,558
en parlant avec Evvie :
"OK, je sais que c'était horrible,"

2505
01:55:54,241 --> 01:55:57,099
"mais c'est le coup que je pensais
le meilleur à ce moment."

2506
01:55:57,224 --> 01:56:00,075
C'était un peu comme
si j'assumais ce moment. Et...

2507
01:56:00,200 --> 01:56:02,982
Honnêtement, ça a été
mon plus grand moment de fierté.

2508
01:56:03,107 --> 01:56:06,258
Et quelle ironie que "Connaissance
égale Pouvoir" vous ait trahie.

2509
01:56:08,228 --> 01:56:10,172
Je peux avoir
une part de pizza, au fait ?

2510
01:56:10,297 --> 01:56:11,654
- Vous voulez... ?
- Oui.

2511
01:56:11,779 --> 01:56:14,044
Un instant.
On fait une pause et on revient.

2512
01:56:14,169 --> 01:56:15,462
Donnez-moi une part.

2513
01:56:15,587 --> 01:56:18,190
<i>Après la pause :
Evvie, Ricard et Danny</i>

2514
01:56:18,315 --> 01:56:22,076
<i>raconteront en quoi l'expérience
Survivor a changé leurs vies.</i>

2515
01:56:28,585 --> 01:56:30,875
Très bien, on est
dans la jungle des Fidji,

2516
01:56:31,000 --> 01:56:34,054
on vient de terminer Survivor 41,

2517
01:56:34,179 --> 01:56:36,179
où Erika a gagné
un million de dollars.

2518
01:56:36,304 --> 01:56:38,538
Elle ne l'a pas encore,
mais ça vient.

2519
01:56:38,663 --> 01:56:41,163
Je veux juste revenir
sur quelques trucs.

2520
01:56:41,288 --> 01:56:43,407
Naseer, comment expliquer aux gens

2521
01:56:43,532 --> 01:56:46,067
ce qu'est la vie
avec un groupe de personnes,

2522
01:56:46,192 --> 01:56:48,555
dans la vraie jungle, aux Fidji ?

2523
01:56:48,680 --> 01:56:51,482
Jeff, être dans Survivor a été mon...

2524
01:56:52,317 --> 01:56:53,862
Mon rêve pendant dix ans.

2525
01:56:53,987 --> 01:56:54,883
Donc,

2526
01:56:55,133 --> 01:56:57,355
je l'ai vraiment apprécié et...

2527
01:56:57,480 --> 01:57:00,725
J'ai apprécié chaque moment
de cette expérience.

2528
01:57:00,850 --> 01:57:02,152
C'est, je dirais...

2529
01:57:02,897 --> 01:57:05,573
C'est une fois... Comment on dit ?

2530
01:57:05,698 --> 01:57:08,752
- Unique dans une vie ?
- Une expérience unique dans une vie.

2531
01:57:08,877 --> 01:57:11,631
Aucun autre Survivant, ou Naufragé,

2532
01:57:11,756 --> 01:57:14,287
n'a utilisé l'île comme je l'ai fait.

2533
01:57:14,912 --> 01:57:17,075
Vous recevez beaucoup d'approbation.

2534
01:57:19,021 --> 01:57:21,643
- Mon Dieu.
- Amenez du petit bois.

2535
01:57:21,768 --> 01:57:24,036
<i><font color="#fab419">Peu de matériel
et un jeu plus rapide,</font></i>

2536
01:57:24,161 --> 01:57:25,880
<font color="#fab419">je me dis : "C'est ce que je veux."</font>

2537
01:57:26,005 --> 01:57:27,749
<font color="#fab419">Je veux cueillir ces papayes.</font>

2538
01:57:27,874 --> 01:57:30,109
<font color="#fab419">Et on avait les légumes du jardin.</font>

2539
01:57:30,477 --> 01:57:32,287
<font color="#fab419">On avait ce dont on avait besoin.</font>

2540
01:57:32,412 --> 01:57:33,412
<font color="#fab419">Et voilà.</font>

2541
01:57:34,594 --> 01:57:36,689
J'étais si fier de moi car...

2542
01:57:37,264 --> 01:57:38,791
Chez moi,

2543
01:57:38,916 --> 01:57:41,932
pendant presque 18 ans,
je vivais au Sri Lanka.

2544
01:57:42,057 --> 01:57:45,225
Je me suis senti
de retour à cette époque.

2545
01:57:45,588 --> 01:57:47,690
Vous voyez, quand j'avais sept ans,

2546
01:57:47,815 --> 01:57:49,891
avec mon lance-pierre, sans chemise,

2547
01:57:50,016 --> 01:57:52,095
portant un sarong, me promenant,

2548
01:57:52,220 --> 01:57:55,348
chassant des oiseaux,
grimpant aux cocotiers.

2549
01:57:55,473 --> 01:57:59,191
Et j'ai ressenti ça à chaque instant
que j'étais...

2550
01:57:59,316 --> 01:58:01,311
- Vraiment ?
- Bien sûr, totalement.

2551
01:58:01,436 --> 01:58:03,064
Car j'ai réalisé mon rêve.

2552
01:58:03,189 --> 01:58:05,634
Même si je n'ai pas gagné,
je suis ravi pour Erika,

2553
01:58:05,759 --> 01:58:07,219
fier de son jeu.

2554
01:58:07,344 --> 01:58:10,249
Je suis ici pour inspirer les enfants

2555
01:58:10,634 --> 01:58:12,411
qui grandissent dans la "pauverté".

2556
01:58:12,536 --> 01:58:14,252
- L'ai-je bien dit ?
- "Pauvreté".

2557
01:58:14,377 --> 01:58:15,788
- "Pauvreté" ?
- "Pauvreté".

2558
01:58:15,913 --> 01:58:19,820
Et aussi, les enfants qui grandissent
dans de petits villages,

2559
01:58:19,945 --> 01:58:20,765
qui...

2560
01:58:20,890 --> 01:58:22,342
Ils n'ont pas assez...

2561
01:58:22,660 --> 01:58:24,397
De soutien ou d'opportunités.

2562
01:58:24,522 --> 01:58:26,258
Je veux faire passer ce message :

2563
01:58:26,383 --> 01:58:28,410
"N'abandonnez jamais vos rêves."

2564
01:58:28,691 --> 01:58:31,412
"Quoi qu'il arrive,
où que vous viviez,"

2565
01:58:32,009 --> 01:58:34,097
"quel que soit
votre type de culture."

2566
01:58:34,222 --> 01:58:37,668
"Vous pouvez porter un sarong
et quand même réaliser vos rêves."

2567
01:58:37,793 --> 01:58:39,254
Magnifique, j'adore ça.

2568
01:58:39,379 --> 01:58:42,212
Et je l'ai fait, et j'en suis fier.

2569
01:58:42,678 --> 01:58:44,759
- Félicitations.
- Merci.

2570
01:58:44,884 --> 01:58:47,477
Evvie, comment décrivez-vous
cette expérience ?

2571
01:58:48,331 --> 01:58:51,253
Tout le monde m'avait dit :
"Ça va changer ta vie."

2572
01:58:51,378 --> 01:58:54,076
Et je suis arrivée en pensant :
"Vous savez quoi ?"

2573
01:58:54,201 --> 01:58:57,089
"Bien sûr, on peut toujours
grandir durant sa vie."

2574
01:58:57,214 --> 01:58:59,623
Mais je suis entrée
dans ce jeu en me pensant

2575
01:59:00,125 --> 01:59:02,665
assez totalement développée,

2576
01:59:02,790 --> 01:59:05,358
et assez confiante
en qui je suis, et...

2577
01:59:05,483 --> 01:59:08,476
Je montre généralement
pas mal de confiance en qui je suis,

2578
01:59:08,601 --> 01:59:10,909
car j'ai grandi dans ma vie.

2579
01:59:11,034 --> 01:59:13,117
Mais, en vérité, je n'espérais pas

2580
01:59:13,242 --> 01:59:15,451
faire quoi que ce soit
dans une épreuve,

2581
01:59:15,576 --> 01:59:18,226
et le fait que j'aie pu,
en deux jours,

2582
01:59:18,351 --> 01:59:21,253
gagner une épreuve de récompense
et une d'immunité,

2583
01:59:21,379 --> 01:59:24,336
ça a changé ma vie.
Je me suis vraiment sentie géniale.

2584
01:59:24,461 --> 01:59:26,484
C'est une expérience
qui change la vie,

2585
01:59:26,609 --> 01:59:29,944
même pour les têtues comme moi
qui pensent ne plus pouvoir grandir,

2586
01:59:30,069 --> 01:59:32,460
vous le pouvez,
et cet endroit fait arriver ça.

2587
01:59:33,008 --> 01:59:35,387
Ricard, le moment
le plus brut pour vous ?

2588
01:59:35,512 --> 01:59:39,110
Car même là, je vois que vous
réfléchissez encore à l'élimination.

2589
01:59:39,235 --> 01:59:40,714
Oui, je veux dire,

2590
01:59:41,077 --> 01:59:42,742
j'ai eu... J'ai du mal.

2591
01:59:43,164 --> 01:59:46,046
J'avais en tête l'image
de ce que serait mon voyage.

2592
01:59:46,171 --> 01:59:48,205
Je pensais que
je gagnerais aujourd'hui.

2593
01:59:48,330 --> 01:59:50,702
Vraiment,
je le sentais dans mon cur.

2594
01:59:51,121 --> 01:59:55,101
Mais, même si la conclusion
a été décevante pour moi,

2595
01:59:55,314 --> 01:59:57,506
et je suis en train de le digérer...

2596
01:59:58,149 --> 01:59:59,067
C'était

2597
01:59:59,356 --> 02:00:00,922
plus grand et plus

2598
02:00:01,639 --> 02:00:03,678
beau et intense,

2599
02:00:03,803 --> 02:00:06,935
et je suis plus fier de moi
que je le pensais possible,

2600
02:00:07,060 --> 02:00:09,279
même si je n'ai pas
atteint mon objectif.

2601
02:00:09,404 --> 02:00:11,110
J'ai été génial.

2602
02:00:11,517 --> 02:00:13,376
Shan et moi avons été géniaux.

2603
02:00:13,501 --> 02:00:16,180
On était un duo puissant,
tout le long.

2604
02:00:16,305 --> 02:00:18,509
C'est incroyable pour moi,

2605
02:00:18,634 --> 02:00:20,367
ce dont je suis capable.

2606
02:00:20,747 --> 02:00:21,973
C'est ce que j'aurais

2607
02:00:22,098 --> 02:00:23,566
- aimé dire aussi.
- Danny.

2608
02:00:23,691 --> 02:00:26,698
Parce que je pense
que j'ai quelque chose

2609
02:00:26,823 --> 02:00:29,103
de différent par rapport aux autres.

2610
02:00:29,347 --> 02:00:31,216
Je suis venu ici en pensant

2611
02:00:31,349 --> 02:00:34,519
faire de la compétition,
chercher à concourir pour gagner.

2612
02:00:35,005 --> 02:00:37,456
Je suis arrivé ici et...

2613
02:00:37,581 --> 02:00:40,637
J'ai découvert que je vivais
depuis 25 ans avec mes démons,

2614
02:00:40,762 --> 02:00:42,374
que je croyais utiliser

2615
02:00:42,676 --> 02:00:45,555
pour me faire avancer
en compétition et dans la vie.

2616
02:00:45,808 --> 02:00:47,650
Et puis, tout d'un coup,

2617
02:00:47,775 --> 02:00:50,041
j'ai compris que je devais
m'en libérer.

2618
02:00:50,166 --> 02:00:52,018
Avez-vous partagé ces démons ?

2619
02:00:52,143 --> 02:00:54,596
Peut-être ne voulez-vous pas.
Est-ce personnel ?

2620
02:00:54,899 --> 02:00:56,790
J'ai perdu mon père à huit ans.

2621
02:00:56,915 --> 02:01:00,743
J'ai vécu avec cette histoire
d'accident de voiture.

2622
02:01:00,868 --> 02:01:01,907
Et à huit ans,

2623
02:01:02,032 --> 02:01:04,895
je ne comprenais pas qu'il n'ait
pas pu rester en vie. Alors...

2624
02:01:05,613 --> 02:01:08,374
Toute ma vie, j'ai été bouleversé,

2625
02:01:08,968 --> 02:01:11,834
j'étais en colère contre
ceux qui avaient leur père.

2626
02:01:11,959 --> 02:01:15,143
Puis j'ai eu honte
d'avoir pensé ça si longtemps.

2627
02:01:15,651 --> 02:01:18,721
Le 4 mai était le 25e anniversaire
de son décès.

2628
02:01:18,846 --> 02:01:20,296
On était tous là.

2629
02:01:20,421 --> 02:01:21,530
Et...

2630
02:01:21,915 --> 02:01:23,151
C'était dur.

2631
02:01:23,938 --> 02:01:26,688
Mais... ils m'ont fait rire,

2632
02:01:27,008 --> 02:01:29,359
j'ai pu me poser et réaliser

2633
02:01:29,484 --> 02:01:32,916
que ça m'avait bloqué,
et non fait avancer.

2634
02:01:33,041 --> 02:01:37,165
Et... J'ai évacué ça et étonnamment,
j'en ai parlé à Deshawn.

2635
02:01:38,540 --> 02:01:41,974
Et j'ai ajouté à ma liste
de "je veux te rendre fier"

2636
02:01:42,099 --> 02:01:44,318
le fait de brandir ce truc.

2637
02:01:44,443 --> 02:01:47,370
Et il m'a donné juste assez de temps
pour gagner cette épreuve.

2638
02:01:50,705 --> 02:01:53,181
Ricard lâche,
Xander lâche en même temps,

2639
02:01:53,306 --> 02:01:56,985
Danny gagne
sa première immunité individuelle,

2640
02:01:57,110 --> 02:01:59,187
en sécurité ce soir au conseil.

2641
02:01:59,312 --> 02:02:02,372
C'est pourquoi je suis tombé à genoux
et ai versé des larmes,

2642
02:02:02,497 --> 02:02:04,532
car j'ai ressenti une chose nouvelle.

2643
02:02:04,832 --> 02:02:07,472
Je suis très reconnaissant
pour l'expérience.

2644
02:02:07,597 --> 02:02:10,143
J'ai reçu tout ce dont
j'avais besoin ici.

2645
02:02:10,268 --> 02:02:13,912
Beaucoup d'entre vous m'ont aidé
à traverser ça, et...

2646
02:02:14,428 --> 02:02:16,218
Je suis heureux et reconnaissant.

2647
02:02:16,343 --> 02:02:19,098
Les choses changeront pour moi
quand je rentrerai.

2648
02:02:19,457 --> 02:02:21,438
Wow. Merci d'avoir partagé ça.

2649
02:02:22,154 --> 02:02:24,133
Une petite pause. À tout de suite.

2650
02:02:24,258 --> 02:02:28,109
<i>À suivre, votre premier aperçu
de Survivor 42.</i>

2651
02:02:33,021 --> 02:02:35,435
Si vous nous rejoignez,

2652
02:02:35,935 --> 02:02:37,224
c'est Survivor,

2653
02:02:37,349 --> 02:02:39,700
Survivor 41, on fait notre Réunion

2654
02:02:39,825 --> 02:02:41,528
dans la jungle des Fidji.

2655
02:02:41,653 --> 02:02:44,034
Je répondrai à la question,
que vous vous posez :

2656
02:02:44,159 --> 02:02:46,060
d'où viennent les pizzas ?
On les fait.

2657
02:02:46,185 --> 02:02:48,802
Stu les a faites. Très bonnes, non ?

2658
02:02:49,057 --> 02:02:50,737
A-t-on oublié quelque chose ?

2659
02:02:50,862 --> 02:02:53,846
Car c'est un peu
une conversation improvisée.

2660
02:02:53,971 --> 02:02:56,400
L'idée était de partager,

2661
02:02:56,525 --> 02:02:58,866
de boire un peu de champagne...
Oui, Evvie ?

2662
02:02:59,313 --> 02:03:02,578
Je voulais dire que pendant le jeu,
on a beaucoup parlé d'âge,

2663
02:03:02,703 --> 02:03:04,984
et je pense avoir été coupable

2664
02:03:05,109 --> 02:03:06,780
d'avoir dit parfois :

2665
02:03:06,905 --> 02:03:10,055
"Ces gosses dans ma tribu !"
En parlant des deux vingtenaires.

2666
02:03:10,180 --> 02:03:13,508
Mais, quand on regarde, on avait
deux des plus jeunes à avoir joué,

2667
02:03:13,633 --> 02:03:17,125
et aussi 2 femmes plus âgées, souvent
ciblées car vues comme faibles.

2668
02:03:17,250 --> 02:03:20,032
Et je pense que 4a prouve

2669
02:03:20,157 --> 02:03:21,837
que tout le monde peut jouer.

2670
02:03:21,962 --> 02:03:23,938
Les deux plus jeunes étaient parfois

2671
02:03:24,063 --> 02:03:26,063
les plus matures, les plus brillants,

2672
02:03:26,188 --> 02:03:28,367
et disaient des choses
matures et brillantes,

2673
02:03:28,492 --> 02:03:31,989
et les deux femmes plus âgées
étaient parfois les plus solides ici.

2674
02:03:32,114 --> 02:03:34,957
Je me disais que si j'avais 20 ans,

2675
02:03:35,082 --> 02:03:36,856
je n'aurais jamais été comme vous,

2676
02:03:36,981 --> 02:03:39,668
et si j'étais, euh,
plus avancée en âge,

2677
02:03:39,793 --> 02:03:42,037
- je ne serais jamais comme vous.
- Plus avancée !

2678
02:03:42,162 --> 02:03:43,936
Je suis très fière de tout le monde.

2679
02:03:44,061 --> 02:03:46,839
Dans mes interviews,
je n'ai rien dit sur vos âges !

2680
02:03:46,964 --> 02:03:48,628
Vous êtes tous incroyables.

2681
02:03:48,753 --> 02:03:50,511
Une "plus avancée" veut parler.

2682
02:03:50,636 --> 02:03:53,659
Mon âge très avancé : 52, 52 ans.

2683
02:03:53,784 --> 02:03:54,627
Désolée.

2684
02:03:54,752 --> 02:03:56,983
- 28 ans à l'intérieur, ...
- Absolument.

2685
02:03:57,108 --> 02:03:59,755
- ... 52 ans à l'extérieur. Merci.
- Absolument.

2686
02:04:00,080 --> 02:04:03,358
Je dois dire, ayant été là,
chaque jour de chaque saison,

2687
02:04:03,483 --> 02:04:05,946
si nous sommes toujours là,
après 21 ans,

2688
02:04:06,071 --> 02:04:07,316
c'est pour ça,

2689
02:04:07,441 --> 02:04:10,235
Et ce que nous faisons
à la fin d'une saison,

2690
02:04:10,360 --> 02:04:12,783
que nous ne diffusons pas, c'est ça.

2691
02:04:12,908 --> 02:04:14,423
Personne ne s'assoit et parle,

2692
02:04:14,548 --> 02:04:16,485
mais nous apportons
champagne et pizza.

2693
02:04:16,610 --> 02:04:19,535
L'équipe vient, car elle ne parle
jamais à personne,

2694
02:04:19,660 --> 02:04:21,960
car nous ne voulons pas
que vous tissiez des liens,

2695
02:04:22,085 --> 02:04:24,496
ça doit rester entre vous.
Je regarde ce groupe

2696
02:04:24,621 --> 02:04:27,232
et j'ai l'impression que
vous avez réinventé le jeu.

2697
02:04:27,357 --> 02:04:29,973
Ce n'est moi qui ai lancé :
"Oubliez le 4, gardez le 1."

2698
02:04:30,098 --> 02:04:33,127
C'était un autre. Je m'en suis
emparé, vous l'avez pris, adopté,

2699
02:04:33,252 --> 02:04:34,863
vous avez ouvert une nouvelle ère.

2700
02:04:34,988 --> 02:04:37,913
Je vous dis, personnellement, merci.

2701
02:04:38,577 --> 02:04:42,042
Car pour revenir à Liana,
à Danny, à Deshawn, à Ricard,

2702
02:04:42,167 --> 02:04:43,526
vous avez tous partagé

2703
02:04:43,651 --> 02:04:45,639
des choses personnelles,

2704
02:04:45,959 --> 02:04:48,412
et quand on regarde à la maison,

2705
02:04:48,537 --> 02:04:50,483
et je regarde, comme tout le monde,

2706
02:04:50,608 --> 02:04:52,497
je suis ému par vos histoires.

2707
02:04:52,622 --> 02:04:53,996
Elles m'inspirent,

2708
02:04:54,121 --> 02:04:55,466
elles me divertissent,

2709
02:04:55,591 --> 02:04:57,646
parfois même j'apprends
avec vos histoires.

2710
02:04:57,771 --> 02:04:59,419
Alors, merci pour le partage.

2711
02:04:59,708 --> 02:05:02,767
Nous allons maintenant
vous renvoyer chez vous.

2712
02:05:03,106 --> 02:05:04,754
Nous allons rester ici,

2713
02:05:05,113 --> 02:05:07,566
et faire venir
un autre groupe de joueurs,

2714
02:05:07,691 --> 02:05:09,667
et filmer Survivor 42.

2715
02:05:09,792 --> 02:05:11,695
Je vous donne un petit indice,

2716
02:05:12,000 --> 02:05:14,527
nous allons garder certaines choses
de votre saison,

2717
02:05:14,652 --> 02:05:17,731
en les ajustant un peu,
en prolongeant l'expérience,

2718
02:05:17,856 --> 02:05:19,695
et voir comment ils réagissent.

2719
02:05:19,820 --> 02:05:23,984
Voici votre premier avant-goût
de Survivor 42.

2720
02:05:29,225 --> 02:05:31,209
<i>Pour notre 42e saison,</i>

2721
02:05:31,615 --> 02:05:35,056
<i>la plus grande expérience sociale
de la télévision</i>

2722
02:05:35,181 --> 02:05:36,217
<i>continue.</i>

2723
02:05:38,413 --> 02:05:40,216
<i>18 nouveaux joueurs</i>

2724
02:05:40,341 --> 02:05:42,528
<i>s'attaquent à la version
la plus dangereuse</i>

2725
02:05:42,653 --> 02:05:44,582
<i>de Survivor jamais vue.</i>

2726
02:05:48,788 --> 02:05:51,920
<i>Être pompier prépare
à toujours s'attendre à l'inattendu.</i>

2727
02:05:52,045 --> 02:05:53,483
Relever ce défi m'excite.

2728
02:05:53,608 --> 02:05:55,761
<i>Je suis une femme
d'affaires intelligente.</i>

2729
02:05:55,886 --> 02:05:59,223
J'ai écrasé des hommes d'affaires
très intelligents.

2730
02:06:01,155 --> 02:06:04,667
<i>J'ai le record du monde de tractions
avec 50 kilos sur le dos.</i>

2731
02:06:04,792 --> 02:06:07,157
<i>Mais il y a un million
de records mondiaux,</i>

2732
02:06:07,282 --> 02:06:08,853
mais un seul Survivant.

2733
02:06:10,923 --> 02:06:13,766
<i>Comment gèreront-ils
les Avantages à risques ?</i>

2734
02:06:13,891 --> 02:06:15,524
Vous direz une phrase secrète.

2735
02:06:15,649 --> 02:06:18,732
<i>"Les patates ont de la peau, j'ai de
la peau, donc, je suis une patate."</i>

2736
02:06:18,857 --> 02:06:20,437
<i>Des rebondissements fous.</i>

2737
02:06:21,311 --> 02:06:22,647
Il y a toujours un truc.

2738
02:06:22,772 --> 02:06:23,887
<i>Pas de nourriture.</i>

2739
02:06:24,012 --> 02:06:25,240
Je suis affamé.

2740
02:06:25,365 --> 02:06:27,314
<i>Et un rythme effréné</i>

2741
02:06:27,439 --> 02:06:30,114
<i>qui les poussera à leurs limites.</i>

2742
02:06:30,239 --> 02:06:31,738
<i>On doit tout mériter.</i>

2743
02:06:31,863 --> 02:06:33,495
<i>Ce jeu est tellement dur.</i>

2744
02:06:33,620 --> 02:06:36,002

## S42E13

1
00:00:00,000 --> 00:00:04,162
WWW.MY-SUBS.CO

Welcome to
the finale of <i>Survivor 42.</i>

I love finale nights,

3

and I think tonight
is gonna be very exciting

and very unpredictable

5

because there are still
so many ways it could play out

two weapons left in the game--

12

15

19

Take a look at this final five.

You have Mike, Jonathan,

00:01:15,965 --> 00:01:17,413

31

32

33
00:01:20,793 --> 00:01:24,172
This is
the finale of <i>Survivor 42.</i>

34

<i>
Savagery is what's</i> <i>
gonna happen right now.</i>

35
00:01:36,586 --> 00:01:37,793
<i>Don't get in my way.</i>

36
00:01:37,827 --> 00:01:40,172
<i>I'm balls to the wall,</i> <i>
going all out.</i>

37
00:01:41,172 --> 00:01:42,896
I've never given up on anything.</i>

38
00:01:42,931 --> 00:01:44,896
<i>On anything I've done,</i> <i>
I've gone extra.</i>

39
00:01:44,931 --> 00:01:46,344
<i>And that's what I'm doing</i> <i>
right now.</i>

40
00:01:46,379 --> 00:01:48,034
<i>I'm fighting</i> <i>
to the bitter end.</i>

41
00:01:48,068 --> 00:01:51,034
<i>
I want to show that I'm here</i> <i>
to play my game</i>

42
00:01:51,068 --> 00:01:52,379
<i>and I'm here to win.</i>

43
00:01:52,413 --> 00:01:55,344
<i>I can close the deal and</i> <i>
be the winner of</i> Survivor 42.

44
00:01:56,379 --> 00:02:00,172
In the end, I will be wearing
theSurvivor</i> <i>tiara on my head,</i>

45
00:02:00,206 --> 00:02:04,344
<i>and I will be</i> <i>
the ultimate Mr.</i> Survivor.

46
00:02:04,379 --> 00:02:06,206
<i>
There's nothing</i> <i>
that's gonna stop me.</i>

47
00:02:06,241 --> 00:02:08,517
<i>At the end of the day,</i> <i>
everyone will know</i>

48
00:02:08,551 --> 00:02:11,000
<i>that Jonathan gave</i> <i>
everything that he had.</i>

49
00:02:16,068 --> 00:02:17,724
<i>There's gonna be</i> <i>
a battle royale.</i>

50
00:02:17,758 --> 00:02:19,586
<i>
This is a big game.</i> <i>
I have to be a big player.</i>

51
00:02:19,620 --> 00:02:20,862
<i>
My goal is to win</i> Survivor.

52
00:02:20,896 --> 00:02:22,172
<i>
The million dollars is mine.</i>

53
00:02:22,206 --> 00:02:23,241
<i>
I don't want to be</i>

54
00:02:23,275 --> 00:02:25,172
<i>second or third,</i> <i>
and I'm gonna take it all.</i>

55
00:02:50,103 --> 00:02:51,896
<i>
After Omar was voted out,</i>

56
00:02:51,931 --> 00:02:55,034
<i>everybody was</i> <i>
just smiling and laughing.</i>

57

Everyone's just happy
we've made it to the final five.

58
00:02:58,551 --> 00:03:00,655
<i>And then we come to find out</i>

59
00:03:00,689 --> 00:03:04,172

at a brand-new beach.</i>

60
00:03:11,793 --> 00:03:14,758
Holy crap. I don't know

61

This is our home.

62

66

67

68
00:03:28,862 --> 00:03:29,896
Yeah.

69
00:03:29,931 --> 00:03:31,413
Good news is,
we have only three days.

70
00:03:31,448 --> 00:03:34,896
<i>
This new beach has nothing.</i>

71
00:03:34,931 --> 00:03:36,206
<i>We don't have a tarp,</i>

72
00:03:36,241 --> 00:03:38,862
<i>we don't have a shelter,</i> <i>
but you know what?</i>

73
00:03:38,896 --> 00:03:40,724
<i>I was on cloud nine</i>

74
00:03:40,758 --> 00:03:42,482
<i>because, by voting out Omar,</i>

75
00:03:42,517 --> 00:03:45,448
now everybody on the jury knows

76

Maryanne is here to play.

77
00:03:47,862 --> 00:03:51,172
<i>I might actually have a chance</i> <i>
to make it to the end</i>

78
00:03:51,206 --> 00:03:52,172
<i>and win this thing.</i>

79
00:03:52,206 --> 00:03:54,827
And I haven't felt like that
this whole game.

80

<i>It's all coming together.</i>

81

Listen,

82

I have no hard feelings,

what did Omar tell you

84

85

86

Well, you voted for me.

87
00:04:09,310 --> 00:04:11,034
I know, but I want
to hear what made you

00:04:11,068 --> 00:04:12,448
pick Omar first.
So that's why...

00:04:14,655 --> 00:04:17,655
Yeah, we-we, uh, we planned Omar
for a little bit.

90
00:04:17,689 --> 00:04:19,862
Okay, and I'm your--
I'm in your alliance,

91

and I was unaware of that.

93

But you already backed up
on your alliance,

94
00:04:25,137 --> 00:04:27,000
because I'm supposed to be
aligned with you. And you...

95
00:04:27,034 --> 00:04:28,586

96
00:04:29,862 --> 00:04:32,137

- You voted for me.

97
00:04:32,172 --> 00:04:33,965
<i>
I'm so pissed.</i>

98
00:04:34,000 --> 00:04:36,172
Now I have to deal with
the stupid wrath of Jonathan

99
00:04:36,206 --> 00:04:38,620

100
00:04:38,655 --> 00:04:40,793

who are in the wrong."</i>

101
00:04:40,827 --> 00:04:42,793
Like, dude, screw you.

00:04:42,827 --> 00:04:44,620

was the plan the whole time,

103
00:04:44,655 --> 00:04:46,482

you didn't tell me that.

104
00:04:46,517 --> 00:04:48,413
<i>That means you lied to me, too.</i>

105
00:04:48,448 --> 00:04:50,689
I think I've been
getting played this whole time.

106
00:04:50,724 --> 00:04:53,551
No. You voted for me, Lindsay.
You're forgetting.

107
00:04:53,586 --> 00:04:56,206
<i>
I can't stand</i> <i>
how he talks to me.</i>

108
00:04:56,241 --> 00:04:58,758
I'm frustrated
that I have to kiss his ass

109
00:04:58,793 --> 00:05:00,724
<i>and grovel,</i>

110
00:05:00,758 --> 00:05:02,827
<i>just for the sake of getting</i> <i>
through the next few days.</i>

111
00:05:02,862 --> 00:05:05,551
And just this cockiness
that he now has

112
00:05:05,586 --> 00:05:07,965
just drives me
up a frickin' wall.

113
00:05:08,000 --> 00:05:11,034
I voted for you because
Omar pinned me against you.

114
00:05:11,068 --> 00:05:13,034
But if I,
but if I knew the truth,

115
00:05:13,068 --> 00:05:14,206
I wouldn't have...

116
00:05:14,241 --> 00:05:16,206
<i>[groans]</i> <i>
He's impossible</i>

117
00:05:16,241 --> 00:05:17,206
to talk to.

118
00:05:17,241 --> 00:05:18,551
He's just so frickin' righteous,

119
00:05:18,586 --> 00:05:20,172
and it drives me insane.

120
00:05:21,241 --> 00:05:23,275
Well, since we're all
being honest here,

121
00:05:23,310 --> 00:05:25,206
I have an idol, and I'm using it
in the next Tribal,

122
00:05:25,241 --> 00:05:26,793
so at least I get to final four.

123
00:05:26,827 --> 00:05:28,275
If you guys want to vote me out
after, that's fine.

124
00:05:28,310 --> 00:05:29,655
Good for you, man.
Good for you.

125
00:05:29,689 --> 00:05:31,068
You're playing your game.

126
00:05:31,103 --> 00:05:33,724
<i>
I'm here</i> <i>
by the skin of my teeth.</i>

127
00:05:33,758 --> 00:05:37,068
<i>They should just name me</i> <i>
- "The In-
- Case Survivor,"</i>

128
00:05:37,103 --> 00:05:39,758
<i>because every time there's</i> <i>
a plan to vote somebody off,</i>

129
00:05:39,793 --> 00:05:42,137
somebody's always gonna
throw votes on Romeo.

130
00:05:42,172 --> 00:05:44,896
Just in case that person plays
an idol, Romeo goes home.

131
00:05:44,931 --> 00:05:48,689
<i>So I thought the only way</i> <i>
that I can survive</i>

132
00:05:48,724 --> 00:05:51,620
<i>the next Tribal Council</i> <i>
is to come up with this lie,</i>

133
00:05:51,655 --> 00:05:55,310

a hidden immunity idol.

134

Yeah.

135
00:05:58,827 --> 00:06:02,379
<i>They seem to buy it,</i> <i>
but just to be sure,</i>

136
00:06:02,413 --> 00:06:04,034
<i>I made a fake idol.</i>

137
00:06:04,068 --> 00:06:06,482
And, uh, I came up

138
00:06:07,724 --> 00:06:08,758
See?

139
00:06:08,793 --> 00:06:10,413
<i>I think I did pretty good.</i>

140
00:06:10,448 --> 00:06:13,344
<i>I suck at arts and crafts,</i> <i>
so my second grade teacher</i>

141
00:06:13,379 --> 00:06:14,965
would be very proud of me.

142
00:06:15,000 --> 00:06:19,172
<i>And, uh, hopefully it'll get me
through another Tribal Council.</i>

143
00:06:36,275 --> 00:06:37,310
Yeah.

144
00:06:38,551 --> 00:06:39,586
Mm-hmm.

145
00:06:46,689 --> 00:06:48,482
I want you.
I literally want you to win.

146
00:06:50,275 --> 00:06:52,551
<i>And, like,</i> <i>
Mike gave me his word.</i>

147
00:06:52,586 --> 00:06:55,827
He said, "If I'm here at five,
I'll give you the idol."

148
00:06:55,862 --> 00:06:58,862
It will be
a two-three-two vote on Omar.

149
00:06:58,896 --> 00:07:00,448
Then he's out.
- Yeah.

150
00:07:00,482 --> 00:07:01,931
- Here's my promise to you, my giveback.
- Yeah. Mm-hmm.

151
00:07:01,965 --> 00:07:03,931
I'm the only one with an idol left.
- Yeah.

152
00:07:03,965 --> 00:07:06,517
- I will either give it to you if you want it...
- Yeah.

153
00:07:06,551 --> 00:07:07,586
...or play it for you.

154
00:07:07,620 --> 00:07:09,103
- I got your back.
- Yeah.

155
00:07:09,137 --> 00:07:11,206
- I give you my word, you'll be in the final four.
- Okay.

156
00:07:15,103 --> 00:07:17,206
<i>
I'm in the worst position</i> <i>
I could possibly be in.</i>

157
00:07:17,241 --> 00:07:19,379
<i>Romeo claims he has an idol.</i>

158
00:07:19,413 --> 00:07:22,724
<i>Mike has an idol, and he's</i> <i>
never gonna turn on Jonathan.</i>

159
00:07:22,758 --> 00:07:25,413
<i>And they're obviously gonna take</i> <i>
Maryanne to the end over me.</i>

160
00:07:25,448 --> 00:07:27,448
<i>So if I don't win immunity</i> <i>
today,</i>

161
00:07:27,482 --> 00:07:28,689
I'm definitely going home.

162
00:07:36,965 --> 00:07:38,103

163
00:07:40,379 --> 00:07:41,965
Yeah, but you're not
gonna play that for me.

164
00:07:42,000 --> 00:07:44,482
I know that every...
everyone wants me out.

165
00:07:44,517 --> 00:07:47,000
<i>Mike is saying that he might</i> <i>
play his idol for me,</i>

166
00:07:47,034 --> 00:07:49,413
but he told Maryanne he would
give her the idol at five.

167
00:07:49,448 --> 00:07:51,655
<i>So I'm like, "Don't lie to me."</i>

168
00:07:53,827 --> 00:07:55,275
I appreciate that.

169
00:07:55,310 --> 00:07:56,344
Please don't.

170
00:07:56,379 --> 00:07:58,172
I'm not. Look at me.
I'm not.

171
00:07:58,206 --> 00:07:59,586
Listen, it's okay. Come here.

172
00:08:01,310 --> 00:08:02,586
My vote's Romeo.

173
00:08:15,206 --> 00:08:16,241
- Okay?
- Mm-hmm.

174
00:08:17,206 --> 00:08:18,689
I'm not.

175
00:08:18,724 --> 00:08:22,000
<i>I'm trying to stay positive,
but if something doesn't happen,</i>

176
00:08:22,034 --> 00:08:23,689
<i>I feel like I'm screwed.</i>

177
00:08:28,689 --> 00:08:29,793
Yes.

178
00:08:29,827 --> 00:08:32,206
Whoa! Tree mail. Yeah.

179
00:08:33,896 --> 00:08:35,275
"Another shot at immunity.

180
00:08:35,310 --> 00:08:38,172
"Final four
is just one vote away.

181
00:08:38,206 --> 00:08:40,724
"If you want
to increase your chances,

182
00:08:40,758 --> 00:08:43,241
the riddle shows you the way."

183
00:08:44,241 --> 00:08:46,241
One for you, Lindsay.

184
00:08:46,275 --> 00:08:47,827
One for you, Mike.

185
00:08:47,862 --> 00:08:51,172
<i>We get tree mail today, knowing
that it's a final five immunity,</i>

186
00:08:51,206 --> 00:08:54,206
<i>but we also get a little</i> <i>
envelope that's saying</i>

187
00:08:54,241 --> 00:08:56,655
"Final Advantage Clue."
And we're all like...

188
00:08:59,241 --> 00:09:01,000
"First you must
unscramble the words,

189
00:09:01,034 --> 00:09:02,551
"then decipher the phrase.

190
00:09:02,586 --> 00:09:04,517
"You cannot search
for the advantage until

191
00:09:04,551 --> 00:09:08,793
you have correctly solved and
written down the entire phrase."

192
00:09:08,827 --> 00:09:10,965
<i>
Tree mail was a word scramble</i>

193
00:09:11,000 --> 00:09:13,241
<i>to figure out a riddle,</i>

194
00:09:13,275 --> 00:09:15,965
<i>which would tell us</i> <i>
where to find an advantage.</i>

195
00:09:26,896 --> 00:09:28,344
<i>
I suck at riddles,</i>

196
00:09:28,379 --> 00:09:32,034
I suck at puzzles, so I knew
that I wasn't gonna get it.

197
00:09:32,068 --> 00:09:33,620
<i>But as long as Jonathan</i>

198
00:09:33,655 --> 00:09:35,896
<i>and Mike didn't get it,</i> <i>
I didn't really care.</i>

199
00:09:35,931 --> 00:09:37,827
I mean, get it, Lindsay.

200
00:09:37,862 --> 00:09:39,551
<i>Go for it.</i>

201
00:09:40,586 --> 00:09:42,137
Luckily,
I'm good at word scrambles,

202
00:09:42,172 --> 00:09:43,206
and I'm good at riddles.

203
00:09:54,758 --> 00:09:55,931
What you got?
- Okay.

204
00:10:00,862 --> 00:10:02,172
<i>
The riddle, it was</i>

205
00:10:02,206 --> 00:10:03,896
<i>"Good fortune is tucked</i>

206
00:10:03,931 --> 00:10:05,379
<i>in the toes</i> <i>
of the sleeping giant."</i>

697
00:32:22,310 --> 00:32:26,103
the only secret that has been
kept in this entire game,

698
00:32:26,137 --> 00:32:29,758
<i>but also Mike might give</i> <i>
his idol to me at Tribal.</i>

699
00:32:29,793 --> 00:32:32,758
<i>So this means that my idol--</i> <i>
I can use it to save Lindsay</i>

700
00:32:32,793 --> 00:32:35,413
<i>and blindside Jonathan.</i> <i>
The question is,</i>

701
00:32:35,448 --> 00:32:37,413
<i>what gives me</i> <i>
my best chance of winning?</i>

702
00:32:40,965 --> 00:32:44,068
Emotionally, yes.

703
00:32:48,068 --> 00:32:49,965
<i>
Lindsay's played</i> <i>
such a great game.</i>

704
00:32:50,000 --> 00:32:52,344
<i>She's won immunities</i> <i>
and taken major risks,</i>

705
00:32:52,379 --> 00:32:54,172
and the jury loves that.

706
00:32:54,206 --> 00:32:56,655
<i>But voting out someone
who knows they're going home--</i>

707
00:32:56,689 --> 00:32:58,379
<i>that's not a big move.</i>

708
00:33:02,517 --> 00:33:03,827
<i>
But if I play my idol</i>

709
00:33:03,862 --> 00:33:05,724
<i>on Lindsay</i> <i>
and blindside Jonathan,</i>

710
00:33:05,758 --> 00:33:07,344
the jury will know
that I am here to play

711
00:33:07,379 --> 00:33:08,931
and that I'm a contender.

712
00:33:08,965 --> 00:33:12,482
<i>But it all comes down</i> <i>
to what Mike does,</i>

713
00:33:12,517 --> 00:33:15,034
<i>and this could make</i> <i>
or break my game.</i>

714
00:33:52,344 --> 00:33:55,068
Let's start this morning.

715
00:33:55,103 --> 00:33:57,620
Lindsay, you wake up,
and you each have a riddle

716
00:33:57,655 --> 00:33:59,862
to solve.
Walk me through what happened.

717
00:33:59,896 --> 00:34:02,793
We each get this envelope
that says,

718
00:34:02,827 --> 00:34:04,931
you have
to fix the word scramble.

719
00:34:04,965 --> 00:34:06,724
Once you figure that out,

720
00:34:06,758 --> 00:34:08,413
you're off to the races
to solve the riddle

721
00:34:08,448 --> 00:34:09,758
and find a secret advantage.

722
00:34:09,793 --> 00:34:11,827
And I was the only one

723
00:34:11,862 --> 00:34:13,896
who solved the riddle.

724
00:34:13,931 --> 00:34:15,931
- I-I had to have been gone for at least 40 minutes.
- At least.

725
00:34:15,965 --> 00:34:18,206
Jonathan, it's got
to be frustrating

726
00:34:18,241 --> 00:34:19,655
because it's an advantage.

727
00:34:19,689 --> 00:34:21,413
It's offering you something
in the game

728
00:34:21,448 --> 00:34:22,793
if you can just solve it.

729
00:34:22,827 --> 00:34:24,206
Yeah, that's the thing.

730
00:34:24,241 --> 00:34:27,758
I haven't felt normal
in days, Mr. Jeff,

731
00:34:27,793 --> 00:34:29,655
because of how hard
this has been.

732
00:34:29,689 --> 00:34:31,344
It took four people.

733
00:34:31,379 --> 00:34:33,034
- Yeah.
- No, we didn't get it.
- And we still didn't get it.

734
00:34:33,068 --> 00:34:34,517
No, Lindsay had
to come back and tell us.

735
00:34:34,551 --> 00:34:36,620
Yeah. We said... we said,
"Lindsay, can you tell us

736
00:34:36,655 --> 00:34:38,344
what it was?" She's like,
"Well, yeah, I got it now."

737
00:34:38,379 --> 00:34:39,793
- It was "sleeping."
- It was "sleeping." It was "sleeping."

738
00:34:39,827 --> 00:34:41,103
It was "sleeping."
We look at the word.

739
00:34:41,137 --> 00:34:42,310
We said, "We can't believe
it was 'sleeping.'"

740
00:34:42,344 --> 00:34:44,344
So, Lindsay, you get

741
00:34:44,379 --> 00:34:45,896
the advantage, but did you feel,

742
00:34:45,931 --> 00:34:47,241
going into the challenge,

743
00:34:47,275 --> 00:34:50,000
that that advantage
would be helpful?

744
00:34:50,034 --> 00:34:52,793
Absolutely. I knew
if I didn't win, I'm going home.

745
00:34:52,827 --> 00:34:56,482
And I was one puzzle piece short

746
00:34:56,517 --> 00:34:58,793
from beating Mike.
Super happy for Mike.

747
00:34:58,827 --> 00:35:00,551
Really proud of him
that he got it.

748
00:35:00,586 --> 00:35:01,896
Just sucks
that in return of that,

749
00:35:01,931 --> 00:35:03,413
I'm most likely going home.

750
00:35:03,448 --> 00:35:06,103
So what's giving you
that feeling?

751
00:35:06,137 --> 00:35:08,241
Based on last Tribal.
Everyone else,

752
00:35:08,275 --> 00:35:10,862
apparently, already kind of knew
that Omar was working everybody.

753
00:35:10,896 --> 00:35:14,137
I didn't until afterwards.

754
00:35:14,172 --> 00:35:17,068
And then there was a lot
of damage control to do,

755
00:35:17,103 --> 00:35:19,793
and some that wasn't able
to be repaired, it seems.

756
00:35:19,827 --> 00:35:21,896
Jonathan, then,
what was the vibe at camp?

757
00:35:21,931 --> 00:35:23,965
I thought it would be fireworks

758
00:35:24,000 --> 00:35:26,620
with people running around
everywhere. Was it not?

759
00:35:26,655 --> 00:35:28,413
Is everybody locked in
that it's Lindsay?

760
00:35:28,448 --> 00:35:30,275
Uh, you can never know
for sure,

761
00:35:30,310 --> 00:35:32,344
of course, because then
comfort sets in,

762
00:35:32,379 --> 00:35:34,172
and we know that
that kills people in this game.

763
00:35:34,206 --> 00:35:39,551
But people do recognize Lindsay
as a big threat, which she is.

764
00:35:39,586 --> 00:35:43,310
Maryanne, what was your take
on what was going down at camp?

765
00:35:43,344 --> 00:35:45,206
In my perspective,
I had to decide

766
00:35:45,241 --> 00:35:47,448
on whether I wanted
to vote emotionally

767
00:35:47,482 --> 00:35:50,103
on who I feel
I want it to be in the end,

768
00:35:50,137 --> 00:35:53,241
and strategically on who
I feel is the best combination

769
00:35:53,275 --> 00:35:55,172
of people to have in the end.

770
00:35:55,206 --> 00:35:57,896
And everyone here knows that
I wear my heart on my sleeve,

771
00:35:57,931 --> 00:35:59,413
so that was something that
was difficult for me because

772
00:35:59,448 --> 00:36:01,310
I love every single person here,
and I...

773
00:36:01,344 --> 00:36:03,620
but I need to go and recognize
that, like,

774
00:36:03,655 --> 00:36:05,172
I want to play this game for me,

775
00:36:05,206 --> 00:36:06,620
and that means
that I might have

776
00:36:06,655 --> 00:36:08,517
to, like, go back on my word,
or, like, that means

777
00:36:08,551 --> 00:36:11,000
that I might have to go back
on an alliance, and that sucks.

778
00:36:11,034 --> 00:36:13,862
So, Lindsay, do you feel

779
00:36:13,896 --> 00:36:17,241
that you were the only one that
was openly feeling desperate?

780
00:36:17,275 --> 00:36:19,689
- Yes.
- So that was clear to everybody?

781
00:36:19,724 --> 00:36:21,000
Yeah, so it's calm

782
00:36:21,034 --> 00:36:23,379
because no one has
to really make a decision.

783
00:36:23,413 --> 00:36:26,758
It was more me having
to plead my case of why

784
00:36:26,793 --> 00:36:29,379
I would like to stay.
I mean, on one end,

785
00:36:29,413 --> 00:36:31,758
I got deceived by Omar
this entire time,

786
00:36:31,793 --> 00:36:35,068
so my social game clearly sucks,
strategic game sucks, because

787
00:36:35,103 --> 00:36:36,793
all I have
is my competitive edge.

788
00:36:36,827 --> 00:36:38,551
That's only one...
That's one note.

789
00:36:38,586 --> 00:36:41,413
So, in terms of fighting
against the jury,

790
00:36:41,448 --> 00:36:45,137
that's not really a big case.
That's only one end of that.

791
00:36:45,172 --> 00:36:46,793
No, absolutely not.
Every time Lindsay

792
00:36:46,827 --> 00:36:50,655
communicates with people,
they have a bond with her.

793
00:36:50,689 --> 00:36:52,965
It's not just
because you got tricked

794
00:36:53,000 --> 00:36:55,551
that makes you
a bad social player at all.

795
00:36:55,586 --> 00:36:58,413
You're social with everyone,
and everyone loves you.

796
00:36:58,448 --> 00:37:00,448
And that's the truth.

797
00:37:00,482 --> 00:37:02,344
And so, Lindsay,
this is a question

798
00:37:02,379 --> 00:37:04,275
I can never figure out
what I would do.

799
00:37:04,310 --> 00:37:07,206
How do you stop trying?
Because I'm sure, at some point,

800
00:37:07,241 --> 00:37:09,413
you go, "Well, okay, I guess
that's it. But wait, Mike,

801
00:37:09,448 --> 00:37:11,793
let me just... Can I...? Let me
just try it one more time."

802
00:37:11,827 --> 00:37:13,310
- Is that what happened?
- That's literally what I did.

803
00:37:13,344 --> 00:37:15,275
- That's exactly what happened. Yes.
- Okay.

804
00:37:15,310 --> 00:37:17,586
I'm doing it right now. Like,
I have to just pitch my case

805
00:37:17,620 --> 00:37:19,482
as best as I can.
Until you snuff that torch

806
00:37:19,517 --> 00:37:22,103
and my name is up there,
I have to just hope

807
00:37:22,137 --> 00:37:25,758
that I can just say one
last thing and offer one last...

808
00:37:25,793 --> 00:37:27,448
I don't know. I-I don't know.

809
00:37:27,482 --> 00:37:29,931
It's like guns blazing,
whatever I have left.

810
00:37:29,965 --> 00:37:31,620
I'm just throwing anything
out there.

811
00:37:31,655 --> 00:37:34,413
Jonathan, how do you feel about

812
00:37:34,448 --> 00:37:36,827
that aspect of the game
in this sense?

813
00:37:36,862 --> 00:37:39,103
The better player you are,

814
00:37:39,137 --> 00:37:41,689
the more likely
you are to be taken out.

815
00:37:41,724 --> 00:37:44,172
In theory, in a lot of games,
the better player you are,

816
00:37:44,206 --> 00:37:46,620
the more likely you are to win
'cause you're better.

817
00:37:46,655 --> 00:37:50,448
It's a fine line. If you aren't
a great player, then

818
00:37:50,482 --> 00:37:52,758
people want
to keep you till the end, but

819
00:37:52,793 --> 00:37:55,413
if you're looked at
as too strong, then done.

820
00:37:55,448 --> 00:37:57,310
Or finding the person

821
00:37:57,344 --> 00:37:59,724
or people
that you really can trust,

822
00:37:59,758 --> 00:38:01,862
and they... you work together
to get to the end,

823
00:38:01,896 --> 00:38:03,413
even if you're a good player,
that helps out.

824
00:38:03,448 --> 00:38:07,034
But again, it is <i>Survivor.</i>
That changes quickly.

825
00:38:07,068 --> 00:38:08,862
And what does that mean?

826
00:38:08,896 --> 00:38:10,551
That you can be a good player,

827
00:38:10,586 --> 00:38:12,448
and if you find
another good player

828
00:38:12,482 --> 00:38:14,103
that you trust,
then maybe the two of you bond

829
00:38:14,137 --> 00:38:15,586
and you protect each other?

830
00:38:15,620 --> 00:38:17,034
Yeah. You don't even have
to be two good players.

831
00:38:17,068 --> 00:38:18,344
Just two people that really know

832
00:38:18,379 --> 00:38:19,620
that they have
each other's back.

833
00:38:19,655 --> 00:38:21,758
As long as one of them
doesn't feel

834
00:38:21,793 --> 00:38:24,827
the other one has an upper hand,
you kind of work together.

835
00:38:24,862 --> 00:38:26,827
I mean,
but it's a hard thing to find.

836
00:38:26,862 --> 00:38:30,793
Well, Maryanne, the key is,
you have to align with people

837
00:38:30,827 --> 00:38:32,620
that you believe you can beat,

838
00:38:32,655 --> 00:38:34,586
and the trick is,
they're aligning with you

839
00:38:34,620 --> 00:38:37,379
because they believe
they can beat you.

840
00:38:37,413 --> 00:38:40,931
Exactly, and so many people have
tried to play that fine line

841
00:38:40,965 --> 00:38:42,793
and played it a little too well.

842
00:38:42,827 --> 00:38:45,103
That's truly why I think
Omar is there, because he...

843
00:38:45,137 --> 00:38:47,482
I thought I was his number one,
but then

844
00:38:47,517 --> 00:38:50,413
I realized that if I did take
my number one to the end,

845
00:38:50,448 --> 00:38:52,655
I'd be taken
and herded as a goat.

846
00:38:52,689 --> 00:38:56,241
But you have to realize,
"Okay, no. I have

847
00:38:56,275 --> 00:38:57,724
"to go, and I now have
to find new allies

848
00:38:57,758 --> 00:38:59,586
"who are round the same level
as me

849
00:38:59,620 --> 00:39:01,724
so I actually have a chance
to win at the end."

850
00:39:01,758 --> 00:39:05,137
So, Romeo, if you were gonna
give this vote a title,

851
00:39:05,172 --> 00:39:09,689
this chapter is called what?
What's the vote about?

852
00:39:09,724 --> 00:39:12,517
I would call it "The Fighter."

853
00:39:12,551 --> 00:39:14,551
Whoever it is didn't give up.

854
00:39:14,586 --> 00:39:18,827
They kept fighting till the
very end, and that's admirable.

855
00:39:18,862 --> 00:39:20,827
So, Lindsay,
you think he's talking to you?

856
00:39:20,862 --> 00:39:22,931
It's "Lindsay: The Fighter"?

857
00:39:22,965 --> 00:39:25,068
Yeah, but I-I like that title.
I'm cool with it.

858
00:39:25,103 --> 00:39:27,620
If-if the reason
for me leaving is because

859
00:39:27,655 --> 00:39:29,931
no one thinks they can beat me,

860
00:39:29,965 --> 00:39:32,103
that's the best way
for me to leave.

861
00:39:33,862 --> 00:39:37,241
All right, well, it sounds
like it is time to vote.

862
00:39:37,275 --> 00:39:39,310
Romeo, you're up.

863
00:40:11,172 --> 00:40:14,068
All right, if anybody has
an advantage or an idol,

864
00:40:14,103 --> 00:40:17,689
and you want to play it,
now would be the time to do so.

865
00:40:20,793 --> 00:40:23,034
Jeff.

866
00:40:24,103 --> 00:40:27,551
I waited 21 years
to do this, also.

867
00:40:27,586 --> 00:40:29,413
However, I can't play it
for myself,

868
00:40:29,448 --> 00:40:31,586
but I want to repay
somebody's loyalty to me.

869
00:40:35,758 --> 00:40:37,724
I'm gonna play this
for Maryanne, okay?

870
00:40:41,241 --> 00:40:43,000
You deserve it. I want you
to be here tomorrow.

871
00:40:43,034 --> 00:40:45,551
Thank you so much.
Thank you.

872
00:40:45,586 --> 00:40:48,758
This is a hidden immunity idol.

873
00:40:48,793 --> 00:40:51,793
Any votes cast
for Maryanne will not count.

874
00:40:51,827 --> 00:40:53,241
Jeff?

875
00:40:53,275 --> 00:40:56,241
Um, I will...

876
00:40:56,275 --> 00:41:00,137
not be playing this
for myself because

877
00:41:00,172 --> 00:41:01,586
it is a fake idol.

878
00:41:01,620 --> 00:41:03,482
I made it at camp. So I'm going
to throw it in the fire.

879
00:41:03,517 --> 00:41:06,068
Good for you. Good for you. Okay.

880
00:41:09,275 --> 00:41:12,896
All right, I'll read the votes.

881
00:41:15,482 --> 00:41:17,172
First vote-- Lindsay.

882
00:41:20,586 --> 00:41:22,793
Jonathan. One vote-- Lindsay,
one vote-- Jonathan.

883
00:41:29,482 --> 00:41:33,034
Lindsay. Two votes-- Lindsay,
one vote-- Jonathan.

884
00:41:37,689 --> 00:41:40,517
14th person voted out
of <i>Survivor 42--</i> Lindsay.

885
00:41:40,551 --> 00:41:42,862
It's three. It's enough.
Need to bring me your torch.

886
00:41:44,724 --> 00:41:48,000
It was fun
while it lasted, guys.

887
00:41:48,034 --> 00:41:50,413
Love you, girl.

888
00:41:54,068 --> 00:41:55,655
Good luck.

889
00:41:55,689 --> 00:41:58,172
- I love you so much.
- Good luck to you.

890
00:42:00,758 --> 00:42:03,793
Ugh.

891
00:42:05,827 --> 00:42:07,517
Lindsay, the tribe has spoken.

892
00:42:10,655 --> 00:42:12,344
Time for you to go. Ah.

893
00:42:12,379 --> 00:42:14,793
- Good luck, guys.
- Bye, Lindsay.

894
00:42:14,827 --> 00:42:16,896
I'm gonna eat so much food!

895
00:42:16,931 --> 00:42:19,241
Enjoy it.

896
00:42:25,862 --> 00:42:28,000
All right, you've made it
to the final four.

897
00:42:28,034 --> 00:42:32,931
Tomorrow you'll compete in
your final immunity challenge.

898
00:42:32,965 --> 00:42:34,344
Grab your torches,
head back to camp.

899
00:42:34,379 --> 00:42:36,551
Good night.
Thanks, Jeff.

900
00:42:39,862 --> 00:42:42,551
I love that the label's
"The Fighter," and I like

901
00:42:42,586 --> 00:42:45,172
<i>that that's my tagline
for this because I really felt</i>

902
00:42:45,206 --> 00:42:47,241
<i>like I fought my way</i> <i>
throughout this whole game.</i>

903
00:42:47,275 --> 00:42:49,413
<i>And I'm incredibly proud</i> <i>
of myself</i>

904
00:42:49,448 --> 00:42:52,000
<i>of how far I got.</i> <i>
This was so much fun.</i>

905
00:42:52,034 --> 00:42:55,103
<i>I got to experience</i> <i>
so many</i> Survivor <i>things</i>

906
00:42:55,137 --> 00:42:57,000
<i>that so many people</i> <i>
don't get to have.</i>

907
00:42:57,034 --> 00:42:59,068
Of course,
I'm a little upset right now,

908
00:42:59,103 --> 00:43:02,551
but this was the best ever.

909
00:43:22,068 --> 00:43:23,413
Come on in.

910
00:43:27,068 --> 00:43:30,000
I can hear you breathing just
walking up the steps, Maryanne.

911
00:43:30,034 --> 00:43:32,344
Oh, yeah.

912
00:43:32,379 --> 00:43:34,206
Good morning, Jeff.

913
00:43:34,241 --> 00:43:36,551
Good morning, Mr. Jeff.

914
00:43:36,586 --> 00:43:37,793
Good morning.

915
00:43:37,827 --> 00:43:39,793
Oh, wow.

916
00:43:39,827 --> 00:43:42,172
It is a <i>Survivor</i> classic.

917
00:43:43,965 --> 00:43:45,896
- You know the name?
- Yes, sir.

918
00:43:45,931 --> 00:43:47,896
All right, so,
let me just check in.

919
00:43:47,931 --> 00:43:50,931
How are you doing, day 25?

920
00:43:50,965 --> 00:43:52,448
Mike, what are you feeling?

921
00:43:52,482 --> 00:43:54,896
Obviously we're very depleted.
It's day 25.

922
00:43:54,931 --> 00:43:58,241
But I always say,
"Big games, big players."

923
00:43:58,275 --> 00:44:00,172
And that's when you reach deeper
than you've ever reached

924
00:44:00,206 --> 00:44:02,655
into everything you have
and put it out there,

925
00:44:02,689 --> 00:44:04,551
and this is
the last immunity challenge.

926
00:44:04,586 --> 00:44:06,551
And whatever's left in the tank,

927
00:44:06,586 --> 00:44:09,034
you have to leave right here
on this platform today.

928
00:44:09,068 --> 00:44:12,275
How about you, Romeo?
When you're about

929
00:44:12,310 --> 00:44:15,241
to take on this challenge,
who all do you think of?

930
00:44:15,275 --> 00:44:17,413
Do you draw
on inspiration right now?

931
00:44:17,448 --> 00:44:19,413
Definitely. Family back home.

932
00:44:19,448 --> 00:44:23,034
All the strong, independent
women that I coach back home.

933
00:44:23,068 --> 00:44:25,137
They're looking at me
and saying, "Hang in there.

934
00:44:25,172 --> 00:44:28,517
You know, you taught me
to push for what you want."

935
00:44:28,551 --> 00:44:30,517
And now I'm showing them that
I'm pushing for what I want.

936
00:44:30,551 --> 00:44:32,103
I want final three.

937
00:44:32,137 --> 00:44:35,379
How about you, Jonathan?
What do you draw on right now?

938
00:44:35,413 --> 00:44:39,275
We've been working this hard
for this moment, Mr. Jeff.

939
00:44:39,310 --> 00:44:43,103
And for me
it comes down to this.

940
00:44:43,137 --> 00:44:46,241
And everything that I have, I'm
going to pour it into this game,

941
00:44:46,275 --> 00:44:48,034
and I'm going to give it my all

942
00:44:48,068 --> 00:44:51,310
so that if I do get kicked off,
then I'll say,

943
00:44:51,344 --> 00:44:54,344
"Hey, I fought the good fight.
I did everything I could do."

944
00:44:54,379 --> 00:44:58,275
Maryanne, right now
you've been so vocal all season

945
00:44:58,310 --> 00:45:00,620
of sharing your emotions.

946
00:45:00,655 --> 00:45:02,689
You even say,
"I wear 'em on my sleeve."

947
00:45:02,724 --> 00:45:04,482
What are you feeling right now?

948
00:45:04,517 --> 00:45:08,000
What are you drawing on
to get you pumped up?

949
00:45:09,068 --> 00:45:12,068
Um... right now...

950
00:45:12,103 --> 00:45:14,448
I'm sorry.

951
00:45:14,482 --> 00:45:19,448
I'm right now
drawing on knowing that

952
00:45:19,482 --> 00:45:24,068
my whole family's going to be
watching me doing this, and...

953
00:45:24,103 --> 00:45:26,758
one of my family members
is not talking

954
00:45:26,793 --> 00:45:28,517
to the rest of my family,

955
00:45:28,551 --> 00:45:30,103
so we haven't really
been together

956
00:45:30,137 --> 00:45:31,689
for more than a year,
and it hurts.

957
00:45:31,724 --> 00:45:35,103
But to know that at this moment,

958
00:45:35,137 --> 00:45:37,103
even if they're separate,

959
00:45:37,137 --> 00:45:39,793
we're together right now,
cheering me on

960
00:45:39,827 --> 00:45:42,275
is the thing that's driving me
and pushing me.

961
00:45:42,310 --> 00:45:46,172
So you being on <i>Survivor</i>
could bring your family back?

962
00:45:49,241 --> 00:45:51,827
I want it more
than a million dollars, Jeff.

963
00:45:53,241 --> 00:45:55,344
I want it more
than a million dollars.

964
00:45:57,068 --> 00:45:59,275
How do you now take that emotion

965
00:45:59,310 --> 00:46:03,655
and turn it into energy
rather than sorrow or sadness?

966
00:46:03,689 --> 00:46:07,034
I sit in the sorrow and sadness.

967
00:46:07,068 --> 00:46:10,379
It's okay to feel sad,
but the thing is,

968
00:46:10,413 --> 00:46:11,931
sadness doesn't take you anywhere.

969
00:46:11,965 --> 00:46:13,344
It's what you do with that.

970
00:46:13,379 --> 00:46:15,793
What am I going to do
with my sadness?

971
00:46:15,827 --> 00:46:17,793
I'm going to turn it
into passion and drive

972
00:46:17,827 --> 00:46:21,034
so that I push myself,
and I do the best that I can,

973
00:46:21,068 --> 00:46:22,862
and I win this competition.

974
00:46:24,689 --> 00:46:26,655
All right,
all four of you feel very ready.

975
00:46:26,689 --> 00:46:28,896
You know what's driving you.

976
00:46:28,931 --> 00:46:31,137
Let's get to it.
First things first, Mike.

977
00:46:31,172 --> 00:46:32,724
Jeff, you might have to wrestle
me for this. I don't know.

978
00:46:32,758 --> 00:46:34,724
- Ah, I don't want to wrestle you, man.
- Ah.

979
00:46:34,758 --> 00:46:36,206
- I want love.
- You always get love, brother.

980
00:46:36,241 --> 00:46:37,620
- Thank you.
- Thank you.

981
00:46:40,068 --> 00:46:42,034
It comes down to this, Mr. Jeff.

982
00:46:42,068 --> 00:46:44,551
It comes down to this.
- Man, I'm stoked!

983
00:46:44,586 --> 00:46:46,689
Come on!

984
00:46:46,724 --> 00:46:51,206
For the last time,
immunity is back up for grabs.

985
00:46:51,241 --> 00:46:52,758
<i>For today's challenge,</i> <i>
you're going</i>

986
00:46:52,793 --> 00:46:54,482
<i>to have one hand tied</i> <i>
behind your back.</i>

987
00:46:54,517 --> 00:46:56,931
<i>You're going
to drop a ball down the chute.</i>

988
00:46:56,965 --> 00:47:00,448
<i>It's going to spiral around.</i> <i>
You're going to catch it.</i>

989
00:47:00,482 --> 00:47:02,241
<i>You're going to drop it again.</i> <i>
At regular intervals,</i>

990
00:47:02,275 --> 00:47:05,551
<i>we will add another ball,</i> <i>
making it more difficult.</i>

991
00:47:05,586 --> 00:47:08,137
<i>If at any point a ball drops,</i>

992
00:47:08,172 --> 00:47:10,448
<i>you're out.</i>

993
00:47:10,482 --> 00:47:13,448
Last person left standing
wins immunity,

994
00:47:13,482 --> 00:47:16,379
guaranteed a spot
at the final three

995
00:47:16,413 --> 00:47:19,448
where you will get a shot
to plead your case to the jury

996
00:47:19,482 --> 00:47:21,344
that you helped vote out,

997
00:47:21,379 --> 00:47:23,448
why you deserve
the title of Sole Survivor

998
00:47:23,482 --> 00:47:24,862
and the million dollars.

999
00:47:24,896 --> 00:47:28,172
Plus, you decide,
"Who do I take with me

1000
00:47:28,206 --> 00:47:31,655
to put in that second seat, and
who do I force to make fire?"

1001
00:47:31,689 --> 00:47:34,275
All the power will be
in the hands

1002
00:47:34,310 --> 00:47:36,068
of the person
who wins this challenge.

1003
00:47:36,103 --> 00:47:38,620
Never has a challenge been
more important

1004
00:47:38,655 --> 00:47:40,068
in this season
than this one right here.

1005
00:47:40,103 --> 00:47:41,724
Are you ready?

1006
00:47:41,758 --> 00:47:43,275
Yes.
- Yes, sir.
Let's get to it.

1007
00:47:43,310 --> 00:47:44,758
Yes.

1008
00:47:50,620 --> 00:47:53,896
All right, everybody pick up
your first ball.

1009
00:47:55,206 --> 00:47:57,034
Here we go. Final four.

1010
00:47:57,068 --> 00:48:00,034
Win this, you're in three. Everybody,

1011
00:48:00,068 --> 00:48:03,137
drop your first ball.

1012
00:48:05,965 --> 00:48:09,034
This challenge is on.

1013
00:48:12,482 --> 00:48:15,655
Everything riding right here

1014
00:48:15,689 --> 00:48:19,137
on this beautifully-designed,
hypnotic game.

1015
00:48:21,275 --> 00:48:24,172
What started
as an art department project

1016
00:48:24,206 --> 00:48:26,655
in <i>Survivor: China</i> by somebody

1017
00:48:26,689 --> 00:48:30,137
who had some free time
on his hands, named Simo,

1018
00:48:30,172 --> 00:48:33,758
turned into a challenge
that we used

1019
00:48:33,793 --> 00:48:36,586
in <i>Survivor: Tocantins,</i>
and is now worth

1020
00:48:36,620 --> 00:48:38,724
a million dollars to somebody.

1021
00:48:38,758 --> 00:48:40,586
Right now you're just getting

1022
00:48:40,620 --> 00:48:42,379
warmed up,
getting a feel of this.

1023
00:48:45,655 --> 00:48:48,344
Mike drops.
Mike, you're out.

1024
00:48:48,379 --> 00:48:50,586
Mike is out with one ball.

1025
00:48:50,620 --> 00:48:54,655
Unbelievable.
Never seen that happen.

1026
00:48:54,689 --> 00:48:58,275
Mike has no control tonight.

1027
00:48:58,310 --> 00:49:00,413
I'm still in shock. What happened?
So am I.

1028
00:49:00,448 --> 00:49:02,689
Took my eye off of it
to put it in.

1029
00:49:02,724 --> 00:49:04,551
I mean,
we're in the warmup phase.

1030
00:49:04,586 --> 00:49:06,655
I literally had it in my hand.

1031
00:49:06,689 --> 00:49:08,758
It slipped out of my hand.

1032
00:49:11,724 --> 00:49:14,551
All right, we're down to three.

1033
00:49:14,586 --> 00:49:18,172
In a moment you're going
to add a second ball,

1034
00:49:18,206 --> 00:49:21,827
and that's when this challenge
will really start to kick in.

1035
00:49:21,862 --> 00:49:24,482
You'll have 15 seconds to do it.

1036
00:49:24,517 --> 00:49:27,000
You don't need to rush.

1037
00:49:27,034 --> 00:49:31,724
You just saw, with Mike,
how quickly it can be over.

1038
00:49:31,758 --> 00:49:35,000
Stay engaged.

1039
00:49:35,034 --> 00:49:37,241
Your 15 seconds starts now.

1040
00:49:37,275 --> 00:49:39,724
Maryanne drops.

1041
00:49:39,758 --> 00:49:41,689
Jonathan drops.

1042
00:49:44,068 --> 00:49:45,965
Romeo drops.

1043
00:49:46,000 --> 00:49:50,000
Everybody now
with two balls in motion.

1044
00:49:51,413 --> 00:49:55,620
The key to this challenge
is that gate.

1045
00:49:55,655 --> 00:49:58,655
It's going to send one ball
to the right,

1046
00:49:58,689 --> 00:50:01,034
and then the next ball
to the left.

1047
00:50:02,068 --> 00:50:05,000
It's going to come down
to the spacing.

1048
00:50:16,793 --> 00:50:19,689
That sound is hypnotic.

1049
00:50:19,724 --> 00:50:22,172
You got to stay very engaged.

1050
00:50:22,206 --> 00:50:25,068
Mike still stunned.

1051
00:50:25,103 --> 00:50:29,172
You never know what is going
to get you on <i>Survivor.</i>

1052
00:50:29,206 --> 00:50:31,241
Oh, Maryanne drops.

1053
00:50:31,275 --> 00:50:35,172
Maryanne is out, and now,
quickly, we are down to two.

1054
00:50:35,206 --> 00:50:37,689
And we only have two balls
in play.

1055
00:50:37,724 --> 00:50:39,689
It speaks to mental exhaustion.

1056
00:50:42,034 --> 00:50:45,793
This is not a difficult phase
of this challenge.

1057
00:50:45,827 --> 00:50:47,862
Lots of kids watching
could do this.

1058
00:50:49,482 --> 00:50:51,758
But they've been sleeping
and eating.

1059
00:50:54,103 --> 00:50:56,068
Mike and Maryanne--

1060
00:50:56,103 --> 00:51:00,275
their fate will be decided
by either Jonathan or Romeo.

1061
00:51:00,310 --> 00:51:03,620
Whoever wins this challenge
will hold

1062
00:51:03,655 --> 00:51:06,793
all the power tonight
at Tribal Council.

1063
00:51:09,413 --> 00:51:12,413
You're gonna get ready
to place a third ball.

1064
00:51:12,448 --> 00:51:15,931
You'll have 15 seconds

1065
00:51:15,965 --> 00:51:17,172
starting now.

1066
00:51:17,206 --> 00:51:19,413
Based on what's happened so far,

1067
00:51:19,448 --> 00:51:21,862
three balls might be it.

1068
00:51:21,896 --> 00:51:23,551
Romeo drops.

1069
00:51:24,551 --> 00:51:26,103
Jonathan drops, and we're now

1070
00:51:26,137 --> 00:51:27,931
into the next phase--
three balls.

1071
00:51:27,965 --> 00:51:32,344
Those balls now feel like
they're spinning more quickly.

1072
00:51:32,379 --> 00:51:35,413
That spacing is really critical.

1073
00:51:35,448 --> 00:51:39,655
Every part of you is focused
on one thing--

1074
00:51:39,689 --> 00:51:41,241
left, then right.

1075
00:51:41,275 --> 00:51:44,137
Left, then right.

1076
00:51:48,241 --> 00:51:50,344
This is it.

1077
00:51:50,379 --> 00:51:53,275
Who will have the power tonight

1078
00:51:53,310 --> 00:51:55,965
to try to control what happens?

1079
00:51:56,000 --> 00:51:57,896
Romeo and Jonathan,

1080
00:51:57,931 --> 00:52:01,413
if you hear a thud
of that ball hitting the plank,

1081
00:52:01,448 --> 00:52:04,172
that's going to echo
in your mind for a lifetime

1082
00:52:04,206 --> 00:52:05,689
if you lose <i>Survivor.</i>

1083
00:52:10,724 --> 00:52:14,103
All right, in a moment, we're
going to add a fourth ball,

1084
00:52:14,137 --> 00:52:16,793
and it's going
to get very difficult.

1085
00:52:16,827 --> 00:52:18,965
So you need to start thinking

1086
00:52:19,000 --> 00:52:21,827
about where you want
to put that fourth ball.

1087
00:52:24,827 --> 00:52:27,034
You'll have 15 seconds
to do it

1088
00:52:27,068 --> 00:52:28,931
starting now.

1089
00:52:30,000 --> 00:52:33,172
You can drop any time
in that window.

1090
00:52:33,206 --> 00:52:35,413
Romeo drops.

1091
00:52:37,793 --> 00:52:40,827
Jonathan drops.

1092
00:52:40,862 --> 00:52:42,448
Jonathan drops, and he's out.

1093
00:52:42,482 --> 00:52:44,310
Can't make the transition.

1094
00:52:44,344 --> 00:52:47,586
Romeo wins
his first individual immunity,

1095
00:52:47,620 --> 00:52:51,620
and it could not have come at a bigger time.

1096
00:52:51,655 --> 00:52:54,586
Romeo is in charge
of everything tonight.

1097
00:52:57,344 --> 00:52:59,206
Congratulations.
- Wow. What a challenge.

1098
00:52:59,241 --> 00:53:01,517
- On any given day...
- I'm proud of you. Great job.

1099
00:53:01,551 --> 00:53:03,068
...anybody can win anything.

1100
00:53:03,103 --> 00:53:05,551
You have the inspiration
in your heart.

1101
00:53:05,586 --> 00:53:08,724
Romeo, what is it right now?

1102
00:53:08,758 --> 00:53:11,931
I want to know right now.

1103
00:53:11,965 --> 00:53:15,344
I feel like I've been at the
bottom of this game for so long,

1104
00:53:15,379 --> 00:53:18,724
and I've just been hanging on
by my fingernails.

1105
00:53:18,758 --> 00:53:20,862
Every Tribal, my name comes up.

1106
00:53:20,896 --> 00:53:24,344
Every single Tribal,
Romeo was always the "in case."

1107
00:53:24,379 --> 00:53:27,482
In case somebody pulls an idol,
throw some votes on Romeo.

1108
00:53:27,517 --> 00:53:28,931
It's just... it's exhausting.

1109
00:53:28,965 --> 00:53:31,551
I've been fighting so hard,
and this feels good.

1110
00:53:31,586 --> 00:53:35,241
And I'm going to go back home,

1111
00:53:35,275 --> 00:53:37,344
and to all those young women
that I work with

1112
00:53:37,379 --> 00:53:39,103
and tell them, "That's what
I tried to teach you.

1113
00:53:39,137 --> 00:53:41,689
"Just-just don't give up
because, hey,

1114
00:53:41,724 --> 00:53:43,344
you could be in the final three
of <i>Survivor."</i>

1115
00:53:43,379 --> 00:53:45,827
This is a dream come true.

1116
00:53:46,827 --> 00:53:49,000
Let me come to you.

1117
00:53:49,034 --> 00:53:51,896
- Yeah!
- Great job.

1118
00:53:51,931 --> 00:53:53,793
- Jeff.
- Final four immunity.

1119
00:53:53,827 --> 00:53:55,793
You are not only safe.

1120
00:53:55,827 --> 00:53:59,103
Every decision that happens
tonight will be yours.

1121
00:53:59,137 --> 00:54:02,068
All right, everybody, grab
your stuff, head back to camp.

1122
00:54:02,103 --> 00:54:04,068
I will see you tonight
for the biggest Tribal

1123
00:54:04,103 --> 00:54:05,482
- of the season. Congrats.
- Thank you.

1124
00:54:05,517 --> 00:54:07,344
See you, Jeff.
Great job, man. Hey.

1125
00:54:07,379 --> 00:54:09,517
<i>It was</i> <i>
extremely emotional for me</i>

1126
00:54:09,551 --> 00:54:12,689
because I felt like, after
winning this, for the first time

1127
00:54:12,724 --> 00:54:15,034
<i>in a long time, I had security.</i>

1128
00:54:16,413 --> 00:54:18,034
<i>
This is definitely</i>

1129
00:54:18,068 --> 00:54:20,655
my Miss America moment. The
spotlight's going to be on me.

1130
00:54:20,689 --> 00:54:23,172
<i>I have the shiniest dress.</i>

1131
00:54:23,206 --> 00:54:26,206
I have the most expensive dress
and the most coveted dress, so

1132
00:54:26,241 --> 00:54:28,275
<i>we'll see what I do tonight.</i>

1133
00:54:42,896 --> 00:54:45,655
Good job, Romeo.
Good job, Romeo.

1134
00:54:45,689 --> 00:54:47,862
Way to come through
when it counted, brother.

1135
00:54:47,896 --> 00:54:48,896
Thank you, guys.

1136
00:54:48,931 --> 00:54:51,655
<i>Coming back from the challenge,</i> <i>
I felt like</i>

1137
00:54:51,689 --> 00:54:56,482
MVP, Miss Universe
and prom queen all combined.

1138
00:54:56,517 --> 00:55:01,034
<i>I beat Jonathan in the final</i> <i>
immunity challenge.</i>

1139
00:55:01,068 --> 00:55:04,034
<i>I am just thrilled,</i>

1140
00:55:04,068 --> 00:55:07,000
and I think this necklace looks
a lot better on me

1141
00:55:07,034 --> 00:55:08,965
than it does
on big-ass Jonathan.

1142
00:55:11,551 --> 00:55:13,517
All good.

1143
00:55:15,689 --> 00:55:18,206
<i>This big victory going into</i>

1144
00:55:18,241 --> 00:55:21,068
<i>one of the most important</i> <i>
Tribal Councils--</i>

1145
00:55:21,103 --> 00:55:25,103
it's just kind of like vengeance
for all those horrible Tribals

1146
00:55:25,137 --> 00:55:28,793
where people just dismissed me

1147
00:55:28,827 --> 00:55:31,448
and-and just threw my name
out there just in case.

1148
00:55:31,482 --> 00:55:34,793
<i>So it feels amazing,</i> <i>
and I'm enjoying it.</i>

1149
00:55:34,827 --> 00:55:37,724
Oh, Romeo, unless you have
your mind made up, and you want

1150
00:55:37,758 --> 00:55:39,793
- to say something, I'd like to talk to you first.
- Sure.

1151
00:55:39,827 --> 00:55:41,000
- Hey, I'll talk to everybody...
- Has nothing to do with...

1152
00:55:41,034 --> 00:55:42,000
It has nothing to do
with strategy.

1153
00:55:42,034 --> 00:55:43,586
It's about my personal feeling.

1154
00:55:43,620 --> 00:55:48,448
<i>Romeo has to send me</i> <i>
to make fire because</i>

1155
00:55:48,482 --> 00:55:51,482
<i>it's the consensus</i> <i>
that I'm the most dangerous.</i>

1156
00:55:51,517 --> 00:55:55,275
It's a compliment and a curse.
It is what it is.

1157
00:55:55,310 --> 00:55:57,310
<i>I think I can beat Maryanne.</i>

1158
00:55:57,344 --> 00:55:59,379
<i>Jonathan could be</i> <i>
a different story, though.</i>

1159
00:55:59,413 --> 00:56:02,793
I'm in deep water,
but I didn't drown yet.

1160
00:56:02,827 --> 00:56:04,689
I know you're gonna have
to ask me to make fire.

1161
00:56:04,724 --> 00:56:08,000
I want you to know
that there's no animosity.

1162
00:56:08,034 --> 00:56:10,206
If I'm being 100% honest,
I know I'm the right move.

1163
00:56:10,241 --> 00:56:12,000
You'd be silly not to send me.

1164
00:56:12,034 --> 00:56:13,758
- That's why I know it's going to happen.
- I respect that a lot.

1165
00:56:13,793 --> 00:56:15,965
You need to think
about the other two.

1166
00:56:16,000 --> 00:56:17,862
- <i>-
- If I go against Jonathan...</i> <i> Yeah.</i>

1167
00:56:17,896 --> 00:56:20,206
<i>...and I beat Jonathan,</i> <i>
then you have to deal</i>

1168
00:56:20,241 --> 00:56:21,586
<i>with me and Maryanne.</i>

1169
00:56:21,620 --> 00:56:23,379
- That's true.
- But if you make me make fire

1170
00:56:23,413 --> 00:56:25,482
against Maryanne
instead of Jonathan,

1171
00:56:25,517 --> 00:56:27,172
- you only got to deal with one of us.
- Yeah.

1172
00:56:27,206 --> 00:56:29,620
<i>I do have to send Mike</i> <i>
to make fire,</i>

1173
00:56:29,655 --> 00:56:31,724
<i>but he has a good point.</i>

1174
00:56:31,758 --> 00:56:35,310
<i>If he goes against Jonathan</i> <i>
and he beats Jonathan,</i>

1175
00:56:35,344 --> 00:56:36,862
now I'm going to be going

1176
00:56:36,896 --> 00:56:38,931
against the two most likable
people in the final three--

1177
00:56:38,965 --> 00:56:40,620
Mike and Maryanne.

1178
00:56:40,655 --> 00:56:42,344
You need to make a bold move.
That's up to you.

1179
00:56:42,379 --> 00:56:44,172
- Listen, I'm giving you advice. I'm just telling you...
- Yeah.

1180
00:56:44,206 --> 00:56:45,551
- that's how I would think about it.
- Yeah.

1181
00:56:45,586 --> 00:56:47,517
<i>I'm weighing everything</i> <i>
at this point</i>

1182
00:56:47,551 --> 00:56:50,241
<i>because what good would it do</i> <i>
for me</i>

1183
00:56:50,275 --> 00:56:53,068
<i>to get to the top three</i> <i>
and end up</i>

1184
00:56:53,103 --> 00:56:55,965
third place or second place?
I want to win.

1185
00:56:56,000 --> 00:56:57,172
Jonathan, are you ready?

1186
00:56:57,206 --> 00:56:59,275
- Yes.
- Go.

1187
00:57:06,965 --> 00:57:08,275
Oh, that's a good amount.

1188
00:57:08,310 --> 00:57:10,034
- Oh, nice. Whoa!
- Hold on.

1189
00:57:10,068 --> 00:57:13,206
<i>Jonathan is</i> <i>
very good at making fire,</i>

1190
00:57:13,241 --> 00:57:17,344
<i>and my fire-making, I would say,</i> <i>
is decent, but the thing is,</i>

1191
00:57:17,379 --> 00:57:19,379
you never know what's going
to happen at Tribal.

1192
00:57:19,413 --> 00:57:20,517
Maybe I'm going to choke.

1193
00:57:20,551 --> 00:57:22,793
Maybe Mike is like,
"I'm a super good fire maker."

1194
00:57:22,827 --> 00:57:25,655
<i>So, the best thing</i> <i>
for me is for Romeo</i>

1195
00:57:25,689 --> 00:57:27,724
to put Jonathan and Mike
for fire,

1196
00:57:27,758 --> 00:57:29,344
<i>and Jonathan wins.</i>

1197
00:57:29,379 --> 00:57:30,758
You're good.
You just have to focus on, like,

1198
00:57:30,793 --> 00:57:32,310
building a fast teepee up,

1199
00:57:32,344 --> 00:57:34,103
'cause the trick is
to get the sticks to catch.

1200
00:57:34,137 --> 00:57:36,448
- They're caught. Mm-hmm.
- Once the sticks catch, you've won.

1201
00:57:36,482 --> 00:57:38,655
- So the sticks are caught. Do you see that?
- Then you're good.

1202
00:57:38,689 --> 00:57:40,586
<i>I've been telling Jonathan</i> <i>
all the tips</i>

1203
00:57:40,620 --> 00:57:42,310
<i>and tricks to go</i> <i>
and make fire because</i>

1204
00:57:42,344 --> 00:57:45,206
I don't want Mike here
in the final three with me.

1205
00:57:45,241 --> 00:57:46,931
I want Jonathan and Romeo

1206
00:57:46,965 --> 00:57:49,000
because that is my best shot
at winning.

1207
00:57:49,034 --> 00:57:51,758
- So, what was that? Like, 30 seconds?
- Yeah, that was, like,

1208
00:57:51,793 --> 00:57:54,034
surprisingly fast.

1209
00:57:54,068 --> 00:57:55,620
Jon, do you want
to go talk, my brother?

1210
00:57:55,655 --> 00:57:57,034
- Yeah, I do.
- Look at you practicing, huh?

1211
00:57:57,068 --> 00:57:58,517
You don't need practice.

1212
00:57:58,551 --> 00:58:00,310
I need practice now.

1213
00:58:00,344 --> 00:58:03,068
<i>The first thing you do to
prepare for a night like tonight</i>

1214
00:58:03,103 --> 00:58:04,965
is you start a lot of fires.

1215
00:58:05,000 --> 00:58:07,206
So I've been starting
a lot of fires.

1216
00:58:07,241 --> 00:58:08,551
And I've been
starting 'em quick,

1217
00:58:08,586 --> 00:58:12,034
<i>but no one has seen Mike</i> <i>
make a fire.</i>

1218
00:58:12,068 --> 00:58:13,517
I'm gonna try like hell to beat
your ass tonight in fire.

1219
00:58:13,551 --> 00:58:15,724
- You better, man. If you don't...
- Hey...

1220
00:58:15,758 --> 00:58:17,275
- If you don't, I would be ashamed.
- I get one last...

1221
00:58:17,310 --> 00:58:19,000
I got...
I got one last little bit in me.

1222
00:58:19,034 --> 00:58:21,965
- I hope... I hope you try.
- Oh, I'm definitely gonna try.

1223
00:58:22,000 --> 00:58:23,275
I ain't giving it to you.

1224
00:58:23,310 --> 00:58:24,724
If you want it,
you got to take it off me.

1225
00:58:24,758 --> 00:58:26,724
Be honest. You start fires
a lot, don't you?

1226
00:58:26,758 --> 00:58:28,965
- I don't know.
- Ah, yes, you do.

1227
00:58:29,000 --> 00:58:31,931
- Ah.
- I think that you've been dealing with fire too long

1228
00:58:31,965 --> 00:58:34,931
for you not
to be a good fire-starter.

1229
00:58:37,586 --> 00:58:39,137
I'll tell you what, though.

1230
00:58:39,172 --> 00:58:41,724
If Romeo gives you an out
not to make fire,

1231
00:58:41,758 --> 00:58:43,827
take it.

1232
00:58:44,827 --> 00:58:46,586
- Yeah?
- Yes.

1233
00:58:46,620 --> 00:58:49,620
Don't lose your spot.
I'm telling you.

1234
00:58:49,655 --> 00:58:50,965
- Yeah.
- Listen, you'll be the favorite,

1235
