2329
02:02:19,934 --> 02:02:21,808
Mais c'est rafraîchissant de savoir

2330
02:02:21,933 --> 02:02:24,334
que je peux avoir
ces moments de faiblesse absolue,

2331
02:02:24,459 --> 02:02:27,315
de doute, sans avoir
la moindre idée d'où ça vient,

2332
02:02:27,440 --> 02:02:30,143
- et bon sang, je me suis reprise !
- Oui !

2333
02:02:30,268 --> 02:02:32,520
Et je suis repartie à la nage !

2334
02:02:32,770 --> 02:02:36,034
J'ai nagé dans l'océan !
Bordel, sérieux !

2335
02:02:36,159 --> 02:02:37,400
Tu l'as fait !

2336
02:02:37,525 --> 02:02:39,754
Bien. Nous allons devoir boucler 45.

2337
02:02:39,879 --> 02:02:42,138
Mais, Drew, je me tourne vers vous.

2338
02:02:42,263 --> 02:02:44,636
- Et voici ma question.
- Oh, bébé !

2339
02:02:44,971 --> 02:02:47,856
Quelle est votre meilleure
référence littéraire

2340
02:02:47,981 --> 02:02:51,442
pour justifier que quelqu'un
postule à Survivor

2341
02:02:51,567 --> 02:02:54,768
et vienne vivre l'expérience
que vous venez de vivre ?

2342
02:02:54,893 --> 02:02:57,445
Jeff, il y a un genre littéraire

2343
02:02:57,570 --> 02:02:59,878
appelé <i>Bildungsroman</i>,
qui vient d'Allemagne.

2344
02:03:00,003 --> 02:03:01,833
Cela parle de jeunes gens

2345
02:03:01,958 --> 02:03:04,152
qui grandissent
et se découvrent eux-mêmes.

2346
02:03:04,277 --> 02:03:06,892
Ici, on a tous la vingtaine,
enfin, certains ont plus,

2347
02:03:07,017 --> 02:03:10,380
mais on est tous à un moment
intermédiaire, un seuil de notre vie.

2348
02:03:10,505 --> 02:03:13,058
Et si vous cherchez
une expérience transcendantale

2349
02:03:13,183 --> 02:03:15,377
qui puisse vous montrer
qui vous êtes vraiment,

2350
02:03:15,502 --> 02:03:17,637
alors ne cherchez
pas plus loin que Survivor.

2351
02:03:17,762 --> 02:03:19,355
Je vous enjoins à postuler.

2352
02:03:19,480 --> 02:03:22,126
Pour nous tous, c'était un peu
"ça passe ou ça casse".

2353
02:03:22,251 --> 02:03:24,538
Et... six mois après, un an après,

2354
02:03:24,663 --> 02:03:26,441
certains sont plus riches
d'un million,

2355
02:03:26,566 --> 02:03:28,915
mais tous, nous avons vécu
une formidable aventure.

2356
02:03:29,040 --> 02:03:32,137
Et voilà pourquoi
vous étiez dans Survivor, Drew !

2357
02:03:32,262 --> 02:03:33,308
Bravo !

2358
02:03:33,433 --> 02:03:37,251
À notre retour :
votre premier aperçu de Survivor 46 !

2359
02:03:39,390 --> 02:03:41,050
Drew, bravo, bravo !

2360
02:03:41,175 --> 02:03:42,775
Je vous ai mis sur le grill !

2361
02:03:47,448 --> 02:03:48,334
<i>À suivre...</i>

2362
02:03:48,459 --> 02:03:51,982
<i>Il faut être solide pour s'engager
dans un truc aussi dingue.</i>

2363
02:03:55,344 --> 02:03:56,701
C'est quoi, ça ?!

2364
02:03:58,619 --> 02:04:00,052
Un foutu bandana !

2365
02:04:08,933 --> 02:04:12,687
Bien, de retour dans l'After
de Survivor 45

2366
02:04:12,812 --> 02:04:14,789
Je veux lever mon verre à vous tous,

2367
02:04:14,914 --> 02:04:17,601
ainsi qu'à tous les joueurs
de la saison absents ce soir,

2368
02:04:17,726 --> 02:04:19,251
qui n'ont pas atteint le jury.

2369
02:04:19,376 --> 02:04:22,217
C'est toujours chouette de voir
arriver un nouveau groupe de joueurs,

2370
02:04:22,342 --> 02:04:24,638
se mettre au défi,
voir de quoi ils sont faits,

2371
02:04:24,763 --> 02:04:27,171
parfois se transformer
ou changer leurs vies.

2372
02:04:27,296 --> 02:04:29,742
C'est toujours doux-amer
de dire au revoir.

2373
02:04:29,867 --> 02:04:33,256
Alors, à vous, les joueurs
de Survivor 45, santé !

2374
02:04:36,656 --> 02:04:39,263
Et aussi doux-amer que ce soit,

2375
02:04:39,388 --> 02:04:42,723
depuis 23 ans, nous avons
la chance de pouvoir dire :

2376
02:04:42,848 --> 02:04:45,249
tandis qu'une saison s'achève,

2377
02:04:45,374 --> 02:04:46,729
une autre commence.

2378
02:04:46,854 --> 02:04:50,594
Voici votre premier aperçu
de Survivor 46.

2379
02:04:56,976 --> 02:04:59,367
<i>Une nouvelle tribu se forme.</i>

2380
02:05:01,051 --> 02:05:04,103
<i>Depuis que j'ai reçu le premier
appel, j'ai été super excitée.</i>

2381
02:05:05,359 --> 02:05:08,215
<i>Je sais que des dizaines de milliers
de personnes postulent.</i>

2382
02:05:08,602 --> 02:05:11,979
<i>Et j'ai toujours dit : "Je serai dans
cette émission un jour, je le ferai."</i>

2383
02:05:13,230 --> 02:05:14,415
On y est !

2384
02:05:14,540 --> 02:05:15,649
Ça va, bébé ?

2385
02:05:15,774 --> 02:05:16,917
Bonjour !

2386
02:05:17,042 --> 02:05:17,983
Ça roule ?

2387
02:05:18,393 --> 02:05:19,468
Ouais !

2388
02:05:22,290 --> 02:05:24,505
- Prenez-moi !
- Je suis faite pour ça !

2389
02:05:24,630 --> 02:05:26,660
J'en ai tellement envie !

2390
02:05:26,785 --> 02:05:29,864
Je m'entends avec n'importe qui.
J'ai un enfant de quatre ans !

2391
02:05:29,989 --> 02:05:33,067
Je dis : soyez positifs, mais que vos
tests soient négatifs. À bientôt !

2392
02:05:36,326 --> 02:05:37,721
C'est quoi, ça ?!

2393
02:05:39,549 --> 02:05:40,875
Un foutu bandana !

2394
02:05:42,451 --> 02:05:45,486
<i>Des milliers postulent,
mais seuls 18 sont choisis</i>

2395
02:05:45,611 --> 02:05:49,116
<i>pour être abandonnés aux Fidji
pour l'aventure d'une vie.</i>

2396
02:05:49,366 --> 02:05:52,470
<i>Il faut être solide pour s'engager
dans un truc aussi dingue.</i>

2397
02:05:52,595 --> 02:05:55,082
Alors... je suis prêt à invoquer
le rockeur en moi.

2398
02:05:56,722 --> 02:05:59,399
<i>Je veux être la première
gagnante d'origine perse</i>

2399
02:05:59,524 --> 02:06:02,430
de Survivor, car mon chou,
il est plus que temps.

2400
02:06:04,425 --> 02:06:06,282
<i>Dans la vie, on me trouve gentille.</i>

2401
02:06:06,407 --> 02:06:07,648
Mais ici ?

2402
02:06:08,163 --> 02:06:09,680
Je vais tout démolir !

2403
02:06:14,941 --> 02:06:16,459
<i>Qui se montrera capable</i>

2404
02:06:16,584 --> 02:06:20,347
<i>de déjouer, dominer et durer
plus que tous les autres ?</i>

2405
02:06:20,472 --> 02:06:23,246
J'y ai réfléchi : "Je devrais
postuler, je peux le faire."

2406
02:06:23,371 --> 02:06:25,407
Et maintenant...
Je suis là, je le fais.

2407
02:06:25,532 --> 02:06:26,543
Je le fais.

2408
02:06:26,901 --> 02:06:28,183
On le fait !

2409
02:06:32,269 --> 02:06:34,041
<i>Survivor 46.</i>

2410
02:06:34,625 --> 02:06:36,294
<i>En février prochain.</i>

2411
02:06:37,948 --> 02:06:39,389
Et voilà, c'est tout !

2412
02:06:39,514 --> 02:06:42,315
Enchérir sur des accessoires
de cette saison, de ces joueurs,

2413
02:06:42,440 --> 02:06:43,547
c'est possible.

2414
02:06:43,672 --> 02:06:45,513
Et si vous voulez être
dans Survivor...

2415
02:06:45,638 --> 02:06:48,249
Enfin, si Drew ne vous a pas
déjà convaincus,

2416
02:06:48,374 --> 02:06:50,240
vous ne voudrez sans doute pas.

2417
02:06:50,365 --> 02:06:53,500
Voilà, on se revoit au printemps
pour Survivor 46.

2418
02:06:53,625 --> 02:06:55,783
Allons signer cette beauté, allez !

2419
02:06:56,791 --> 02:06:57,791
Dee.

2420
02:06:58,073 --> 02:06:59,320
À vous l'honneur.

2421
02:06:59,570 --> 02:07:01,538
J'aurais dû travailler
ma foutue signature !

2422
02:07:01,663 --> 02:07:03,140
Il nous faut du champagne !

2423
02:07:04,952 --> 02:07:07,014
Tout le monde signe, allez !

2424
02:07:10,110 --> 02:07:13,408
Dee ! Ainsi s'achève Survivor 45.
Dites-le !

2425
02:07:13,621 --> 02:07:16,449
Et ainsi s'achève
la saison 45, bébé !

2426
02:07:22,444 --> 02:07:26,140
<font color="#fab419">Traduction :
FredoBsi, Scwarzy, Nov, Jack Bauer</font>

2427
02:07:26,265 --> 02:07:29,371
<font color="#fab419">Relecture et synchro :
Jack Bauer, Nov</font>

2428
02:07:29,496 --> 02:07:32,653
<font color="#fab419">Team Survivor-ST
https://survivor-st.variousforum.com</font>



## S46E13

1
00:00:00,000 --> 00:00:04,162
WWW.MY-SUBS.CO

﻿1
00:00:02,310 --> 00:00:04,720
Welcome to the season finale
of Survivor46.

2
00:00:04,750 --> 00:00:06,130
Well, it's been a fun

3
00:00:06,170 --> 00:00:08,510
and unpredictable season
of Survivor.

4
00:00:08,550 --> 00:00:10,310
We've had a lot
of strong players taken out--

5
00:00:10,340 --> 00:00:14,100
including six straight
blindsides-- forming our jury.

6
00:00:14,130 --> 00:00:17,510
We've had five players voted
out with idols in their pocket,

7
00:00:17,550 --> 00:00:18,960
including
the last four in a row.

8
00:00:19,000 --> 00:00:20,580
That's a record.

9
00:00:20,620 --> 00:00:24,340
And to date, it's been 23 days
they've gone without rice.

10
00:00:24,370 --> 00:00:26,000
Also a record.

11
00:00:26,030 --> 00:00:27,550
But now we're down to five.

12
00:00:27,580 --> 00:00:29,820
Tonight we'll have
two immunity challenges,

13
00:00:29,860 --> 00:00:32,610
two Tribal Councils,
one fire-making showdown.

14
00:00:32,650 --> 00:00:34,680
And then our final three
will face the jury

15
00:00:34,720 --> 00:00:37,860
and we will crown a winner
of Survivor46.

16
00:00:37,890 --> 00:00:39,580
We'll then immediately
go into the aftershow

17
00:00:39,620 --> 00:00:41,200
while we're still here
in beautiful Fiji

18
00:00:41,240 --> 00:00:43,170
and talk about it all.

19
00:00:43,200 --> 00:00:44,860
All right, our final five:

20
00:00:44,890 --> 00:00:47,310
Charlie, Maria, Ben,

21
00:00:47,340 --> 00:00:49,890
Liz and Kenzie.

22
00:00:49,930 --> 00:00:52,410
Who will be
this season's Sole Survivor

23
00:00:52,440 --> 00:00:55,100
and take home the check
for a million dollars?

24
00:00:55,130 --> 00:00:56,310
This is it.

25
00:00:56,340 --> 00:00:59,200
Season finale, Survivor46.

26
00:00:59,240 --> 00:01:01,620
♪

27
00:01:08,060 --> 00:01:09,480
Oh, my God.

28
00:01:10,480 --> 00:01:12,620
[laughing quietly]

29
00:01:12,650 --> 00:01:14,000
And behold.

30
00:01:17,890 --> 00:01:20,440
PROBST:
Previously onSurvivor...

31
00:01:20,480 --> 00:01:22,060
MARIA:
Hopefully, we get to
keep in touch

32
00:01:22,100 --> 00:01:24,060
-and be in each other's lives.
-Oh, my God, yeah.

33
00:01:24,100 --> 00:01:26,370
MARIA:
I adore Charlie so much,

34
00:01:26,410 --> 00:01:28,060
but right now,

35
00:01:28,100 --> 00:01:30,240
-he's standing in my way.
-CHARLIE: I am just

36
00:01:30,270 --> 00:01:32,580
so grateful to, like,
have you just in my life.

37
00:01:32,620 --> 00:01:34,440
I love her to death, but

38
00:01:34,480 --> 00:01:35,890
if I'm going to play to win,

39
00:01:35,930 --> 00:01:37,750
I have to vote her out.

40
00:01:37,790 --> 00:01:40,510
PROBST:
Maria down to her last piece.

41
00:01:40,550 --> 00:01:43,030
And there it is.

42
00:01:43,060 --> 00:01:44,580
Maria's done it.
Her third

43
00:01:44,620 --> 00:01:47,370
individual immunity win.

44
00:01:50,750 --> 00:01:52,820
BEN:
Now everybody's trying
to come together to take down

45
00:01:52,860 --> 00:01:54,720
the king and queen.

46
00:01:54,750 --> 00:01:57,170
-LIZ: Yeah, I love Charlie.
-Yeah.

47
00:01:57,200 --> 00:01:59,510
Maria thinks Liz and I
are gonna vote Charlie.

48
00:01:59,550 --> 00:02:01,240
-I knew this day would come.
-KENZIE: Yeah.

49
00:02:01,270 --> 00:02:03,960
But we're just bamboozling
Maria and Q.

50
00:02:04,000 --> 00:02:05,720
All right.

51
00:02:05,750 --> 00:02:07,130
Tonight is Charlie's
night to go,

52
00:02:07,170 --> 00:02:09,310
and I hope I get a hug.

53
00:02:10,340 --> 00:02:11,550
PROBST:
If anybody has an advantage

54
00:02:11,580 --> 00:02:12,820
or an idol
and you want to play it,

55
00:02:12,860 --> 00:02:15,340
now would be the time to do so.

56
00:02:16,680 --> 00:02:18,890
All right, I'll read the votes.

57
00:02:19,930 --> 00:02:21,170
Thirteenth person voted out

58
00:02:21,200 --> 00:02:25,030
and the sixth member
of our jury: Q.

59
00:02:25,060 --> 00:02:28,650
♪

60
00:02:28,680 --> 00:02:29,790
The tribe has spoken.

61
00:02:32,130 --> 00:02:35,790
Congratulations on making it
to the final five.

62
00:02:35,820 --> 00:02:39,030
One of you will claim the title
of Sole Survivor

63
00:02:39,060 --> 00:02:40,720
and the million dollars
that goes with it.

64
00:02:51,440 --> 00:02:53,480
♪

65
00:03:00,170 --> 00:03:02,440
[cracking]

66
00:03:06,550 --> 00:03:08,650
Charlie, can we go talk?

67
00:03:08,680 --> 00:03:11,340
Oh, yeah, of course.
Where you want to go?

68
00:03:13,890 --> 00:03:16,030
MARIA:
Oh, my God.

69
00:03:16,060 --> 00:03:18,440
I messed up.
I messed up tonight.

70
00:03:18,480 --> 00:03:20,890
I tried to take out Charlie,

71
00:03:20,930 --> 00:03:22,580
my closest ally.

72
00:03:22,620 --> 00:03:25,340
But my big move didn't pan out.

73
00:03:25,370 --> 00:03:27,550
And, yeah, I have to do,

74
00:03:27,580 --> 00:03:29,410
like, major damage control.

75
00:03:33,410 --> 00:03:35,790
-Yeah.
-...to tell me that
if I sat next to you at the end,

76
00:03:35,820 --> 00:03:37,550
I was never gonna win.

77
00:03:37,580 --> 00:03:40,860
They pitted me against you
and did a bait and switch

78
00:03:40,890 --> 00:03:43,240
and made me vote for you
so I look like an idiot,

79
00:03:43,270 --> 00:03:44,960
and now Q's gone.

80
00:03:45,000 --> 00:03:46,340
I'm, like, nauseated

81
00:03:46,370 --> 00:03:49,030
just trying
to explain myself to Charlie,

82
00:03:49,060 --> 00:03:51,100
and I'm really worried my

83
00:03:51,130 --> 00:03:54,440
best friend in the game
is never gonna forgive me,

84
00:03:54,480 --> 00:03:56,100
and my game is done.

85
00:03:56,130 --> 00:03:57,550
-That threesome
-Mm-hmm.

86
00:03:57,580 --> 00:03:59,480
-that's up there
is out to get us.
-Yeah.

87
00:03:59,510 --> 00:04:01,410
-MARIA: They messed up
the alliance
-Like...

88
00:04:01,440 --> 00:04:03,200
-No, no.
-I trusted the most
and now it's tainted.

89
00:04:03,240 --> 00:04:05,790
You know what? There's no reason
to call the party off.

90
00:04:05,820 --> 00:04:08,060
I still want to party, okay?

91
00:04:08,100 --> 00:04:10,480
Because we're down
to five people, and guess what?

92
00:04:10,510 --> 00:04:13,270
-We just got to think
how we're gonna play this.
-Okay.

93
00:04:13,310 --> 00:04:15,240
CHARLIE:
Final five

94
00:04:15,270 --> 00:04:17,750
by the skin of my teeth. Ooh!

95
00:04:17,790 --> 00:04:21,170
Maria, my number one ally,

96
00:04:21,200 --> 00:04:23,060
came for my throat.

97
00:04:23,100 --> 00:04:26,750
You know, it'd be easy for me
to be bitter and upset, but

98
00:04:26,790 --> 00:04:28,620
let's be real.
If she didn't win immunity,

99
00:04:28,650 --> 00:04:30,820
I was planning
on doing the same thing.

100
00:04:30,860 --> 00:04:32,960
I'm sorry.
God, I screwed up.

101
00:04:33,000 --> 00:04:34,480
-God.
-What the heck, Maria?

102
00:04:34,510 --> 00:04:35,620
-Man.
-What the heck?

103
00:04:35,650 --> 00:04:36,680

Maria

-[laughs]

110
00:04:51,170 --> 00:04:52,720

-CHARLIE: But

if one thing

113

114
00:04:58,340 --> 00:05:02,200

open, keep every option open,

115
00:05:02,240 --> 00:05:04,410
to get to the end and

116
00:05:04,440 --> 00:05:06,620

go for the million.

00:05:32,650 --> 00:05:35,790

128
00:05:35,820 --> 00:05:38,030

Yeah, I know.

00:05:38,060 --> 00:05:39,370

Maria says she finally

Just a face.

133
00:05:47,370 --> 00:05:49,720

136
00:05:53,510 --> 00:05:55,680

to let me win tomorrow?

137
00:05:57,130 --> 00:05:59,370
MARIA:
I am on the bottom, and

138
00:05:59,410 --> 00:06:02,310

there's a massive target on me.

00:06:02,340 --> 00:06:04,310
Winning tomorrow is imperative.

140
00:06:04,340 --> 00:06:07,960
Like, this is the time
to just, like, go for it,

141
00:06:08,000 --> 00:06:10,680

and hopefully

142
00:06:10,720 --> 00:06:13,510

143
00:06:13,550 --> 00:06:15,680
♪

00:06:17,860 --> 00:06:20,270
♪

145
00:06:49,960 --> 00:06:52,130
♪

00:07:21,790 --> 00:07:23,820
♪

00:07:40,930 --> 00:07:42,680
Come on in!

148
00:07:50,510 --> 00:07:53,510
Mighty fierce-looking
final five.

00:07:54,510 --> 00:07:56,130
Going back to day one,

00:07:56,170 --> 00:07:58,270

this five.

151
00:07:58,310 --> 00:08:00,310
No, no.

152
00:08:00,340 --> 00:08:02,410
But here we are.

153
00:08:04,790 --> 00:08:07,820

00:08:07,860 --> 00:08:09,750

00:08:09,790 --> 00:08:11,750

156
00:08:11,790 --> 00:08:13,960

00:08:14,000 --> 00:08:15,000

Whoa.

159
00:08:19,000 --> 00:08:20,410

160
00:08:20,440 --> 00:08:22,340
All right,
for today's challenge,

161
00:08:22,370 --> 00:08:25,200

162
00:08:26,620 --> 00:08:29,100
Once you're through,

You'll then cross that bridge

166
00:08:39,440 --> 00:08:42,000

Once you've finished

168
00:08:45,930 --> 00:08:49,060

00:08:55,930 --> 00:08:57,890
First person

173
00:09:06,170 --> 00:09:09,860

At the very least,
you're making fire

00:09:11,410 --> 00:09:13,930

00:09:25,370 --> 00:09:27,000

182
00:09:27,030 --> 00:09:29,270

-garlic bread,

183
00:09:29,310 --> 00:09:31,030

184
00:09:31,060 --> 00:09:32,410

185
00:09:32,440 --> 00:09:34,650

00:09:46,550 --> 00:09:49,030

00:15:31,790 --> 00:15:33,790

00:15:33,820 --> 00:15:35,550

303
00:15:35,580 --> 00:15:37,930

00:15:40,480 --> 00:15:43,270

305
00:15:43,310 --> 00:15:45,340
Maria trying

306
00:15:52,890 --> 00:15:54,580
PROBST:

318
00:16:30,480 --> 00:16:32,790

PROBST:
No!

00:16:49,270 --> 00:16:51,170

00:17:02,510 --> 00:17:04,480

00:17:10,750 --> 00:17:12,340

00:17:14,340 --> 00:17:16,510

00:17:16,550 --> 00:17:18,370
KENZIE:
Maria.

00:17:18,410 --> 00:17:20,000

00:17:20,030 --> 00:17:23,680
Wow.
Another unpredictable moment

00:17:23,720 --> 00:17:26,890

00:17:26,930 --> 00:17:29,680

00:17:29,720 --> 00:17:31,480

you're incredible, Maria.

00:17:55,170 --> 00:17:57,310

-At the very least,

00:17:57,340 --> 00:17:59,060

-you got a shot at making fire.

00:18:08,270 --> 00:18:11,030

356
00:18:16,130 --> 00:18:19,410
Maria, it is one of the most
interesting facets of Survivor--

Maria's a great player.

597
00:28:17,030 --> 00:28:19,550
I still think
she is the MVP of the season.

598
00:28:19,580 --> 00:28:22,130
But no hard feelings.

599
00:28:22,170 --> 00:28:23,480
We all have to outlast,

600
00:28:23,510 --> 00:28:25,680
outplay, outwit, outshred,
whatever it is.

601
00:28:25,720 --> 00:28:28,130
The bottom line is
we have to play the game.

602
00:28:28,170 --> 00:28:30,790
PROBST:
Kenzie, what Ben
is saying is that

603
00:28:30,820 --> 00:28:32,750
you do develop relationships,

604
00:28:32,790 --> 00:28:35,170
and sometimes
they become like this,

605
00:28:35,200 --> 00:28:36,920
but then sometimes they do this.

606
00:28:36,960 --> 00:28:38,750
Doesn't mean you can't
play the game with somebody,

607
00:28:38,790 --> 00:28:40,750
but it does mean
if I have the opportunity

608
00:28:40,790 --> 00:28:42,550
to take you out, I might.

609
00:28:42,580 --> 00:28:44,680
And it sounds like Ben
is saying, "I have no problem

610
00:28:44,720 --> 00:28:46,410
writing
Maria's name down tonight."

611
00:28:46,440 --> 00:28:48,130
-Am I getting this right?
-Yeah, definitely.

612
00:28:48,170 --> 00:28:50,130
KENZIE:
Yeah. Maria's incredible.

613
00:28:50,170 --> 00:28:51,960
Like, an amazing woman.

614
00:28:51,990 --> 00:28:53,920
-Thank you.
-KENZIE: I admire you.
I respect you.

615
00:28:53,960 --> 00:28:55,510
I love you deeply.

616
00:28:55,550 --> 00:28:58,300
And that is what's
crazy about Survivor,

617
00:28:58,340 --> 00:29:00,550
is that I can look someone
in the face and be like,

618
00:29:00,580 --> 00:29:03,960
"You could kick my ass
up and down this game."

619
00:29:03,990 --> 00:29:07,720
So I have to write
your name down tonight.

620
00:29:07,750 --> 00:29:09,820
-I totally understand.
-KENZIE: Because...

621
00:29:10,820 --> 00:29:13,550
...you would beat all of us.

622
00:29:13,580 --> 00:29:14,720
You're amazing.

623
00:29:15,920 --> 00:29:17,820
-You are wonderful.
-Thank you, Kenzie.

624
00:29:17,860 --> 00:29:19,890
-I love you.
-I love you, too.

625
00:29:21,990 --> 00:29:25,100
Liz, Ben and Kenzie
have been very open.

626
00:29:25,130 --> 00:29:28,270
They're voting Maria.
So, where are you?

627
00:29:28,300 --> 00:29:30,790
I'm just ready
to focus on the game.

628
00:29:30,820 --> 00:29:32,510
Sometimes I'm like
a horse with blinders on.

629
00:29:32,550 --> 00:29:36,170
When I was helping Kenzie
with the puzzle today,

630
00:29:36,200 --> 00:29:39,550
I wasn't thinking
about Maria's feelings.

631
00:29:39,580 --> 00:29:42,410
Afterwards, I was definitely
thinking about her feelings

632
00:29:42,440 --> 00:29:44,820
and what a jerk I looked like.

633
00:29:44,860 --> 00:29:46,820
And so it's really hard,

634
00:29:46,860 --> 00:29:49,610
but Maria and I, we're like

635
00:29:49,650 --> 00:29:51,820
two ships passing in the night.
Like,

636
00:29:51,860 --> 00:29:55,300
we could have been the, like,
most dynamic duo out here,

637
00:29:55,340 --> 00:29:58,750
but for some reason, instead
of attracting each other,

638
00:29:58,790 --> 00:30:01,990
we just kept getting further and
further apart with each vote.

639
00:30:02,030 --> 00:30:04,580
Charlie, where are you
with Maria?

640
00:30:04,610 --> 00:30:06,580
Yeah, so...

641
00:30:06,610 --> 00:30:09,580
Maria and I have worked

642
00:30:09,610 --> 00:30:12,440
really side by side
a lot of this game.

643
00:30:12,480 --> 00:30:14,440
We've got 24 days together.

644
00:30:14,480 --> 00:30:16,440
You know,
you have people that you

645
00:30:16,480 --> 00:30:18,960
build these insane bonds with,

646
00:30:18,990 --> 00:30:20,920
and then you have to
vote each other out.

647
00:30:20,960 --> 00:30:23,820
Tonight, it's almost like
a sibling rivalry moment.

648
00:30:25,820 --> 00:30:29,440
PROBST:
Maria, from my vantage point,
you've been very gracious

649
00:30:29,480 --> 00:30:32,510
about handling this pressure
and having a target

650
00:30:32,550 --> 00:30:34,960
and even having them
double-team,

651
00:30:34,990 --> 00:30:36,300
trying to get at you.

652
00:30:36,340 --> 00:30:38,750
How are you able
to play the game

653
00:30:38,790 --> 00:30:40,230
as hard as you've played
but also understand,

654
00:30:40,270 --> 00:30:41,440
"You're coming for me.

655
00:30:41,480 --> 00:30:42,890
If you can get me,
you should get me."

656
00:30:42,920 --> 00:30:45,480
Um, I think any competitor

657
00:30:45,510 --> 00:30:47,750
knows how to win
and knows how to lose.

658
00:30:47,790 --> 00:30:50,300
And I can honor and respect

659
00:30:50,340 --> 00:30:53,860
any move that takes down
a fierce competitor like myself.

660
00:30:53,890 --> 00:30:55,750
There's also

661
00:30:55,790 --> 00:30:58,030
the knowledge that
my kids are watching.

662
00:30:58,060 --> 00:31:00,200
My kids are watching tonight.

663
00:31:00,230 --> 00:31:03,200
You know? And I plan
on walking out of here

664
00:31:03,230 --> 00:31:04,650
with my head held high.

665
00:31:04,680 --> 00:31:07,580
[sniffles] I'm proud of myself,
I'm proud of my game,

666
00:31:07,610 --> 00:31:09,820
and I know that they're
gonna be proud of me.

667
00:31:09,860 --> 00:31:11,580
And being ungracious-- like,

668
00:31:11,610 --> 00:31:13,510
that's not
what I want them to do.

669
00:31:13,550 --> 00:31:16,580
And so I'm going to be
an example to them.

670
00:31:16,610 --> 00:31:18,960
PROBST:
Where does that come from?

671
00:31:18,990 --> 00:31:22,480
I guess it comes
from my upbringing.

672
00:31:22,510 --> 00:31:24,440
You know, I'm-I'm an immigrant.

673
00:31:24,480 --> 00:31:26,650
I come from Beirut, Lebanon, and

674
00:31:26,680 --> 00:31:28,410
you know, I grew up

675
00:31:28,440 --> 00:31:31,920
with, I guess,
an environment of survival.

676
00:31:31,960 --> 00:31:34,990
You know, work hard,
be determined

677
00:31:35,030 --> 00:31:37,060
and to be honest
and to be respectful

678
00:31:37,100 --> 00:31:39,750
and to be gracious
and to be humble.

679
00:31:39,790 --> 00:31:42,200
And I think to myself,

680
00:31:42,230 --> 00:31:44,370
"My husband and I
are raising three boys,

681
00:31:44,410 --> 00:31:46,580
"and Daddy is strong as hell.

682
00:31:46,610 --> 00:31:48,370
But you know what?
Mommy is, too."

683
00:31:51,890 --> 00:31:54,300
PROBST:
Well, it's a tough
transition to make,

684
00:31:54,340 --> 00:31:56,440
but it is time to vote.

685
00:31:56,480 --> 00:31:58,230
Maria, you're up.

686
00:32:01,890 --> 00:32:04,720
♪

687
00:32:10,550 --> 00:32:12,860
I literally want
to be you when I grow up.

688
00:32:12,890 --> 00:32:15,300
You're the coolest person
in the whole world,

689
00:32:15,340 --> 00:32:16,990
which is exactly
why this is happening,

690
00:32:17,030 --> 00:32:19,720
because you literally would
have wiped the floor with us.

691
00:32:19,750 --> 00:32:21,580
Like, you're amazing.

692
00:32:27,370 --> 00:32:29,680
♪

693
00:32:39,170 --> 00:32:40,920
Listen up, future nephews.

694
00:32:40,960 --> 00:32:44,030
Your mom kicks butt.

695
00:32:51,580 --> 00:32:53,790
♪

696
00:32:53,820 --> 00:32:55,720
I'll go tally the votes.

697
00:33:01,200 --> 00:33:03,230
♪

698
00:33:06,720 --> 00:33:10,060
If anybody has an advantage or
an idol and you want to play it,

699
00:33:10,100 --> 00:33:11,750
now would be the time to do so.

700
00:33:17,410 --> 00:33:19,920
All right.
I'll read the votes.

701
00:33:23,550 --> 00:33:24,920
First vote: Ben.

702
00:33:24,960 --> 00:33:26,300
Let's go!

703
00:33:26,340 --> 00:33:27,550
[laughing]

704
00:33:29,650 --> 00:33:30,890
Maria.

705
00:33:30,920 --> 00:33:32,440
One vote Ben, one vote Maria.

706
00:33:36,550 --> 00:33:39,300
Maria. Two votes Maria,
one vote Ben.

707
00:33:44,340 --> 00:33:46,170
Fourteenth person voted out

708
00:33:46,200 --> 00:33:48,230
and the seventh member
of our jury: Maria.

709
00:33:48,270 --> 00:33:50,860
That's three. That's enough.
Need to bring me your torch.

710
00:33:51,860 --> 00:33:53,550
Good job, Maria.

711
00:33:58,550 --> 00:34:00,440
Bring it in, Lieutenant Mom.

712
00:34:00,480 --> 00:34:02,270
LIZ:
I want a hug.

713
00:34:04,340 --> 00:34:05,610
Thank you.

714
00:34:14,200 --> 00:34:16,750
♪

715
00:34:21,720 --> 00:34:24,030
Maria, the tribe has spoken.

716
00:34:24,060 --> 00:34:25,820
Thank you.

717
00:34:25,860 --> 00:34:28,370
It's been a pleasure, you guys.
Love you.

718
00:34:28,410 --> 00:34:30,990
-We love you, Maria. [whooping]
-MVP.

719
00:34:31,030 --> 00:34:32,790
-[Liz whoops]
-Bye.

720
00:34:34,890 --> 00:34:36,920
♪

721
00:34:37,890 --> 00:34:39,410
[mouths]

722
00:34:46,270 --> 00:34:49,720
Congratulations on
making it to the final four.

723
00:34:50,750 --> 00:34:53,960
Tomorrow, you'll compete in
your final immunity challenge.

724
00:34:53,990 --> 00:34:57,100
Grab your torches.
Head back to camp. Good night.

725
00:34:57,130 --> 00:34:59,030
Oh, wow.

726
00:35:05,170 --> 00:35:06,720
You know what?

727
00:35:06,750 --> 00:35:08,230
I feel amazing.

728
00:35:08,270 --> 00:35:10,550
I played such a good game.

729
00:35:10,580 --> 00:35:14,410
I'm 47 and, you know,
I smoked some of these guys.

730
00:35:14,440 --> 00:35:17,960
It felt really good
to know that, at my age,

731
00:35:17,990 --> 00:35:21,230
at my stage of life,
like, I still got it.

732
00:35:28,340 --> 00:35:30,610
♪

733
00:35:33,790 --> 00:35:35,410
BEN:
So...

734
00:35:35,440 --> 00:35:37,860
-Final four!
-Final four!
-[screams]

735
00:35:37,890 --> 00:35:39,410
Oh, yeah!

736
00:35:39,440 --> 00:35:41,440
[all whooping]

737
00:35:41,480 --> 00:35:43,550
CHARLIE: Come here, Meemaw.

738
00:35:43,580 --> 00:35:46,960
-Let's go!
-[whooping]

739
00:35:46,990 --> 00:35:49,890
LIZ:
Holy hot dog on a stick,
I made it.

740
00:35:49,920 --> 00:35:53,340
Ta-frigging-da, baby.

741
00:35:53,370 --> 00:35:57,100
Final four feels amazing.
But honestly,

742
00:35:57,130 --> 00:35:58,580
I knew it was gonna happen.

743
00:35:58,610 --> 00:35:59,610
BEN: Congrats to y'all.

744
00:36:02,100 --> 00:36:03,680
LIZ: It was.

745
00:36:03,720 --> 00:36:06,170
CHARLIE:
As sweet as it is
being in the final four,

746
00:36:06,200 --> 00:36:07,270
Tribal was hard.

747
00:36:07,300 --> 00:36:09,680
I knew if I was going to have

748
00:36:09,720 --> 00:36:13,200
a shot at this title,
Maria couldn't be there with me.

749
00:36:13,230 --> 00:36:14,270
LIZ: Oh, my God.

750
00:36:17,230 --> 00:36:19,610
-Yeah, that's a lot of power.
-LIZ: It's a lot of power.

751
00:36:19,650 --> 00:36:22,790
CHARLIE:
This whole game,
I've been all about options,

752
00:36:22,820 --> 00:36:26,030
and, tomorrow,
the only way to have options

753
00:36:26,060 --> 00:36:27,580
is to win.

754
00:36:27,610 --> 00:36:29,550
You have
to be wearing the necklace.

755
00:36:29,580 --> 00:36:31,580
Otherwise you're at the mercy

756
00:36:31,610 --> 00:36:33,750
of whoever is wearing it.

757
00:36:38,270 --> 00:36:40,300
♪

758
00:36:44,920 --> 00:36:47,580
BEN:
[panting rapidly] Aah!

759
00:36:55,230 --> 00:36:57,030
BEN: At night,
I don't know what happens.

760
00:36:57,060 --> 00:37:00,580
Some nights, I have
a reason why I freak out,

761
00:37:00,610 --> 00:37:02,960
but last night, I had all the
reason in the world to chill--

762
00:37:02,990 --> 00:37:05,230
you know, I had a reward,

763
00:37:05,270 --> 00:37:06,920
we got Maria out.

764
00:37:06,960 --> 00:37:09,170
But I have this hysteria,

765
00:37:09,200 --> 00:37:11,790
and I have to calm down
for a minute. It takes a while.

766
00:37:21,720 --> 00:37:25,440
BEN: It's weird.
It's like I wake up from a drem

767
00:37:25,480 --> 00:37:27,270
and this jolt of electricity

768
00:37:27,300 --> 00:37:29,550
bumps me up like Beetlejuice.

769
00:37:32,860 --> 00:37:36,410
-I've been suffering since,
like, day 13 or whatever.
-I know.

770
00:37:36,440 --> 00:37:38,750
[panting]

771
00:37:38,790 --> 00:37:41,270
-KENZIE: Ben, is that you?
-Yeah.

772
00:37:41,300 --> 00:37:42,990
-Hold my hand just a little bit.
-KENZIE: I'm right here.

773
00:37:46,060 --> 00:37:48,300
Ah. Yeah.

774
00:37:48,340 --> 00:37:50,610
I need water.

775
00:37:52,750 --> 00:37:55,750
I feel like I don't
stand a chance, you know?

776
00:37:59,100 --> 00:38:01,790
I thought I went into this game

777
00:38:01,820 --> 00:38:04,270
really having conquered
some of my demons, but...

778
00:38:04,300 --> 00:38:05,960
the big lesson
for me in life is

779
00:38:05,990 --> 00:38:07,680
how do you let go

780
00:38:07,720 --> 00:38:10,030
of trying to control
what you can't?

781
00:38:10,060 --> 00:38:11,860
And how do you trust in yoursef

782
00:38:11,890 --> 00:38:15,130
and believe in who you are
despite your fears?

783
00:38:22,510 --> 00:38:23,680
Yeah.

784
00:38:23,720 --> 00:38:25,550
But at the same time,

785
00:38:25,580 --> 00:38:27,820
I feel very blessed because

786
00:38:27,860 --> 00:38:29,270
people show up for me.

787
00:38:29,300 --> 00:38:30,510
They believe in me.

788
00:38:30,550 --> 00:38:32,440
Anti-anxiety hug.

789
00:38:33,680 --> 00:38:35,230
We got you, bro.

790
00:38:35,270 --> 00:38:36,580
BEN:
To me, it just
comes down to, like,

791
00:38:36,610 --> 00:38:38,170
I went through it.

792
00:38:38,200 --> 00:38:40,100
I didn't quit.

793
00:38:40,130 --> 00:38:42,060
And thank God
I had Kenzie and Charlie.

794
00:38:52,340 --> 00:38:54,860
♪

795
00:39:02,990 --> 00:39:05,270
♪ Tree mail, tree mail♪

796
00:39:05,300 --> 00:39:07,030
♪ Where do you get your news♪

797
00:39:07,060 --> 00:39:08,990
BOTH:
♪ Tree mail, tree mail♪

798
00:39:09,030 --> 00:39:10,480
♪ Gathering all the clues♪

799
00:39:10,510 --> 00:39:11,680
♪ Yow!♪

800
00:39:11,720 --> 00:39:14,200
-CHARLIE: This is intense.
-BEN: I know.

801
00:39:14,230 --> 00:39:15,200
Siga!

802
00:39:15,230 --> 00:39:16,200
[both exclaim]

803
00:39:16,230 --> 00:39:17,510
Let's go.

804
00:39:17,550 --> 00:39:18,580
-Dude.
-Dude.

805
00:39:18,610 --> 00:39:20,130
The last two Siga.

806
00:39:20,170 --> 00:39:22,030
The first pair remaining.

807
00:39:22,060 --> 00:39:24,750
-Dumb and Dumber, baby.
-Let go!

808
00:39:24,790 --> 00:39:27,920
CHARLIE:
I've been with Ben
since day one.

809
00:39:27,960 --> 00:39:30,550
You know, we started
the Dumb and Dumber alliance

810
00:39:30,580 --> 00:39:32,610
after we botched
the Savvy challenge.

811
00:39:32,650 --> 00:39:34,680
We've become more than friends.

812
00:39:34,720 --> 00:39:36,170
Friends doesn't cut it anymore.

813
00:39:36,200 --> 00:39:38,270
-You want to read it?
-I'll read it. Sure.

814
00:39:38,300 --> 00:39:40,510
-Dude, these beads
are sick, too.
-These are sick. Thank you.

815
00:39:40,550 --> 00:39:42,610
CHARLIE:
Problem is, you know,

816
00:39:42,650 --> 00:39:46,030
this is the pinnacle
of theSurvivor dilemma.

817
00:39:46,060 --> 00:39:48,920
We're friends,
but we're friends going to war.

818
00:39:58,370 --> 00:40:00,130
-Ooh...
-Ooh...

819
00:40:00,170 --> 00:40:03,270
-Last immunity challenge.
-Let's go!

820
00:40:03,300 --> 00:40:05,300
KENZIE:
Final four.

821
00:40:05,340 --> 00:40:06,920
I mean, I'm in.

822
00:40:06,960 --> 00:40:08,370
[laughing]

823
00:40:08,410 --> 00:40:11,990
The final four challenge
is the most important challenge

824
00:40:12,030 --> 00:40:13,680
of the entire game.

825
00:40:13,720 --> 00:40:16,200
Especially for me,
because I'm so nervous

826
00:40:16,230 --> 00:40:17,860
about fire-making.

827
00:40:17,890 --> 00:40:19,820
I have this
really weird condition

828
00:40:19,860 --> 00:40:22,340
where the ligaments on my wrist

829
00:40:22,370 --> 00:40:24,680
are too big for my body.

830
00:40:24,720 --> 00:40:27,790
And so my joints are constantly
popping in and out of place.

831
00:40:27,820 --> 00:40:29,300
[popping]

832
00:40:30,550 --> 00:40:33,060
So I haven't been
practicing fire very much

833
00:40:33,100 --> 00:40:35,480
because my hand
starts cramping up

834
00:40:35,510 --> 00:40:37,960
and I don't want to look like
a complete dum-dum.

835
00:40:37,990 --> 00:40:39,030
Ugh!

836
00:40:40,030 --> 00:40:41,170
There we go.

837
00:40:41,200 --> 00:40:42,790
There you go, Benny. Nice job.

838
00:40:42,820 --> 00:40:45,580
LIZ:
I'm getting this feeling
that everyone thinks

839
00:40:45,610 --> 00:40:47,990
Liz is the number one threat.

840
00:40:48,030 --> 00:40:49,410
We definitely need to throw her

841
00:40:49,440 --> 00:40:50,790
into fire.

842
00:40:50,820 --> 00:40:52,580
I've never had
my name written down.

843
00:40:52,610 --> 00:40:53,580
I have four

844
00:40:53,610 --> 00:40:55,680
Nami members on the jury.

845
00:40:55,720 --> 00:40:59,130
And so if I make it
to the final three,

846
00:40:59,170 --> 00:41:02,990
I can literally
see Jeff with the parchment.

847
00:41:03,030 --> 00:41:04,410
"The winner is Liz."

848
00:41:04,440 --> 00:41:06,300
[whoops]

849
00:41:06,340 --> 00:41:08,300
I hope I win this immunity.

850
00:41:08,340 --> 00:41:09,610
Otherwise,

851
00:41:09,650 --> 00:41:11,750
I got to make fire.
I just know it.

852
00:41:16,580 --> 00:41:18,580
♪

853

For today's challenge,

00:42:38,890 --> 00:42:41,580

880
00:42:41,610 --> 00:42:45,340

881
00:42:47,060 --> 00:42:48,720
-Yeah, right.
-Catch?
-[laughs]

883
00:42:51,060 --> 00:42:54,340
PROBST:
You're gonna have a timer
in the form of a giant

884
00:42:54,370 --> 00:42:57,510
Survivor pinball table.
Here's how it works.

885
00:42:57,550 --> 00:43:00,960
You're gonna start by rolling

its way back down the ramp,

890

891

892
00:43:11,060 --> 00:43:13,680

893
00:43:13,720 --> 00:43:16,270

894
00:43:16,300 --> 00:43:18,230

895
00:43:18,270 --> 00:43:20,170

896
00:43:20,200 --> 00:43:23,170
And during that time,
you can't work on your puzzle.

897
00:43:23,200 --> 00:43:26,610
So during this entire challeng,
your focus is going to be spli,

898

899

900
00:43:35,030 --> 00:43:36,130
You're still in.

901
00:43:36,170 --> 00:43:37,510
-Yeah, that's sick.
-Just whoever

00:43:37,550 --> 00:43:38,860

-Yeah.

903
00:43:38,890 --> 00:43:40,270

-BEN: Hey, I have...

I barely slept
more than two hours a night

906
00:43:44,990 --> 00:43:46,410
-for, like, 14 days.

907
00:43:46,440 --> 00:43:48,580
And it's, like, been

908
00:43:48,610 --> 00:43:51,340
the most intense time

909

910
00:43:53,580 --> 00:43:54,890
That's it.

911
00:43:54,920 --> 00:43:57,410

912
00:43:57,440 --> 00:43:58,790
-Yeah, let's do it.
-Oh, yeah.
-Yeah.

922
00:44:19,610 --> 00:44:23,480

next to you in that second spot

923

Biggest challenge of the season.

925
00:44:31,580 --> 00:44:33,580
-We'll draw her spots.
-[whoops]

926
00:44:33,610 --> 00:44:35,920
-PROBST: Get it on. Here we go.

-[exclaims]

927
00:44:39,890 --> 00:44:42,610
♪

929
00:44:45,890 --> 00:44:49,790

931

You've got to roll that ball

937

941

Kenzie heading back. Charlie
heading back. Ben heading back.

942

Kenzie with another roll.

943
00:45:33,170 --> 00:45:35,130
She's good.

944
00:45:36,200 --> 00:45:37,230
Charlie's good.

945

Ben has his ball.

946
00:45:41,340 --> 00:45:42,410
Ben's good.

947

955
00:46:09,960 --> 00:46:12,130

956

957

Giving an advantage

958

Day 25, Survivor46.

00:46:22,170 --> 00:46:24,750

962
00:46:34,100 --> 00:46:36,650
Kenzie doing

964

965

Every single second

981

Charlie trying

983

984

985
00:47:46,650 --> 00:47:47,890
KENZIE:
Whoops.

Kenzie suffering

996
00:48:16,750 --> 00:48:19,920
Something so simple,

997
00:48:19,960 --> 00:48:23,030

998
00:48:23,060 --> 00:48:25,920
Charlie races back

999

1000
00:48:27,270 --> 00:48:29,680
Charlie back to work

1001
00:48:29,720 --> 00:48:32,230
Kenzie with another
piece on her puzzle.

1002
00:48:32,270 --> 00:48:34,510
Kenzie races back,
saves her ball.

1003
00:48:36,860 --> 00:48:39,440
She's got it. Kenzie's

1004
00:48:39,480 --> 00:48:41,130
It's now Ben in the lead.

1005
00:48:41,170 --> 00:48:43,510
He's yet
to win an immunity challenge.

1006
00:48:43,550 --> 00:48:44,580

1007
00:48:44,610 --> 00:48:46,170
He's put everything on

1008

1009

Kenzie, right behind, fresh

1014

That ball clanks.

1015
00:49:07,370 --> 00:49:10,990
It is Kenzie and Ben

1016
00:49:11,030 --> 00:49:13,650

1017
00:49:13,680 --> 00:49:16,100

1018
00:49:17,170 --> 00:49:19,230
This is gonna

1020
00:49:23,060 --> 00:49:25,170

1023

1026

1028
00:49:41,230 --> 00:49:44,300
Kenzie trying to find another
piece. She's got to race back.

1029

Kenzie's got to get it here.

1030

1031

She's got it!
Kenzie down to three pieces.

1032
00:49:51,100 --> 00:49:53,300

1033
00:49:53,340 --> 00:49:57,100

1034
00:49:57,130 --> 00:49:58,890

1035

1036
00:50:01,610 --> 00:50:02,790

00:50:06,370 --> 00:50:08,440

Guaranteed a spot

1042
00:50:19,130 --> 00:50:20,750

All right!

00:50:28,890 --> 00:50:31,230

1045
00:50:31,270 --> 00:50:32,750

1047

1048
00:50:39,720 --> 00:50:41,920

Ben, come on over.

-CHARLIE: Let's go, buddy.

1050
00:50:43,200 --> 00:50:44,230

1051

Dude, I thought

1052

1053
00:50:49,270 --> 00:50:52,170
Ben, your first individual

1054

1055
00:50:55,170 --> 00:50:58,100

1058
00:51:02,990 --> 00:51:06,410

you say,

1064
00:51:16,440 --> 00:51:18,720
and which of the other two
are gonna have to make fire

1065
00:51:18,750 --> 00:51:19,960
to earn that third spot.

1066
00:51:19,990 --> 00:51:22,440
Yeah, it's, uh...
a little wild.

1067
00:51:22,480 --> 00:51:25,890
I found it remarkable, given
that just a few minutes ago,

1068
00:51:25,920 --> 00:51:29,030

"I'm so distracted.

1069
00:51:29,060 --> 00:51:30,750
-I can't focus."
-Yeah.

1070
00:51:30,790 --> 00:51:33,820
And you get a challenge
that requires split focus.

1071
00:51:33,860 --> 00:51:36,550
And of all four,
you had the most focus.

1072
00:51:36,580 --> 00:51:38,680
It was clear.
Where did that come from?

1073
00:51:38,720 --> 00:51:40,370
What is that inside you
that you,

1074
00:51:40,410 --> 00:51:43,230
when you need to,
you can get that gear?

1075
00:51:43,270 --> 00:51:46,100
Today, I was just like,
"I have to show up for me,"

1076
00:51:46,130 --> 00:51:48,370
'cause I'm always trying
to be somebody's hype man.

1077
00:51:48,410 --> 00:51:50,060
And at, like,
1:00 in the morning, I'm like,

1078
00:51:50,100 --> 00:51:53,650
"It's okay, dude. I love you.
You came this far."

1079
00:51:53,680 --> 00:51:55,650
And when I got here,
and I was like, "Wow.

1080
00:51:55,680 --> 00:51:57,200
It's like a pachinko machine
or something."

1081
00:51:57,230 --> 00:51:58,820
-It brought out,
like, the little kid in me.
-Mm.

1082
00:51:58,860 --> 00:52:01,440
And I live to be my inner child.

1083
00:52:01,480 --> 00:52:02,820
That's why I'm in a rock band.

1084
00:52:02,860 --> 00:52:03,960
You know what I'm saying?

1085
00:52:03,990 --> 00:52:04,960
And this was, like,

1086
00:52:04,990 --> 00:52:06,920
the most meditational,

1087
00:52:06,960 --> 00:52:09,410
transcendental
shred-itation game

1088
00:52:09,440 --> 00:52:11,170
of the entire season.

1089
00:52:11,200 --> 00:52:13,370
So I just was in the moment,

1090
00:52:13,410 --> 00:52:14,820
and I didn't
think about anything else.

1091
00:52:14,860 --> 00:52:16,440
-All right.
-I know that's a word scramble,

1092
00:52:16,480 --> 00:52:18,060
-but that's how my brain is.
-It was beautiful.

1093
00:52:18,100 --> 00:52:19,510
No, it was beautiful.

1094
00:52:19,550 --> 00:52:21,990
You found meditation
where everybody else saw chaos.

1095
00:52:22,030 --> 00:52:23,510
-BEN: Yeah.
-PROBST: All right.

1096
00:52:23,550 --> 00:52:25,410
You are safe.
You're in the final three.

1097
00:52:25,440 --> 00:52:27,820
-Crazy.
-Busy afternoon,
I'm imagining, back at camp,

1098
00:52:27,860 --> 00:52:30,270

will all be

1099
00:52:30,300 --> 00:52:31,860

1100
00:52:31,890 --> 00:52:34,200

Grab your stuff. Head out.

1101
00:52:34,230 --> 00:52:35,550
I'll see you all tonight
at Tribal Council.

1102
00:52:35,580 --> 00:52:37,370
-Can I give you a hug, though?
-Give me a hug, brother.

1103
00:52:37,410 --> 00:52:39,030
-OTHERS: Aw...
-All right!

1104
00:52:39,060 --> 00:52:40,580
-PROBST: Congrats. Well done.
-BEN: Thanks, Jeff.

1105
00:52:40,610 --> 00:52:42,580

-[exhales]

1106
00:52:42,610 --> 00:52:44,550
-LIZ: Good job, brother.
-BEN: Let's do it.

1107
00:52:44,580 --> 00:52:46,860
I was so down on myself,

1108

when I was at my lowest,

1109
00:52:49,580 --> 00:52:50,960

1110

And for some reason,

1111
00:52:52,610 --> 00:52:54,650
the determination just came out

1112

and then I won immunity.

1113

It's so sick.

1114
00:52:58,440 --> 00:53:01,130
13-year-old me,
who got made fun of

1115

told I wouldn't get anywhere.

1116

Who's gonna be able
to tell me what now, dude?

1117
00:53:14,100 --> 00:53:16,130
♪

1118

Dare I say it, Ben--
you rocked it.

1119
00:53:31,860 --> 00:53:33,650

-Yeah, Ben.

1120
00:53:33,680 --> 00:53:35,480
-Cowabunga.
-Who rocks?

1121
00:53:35,510 --> 00:53:36,650
-You rock.
-You rock.

1122
00:53:36,680 --> 00:53:38,920
CHARLIE:
You're the man of the hour.

1123
00:53:38,960 --> 00:53:41,060
BEN:
Well, listen, I know
we all want to get into it,

1124
00:53:41,100 --> 00:53:42,820
but I'm gonna be honest,
like, I don't have...

1125
00:53:42,860 --> 00:53:45,650
-No, no. We want to rest, dude.
-Okay. Okay.

1126
00:53:45,680 --> 00:53:47,580
Yeah, you can collect your
thoughts. Do whatever you need.

1127
00:53:47,610 --> 00:53:49,990
This is what I think about
the other two. No, I'm kidding.

1128
00:53:50,030 --> 00:53:51,860
I'm so proud of myself.

1129

Nobody would call me

1130
00:53:53,990 --> 00:53:56,130
I was the kid
they didn't pick for dodgeball.

1131
00:53:56,170 --> 00:53:57,300
You know what I'm saying?

1132
00:53:57,340 --> 00:53:59,720
CHARLIE:
Soak this moment in.

1133
00:53:59,750 --> 00:54:01,750
King Ben!

1134
00:54:01,790 --> 00:54:03,820
♪

1135
00:54:08,890 --> 00:54:11,750
Yes. So sick.

1136

1137

Wearing this necklace,
as aSurvivor fan,

1138
00:54:17,300 --> 00:54:19,270

"Damn, I did it."

1139

To hear Jeff just say,

1140

like, that's crazy.

1141

You know?
After all my panic attacks

1142

1143

it's just a confirmation.

1144

When in doubt, if you rock out,

1145
00:54:33,170 --> 00:54:35,230

1146

the weight of winning hit me.

1147
00:54:42,440 --> 00:54:45,170
I'm in the final three,

1148
00:54:45,200 --> 00:54:47,170

1150

go at it in fire.

1151

1152

So I feel like, no matter what,

1153

1154
00:55:01,990 --> 00:55:03,820
Some people
are in different situations.

1155

1156

Yeah, I mean, obviously,
I'm very close with Kenzie,

1157

like, my day one.

1158
00:55:10,370 --> 00:55:11,960
And, uh...

1159

I think you kind of
unintentionally played

1160

1161

-I mean, I'm super flattered.
-Yeah.

1162
00:55:18,370 --> 00:55:20,270
I mean, I feel like that's why

1163

1167

1168

1171

-I'm a millionaire.

1172
00:55:41,410 --> 00:55:42,440

1173

I think
I'm the most broke person

you know?

1175

She was like, "I got money.
I just want to make it further"

1176

I'm broke,

1177
00:55:50,920 --> 00:55:53,790
you know? Like, I share a space
with my parents.

1178

So, to me,
it just confirmed that

1179

1180

Yeah, well, I'm out.

1181

1182

-[wrists popping]
-Yeah.

1183

1184
00:56:09,370 --> 00:56:11,410

1185

was a threat. Now, she's here.

1186

1187

-Sure.
-If you don't want one,

1188

So, now the thing
I got to think about

1189

put up against Liz.

1190

Always down to rip it up.
I'm here, okay?

1191
00:56:26,270 --> 00:56:27,300
Okay.

1192
00:56:29,100 --> 00:56:31,130
♪

1193

1195

1196

Ben just told me,

1197

the hardest game."

1198

1199
00:57:00,580 --> 00:57:02,410

1200
00:57:02,440 --> 00:57:03,890
I knew the fire-making

1201

1202
00:57:06,680 --> 00:57:09,920
My friggin' loose-ass wrists

1203

1204
00:57:12,720 --> 00:57:15,510
But I'm not...
I'm not gonna give up.

1205

I guess I need to practice fir.

1206
00:57:17,960 --> 00:57:20,300
It's like,
I'm having a hard time...

1207

-...picking between you and him.
-I know.

1208
00:57:24,270 --> 00:57:25,960
Charlie's my day one.

1209

But it's like,
you are also equally

1210

1211

So then it just comes down
to who can beat Liz.

1212
00:57:33,230 --> 00:57:34,580
-Yeah.
-And who you want

1213
00:57:34,610 --> 00:57:36,580

-I know.

1214

-It's okay.

1215

whatever choice you make.

1216

1217

This season,
my fire-making's been great.

1218
00:57:46,200 --> 00:57:47,580
So, tonight,

1219

1220

Yes.

1221

1222
00:57:53,510 --> 00:57:55,580
Positives going
into fire against Liz

1223

is I think I can beat her.
Another positive is that

1224
00:57:58,200 --> 00:58:00,510
it would be great for my résum,
but it doesn't

1225

make it any less

1226

Like, I'm still freaking out,

1227
00:58:04,340 --> 00:58:05,860

1228

But for all I know,
Ben could be like,

1229

make Charlie do it."

1230

♪

1235

1236
00:58:30,170 --> 00:58:31,410
Yeah.
You want to have a chat?

1237

Yeah.
What's going on, dude?

1238

All's good.
It's a heavy decision.

1239

Yeah. What's... Talk me

1240
00:58:37,790 --> 00:58:39,200
You sit.
Pop a squat.

1241
00:58:39,230 --> 00:58:41,790
BEN:
It's like, I know
I want to put Liz in.

1242
00:58:41,820 --> 00:58:42,790
CHARLIE:
Yeah.

1243
00:58:42,820 --> 00:58:45,230
And it's like, I don't know

1244
00:58:45,270 --> 00:58:47,030

between you and Kenzie.

1245
00:58:47,060 --> 00:58:48,030

1246
00:58:48,060 --> 00:58:49,340
She's practicing.

1247
00:58:49,370 --> 00:58:51,580
-Isn't she good?
-Truth is, you're kicking

1248
00:58:51,610 --> 00:58:53,720

1249

You're seeing one right here,

1250
00:58:55,270 --> 00:58:57,270
-but I've been
kind of struggling, too.
-Yeah.

1251

CHARLIE:
Yeah, the competitor in me
is like,

1252
00:58:59,030 --> 00:59:00,860

1253

But the other part of me
just says,

1254

fire-making on my résumé.

1255

I don't really
want it on my résumé."

1256

And it makes me
want to just say,

1257

1258

At the end of the day, would...

1261

1263

'Cause I know you're

1264

1265
00:59:25,230 --> 00:59:26,410
I need to get

1266

1267

1268

1270

CHARLIE:
Ben has all the power today.

1271
00:59:36,510 --> 00:59:37,580
His goal

1272

1273

1274

but, you know, fire is fluky,

1275
00:59:44,030 --> 00:59:46,750

1276

All it takes

1277
00:59:51,790 --> 00:59:53,820
♪

1278

1279
01:00:02,200 --> 01:00:03,300

1280

I feel like
I know how to do this,

1281

I don't know how to do it.

1282
01:00:07,300 --> 01:00:08,960
Ben was like, "Oh, my gosh.

1283
01:00:08,990 --> 01:00:11,270
"There's absolutely no way

1285

1286
01:00:15,610 --> 01:00:18,370

1287
01:00:21,510 --> 01:00:23,680

1288

Wow, I'm on

1289
01:00:26,860 --> 01:00:28,410
You can do it,

1290

1291
01:00:32,230 --> 01:00:34,030
I will not be beaten.

1292
01:00:34,060 --> 01:00:35,580
[groans]

1293

CHARLIE:
Is that Liz yelling?

1294

She just, like,

1295
01:00:39,990 --> 01:00:42,100
Okay, I'm feeling better.

1296
01:00:42,130 --> 01:00:44,920

1297
01:00:44,960 --> 01:00:47,480
Oh, yeah, baby. Oh, yeah.

1298

Just make a couple jokes,

1299
01:00:50,610 --> 01:00:52,550
Yay.

1300

♪

1301

KENZIE:
I'm feeling scared.

1302

Yeah, I-I know...
I-I know I can make fire.

1303

I've done it

1304
01:01:06,580 --> 01:01:08,550

like, cracking under pressure.

1305
01:01:09,890 --> 01:01:12,130
I can't get anything
to catch on fire, and, like...

1306
01:01:12,170 --> 01:01:14,170
Ugh. I just
need to get it together.

1307
01:01:14,200 --> 01:01:16,650
Oh, my gosh, I'm doing it...

1308
01:01:21,860 --> 01:01:24,030
KENZIE:
This is, like,
the pressure point, but...

1309
01:01:24,060 --> 01:01:26,550

I'm gonna face it head-on.

1310
01:01:27,580 --> 01:01:29,860
And I'm gonna give it my all,
even though I'm scared.

1311
01:01:31,610 --> 01:01:33,650
I know I can do this.
I can do this.

1312
01:01:35,820 --> 01:01:37,440
CHARLIE:
This is it.

1313
01:01:37,480 --> 01:01:39,990
After tonight,
the final three is set.

1314
01:01:40,030 --> 01:01:42,610
The weight of that pressure--
it's suffocating.

1315
01:01:42,650 --> 01:01:44,230
Oh, yes, baby.

1316
01:01:46,440 --> 01:01:47,820
Did you make your choice?

1317
01:01:49,060 --> 01:01:51,270
BEN:
I'm trying to figure out
who I think has

1318
01:01:51,300 --> 01:01:53,370

1319
01:01:53,410 --> 01:01:55,130
That's what I'm talking about.

1320
01:01:55,170 --> 01:01:57,170
Dude, you crushed it.

1321
01:01:57,200 --> 01:01:58,860
Charlie's really good at fire,

1322
01:01:58,890 --> 01:02:01,300
but the hardest part is

1323
01:02:01,340 --> 01:02:03,860
Charlie's been my number one
from day one.

1324
01:02:03,890 --> 01:02:06,300
I love the kid.

1325
01:02:07,680 --> 01:02:09,680
And the other side is Kenzie.

1326
01:02:09,720 --> 01:02:12,200
She's been one of the best
friends I made out here,

1327
01:02:12,230 --> 01:02:15,230
and she's been my number one
through my panic attacks.

1328
01:02:15,270 --> 01:02:16,820
She's been a sweetheart.

1329
01:02:16,860 --> 01:02:17,990
There you go, Kenzie.

1330
01:02:18,030 --> 01:02:19,410
I don't know how I'm gonna

1331
01:02:19,440 --> 01:02:21,480
lean one over the other.

1332
01:02:23,440 --> 01:02:24,890
I have to think wisely.

1333
01:02:24,920 --> 01:02:26,750
It's heavy, bro.
I'm stuck between

1334
01:02:26,790 --> 01:02:29,550

1335
01:02:29,580 --> 01:02:32,440
♪

1336
01:02:40,750 --> 01:02:42,790
♪

1337
01:02:51,580 --> 01:02:52,610
[quietly exclaims]

1338
01:02:55,860 --> 01:02:57,340
BEN:
'Sup, Jeff.

1339
01:02:57,370 --> 01:02:58,610
CHARLIE:
Jeff.

1340
01:03:01,790 --> 01:03:04,100
♪

1341
01:03:08,480 --> 01:03:10,100
PROBST:
All right.

1342
01:03:10,130 --> 01:03:12,580
We get to our final
immunity challenge.

1343
01:03:12,610 --> 01:03:14,030

1344
01:03:14,060 --> 01:03:17,410

logo puzzle in front of you.

1345
01:03:17,440 --> 01:03:19,410
But there was a twist.
Ben,

1346
01:03:19,440 --> 01:03:21,130
you were the only person
that didn't

1347
01:03:21,170 --> 01:03:23,410
make any mistakes
in the challenge.

1348
01:03:23,440 --> 01:03:26,300
Explain that, because
you walked in and said,

1349
01:03:26,340 --> 01:03:28,550
"I am all over the place today,"

1350
01:03:28,580 --> 01:03:30,410
and yet something
crystallized, and you were

1351
01:03:30,440 --> 01:03:31,860
perfect in that challenge.

1352
01:03:31,890 --> 01:03:33,990
BEN:
You know, I didn't
go into that challenge

1353
01:03:34,030 --> 01:03:35,720
expecting to win.

1354
01:03:35,750 --> 01:03:38,510
I said that 'cause it was true.
I haven't been able to sleep.

1355
01:03:38,550 --> 01:03:40,510
Night terrors, panic attacks.

1356
01:03:40,550 --> 01:03:43,720
It's just very, very brutal.

1357
01:03:43,750 --> 01:03:46,340
For some reason, today,
I just decided

1358
01:03:46,370 --> 01:03:48,580
to say, "This is it.
I'm just gonna go for it."

1359
01:03:48,610 --> 01:03:52,200
I don't know. I had a blast.
It just came together.

1360
01:03:52,230 --> 01:03:54,580
PROBST:
Charlie, you were
in it for a while,

1361
01:03:54,610 --> 01:03:57,440
but a couple of mistakes
cost you this challenge.

1362
01:03:57,480 --> 01:04:00,060
What did you reflect on
this afternoon?

1363
01:04:00,100 --> 01:04:02,750
Today's immunity challenge
is potentially

1364
01:04:02,790 --> 01:04:04,580
the one with the most power
of the season.

1365
01:04:04,610 --> 01:04:06,920
Ben's, of course, safe tonight,

1366
01:04:06,960 --> 01:04:09,300
but tonight he can do
whatever the heck he wants.

1367
01:04:09,340 --> 01:04:11,200
So...

1368
01:04:11,230 --> 01:04:13,790
it was a lot of reflecting,

1369
01:04:13,820 --> 01:04:15,820
but there's not much
time for reflection

1370
01:04:15,860 --> 01:04:18,030
when all I was really doing

1371
01:04:18,060 --> 01:04:20,030
was making fires all day.

1372
01:04:20,060 --> 01:04:21,580
Kenzie, you were very close.

1373
01:04:21,610 --> 01:04:23,790
Would have been your third
individual immunity win.

1374
01:04:23,820 --> 01:04:26,790
You, too, had issues,
not with getting the ball late,

1375
01:04:26,820 --> 01:04:28,580
but with just
getting the ball up the ramp,

1376
01:04:28,610 --> 01:04:31,750
and those few extra tosses
were the difference.

1377
01:04:31,790 --> 01:04:33,750
You were a few pieces behind.

1378
01:04:33,790 --> 01:04:35,440
Yeah, I was three pieces behind.

1379
01:04:35,480 --> 01:04:37,030
And they will probably
haunt me forever.

1380
01:04:37,060 --> 01:04:40,440
Like, crumbles. I'm happy
for my friend, but here we are.

1381
01:04:41,480 --> 01:04:43,860
Liz, what was
your experience today?

1382
01:04:43,890 --> 01:04:46,480
"Liz, you're the biggest threat.

1383
01:04:46,510 --> 01:04:48,480
"You're definitely
going to fire.

1384
01:04:48,510 --> 01:04:49,820
I don't know
who's going against you."

1385
01:04:49,860 --> 01:04:51,860
-Yeah.
-LIZ: And then I just

1386
01:04:51,890 --> 01:04:55,580
fell apart,
'cause I suck at fire.

1387
01:04:55,610 --> 01:04:58,130
And, um, I knew this was

1388
01:04:58,170 --> 01:04:59,720
the one hole in my game.

1389
01:04:59,750 --> 01:05:03,030
And I'm gonna go to fire.
I mean,

1390
01:05:03,060 --> 01:05:04,340
he's totally right.

1391
01:05:04,370 --> 01:05:05,510
I've never
had my name written down,

1392
01:05:05,550 --> 01:05:07,440
so, he's smarter than he looks.

1393
01:05:07,480 --> 01:05:09,480
-[chuckles]
-So, Ben, you had
one easy decision.

1394
01:05:09,510 --> 01:05:11,370
-You knew Liz, immediately.
-Yeah.

1395
01:05:11,410 --> 01:05:13,820
So then the debate became

1396
01:05:13,860 --> 01:05:15,510
Kenzie or Charlie.

1397
01:05:15,550 --> 01:05:17,100
Yeah. And when it

1398
01:05:17,130 --> 01:05:19,410
came down to
Kenzie and Charlie, I mean,

1399
01:05:19,440 --> 01:05:21,370
Charlie's the first friend
I made out here.

1400
01:05:21,410 --> 01:05:23,480
I know that's not great
when it comes to

1401
01:05:23,510 --> 01:05:25,270
talking about your strategy, but

1402
01:05:25,300 --> 01:05:27,680
if somebody can give you
a little bit of kindness,

1403
01:05:27,720 --> 01:05:30,820
it goes a long way, whether
they know it or not. And

1404
01:05:30,860 --> 01:05:34,030
the hard part is
my friendship with Kenzie

1405
01:05:34,060 --> 01:05:37,270
is very similar, except
I only met Kenzie at the merge.

1406
01:05:37,300 --> 01:05:40,170
But I'd say her impact
on me feeling sane--

1407
01:05:40,200 --> 01:05:43,060
it's like, I can't...
I can't oversell it.

1408
01:05:43,100 --> 01:05:45,510
Like, I'm playing Survivor,

1409
01:05:45,550 --> 01:05:47,650
but I'm hanging out with
my homies and having, like,

1410
01:05:47,680 --> 01:05:49,550
a real human experience
that, like,

1411
01:05:49,580 --> 01:05:51,580
you know, it sucks that

1412
01:05:51,610 --> 01:05:53,580
I have to make this decision.

1413
01:05:53,610 --> 01:05:56,510
PROBST:
So, Ben, are you ready
to tell us your decision?

1414
01:06:00,440 --> 01:06:02,680
So, it's gonna
be Liz and Kenzie tonight

1415
01:06:02,720 --> 01:06:04,750
going at it for fire.

1416
01:06:08,230 --> 01:06:10,550
♪

1417
01:06:12,370 --> 01:06:13,960
PROBST:
Which means, Charlie,

1418
01:06:13,990 --> 01:06:15,680
you made it to the final three.

1419
01:06:15,720 --> 01:06:17,030
You will take that second spot.

1420
01:06:17,060 --> 01:06:19,960
This is what you dream of,

1421
01:06:19,990 --> 01:06:21,480
because
getting to the final three

1422
01:06:21,510 --> 01:06:23,720
is as much as any player can do.

1423
01:06:23,750 --> 01:06:25,820
You've gone as far as
you can go. What's the feeling?

1424
01:06:25,860 --> 01:06:28,510
CHARLIE:
I'm grateful to Ben,
you know, in this moment.

1425
01:06:28,550 --> 01:06:31,480
Because of the relationship
and the bond that we've built,

1426
01:06:31,510 --> 01:06:33,200
he's gonna take me
to the final three.

1427
01:06:33,230 --> 01:06:36,130
And getting there with that bond

1428
01:06:36,170 --> 01:06:38,860
means just as much to me
as making fire.

1429
01:06:38,890 --> 01:06:40,610
PROBST:
Kenzie, what's it like
to hear that

1430
01:06:40,650 --> 01:06:44,410
when you can hear a little bit
of emotion in Ben's voice,

1431
01:06:44,440 --> 01:06:46,170
and he's very clearly saying,

1432
01:06:46,200 --> 01:06:48,580
"It wasn't easy for me because

1433
01:06:48,610 --> 01:06:49,790
of love and friendship"?

1434
01:06:49,820 --> 01:06:52,410
KENZIE:
Yeah. There is emotion. Like,

1435
01:06:52,440 --> 01:06:54,510
we have, like,
fallen in love with each other,

1436
01:06:54,550 --> 01:06:55,790
and it's so complicated.

1437
01:06:55,820 --> 01:06:57,270
But at the same time,

1438
01:06:57,300 --> 01:06:59,230
as annoyed as I am
that I have to do this,

1439
01:06:59,270 --> 01:07:02,610
I am grateful that I'm not
getting my name written down

1440
01:07:02,650 --> 01:07:04,860
and that I get a chance

1441
01:07:04,890 --> 01:07:06,960
to try, you know?
That's exciting.

1442
01:07:06,990 --> 01:07:08,170
[laughs]

1443
01:07:08,200 --> 01:07:10,300
We're gonna
give it our all, baby.

1444
01:07:10,340 --> 01:07:11,990
It's down to the ladies tonight.

1445
01:07:12,030 --> 01:07:14,410
[chuckles]
Like, it is what it is.

1446
01:07:14,440 --> 01:07:16,410
All right, it is time

1447
01:07:16,440 --> 01:07:17,890
for the final four
fire-making challenge.

1448
01:07:17,920 --> 01:07:21,100
The winner will take the third
and final spot at our final

1449
01:07:21,130 --> 01:07:24,130
Tribal Council.
Kenzie, Liz...

1450
01:07:24,170 --> 01:07:25,720
take your spots.

1451
01:07:27,060 --> 01:07:28,890
♪

1452
01:07:40,510 --> 01:07:43,480
All right. So, you both
have the same fire-making kit.

1453
01:07:43,510 --> 01:07:45,960
In seasons past,
we have sent this kit

1454
01:07:45,990 --> 01:07:47,990
out to your camp
so you could practice.

1455
01:07:48,030 --> 01:07:50,750
We did not do that this season.
This is new to you.

1456
01:07:50,790 --> 01:07:53,480
All you had
was a knife and a flint.

1457
01:07:53,510 --> 01:07:56,200
So, forget about
setting a record.

1458
01:07:56,230 --> 01:07:58,510
This is about being faster
than the other person.

1459
01:07:59,510 --> 01:08:01,720
Who can make fire fastest

1460
01:08:01,750 --> 01:08:03,480
and get it to burn hot enough,

1461
01:08:03,510 --> 01:08:05,230
long enough
to burn through that rope?

1462
01:08:05,270 --> 01:08:07,230
That's what
we're gonna find out.

1463
01:08:07,270 --> 01:08:10,410
The person who does that
will make it to the final three.

1464
01:08:11,370 --> 01:08:12,920
Are you both ready?

1465
01:08:12,960 --> 01:08:14,920
-Ugh. No.
-[chuckles]

1466
01:08:14,960 --> 01:08:16,860
This is as good as it's gonna
get, Jeff. [chuckles]

1467
01:08:16,890 --> 01:08:19,340
-Liz?
-Okay.

1468
01:08:19,370 --> 01:08:21,790
All right.
This challenge is on.

1469
01:08:21,820 --> 01:08:23,510
Begin.

1470
01:08:24,990 --> 01:08:27,550
Takes three things to make fire.

1471
01:08:27,580 --> 01:08:29,440
You need heat.

1472
01:08:29,480 --> 01:08:31,990
You're gonna get that heat
by striking your flint,

1473
01:08:32,030 --> 01:08:34,130
trying to get a spark,
some friction.

1474
01:08:34,170 --> 01:08:36,300
Then you need fuel.

1475
01:08:36,340 --> 01:08:38,960
That's gonna
be kindling or some hessian.

1476
01:08:38,990 --> 01:08:41,170
And then once you get a flame,
you need oxygen.

1477
01:08:41,200 --> 01:08:43,230
You got to let it breathe,
so it can get big enough

1478
01:08:43,270 --> 01:08:45,300
to burn through that rope.

1479
01:08:46,610 --> 01:08:47,960
Okay.

1480
01:08:47,990 --> 01:08:49,130
Liz going for a spark.

1481
01:08:55,510 --> 01:08:57,440
Liz has a baby flame.

1482
01:09:02,370 --> 01:09:03,340
Fudge.

1483
01:09:03,370 --> 01:09:05,060
No fire yet.

1484
01:09:11,060 --> 01:09:14,680
Kenzie, a lot of prep.
Unusual approach.

1485
01:09:19,610 --> 01:09:20,650
Oh, my God.

1486
01:09:22,860 --> 01:09:25,510
PROBST:
Liz, a lot of spark.

1487
01:09:28,790 --> 01:09:30,890
And a little bit of a flame.

1488
01:09:32,680 --> 01:09:33,990
Aw...

1489
01:09:34,960 --> 01:09:36,890
It dies.

1490
01:09:36,920 --> 01:09:39,820
25 days of fatigue
and the pressure.

1491
01:09:39,860 --> 01:09:42,270
This could literally be

1492
01:09:42,300 --> 01:09:44,960
a million-dollar fire
you are making right now.

1493
01:09:44,990 --> 01:09:46,030
Oh.

1494
01:10:01,300 --> 01:10:03,340
What is happening?

1495
01:10:03,370 --> 01:10:05,680
It's pressure. Keep digging.

1496
01:10:05,720 --> 01:10:07,820
You're both in it, clearly.

1497
01:10:12,230 --> 01:10:13,440
Okay.

1498
01:10:19,370 --> 01:10:20,920
-Oh, my...
-Kenzie.

1499
01:10:21,960 --> 01:10:24,550
PROBST:
Kenzie's got
a little bit of a flame.

1500
01:10:25,920 --> 01:10:27,300
Now she's got to nurture it.

1501
01:10:27,340 --> 01:10:30,650
It's got to breathe.
Don't want to suffocate it.

1502
01:10:33,100 --> 01:10:35,790
Now Liz has
a little bit of a flame.

1503
01:10:38,680 --> 01:10:40,550
And out.

1504
01:10:40,580 --> 01:10:43,170
Kenzie still working.

1505
01:10:43,200 --> 01:10:45,610
So long as
she doesn't smother it.

1506
01:10:50,720 --> 01:10:51,750
Ow.

1507
01:10:53,060 --> 01:10:55,510
PROBST: Kenzie continues
to nurture that fire.

1508
01:10:55,550 --> 01:10:56,550
Oh, God.

1509
01:11:05,270 --> 01:11:08,920
PROBST: Liz now has flame.
Can she get this one to stick?

1510
01:11:10,410 --> 01:11:11,610
No.

1511
01:11:11,650 --> 01:11:13,060
[groans]

1512
01:11:13,100 --> 01:11:15,550
PROBST:
Kenzie's fire starting
to take now.

1513
01:11:15,580 --> 01:11:17,410
Medium-sized fire.

1514
01:11:17,440 --> 01:11:19,580
Now it's starting to just

1515
01:11:19,610 --> 01:11:21,750
light the fibers of that rope.

1516
01:11:25,680 --> 01:11:27,680
It's really going now.

1517
01:11:27,720 --> 01:11:29,650
That's burning that rope.

1518
01:11:30,890 --> 01:11:32,580
-Oh, my God.
-PROBST: That is a fire

1519
01:11:32,610 --> 01:11:34,820
that's gonna get you a spot
in the final three.

1520
01:11:37,370 --> 01:11:39,610
-And there it is.
Kenzie's done it.
-Oh, my God!

1521
01:11:39,650 --> 01:11:41,890
PROBST:
She has earned the final spot

1522
01:11:41,920 --> 01:11:43,860
-at the final three...
-Oh...

1523
01:11:43,890 --> 01:11:45,860
-Come on, you knew
you were winning that.
-Oh...

1524
01:11:45,890 --> 01:11:49,060
PROBST:
...with Ben and Charlie and a
shot at the million-dollar prize

1525
01:11:49,100 --> 01:11:50,370
that goes along with it.

1526
01:11:52,860 --> 01:11:53,860
Thanks, babe.

1527
01:11:53,890 --> 01:11:55,440
Yeah. Of course.

1528
01:11:57,410 --> 01:11:59,440
♪

1529
01:12:04,480 --> 01:12:05,440
Boo.

1530
01:12:05,480 --> 01:12:07,680
Tomato, tomato.

1531
01:12:07,720 --> 01:12:10,580
PROBST:
Kenzie, let's start with you.
Congratulations.

1532
01:12:10,610 --> 01:12:12,100
Thank you so much.

1533
01:12:12,130 --> 01:12:13,550
-PROBST: You've
made the final three,
-Amazing.

1534
01:12:13,580 --> 01:12:15,130
-Thank you.
-you earned your way in.

1535
01:12:15,170 --> 01:12:16,790
What is the feeling right now?
I know it's been

1536
01:12:16,820 --> 01:12:18,370
-an emotional 25 days.
-[Kenzie exhales]

1537
01:12:18,410 --> 01:12:20,370
Yeah, I mean, I...

1538
01:12:20,410 --> 01:12:22,720
I've been
at the bottom since Yanu,

1539
01:12:22,750 --> 01:12:25,650
and I've been earning it
the whole way,

1540
01:12:25,680 --> 01:12:27,720
so it just made sense.

1541
01:12:27,750 --> 01:12:30,030
And it's so ironic
that we set the record

1542
01:12:30,060 --> 01:12:33,230
for the longest time
without flint, and...

1543
01:12:33,270 --> 01:12:35,370
Earlier today, when I couldn't
catch a fire, I was like,

1544
01:12:35,410 --> 01:12:37,170
"Of course my journey's
gonna end without fire.

1545
01:12:37,200 --> 01:12:38,230
It started without fire."

1546
01:12:38,270 --> 01:12:40,610
But I redeemed myself
with that today.

1547
01:12:41,960 --> 01:12:44,100
It's just really overwhelming.

1548
01:12:44,130 --> 01:12:46,230
Like, my... I couldn't
get a flame all day today.

1549
01:12:46,270 --> 01:12:50,100
So my confidence was shot.
I was like, "Well, you know..."

1550
01:12:50,130 --> 01:12:52,820
I'm just very grateful.
I earned it.

1551
01:12:54,860 --> 01:12:58,440
Liz, I know you've had
some very fun times

1552
01:12:58,480 --> 01:13:00,650
and you've had
some very low lows.

1553
01:13:00,680 --> 01:13:03,410
What's the big takeaway
from this journey?

1554
01:13:03,440 --> 01:13:06,920
You learn
so much about yourself,

1555
01:13:06,960 --> 01:13:09,680
and the game is so much bigger

1556
01:13:09,720 --> 01:13:11,650
than you think it is.

1557
01:13:11,680 --> 01:13:12,650
[sniffles]

1558
01:13:12,680 --> 01:13:16,370
But I am very proud of my game.

1559
01:13:17,960 --> 01:13:20,820
It was really over for you guys.
It really was.

1560
01:13:22,510 --> 01:13:24,060
[sniffles]

1561
01:13:25,060 --> 01:13:27,720
I would've beat all of you.

1562
01:13:28,720 --> 01:13:30,410
[sniffles]

1563
01:13:30,440 --> 01:13:31,990
All right, Liz.

1564
01:13:32,030 --> 01:13:34,510
You become the eighth
and final member

1565
01:13:34,550 --> 01:13:35,990
-of our jury.
-I know it.

1566
01:13:36,030 --> 01:13:37,790
You need to grab your torch.

1567
01:13:43,340 --> 01:13:46,130
♪

1568
01:13:47,610 --> 01:13:48,580
[sniffles]

1569
01:13:48,610 --> 01:13:50,170
Love you, Liz.

1570
01:13:50,200 --> 01:13:51,890
I'll love you tomorrow.

1571
01:13:51,920 --> 01:13:54,580
-[laughs]: Take your time, mama.
-LIZ: No, I love you now.

1572
01:13:54,610 --> 01:13:57,410
Oh, God bless America.

1573
01:13:57,440 --> 01:13:59,550
-Liz, the tribe has spoken.
-[groans softly]

1574
01:14:01,820 --> 01:14:03,860
Time for you to go.

1575
01:14:07,230 --> 01:14:08,550
[sniffles]

1576
01:14:09,510 --> 01:14:11,550
♪

1577
01:14:13,680 --> 01:14:16,650
Kenzie, Ben, Charlie,
congratulations.

1578
01:14:16,680 --> 01:14:18,960
You made it to the final three.

1579
01:14:18,990 --> 01:14:22,340
Now, the power in the game
shifts to the jury.

1580
01:14:22,370 --> 01:14:23,720
They decide who wins.

1581
01:14:23,750 --> 01:14:25,580
Tomorrow night,
you will face them

1582
01:14:25,610 --> 01:14:29,440
and each of you will
have a chance to persuade them

1583
01:14:29,480 --> 01:14:33,060
that it's you that deserves
the title of Sole Survivor

1584
01:14:33,100 --> 01:14:35,860
and the million dollars that
goes along with it. You have

1585
01:14:35,890 --> 01:14:38,300
one more night here
in beautiful Fiji. Enjoy it.

1586
01:14:38,340 --> 01:14:40,960
Try to get some sleep.
You know you're gonna need it.

1587
01:14:40,990 --> 01:14:42,580
Grab your torches.
Head back to camp.

1588
01:14:42,610 --> 01:14:45,550
-I'll try, okay?
-Good night.

1589
01:14:45,580 --> 01:14:47,060
♪

1590
01:14:56,720 --> 01:14:58,230
So close.

1591
01:14:58,270 --> 01:15:00,960
So pissed. [laughs]

1592
01:15:00,990 --> 01:15:03,100
I made it 25 days.

1593
01:15:03,130 --> 01:15:06,340
I did everything
I thought that I would do.

1594
01:15:06,370 --> 01:15:07,890
I really think

1595
01:15:07,920 --> 01:15:10,230
I would have won, but...

1596

01:33:17,240 --> 01:33:18,890
They are one and the same.
I know

2071
01:33:18,930 --> 01:33:21,580
they're supposed to be separate,
but I'm a people person.

2072
01:33:21,620 --> 01:33:23,030
I've had deep conversations
with each of you.

2073
01:33:23,060 --> 01:33:25,030
I've, like, held half of you

2074
01:33:25,060 --> 01:33:27,240
while you've cried
about various things. Like,

2075
01:33:27,270 --> 01:33:29,720
yeah, I got
brought along on votes.

2076
01:33:29,750 --> 01:33:31,750
That's how I ended up here.

2077
01:33:31,790 --> 01:33:33,930
-I'll take it. I'll own it.
It's true.
-TIFFANY: Time.

2078
01:33:33,960 --> 01:33:35,480
-I'm not gonna say
I drove a vote. Okay.
-SODA: Time.

2079
01:33:35,510 --> 01:33:37,620
Nice ownership. Thank you.
Charlie?

2080
01:33:37,650 --> 01:33:39,310
CHARLIE:
Maria and I were
partners in crime

2081
01:33:39,340 --> 01:33:42,340
for a lot of the game,
but by the time

2082
01:33:42,370 --> 01:33:44,340
Maria was winding back her fist

2083
01:33:44,370 --> 01:33:45,820
to throw a punch at me,

2084
01:33:45,860 --> 01:33:47,860
I had already
put the pieces in place

2085
01:33:47,890 --> 01:33:49,580
that were setting up her demise.

2086
01:33:49,620 --> 01:33:52,440
I put together the four
that protected me

2087
01:33:52,480 --> 01:33:56,100
from the punch that you and Q
threw at me at final six,

2088
01:33:56,130 --> 01:33:59,030
and ultimately voted both of you
out of the game

2089
01:33:59,060 --> 01:34:01,550
at six and at five,
exactly how I designed

2090
01:34:01,580 --> 01:34:03,030
after the Tiffany vote.

2091
01:34:03,060 --> 01:34:04,930
I thought that I needed...

2092
01:34:04,960 --> 01:34:06,410
-to differentiate...
-Time.
-Time.

2093
01:34:06,440 --> 01:34:09,310
-Ben?
-Oh, yeah. I mean,
I'll definitely agree.

2094
01:34:09,340 --> 01:34:12,240
I'm probably
the most emotional person,

2095
01:34:12,270 --> 01:34:13,820
most "cries in this game"
this season,

2096
01:34:13,860 --> 01:34:15,650
but that's what

2097
01:34:15,680 --> 01:34:17,790
I had to do, and it crushed me

2098
01:34:17,820 --> 01:34:20,060
that I felt I came
into the merge with this plan

2099
01:34:20,100 --> 01:34:22,170
that got wrecked, and

2100
01:34:22,200 --> 01:34:23,790
I was very fortunate

2101
01:34:23,820 --> 01:34:26,030
that how emotional I was
opened the doors

2102
01:34:26,060 --> 01:34:27,580
to make friendships and bonds

2103
01:34:27,620 --> 01:34:29,620
that allowed me
to be part of moves

2104
01:34:29,650 --> 01:34:31,720
that I wanted to be part of.
And, yeah,

2105
01:34:31,750 --> 01:34:34,340
I openly admitted
I was a goat for a few votes.

2106
01:34:34,370 --> 01:34:37,860
But when the turn came
to not be that, the only way

2107
01:34:37,890 --> 01:34:39,130
-that would have happened...
-Time.

2108
01:34:39,170 --> 01:34:40,620
-SODA: Time.
-Yeah. Cool.

2109
01:34:40,650 --> 01:34:42,480
Thank you all so much.
I know that was hard, um,

2110
01:34:42,510 --> 01:34:44,240
-but you all did great.
-BEN: All good.

2111
01:34:44,270 --> 01:34:47,620
Q, you haven't asked a question.

2112
01:34:47,650 --> 01:34:51,270
All righty.
The most important thing

2113
01:34:51,310 --> 01:34:54,580

2114
01:34:54,620 --> 01:34:57,720
What do you plan

2115
01:34:57,750 --> 01:34:59,720

your life?

2116
01:34:59,750 --> 01:35:02,270
-Ben?
-Um, you know, I'm a musician.

2117
01:35:02,310 --> 01:35:03,820
I get a lot
of great things in my life,

2118
01:35:03,860 --> 01:35:05,820
but I don't make a lot of money.

2119
01:35:05,860 --> 01:35:08,720
I want to give my parents
some sort of retirement

2120
01:35:08,750 --> 01:35:10,310
'cause they're hardworking
immigrants

2121
01:35:10,340 --> 01:35:12,240
that always put food
on the table

2122
01:35:12,270 --> 01:35:14,370
and weren't around
because of how hard they worked.

2123
01:35:14,410 --> 01:35:16,720
And at the same time,
I want to join up

2124
01:35:16,750 --> 01:35:19,750
with my best friend's
nonprofit program and help bring

2125
01:35:19,790 --> 01:35:22,720
