in South Florida.

2126
01:35:22,750 --> 01:35:25,410
It's an initiative I've already
been a part of called

2127
01:35:25,440 --> 01:35:27,340
Young Musicians Unite.

2128
01:35:27,370 --> 01:35:29,750
And having an artistic
expression for kids is a way

2129
01:35:29,790 --> 01:35:32,310
for them to feel comfortable
with who they are,

2130
01:35:32,340 --> 01:35:35,030
which is something
I had to learn the hard way

2131
01:35:35,060 --> 01:35:37,480
'cause nobody gave me that
opportunity when I was a kid.

2132
01:35:37,510 --> 01:35:39,270
Q:
Thank you, Ben.

2133
01:35:39,310 --> 01:35:41,480
-Charlie?
-CHARLIE: Yeah, so,

2134
01:35:41,510 --> 01:35:43,960
number one: family is more
important to me than anything.

2135
01:35:44,000 --> 01:35:47,820
And to be where I am at
in my life--

2136
01:35:47,860 --> 01:35:49,580
you know, I'm 25 years old,

2137
01:35:49,620 --> 01:35:51,860
and a million dollars
is a whole lot of money.

2138
01:35:51,890 --> 01:35:54,790
Life-changing. I can set up
the rest of my life

2139
01:35:54,820 --> 01:35:56,170
for me and my family.

2140
01:35:56,200 --> 01:35:58,510
You know, part of this
experience has been

2141
01:35:58,550 --> 01:36:01,130
getting to meet
and know all of you.

2142
01:36:01,170 --> 01:36:02,580
And if there's one thing
I know, it's that

2143
01:36:02,620 --> 01:36:05,000
every single person here
had something

2144
01:36:05,030 --> 01:36:06,720
bigger than themselves
they were playing for.

2145
01:36:06,750 --> 01:36:09,960
I've talked with a lot of you
about the work that I do.

2146
01:36:10,000 --> 01:36:11,440
I've worked a lot
in immigration law.

2147
01:36:11,480 --> 01:36:14,340
There's a lot of organizations
that I would want

2148
01:36:14,370 --> 01:36:17,580
to make a donation to,
and I would also want to,

2149
01:36:17,620 --> 01:36:20,480
you know, bet on myself and pay
for law school with this money.

2150
01:36:20,510 --> 01:36:22,340
Thank you, Charlie.

2151
01:36:22,370 --> 01:36:24,580
-Kenzie?
-KENZIE: I've been

2152
01:36:24,620 --> 01:36:26,680
in my career
since I was 15 years old,

2153
01:36:26,720 --> 01:36:28,680
not because it sounded fun.

2154
01:36:28,720 --> 01:36:30,650
I would have loved to enjoy
high school like a normal kid.

2155
01:36:30,680 --> 01:36:32,000
I couldn't.

2156
01:36:32,030 --> 01:36:34,030
I started working in salons
when I was 15,

2157
01:36:34,060 --> 01:36:35,650
got my beauty license
by the time I was 17,

2158
01:36:35,680 --> 01:36:37,930
opened my salon
by the time I was 24.

2159
01:36:37,960 --> 01:36:40,240
I opened it
to give people a place to work.

2160
01:36:40,270 --> 01:36:43,200
I don't make any money off
of the chairs that I rent out.

2161
01:36:43,240 --> 01:36:46,030
If a business person
looked at my business plan,

2162
01:36:46,060 --> 01:36:47,480
they would lose their minds
and be like,

2163
01:36:47,510 --> 01:36:49,060
"You could make so much money
off of this."

2164
01:36:49,100 --> 01:36:51,170
It's not about the money. The
business is not about the money.

2165
01:36:51,200 --> 01:36:53,270
It's about providing people
an opportunity.

2166
01:36:53,310 --> 01:36:55,960
So this money
would be mine, for me.

2167
01:36:56,000 --> 01:36:59,100
I would invest it and I would
set up myself so I don't have

2168
01:36:59,130 --> 01:37:02,440
to be 70 years old
doing bang trims on kids, okay?

2169
01:37:02,480 --> 01:37:04,100
-[laughing]
-Like, I'm trying

2170
01:37:04,130 --> 01:37:07,000
to set myself up
to have a family

2171
01:37:07,030 --> 01:37:10,650
and to be able to be
financially secure in myself.

2172
01:37:10,680 --> 01:37:12,790
This was my venture.
My life is...

2173
01:37:12,820 --> 01:37:14,620
has been for everyone else.

2174
01:37:14,650 --> 01:37:16,440
-Q: Thank you so much.
-No problem.

2175
01:37:16,480 --> 01:37:17,580
Q:
Yes, ma'am.

2176
01:37:18,720 --> 01:37:19,820
Well done, jury.

2177
01:37:19,860 --> 01:37:21,930
Every single question got

2178
01:37:21,960 --> 01:37:23,200
different information.

2179
01:37:23,240 --> 01:37:24,820
Well done. Thank you.

2180
01:37:24,860 --> 01:37:26,650
Charlie, Kenzie, Ben,

2181
01:37:26,680 --> 01:37:28,680
I'm gonna give you 30 seconds.

2182
01:37:28,720 --> 01:37:31,030
-Okay.
-PROBST: If you think

2183
01:37:31,060 --> 01:37:32,750
there was something
not brought up

2184
01:37:32,790 --> 01:37:36,030
that is pertinent to your game,
this is your chance to make it.

2185
01:37:36,060 --> 01:37:37,580
Charlie, 30 seconds.

2186
01:37:37,620 --> 01:37:40,170
A pattern I wanted to highlight

2187
01:37:40,200 --> 01:37:42,130
was "never close a door."

2188
01:37:42,170 --> 01:37:43,650
Always keep my options open.

2189
01:37:43,680 --> 01:37:46,130
Everyone here knows
that I've strategized with them

2190
01:37:46,170 --> 01:37:48,620
at one point or another
in the game.

2191
01:37:48,650 --> 01:37:50,030
It's what gave me options.

2192
01:37:50,060 --> 01:37:52,480
It's what let me see my position
in the game,

2193
01:37:52,510 --> 01:37:54,650
stay safe and have power.

2194
01:37:54,680 --> 01:37:56,480
That's how I feel like
I got here today,

2195
01:37:56,510 --> 01:37:59,370
and I really just wanted to hit
that point home to all of you.

2196
01:37:59,410 --> 01:38:01,030
I think I played hard.
Thank you for listening.

2197
01:38:01,060 --> 01:38:03,480
-PROBST: Kenzie?
-Thank you.

2198
01:38:03,510 --> 01:38:05,240
KENZIE:
Oh, to sum it up, um, I went

2199
01:38:05,270 --> 01:38:08,480
on every sanctuary reward
because I am a social butterfly.

2200
01:38:08,510 --> 01:38:10,650
I competed
in every single challenge

2201
01:38:10,680 --> 01:38:12,750
from the first one
to the fire-making.

2202
01:38:12,790 --> 01:38:15,130
Won two of those,
thanks to some help, because

2203
01:38:15,170 --> 01:38:16,650
you get by with a little help
from your friends.

2204
01:38:16,680 --> 01:38:19,370
I came in here trying to make
friends, and thank you all

2205
01:38:19,410 --> 01:38:20,750
for listening. Um...

2206
01:38:20,790 --> 01:38:23,270
Yeah. I... I just love you all.

2207
01:38:23,310 --> 01:38:24,680
Thank you so much. [laughs]

2208
01:38:24,720 --> 01:38:26,410
-Thank you, Kenzie.
-Thank you.
-PROBST: Ben.

2209
01:38:26,440 --> 01:38:28,510
Not that I think
it stacks up against them,

2210
01:38:28,550 --> 01:38:30,960
but, uh, with everything
I've been through in my life,

2211
01:38:31,000 --> 01:38:33,510
I did want to come here
and be the emotional me

2212
01:38:33,550 --> 01:38:36,620
and not the bravado frontman
performer version of me.

2213
01:38:36,650 --> 01:38:39,060
And even though
I had a hard time

2214
01:38:39,100 --> 01:38:40,680
with the night terrors,

2215
01:38:40,720 --> 01:38:43,000
I got from the bottom
and had fun

2216
01:38:43,030 --> 01:38:45,550
climbing my way through moves
towards the end.

2217
01:38:45,580 --> 01:38:47,580
I played the game I wanted
to play, and I'm glad I got

2218
01:38:47,620 --> 01:38:49,620
to meet y'all,
because y'all rock, and...

2219
01:38:49,650 --> 01:38:51,000
-Q: Thank you.
-Who rocks?

2220
01:38:51,030 --> 01:38:52,410
-Thanks, Ben.
-You rock.
-You rock.

2221
01:38:52,440 --> 01:38:53,820
TIFFANY:
Thanks, Ben.

2222
01:38:53,860 --> 01:38:55,340
-I'll accept that.
-Right. The one, right?

2223
01:38:55,370 --> 01:38:56,580
Come on. That's for you there.

2224
01:38:56,620 --> 01:38:58,410
-[laughing]
-PROBST: Charlie,

2225
01:38:58,440 --> 01:39:01,030
Kenzie, Ben,
it's not easy to sit

2226
01:39:01,060 --> 01:39:03,960
in those seats
and defend your game, but

2227
01:39:04,000 --> 01:39:07,440
you have to claim your victory,
and one of you just did.

2228
01:39:07,480 --> 01:39:08,860
The question is who.

2229
01:39:08,890 --> 01:39:11,620
The only thing left to do
is vote.

2230
01:39:11,650 --> 01:39:13,480
-[laughing]
-[grunts]

2231
01:39:16,200 --> 01:39:17,580
CHARLIE: I love you guys.

2232
01:39:19,060 --> 01:39:22,030
♪



## S47E13

1
00:00:00,000 --> 00:00:04,162
WWW.MY-SUBS.CO

﻿1
00:00:09,080 --> 00:00:11,735
Welcome to a special two-hour
penultimate episode

2
00:00:11,838 --> 00:00:14,148
of <i>Survivor</i> 47.

3
00:00:14,252 --> 00:00:16,804
Like any season of <i>Survivor,</i>
this one's been unique,

4
00:00:16,907 --> 00:00:19,528
and it's really centered
around two big themes.

5
00:00:19,631 --> 00:00:23,045
Number one:
a constant shift of power.

6
00:00:23,148 --> 00:00:25,769
Every player in the game has
been on the bottom and the top.

7
00:00:25,873 --> 00:00:29,080
The other theme is some
very savvy social gameplay,

8
00:00:29,183 --> 00:00:31,355
which has made it
very hard to know

9
00:00:31,459 --> 00:00:33,355
who's telling the truth
and who's lying.

10
00:00:33,459 --> 00:00:34,769
And it's led
to some big moments,

11
00:00:34,873 --> 00:00:37,183
like last week's
Operation Italy,

12
00:00:37,286 --> 00:00:39,873
a beautifully-executed charade

13
00:00:39,976 --> 00:00:41,804
that took Caroline
out of the game

14
00:00:41,907 --> 00:00:43,804
and left us with six players.

15
00:00:43,907 --> 00:00:46,907
A final six that nobody
would have predicted on day one,

16
00:00:47,011 --> 00:00:48,424
starting with Andy.

17
00:00:48,528 --> 00:00:50,045
Got off to
one of the worst starts

18
00:00:50,148 --> 00:00:51,873
in the history of <i>Survivor.</i>

19
00:00:51,976 --> 00:00:54,459
But instead of giving in,
he dug in

20
00:00:54,562 --> 00:00:57,011
and he found his footing,
and he's still here.

21
00:00:57,114 --> 00:00:59,631
Sam: he had power
early in the game,

22
00:00:59,735 --> 00:01:01,528
but since the merge,
he's been on the bottom

23
00:01:01,631 --> 00:01:05,459
and has had to play scrappy
every day just to alive.

24
00:01:05,562 --> 00:01:09,286
Genevieve: she is social,
she's strategic,

25
00:01:09,390 --> 00:01:11,804
she is cutthroat,
and everybody knows it.

26
00:01:11,907 --> 00:01:15,114
And that's why she has
a very big target on her back.

27
00:01:15,217 --> 00:01:17,976
Sue: she's got an idol.
Nobody knows about it.

28
00:01:18,080 --> 00:01:21,217
But her real strength in
the game has come from loyalty.

29
00:01:21,321 --> 00:01:24,493
And with the Caroline vote-out,
she lost her last ally.

30
00:01:24,597 --> 00:01:26,183
And for the first time
this season,

31
00:01:26,286 --> 00:01:27,976
Sue is alone in the game.

32
00:01:28,080 --> 00:01:30,252
Teeny: she's been very open.

33
00:01:30,355 --> 00:01:31,873
She's an emotional player.

34
00:01:31,976 --> 00:01:34,080
It's worked for her,
it's worked against her.

35
00:01:34,183 --> 00:01:37,045
But what has kept her in
the game are her social skills.

36
00:01:37,148 --> 00:01:38,804
Finally, Rachel.

37
00:01:38,907 --> 00:01:41,700
She's already won two
individual immunity challenges.

38
00:01:41,804 --> 00:01:44,907
She has a Block a Vote and
an idol that nobody knows about.

39
00:01:45,011 --> 00:01:48,390
That is a lot of power with only
six players left in the game

40
00:01:48,493 --> 00:01:50,286
and she's gonna need it
because right now,

41
00:01:50,390 --> 00:01:52,597
Rachel is the biggest threat
in the game.

42
00:01:52,700 --> 00:01:54,597
All right, tonight we're gonna
have two challenges,

43
00:01:54,700 --> 00:01:56,045
two Tribal Councils.

44
00:01:56,148 --> 00:01:58,286
We'll go from six
to five to four,

45
00:01:58,390 --> 00:02:01,493
and if you can get to four,
then at the very least,

46
00:02:01,597 --> 00:02:03,804
you are guaranteed
a shot to make fire

47
00:02:03,907 --> 00:02:06,217
and you got a shot
to win this game.

48
00:02:06,321 --> 00:02:09,976
But all it takes
is just one mistake

49
00:02:10,080 --> 00:02:11,597
and your game is done.

50
00:02:11,700 --> 00:02:14,321
That's why <i>Survivor</i>
is so difficult to win

51
00:02:14,424 --> 00:02:16,390
and so fun to watch.

52
00:02:16,493 --> 00:02:18,942
All right, here we go.

53
00:02:19,045 --> 00:02:22,321
♪ ♪

54
00:02:23,700 --> 00:02:26,459
<i>Previously on</i> Survivor...

55
00:02:27,666 --> 00:02:30,114
ANDY:
This is the defining night

56
00:02:30,217 --> 00:02:31,942
for the rest of this game.

57
00:02:33,976 --> 00:02:35,631
<i>ANDY:
The goal is build suspicion</i>

58
00:02:35,735 --> 00:02:37,080
<i>that one of you has an idol.</i>

59
00:02:37,183 --> 00:02:38,666
<i>If we do that,</i>

60
00:02:38,769 --> 00:02:40,804
<i>they will be compelled
to split the vote.</i>

61
00:02:40,907 --> 00:02:42,424
I'm most afraid of the idol.

62
00:02:42,528 --> 00:02:43,700
CAROLINE:
So then, we would need

63
00:02:43,804 --> 00:02:45,459
- to then split the vote.
- Yeah.

64
00:02:46,631 --> 00:02:48,148
Thank you, Andy.

65
00:02:48,252 --> 00:02:49,183
This is the biggest heist

66
00:02:49,286 --> 00:02:50,183
<i>of</i> Survivor.

67
00:02:50,286 --> 00:02:52,286
Yeah.

68
00:02:52,390 --> 00:02:53,424
<i>ANDY:
And we're calling it</i>

69
00:02:53,528 --> 00:02:54,735
Operation Italy.

70
00:03:00,873 --> 00:03:02,424
PROBST:
If anybody has an advantage

71
00:03:02,528 --> 00:03:03,838
or an idol
and you want to play it,

72
00:03:03,942 --> 00:03:06,355
now would be the time to do so.

73
00:03:10,907 --> 00:03:12,045
All right, I'll read the votes.

74
00:03:13,493 --> 00:03:15,390
Twelfth person
voted out of <i>Survivor</i> 47

75
00:03:15,493 --> 00:03:18,252
and the fifth member
of our jury:

76
00:03:18,355 --> 00:03:20,252
- Caroline.
- Okay.

77
00:03:27,390 --> 00:03:28,424
The tribe has spoken.

78
00:03:32,873 --> 00:03:34,907
♪ ♪

79
00:03:43,838 --> 00:03:47,148
<i>SUE:
Tribal really sucked tonight.</i>

80

<i>Caroline was blindsided, so,</i>

81
00:03:50,252 --> 00:03:53,942

82
00:03:54,045 --> 00:03:55,493

83
00:03:55,597 --> 00:03:57,562
<i>Thank God that I have an idol,</i>

84
00:03:57,666 --> 00:03:59,666
<i>because I'm in trouble.</i>

85

<i>Andy was supposed to be working
with myself, Rachel,</i>

86
00:04:02,424 --> 00:04:04,355
<i>Caroline and Teeny, but</i>

87
00:04:04,459 --> 00:04:06,217
Andy freakin' flipped.

88
00:04:06,321 --> 00:04:09,942
<i>So right now, I want to rip
Andy's head off his shoulders.</i>

89
00:04:10,045 --> 00:04:12,390
Ugh!

90
00:04:12,493 --> 00:04:15,045
So frustrated. So frustrated.

91
00:04:15,148 --> 00:04:16,666
[laughing]

92
00:04:18,114 --> 00:04:19,321
Oh, my God.

93
00:04:20,666 --> 00:04:22,942
<i>ANDY:
Tribal was incredible.</i>

94
00:04:23,045 --> 00:04:24,942
Operation Italy.

95
00:04:25,045 --> 00:04:27,355
It went off to perfection.

96
00:04:27,459 --> 00:04:28,976
<i>And to sit here</i>

97
00:04:29,080 --> 00:04:30,769
<i>having pulled off
the biggest move of the season,</i>

98
00:04:30,873 --> 00:04:33,666
<i>this is the feeling you want
when you come out here.</i>

99
00:04:33,769 --> 00:04:35,424
<i>Like, I'm playing</i>
Survivor <i>for real.</i>

100
00:04:35,528 --> 00:04:38,493
I'm actually doing it, and...
[laughs]

101
00:04:41,148 --> 00:04:43,769
I love... It's-it's...

102
00:04:43,873 --> 00:04:46,252
Okay, can I say,
I'm so happy to hear that?

103
00:04:46,355 --> 00:04:48,011
I-I feel the love tonight.

104
00:04:50,528 --> 00:04:51,907
- No.
- No.

105
00:04:52,011 --> 00:04:53,631
<i>GENEVIEVE:
Tonight, Sam and I were both</i>

106
00:04:53,735 --> 00:04:55,735
<i>on the chopping block, so,</i>

107
00:04:55,838 --> 00:04:59,286
by all accounts, I should not
be sitting here today

108
00:04:59,390 --> 00:05:01,907

of Operation Italy.

109
00:05:02,011 --> 00:05:05,148
<i>It was such a long shot, but</i>

110
00:05:05,252 --> 00:05:07,286
it worked. [laughs]

111
00:05:08,666 --> 00:05:10,907
Andy-- he is...

112
00:05:11,011 --> 00:05:12,838

than we all thought

113
00:05:12,942 --> 00:05:15,666

than we thought.

114
00:05:15,769 --> 00:05:17,700
SUE:
I've never seen someone
flip-flop so much in my life.

115
00:05:17,804 --> 00:05:19,148
Just...
I have no respect for people

116
00:05:19,252 --> 00:05:21,838

but whatever.

117
00:05:21,942 --> 00:05:24,459
I'm so pissed at him.

118
00:05:24,562 --> 00:05:27,907
It is safe to say that not
one single thing went the way

119
00:05:28,011 --> 00:05:30,528
I thought it was going to go
at Tribal Council.

120
00:05:30,631 --> 00:05:34,459
<i>Me, Rachel and Sue
all look like idiots</i>

121

122
00:05:36,562 --> 00:05:40,424
<i>And Andy flipped on us. And so,
we need to talk right now.</i>

123
00:05:40,528 --> 00:05:41,838

124
00:05:41,942 --> 00:05:43,976
That was insane to do.

125
00:05:44,080 --> 00:05:47,148
Why don't we run this back
first and let's explain

126
00:05:47,252 --> 00:05:48,493
- what just happened.

128
00:05:50,217 --> 00:05:52,424
I was like, "This is better

129
00:05:52,528 --> 00:05:54,321
<i>So, we spilt up Caroline, Sue</i>

130
00:05:54,424 --> 00:05:55,424

131
00:05:55,528 --> 00:05:56,321
<i>TEENY:
It seemed like</i>

132
00:05:56,424 --> 00:05:57,562
Genevieve and Sam knew

00:05:57,666 --> 00:05:59,183

134

No. [laughs]

135
00:06:01,114 --> 00:06:03,321
<i>I know I need

136

<i>Teeny is feeling like I have</i>

00:06:08,252 --> 00:06:10,700

139
00:06:10,804 --> 00:06:12,286

140
00:06:12,390 --> 00:06:15,011
<i>But no, no, no,
we can't let her believe that.</i>

141
00:06:15,114 --> 00:06:16,562
Those are, like...

142
00:06:18,666 --> 00:06:19,562
SAM:
Yeah.

143
00:06:19,666 --> 00:06:20,942
<i>Right now,</i>

144
00:06:21,045 --> 00:06:22,907
<i>there's six of us left
in the game.</i>

145
00:06:23,011 --> 00:06:25,252
<i>That makes it
extra important for us</i>

146
00:06:25,355 --> 00:06:28,114

147
00:06:28,217 --> 00:06:30,804
<i>Fortunately,
Teeny's kind of, like,</i>

148
00:06:30,907 --> 00:06:32,424
<i>confused about what happened.</i>

149
00:06:32,528 --> 00:06:33,804
<i>And so,</i>

150
00:06:33,907 --> 00:06:35,493
we play it off like

151
00:06:35,597 --> 00:06:38,114

152
00:06:38,217 --> 00:06:41,942
The fact is, you lied to me,
thinking I was going home.

153
00:06:42,045 --> 00:06:43,942
- Yes.
- Andy wanted to vote me home,

154
00:06:44,045 --> 00:06:45,700
but then changed his mind
to save me.

155
00:06:45,804 --> 00:06:47,459
So I told Genevieve to
play the idol, which was best

156
00:06:47,562 --> 00:06:49,562
for her, but she didn't
trust me on my gut,

157
00:06:49,666 --> 00:06:51,321
- so then she didn't play it.
- [laughing]

158
00:06:51,424 --> 00:06:53,011
And then somehow,
we came out with the idol

159
00:06:53,114 --> 00:06:55,804
- and Caroline went home.
- [laughing]

160
00:06:55,907 --> 00:06:58,321
<i>SAM:
I think Teeny, right now,
is in panic mode,</i>

161
00:06:58,424 --> 00:07:01,666
<i>and she's very
vulnerable, and so,</i>

162
00:07:01,769 --> 00:07:05,183
Teeny bought it
every single step of the way.

163
00:07:05,286 --> 00:07:07,493
So, it was...

164
00:07:07,597 --> 00:07:09,183

165
00:07:09,286 --> 00:07:11,045
I walked out
of that Tribal Council

166
00:07:11,148 --> 00:07:12,700

looking at the stars.

167
00:07:12,804 --> 00:07:14,424
- I smiled and shook my head.
- And I... I was just like,

168
00:07:14,528 --> 00:07:15,873
"How the ... did that happen?"

169
00:07:15,976 --> 00:07:18,286
<i>TEENY:
At this point, I have no idea</i>

170
00:07:18,390 --> 00:07:21,011

to the end is anymore.

171
00:07:21,114 --> 00:07:24,528
<i>I don't trust anybody anymore.</i>

172
00:07:24,631 --> 00:07:27,321
And with six people left,
there's really nowhere to hide.

173
00:07:27,424 --> 00:07:28,907
At this point, this is...

174
00:07:29,976 --> 00:07:31,459
- Yeah. Yeah.
- Yeah.

175
00:07:31,562 --> 00:07:33,080
- This is who it's gonna be.
- Yeah.
- Yeah.

176
00:07:33,183 --> 00:07:35,459
If we get Rachel out,
this is who it's gonna be.

177
00:07:35,562 --> 00:07:38,252
<i>Even though me and Rachel
were working together,</i>

178
00:07:38,355 --> 00:07:40,907
<i>she is the biggest
challenge threat at this point,</i>

179
00:07:41,011 --> 00:07:43,321
<i>and she's the biggest
fire threat at the final four.</i>

180
00:07:43,424 --> 00:07:44,804
<i>So,</i>

181
00:07:44,907 --> 00:07:47,562
my brain does make a switch.
I do want to work

182
00:07:47,666 --> 00:07:50,769
<i>with Sam and Genevieve and Andy
to get Rachel out of this game.</i>

183
00:07:50,873 --> 00:07:52,252
This is really a moment

184
00:07:52,355 --> 00:07:55,183

and adapt in <i>Survivor.</i>

185
00:07:55,286 --> 00:07:57,080
SUE:
Did Teeny go down with them?

186
00:07:59,252 --> 00:08:01,976
<i>So, when we got back
from Tribal,</i>

187
00:08:02,080 --> 00:08:05,148
Andy, Teeny, Sam and Genevieve

188
00:08:05,252 --> 00:08:06,700

189
00:08:06,804 --> 00:08:10,114
<i>And I just felt like,
in that moment,</i>

190
00:08:10,217 --> 00:08:12,148
<i>I needed to know
what was going on,</i>

191
00:08:12,252 --> 00:08:14,114

192
00:08:18,735 --> 00:08:21,148
<i>I think one of the things
that you can't grasp at home,</i>

193
00:08:21,252 --> 00:08:23,321
because you always see
the, like, infrared camera,

194
00:08:23,424 --> 00:08:24,769
and, you know, it feels like

195

there's got to be
a flashlight somewhere,

196
00:08:26,493 --> 00:08:28,976
<i>but you can't see anything.</i>

197
00:08:29,080 --> 00:08:31,838
<i>It's dark.
It's pitch black.</i>

198
00:08:31,942 --> 00:08:34,666
- [laughing]
- GENEVIEVE: I don't
appreciate it...

199
00:08:34,769 --> 00:08:36,286
<i>RACHEL:
I mean, I couldn't see them.
I could only hear them.</i>

200
00:08:36,390 --> 00:08:38,907
<i>- So I'm following their voices.</i>
- [Genevieve laughing]

201
00:08:39,011 --> 00:08:41,459
<i>And I basically
crawl on my belly</i>

202
00:08:41,562 --> 00:08:43,114
<i>underneath a bush</i>

203
00:08:43,217 --> 00:08:44,528
<i>right next to them,</i>

204
00:08:44,631 --> 00:08:47,080
and I just listen
to their entire conversation.

205
00:08:50,873 --> 00:08:53,493
SAM:
Sol saved her,
she took out Kyle

206
00:08:53,597 --> 00:08:55,252
- with beating him the necklace,
she became the challenge champ
- Yeah.

207
00:08:55,355 --> 00:08:56,838
- after him.
- She's incredible at challenges.

208
00:08:56,942 --> 00:08:58,700
And I think she has
a really close relationship

209
00:08:58,804 --> 00:08:59,804
with Caroline.

210
00:09:03,907 --> 00:09:05,424
- So... she cannot win.
- She can't win.

211
00:09:05,528 --> 00:09:07,217
- She cannot win.
- I think everything is kind of

212
00:09:07,321 --> 00:09:09,942
crystallized,
and we just have to gun

213
00:09:10,045 --> 00:09:12,390
for the immunity necklace.

214
00:09:12,493 --> 00:09:14,390
So I find out so much.

215
00:09:14,493 --> 00:09:17,011
<i>I learn that
they're all gunning for me.</i>

216
00:09:17,114 --> 00:09:18,424
<i>I hear my name.</i>

217
00:09:18,528 --> 00:09:20,942
I hear,
"She cannot win tomorrow,"

218
00:09:21,045 --> 00:09:22,424
"Anybody but her."

219
00:09:22,528 --> 00:09:24,011
- [laughing]: That's so bad.
- Genevieve, I told you

220
00:09:24,114 --> 00:09:26,424
you do have nerves of steel.
When you didn't play that thing,

221
00:09:26,528 --> 00:09:27,631
I was like, "Wait a minute."

222
00:09:27,735 --> 00:09:28,942
<i>RACHEL:
I found out</i>

223
00:09:29,045 --> 00:09:30,562
Genevieve does have an idol,

224
00:09:30,666 --> 00:09:33,355
and that she has balls of steel
to have not played it yet.

225
00:09:33,459 --> 00:09:36,148
Do you know what she's got?
Does she have an idol?

226
00:09:36,252 --> 00:09:39,286
She does not have an idol.
She has a Block a Vote.

227
00:09:39,390 --> 00:09:40,700
She can block somebody's vote.

228
00:09:40,804 --> 00:09:42,769
<i>RACHEL:
And finally,</i>

229
00:09:42,873 --> 00:09:46,631
<i>when Teeny told Sam and
Genevieve about my advantage,</i>

230
00:09:46,735 --> 00:09:48,838
<i>that's when I knew
that I didn't have Teeny.</i>

231
00:09:48,942 --> 00:09:51,459
<i>But the good news is that
they don't know I have an idol,</i>

232
00:09:51,562 --> 00:09:53,286
<i>which is brilliant in the sense</i>

233
00:09:53,390 --> 00:09:56,080
that they will never
see an idol coming from me.

234
00:09:57,252 --> 00:09:59,011
I...

235
00:10:03,217 --> 00:10:04,217
Okay.

236
00:10:06,769 --> 00:10:09,666
<i>RACHEL:
And so, with this information,</i>

237
00:10:09,769 --> 00:10:11,528
<i>I have more legs in this game</i>

238
00:10:11,631 --> 00:10:14,424
<i>than anybody at camp
realizes, and I can</i>

239
00:10:14,528 --> 00:10:16,735
hopefully turn this game around.

240
00:10:19,804 --> 00:10:21,769
♪ ♪

241
00:10:49,424 --> 00:10:51,321
♪ ♪

242
00:11:16,286 --> 00:11:18,080
♪ ♪

243
00:11:30,735 --> 00:11:32,769
♪ ♪

244
00:11:41,873 --> 00:11:44,321
<i>SUE:
In the early morning,
I woke up, and</i>

245
00:11:44,424 --> 00:11:47,666
<i>I'm feeling a little broken.
I'm just like,</i>

246
00:11:47,769 --> 00:11:50,528
<i>"Oh, my God.
Like, put me out of my misery."</i>

247
00:11:50,631 --> 00:11:53,355
Oh, my poor Caroline.

248
00:11:53,459 --> 00:11:54,976
I lost my girl.

249
00:11:55,080 --> 00:11:57,355
<i>It freakin' sucks</i>

250
00:11:57,459 --> 00:12:00,390
<i>to lose my last number one.</i>

251
00:12:00,493 --> 00:12:03,114
<i>I'm devastated,
but in the same breath,</i>

252
00:12:03,217 --> 00:12:04,804
<i>it's something else
I just got to suck up</i>

253
00:12:04,907 --> 00:12:08,252
<i>and just stand up
and start playing the game hard.</i>

254
00:12:22,390 --> 00:12:25,252
<i>I have an idol,
but I want to find another idol.</i>

255
00:12:25,355 --> 00:12:27,804
<i>I want to find an advantage.
I want to still keep searching.</i>

256
00:12:27,907 --> 00:12:29,080
I just have to believe

257
00:12:29,183 --> 00:12:31,183

out there.

258
00:12:32,459 --> 00:12:34,148
<i>I'm looking for a miracle.
Yeah, on</i> Survivor.

259
00:12:34,252 --> 00:12:36,183
<i>Is that possible?</i>

260
00:12:36,286 --> 00:12:38,769
Is it possible to find a miracle
on <i>Survivor?</i>

261
00:12:42,148 --> 00:12:44,183
Are you okay?

262
00:12:44,286 --> 00:12:46,597
I want to dig around this.
I want to dig--

263
00:12:46,700 --> 00:12:48,424
Can we please dig around this?

264
00:12:48,528 --> 00:12:50,493
- Hey.
- I don't care if that
something's happened here.

265
00:12:51,286 --> 00:12:52,976
I have an idol.

266

I found it
day after the auction,

267
00:12:54,424 --> 00:12:55,976

a single person.

268
00:12:56,080 --> 00:12:58,459
I'm sorry. You've been
digging up everything?

269
00:12:58,562 --> 00:13:00,011
Mm-hmm.

270
00:13:00,114 --> 00:13:02,114
- ...you don't
have to dig here, okay?
- Okay.

271
00:13:02,217 --> 00:13:05,390
<i>Rachel shows up.
She says, "Don't worry.</i>

272
00:13:05,493 --> 00:13:07,183
I have the idol."

273
00:13:07,286 --> 00:13:09,907
And I'm like, "Oh, my God."

274
00:13:10,011 --> 00:13:11,528
So now I know her secret.

275
00:13:11,631 --> 00:13:14,080
<i>She has
a Block a Vote Advantage</i>

276
00:13:14,183 --> 00:13:16,217
<i>and she has an idol.</i>

277
00:13:18,148 --> 00:13:20,148
<i>I feel I've-I've built</i>

278
00:13:20,252 --> 00:13:22,321
<i>a good alliance with Rachel.</i>

279
00:13:22,424 --> 00:13:24,873
I trust her.
She's shared so much with me.

280
00:13:24,976 --> 00:13:26,390
You cannot tell anybody, okay?

281
00:13:26,493 --> 00:13:28,286
I'm not.
We cannot tell anybody, okay?

282
00:13:28,390 --> 00:13:31,493
<i>SUE:
But I'm not sharing
that I have an idol, too,</i>

283
00:13:31,597 --> 00:13:34,631
<i>because everybody
wants her out, so,</i>

284
00:13:34,735 --> 00:13:37,838
I might be able
to hold it one more day.

285
00:13:37,942 --> 00:13:40,942
If I don't win today,
I'm getting all the votes

286
00:13:41,045 --> 00:13:43,045
because now that
I've won two immunities,

287
00:13:43,148 --> 00:13:44,528
- I'm this huge threat.
- Mm-hmm.

288
00:13:44,631 --> 00:13:47,735
- So I think that
we can trick them.
- Okay. Okay.

289
00:13:47,838 --> 00:13:49,148
- I think we can do this.
- Yeah.

290
00:13:49,252 --> 00:13:52,011
I think we have... we have...
We're not dead.

291
00:13:52,114 --> 00:13:53,735
- Okay.
- Okay?

292
00:13:53,838 --> 00:13:56,459
<i>RACHEL:
It was scary to tell Sue
about the idol, but</i>

293
00:13:56,562 --> 00:13:58,769
at this point, I need Sue.

294
00:13:58,873 --> 00:14:00,804
I have nobody else in this game,

295
00:14:00,907 --> 00:14:03,562
and if I'm gonna pull off
anything, I need her trust.

296
00:14:06,562 --> 00:14:09,666
We have to pretend
because Genevieve has an idol.

297
00:14:09,769 --> 00:14:12,355
<i>And so, I tell her my plan.</i>

298
00:14:12,459 --> 00:14:14,907
We have to pretend
like Teeny is still with us.

299
00:14:15,011 --> 00:14:17,424
We have to act like we have
no idea that she has flipped.

300
00:14:17,528 --> 00:14:20,631
<i>I just want
to make them feel comfortable</i>

301
00:14:20,735 --> 00:14:22,942
<i>so they don't know
I have an idol,</i>

302
00:14:23,045 --> 00:14:25,148
and I would kind of just be able
to, like, smoke 'em.

303
00:14:26,735 --> 00:14:28,700
TEENY:
Tree mail!

304
00:14:28,804 --> 00:14:31,976
All right. Day 23, immunity
challenge. Let's hear it.

305
00:14:32,080 --> 00:14:34,011
<i>RACHEL:
I need immunity</i>

306
00:14:34,114 --> 00:14:35,390
today so badly.

307
00:14:39,286 --> 00:14:41,493
RACHEL: Oh, God.

308
00:14:44,114 --> 00:14:45,976
GENEVIEVE: Oh, no.

309
00:14:47,011 --> 00:14:48,493
<i>RACHEL:
If I win today,</i>

310
00:14:48,597 --> 00:14:51,321
I think I can get
to the end of this game

311
00:14:51,424 --> 00:14:54,493
<i>because then I can use my idol
at the final five.</i>

312
00:14:54,597 --> 00:14:57,976
<i>People, like, assume that
I would be down and upset</i>

313
00:14:58,080 --> 00:15:01,735
<i>about my place in this game,
and yet, I am sitting here</i>

314
00:15:01,838 --> 00:15:04,355
with a grin on my face,
so excited

315
00:15:04,459 --> 00:15:07,355
to just see
if I am able to, like,

316
00:15:07,459 --> 00:15:09,459
just shift these pieces
into place

317
00:15:09,562 --> 00:15:11,528
to get the result I want.

318
00:15:11,631 --> 00:15:13,459
<i>And so, I'm either gonna</i>

319
00:15:13,562 --> 00:15:15,355
<i>smash this out of the water</i>

320
00:15:15,459 --> 00:15:17,700
or I'm gonna, like,
flail in the water

321
00:15:17,804 --> 00:15:19,528
and drown trying.

322
00:15:19,631 --> 00:15:21,666
Bob and weave.

323
00:15:24,424 --> 00:15:25,700
Hey, you want to spend part
of your summer living

324
00:15:25,804 --> 00:15:27,080
in the jungles of Fiji,

325
00:15:27,183 --> 00:15:28,631
experiencing the adventure
of a lifetime?

326
00:15:28,735 --> 00:15:30,080
Apply to be on <i>Survivor.</i>

327
00:15:32,631 --> 00:15:35,735
♪ ♪

328
00:15:47,631 --> 00:15:48,838
Bring in the boat!

329
00:15:50,666 --> 00:15:52,493
♪ ♪

330
00:15:59,907 --> 00:16:01,735
- Oh, boy.
- I know.

331
00:16:01,838 --> 00:16:04,217
Best kind of <i>Survivor</i> entrance
right there.

332
00:16:13,528 --> 00:16:15,424
So, day 23,

333
00:16:15,528 --> 00:16:17,631
the final six.
Let's get to today's

334
00:16:17,735 --> 00:16:19,873
immunity challenge.
First things first.

335
00:16:19,976 --> 00:16:21,493
Got to take it back, Rachel.

336
00:16:21,597 --> 00:16:23,080
Second time.

337
00:16:23,183 --> 00:16:25,148
Thank you.

338
00:16:27,321 --> 00:16:30,838
Once again, immunity
is back up for grabs.

339
00:16:30,942 --> 00:16:34,011
<i>For today's challenge,
you're gonna leap into the ocean</i>

340
00:16:34,114 --> 00:16:36,562
<i>and then swim to a platform</i>

341
00:16:36,666 --> 00:16:39,114
<i>where you will find a buoy
attached to a rope.</i>

342
00:16:39,217 --> 00:16:41,217
<i>You're gonna maneuver that buoy
through a series</i>

343
00:16:41,321 --> 00:16:43,011
<i>of obstacles
until you reach the finish,</i>

344
00:16:43,114 --> 00:16:46,873
<i>where you will race to solve
a</i> Survivor <i>logo puzzle.</i>

345
00:16:51,804 --> 00:16:53,493
GENEVIEVE:
I know you do, Rachel.

346
00:16:53,597 --> 00:16:55,804
PROBST:
First person to finish

347
00:16:55,907 --> 00:16:59,804
wins immunity, guaranteed a spot
in the final five.

348
00:16:59,907 --> 00:17:03,355
In addition,
you're playing for reward.

349
00:17:03,459 --> 00:17:04,804
Want to know
what you're playing for?

350
00:17:04,907 --> 00:17:07,390
- Yeah.
- Yes, badly.
- You'll be taken to...

351
00:17:08,528 --> 00:17:09,735
...the sanctuary.

352
00:17:09,838 --> 00:17:12,355
Where good things happen.

353
00:17:12,459 --> 00:17:14,321
- Steak.
- Oh. Okay.

354
00:17:14,424 --> 00:17:15,804
PROBST:
Baked potato,

355
00:17:15,907 --> 00:17:17,011
wine, juice

356
00:17:17,114 --> 00:17:19,873
and cheesecake for dessert.

357
00:17:19,976 --> 00:17:22,700
PROBST:
You talk about fuel
to get you to the end?

358
00:17:22,804 --> 00:17:25,114
This will do it.
Losers,

359
00:17:25,217 --> 00:17:26,735
Tribal Council,
where somebody will be

360
00:17:26,838 --> 00:17:28,666
the 13th person voted out,

361
00:17:28,769 --> 00:17:31,011
become the sixth member
of our jury.

362
00:17:31,114 --> 00:17:32,838
Big enough "steaks"?

363
00:17:34,631 --> 00:17:37,804
- Yeah.
- [mock-laughs]

364
00:17:37,907 --> 00:17:41,321
We'll draw for spots,
and we'll get it on. Here we go.

365
00:17:47,769 --> 00:17:49,321
All right, here we go.

366
00:17:49,424 --> 00:17:52,424
For immunity and reward,

367
00:17:52,528 --> 00:17:55,424
guaranteed spot
in the final five.

368
00:17:55,528 --> 00:17:57,080
Survivors ready?

369
00:17:59,769 --> 00:18:01,424
Go! First you got to leap.

370
00:18:01,528 --> 00:18:02,804
[Survivors grunting, shrieking]

371
00:18:05,011 --> 00:18:06,148
That's how you do it.

372
00:18:06,252 --> 00:18:08,459
Now it's a swim
to that platform,

373
00:18:08,562 --> 00:18:11,528
and immediately start
working with that buoy.

374
00:18:11,631 --> 00:18:14,769
You're maneuvering it
through a series of obstacles

375
00:18:14,873 --> 00:18:16,148
as fast as you can.

376
00:18:18,597 --> 00:18:21,562
Sam is ripping through it.

377
00:18:21,666 --> 00:18:24,493
Sam is over quickly,
out to an early lead.

378
00:18:24,597 --> 00:18:27,631
Here comes Genevieve
right on his tail.

379
00:18:29,459 --> 00:18:32,045
Here comes Rachel.

380
00:18:33,286 --> 00:18:35,838
Teeny with a sloppy fall,
but it's okay.

381
00:18:35,942 --> 00:18:38,493
Sue's in the water.

382
00:18:41,114 --> 00:18:42,493
It is Sam in the lead.

383
00:18:42,597 --> 00:18:45,148
Now you're gonna be putting
that buoy over and under.

384
00:18:47,942 --> 00:18:51,321
If this puzzle is close,
every second's gonna count.

385
00:18:58,080 --> 00:19:00,493
Now it's Genevieve in the lead.

386
00:19:00,597 --> 00:19:02,631
Genevieve moved quickly
through that second stage

387
00:19:02,735 --> 00:19:05,528
with the buoy
and she's in the lead.

388
00:19:07,459 --> 00:19:09,080
Sam right on her tail.

389
00:19:09,183 --> 00:19:11,493
Here comes Rachel and Andy.

390
00:19:11,597 --> 00:19:12,838
Genevieve's out of the water.

391
00:19:12,942 --> 00:19:14,528
You're good.
Get up, Genevieve.

392
00:19:14,631 --> 00:19:16,769
Start working on the puzzle.

393
00:19:20,286 --> 00:19:23,252
Here comes Rachel
gaining on Sam now.

394
00:19:23,355 --> 00:19:26,838
Andy gaining on Rachel.
Teeny gaining on Andy.

395
00:19:26,942 --> 00:19:28,700
And here comes Sue.

396
00:19:28,804 --> 00:19:30,424
Everybody's gonna be in this.

397
00:19:31,459 --> 00:19:34,080
You got to get up on
the platform and start working.

398
00:19:34,183 --> 00:19:37,735
There are all kinds
of puzzles on <i>Survivor.</i>

399
00:19:37,838 --> 00:19:40,493
Some puzzles
come easier to others.

400
00:19:40,597 --> 00:19:42,355
Sometimes you walk up,
and you go,

401
00:19:42,459 --> 00:19:44,011
"Oh, this puzzle's all mine."

402
00:19:47,355 --> 00:19:50,459
Everybody now working
on this logo puzzle.

403
00:19:50,562 --> 00:19:53,700
You've been wearing it
on your Buff all season long.

404
00:19:53,804 --> 00:19:57,321
You'll never forget this logo,
you win this puzzle.

405
00:19:57,424 --> 00:19:59,735
It is Rachel out
to a very fast start.

406
00:19:59,838 --> 00:20:02,217
Genevieve on her tail.

407
00:20:05,631 --> 00:20:07,976
Genevieve with another piece.

408
00:20:08,080 --> 00:20:10,459
Rachel with another piece.

409
00:20:10,562 --> 00:20:12,321
Andy just gonna look next door.

410
00:20:12,424 --> 00:20:14,080
"I'm gonna
let Rachel do the work.

411
00:20:14,183 --> 00:20:15,976
I'll just see what she's doing."
Teeny gonna get in on that.

412
00:20:16,080 --> 00:20:18,114
All that means is you're behind.

413
00:20:19,804 --> 00:20:22,355
This is turning out
to be a showdown

414
00:20:22,459 --> 00:20:24,459
quickly
between Rachel and Genevieve.

415
00:20:26,286 --> 00:20:28,390
Genevieve with another piece.

416
00:20:28,493 --> 00:20:30,493
Rachel with another piece.

417
00:20:34,114 --> 00:20:36,976
Right now, if you were Genevieve
or Rachel, you got to keep

418
00:20:37,080 --> 00:20:39,735
busting it, 'cause you got
somebody right on your tail.

419
00:20:40,838 --> 00:20:42,804
Genevieve and Rachel

420
00:20:42,907 --> 00:20:45,390
are ripping through this puzzle.

421
00:20:45,493 --> 00:20:47,631
And another piece from Rachel.

422
00:20:47,735 --> 00:20:49,080
Dude.

423
00:20:53,700 --> 00:20:55,562
Genevieve with another piece.

424
00:20:55,666 --> 00:20:58,390
Now it's Rachel
who feels the pressure.

425
00:20:58,493 --> 00:21:00,804
It is Genevieve
clearly in the lead now.

426
00:21:02,562 --> 00:21:04,321
Genevieve can feel
that momentum.

427
00:21:04,424 --> 00:21:07,045
Rachel trying to catch up.

428
00:21:08,045 --> 00:21:10,252
Nobody else even close.

429
00:21:11,286 --> 00:21:13,873
You might have more fun
just watching like I'm doing.

430
00:21:16,700 --> 00:21:18,735
Genevieve down to six pieces.

431
00:21:21,562 --> 00:21:24,217
Rachel about double that.

432
00:21:24,321 --> 00:21:26,114
Rachel with another piece.

433
00:21:26,217 --> 00:21:27,873
Oh, my God, come on...
[muttering]

434
00:21:27,976 --> 00:21:31,528
Guaranteed spot
in the final five on the line.

435
00:21:33,631 --> 00:21:36,148
Genevieve down
to two pieces now.

436
00:21:37,493 --> 00:21:39,838
Rachel with another piece.

437
00:21:39,942 --> 00:21:40,976
Genevieve down
to one piece left.

438
00:21:45,217 --> 00:21:48,976
And it's over. Genevieve wins
individual immunity,

439
00:21:49,080 --> 00:21:52,183
guaranteed a spot
in the final five

440
00:21:52,286 --> 00:21:54,804
of <i>Survivor</i> 47.

441
00:21:54,907 --> 00:21:57,011
Wow. That was the fastest
I've ever seen

442
00:21:57,114 --> 00:21:59,114
a logo puzzle put together.

443
00:22:03,700 --> 00:22:05,321
Genevieve, come on over.

444
00:22:09,217 --> 00:22:11,390
First individual immunity win

445
00:22:11,493 --> 00:22:14,666
guarantees you a spot
in the final five.

446
00:22:14,769 --> 00:22:16,390
- Yeah.
- In addition,

447
00:22:16,493 --> 00:22:20,183
you've won an afternoon at the
sanctuary, where you are going

448
00:22:20,286 --> 00:22:23,252
to fuel your body for that
final push to the end.

449
00:22:23,355 --> 00:22:25,942
Choose one person to join you.

450
00:22:27,183 --> 00:22:29,769
Already Sam is shaking his head

451
00:22:29,873 --> 00:22:31,597
- saying, "Don't choose me"?
- SAM: Yeah.

452
00:22:31,700 --> 00:22:33,700
My stomach
is in absolute shambles,

453
00:22:33,804 --> 00:22:36,217
so, do not waste a spot

454
00:22:36,321 --> 00:22:37,769
on me on the reward.

455
00:22:37,873 --> 00:22:39,493
Let somebody
who hasn't eaten eat.

456
00:22:39,597 --> 00:22:42,942
Um, so in that case,
I... I'm gonna take Sue.

457
00:22:43,045 --> 00:22:46,045
PROBST:
Come on over, Sue.

458
00:22:47,562 --> 00:22:50,011
All right, Genevieve,
you have one more spot.

459
00:22:55,873 --> 00:22:58,907
- Teeny.
- Teeny, come on over.
- Yeah.

460
00:22:59,011 --> 00:23:02,286
- Yeah, come on.
- Oh, my God.

461
00:23:03,355 --> 00:23:04,493
PROBST:
Here's what's gonna happen.

462
00:23:04,597 --> 00:23:05,700
Three of you are
going to the sanctuary,

463
00:23:05,804 --> 00:23:07,666
three of you going back to camp.

464
00:23:07,769 --> 00:23:09,080
Tonight, Tribal Council.

465
00:23:09,183 --> 00:23:11,183
somebody will be
the 13th person voted out,

466
00:23:11,286 --> 00:23:13,011
become the sixth member
of our jury.

467
00:23:13,114 --> 00:23:14,562
It won't be you.
Bring in the boat.

468
00:23:16,217 --> 00:23:18,011
[squeals]

469
00:23:18,114 --> 00:23:19,700
Limo service.

470
00:23:19,804 --> 00:23:21,080
- Fiji limo service.
- TEENY: Yeah!

471
00:23:23,321 --> 00:23:26,666
All right, head over,
board your <i>Survivor</i> limo.

472
00:23:26,769 --> 00:23:28,804
- Yeah. [laughing]
- Enjoy your afternoon
at the sanctuary.

473
00:23:28,907 --> 00:23:30,424
- Thank you.
- Have fun.

474
00:23:30,528 --> 00:23:33,148
GENEVIEVE:
Desserts!

475
00:23:34,493 --> 00:23:37,011
PROBST: Enjoy.

476
00:23:37,114 --> 00:23:38,286
PROBST:
Andy, Rachel, Sam,
got nothing for you.

477
00:23:38,390 --> 00:23:39,976
Swim out. See you tonight
at Tribal Council.

478
00:23:40,080 --> 00:23:41,873
<i>RACHEL:
Genevieve beat me.</i>

479
00:23:41,976 --> 00:23:44,838
<i>So, the majority of the votes
are going to fall on me tonight.</i>

480
00:23:44,942 --> 00:23:46,907
<i>But I have a Block a Vote, and</i>

481
00:23:47,011 --> 00:23:48,907
if I play my idol, Sue and I

482
00:23:49,011 --> 00:23:51,114
get to decide who goes home.

483
00:23:51,217 --> 00:23:53,321
<i>There is, like,
a pleasure in the fact</i>

484
00:23:53,424 --> 00:23:55,286
<i>that Sue and I</i>

485
00:23:55,390 --> 00:23:58,390
have this power
over this larger group today.

486
00:24:04,045 --> 00:24:05,666
♪ ♪

487
00:24:08,631 --> 00:24:10,838
- TEENY: Oh, my goodness.
- Oh, my God.

488
00:24:10,942 --> 00:24:12,769
- SUE: Oh, my gosh.
TEENY: Wine.
- GENEVIEVE: Oh, my.

489
00:24:12,873 --> 00:24:15,148
- Run, Genevieve.
- Go, Genevieve!

490
00:24:15,252 --> 00:24:17,355
Oh, my God.

491
00:24:17,459 --> 00:24:19,286
Wow.

492
00:24:19,390 --> 00:24:21,597
I'm going to inhale
every last bite of this.

493
00:24:21,700 --> 00:24:22,942
- Oh, my God!
- Genevieve,

494
00:24:23,045 --> 00:24:25,528
- thank you.
- [Genevieve shrieks]

495
00:24:25,631 --> 00:24:26,735
<i>I win this immunity challenge,</i>

496
00:24:26,838 --> 00:24:29,838
which I am thrilled about.

497
00:24:29,942 --> 00:24:31,459
Never doubted myself.

498
00:24:31,562 --> 00:24:33,597
JK. Doubted myself
the whole time,

499
00:24:33,700 --> 00:24:36,045
but pulled it out,
and I'm very proud.

500
00:24:36,148 --> 00:24:38,321
- Wow. I'll start by pouring us.
- SUE: Okay.

501
00:24:38,424 --> 00:24:39,804
- GENEVIEVE: Thank you.
- Let's not waste
a single second.

502
00:24:39,907 --> 00:24:41,114
- GENEVIEVE:
Pass me the juice, please.
- Yes.

503
00:24:41,217 --> 00:24:42,459
TEENY:
I'll pass on the juice for now.

504
00:24:42,562 --> 00:24:44,114
I got.. I got my juice.

505
00:24:44,217 --> 00:24:46,976
- Let me know
when anybody wants a refill.
- SUE: Okay.

506
00:24:47,080 --> 00:24:48,804
<i>GENEVIEVE:
My main objective is,</i>

507
00:24:48,907 --> 00:24:52,597
<i>have a nice time with
these two women that I have had</i>

508
00:24:52,700 --> 00:24:55,045
up-and-down relationships with
throughout the game.

509
00:24:55,148 --> 00:24:57,183
<i>I need to convince them</i>

510
00:24:57,286 --> 00:24:58,838
<i>that Rachel's the biggest target
to everyone,</i>

511
00:24:58,942 --> 00:25:01,597
<i>and I don't want
to push too aggressively</i>

512
00:25:01,700 --> 00:25:02,942
at this point.

513
00:25:03,045 --> 00:25:04,493
I'm voting for Rachel.

514
00:25:07,907 --> 00:25:10,217
I see her as the-the biggest
sort of obstacle

515
00:25:10,321 --> 00:25:11,838
for me getting to the end.

516
00:25:11,942 --> 00:25:13,873
What are you thinking, Teeny?

517
00:25:13,976 --> 00:25:16,114
TEENY:
I will never beat her
in a puzzle.

518
00:25:16,217 --> 00:25:18,700
I will never beat her in fire,

519
00:25:18,804 --> 00:25:21,080
and I kind of want
to eliminate that option.

520
00:25:21,183 --> 00:25:24,493
<i>SUE: Genevieve and Teeny
are going for Rachel,</i>

521
00:25:24,597 --> 00:25:27,424
but I know she has an idol.
She's playing her idol.

522
00:25:27,528 --> 00:25:30,804
<i>So whoever Rachel and I
decide to vote for</i>

523
00:25:30,907 --> 00:25:32,700
will go home tonight.

524
00:25:32,804 --> 00:25:35,597
- GENEVIEVE: Um, I'm gonna die.
- Let Teeny fill up.

525
00:25:35,700 --> 00:25:37,114
GENEVIEVE:
I'm not filling up anymore.

526
00:25:37,217 --> 00:25:38,769
- Did you put more wine
in our glasses?
- Yes.

527
00:25:38,873 --> 00:25:41,080
[laughing]

528
00:25:41,183 --> 00:25:42,631
GENEVIEVE:
Yeah.

529
00:25:42,735 --> 00:25:44,562
Okay, so when we get back
to camp, what do I tell Rachel?

530
00:25:44,666 --> 00:25:47,183
- Oh, yeah.
- I think she knows.

531
00:25:47,286 --> 00:25:49,355
That's something I also wanted
to say to you is that, like,

532
00:25:49,459 --> 00:25:51,735
when you didn't play that idol,
I was...

533
00:25:53,838 --> 00:25:55,666
[laughing]: I have
a secret idol that no one...

534
00:25:55,769 --> 00:25:57,942
Oh! Hmm.

535
00:25:58,045 --> 00:26:00,666
The hypothetical idol
that I don't know exists.

536
00:26:00,769 --> 00:26:03,493
<i>Because I had a little red wine
in my system,</i>

537
00:26:03,597 --> 00:26:05,528
<i>I told Sue</i>

538
00:26:05,631 --> 00:26:08,148
<i>that Genevieve has an idol.</i>

539
00:26:08,252 --> 00:26:10,148
And instantly,

540
00:26:10,252 --> 00:26:12,011
I'm just face-palming myself.

541
00:26:12,114 --> 00:26:14,666
<i>And I just started to be</i>

542
00:26:14,769 --> 00:26:16,528
<i>in good with Genevieve again.
So,</i>

543
00:26:16,631 --> 00:26:19,114
I know I made a mistake.

544
00:26:19,217 --> 00:26:21,321
The red wine's talking now.

545
00:26:21,424 --> 00:26:24,183
<i>I've revealed myself
as the 23-year-old I am</i>

546
00:26:24,286 --> 00:26:26,252
in that I can't
get a few drinks in me

547
00:26:26,355 --> 00:26:28,424
without spilling the secrets

548
00:26:28,528 --> 00:26:30,700
that are really,
really important

549
00:26:30,804 --> 00:26:32,114
to people in this game.

550
00:26:32,217 --> 00:26:33,321
You did good, girl.

551
00:26:33,424 --> 00:26:35,080
- Good job.
- Thank you.

552
00:26:35,183 --> 00:26:36,907
<i>Teeny has now let</i>

553
00:26:37,011 --> 00:26:40,011
<i>my idol secret spill to Sue.</i>

554
00:26:40,114 --> 00:26:41,528
I don't care.

555
00:26:41,631 --> 00:26:43,666
It's not an idol.

556
00:26:43,769 --> 00:26:45,252
But the more people

557
00:26:45,355 --> 00:26:47,252
<i>that think it is, the better</i>

558
00:26:47,355 --> 00:26:48,631
<i>for my game.
I mean,</i>

559
00:26:48,735 --> 00:26:50,217
I should be thanking you.
This is amazing

560
00:26:50,321 --> 00:26:51,735
for my game.
Great job.

561
00:26:51,838 --> 00:26:54,080
<i>Keep it up.
I'll give you a refill here.</i>

562
00:26:54,183 --> 00:26:56,597
Tell her more about how real
this fake idol is. Go for it.

563
00:26:56,700 --> 00:26:58,942
- [burps] Sorry.
- [laughs] Oh, my...

564
00:26:59,045 --> 00:27:01,424
<i>There's an undeniable amount</i>

565
00:27:01,528 --> 00:27:05,217
of good fortune
hitting me on day 23.

566
00:27:12,459 --> 00:27:14,424
RACHEL: Think you can
beat Genevieve, Sam?

567
00:27:14,528 --> 00:27:16,217
No.

568
00:27:16,321 --> 00:27:18,355
Why'd you guys
all hand her the ... game?

569
00:27:18,459 --> 00:27:19,873
'Cause I think you both
could have beat me

570
00:27:19,976 --> 00:27:21,976
more... better than you could
have beaten Genevieve.

571
00:27:22,080 --> 00:27:24,321
And I don't understand.

572
00:27:24,424 --> 00:27:27,286
- How do you feel
about your big move, Andy?
- [weak chuckle]

573
00:27:27,390 --> 00:27:29,804
<i>SAM:
It's three Gata members--
me, Andy and Rachel--</i>

574
00:27:29,907 --> 00:27:32,769
<i>sitting on a beach, day 23.</i>

575
00:27:32,873 --> 00:27:36,011
We've all kind of been on this
roller coaster of a game,

576
00:27:36,114 --> 00:27:37,942
weaving in and out
of one another,

577
00:27:38,045 --> 00:27:40,355
coming after one another,
trying to work in harmony.

578
00:27:40,459 --> 00:27:44,045
<i>And so, this is an opportunity
with Rachel</i>

579
00:27:44,148 --> 00:27:47,286
<i>to clear the air,
to lay out all my cards.</i>

580
00:27:47,390 --> 00:27:49,666
Like, I feel like I laid a lot
of my cards out for you

581
00:27:49,769 --> 00:27:51,666
because I was looking for,

582
00:27:51,769 --> 00:27:54,252
like, who wanted
to play the game with me.

583
00:27:54,355 --> 00:27:56,666
I feel like you heard me,

584
00:27:56,769 --> 00:27:59,735
but wanted to play
with Sue and Caroline

585
00:27:59,838 --> 00:28:01,493
and Teeny and Andy,

586
00:28:01,597 --> 00:28:03,562
and I wasn't really
part of your plans.

587
00:28:03,666 --> 00:28:05,873
So, I had to find another way

588
00:28:05,976 --> 00:28:08,321
to move forward in the game,

589
00:28:08,424 --> 00:28:10,528
so...

590
00:28:10,631 --> 00:28:12,976
I do think you would
win the game if you got there.

591
00:28:13,080 --> 00:28:15,804
It might be difficult for you
to see, being you, but...

592
00:28:15,907 --> 00:28:17,838
It is difficult for me to see.

593
00:28:17,942 --> 00:28:19,942
<i>SAM:
Today was the first time
in the game</i>

594
00:28:20,045 --> 00:28:22,114
<i>that I've been very direct
with somebody</i>

595
00:28:22,217 --> 00:28:23,528
<i>about where
my vote was gonna go.</i>

596
00:28:23,631 --> 00:28:26,321
And you're always
hesitant in <i>Survivor</i>

597
00:28:26,424 --> 00:28:29,355
to, like, let your target know
that they're your target.

598
00:28:29,459 --> 00:28:31,769
That could backfire on you.

599
00:28:31,873 --> 00:28:34,355
But in the moment, it just
kind of felt right to me.

600
00:28:34,459 --> 00:28:35,873
It felt like

601
00:28:35,976 --> 00:28:38,631
the closing
of the book of Gata.

602
00:28:38,735 --> 00:28:40,804
It's hard decisions, man.

603
00:28:40,907 --> 00:28:43,355
I know. I don't...
None of it's personal.

604
00:28:43,459 --> 00:28:44,873
Like, just know that, like,

605
00:28:44,976 --> 00:28:47,080
I'm pissed, but I'm pissed
because I'm just like,

606
00:28:47,183 --> 00:28:48,838
"God, this is close." You know?

607
00:28:48,942 --> 00:28:50,355
- Yeah.
- Sucks to get this close.

608
00:28:50,459 --> 00:28:52,907
It sucks to...
Yeah, you're right.

609
00:28:53,011 --> 00:28:53,907
<i>RACHEL: Just sitting there</i>

610
00:28:54,011 --> 00:28:55,252
with these two guys

611
00:28:55,355 --> 00:28:56,459
who I've been with
since day one--

612
00:28:56,562 --> 00:28:58,597
<i>it's a little bittersweet.</i>

613
00:28:58,700 --> 00:29:00,631
Genuinely, this is a game to me,

614
00:29:00,735 --> 00:29:02,114
and it always has been.

615
00:29:02,217 --> 00:29:04,769
So... like, I love you guys.

616
00:29:05,942 --> 00:29:07,907
We will hang out after this.

617
00:29:08,011 --> 00:29:09,424
- [laughs]
- Yeah.

618
00:29:09,528 --> 00:29:12,355
And I'm not mad at you.
I'm mad at myself.

619
00:29:12,459 --> 00:29:15,907
Today was my ... challenge
to lose, and I'm so mad.

620
00:29:16,011 --> 00:29:17,942
I'm so mad that I lost it.

621
00:29:18,045 --> 00:29:20,597
I knew everything
was riding on it.

622
00:29:24,286 --> 00:29:26,942
<i>There's, like, a brotherly sense
to them, right?</i>

623
00:29:27,045 --> 00:29:29,080
<i>We've been here for 23 days,
but it genuinely</i>

624
00:29:29,183 --> 00:29:30,597
feels like I've known these guys
for, like,

625
00:29:30,700 --> 00:29:32,459
at least a year or two
at this point.

626
00:29:32,562 --> 00:29:36,080
<i>And so, I think today,
it just kind of all hit.</i>

627
00:29:36,183 --> 00:29:39,942
These challenges
are wildly unpredictable.

628
00:29:40,045 --> 00:29:41,907
RACHEL:
I know, but it's a puzzle, man.

629
00:29:42,011 --> 00:29:45,252
<i>But at the same time,
it's just kind of this really</i>

630
00:29:45,355 --> 00:29:47,769
funny dynamic where I'm kind of,

631
00:29:47,873 --> 00:29:49,769
like, playing into

632
00:29:49,873 --> 00:29:52,597
my, you know, "imminent death."

633
00:29:52,700 --> 00:29:54,493
<i>And yet,</i>

634
00:29:54,597 --> 00:29:56,562
<i>I know I'm not dying tonight.</i>

635
00:29:56,666 --> 00:29:59,045
I'm gonna be
waking up here tomorrow

636
00:29:59,148 --> 00:30:01,528
and one of them won't be.

637
00:30:01,631 --> 00:30:03,355
[sniffles]

638
00:30:05,666 --> 00:30:07,286
[laughs]

639
00:30:07,390 --> 00:30:09,424
<i>But if I do not have
to play this idol tonight,</i>

640
00:30:09,528 --> 00:30:11,666
I get to play it tomorrow
and guarantee myself fire,

641
00:30:11,769 --> 00:30:14,080
<i>which is even better for me.</i>

642
00:30:14,183 --> 00:30:16,183
<i>And so, I want
to connect with Andy.</i>

643
00:30:16,286 --> 00:30:18,355
I want to be real
with Andy, and...

644
00:30:18,459 --> 00:30:21,873
I want him to kind of try and
see my perspective and see why

645
00:30:21,976 --> 00:30:25,321
<i>Sam is a better vote
than me tonight.</i>

646
00:30:25,424 --> 00:30:27,700
From what I've heard when
people chatter about Andy...

647
00:30:27,804 --> 00:30:29,355
Mm-hmm.

648
00:30:29,459 --> 00:30:31,321
...it's never been in the sense
of, like, you're a threat.

649
00:30:31,424 --> 00:30:33,769
- Mm-hmm.
- And so, I think
you do have an uphill battle.

650
00:30:33,873 --> 00:30:36,321
- Yeah.
- And I think

651
00:30:36,424 --> 00:30:37,873
if you and Sam
sat there tonight,

652
00:30:37,976 --> 00:30:40,424
- Yeah.
- as the final two,
he would win, hands down.

653
00:30:40,528 --> 00:30:41,735
Mm-hmm. Yeah.

654
00:30:41,838 --> 00:30:43,459
I just think right now,

655
00:30:43,562 --> 00:30:45,907
- the perception of you
with the jury is relatively low.
- Mm-hmm.

656
00:30:48,631 --> 00:30:49,700
- It's not, like, bad.
- Yeah, yeah, yeah. Yeah.

657
00:30:49,804 --> 00:30:51,666
But it's also not good.

658
00:30:51,769 --> 00:30:52,873
And I think Sam has...

659
00:30:53,907 --> 00:30:55,424
<i>...better relationships,</i>

660
00:30:55,528 --> 00:30:57,493
<i>and I think that
I would lose votes to him,</i>

661
00:30:57,597 --> 00:30:59,735
- even if I sat next to him.
- Yeah.

662
00:30:59,838 --> 00:31:01,321
<i>ANDY: It's very clear</i>

663
00:31:01,424 --> 00:31:03,562
<i>that the conventional
long-running narrative is</i>

664
00:31:03,666 --> 00:31:06,114
<i>that I am not a threat, and Sam
is a threat, and Sam is a threat</i>

665
00:31:06,217 --> 00:31:09,011
because he is someone
who can definitely garner

666
00:31:09,114 --> 00:31:10,976
a lot of jury votes
in the end of the game.

667
00:31:11,080 --> 00:31:13,735
Your superpower is that the way

668
00:31:13,838 --> 00:31:15,769
you move around the world
is, like,

669
00:31:15,873 --> 00:31:19,011
a little careless, genuinely.

670
00:31:19,114 --> 00:31:21,562
And.... because of that,

671
00:31:21,666 --> 00:31:23,562
- people underestimate you.
- Mm-hmm. Mm-hmm.

672
00:31:23,666 --> 00:31:24,907
<i>I'm sick of it.</i>

673
00:31:25,011 --> 00:31:26,907
I'm sick of being underestimated
in this game,

674
00:31:27,011 --> 00:31:28,493
because you just want
to be out here,

675
00:31:28,597 --> 00:31:30,321
and you want to be known
as a capable player.

676
00:31:30,424 --> 00:31:31,666
I think
you do have a better story

677
00:31:31,769 --> 00:31:33,424
against me
than you do against Sam.

678
00:31:33,528 --> 00:31:35,493
You've deceived me
multiple times.

679
00:31:35,597 --> 00:31:36,942
<i>ANDY:
I've gained a lot of confidence</i>

680
00:31:37,045 --> 00:31:38,907
<i>in my decision-making, but I can</i>

681
00:31:39,011 --> 00:31:41,493
<i>kind of maybe
feel the pressure of</i>

682
00:31:41,597 --> 00:31:44,183
how important
this vote is for my game.

683
00:31:44,286 --> 00:31:47,804
I'm-I'm pretty sick of lying
to you, though. I don't like it.

684
00:31:47,907 --> 00:31:49,838
So, I don't have an answer
right now.

685
00:31:49,942 --> 00:31:51,286
Yeah, no rush.

686
00:31:51,390 --> 00:31:52,804
<i>ANDY:
At this point,</i>

687
00:31:52,907 --> 00:31:55,562
<i>I need my perception to turn.
So,</i>

688
00:31:55,666 --> 00:31:57,838
I'm closing zero doors
right now.

689
00:31:57,942 --> 00:32:00,045
Absolutely zero doors, and
I don't know what I'm gonna do.

690
00:32:00,148 --> 00:32:01,769
[laughs]

691
00:32:06,114 --> 00:32:08,114
♪ ♪

692
00:32:16,700 --> 00:32:18,252
SAM:
Hi.

693
00:32:18,355 --> 00:32:19,597
Hi.

694
00:32:19,700 --> 00:32:21,080
- ANDY: How was it?
- Good.

695
00:32:21,183 --> 00:32:22,907
- Hello, Beka.
- SAM: Hello.

696
00:32:24,700 --> 00:32:26,148
TEENY:
Full.

697
00:32:26,252 --> 00:32:27,597
<i>GENEVIEVE:
Coming back to camp,</i>

698
00:32:27,700 --> 00:32:31,321
I need to make sure
that the obvious, easy vote

699
00:32:31,424 --> 00:32:33,942
of Rachel stays the vote.

700
00:32:34,045 --> 00:32:37,217
<i>And the thing
that worries me is</i>

701
00:32:37,321 --> 00:32:39,114
<i>when things feel obvious
and easy,</i>

702
00:32:39,217 --> 00:32:41,252
<i>that's when players</i>

703
00:32:41,355 --> 00:32:43,459
<i>think "maybe now is a good time</i>

704
00:32:43,562 --> 00:32:45,907
<i>to do something," you know?</i>

705
00:32:46,011 --> 00:32:47,355
And I want to make sure
everyone knows,

706
00:32:47,459 --> 00:32:49,804
<i>"Tonight, let's not
do something crazy.</i>

707
00:32:49,907 --> 00:32:51,838
Let's just do Rachel."

708
00:32:55,976 --> 00:32:58,286
- What do you mean?
- You mean she yelled at you?

709
00:32:58,390 --> 00:33:01,493
She's like, "I hope you enjoyed
your move last night."

710
00:33:01,597 --> 00:33:04,321
- Oh, I'm sorry, Andy.
- ANDY: That's okay.

711
00:33:04,424 --> 00:33:07,597
It was literally, like,
we sat there

712
00:33:07,700 --> 00:33:09,838
and acknowledged the fact
that we were voting her out.

713
00:33:09,942 --> 00:33:11,562
- Did you?
- Yeah.

714
00:33:11,666 --> 00:33:15,459
<i>SAM:
Right now, I feel very uneasy.</i>

715
00:33:15,562 --> 00:33:17,873
I think
I'm Rachel's target tonight.

716
00:33:17,976 --> 00:33:19,804
I think
Rachel's coming after me.

717
00:33:19,907 --> 00:33:22,804
<i>She doesn't realize how big
of a threat Andy is right now,</i>

718
00:33:22,907 --> 00:33:25,424
<i>and Genevieve is immune, so,</i>

719
00:33:25,528 --> 00:33:27,976
I think if there's
a hiccup tonight,

720
00:33:28,080 --> 00:33:29,390
I'm in a lot of trouble.

721
00:33:29,493 --> 00:33:31,252
Andy, what are you thinking?

722
00:33:31,355 --> 00:33:32,666
- Truth-Truthfully?
- SUE: Yeah.

723
00:33:32,769 --> 00:33:35,528
This is the endgame.
I'm weighing my options.

724
00:33:41,252 --> 00:33:44,217
Would we be, like, a final three
if I were to vote with you?

725
00:33:44,321 --> 00:33:45,942
- Yes.
- We'd be a final three?

726
00:33:46,045 --> 00:33:47,976
I mean, we don't have loyalty
to any of those other people.

727
00:33:48,080 --> 00:33:49,700
- Right.
- Yeah.

728
00:33:49,804 --> 00:33:51,424
And no one else
has given us a bone.

729
00:33:51,528 --> 00:33:52,976
Yeah.

730
00:33:53,080 --> 00:33:54,321
RACHEL:
I would not vote you out

731
00:33:54,424 --> 00:33:56,252
tomorrow if you saved me today.

732
00:33:56,355 --> 00:33:57,631
- Mm-hmm.
- I promise you that.

733
00:33:57,735 --> 00:33:58,976
You promise?

734
00:33:59,080 --> 00:34:00,355
I promise.
Do you promise him that?

735
00:34:00,459 --> 00:34:02,424
I promise that I will not
vote you out tomorrow.

736
00:34:03,976 --> 00:34:07,148
<i>ANDY:
The logistics of Rachel's pitch
are pretty clear.</i>

737
00:34:07,252 --> 00:34:09,873
<i>With her Block a Vote Advantage,
you do the numbers,</i>

738
00:34:09,976 --> 00:34:11,390
<i>it's not hard to see that</i>

739
00:34:11,493 --> 00:34:14,321
Rachel just needs two people
on her side,

740
00:34:14,424 --> 00:34:15,597
<i>and she believes
she has Sue already.</i>

741
00:34:15,700 --> 00:34:17,080
<i>So if she could</i>

742
00:34:17,183 --> 00:34:19,976
just swing just me,
just little old me, over to her,

743
00:34:20,080 --> 00:34:23,631
<i>then we can become the majority
on a final five.</i>

744
00:34:23,735 --> 00:34:26,286
Now... that's interesting.

745
00:34:26,390 --> 00:34:28,321
- Yeah.
- RACHEL: I think
that it was clear that

746
00:34:28,424 --> 00:34:31,873
you're in dead last because
Genevieve would have taken Sam.

747
00:34:31,976 --> 00:34:34,080
She didn't.
She then took Teeny and Sue

748
00:34:34,183 --> 00:34:35,735
- and not you.
- Yeah.

749
00:34:35,838 --> 00:34:38,114
<i>If I look at this game so far,</i>

750
00:34:38,217 --> 00:34:39,666
I've been on a real hot streak,

751
00:34:39,769 --> 00:34:42,045
and I've been pulling off
really cool moves

752
00:34:42,148 --> 00:34:43,493
that I could sell to a jury.

753
00:34:43,597 --> 00:34:46,493
<i>And so, what if I go
with Rachel and Sue?</i>

754
00:34:46,597 --> 00:34:47,976
<i>What if I knock someone out</i>

755
00:34:48,080 --> 00:34:50,321
<i>that I've been working with
very recently?</i>

756
00:34:50,424 --> 00:34:52,045
I mean, that's
a pretty bold move.

757
00:34:52,148 --> 00:34:55,011
- Yeah, it's a big decision
for me, for sure.
- Yeah.

758
00:34:55,114 --> 00:34:57,080
<i>ANDY:
This decision is, like,
it's game-breaking</i>

759
00:34:57,183 --> 00:34:58,631
<i>if it's not correct.</i>

760
00:34:58,735 --> 00:35:00,631
<i>And if I make
the right decision,</i>

761
00:35:00,735 --> 00:35:02,321
<i>I think I'm ready to just</i>

762
00:35:02,424 --> 00:35:06,011
keep hitting my stride, and...
and go on to win this game.

763
00:35:07,183 --> 00:35:08,562
SUE: You have to.

764
00:35:08,666 --> 00:35:10,148
You have to play your idol.

765
00:35:10,252 --> 00:35:12,183
I was hoping...

766
00:35:12,286 --> 00:35:13,976
- You're not swaying them.
- Okay.

767
00:35:14,080 --> 00:35:15,666
- They're all against you.
Teeny's against you, too.
- I believe you.

768
00:35:15,769 --> 00:35:17,217
- I promise you.
- I know she is.

769
00:35:17,321 --> 00:35:19,735
I was hoping...
Andy's a very rational player.

770
00:35:19,838 --> 00:35:21,252
I was hoping by appealing...

771
00:35:21,355 --> 00:35:22,735
No, he ratted you out.

772
00:35:22,838 --> 00:35:24,942
He just told everybody
what you said to him.

773
00:35:25,045 --> 00:35:26,321
Everything.

774
00:35:26,424 --> 00:35:28,252
- Don't trust him.
- Okay.

775
00:35:28,355 --> 00:35:30,459
<i>SUE:
My loyalty to Rachel is real,</i>

776
00:35:30,562 --> 00:35:34,045
<i>and so, I'm gonna go with
what she wants to do.</i>

777
00:35:34,148 --> 00:35:35,769
<i>Every single person</i>

778
00:35:35,873 --> 00:35:38,424
<i>thinks that Rachel is</i>

779
00:35:38,528 --> 00:35:41,666
absolutely going home.

780
00:35:42,666 --> 00:35:43,700
Yes.

781
00:35:47,873 --> 00:35:49,631
- It'll be announced
before the vote?
- No, it'll be when he goes

782
00:35:49,735 --> 00:35:52,183
- up to the booth,
it will just say he can't vote.
- Okay.

783
00:35:54,459 --> 00:35:55,735
Yeah. Yeah.

784
00:35:55,838 --> 00:35:56,907
Okay.

785
00:35:57,011 --> 00:35:58,080
<i>SUE:
Meanwhile,</i>

786
00:35:58,183 --> 00:35:59,942
I know she has an idol,

- Great job, Rachel.

1026
00:49:19,286 --> 00:49:21,011
TEENY:
Rachel with the first idol play

1027
00:49:21,114 --> 00:49:22,597
of the post-jury phase
of the game.

1028
00:49:22,700 --> 00:49:23,907
Great job, Rachel.

1029
00:49:24,011 --> 00:49:25,597
- Rachel...
- How long have you had that?

1030
00:49:28,045 --> 00:49:29,217
TEENY: Shut up.

1031
00:49:31,735 --> 00:49:33,252
- Oh.
- Can you explain, though.
- I would love to share,

1032
00:49:33,355 --> 00:49:34,700
but I also...

1033
00:49:38,355 --> 00:49:41,252
<i>RACHEL:
The emotion
during that Tribal was</i>

1034
00:49:41,355 --> 00:49:44,286

1035
00:49:44,390 --> 00:49:47,562
<i>We had my funeral procession</i>

1036

<i>and little did they know that</i>

1037
00:49:50,217 --> 00:49:53,217
<i>I had an idol in my pocket, and</i>

1038
00:49:53,321 --> 00:49:55,873
I would wake up

1039
00:49:55,976 --> 00:49:57,286

1040

1041

- That is amazing.
- RACHEL: Um,

1042
00:50:01,631 --> 00:50:03,045
I'm very curious
where you got yours.

1043
00:50:09,942 --> 00:50:11,562
- SUE: What? What?!
- You're frick...
No, you're lying.

1044
00:50:11,666 --> 00:50:12,666
- SUE: No frickin' way.
- Oh, my God.

1045
00:50:13,597 --> 00:50:14,873
GENEVIEVE: So...

1046
00:50:14,976 --> 00:50:17,355
<i>So my idol is totally fake,</i>

1047
00:50:17,459 --> 00:50:20,562
<i>and only Sam is left in the game

1048
00:50:20,666 --> 00:50:22,252
<i>So,</i>

1049
00:50:22,355 --> 00:50:26,148
I guess the age-old advice of
"fake it till you make it" can

1050
00:50:26,252 --> 00:50:27,735
<i>even work in</i> Survivor.

1051
00:50:27,838 --> 00:50:29,528
<i>You just have to fan
those flames a little bit,</i>

1052
00:50:29,631 --> 00:50:32,355

1053
00:50:32,459 --> 00:50:34,321

you've got an idol.

1054

RACHEL:
I wanted to have the necklace
today so that I could

1055
00:50:36,217 --> 00:50:37,493

1056

You winning today

1057
00:50:39,804 --> 00:50:41,597
- [laughs]
- GENEVIEVE: Well,
I'm sorry, Rachel,

1058
00:50:41,700 --> 00:50:43,597
but I'm gonna have to try
and win tomorrow now, too,

1059
00:50:43,700 --> 00:50:46,528
- Um, yeah, samesies.
- because I still have
a Rachel problem in this game.

1060
00:50:46,631 --> 00:50:48,493
<i>RACHEL:
Genevieve and I
have kind of been</i>

1061
00:50:48,597 --> 00:50:50,148
<i>dancing around each other.</i>

1062
00:50:50,252 --> 00:50:53,217
<i>We both recognized each other
the second we merged.</i>

1063
00:50:53,321 --> 00:50:54,562
<i>I never trusted her</i>

1064
00:50:54,666 --> 00:50:56,493
<i>and she never trusted me
because I think</i>

1065
00:50:56,597 --> 00:50:58,631
like just recognized like,

1066
00:50:58,735 --> 00:51:00,562
and we just knew

1067
00:51:00,666 --> 00:51:03,562
that we were gonna
be adversaries in this game.

1068
00:51:05,080 --> 00:51:07,597
I should not care
about getting firewood.

1069
00:51:09,080 --> 00:51:10,355
I know.

1070
00:51:10,459 --> 00:51:11,804
<i>GENEVIEVE:
Rachel and I don't bother</i>

1071
00:51:11,907 --> 00:51:14,424
<i>hiding the fact that</i>

1072
00:51:14,528 --> 00:51:15,804

1073
00:51:15,907 --> 00:51:17,528
<i>I definitely look at her</i>

1074
00:51:17,631 --> 00:51:19,631
<i>as someone who
I don't want to sit next to.</i>

1075
00:51:19,735 --> 00:51:22,080
<i>I think she will win the game,</i>

1076
00:51:22,183 --> 00:51:24,907
<i>and it sounds like
she may feel similarly about me.</i>

1077
00:51:25,011 --> 00:51:28,217
And so, it really is one
of those situations where

1078
00:51:28,321 --> 00:51:31,114
<i>this island isn't big enough
for the both of us.</i>

1079
00:51:31,217 --> 00:51:33,735
<i>And so,
it's Genevieve vs. Rachel.</i>

1080
00:51:39,424 --> 00:51:41,424
♪ ♪

1081
00:52:00,424 --> 00:52:02,666
What time do you think
she went out?

1082
00:52:02,769 --> 00:52:04,355
- I mean...
- I mean...

1083
00:52:04,459 --> 00:52:06,114
Yeah, she might already have it.

1084
00:52:06,217 --> 00:52:08,217
Let's find out.

1085
00:52:10,286 --> 00:52:12,597
Day 24.
It's about time

1086
00:52:12,700 --> 00:52:15,045
we search someone's bag
for stuff.

1087
00:52:15,148 --> 00:52:17,217
- TEENY: Check the pockets.
- Yeah.

1088
00:52:18,804 --> 00:52:19,942
Nothing there.

1089
00:52:20,907 --> 00:52:22,769
Nothing there.

1090
00:52:23,804 --> 00:52:26,976
<i>As happy as I am to have
made it through Tribal Council,</i>

1091
00:52:27,080 --> 00:52:28,907
I am so irritated

1092
00:52:29,011 --> 00:52:30,976
that Rachel
is still in this game.

1093
00:52:31,080 --> 00:52:32,907
I have been targeting her

1094
00:52:33,011 --> 00:52:35,528
<i>for days and days now,</i>

1095
00:52:35,631 --> 00:52:36,942
<i>and she's still here.</i>

1096
00:52:37,045 --> 00:52:39,217
Got to make sure
there's no surprises.

1097
00:52:39,321 --> 00:52:40,907
Last night was not fun.

1098
00:52:41,011 --> 00:52:42,838
<i>Because Rachel played an idol,</i>

1099
00:52:42,942 --> 00:52:44,976
<i>I have to think
there is one out here somewhere.</i>

1100
00:52:45,080 --> 00:52:46,390
<i>And I know, for me,</i>

1101
00:52:46,493 --> 00:52:48,528
I can't let Rachel get it.

1102

GENEVIEVE: I don't think
it would be in her bag.

1103
00:52:53,286 --> 00:52:56,148
<i>SUE: Everyone is thinking that
there is another idol out there,</i>

1104
00:52:56,252 --> 00:52:59,424
<i>and I'm, like, the smart one,
keeping my mouth shut that</i>

1105
00:52:59,528 --> 00:53:01,459
I have a hidden immunity idol.

1106
00:53:03,080 --> 00:53:05,700
- Yeah.
- She's got it, it'll be on her.

1107
00:53:05,804 --> 00:53:09,217
<i>SUE:
This has been my theme
this whole time from day one.</i>

1108
00:53:09,321 --> 00:53:10,804
<i>I know everyone's gonna</i>

1109
00:53:10,907 --> 00:53:12,838
freakin' underestimate me.

1110
00:53:12,942 --> 00:53:15,286
And none of 'em
would even think

1111
00:53:15,390 --> 00:53:16,700
<i>that I would have an idol.</i>

1112
00:53:16,804 --> 00:53:18,114
<i>I freakin' made it
to the final five</i>

1113
00:53:18,217 --> 00:53:21,114
<i>with an idol in my pocket.</i>

1114
00:53:21,217 --> 00:53:23,942
Isn't it crazy?
Isn't this freakin' crazy?

1115
00:53:27,355 --> 00:53:28,562
She's had a lot of good luck
in this game.

1116
00:53:28,666 --> 00:53:30,355
- SAM: Yeah.
- She has.

1117

If she wins today,
it's, like, damn.

1118
00:53:33,217 --> 00:53:36,011
<i>I genuinely love this battle
with Rachel.</i>

1119
00:53:36,114 --> 00:53:37,942
To have Rachel and I as, like,

00:53:38,045 --> 00:53:40,390

professional women

1121

<i>in their 30s going
against each other--</i>

1122
00:53:42,976 --> 00:53:46,355
<i>it makes me feel
really good about</i>

1123
00:53:46,459 --> 00:53:48,183
season 47 of <i>Survivor.</i>

1124
00:53:52,252 --> 00:53:54,252
I can't see anything.

1125
00:53:59,597 --> 00:54:01,424
<i>GENEVIEVE:
It's a little awkward
when I have to kind of</i>

1126
00:54:01,528 --> 00:54:03,493
follow her around camp because

1127
00:54:03,597 --> 00:54:06,011
<i>if she finds an idol,
it's gonna be a problem for me.</i>

1128
00:54:06,114 --> 00:54:08,114
<i>So, babysitting Rachel

1129
00:54:08,217 --> 00:54:09,769
I hate having to do it to her,

1130
00:54:09,873 --> 00:54:12,183
but I'm pretty open
about the fact that,

1131
00:54:12,286 --> 00:54:14,873
<i>"I'm sorry, Rachel.
I have to follow you everywhere</i>

1132
00:54:14,976 --> 00:54:16,666
and make sure you lose today
and vote you out."

1133
00:54:16,769 --> 00:54:19,011
If you find a second idol...

1134
00:54:19,114 --> 00:54:21,114
I swear to God, Genevieve...

1135
00:54:21,217 --> 00:54:23,080
It's a fun relationship
we have in this game.

1136
00:54:23,183 --> 00:54:25,114
The best frenemy
I could have asked for.

1137
00:54:25,217 --> 00:54:27,700
[laughs]
Mm. Agreed.

1138
00:54:27,804 --> 00:54:29,907
<i>RACHEL:
Genevieve and I will be going
head-to-head,</i>

1139
00:54:30,011 --> 00:54:32,045
<i>but I'm happy to have somebody</i>

1140
00:54:32,148 --> 00:54:35,390

I really genuinely respect

1141
00:54:35,493 --> 00:54:37,390
<i>to, like, showdown with
in this game.</i>

1142
00:54:37,493 --> 00:54:38,873
<i>We are going</i>

1143
00:54:38,976 --> 00:54:41,804

1144

Here's my question.
If neither of us

1145
00:54:43,114 --> 00:54:44,390

1146
00:54:45,597 --> 00:54:46,631
Sam.

1147
00:54:48,286 --> 00:54:49,769
I'm so proud of us.

1148
00:54:49,873 --> 00:54:51,562
- Final five. Like...
- Twenty-four. 24.

1149
00:54:51,666 --> 00:54:54,183
I will never get over it
in my life.

1150
00:54:54,286 --> 00:54:55,562
- Like, this is just insane.
- Crazy.

1151
00:54:55,666 --> 00:54:57,011
Twenty-four.

1152
00:54:59,045 --> 00:55:00,597
SAM:
Tonight's the last time
we vote.

1153
00:55:00,700 --> 00:55:02,769
SUE:
Okay. So, what bothers me

1154
00:55:02,873 --> 00:55:05,528
is that, last night,

1155
00:55:05,631 --> 00:55:07,493
- when they both came back,
they're just
- The two-- the two of them

1156
00:55:07,597 --> 00:55:09,459
- coming back here talking about
how great each other are...
- TEENY: Oh!

1157
00:55:09,562 --> 00:55:11,838
- Dude!
- SUE: To me, that's--
I can't stand showboating.

1158
00:55:11,942 --> 00:55:13,562
SAM:
Like, sitting in front
of the other three people

1159
00:55:13,666 --> 00:55:15,080
being like,
"One of us is gonna win."

1160
00:55:15,183 --> 00:55:16,528
- Like they're so confident.
- Like, I was like,

1161
00:55:16,631 --> 00:55:18,907
"You're really, like,
that sure that we all suck?"

1162
00:55:19,011 --> 00:55:20,631
- Yeah.
- SUE: That's exactly how I felt.

1163
00:55:20,735 --> 00:55:22,666
"Do you see that
we're sitting here with you?"

1164
00:55:22,769 --> 00:55:25,355
<i>I'm very annoyed
at Rachel and Genevieve</i>

1165
00:55:25,459 --> 00:55:26,769
<i>literally thinking
they're the big threats,</i>

1166
00:55:26,873 --> 00:55:28,528
<i>they're the big dogs.</i>

1167
00:55:28,631 --> 00:55:30,390
<i>How they've done this, how
they've done that, and they're</i>

1168
00:55:30,493 --> 00:55:32,390
just ready
to duke it out together.

1169
00:55:32,493 --> 00:55:33,873
There's three other people

1170
00:55:33,976 --> 00:55:35,631
<i>still in existence here.</i>

1171
00:55:35,735 --> 00:55:36,976
Like, what about us?

1172
00:55:37,080 --> 00:55:38,597
They think

1173
00:55:38,700 --> 00:55:40,528
it's only now a game
between the two of them.

1174
00:55:40,631 --> 00:55:43,562
- Yes.
- And whichever one of them
gets to the end wins.

1175
00:55:43,666 --> 00:55:45,700
- SAM: Yeah.
- And I actually just
don't think that's true.

1176
00:55:47,769 --> 00:55:49,011
Me too.

1177
00:55:49,114 --> 00:55:51,080
Yeah, it kind of made me mad.

1178
00:55:51,183 --> 00:55:54,217
<i>Genevieve and Rachel
have been talking about how</i>

1179
00:55:54,321 --> 00:55:56,252
<i>they're the two best players,</i>

1180
00:55:56,355 --> 00:55:58,355
<i>one of them is surely
gonna win the season.</i>

1181
00:55:58,459 --> 00:56:01,114
<i>Okay, we'll see about that.</i>

1182
00:56:01,217 --> 00:56:04,045
If I have anything to say about

1183
00:56:08,286 --> 00:56:10,286
♪ ♪

1184
00:56:19,528 --> 00:56:21,114
Come on in!

1185
00:56:28,666 --> 00:56:30,321
There they are.

1186
00:56:30,424 --> 00:56:32,252
Final five.

1187
00:56:32,355 --> 00:56:35,390
What's left of the community.

1188
00:56:35,493 --> 00:56:37,148
[chuckles]

1189
00:56:40,148 --> 00:56:43,735
So, here we are, day 24.

1190
00:56:43,838 --> 00:56:47,045
In your final five challenge,
arguably

1191
00:56:47,148 --> 00:56:50,183
the biggest and most important
challenge of the season,

1192
00:56:50,286 --> 00:56:52,080
because if you
win this challenge,

1193
00:56:52,183 --> 00:56:53,528
you can't be voted out tonight,

1194
00:56:53,631 --> 00:56:55,907
which means you can't
be voted out of this game.

1195
00:56:56,011 --> 00:56:57,873
At the very least,

1196
00:56:57,976 --> 00:56:59,838
you got a shot at making fire.

1197
00:56:59,942 --> 00:57:01,804
So, no matter what happens
in the final four challenge,

1198
00:57:01,907 --> 00:57:04,183
you have that certainty.
Big stakes.

1199
00:57:04,286 --> 00:57:05,493
- Shall we get to it?
- [all voice assent]

1200
00:57:05,597 --> 00:57:06,838
All right, first things first,
Genevieve.

1201
00:57:06,942 --> 00:57:09,183
- Got to take back the necklace.
- Yes, sir.

1202
00:57:10,217 --> 00:57:11,562
Thank you.

1203
00:57:13,080 --> 00:57:14,528
Mm...

1204
00:57:16,080 --> 00:57:19,321
Once again,
immunity is back up for grabs.

1205
00:57:19,424 --> 00:57:21,045
For today's challenge,
you're gonna race in

1206
00:57:21,148 --> 00:57:23,080
<i>from the ocean,</i>

1207
00:57:23,183 --> 00:57:25,217
<i>dig through
a massive pile of sand</i>

1208
00:57:25,321 --> 00:57:26,907
<i>to get under a log.</i>

1209
00:57:27,011 --> 00:57:29,838

on a wobbly beam while using</i>

1210
00:57:29,942 --> 00:57:33,252

to stack balls on stands.</i>

1211
00:57:34,528 --> 00:57:37,355
<i>If your stack drops,
got to start again.</i>

1212
00:57:37,459 --> 00:57:39,873
<i>First player
to stack six balls...</i>

1213
00:57:41,769 --> 00:57:43,873

1214
00:57:43,976 --> 00:57:46,493
