in the final four.

1215
00:57:46,597 --> 00:57:49,735
Losers, Tribal Council,
where somebody will be

1216
00:57:49,838 --> 00:57:51,286
the 14th person voted out,

1217
00:57:51,390 --> 00:57:54,942
become the seventh member
of our jury.

1218
00:57:56,252 --> 00:57:58,045
Let's do it.
We'll get it on. Here we go.

1219
00:58:06,252 --> 00:58:08,217
All right, here we go.

1220
00:58:08,321 --> 00:58:09,459
For immunity and a spot

1221
00:58:09,562 --> 00:58:11,217
in the final four

1222
00:58:11,321 --> 00:58:14,045
of <i>Survivor</i> 47.

1223
00:58:14,148 --> 00:58:15,597
Survivors ready?

1224
00:58:17,769 --> 00:58:18,666
Go!

1225
00:58:18,769 --> 00:58:20,528
First it is a sprint,

1226
00:58:20,631 --> 00:58:24,183
which on day 24 is
more difficult than it sounds.

1227
00:58:24,286 --> 00:58:26,286
Look at that-- Teeny and Sam.

1228
00:58:26,390 --> 00:58:28,493
Here comes Sue,
then Rachel, then Genevieve.

1229
00:58:28,597 --> 00:58:30,321
Now you got
to dig through that sand.

1230
00:58:30,424 --> 00:58:32,666
It's a big pile of sand,

1231
00:58:32,769 --> 00:58:34,321
and you want
to get through it quickly.

1232
00:58:34,424 --> 00:58:36,390
You know how
these challenges go.

1233
00:58:36,493 --> 00:58:39,907
Sometimes it comes down
to a few seconds,

1234
00:58:40,011 --> 00:58:42,631
so every handful
of sand you get matters.

1235
00:58:42,735 --> 00:58:44,942
Sue is through first.

1236
00:58:46,562 --> 00:58:47,666
Here comes Sam.

1237
00:58:47,769 --> 00:58:49,080
- Here comes Teeny.
- [grunts]

1238
00:58:49,183 --> 00:58:50,838
[grunting]

1239
00:58:50,942 --> 00:58:52,700
Rachel's through.

1240
00:58:54,493 --> 00:58:57,873
Genevieve in dead last
through the sand.

1241
00:58:57,976 --> 00:59:01,528
Now you're gonna
stack balls on stands.

1242
00:59:01,631 --> 00:59:04,321
You got to approach
from the back,

1243
00:59:04,424 --> 00:59:06,424
- Whoa, ...
- walk up that wobbly stand,

1244
00:59:06,528 --> 00:59:07,493
and then gently

1245
00:59:07,597 --> 00:59:10,148
place a ball and then a stand.

1246
00:59:12,597 --> 00:59:14,666
- Here comes Genevieve.
- Hate the sand.

1247
00:59:14,769 --> 00:59:18,011
[grunting]
...

1248
00:59:19,080 --> 00:59:21,355
PROBST:
Sue has one ball and one stand.

1249
00:59:21,459 --> 00:59:24,252
Rachel with her first ball
and stand.

1250
00:59:24,355 --> 00:59:27,873
Here comes Genevieve
with her first ball.

1251
00:59:27,976 --> 00:59:29,459
- Oh, ...
- These early ones are easy.

1252
00:59:29,562 --> 00:59:32,562
You got to use these early balls

1253
00:59:32,666 --> 00:59:34,907
and stands
to train yourself

1254
00:59:35,011 --> 00:59:38,114
to learn,
"How do I want to stack them?"

1255
00:59:38,217 --> 00:59:39,873
Anticipate what's coming,

1256
00:59:39,976 --> 00:59:42,838
which is six balls total.

1257
00:59:42,942 --> 00:59:45,045
And just like this game,

1258
00:59:45,148 --> 00:59:47,114
the longer
you get into this challenge,

1259
00:59:47,217 --> 00:59:49,528
the higher that becomes,
the more precarious.

1260
00:59:51,873 --> 00:59:54,424
Sue drops, got to start again.

1261
00:59:54,528 --> 00:59:56,390
- Oh.
- PROBST: Sam loses everything.

1262
00:59:56,493 --> 00:59:57,735
Got to clear the whole deck.

1263
00:59:57,838 --> 01:00:01,011
If you drop,
everything comes off.

1264
01:00:02,080 --> 01:00:04,390
Genevieve places another ball.

1265
01:00:04,493 --> 01:00:06,528
Rachel places another ball.

1266
01:00:06,631 --> 01:00:08,355
Damn. No.

1267
01:00:08,459 --> 01:00:10,080
PROBST:
It is Genevieve
gonna lose everything.

1268
01:00:10,183 --> 01:00:12,528
It's now Rachel in the lead.

1269
01:00:12,631 --> 01:00:15,735
Rachel loses everything.
Now it's Teeny in the lead.

1270
01:00:16,873 --> 01:00:19,700
Teeny drops.
We're virtually starting again.

1271
01:00:19,804 --> 01:00:22,700
This is one of those challenges
that's gonna be maddening.

1272
01:00:22,804 --> 01:00:25,804
- Oh.
- PROBST: You're gonna
make progress, it's gonna drop.

1273
01:00:25,907 --> 01:00:27,355
But if you're playing smart,

1274
01:00:27,459 --> 01:00:30,700
you're paying attention
to what you did wrong.

1275
01:00:30,804 --> 01:00:32,528
Everybody's gonna drop.

1276
01:00:32,631 --> 01:00:34,493
This is about learning
how to get better

1277
01:00:34,597 --> 01:00:35,976
at this specific,

1278
01:00:36,080 --> 01:00:39,183
weird <i>Survivor</i> challenge.

1279
01:00:58,252 --> 01:01:00,286
Genevieve...

1280
01:01:00,390 --> 01:01:02,286
places her fourth ball.

1281
01:01:02,390 --> 01:01:03,666
It's Genevieve in the lead,

1282
01:01:03,769 --> 01:01:06,769
by a bit, over Rachel.

1283
01:01:06,873 --> 01:01:09,045
Genevieve on one end,
Rachel on the other.

1284
01:01:09,148 --> 01:01:12,114
Right now,
in a battle for immunity.

1285
01:01:12,217 --> 01:01:14,528
Rachel places her fourth ball.

1286
01:01:14,631 --> 01:01:17,597
Genevieve has her fourth ball
and a stand.

1287
01:01:17,700 --> 01:01:20,355
So it's Genevieve in the lead,
Rachel trying to catch her.

1288
01:01:20,459 --> 01:01:22,459
It's another familiar situation.

1289
01:01:22,562 --> 01:01:25,080
Do you want to press it,
try to catch,

1290
01:01:25,183 --> 01:01:27,011
or you're gonna wait
for them to fall and just keep

1291
01:01:27,114 --> 01:01:28,424
with your game?

1292
01:01:28,528 --> 01:01:30,700
Genevieve placing
her fifth ball.

1293
01:01:30,804 --> 01:01:33,493
There are only six total.
You've got a fifth ball,

1294
01:01:33,597 --> 01:01:35,873
- Let go.
- then a stand and a final ball,

1295
01:01:35,976 --> 01:01:37,666
if you can get it to stay.

1296
01:01:37,769 --> 01:01:40,735
Rachel places her fifth ball.

1297
01:01:42,148 --> 01:01:44,114
Rachel loses everything.

1298
01:01:44,217 --> 01:01:46,390
The smallest vibration
on that platform can do it.

1299
01:01:46,493 --> 01:01:48,976
- No. I...
- PROBST: Genevieve drops.

1300
01:01:49,080 --> 01:01:50,424
It's now Sam.

1301
01:01:50,528 --> 01:01:52,286
Sam drops.

1302
01:01:52,390 --> 01:01:55,769
We're starting again.
Everybody is in this.

1303
01:01:55,873 --> 01:01:59,183
You cannot give up.
You got to dig in again.

1304
01:01:59,286 --> 01:02:00,769
Ugh!

1305
01:02:03,873 --> 01:02:04,907
Nope.

1306
01:02:09,390 --> 01:02:10,390
Ah...

1307
01:02:12,424 --> 01:02:13,493
Oh.

1308
01:02:18,942 --> 01:02:20,562
Rachel back out
with her fifth ball.

1309
01:02:20,666 --> 01:02:24,045
Here comes Genevieve
with her fifth.

1310
01:02:24,148 --> 01:02:25,838
There are only six total.

1311
01:02:27,114 --> 01:02:29,355
We're back
to a duel on the corners.

1312
01:02:29,459 --> 01:02:31,045
Rachel and Genevieve

1313
01:02:31,148 --> 01:02:34,769
have been making more
and more progress every round.

1314
01:02:34,873 --> 01:02:38,011
That's encouraging,
but it doesn't get you the win.

1315
01:02:38,114 --> 01:02:39,700
You've got to finish.

1316
01:02:39,804 --> 01:02:42,011
It is Rachel right now
coming back with her last stand.

1317
01:02:42,114 --> 01:02:43,907
Then one more ball,

1318
01:02:44,011 --> 01:02:45,424
and immunity is hers.

1319
01:02:47,148 --> 01:02:49,148
Genevieve one ball behind.

1320
01:02:50,321 --> 01:02:51,942
Genevieve continuing to dig,

1321
01:02:52,045 --> 01:02:54,493
hoping for a drop from Rachel.

1322
01:02:56,286 --> 01:02:59,148
Here comes Rachel
with the sixth and final ball,

1323
01:02:59,252 --> 01:03:01,459
guaranteeing her a spot

1324
01:03:01,562 --> 01:03:03,804
in the final four.

1325
01:03:03,907 --> 01:03:07,424
Genevieve trying to catch her,
hoping for disaster.

1326
01:03:07,528 --> 01:03:10,390
It's happened before.
Can it happen again?

1327
01:03:11,424 --> 01:03:12,424
It would be Rachel's

1328
01:03:12,528 --> 01:03:15,631
third individual immunity win.

1329
01:03:17,286 --> 01:03:18,735
PROBST: Here comes Genevieve.

1330
01:03:18,838 --> 01:03:21,666
She's got two things left:
one stand and one ball.

1331
01:03:27,045 --> 01:03:29,045
Rachel placing that ball.

1332
01:03:34,011 --> 01:03:36,045
It's dancing around.

1333
01:03:40,838 --> 01:03:42,838
Genevieve places
her final stand.

1334
01:03:42,942 --> 01:03:44,804
She has one ball left.

1335
01:03:44,907 --> 01:03:47,286
Rachel's placed the sixth ball.

1336
01:03:47,390 --> 01:03:49,148
Now she's trying
to get that pole out of there

1337
01:03:49,252 --> 01:03:50,562
without touching anything.

1338
01:03:50,666 --> 01:03:51,873
Then she has to
get off the stand

1339
01:03:51,976 --> 01:03:53,700
and back to the platform.

1340
01:03:53,804 --> 01:03:56,700
Genevieve right on her tail.

1341
01:03:57,769 --> 01:03:59,286
Rachel trying to keep that ball

1342
01:03:59,390 --> 01:04:02,528
- Don't worry.
- and stack in place.

1343
01:04:03,873 --> 01:04:05,631
Can she do it?

1344
01:04:14,700 --> 01:04:17,735
Genevieve drops
and loses everything!

1345
01:04:18,942 --> 01:04:21,804
It is now
Rachel's challenge to win.

1346
01:04:21,907 --> 01:04:23,390
All eyes on Rachel right now.

1347
01:04:23,493 --> 01:04:26,148
Does she have it?

1348
01:04:31,045 --> 01:04:33,873
- You go, girl.
- And she does. It's over!

1349
01:04:33,976 --> 01:04:37,838
- Rachel has won her third
individual immunity,
- So proud of you.

1350
01:04:37,942 --> 01:04:39,976
- guaranteeing herself a spot
- You did it, you did it,
you did it.

1351
01:04:40,080 --> 01:04:42,114
- in the final four.
- You did it.

1352
01:04:42,217 --> 01:04:44,976
Wow, what a challenge.

1353
01:04:45,080 --> 01:04:47,080
Well done.

1354
01:04:49,080 --> 01:04:51,424
Good job.

1355
01:04:51,528 --> 01:04:53,942
Well done, Rachel.

1356
01:04:54,045 --> 01:04:56,011
Good job.

1357
01:04:59,976 --> 01:05:02,011
[sighs]

1358
01:05:04,321 --> 01:05:05,769
Rachel, come on over.

1359
01:05:05,873 --> 01:05:07,321
Good job, Rachel.

1360
01:05:08,804 --> 01:05:10,252
Beka woman.

1361
01:05:10,355 --> 01:05:13,459
For the third time,
individual immunity is yours.

1362
01:05:13,562 --> 01:05:15,080
Means you are safe tonight,

1363
01:05:15,183 --> 01:05:17,080
guaranteed a spot
in the final four.

1364
01:05:17,183 --> 01:05:18,873
You cannot be voted out
of this game.

1365
01:05:18,976 --> 01:05:21,459
- Thank God, Jeff.
- At the very least,

1366
01:05:21,562 --> 01:05:23,838
you've earned yourself a spot
in the fire-making challenge.

1367
01:05:23,942 --> 01:05:25,183
As for the rest of you,

1368
01:05:25,286 --> 01:05:28,183
tonight the dream will end
for one of you.

1369
01:05:28,286 --> 01:05:31,183
Fourteenth person voted out,
seventh member of our jury.

1370
01:05:31,286 --> 01:05:32,700
It won't be you.
Congrats.

1371
01:05:32,804 --> 01:05:34,183
Grab your stuff, head out.
See you tonight of Tribal.

1372
01:05:34,286 --> 01:05:36,459
- Thanks, Jeff. Can I have a hug?
- Of course.

1373
01:05:36,562 --> 01:05:37,976
Well done.

1374
01:05:39,631 --> 01:05:41,321
<i>GENEVIEVE:
I'm incredibly bummed</i>

1375
01:05:41,424 --> 01:05:43,873
<i>that Rachel has won
the challenge.</i>

1376
01:05:43,976 --> 01:05:45,804
<i>Had anyone else won,</i>

1377
01:05:45,907 --> 01:05:47,873
<i>she would have been
going home tonight.</i>

1378
01:05:47,976 --> 01:05:49,528
<i>And now that's not happening.</i>

1379
01:05:49,631 --> 01:05:52,424
<i>So the best thing
I can think of is</i>

1380
01:05:52,528 --> 01:05:55,390
<i>I've got this fake idol that
everyone is afraid is real.</i>

1381
01:05:55,493 --> 01:05:57,045
<i>So,</i>

1382
01:05:57,148 --> 01:06:00,321
it's not over yet.
It's not over yet.

1383
01:06:06,666 --> 01:06:08,700
♪ ♪

1384
01:06:16,493 --> 01:06:18,528
- Thank you.
- Go, Rachel!

1385
01:06:21,011 --> 01:06:23,045
<i>RACHEL:
Oh, my God.</i>

1386
01:06:23,148 --> 01:06:26,080
I won immunity
when I needed it so badly.

1387
01:06:26,183 --> 01:06:28,493
- SUE: That was a tough one.
- I needed it.
I knew I needed it.

1388
01:06:28,597 --> 01:06:31,355
Great for you.
Great for you, Rachel.

1389
01:06:31,459 --> 01:06:33,355
Genevieve, you're playing
your idol for yourself tonight?

1390
01:06:33,459 --> 01:06:34,700
We shall see.

1391
01:06:34,804 --> 01:06:36,252
<i>RACHEL:
The last couple days,</i>

1392
01:06:36,355 --> 01:06:38,148
<i>I've been carrying around
this rivalry</i>

1393
01:06:38,252 --> 01:06:40,045
<i>between Genevieve and me.</i>

1394
01:06:40,148 --> 01:06:43,976
<i>And knowing that she's secure
tonight with her idol</i>

1395
01:06:44,080 --> 01:06:47,700
<i>and knowing that I was backed
completely into a corner,</i>

1396
01:06:47,804 --> 01:06:51,562
drove me today to get it done.

1397
01:06:52,562 --> 01:06:55,804
Never in a million years thought
that that would be the case.

1398
01:06:55,907 --> 01:06:57,390
SAM:
I tried to tell 'em at,
like, the final nine,

1399
01:06:57,493 --> 01:07:00,217
but nobody wanted to listen
to little old Sam.

1400
01:07:00,321 --> 01:07:02,355
- [Genevieve chuckles]
- That I was gonna do well?

1401
01:07:02,459 --> 01:07:04,148
That you were gonna win the game
if we didn't vote you out.

1402
01:07:04,252 --> 01:07:05,493
RACHEL:
What?!

1403
01:07:05,597 --> 01:07:06,666
- Yeah.
- You did not.

1404
01:07:06,769 --> 01:07:08,080
SAM:
Swear.

1405
01:07:08,183 --> 01:07:10,114
<i>Rachel wins immunity,
her third win.</i>

1406
01:07:10,217 --> 01:07:13,390
<i>The most defeating
of them all to this point.</i>

1407
01:07:13,493 --> 01:07:15,804
<i>Rachel's got her ticket
to the final four,</i>

1408
01:07:15,907 --> 01:07:19,355
and my path to winning this game
got a lot more complicated.

1409
01:07:19,459 --> 01:07:23,183
<i>If everybody
believes Genevieve is safe,</i>

1410
01:07:23,286 --> 01:07:25,286
I'm probably
the most likely target.

1411
01:07:25,390 --> 01:07:28,286
<i>But I know
Genevieve's idol is fake,</i>

1412
01:07:28,390 --> 01:07:29,873
<i>because I helped her make it.</i>

1413
01:07:29,976 --> 01:07:33,700
<i>And so, as close
as I am with Genevieve,</i>

1414
01:07:33,804 --> 01:07:35,562
<i>with Rachel immune,</i>

1415
01:07:35,666 --> 01:07:37,114
Genevieve has to go tonight.

1416
01:07:39,873 --> 01:07:41,700
I might be making

1417
01:07:41,804 --> 01:07:43,769
a million-dollar
mistake right now,

1418
01:07:43,873 --> 01:07:45,355
but I'm gonna do it anyway.

1419
01:07:45,459 --> 01:07:47,459
And you might not believe me.

1420
01:07:49,011 --> 01:07:50,942
Genevieve's idol is fake.

1421
01:07:51,045 --> 01:07:53,045
- Seriously?
- I-I made it with her.

1422
01:07:53,148 --> 01:07:55,666
- Seriously?
- At the final seven.

1423
01:07:55,769 --> 01:07:57,252
We made it on the reward.

1424
01:07:59,355 --> 01:08:00,976
- Wow.
- So...

1425
01:08:01,080 --> 01:08:02,804
- So she has...
- She doesn't have an idol?

1426
01:08:02,907 --> 01:08:05,321
Genevieve does not
have an idol tonight.

1427
01:08:05,424 --> 01:08:07,459
- A hundred percent confirmed?
- One million percent.

1428
01:08:07,562 --> 01:08:10,080
I made that thing with her,
and Andy knew that.

1429
01:08:10,183 --> 01:08:13,528
We showed it to him on the
reward, which got him to flip.

1430
01:08:13,631 --> 01:08:16,459
That make-that makes everything
make so much more sense.

1431
01:08:16,562 --> 01:08:19,321
Everything makes so much more--
Thank you for that.

1432
01:08:19,424 --> 01:08:21,286
<i>SAM:
I can tell
Teeny's mind is melting.</i>

1433
01:08:21,390 --> 01:08:23,976
<i>I see her realize</i>

1434
01:08:24,080 --> 01:08:26,355
in real time, "Oh, crap.

1435
01:08:26,459 --> 01:08:29,562
I've known nothing about what's
actually going on in this game."

1436
01:08:29,666 --> 01:08:31,838
<i>I see confusion,</i>

1437
01:08:31,942 --> 01:08:35,045
<i>I see betrayal, I see fear.</i>

1438
01:08:35,148 --> 01:08:37,562
And that's kind of the
exact reaction I'm hoping for.

1439
01:08:37,666 --> 01:08:39,804
I'm hoping that Teeny will feel

1440
01:08:39,907 --> 01:08:42,631
so betrayed by Genevieve,

1441
01:08:42,735 --> 01:08:46,114
so thankful to me
for finally coming clean that

1442
01:08:46,217 --> 01:08:48,631
<i>there will be no doubt
in her mind what has to happen.</i>

1443
01:08:48,735 --> 01:08:51,148
Genevieve has to go home.

1444
01:08:51,252 --> 01:08:53,355
<i>TEENY:
So, we could get
Genevieve tonight?</i>

1445
01:08:53,459 --> 01:08:56,355
We probably would have to
convince Rachel and Sue

1446
01:08:56,459 --> 01:08:58,183
that it really is a fake idol.

1447
01:08:58,286 --> 01:09:00,252
And then get them
to vote on Genevieve.

1448
01:09:01,286 --> 01:09:02,666
<i>TEENY:
Wow!</i>

1449
01:09:03,873 --> 01:09:06,700
I actually can't even
get myself to think straight.

1450
01:09:07,735 --> 01:09:09,459
<i>My brain can't catch up</i>

1451
01:09:09,562 --> 01:09:12,148
<i>to all the things that I need</i>

1452
01:09:12,252 --> 01:09:15,321
to unlearn about
what I thought was going on.

1453
01:09:19,148 --> 01:09:22,562
<i>TEENY:
There was no clue
under a pizza slice.</i>

1454
01:09:22,666 --> 01:09:23,838
<i>Genevieve's idol</i>

1455
01:09:23,942 --> 01:09:25,183
is fake.

1456
01:09:25,286 --> 01:09:26,528
It was never real.

1457
01:09:26,631 --> 01:09:28,907
<i>I'm literally
rewinding the tapes</i>

1458
01:09:29,011 --> 01:09:31,597
<i>on every conversation
that I've had...</i>

1459
01:09:37,011 --> 01:09:38,873
<i>TEENY:
...and every opportunity</i>

1460
01:09:38,976 --> 01:09:41,907
<i>that I've let Genevieve
trick me and trick me.</i>

1461
01:09:42,011 --> 01:09:43,769
Me and Genevieve are voting...

1462
01:09:45,459 --> 01:09:46,873
<i>TEENY:
And it goes
all the way back to...</i>

1463
01:09:46,976 --> 01:09:48,217
PROBST:
Fourth person voted out of

1464
01:09:48,321 --> 01:09:49,493
<i>Survivor</i> 47: Kishan.

1465
01:09:49,597 --> 01:09:50,769
<i>TEENY:
...Genevieve voting out Kishan.</i>

1466
01:09:50,873 --> 01:09:52,459
<i>TEENY:
I don't understand</i>

1467
01:09:52,562 --> 01:09:53,666
how they got
the numbers to do you.

1468
01:09:53,769 --> 01:09:55,321
No.
What is happening?

1469
01:09:55,424 --> 01:09:57,252
<i>TEENY:
Then Genevieve decided
to get Sol out.</i>

1470
01:09:57,355 --> 01:09:58,907
The tribe has spoken.

1471
01:10:03,666 --> 01:10:05,700
Why?

1472
01:10:07,148 --> 01:10:09,183
<i>TEENY:
Then Sam, Andy and Genevieve</i>

1473
01:10:09,286 --> 01:10:11,631
<i>concocted one
of the most intricate</i>

1474
01:10:11,735 --> 01:10:13,562
<i>missions of this game:</i>

1475
01:10:13,666 --> 01:10:15,045
Operation Italy...

1476
01:10:15,148 --> 01:10:17,252
Twelfth person voted out
of <i>Survivor</i> 47:

1477
01:10:17,355 --> 01:10:19,080
Caroline.

1478
01:10:19,183 --> 01:10:20,838
<i>TEENY:
...fooling me
and getting Caroline out.</i>

1479
01:10:20,942 --> 01:10:21,942
PROBST:
The tribe has spoken.

1480
01:10:23,562 --> 01:10:25,390
<i>TEENY:
And I fell into</i>

1481
01:10:25,493 --> 01:10:28,114
<i>every single trap.</i>

1482
01:10:28,217 --> 01:10:31,390
<i>How could I have been so stupid?</i>

1483
01:10:32,390 --> 01:10:33,666
If her idol is fake,

1484
01:10:33,769 --> 01:10:34,976
and I've been granted
the knowledge of that,

1485
01:10:35,080 --> 01:10:37,597
I would be a fool
not to eliminate Genevieve

1486
01:10:37,700 --> 01:10:40,286
and end this chapter
of her fooling me

1487
01:10:40,390 --> 01:10:42,631
with me getting the last word.

1488
01:10:42,735 --> 01:10:44,873
What if I told you
Genevieve wasn't safe?

1489
01:10:44,976 --> 01:10:46,355
The idol's fake.

1490
01:10:46,459 --> 01:10:50,011
Sam told me that Andy,
him and Genevieve made the idol.

1491
01:10:52,321 --> 01:10:55,217
SUE: You think she told him
to tell you that?

1492
01:10:55,321 --> 01:10:57,459
- 'Cause they're
scamming something.
- RACHEL: Yeah.

1493
01:10:57,562 --> 01:11:00,217
It's just a little bit fishy.

1494
01:11:00,321 --> 01:11:02,804

an idol and you want to play it,

1725
01:21:57,148 --> 01:21:59,976
tonight is the last night
you can do so.

1726
01:22:09,011 --> 01:22:10,769
I told you it was fake.

1727
01:22:11,735 --> 01:22:12,769
Aw.

1728
01:22:16,080 --> 01:22:18,045
- All right, I'll read the votes.
- SUE: Jeff?

1729
01:22:18,148 --> 01:22:19,735
I'd like to say something.

1730
01:22:19,838 --> 01:22:22,252
I found this immunity idol

1731
01:22:22,355 --> 01:22:24,976
that I would like
to play tonight for myself.

1732
01:22:25,080 --> 01:22:26,735
[mouths]

1733
01:22:31,528 --> 01:22:33,528
- Thank you.
- You're welcome.

1734
01:22:41,080 --> 01:22:43,666
This is a hidden immunity idol.

1735
01:22:43,769 --> 01:22:46,528
Any votes cast
for Sue will not count.

1736
01:22:49,217 --> 01:22:50,873
I'll read the votes.

1737
01:22:53,217 --> 01:22:54,355
First vote:

1738
01:22:54,459 --> 01:22:55,838
Genevieve.

1739
01:22:59,286 --> 01:23:01,804
Sam. That's one vote Genevieve,
one vote Sam.

1740
01:23:06,321 --> 01:23:09,355
Sam. That's two votes Sam,
one vote Genevieve.

1741
01:23:16,045 --> 01:23:17,735
Genevieve.

1742
01:23:17,838 --> 01:23:19,942
We're tied.
Two votes Genevieve,

1743
01:23:20,045 --> 01:23:22,252
two votes Sam, one vote left.

1744
01:23:26,217 --> 01:23:27,838
Fourteenth person voted out

1745
01:23:27,942 --> 01:23:29,735
and the seventh member
of our jury:

1746
01:23:29,838 --> 01:23:31,631
Genevieve.

1747
01:23:31,735 --> 01:23:33,321
Need to bring me your torch.

1748
01:23:34,390 --> 01:23:35,528
SUE:
Good playing, Genevieve.

1749
01:23:35,631 --> 01:23:37,321
- RACHEL: Good game, Genevieve.
- Hugs.

1750
01:23:40,355 --> 01:23:42,390
Come on, give me one.

1751
01:23:47,217 --> 01:23:49,217
Sorry for all the spinning.

1752
01:23:50,321 --> 01:23:51,769
[Teeny mutters]

1753
01:23:59,597 --> 01:24:01,700
Nice.

1754
01:24:15,321 --> 01:24:17,321
Genevieve, the tribe has spoken.

1755
01:24:17,424 --> 01:24:19,321
They have.

1756
01:24:19,424 --> 01:24:20,838
Thank you for the opportunity.

1757
01:24:20,942 --> 01:24:23,045
- I had the time of my life.
- Thanks for being here.

1758
01:24:23,148 --> 01:24:24,528
- Time for you to go.
- TEENY: Bye, Genevieve.

1759
01:24:24,631 --> 01:24:25,976
- Good luck.
- SUE: Bye, Genevieve.

1760
01:24:36,838 --> 01:24:40,148
Congratulations on surviving
another stage of this game.

1761
01:24:40,252 --> 01:24:42,838
You can no longer be voted out.

1762
01:24:42,942 --> 01:24:45,873
Tomorrow you'll compete in
your final immunity challenge.

1763
01:24:45,976 --> 01:24:48,769
The winner earns a spot
in the final three.

1764
01:24:48,873 --> 01:24:51,493
For the other three,
at the very least,

1765
01:24:51,597 --> 01:24:53,700
you'll be making fire,
which means,

1766
01:24:53,804 --> 01:24:57,183
Teeny, Rachel, Sue, Sam,

1767
01:24:57,286 --> 01:24:59,631
any one of you
could win this game.

1768
01:24:59,735 --> 01:25:02,355
Grab your torches.
Head back to camp. Good night.

1769
01:25:03,493 --> 01:25:05,011
Thank you.

1770
01:25:20,045 --> 01:25:22,907
Captioning sponsored by
CBS

1771
01:25:23,011 --> 01:25:25,942
and TOYOTA.

1772
01:25:26,045 --> 01:25:29,045
Captioned by
Media Access Group at WGBH
access.wgbh.org

1773
01:25:31,666 --> 01:25:33,907
<i>RACHEL:
This is the last stand,</i>

1774
01:25:34,011 --> 01:25:35,252
<i>the final battle.</i>

1775
01:25:35,355 --> 01:25:36,666
<i>PROBST:
Next time</i>

1776
01:25:36,769 --> 01:25:39,528
<i>on the season finale
of</i> Survivor...

1777
01:25:39,631 --> 01:25:43,011
You want it, this is where
you step up and grab it!

1778
01:25:43,114 --> 01:25:45,666
- [grunts]
<i>- SUE: I want to</i>

1779
01:25:45,769 --> 01:25:47,666
scream! I'm so pumped!

1780
01:25:48,769 --> 01:25:50,045
<i>SAM:
You don't want to play 25 days</i>

1781
01:25:50,148 --> 01:25:51,666
and come up that short.

1782
01:25:51,769 --> 01:25:53,838
<i>TEENY:
This is gonna be a bloodbath.</i>

1783
01:25:54,942 --> 01:25:56,321
<i>RACHEL:
My only option</i>

1784
01:25:56,424 --> 01:25:57,666
is to kick ass.

1785
01:26:01,804 --> 01:26:03,114
I just got voted out.

1786
01:26:03,217 --> 01:26:05,321
Five is as far as I get
to go in this game.

1787
01:26:05,424 --> 01:26:08,735
<i>But I am so proud
of how I played out here.</i>

1788
01:26:08,838 --> 01:26:11,321
<i>I exceeded my expectations,</i>

1789
01:26:11,424 --> 01:26:13,252
<i>and my expectations were high.</i>

1790
01:26:13,355 --> 01:26:16,252
<i>I wanted the million. I didn't
get there, but I did better.</i>

1791
01:26:16,355 --> 01:26:17,769
<i>And I'm more
proud of myself than</i>

1792
01:26:17,873 --> 01:26:20,217
I imagined that I could be.

1793
01:26:20,321 --> 01:26:22,045
[roars]
